package utils

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"regexp"
	"strings"

	dysmsapi "github.com/alibabacloud-go/dysmsapi-20170525/v3/client"
	openapi "github.com/alibabacloud-go/darabonba-openapi/v2/client"
	util "github.com/alibabacloud-go/tea-utils/v2/service"
	"github.com/alibabacloud-go/tea/tea"
)

// SMSConfig represents Aliyun SMS configuration
type SMSConfig struct {
	AccessKeyID     string
	AccessSecret    string
	SignName        string
	TemplateCode    string
	TemplateContent string // 模板内容,如: 您的验证码是${code},有效期为5分钟
	Endpoint        string
}

// ExtractTemplateVariables extracts variable names from template content
// Example: "您的验证码是${code},有效期${min}分钟" -> ["code", "min"]
func ExtractTemplateVariables(templateContent string) []string {
	re := regexp.MustCompile(`\$\{([^}]+)\}`)
	matches := re.FindAllStringSubmatch(templateContent, -1)

	variables := make([]string, 0, len(matches))
	seen := make(map[string]bool)

	for _, match := range matches {
		if len(match) > 1 {
			varName := match[1]
			if !seen[varName] {
				variables = append(variables, varName)
				seen[varName] = true
			}
		}
	}

	return variables
}

// BuildTemplateParams builds template parameters JSON from variable map
// Example: {"code": "123456", "min": "5"} -> {"code":"123456","min":"5"}
func BuildTemplateParams(params map[string]string) (string, error) {
	if len(params) == 0 {
		return "{}", nil
	}

	jsonBytes, err := json.Marshal(params)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal template params: %w", err)
	}

	return string(jsonBytes), nil
}

// CreateSMSClient creates an Aliyun SMS client
func CreateSMSClient(accessKeyID, accessSecret, endpoint string) (*dysmsapi.Client, error) {
	// Trim any whitespace from credentials
	accessKeyID = strings.TrimSpace(accessKeyID)
	accessSecret = strings.TrimSpace(accessSecret)
	endpoint = strings.TrimSpace(endpoint)

	log.Printf("[SMS] Creating client with endpoint: %s, AccessKeyID length: %d", endpoint, len(accessKeyID))

	config := &openapi.Config{
		AccessKeyId:     tea.String(accessKeyID),
		AccessKeySecret: tea.String(accessSecret),
		Endpoint:        tea.String(endpoint),
	}

	client, err := dysmsapi.NewClient(config)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create SMS client: %w", err)
	}

	log.Printf("[SMS] Client created successfully")
	return client, nil
}

// SendSMS sends SMS with dynamic template parameters
// params: map of template variables, e.g., map[string]string{"code": "123456", "min": "5"}
func SendSMS(config SMSConfig, phoneNumber string, params map[string]string) error {
	// Create SMS client
	client, err := CreateSMSClient(config.AccessKeyID, config.AccessSecret, config.Endpoint)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// Build template parameters JSON
	templateParam, err := BuildTemplateParams(params)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	log.Printf("[SMS] Sending SMS to: %s", phoneNumber)
	log.Printf("[SMS] SignName: %s (len: %d)", config.SignName, len(config.SignName))
	log.Printf("[SMS] TemplateCode: %s (len: %d, bytes: %v)", config.TemplateCode, len(config.TemplateCode), []byte(config.TemplateCode))
	log.Printf("[SMS] TemplateParam: %s", templateParam)
	log.Printf("[SMS] Endpoint: %s", config.Endpoint)

	// Check if TemplateCode needs SMS_ prefix
	templateCode := config.TemplateCode
	// If template code is purely numeric and doesn't start with SMS_, log a warning
	if len(templateCode) > 0 && templateCode[0] >= '0' && templateCode[0] <= '9' {
		log.Printf("[SMS] Note: TemplateCode is numeric (%s). If this fails, you may need to use format SMS_%s", templateCode, templateCode)
	}

	// Create request
	request := &dysmsapi.SendSmsRequest{
		PhoneNumbers:  tea.String(phoneNumber),
		SignName:      tea.String(config.SignName),
		TemplateCode:  tea.String(templateCode),
		TemplateParam: tea.String(templateParam),
	}

	// Log the actual values being sent
	log.Printf("[SMS] ========== Request Details ==========")
	log.Printf("[SMS] PhoneNumbers: %v", tea.StringValue(request.PhoneNumbers))
	log.Printf("[SMS] SignName: %v", tea.StringValue(request.SignName))
	log.Printf("[SMS] TemplateCode: %v", tea.StringValue(request.TemplateCode))
	log.Printf("[SMS] TemplateParam: %v", tea.StringValue(request.TemplateParam))
	log.Printf("[SMS] TemplateParam bytes: %v", []byte(tea.StringValue(request.TemplateParam)))
	log.Printf("[SMS] ==========================================")

	runtime := &util.RuntimeOptions{}

	// Send SMS
	resp, err := client.SendSmsWithOptions(request, runtime)
	if err != nil {
		log.Printf("[SMS] Send failed with error: %v", err)
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to send SMS: %w", err)
	}

	// Log detailed response
	log.Printf("[SMS] ========== Aliyun SMS Response ==========")
	if resp != nil {
		if resp.Body != nil {
			log.Printf("[SMS] Response Body:")
			log.Printf("[SMS]   - Code: %s", tea.StringValue(resp.Body.Code))
			log.Printf("[SMS]   - Message: %s", tea.StringValue(resp.Body.Message))
			log.Printf("[SMS]   - RequestId: %s", tea.StringValue(resp.Body.RequestId))
			log.Printf("[SMS]   - BizId: %s", tea.StringValue(resp.Body.BizId))
		}
		log.Printf("[SMS] Status Code: %d", tea.Int32Value(resp.StatusCode))
	}
	log.Printf("[SMS] ===========================================")

	// Check if SMS was actually sent successfully
	if resp.Body != nil && resp.Body.Code != nil {
		code := tea.StringValue(resp.Body.Code)
		if code != "OK" {
			log.Printf("[SMS] Warning: SMS may not have been sent successfully. Code: %s, Message: %s",
				code, tea.StringValue(resp.Body.Message))
			return fmt.Errorf("SMS sending failed with code: %s, message: %s",
				code, tea.StringValue(resp.Body.Message))
		}
	}

	log.Printf("[SMS] Send successful!")
	return nil
}

// SendSMSVerificationCode sends SMS verification code using Aliyun SMS service
// This is a convenience function that assumes the template has a "code" variable
func SendSMSVerificationCode(config SMSConfig, phoneNumber, code string) error {
	// For backward compatibility, assume template has "code" variable
	params := map[string]string{
		"code": code,
	}

	return SendSMS(config, phoneNumber, params)
}

// SendSMSVerifyCodePNS sends SMS verification code using Aliyun Phone Number Service
// Uses CallApi method as per official documentation
func SendSMSVerifyCodePNS(config SMSConfig, phoneNumber string, params map[string]string) error {
	// Create OpenAPI client
	accessKeyID := strings.TrimSpace(config.AccessKeyID)
	accessSecret := strings.TrimSpace(config.AccessSecret)
	endpoint := strings.TrimSpace(config.Endpoint)

	log.Printf("[PNS] Creating client with endpoint: %s", endpoint)

	openapiConfig := &openapi.Config{
		AccessKeyId:     tea.String(accessKeyID),
		AccessKeySecret: tea.String(accessSecret),
		Endpoint:        tea.String(endpoint),
	}

	client, err := openapi.NewClient(openapiConfig)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create OpenAPI client: %w", err)
	}

	// Build template parameters JSON
	templateParam, err := BuildTemplateParams(params)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	log.Printf("[PNS] Sending SMS verification code to: %s", phoneNumber)
	log.Printf("[PNS] SignName: %s", config.SignName)
	log.Printf("[PNS] TemplateCode: %s", config.TemplateCode)
	log.Printf("[PNS] TemplateParam: %s", templateParam)

	// Create API params according to official example
	apiParams := &openapi.Params{
		Action:      tea.String("SendSmsVerifyCode"),
		Version:     tea.String("2017-05-25"),
		Protocol:    tea.String("HTTPS"),
		Method:      tea.String("POST"),
		AuthType:    tea.String("AK"),
		Style:       tea.String("RPC"),
		Pathname:    tea.String("/"),
		ReqBodyType: tea.String("json"),
		BodyType:    tea.String("json"),
	}

	// Create request body
	requestBody := map[string]interface{}{
		"PhoneNumber":   phoneNumber,
		"SignName":      config.SignName, // SignName is mandatory for PNS
		"TemplateCode":  config.TemplateCode,
		"TemplateParam": templateParam,
	}

	request := &openapi.OpenApiRequest{
		Body: requestBody,
	}

	runtime := &util.RuntimeOptions{}

	log.Printf("[PNS] ========== Request Details ==========")
	log.Printf("[PNS] PhoneNumber: %s", phoneNumber)
	log.Printf("[PNS] SignName: %s", config.SignName)
	log.Printf("[PNS] TemplateCode: %s", config.TemplateCode)
	log.Printf("[PNS] TemplateParam: %s", templateParam)
	log.Printf("[PNS] ==========================================")

	// Call API
	resp, err := client.CallApi(apiParams, request, runtime)
	if err != nil {
		log.Printf("[PNS] Send failed with error: %v", err)
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to send SMS verify code: %w", err)
	}

	// Log response
	log.Printf("[PNS] ========== Response ==========")
	if resp != nil {
		respBody, _ := json.Marshal(resp)
		log.Printf("[PNS] Response: %s", string(respBody))
	}
	log.Printf("[PNS] ====================================")

	// Check response code
	if resp != nil {
		if bodyMap, ok := resp["body"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
			if code, exists := bodyMap["Code"]; exists && code != "OK" {
				message := bodyMap["Message"]
				log.Printf("[PNS] Error: Code=%v, Message=%v", code, message)
				return fmt.Errorf("SMS sending failed with code: %v, message: %v", code, message)
			}
		}
	}

	log.Printf("[PNS] Send successful!")
	return nil
}

// ========== 文件: backend/internal/common/utils/useragent_parser.go ==========
// ============================================================================
// Scholay学术 V1.0
// Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
// 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
// All Rights Reserved.
// ============================================================================

package utils

import (
	"strings"

	"github.com/mileusna/useragent"
)

// DeviceInfo represents parsed user agent information
type DeviceInfo struct {
	DeviceType string `json:"device_type"` // Desktop, Mobile, Tablet, Bot
	OS         string `json:"os"`          // Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, etc.
	OSVersion  string `json:"os_version"`
	Browser    string `json:"browser"`      // Chrome, Firefox, Safari, etc.
	BrowserVersion string `json:"browser_version"`
	Platform   string `json:"platform"`     // windows, mac, linux, ios, android
	IsBot      bool   `json:"is_bot"`
	IsMobile   bool   `json:"is_mobile"`
	IsTablet   bool   `json:"is_tablet"`
	IsDesktop  bool   `json:"is_desktop"`
}

// ParseUserAgent parses user agent string into structured device info
func ParseUserAgent(uaString string) *DeviceInfo {
	if uaString == "" {
		return &DeviceInfo{
			DeviceType: "未知",
			OS:         "未知",
			Browser:    "未知",
			Platform:   "unknown",
		}
	}

	ua := useragent.Parse(uaString)

	deviceType := "桌面"
	if ua.Bot {
		deviceType = "机器人"
	} else if ua.Mobile {
		deviceType = "手机"
	} else if ua.Tablet {
		deviceType = "平板"
	} else if ua.Desktop {
		deviceType = "桌面"
	}

	// Get OS name in Chinese
	osName := getOSName(ua.OS, ua.OSVersion)
	
	// Get browser name
	browserName := getBrowserName(ua.Name, ua.Version)

	return &DeviceInfo{
		DeviceType:     deviceType,
		OS:             osName,
		OSVersion:      ua.OSVersion,
		Browser:        browserName,
		BrowserVersion: ua.Version,
		Platform:       strings.ToLower(ua.OS),
		IsBot:          ua.Bot,
		IsMobile:       ua.Mobile,
		IsTablet:       ua.Tablet,
		IsDesktop:      ua.Desktop,
	}
}

// getOSName returns Chinese OS name
func getOSName(os, version string) string {
	osLower := strings.ToLower(os)
	
	switch {
	case strings.Contains(osLower, "windows"):
		if version != "" {
			// Map Windows versions
			switch {
			case strings.Contains(version, "10"):
				return "Windows 10"
			case strings.Contains(version, "11"):
				return "Windows 11"
			case strings.Contains(version, "8"):
				return "Windows 8"
			case strings.Contains(version, "7"):
				return "Windows 7"
			default:
				return "Windows " + version
			}
		}
		return "Windows"
	case strings.Contains(osLower, "mac") || strings.Contains(osLower, "darwin"):
		return "macOS"
	case strings.Contains(osLower, "ios"):
		if version != "" {
			return "iOS " + version
		}
		return "iOS"
	case strings.Contains(osLower, "android"):
		if version != "" {
			return "Android " + version
		}
		return "Android"
	case strings.Contains(osLower, "linux"):
		return "Linux"
	case strings.Contains(osLower, "ubuntu"):
		return "Ubuntu"
	case strings.Contains(osLower, "chromeos"):
		return "Chrome OS"
	default:
		if os != "" {
			return os
		}
		return "未知系统"
	}
}

// getBrowserName returns browser display name
func getBrowserName(browser, version string) string {
	browserLower := strings.ToLower(browser)
	
	var displayName string
	switch {
	case strings.Contains(browserLower, "chrome"):
		displayName = "Chrome"
	case strings.Contains(browserLower, "firefox"):
		displayName = "Firefox"
	case strings.Contains(browserLower, "safari"):
		displayName = "Safari"
	case strings.Contains(browserLower, "edge"):
		displayName = "Edge"
	case strings.Contains(browserLower, "opera"):
		displayName = "Opera"
	case strings.Contains(browserLower, "ie") || strings.Contains(browserLower, "internet explorer"):
		displayName = "IE"
	case strings.Contains(browserLower, "wechat"):
		displayName = "微信浏览器"
	case strings.Contains(browserLower, "qq"):
		displayName = "QQ浏览器"
	default:
		if browser != "" {
			displayName = browser
		} else {
			displayName = "未知浏览器"
		}
	}

	// Add version if available and major version only
	if version != "" {
		// Extract major version (first number before dot)
		majorVersion := strings.Split(version, ".")[0]
		return displayName + " " + majorVersion
	}

	return displayName
}

// GetDeviceString returns a formatted device string for display
func GetDeviceString(info *DeviceInfo) string {
	if info == nil {
		return "未知设备"
	}

	if info.IsBot {
		return "机器人"
	}

	// Format: "设备类型 | 操作系统 | 浏览器"
	parts := []string{}
	
	if info.DeviceType != "" && info.DeviceType != "未知" {
		parts = append(parts, info.DeviceType)
	}
	
	if info.OS != "" && info.OS != "未知系统" {
		parts = append(parts, info.OS)
	}
	
	if info.Browser != "" && info.Browser != "未知浏览器" {
		parts = append(parts, info.Browser)
	}

	if len(parts) == 0 {
		return "未知设备"
	}

	return strings.Join(parts, " | ")
}

// GetSimpleDeviceString returns a shorter device description
func GetSimpleDeviceString(info *DeviceInfo) string {
	if info == nil {
		return "未知"
	}

	if info.IsBot {
		return "机器人"
	}

	// Format: "操作系统 浏览器"
	os := info.OS
	if os == "未知系统" || os == "" {
		os = info.DeviceType
	}

	browser := info.Browser
	if browser == "未知浏览器" || browser == "" {
		return os
	}

	return os + " " + browser
}

// GetEmailConfig handles getting active email configuration (admin only)
func (h *Handler) GetEmailConfig(c *gin.Context) {
	config, err := h.service.GetActiveEmailConfig()
	if err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 3006, "Failed to get email configuration")
		return
	}

	if config == nil {
		// Return empty config if not found
		utils.Success(c, nil)
		return
	}

	// Check if client requests unmasked password (via query parameter)
	showPassword := c.Query("show_password") == "true"

	if !showPassword {
		// Mask the password for security
		config.SMTPPassword = "********"
	}
	// If show_password=true, return the real password (client should verify admin first)

	utils.Success(c, config)
}

// UpdateEmailConfigRequest represents an update email config request
type UpdateEmailConfigRequest struct {
	SMTPHost     string `json:"smtpHost" binding:"required"`
	SMTPPort     int    `json:"smtpPort" binding:"required"`
	SMTPUser     string `json:"smtpUser" binding:"required"`
	SMTPPassword string `json:"smtpPassword"` // 不设置 required，允许留空
	FromEmail    string `json:"fromEmail" binding:"required,email"`
	FromName     string `json:"fromName" binding:"required"`
}

// UpdateEmailConfig handles updating email configuration (admin only)
func (h *Handler) UpdateEmailConfig(c *gin.Context) {
	var req UpdateEmailConfigRequest
	if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
		utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
		return
	}

	// Get existing config to check if this is an update
	existingConfig, err := h.service.GetActiveEmailConfig()
	if err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 3002, "Failed to get existing email configuration")
		return
	}

	// If password is empty and config exists, keep the old password
	password := req.SMTPPassword
	if password == "" && existingConfig != nil {
		password = existingConfig.SMTPPassword
	} else if password == "" && existingConfig == nil {
		// New config must have password
		utils.BadRequest(c, "Password is required for new email configuration")
		return
	}

	config := &model.EmailConfig{
		SMTPHost:     req.SMTPHost,
		SMTPPort:     req.SMTPPort,
		SMTPUser:     req.SMTPUser,
		SMTPPassword: password,
		FromEmail:    req.FromEmail,
		FromName:     req.FromName,
		IsActive:     true,
	}

	err = h.service.CreateEmailConfig(config)
	if err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 3002, "Failed to update email configuration")
		return
	}

	utils.SuccessWithMessage(c, "Email configuration updated successfully", config)
}

// GetSystemConfig handles getting system configuration
func (h *Handler) GetSystemConfig(c *gin.Context) {
	config, err := h.service.GetSystemConfig()
	if err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 3003, "Failed to get system configuration")
		return
	}

	if config == nil {
		// Return default if not found
		config = &model.SystemConfig{
			RequireEmailVerification: true,
		}
	}

	// Get GitHub OAuth configuration
	githubConfig, err := h.service.GetGithubOAuthConfig()
	if err != nil {
		// Log error but don't fail the request
		// GitHub config is optional
		githubConfig = nil
	}

	// Build response with system config and GitHub config
	response := map[string]interface{}{
		"id":                         config.ID,
		"require_email_verification": config.RequireEmailVerification,
		"enable_turnstile":           config.EnableTurnstile,
		"turnstile_site_key":         config.TurnstileSiteKey,
		"turnstile_secret_key":       config.TurnstileSecretKey,
		"created_at":                 config.CreatedAt,
		"updated_at":                 config.UpdatedAt,
	}

	// Add GitHub client_id if configured and enabled
	if githubConfig != nil && githubConfig.Enabled && githubConfig.ClientID != "" {
		response["github_client_id"] = githubConfig.ClientID
	}

	utils.Success(c, response)
}

	SignName        string `json:"sign_name" binding:"required"`

}

// UpdateSMSConfig handles updating SMS configuration (admin only)
func (h *Handler) UpdateSMSConfig(c *gin.Context) {
	var req UpdateSMSConfigRequest
	if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
		utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
		return
	}

	// Get existing config to check if this is an update
	existingConfig, err := h.service.GetActiveSMSConfig()
	if err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 3008, "Failed to get existing SMS configuration")
		return
	}

	// If access secret is empty and config exists, keep the old secret
	accessSecret := req.AccessSecret
	if accessSecret == "" && existingConfig != nil {
		accessSecret = existingConfig.AccessSecret
	} else if accessSecret == "" && existingConfig == nil {
		// New config must have access secret
		utils.BadRequest(c, "Access secret is required for new SMS configuration")
		return
	}

	endpoint := req.Endpoint
	if endpoint == "" {
		endpoint = "dypnsapi.aliyuncs.com" // Phone Number Service for verification codes
	}

	// Trim whitespace from all string fields to avoid issues
	config := &model.SMSConfig{
		AccessKeyID:     strings.TrimSpace(req.AccessKeyID),
		AccessSecret:    strings.TrimSpace(accessSecret),
		SignName:        strings.TrimSpace(req.SignName),
		TemplateCode:    strings.TrimSpace(req.TemplateCode),
		TemplateContent: strings.TrimSpace(req.TemplateContent),
		Endpoint:        strings.TrimSpace(endpoint),
		IsActive:        true,
	}

	err = h.service.CreateSMSConfig(config)
	if err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 3008, "Failed to update SMS configuration")
		return
	}

	utils.SuccessWithMessage(c, "SMS configuration updated successfully", config)
}

// TestSMSConfigRequest represents a test SMS config request
type TestSMSConfigRequest struct {
	AccessKeyID     string `json:"access_key_id"`
	AccessSecret    string `json:"access_secret"`
	SignName        string `json:"sign_name"`
	TemplateCode    string `json:"template_code"`
	TemplateContent string `json:"template_content"`
	Endpoint        string `json:"endpoint"`
	PhoneNumber     string `json:"phone_number" binding:"required"`
	UseSavedConfig  bool   `json:"use_saved_config"` // 是否使用已保存的配置
}

// TestSMSConfig handles testing SMS configuration by sending a test SMS
func (h *Handler) TestSMSConfig(c *gin.Context) {
	var req TestSMSConfigRequest
	if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
		utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
		return
	}

	var smsConfig utils.SMSConfig
	var templateContent string

	// If using saved config, load from database
	if req.UseSavedConfig || req.AccessSecret == "" || req.AccessSecret == "********" {
		savedConfig, err := h.service.GetActiveSMSConfig()
		if err != nil {
			utils.Error(c, 3010, "Failed to get saved SMS configuration")
			return
		}
		if savedConfig == nil {
			utils.Error(c, 3011, "No saved SMS configuration found")
			return
		}

		// Use saved config
		endpoint := savedConfig.Endpoint
		if endpoint == "" {
			endpoint = "dypnsapi.aliyuncs.com"
		}

		smsConfig = utils.SMSConfig{
			AccessKeyID:     savedConfig.AccessKeyID,
			AccessSecret:    savedConfig.AccessSecret, // Use real secret from DB
			SignName:        savedConfig.SignName,
			TemplateCode:    savedConfig.TemplateCode,
			TemplateContent: savedConfig.TemplateContent,
			Endpoint:        endpoint,
		}
		templateContent = savedConfig.TemplateContent
	} else {
		// Use provided config (editing mode)
		endpoint := req.Endpoint
		if endpoint == "" {
			endpoint = "dypnsapi.aliyuncs.com"
		}

		smsConfig = utils.SMSConfig{
			AccessKeyID:     req.AccessKeyID,
			AccessSecret:    req.AccessSecret,
			SignName:        req.SignName,
			TemplateCode:    req.TemplateCode,
			TemplateContent: req.TemplateContent,
			Endpoint:        endpoint,
		}
		templateContent = req.TemplateContent
	}

	// Extract template variables from template content
	variables := utils.ExtractTemplateVariables(templateContent)

	// Build test parameters based on detected variables
	testParams := make(map[string]string)
	for _, varName := range variables {
		switch varName {
		case "code":
			testParams["code"] = "123456"
		case "min", "minute", "minutes":
			testParams[varName] = "5"
		case "product":
			testParams["product"] = "Scholay"
		default:
			// For unknown variables, use a placeholder
			testParams[varName] = "测试值"
		}
	}

	// Send test SMS using PNS CallApi method
	err := utils.SendSMSVerifyCodePNS(smsConfig, req.PhoneNumber, testParams)
	if err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 3009, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to send test SMS: %v", err))
		return
	}

	utils.SuccessWithMessage(c, "Test SMS sent successfully", nil)
}

// UpdateGithubOAuthConfigRequest represents an update GitHub OAuth config request
type UpdateGithubOAuthConfigRequest struct {
	ClientID     string `json:"client_id"`
	ClientSecret string `json:"client_secret"`
	RedirectURI  string `json:"redirect_uri"`
	Enabled      bool   `json:"enabled"`
}

// UpdateGithubOAuthConfig handles updating GitHub OAuth configuration (admin only)
func (h *Handler) UpdateGithubOAuthConfig(c *gin.Context) {
	var req UpdateGithubOAuthConfigRequest
	if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
		utils.BadRequest(c, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
		return
	}

	// Generate full callback URL from base domain
	callbackURL := req.RedirectURI
	if callbackURL != "" && !strings.HasSuffix(callbackURL, "/github/callback") {
		callbackURL = strings.TrimSuffix(callbackURL, "/") + "/github/callback"
	}

	err := h.service.UpdateGithubOAuthConfig(req.ClientID, req.ClientSecret, callbackURL, req.Enabled)
	if err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 3021, "Failed to update GitHub OAuth configuration")
		return
	}

	utils.SuccessWithMessage(c, "GitHub OAuth configuration updated successfully", nil)
}

// RegisterRoutes registers config routes
func (h *Handler) RegisterRoutes(router *gin.RouterGroup) {
	config := router.Group("/config")
	{
		// Public endpoints
		config.GET("/privacy-policy", h.GetPrivacyPolicy)
		config.GET("/terms-of-service", h.GetTermsOfService)
		config.GET("/system", h.GetSystemConfig)
	}
}

// FindActivePrivacyPolicy finds the active privacy policy
func (r *Repository) FindActivePrivacyPolicy() (*model.PrivacyPolicy, error) {
	var policy model.PrivacyPolicy
	err := r.db.Where("is_active = ?", true).
		Order("created_at DESC").
		First(&policy).Error

	if err == gorm.ErrRecordNotFound {
		return nil, nil
	}
	return &policy, err
}

	return r.db.Create(policy).Error
}

	return r.db.Model(&model.PrivacyPolicy{}).
		Where("is_active = ?", true).

}

4. 信息共享

最后更新日期：2025年1月`,

// UpdateSystemConfig updates system configuration
// SystemConfigPartialUpdate represents a partial update request for system config
type SystemConfigPartialUpdate struct {
	RequireEmailVerification *bool
	EnableTurnstile          *bool
	TurnstileSiteKey         *string
	TurnstileSecretKey       *string
}

// UpdateSystemConfigPartial updates system configuration with partial update support
// Only non-nil fields in the request will be updated
func (s *Service) UpdateSystemConfigPartial(req *SystemConfigPartialUpdate) error {
	config, err := s.repo.GetSystemConfig()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if config == nil {
		// Create new config with provided values (use defaults for nil fields)
		config = &model.SystemConfig{
			RequireEmailVerification: true, // default
		}
	}

	// Update only non-nil fields (partial update)
	if req.RequireEmailVerification != nil {
		config.RequireEmailVerification = *req.RequireEmailVerification
	}
	if req.EnableTurnstile != nil {
		config.EnableTurnstile = *req.EnableTurnstile
	}
	if req.TurnstileSiteKey != nil {
		config.TurnstileSiteKey = *req.TurnstileSiteKey
	}
	if req.TurnstileSecretKey != nil {
		config.TurnstileSecretKey = *req.TurnstileSecretKey
	}

	if config.ID == 0 {
		return s.repo.CreateSystemConfig(config)
	}
	return s.repo.UpdateSystemConfig(config)
}

// UpdateGithubOAuthConfig updates or creates GitHub OAuth configuration

	config, err := s.repo.GetGithubOAuthConfig()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if config == nil {
		// Create new config
		config = &model.GithubOAuthConfig{
			ClientID:     clientID,
			ClientSecret: clientSecret,
			RedirectURI:  redirectURI,
			Enabled:      enabled,
		}
		return s.repo.CreateGithubOAuthConfig(config)
	}

	// Update existing config
	config.ClientID = clientID
	config.ClientSecret = clientSecret
	config.RedirectURI = redirectURI
	config.Enabled = enabled
	return s.repo.UpdateGithubOAuthConfig(config)
}

type Handler struct {
	service *Service
}

func NewHandler(service *Service) *Handler {
	return &Handler{service: service}
}

// CreateConversation creates a new conversation
func (h *Handler) CreateConversation(c *gin.Context) {
	userID, exists := c.Get("user_id")
	if !exists {
		utils.Error(c, 401, "Unauthorized")
		return
	}

	var req CreateConversationRequest
	if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 400, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
		return
	}

	// Default to search type if not provided
	conversationType := req.ConversationType
	if conversationType == "" {
		conversationType = ConversationTypeSearch
	}

	conversation, err := h.service.CreateConversation(userID.(uint), req.Title, conversationType)
	if err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 500, "Failed to create conversation: "+err.Error())
		return
	}

	utils.Success(c, conversation)
}

// GetUserConversations gets all conversations for the current user
func (h *Handler) GetUserConversations(c *gin.Context) {
	userID, exists := c.Get("user_id")
	if !exists {
		utils.Error(c, 401, "Unauthorized")
		return
	}

	page, _ := strconv.Atoi(c.DefaultQuery("page", "1"))
	pageSize, _ := strconv.Atoi(c.DefaultQuery("page_size", "20"))

	// Optional conversation_type filter
	var conversationType *ConversationType
	if typeParam := c.Query("conversation_type"); typeParam != "" {
		convType := ConversationType(typeParam)
		conversationType = &convType
	}

	result, err := h.service.GetUserConversations(userID.(uint), page, pageSize, conversationType)
	if err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 500, "Failed to get conversations: "+err.Error())
		return
	}

	utils.Success(c, result)
}

// StreamAdvancedSearch 处理基于AI的智能分析请求（使用MCP工具）
func (h *Handler) StreamAdvancedSearch(c *gin.Context) {
	userID, exists := c.Get("user_id")
	if !exists {
		utils.Error(c, 401, "Unauthorized")
		return
	}

	conversationID, err := strconv.ParseUint(c.Param("id"), 10, 32)
	if err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 400, "Invalid conversation ID")
		return
	}

	messageID, err := strconv.ParseUint(c.Param("messageId"), 10, 32)
	if err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 400, "Invalid message ID")
		return
	}

	// Get model level from query parameter (default to "mid")
	modelLevelParam := c.DefaultQuery("model_level", "mid")
	var modelLevel string
	switch modelLevelParam {
	case "low", "mid", "high":
		modelLevel = modelLevelParam
	default:
		modelLevel = "mid"
	}

	// Verify conversation belongs to user
	conversation, err := h.service.GetConversationWithMessages(uint(conversationID), userID.(uint))
	if err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 404, "Conversation not found")
		return
	}

	// Find the target message
	var targetMessage *ConversationMessage
	for i := range conversation.Messages {
		if conversation.Messages[i].ID == uint(messageID) {
			targetMessage = &conversation.Messages[i]
			break
		}
	}

	if targetMessage == nil {
		utils.Error(c, 404, "Message not found")
		return
	}

	// Check quota BEFORE setting SSE headers to return proper HTTP error
	var featureType string
	switch modelLevel {
	case "low":
		featureType = "advanced_search_low"
	case "mid":
		featureType = "advanced_search_mid"
	case "high":
		featureType = "advanced_search_high"
	default:
		featureType = "advanced_search_mid"
	}

	// Perform quota check before SSE stream starts
	// Use the conversation service's subscription service to check quota
	hasQuota, err := h.service.subscriptionService.CheckQuota(userID.(uint), featureType)
	if err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 500, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to check quota: %s", err.Error()))
		return
	}
	if !hasQuota {
		utils.Error(c, 403, "配额不足，请升级订阅")
		return
	}

	// Set headers for SSE
	c.Header("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
	c.Header("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
	c.Header("Connection", "keep-alive")
	c.Header("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")

	// 执行智能分析并流式返回结果（使用指定的模型级别）
	err = h.service.AdvancedSearchAndAnalyze(
		uint(conversationID),
		targetMessage.SearchQuery,
		c.Writer,
		userID.(uint),
		thirdparty.ModelLevel(modelLevel),
	)
	if err != nil {
		// Error handling for streaming - write error as SSE
		c.Writer.Write([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("data: [ERROR] %s\n\n", err.Error())))
		c.Writer.(http.Flusher).Flush()
		return
	}

	// Send done signal
	c.Writer.Write([]byte("data: [DONE]\n\n"))
	c.Writer.(http.Flusher).Flush()
}

// StreamContinueConversation handles continuing the conversation with context
func (h *Handler) StreamContinueConversation(c *gin.Context) {
	userID, exists := c.Get("user_id")
	if !exists {
		utils.Error(c, 401, "Unauthorized")
		return
	}

	conversationID, err := strconv.ParseUint(c.Param("id"), 10, 32)
	if err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 400, "Invalid conversation ID")
		return
	}

	var req struct {
		Query      string `json:"query" binding:"required"`
		ModelLevel string `json:"model_level"` // Optional, defaults to "mid"
	}
	if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 400, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
		return
	}

	// Validate and default model level
	modelLevel := req.ModelLevel
	if modelLevel == "" {
		modelLevel = "mid"
	}
	switch modelLevel {
	case "low", "mid", "high":
		// Valid model level
	default:
		modelLevel = "mid"
	}

	// Verify conversation belongs to user
	conversation, err := h.service.GetConversationWithMessages(uint(conversationID), userID.(uint))
	if err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 404, "Conversation not found")
		return
	}

	// Verify the conversation exists
	if conversation == nil {
		utils.Error(c, 404, "Conversation not found")
		return
	}

	// Set headers for SSE
	c.Header("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
	c.Header("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
	c.Header("Connection", "keep-alive")
	c.Header("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")

	// Continue the conversation with specified model level
	err = h.service.ContinueConversation(
		uint(conversationID),
		req.Query,
		c.Writer,
		userID.(uint),
		thirdparty.ModelLevel(modelLevel),
	)
	if err != nil {
		// Error handling for streaming - write error as SSE
		c.Writer.Write([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("data: [ERROR] %s\n\n", err.Error())))
		c.Writer.(http.Flusher).Flush()
		return
	}

	// Send done signal
	c.Writer.Write([]byte("data: [DONE]\n\n"))
	c.Writer.(http.Flusher).Flush()
}


// GetFollowUpQuestions handles getting follow-up questions for a message
// This is a separate endpoint called after the streaming response completes
func (h *Handler) GetFollowUpQuestions(c *gin.Context) {
	userID, exists := c.Get("user_id")
	if !exists {
		utils.Error(c, 401, "Unauthorized")
		return
	}

	conversationID, err := strconv.ParseUint(c.Param("id"), 10, 32)
	if err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 400, "Invalid conversation ID")
		return
	}

	messageID, err := strconv.ParseUint(c.Param("messageId"), 10, 32)
	if err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 400, "Invalid message ID")
		return
	}

	// Call service to get or generate follow-up questions
	questions, err := h.service.GetFollowUpQuestions(uint(conversationID), uint(messageID), userID.(uint))
	if err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 404, err.Error())
		return
	}

	// Return questions as JSON
	utils.Success(c, map[string]interface{}{
		"questions": questions,
	})
}

// ChatHandler handles chat-related HTTP requests
type ChatHandler struct {
	chatService *ChatService
	service     *Service
}

// NewChatHandler creates a new chat handler
func NewChatHandler(repo *Repository, aiService *ai.Service, service *Service, subscriptionService interface {
	CheckQuota(userID uint, featureType string) (bool, error)
	IncrementUsage(userID uint, featureType string) error
	CheckAndIncrementQuota(userID uint, featureType string) error
}) *ChatHandler {
	chatService := NewChatService(repo, aiService)
	chatService.SetSubscriptionService(subscriptionService)
	return &ChatHandler{
		chatService: chatService,
		service:     service,
	}
}

// StreamChatMessage handles streaming chat requests
// POST /api/v1/conversations/:id/chat/stream
func (h *ChatHandler) StreamChatMessage(c *gin.Context) {
	userID := c.GetUint("user_id")

	// Parse conversation ID
	conversationID, err := strconv.ParseUint(c.Param("id"), 10, 32)
	if err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid conversation ID")
		return
	}

	// Parse request body
	var req ChatRequest
	if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
		return
	}

	req.ConversationID = uint(conversationID)

	// Set headers for Server-Sent Events
	c.Header("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
	c.Header("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
	c.Header("Connection", "keep-alive")
	c.Header("X-Accel-Buffering", "no") // Disable nginx buffering

	// Create context with timeout
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(c.Request.Context(), 5*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()

	// Stream the chat
	if err := h.chatService.StreamChat(ctx, userID, req, c.Writer); err != nil {
		log.Printf("Stream chat error: %v", err)
		// Error already sent via SSE
		return
	}

	c.Status(http.StatusOK)
}

// GetMessageTree retrieves the complete message tree for a conversation
// GET /api/v1/conversations/:id/tree
func (h *ChatHandler) GetMessageTree(c *gin.Context) {
	userID := c.GetUint("user_id")

	conversationID, err := strconv.ParseUint(c.Param("id"), 10, 32)
	if err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid conversation ID")
		return
	}

	tree, err := h.chatService.GetMessageTree(uint(conversationID), userID)
	if err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
		return
	}

	utils.SuccessResponse(c, http.StatusOK, "Message tree retrieved successfully", tree)
}

}

// CreateConversationAndChat creates a new conversation and starts chatting
// POST /api/v1/conversations/chat/new
func (h *ChatHandler) CreateConversationAndChat(c *gin.Context) {
	userID := c.GetUint("user_id")

	var req struct {
		Title      string `json:"title"`
		Content    string `json:"content" binding:"required"`
		ModelLevel string `json:"model_level,omitempty"` // "low", "mid", "high"
	}

	if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
		return
	}

	// Generate title from first message if not provided
	title := req.Title
	if title == "" {
		title = h.generateTitle(req.Content)
	}

	// Create conversation with chat type
	conversation, err := h.service.CreateConversation(userID, title, ConversationTypeChat)
	if err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to create conversation")
		return
	}

	// Set SSE headers
	c.Header("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
	c.Header("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
	c.Header("Connection", "keep-alive")
	c.Header("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")

	// Send conversation ID first
	h.chatService.sendEvent(c.Writer, ChatResponse{
		Type: "conversation_created",
		Metadata: map[string]interface{}{
			"conversation_id": conversation.ID,
			"title":           conversation.Title,
		},
	})

	// Start chat
	chatReq := ChatRequest{
		ConversationID:  conversation.ID,
		Content:         req.Content,
		ParentMessageID: nil,
		ModelLevel:      req.ModelLevel, // Pass model level to chat service
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(c.Request.Context(), 5*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()

	if err := h.chatService.StreamChat(ctx, userID, chatReq, c.Writer); err != nil {
		log.Printf("Stream chat error: %v", err)
		return
	}

	c.Status(http.StatusOK)
}

// generateTitle generates a conversation title from the first message
func (h *ChatHandler) generateTitle(content string) string {
	// Take first 50 characters or first sentence
	title := content
	if len(title) > 50 {
		title = title[:50] + "..."
	}
	return title
}

// QuickChat handles a simple non-streaming chat for backward compatibility
// POST /api/v1/conversations/:id/chat
func (h *ChatHandler) QuickChat(c *gin.Context) {
	_ = c.GetUint("user_id") // userID not used in this simple endpoint

	_, err := strconv.ParseUint(c.Param("id"), 10, 32)
	if err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid conversation ID")
		return
	}

	var req struct {
		Content         string  `json:"content" binding:"required"`
		ParentMessageID *string `json:"parent_message_id,omitempty"`
	}

	if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
		return
	}

	// Create user message ID for response
	userMessageID := uuid.New().String()

	utils.SuccessResponse(c, http.StatusOK, "Message sent. Use /chat/stream for streaming responses", gin.H{
		"message_id": userMessageID,
		"message":    "Use streaming endpoint for full chat experience",
	})
}

// GetSiblingMessages returns all sibling messages (same parent) for branch navigation
// GET /api/v1/conversations/messages/:messageId/siblings
func (h *ChatHandler) GetSiblingMessages(c *gin.Context) {
	messageID := c.Param("messageId")

	if messageID == "" {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Message ID is required")
		return
	}

	siblings, err := h.chatService.repo.GetSiblingMessages(messageID)
	if err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
		return
	}

	// Calculate current index
	currentIndex := 0
	for i, msg := range siblings {
		if msg.MessageID == messageID {
			currentIndex = i
			break
		}
	}

	utils.SuccessResponse(c, http.StatusOK, "Siblings retrieved successfully", gin.H{
		"siblings":      siblings,
		"current_index": currentIndex,
		"total":         len(siblings),
	})
}

// GetBranchChain returns the complete chain from root to leaf for a specific branch
// GET /api/v1/conversations/messages/:messageId/branch
func (h *ChatHandler) GetBranchChain(c *gin.Context) {
	userID := c.GetUint("user_id")
	messageID := c.Param("messageId")

	if messageID == "" {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Message ID is required")
		return
	}

	// Get complete branch chain
	chain, err := h.chatService.GetBranchChain(messageID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
		return
	}

	utils.SuccessResponse(c, http.StatusOK, "Branch chain retrieved successfully", chain)
}

package conversation

import (
	"database/sql/driver"
	"encoding/json"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// ConversationType represents the type of conversation
type ConversationType string

const (
	ConversationTypeChat   ConversationType = "chat"
	ConversationTypeSearch ConversationType = "search"
)

// Conversation represents a conversation between user and system
type Conversation struct {
	ID               uint             `gorm:"primaryKey" json:"id"`
	UserID           uint             `gorm:"not null;index:idx_user_id" json:"user_id"`
	Title            string           `gorm:"type:varchar(255);not null" json:"title"`
	ConversationType ConversationType `gorm:"type:varchar(20);not null;default:search;index:idx_conversation_type" json:"conversation_type"`
	ModelLevel       string           `gorm:"type:varchar(20);default:low" json:"model_level"` // Model level used: low, mid, high
	CreatedAt        time.Time        `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt        time.Time        `json:"updated_at"`
}

// MessageRole represents the role of a message sender
type MessageRole string

const (
	MessageRoleUser      MessageRole = "user"
	MessageRoleAssistant MessageRole = "assistant"
	MessageRoleSystem    MessageRole = "system"
)

// SearchResults represents Semantic Scholar search results stored as JSON
type SearchResults []map[string]interface{}

// Scan implements sql.Scanner interface
func (s *SearchResults) Scan(value interface{}) error {
	if value == nil {
		*s = nil
		return nil
	}

	bytes, ok := value.([]byte)
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}

	return json.Unmarshal(bytes, s)
}

// Value implements driver.Valuer interface
func (s SearchResults) Value() (driver.Value, error) {
	if s == nil {
		return nil, nil
	}
	return json.Marshal(s)
}

// ConversationMessage represents a message in a conversation with chain support
type ConversationMessage struct {
	ID                  uint          `gorm:"primaryKey" json:"id"`
	MessageID           string        `gorm:"type:varchar(36);uniqueIndex;not null" json:"message_id"`
	ConversationID      uint          `gorm:"not null;index:idx_conversation_id" json:"conversation_id"`
	ParentMessageID     *string       `gorm:"type:varchar(36);index:idx_parent_message_id" json:"parent_message_id"`
	Role                MessageRole   `gorm:"type:varchar(20);not null" json:"role"`
	Content             string        `gorm:"type:text;not null" json:"content"`
	SearchQuery         string        `gorm:"type:varchar(500)" json:"search_query,omitempty"`
	SearchResults       SearchResults `gorm:"type:json" json:"search_results,omitempty"`
	SearchResultsTotal  int           `gorm:"default:0" json:"search_results_total,omitempty"`
	FollowUpQuestions   string        `gorm:"type:text" json:"follow_up_questions,omitempty"` // Only saved for latest assistant message
	TokenCount          int           `gorm:"default:0" json:"token_count,omitempty"`
	Model               string        `gorm:"type:varchar(50)" json:"model,omitempty"`
	FinishReason        string        `gorm:"type:varchar(20)" json:"finish_reason,omitempty"`
	Error               bool          `gorm:"default:false" json:"error"`
	Unfinished          bool          `gorm:"default:false" json:"unfinished"`
	CreatedAt           time.Time     `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt           time.Time     `json:"updated_at"`
}

// BeforeCreate hook to generate message_id if not set
func (m *ConversationMessage) BeforeCreate(tx *gorm.DB) error {
	if m.MessageID == "" {
		m.MessageID = uuid.New().String()
	}
	return nil
}

// CreateConversationRequest represents the request to create a new conversation
type CreateConversationRequest struct {
	Title            string           `json:"title" binding:"required"`
	ConversationType ConversationType `json:"conversation_type"` // Optional, defaults to "search" if not provided
}

// CreateMessageRequest represents the request to add a message to a conversation
type CreateMessageRequest struct {
	Content          string  `json:"content" binding:"required"`
	ParentMessageID  *string `json:"parent_message_id,omitempty"` // For branching conversations
	SearchQuery      string  `json:"search_query"`
	SearchPapers     bool    `json:"search_papers"` // Whether to search papers via Semantic Scholar
}

// MessageChainResponse represents a message with its position in the chain
type MessageChainResponse struct {
	ConversationMessage
	Children []string `json:"children,omitempty"` // Child message IDs (for branching visualization)
}

// ConversationWithMessages represents a conversation with its messages
type ConversationWithMessages struct {
	Conversation
	Messages []ConversationMessage `json:"messages"`
}

// ConversationListResponse represents a list of conversations
type ConversationListResponse struct {
	Conversations []Conversation `json:"conversations"`
	Total         int64          `json:"total"`
}

package conversation

import (
	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

type Repository struct {
	db *gorm.DB
}

func NewRepository(db *gorm.DB) *Repository {
	return &Repository{db: db}
}

// CreateConversation creates a new conversation
func (r *Repository) CreateConversation(conversation *Conversation) error {
	return r.db.Create(conversation).Error
}

// GetConversationByID gets a conversation by ID
func (r *Repository) GetConversationByID(id uint, userID uint) (*Conversation, error) {
	var conversation Conversation
	err := r.db.Where("id = ? AND user_id = ?", id, userID).First(&conversation).Error
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &conversation, nil
}

// GetUserConversations gets all conversations for a user, optionally filtered by type
func (r *Repository) GetUserConversations(userID uint, limit, offset int, conversationType *ConversationType) ([]Conversation, int64, error) {
	var conversations []Conversation
	var total int64

	// Build base query
	query := r.db.Model(&Conversation{}).Where("user_id = ?", userID)

	// Add conversation type filter if provided
	if conversationType != nil {
		query = query.Where("conversation_type = ?", *conversationType)
	}

	// Get total count
	if err := query.Count(&total).Error; err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}

	// Get conversations ordered by updated_at DESC
	err := query.Order("updated_at DESC").
		Limit(limit).
		Offset(offset).
		Find(&conversations).Error

	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}

	return conversations, total, nil
}

// UpdateConversation updates a conversation
func (r *Repository) UpdateConversation(conversation *Conversation) error {
	return r.db.Save(conversation).Error
}

// DeleteConversation deletes a conversation and its messages
func (r *Repository) DeleteConversation(id uint, userID uint) error {
	return r.db.Where("id = ? AND user_id = ?", id, userID).Delete(&Conversation{}).Error
}

// CreateMessage creates a new message in a conversation
func (r *Repository) CreateMessage(message *ConversationMessage) error {
	return r.db.Create(message).Error
}

// GetConversationMessages gets all messages for a conversation
func (r *Repository) GetConversationMessages(conversationID uint) ([]ConversationMessage, error) {
	var messages []ConversationMessage
	err := r.db.Where("conversation_id = ?", conversationID).
		Order("created_at ASC").
		Find(&messages).Error
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return messages, nil
}

// GetConversationWithMessages gets a conversation with all its messages
func (r *Repository) GetConversationWithMessages(id uint, userID uint) (*ConversationWithMessages, error) {
	// Get conversation
	conversation, err := r.GetConversationByID(id, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// Get messages
	messages, err := r.GetConversationMessages(id)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &ConversationWithMessages{
		Conversation: *conversation,
		Messages:     messages,
	}, nil
}

// TouchConversation updates the updated_at timestamp
func (r *Repository) TouchConversation(id uint) error {
	return r.db.Model(&Conversation{}).Where("id = ?", id).Update("updated_at", gorm.Expr("NOW()")).Error
}

// UpdateMessageSearchResults updates the search results for the latest user message in a conversation
func (r *Repository) UpdateMessageSearchResults(conversationID uint, query string, papers []map[string]interface{}, total int) error {
	// Find the latest user message with matching query
	var message ConversationMessage
	err := r.db.Where("conversation_id = ? AND role = ? AND search_query = ?", conversationID, MessageRoleUser, query).
		Order("created_at DESC").
		First(&message).Error
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// Convert papers to SearchResults
	searchResults := make(SearchResults, len(papers))
	for i, paper := range papers {
		searchResults[i] = paper
	}

	// Update the message with search results
	return r.db.Model(&message).Updates(map[string]interface{}{
		"search_results":       searchResults,
		"search_results_total": total,
	}).Error
}

// UpdateMessageSearchResultsByID updates the search results for a specific message by its ID
func (r *Repository) UpdateMessageSearchResultsByID(messageID uint, papers []map[string]interface{}, total int) error {
	// Convert papers to SearchResults
	searchResults := make(SearchResults, len(papers))
	for i, paper := range papers {
		searchResults[i] = paper
	}

	// Update the message with search results
	return r.db.Model(&ConversationMessage{}).Where("id = ?", messageID).Updates(map[string]interface{}{
		"search_results":       searchResults,
		"search_results_total": total,
	}).Error
}

// GetMessageByMessageID gets a message by its UUID message_id
func (r *Repository) GetMessageByMessageID(messageID string) (*ConversationMessage, error) {
	var message ConversationMessage
	err := r.db.Where("message_id = ?", messageID).First(&message).Error
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &message, nil
}

// GetMessagesByParentID gets all messages with a specific parent_message_id
func (r *Repository) GetMessagesByParentID(conversationID uint, parentMessageID string) ([]ConversationMessage, error) {
	var messages []ConversationMessage
	err := r.db.Where("conversation_id = ? AND parent_message_id = ?", conversationID, parentMessageID).
		Order("created_at ASC").
		Find(&messages).Error
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return messages, nil
}

// BuildMessageChain builds the complete message chain from root to a specific message
// Returns messages in chronological order (oldest to newest)
func (r *Repository) BuildMessageChain(messageID string) ([]ConversationMessage, error) {
	var chain []ConversationMessage
	currentMessageID := messageID

	// Traverse backwards through parent messages
	for currentMessageID != "" {
		message, err := r.GetMessageByMessageID(currentMessageID)
		if err != nil {
			if err == gorm.ErrRecordNotFound {
				break
			}
			return nil, err
		}

		// Prepend to chain (to maintain chronological order)
		chain = append([]ConversationMessage{*message}, chain...)

		// Move to parent
		if message.ParentMessageID != nil {
			currentMessageID = *message.ParentMessageID
		} else {
			break
		}
	}

	return chain, nil
}

// GetLatestMessageInConversation gets the most recent message in a conversation
func (r *Repository) GetLatestMessageInConversation(conversationID uint) (*ConversationMessage, error) {
	var message ConversationMessage
	err := r.db.Where("conversation_id = ?", conversationID).
		Order("created_at DESC, id DESC").
		First(&message).Error
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &message, nil
}

// UpdateMessage updates a message (for upsert-like behavior)
func (r *Repository) UpdateMessage(message *ConversationMessage) error {
	return r.db.Save(message).Error
}

// UpsertMessage creates or updates a message by message_id
func (r *Repository) UpsertMessage(message *ConversationMessage) error {
	// Check if message exists
	var existing ConversationMessage
	err := r.db.Where("message_id = ?", message.MessageID).First(&existing).Error

	if err == gorm.ErrRecordNotFound {
		// Create new message
		return r.db.Create(message).Error
	} else if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// Update existing message
	message.ID = existing.ID // Preserve the primary key
	return r.db.Save(message).Error
}

// GetMessageChildren gets all children of a message for building the message tree
func (r *Repository) GetMessageChildren(conversationID uint, messageID string) ([]ConversationMessage, error) {
	return r.GetMessagesByParentID(conversationID, messageID)
}

// GetAllMessagesForTree gets all messages in a conversation for building a complete tree
func (r *Repository) GetAllMessagesForTree(conversationID uint) ([]ConversationMessage, error) {
	var messages []ConversationMessage
	err := r.db.Where("conversation_id = ?", conversationID).
		Order("created_at ASC").
		Find(&messages).Error
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return messages, nil
}

// GetSiblingMessages gets all sibling messages (same parent_message_id) for a given message
// Returns messages ordered by created_at, useful for branch navigation
func (r *Repository) GetSiblingMessages(messageID string) ([]ConversationMessage, error) {
	// First get the target message to find its parent
	targetMessage, err := r.GetMessageByMessageID(messageID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// If no parent, this is a root message - no siblings
	if targetMessage.ParentMessageID == nil {
		return []ConversationMessage{*targetMessage}, nil
	}

	// Get all messages with the same parent
	var siblings []ConversationMessage
	err = r.db.Where("conversation_id = ? AND parent_message_id = ?",
		targetMessage.ConversationID,
		*targetMessage.ParentMessageID).
		Order("created_at ASC").
		Find(&siblings).Error

	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return siblings, nil
}

// GetLatestLeafFromMessage finds the latest leaf node (deepest child) starting from a message
// This is used for branch navigation to show the complete path of a sibling branch
func (r *Repository) GetLatestLeafFromMessage(messageID string) (string, error) {
	currentMessageID := messageID

	for {
		// Get children of current message
		message, err := r.GetMessageByMessageID(currentMessageID)
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}

		var children []ConversationMessage
		err = r.db.Where("conversation_id = ? AND parent_message_id = ?",
			message.ConversationID, currentMessageID).
			Order("created_at DESC"). // Get latest child first
			Find(&children).Error

		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}

		// If no children, this is a leaf node
		if len(children) == 0 {
			return currentMessageID, nil
		}

		// Continue with the latest child
		currentMessageID = children[0].MessageID
	}
}

// ClearOldFollowUpQuestions clears follow_up_questions field from all previous messages in a conversation
// This ensures only the latest assistant message shows follow-up questions
func (r *Repository) ClearOldFollowUpQuestions(conversationID uint) error {
	return r.db.Model(&ConversationMessage{}).
		Where("conversation_id = ? AND role = ? AND follow_up_questions IS NOT NULL AND follow_up_questions != ?",
			conversationID, MessageRoleAssistant, "").
		Update("follow_up_questions", "").Error
}

// GetMessageByID gets a message by its numeric ID
func (r *Repository) GetMessageByID(id uint) (*ConversationMessage, error) {
	var message ConversationMessage
	err := r.db.Where("id = ?", id).First(&message).Error
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &message, nil
}

// UpdateMessageFollowUpQuestions updates the follow_up_questions field of a message
func (r *Repository) UpdateMessageFollowUpQuestions(messageID uint, questions string) error {
	return r.db.Model(&ConversationMessage{}).
		Where("id = ?", messageID).
		Update("follow_up_questions", questions).Error
}

package conversation

	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// BuildMessageChainOptimized 优化版本 - 使用单次查询和内存中构建链
// 相比原版的循环查询,性能提升10-100倍
func (r *Repository) BuildMessageChainOptimized(messageID string) ([]ConversationMessage, error) {
	// 首先获取目标消息,找到其conversation_id
	targetMessage, err := r.GetMessageByMessageID(messageID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// 一次性获取该对话的所有消息 - 避免N+1查询
	var allMessages []ConversationMessage
	err = r.db.Where("conversation_id = ?", targetMessage.ConversationID).
		Order("created_at ASC").
		Find(&allMessages).Error
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// 构建消息映射表,用于快速查找
	messageMap := make(map[string]*ConversationMessage)
	for i := range allMessages {
		messageMap[allMessages[i].MessageID] = &allMessages[i]
	}

	// 从目标消息向上遍历构建链
	var chain []ConversationMessage
	currentMessageID := messageID

	for currentMessageID != "" {
		message, exists := messageMap[currentMessageID]
		if !exists {
			break
		}

		// 前置插入,保持时间顺序
		chain = append([]ConversationMessage{*message}, chain...)

		// 移动到父消息
		if message.ParentMessageID != nil {
			currentMessageID = *message.ParentMessageID
		} else {
			break
		}
	}

	return chain, nil
}

// GetConversationWithMessagesOptimized 优化版本 - 使用单次查询
func (r *Repository) GetConversationWithMessagesOptimized(id uint, userID uint) (*ConversationWithMessages, error) {
	var result ConversationWithMessages

	// 使用事务确保数据一致性,但不影响性能
	err := r.db.Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error {
		// 获取对话
		var conversation Conversation
		if err := tx.Where("id = ? AND user_id = ?", id, userID).First(&conversation).Error; err != nil {
			return err
		}
		result.Conversation = conversation

		// 获取所有消息 - 单次查询
		var messages []ConversationMessage
		if err := tx.Where("conversation_id = ?", id).
			Order("created_at ASC").
			Find(&messages).Error; err != nil {
			return err
		}
		result.Messages = messages

		return nil
	})

	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &result, nil
}

type Service struct {
	repo                *Repository
	scholarManager      *semanticscholar.Manager
	aiService           *ai.Service
	subscriptionService *subscription.Service
}

func NewService(repo *Repository, scholarManager *semanticscholar.Manager, aiService *ai.Service, subscriptionService *subscription.Service) *Service {
	return &Service{
		repo:                repo,
		scholarManager:      scholarManager,
		aiService:           aiService,
		subscriptionService: subscriptionService,
	}
}

// CreateConversation creates a new conversation for a user
func (s *Service) CreateConversation(userID uint, title string, conversationType ConversationType) (*Conversation, error) {
	// Default to search type if not provided
	if conversationType == "" {
		conversationType = ConversationTypeSearch
	}

	conversation := &Conversation{
		UserID:           userID,
		Title:            title,
		ConversationType: conversationType,
	}

	if err := s.repo.CreateConversation(conversation); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return conversation, nil
}

// GetUserConversations gets all conversations for a user, optionally filtered by type
func (s *Service) GetUserConversations(userID uint, page, pageSize int, conversationType *ConversationType) (*ConversationListResponse, error) {
	if page < 1 {
		page = 1
	}
	if pageSize < 1 || pageSize > 100 {
		pageSize = 20
	}

	offset := (page - 1) * pageSize
	conversations, total, err := s.repo.GetUserConversations(userID, pageSize, offset, conversationType)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &ConversationListResponse{
		Conversations: conversations,
		Total:         total,
	}, nil
}

// GetConversationWithMessages gets a conversation with all its messages
func (s *Service) GetConversationWithMessages(conversationID uint, userID uint) (*ConversationWithMessages, error) {
	return s.repo.GetConversationWithMessages(conversationID, userID)
}

// DeleteConversation deletes a conversation
func (s *Service) DeleteConversation(conversationID uint, userID uint) error {
	return s.repo.DeleteConversation(conversationID, userID)
}

// AddMessage adds a message to a conversation and optionally searches papers
func (s *Service) AddMessage(conversationID uint, userID uint, req CreateMessageRequest) (*ConversationMessage, error) {
	// Verify conversation belongs to user
	conversation, err := s.repo.GetConversationByID(conversationID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("conversation not found: %w", err)
	}

	// Create user message
	message := &ConversationMessage{
		ConversationID: conversationID,
		Role:           MessageRoleUser,
		Content:        req.Content,
		SearchQuery:    req.SearchQuery,
	}

	// If search is requested, search papers via Semantic Scholar
	if req.SearchPapers && req.SearchQuery != "" {
		searchResults, total, err := s.searchPapers(req.SearchQuery)
		if err != nil {
			// Don't fail the message creation if search fails
			fmt.Printf("Warning: failed to search papers: %v\n", err)
		} else {
			message.SearchResults = searchResults
			message.SearchResultsTotal = total
		}
	}

	// Save message
	if err := s.repo.CreateMessage(message); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// Update conversation's updated_at timestamp
	if err := s.repo.TouchConversation(conversationID); err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("Warning: failed to update conversation timestamp: %v\n", err)
	}

	// Auto-update conversation title if this is the first message
	messages, _ := s.repo.GetConversationMessages(conversationID)
	if len(messages) == 1 {
		title := s.generateTitle(req.Content)
		conversation.Title = title
		s.repo.UpdateConversation(conversation)
	}

	return message, nil
}

// searchPapers searches papers using Semantic Scholar API
func (s *Service) searchPapers(query string) (SearchResults, int, error) {
	// Search papers
	result, err := s.scholarManager.SearchPapers(semanticscholar.PaperSearchOptions{
		Query:  query,
		Limit:  20,
		Fields: []string{"title", "abstract", "year", "authors", "citationCount", "url", "venue", "publicationDate"},
	})

	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}

	// Convert to SearchResults format
	var searchResults SearchResults
	for _, paper := range result.Data {
		paperMap := map[string]interface{}{
			"paperId":       paper.PaperID,
			"title":         paper.Title,
			"abstract":      paper.Abstract,
			"year":          paper.Year,
			"citationCount": paper.CitationCount,
			"url":           paper.URL,
			"venue":         paper.Venue,
			"publicationDate": paper.PublicationDate,
		}

		// Convert authors
		var authors []map[string]interface{}
		for _, author := range paper.Authors {
			authors = append(authors, map[string]interface{}{
				"authorId": author.AuthorID,
				"name":     author.Name,
			})
		}
		paperMap["authors"] = authors

		searchResults = append(searchResults, paperMap)
	}

	return searchResults, result.Total, nil
}

// generateTitle generates a title from the first message content
func (s *Service) generateTitle(content string) string {
	// Take first 50 characters or until first newline
	lines := strings.Split(content, "\n")
	title := lines[0]

	if len(title) > 50 {
		title = title[:50] + "..."
	}

	return title
}

// UpdateConversationTitle updates the title of a conversation
func (s *Service) UpdateConversationTitle(conversationID uint, userID uint, title string) error {
	conversation, err := s.repo.GetConversationByID(conversationID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	conversation.Title = title
	return s.repo.UpdateConversation(conversation)
}

package conversation

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"

	"scholar-backend/internal/ai"
	"scholar-backend/internal/mcp"
	"scholar-backend/internal/semanticscholar"
