// AdvancedSearchAndAnalyze 执行基于AI的智能分析（使用MCP工具）并流式返回结果
// 检查配额并根据用户订阅使用相应的模型级别
// 支持对话上下文以便进行后续分析
func (s *Service) AdvancedSearchAndAnalyze(conversationID uint, query string, writer io.Writer, userID uint, modelLevel thirdparty.ModelLevel) error {
	// Determine feature type based on model level
	var featureType string
	switch modelLevel {
	case thirdparty.ModelLevelLow:
		featureType = "advanced_search_low"
	case thirdparty.ModelLevelMid:
		featureType = "advanced_search_mid"
	case thirdparty.ModelLevelHigh:
		featureType = "advanced_search_high"
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid model level: %s", modelLevel)
	}

	// Increment usage (quota check already done in handler before SSE started)
	// Use atomic increment to ensure thread safety
	if err := s.subscriptionService.IncrementUsage(userID, featureType); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to increment usage: %w", err)
	}

	// Get the user message (it should already exist, created by AddMessage)
	// We need to find the latest user message with this query
	var userMessage *ConversationMessage
	messages, err := s.repo.GetConversationMessages(conversationID)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get conversation messages: %w", err)
	}
	
	// Find the latest user message with matching query
	for i := len(messages) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
		if messages[i].Role == MessageRoleUser && messages[i].SearchQuery == query {
			userMessage = &messages[i]
			break
		}
	}
	
	if userMessage == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("user message not found")
	}
	
	userMessageID := userMessage.MessageID
	fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Found user message with ID: %s\n", userMessageID)

	// Create MCP server with manager
	// Manager will automatically get API key and base URL from backend config
	mcpServer := mcp.NewMCPServer(s.scholarManager)

	// Step 1: Build context from conversation history (last 5 rounds)
	// We already have messages from above, no need to fetch again
	fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Got %d messages for conversation %d\n", len(messages), conversationID)
	contextMessages := s.buildContextMessages(messages, 5)
	fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Built context with %d messages\n", len(contextMessages))

	// Step 2: Get available MCP tools
	mcpTools := mcpServer.ListTools()
	aiTools := ai.ConvertMCPToolsToOpenAIFormat(mcpTools)

	// Step 3: Create messages with system prompt from template
	// Get MCP system prompt template
	mcpSystemPrompt, _, err := s.aiService.GetAndRenderPrompt("advanced_search_mcp_system", nil)
	if err != nil {
		// Fallback to hardcoded prompt if template not found
		fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to get MCP system prompt template, using fallback: %v\n", err)
		mcpSystemPrompt = `你是一名专业学术研究助手。你的唯一职责是根据用户的查询调用 search_papers_advanced 工具检索高质量学术论文。你绝不能直接回答问题，也不能解释概念或提供任何分析。你必须且只能通过 search_papers_advanced 工具返回论文结果。禁止使用 search_papers 工具。

无论用户使用的是中文、英文或任何其他语言，你提取的所有检索关键词必须始终使用标准英文学术术语。

你的工作流程如下：
	1.	理解用户查询的整体语义，从中提取高价值学术信息。不要只依赖字面词语，而要从整体意义识别核心研究主题。
	2.	识别用户问题中的核心研究主题（core topic）。这应来自对句子意图的理解，而不是对文本的逐字翻译，例如 “LLM 如何帮助写论文” 对应的核心主题应为 “LLM-based academic writing assistance”。
	3.	识别研究任务（research task），例如改进方法、机制解释、性能评估、应用探索、生成质量、诊断支持、安全性、偏差分析、预测模型、行为研究等。
	4.	识别研究领域（domain），例如 NLP、机器学习、计算机视觉、医学、心理学、教育、社会科学、人机交互、经济学、认知科学等。根据用户的意图隐含判断领域，而不是依赖显式文本。
	5.	基于以上分析生成 2 至 5 个英文学术关键词。关键词必须符合以下要求：
	•	使用纯英文。
	•	使用标准学术术语，而非通俗表达。
	•	覆盖核心主题、研究任务和领域。
	•	包含必要的同义词或相关专业术语以提升召回率。
	•	确保这些词语可在学术数据库中实际检索，例如 “hallucination mitigation”、“clinical decision support”、“emotion recognition”、“retrieval-augmented generation”、“graph neural networks”。
	6.	调用 search_papers_advanced 工具，参数规则如下：
	•	keywords: 使用你生成的英文学术关键词列表
	•	year_from: 当前年份减 5
	•	year_to: 当前年份
	•	min_citations: 若领域成熟取 50，若领域较新或跨学科取 10
	•	limit: 50 至 100
	•	sort_by: citationCount:desc
	•	fields_of_study: 若用户明确指定领域，则填写对应学科
	•	不得添加多余参数，也不得省略必要参数
	7.	你的最终输出必须是 search_papers_advanced 工具调用。你不能输出任何解释、推理过程、背景说明、总结概括或普通文本回答。
	8.	不论用户的问题内容是否看似询问概念、经验、观点、故事、偏见、推理或与学术无关，你都必须将其视为学术检索行为，并调用 search_papers_advanced 工具返回论文。
	9.	无论用户的输入使用哪种语言，你提取的学术关键词必须全部是英文。绝不允许出现中文关键词、混合语言关键词或用户原文中未翻译的名词。

请严格遵守以上全部规则。`
	}

	systemMessage := ai.ChatMessage{
		Role:    "system",
		Content: mcpSystemPrompt,
	}

	// Add current user query
	contextMessages = append(contextMessages, ai.ChatMessage{
		Role:    "user",
		Content: query,
	})

	// Prepend system message
	initialMessages := append([]ai.ChatMessage{systemMessage}, contextMessages...)

	// Step 4: Call AI with tools to get tool calls
	// Use low-level model for tool calling to save cost (tool selection doesn't need advanced reasoning)
	fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Calling AI with tools, initial messages count: %d, tools count: %d\n", len(initialMessages), len(aiTools))
	toolCallResponse, err := s.aiService.ChatCompletionWithTools(initialMessages, aiTools, "auto", thirdparty.ModelLevelLow)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("[ERROR] AI tool call failed: %v\n", err)
		// Still try fallback search below, don't send error to frontend yet
		toolCallResponse = nil
	}

	// Step 5: Execute tool calls and collect results
	var allPapers []map[string]interface{}
	var totalCount int

	if toolCallResponse != nil && len(toolCallResponse.Choices) > 0 && len(toolCallResponse.Choices[0].Message.ToolCalls) > 0 {
		fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Found %d tool calls\n", len(toolCallResponse.Choices[0].Message.ToolCalls))
		for _, toolCall := range toolCallResponse.Choices[0].Message.ToolCalls {
			fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Tool call name: %s\n", toolCall.Function.Name)
			fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Tool call arguments: %s\n", toolCall.Function.Arguments)

			// Support both search_papers and search_papers_advanced
			if toolCall.Function.Name == "search_papers" || toolCall.Function.Name == "search_papers_advanced" {
				// Parse tool arguments
				var args map[string]interface{}
				if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(toolCall.Function.Arguments), &args); err != nil {
					fmt.Printf("[ERROR] Failed to parse tool arguments: %v\n", err)
					continue
				}

				// Call MCP tool
				toolRequest := mcp.ToolRequest{
					Name:      toolCall.Function.Name,
					Arguments: args,
				}

				papers, total, err := s.executeMCPToolCall(mcpServer, toolRequest)
				if err != nil {
					fmt.Printf("[ERROR] MCP tool call failed: %v\n", err)
					// Don't send technical error to frontend, will handle at the end
					continue
				}

				allPapers = append(allPapers, papers...)
				if total > totalCount {
					totalCount = total
				}
			}
		}
	}

	// If no papers found, try a simple direct search
	if len(allPapers) == 0 {
		fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] No papers from tool calls, doing direct search\n")
		papers, total, err := s.mcpSearch(query, mcpServer)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Printf("[ERROR] Direct search failed: %v\n", err)
			// Send friendly error message
			friendlyError := "网络异常，请稍后重试。如果问题持续，请联系管理员。"
			
			// Save error message to database with parent_message_id
			errorMessage := &ConversationMessage{
				ConversationID:    conversationID,
				ParentMessageID:   &userMessageID,
				Role:              MessageRoleAssistant,
				Content:           friendlyError,
				FollowUpQuestions: "",
			}
			
			if saveErr := s.repo.CreateMessage(errorMessage); saveErr != nil {
				fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to save error message: %v\n", saveErr)
			}
			
			// Send error to frontend
			fmt.Fprintf(writer, "data: [ERROR] %s\n\n", friendlyError)
			if flusher, ok := writer.(interface{ Flush() }); ok {
				flusher.Flush()
			}
			
			return fmt.Errorf("search failed: %w", err)
		}
		allPapers = papers
		totalCount = total
	}

	// Limit papers to top 50 for frontend display and AI analysis
	const maxPapersToShow = 50
	displayPapers := allPapers
	if len(displayPapers) > maxPapersToShow {
		fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Limiting papers from %d to %d for display and analysis\n", len(allPapers), maxPapersToShow)
		displayPapers = displayPapers[:maxPapersToShow]
	}

	// Step 6: Update user message with search results
	if err := s.repo.UpdateMessageSearchResultsByID(userMessage.ID, displayPapers, totalCount); err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("Warning: failed to update user message with search results: %v\n", err)
	}

	// Send papers to frontend (only top 50)
	papersData := map[string]interface{}{
		"papers": displayPapers,
		"total":  totalCount,  // Still show the real total count
	}
	papersJSON, _ := json.Marshal(papersData)
	fmt.Fprintf(writer, "data: [PAPERS]%s\n\n", string(papersJSON))
	if flusher, ok := writer.(interface{ Flush() }); ok {
		flusher.Flush()
	}

	// Step 7: Generate AI analysis of the papers and save to database
	fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Formatting %d papers for AI analysis\n", len(displayPapers))
	// Use more papers for analysis (up to 30) with shorter abstracts
	papersForPrompt := ai.FormatPapersForPromptWithLimit(displayPapers, 30, 200)
	fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Formatted papers, length: %d characters\n", len(papersForPrompt))

	// Get analysis prompt templates
	analysisSystemPrompt, _, err := s.aiService.GetAndRenderPrompt("advanced_search_analysis_system", nil)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to get analysis system prompt template, using fallback: %v\n", err)
		analysisSystemPrompt = "你是一名具有深厚研究背景的高级学术分析专家，能够对多篇论文进行深入解读、方法分析、研究发现抽象、理论联系与批判性整合，并以学术写作风格输出高质量分析报告。"
	}

	analysisPrompt, _, err := s.aiService.GetAndRenderPrompt("advanced_search_analysis", map[string]string{
		"query":  query,
		"papers": papersForPrompt,
	})
	if err != nil {
		// Fallback to hardcoded prompt if template not found
		fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to get analysis prompt template, using fallback: %v\n", err)
		analysisPrompt = fmt.Sprintf(`用户查询：%s
找到的论文：%s

请作为一名具备跨领域知识的资深学术研究专家，对以上论文进行深度整合分析，并给出具有洞察力、逻辑严密、贴合用户问题的学术级解读。

你的输出必须遵守以下原则：

一、输出结构不固定
你不需要使用预定义的标题，也不需要每次遵循同样的段落结构。
你应根据用户的查询内容、论文主题性质、研究领域特点，自主决定分析的组织方式。
输出形式可以是：
	•	连贯的长文
	•	分层的分析段落
	•	自定义的小节
	•	或混合结构
但必须确保内容严谨、有逻辑、有深度。

二、分析范围必须覆盖以下六大方面（但无需按固定标题呈现）
你要在整份分析中自然体现以下内容，但你可以自由组织顺序、结构与表达方式：
	1.	研究领域背景、核心问题、发展趋势
	2.	各论文的方法、技术路线与创新点
	3.	论文的发现、结论与学术贡献
	4.	实际应用价值、实践意义、产业影响
	5.	研究脉络、方法演进、论文之间的逻辑关系
	6.	批判性观点、研究不足与未来方向
这些内容要以“自然流畅、连贯而不刻意分段”的方式融入分析。

三、引用格式必须严格使用以下形式
【引用编号：具体内容】
所有论述性内容必须通过引用论文中的数据、方法、结论或关键描述进行支撑。
每一部分分析都必须至少使用 3–5 个引用标记。
引用必须具体，例如：
【引用3：模型在XXX数据集上提升了12.5%】
而不是模糊表达。

四、分析必须基于论文内容本身
	•	不得编造不存在的论文结论
	•	不得使用无引用支持的判断
	•	必须结合论文中的数据、实验结果、方法细节
	•	必须保持学术严谨性和批判性

五、写作风格要求
	•	像一位 senior researcher 的深度综述
	•	不复述论文摘要，而是给“洞察”与“分析”
	•	不空洞、不堆叠句子
	•	强调交叉比较、研究关系、理论意义、应用前景
	•	在整体布局上做到自然流畅、有张力、有逻辑

六、最终输出
	•	使用 Markdown 格式
	•	无固定标题框架
	•	完全由你自由组织结构
	•	内容必须覆盖上述六大分析面向，但表达形式由你决定
	•	引用规范必须严格遵守

请开始你的深度综合分析。`, query, papersForPrompt)
	}

	analysisMessages := []ai.ChatMessage{
		{
			Role:    "system",
			Content: analysisSystemPrompt,
		},
		{
			Role:    "user",
			Content: analysisPrompt,
		},
	}

	// Apply context truncation to ensure we stay within 128K limit
	const max128K = 128000 * 4 // Roughly 128K tokens * 4 chars per token
	analysisMessages = ai.TruncateContextForLimit(analysisMessages, max128K)

	fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] About to call StreamChatCompletionAndCollectWithLevel, modelLevel: %s, messages count: %d, prompt length: %d\n",
		modelLevel, len(analysisMessages), len(analysisPrompt))

	// Stream AI response and collect full content using specified model level
	fullContent, err := s.aiService.StreamChatCompletionAndCollectWithLevel(analysisMessages, writer, modelLevel)
	if err != nil {
		// 生成友好的错误消息
		friendlyError := "网络异常，请稍后重试。如果问题持续，请联系管理员。"
		fmt.Printf("[ERROR] AI analysis failed: %v\n", err)

		// 将错误消息保存为 assistant 消息，以便历史记录中显示
		errorMessage := &ConversationMessage{
			ConversationID:    conversationID,
			ParentMessageID:   &userMessageID,
			Role:              MessageRoleAssistant,
			Content:           friendlyError,
			FollowUpQuestions: "",
		}

		if saveErr := s.repo.CreateMessage(errorMessage); saveErr != nil {
			fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to save error message: %v\n", saveErr)
		}

		// 通过流式接口发送错误消息
		fmt.Fprintf(writer, "data: %s\n\n", friendlyError)
		if flusher, ok := writer.(interface{ Flush() }); ok {
			flusher.Flush()
		}

		return fmt.Errorf("AI analysis failed: %w", err)
	}

	// Note: Usage was already incremented at the beginning

	// Step 8: Clear old follow-up questions from previous messages in this conversation
	if err := s.repo.ClearOldFollowUpQuestions(conversationID); err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to clear old follow-up questions: %v\n", err)
	}

	// Save assistant message to conversation with parent_message_id
	// Follow-up questions will be generated on-demand via separate endpoint
	assistantMessage := &ConversationMessage{
		ConversationID:    conversationID,
		ParentMessageID:   &userMessageID, // Link to user message
		Role:              MessageRoleAssistant,
		Content:           fullContent,
		FollowUpQuestions: "", // Will be generated on-demand
	}

	if err := s.repo.CreateMessage(assistantMessage); err != nil {
		// Log error but don't fail the request
		fmt.Printf("Warning: failed to save assistant message: %v\n", err)
	}

	return nil
}

// generateFollowUpQuestions generates follow-up questions based on the analysis
// Uses low model for cost efficiency and returns all questions at once (non-streaming)
func (s *Service) generateFollowUpQuestions(query string, analysisContent string) (string, error) {
	// Get follow-up questions prompt from database
	followUpSystemPrompt, _, err := s.aiService.GetAndRenderPrompt("follow_up_questions_system", nil)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to get follow-up questions system prompt, using fallback: %v\n", err)
		followUpSystemPrompt = "你是一位专业的学术研究助手，擅长基于研究分析提出有深度的延伸问题。"
	}

	followUpPrompt, _, err := s.aiService.GetAndRenderPrompt("follow_up_questions", map[string]string{
		"query":    query,
		"analysis": analysisContent,
	})
	if err != nil {
		// Fallback to hardcoded prompt
		fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to get follow-up questions prompt, using fallback: %v\n", err)
		followUpPrompt = fmt.Sprintf(`用户查询：%s

已完成的分析：
%s

基于上述分析，请提供3-5个发散性的后续研究问题，格式如下：
[FOLLOW_UP_QUESTIONS]
1. 问题文本1
2. 问题文本2
3. 问题文本3
[/FOLLOW_UP_QUESTIONS]

这些问题应该：
- 基于当前研究的自然延伸
- 具有一定的探索性和前瞻性
- 涵盖不同角度（技术深化、应用拓展、跨领域融合、伦理思考等）
- 能够引发深入讨论
- 每个问题都应该简洁明了，一句话即可

请直接输出问题列表，不要有其他内容。`, query, analysisContent)
	}

	followUpMessages := []ai.ChatMessage{
		{
			Role:    "system",
			Content: followUpSystemPrompt,
		},
		{
			Role:    "user",
			Content: followUpPrompt,
		},
	}

	// Use low model for follow-up questions generation (cost-efficient, non-streaming)
	followUpContent, err := s.aiService.ChatCompletionWithLevel(followUpMessages, thirdparty.ModelLevelLow)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	return followUpContent, nil
}

// executeMCPToolCall executes a single MCP tool call and returns papers
func (s *Service) executeMCPToolCall(mcpServer *mcp.MCPServer, toolRequest mcp.ToolRequest) ([]map[string]interface{}, int, error) {
	result, err := mcpServer.CallTool(toolRequest)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}

	// Parse the MCP response
	if len(result.Content) == 0 {
		return []map[string]interface{}{}, 0, nil
	}

	// The MCP server returns JSON in the text field
	var searchResponse semanticscholar.SearchResponse
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(result.Content[0]["text"].(string)), &searchResponse); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse search results: %w", err)
	}

	// Convert papers to map format
	papers := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, len(searchResponse.Data))
	for _, paper := range searchResponse.Data {
		paperMap := map[string]interface{}{
			"paperId":         paper.PaperID,
			"title":           paper.Title,
			"abstract":        paper.Abstract,
			"year":            paper.Year,
			"citationCount":   paper.CitationCount,
			"url":             paper.URL,
			"venue":           paper.Venue,
			"publicationDate": paper.PublicationDate,
		}

		// Convert authors
		var authors []map[string]interface{}
		for _, author := range paper.Authors {
			authors = append(authors, map[string]interface{}{
				"authorId": author.AuthorID,
				"name":     author.Name,
			})
		}
		paperMap["authors"] = authors

		// Add TLDR if available
		if paper.TLDR != nil {
			paperMap["tldr"] = map[string]interface{}{
				"model": paper.TLDR.Model,
				"text":  paper.TLDR.Text,
			}
		}

		// Add externalIds if available
		if paper.ExternalIDs != nil {
			paperMap["externalIds"] = paper.ExternalIDs
		}

		// Add fieldsOfStudy if available
		if paper.FieldsOfStudy != nil {
			paperMap["fieldsOfStudy"] = paper.FieldsOfStudy
		}

		papers = append(papers, paperMap)
	}

	return papers, searchResponse.Total, nil
}

// mcpSearch performs search using MCP server
func (s *Service) mcpSearch(query string, mcpServer *mcp.MCPServer) ([]map[string]interface{}, int, error) {
	// Use MCP tool to search papers
	toolRequest := mcp.ToolRequest{
		Name: "search_papers",
		Arguments: map[string]interface{}{
			"query":  query,
			"limit":  20,
			"offset": 0,
		},
	}

	return s.executeMCPToolCall(mcpServer, toolRequest)
}

// GetFollowUpQuestions generates and returns follow-up questions for a message
// This is a separate endpoint to avoid including questions in the streaming response
// messageID can be either user message ID or assistant message ID
func (s *Service) GetFollowUpQuestions(conversationID uint, messageID uint, userID uint) (string, error) {
	// Verify conversation belongs to user
	_, err := s.repo.GetConversationByID(conversationID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("conversation not found: %w", err)
	}

	// Get all messages to find the right user and assistant message pair
	messages, err := s.repo.GetConversationMessages(conversationID)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get conversation messages: %w", err)
	}

	// Find the message by ID
	var targetMessage *ConversationMessage
	var targetIndex int
	for i, msg := range messages {
		if msg.ID == messageID {
			targetMessage = &messages[i]
			targetIndex = i
			break
		}
	}

	if targetMessage == nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("message not found")
	}

	var userMessage *ConversationMessage
	var assistantMessage *ConversationMessage

	// Determine which is the user message and which is the assistant message
	if targetMessage.Role == MessageRoleUser {
		// If target is user message, find the next assistant message
		userMessage = targetMessage
		for i := targetIndex + 1; i < len(messages); i++ {
			if messages[i].Role == MessageRoleAssistant {
				assistantMessage = &messages[i]
				break
			}
		}
	} else if targetMessage.Role == MessageRoleAssistant {
		// If target is assistant message, find the previous user message
		assistantMessage = targetMessage
		for i := targetIndex - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
			if messages[i].Role == MessageRoleUser {
				userMessage = &messages[i]
				break
			}
		}
	} else {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid message role")
	}

	if userMessage == nil || assistantMessage == nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("could not find message pair")
	}

	// Check if follow-up questions already exist in assistant message
	if assistantMessage.FollowUpQuestions != "" {
		fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Returning cached follow-up questions for assistant message %d\n", assistantMessage.ID)
		return assistantMessage.FollowUpQuestions, nil
	}

	// Get search query from user message
	searchQuery := userMessage.SearchQuery
	if searchQuery == "" {
		searchQuery = userMessage.Content
	}

	if searchQuery == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("no search query found")
	}

	// Generate follow-up questions based on user query and assistant response
	fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Generating follow-up questions for user query: %s, assistant message ID: %d\n", searchQuery, assistantMessage.ID)
	followUpQuestions, err := s.generateFollowUpQuestions(searchQuery, assistantMessage.Content)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("[ERROR] Failed to generate follow-up questions: %v\n", err)
		// 返回友好的错误提示，而不是空字符串
		// 这样前端可以显示有意义的错误信息
		return "", fmt.Errorf("网络异常，暂时无法生成延伸问题。请稍后重试")
	}

	// Save to database for caching (save to assistant message)
	if err := s.repo.UpdateMessageFollowUpQuestions(assistantMessage.ID, followUpQuestions); err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to cache follow-up questions: %v\n", err)
		// Don't fail the request, just log the warning
	}

	return followUpQuestions, nil
}

package conversation

import (
	"bufio"
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"scholar-backend/internal/ai"
	"scholar-backend/internal/thirdparty"
	"strings"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// ChatService handles chat-style conversations with message chains
type ChatService struct {
	repo               *Repository
	aiService          *ai.Service
	tokenCounter       *TokenCounter
	subscriptionRepo   interface {
		CheckQuota(userID uint, featureType string) (bool, error)
		IncrementUsage(userID uint, featureType string) error
		CheckAndIncrementQuota(userID uint, featureType string) error
	}
}

// NewChatService creates a new chat service
func NewChatService(repo *Repository, aiService *ai.Service) *ChatService {
	// Default max context: 4000 tokens (conservative for most models)
	// This leaves room for system prompts and response
	return &ChatService{
		repo:         repo,
		aiService:    aiService,
		tokenCounter: NewTokenCounter(4000),
	}
}

// SetSubscriptionService sets the subscription service for quota checking
func (s *ChatService) SetSubscriptionService(subscriptionService interface {
	CheckQuota(userID uint, featureType string) (bool, error)
	IncrementUsage(userID uint, featureType string) error
	CheckAndIncrementQuota(userID uint, featureType string) error
}) {
	s.subscriptionRepo = subscriptionService
}

// ChatRequest represents a streaming chat request
type ChatRequest struct {
	ConversationID  uint    `json:"conversation_id"` // Set by handler from URL param
	Content         string  `json:"content" binding:"required"`
	ParentMessageID *string `json:"parent_message_id,omitempty"`
	ModelLevel      string  `json:"model_level,omitempty"` // "low", "mid", "high"
}

// ChatResponse represents a streaming chat response chunk
type ChatResponse struct {
	Type      string `json:"type"` // "message_start", "content_delta", "message_end", "error"
	MessageID string `json:"message_id,omitempty"`
	Content   string `json:"content,omitempty"`
	Error     string `json:"error,omitempty"`
	Metadata  map[string]interface{} `json:"metadata,omitempty"`
}

// StreamChat handles a chat request with streaming response
func (s *ChatService) StreamChat(ctx context.Context, userID uint, req ChatRequest, writer io.Writer) error {
	// 0. Atomically check and increment quota before processing
	if s.subscriptionRepo != nil {
		// Determine feature type based on model level
		modelLevel := req.ModelLevel
		if modelLevel == "" {
			modelLevel = "low"
		}

		var featureType string
		switch modelLevel {
		case "low":
			featureType = "ai_chat_normal"
		case "mid":
			featureType = "ai_chat_mid"
		case "high":
			featureType = "ai_chat_high"
		default:
			featureType = "ai_chat_normal"
		}

		// Atomically check and increment quota to prevent race conditions
		if err := s.subscriptionRepo.CheckAndIncrementQuota(userID, featureType); err != nil {
			log.Printf("Quota check failed: %v", err)
			return fmt.Errorf("配额不足：%s", err.Error())
		}
	}

	// 1. Verify conversation ownership and update model level
	conversation, err := s.repo.GetConversationByID(req.ConversationID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("conversation not found: %w", err)
	}

	// Update conversation's model level if changed
	if modelLevel := req.ModelLevel; modelLevel != "" && conversation.ModelLevel != modelLevel {
		conversation.ModelLevel = modelLevel
		if err := s.repo.UpdateConversation(conversation); err != nil {
			log.Printf("Failed to update conversation model level: %v", err)
		}
	}

	// 2. Create user message
	userMessageID := uuid.New().String()
	userMessage := &ConversationMessage{
		MessageID:       userMessageID,
		ConversationID:  req.ConversationID,
		ParentMessageID: req.ParentMessageID,
		Role:            MessageRoleUser,
		Content:         req.Content,
	}

	// Calculate and cache token count
	userMessage.TokenCount = s.tokenCounter.CountMessageTokens(userMessage)

	// Save user message
	if err := s.repo.UpsertMessage(userMessage); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save user message: %w", err)
	}

	// 3. Build message chain for context
	messageChain, err := s.buildContextChain(userMessageID)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to build context: %w", err)
	}

	// 4. Apply token window limiting
	contextMessages := s.tokenCounter.BuildContextWindow(messageChain)

	// 5. Convert to AI service format
	aiMessages := s.convertToAIMessages(contextMessages)

	// 6. Create assistant message placeholder
	assistantMessageID := uuid.New().String()
	assistantMessage := &ConversationMessage{
		MessageID:       assistantMessageID,
		ConversationID:  req.ConversationID,
		ParentMessageID: &userMessageID,
		Role:            MessageRoleAssistant,
		Content:         "",
		Unfinished:      true,
	}

	if err := s.repo.UpsertMessage(assistantMessage); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create assistant message: %w", err)
	}

	// 6.5. Send user_message_created event (for new conversations)
	s.sendEvent(writer, ChatResponse{
		Type:      "user_message_created",
		MessageID: userMessageID,
		Metadata: map[string]interface{}{
			"content": req.Content,
		},
	})

	// 7. Send message_start event with parent info
	s.sendEvent(writer, ChatResponse{
		Type:      "message_start",
		MessageID: assistantMessageID,
		Metadata: map[string]interface{}{
			"parent_message_id": userMessageID,  // Frontend needs this for context chain
		},
	})

	// 8. Stream AI response with specified model level
	// Determine model level (default to "low" if not specified)
	modelLevel := thirdparty.ModelLevelLow
	if req.ModelLevel != "" {
		switch req.ModelLevel {
		case "mid":
			modelLevel = thirdparty.ModelLevelMid
		case "high":
			modelLevel = thirdparty.ModelLevelHigh
		}
	}

	fullContent := ""
	var streamBuffer bytes.Buffer
	multiWriter := io.MultiWriter(&streamBuffer, writer)

	// Create a custom writer that forwards chunks as SSE
	customWriter := &sseWriter{writer: multiWriter, onChunk: func(chunk string) {
		fullContent += chunk
		s.sendEvent(writer, ChatResponse{
			Type:    "content_delta",
			Content: chunk,
		})
	}}

	err = s.aiService.StreamChatCompletionWithLevel(aiMessages, customWriter, modelLevel)
	if err != nil {
		s.sendEvent(writer, ChatResponse{
			Type:  "error",
			Error: err.Error(),
		})
		assistantMessage.Error = true
		assistantMessage.Unfinished = false
		s.repo.UpdateMessage(assistantMessage)
		return err
	}

	// 9. Update assistant message with complete content
	assistantMessage.Content = fullContent
	assistantMessage.Unfinished = false
	assistantMessage.FinishReason = "stop"
	assistantMessage.TokenCount = s.tokenCounter.EstimateTokenCount(fullContent) + 4

	if err := s.repo.UpdateMessage(assistantMessage); err != nil {
		log.Printf("Failed to update assistant message: %v", err)
	}

	// 10. Touch conversation to update timestamp
	s.repo.TouchConversation(req.ConversationID)

	// 11. Send message_end event
	s.sendEvent(writer, ChatResponse{
		Type:      "message_end",
		MessageID: assistantMessageID,
		Metadata: map[string]interface{}{
			"token_count":   assistantMessage.TokenCount,
			"finish_reason": assistantMessage.FinishReason,
		},
	})

	return nil
}

// sseWriter wraps an io.Writer and extracts text chunks from SSE stream
type sseWriter struct {
	writer  io.Writer
	onChunk func(string)
}

func (w *sseWriter) Write(p []byte) (n int, err error) {
	// Forward to underlying writer
	n, err = w.writer.Write(p)
	if err != nil {
		return n, err
	}

	// Extract content from SSE stream
	content := string(p)
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(strings.NewReader(content))
	for scanner.Scan() {
		line := scanner.Text()
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "data: ") {
			data := strings.TrimPrefix(line, "data: ")
			if data == "[DONE]" {
				continue
			}

			var chunk ai.ChatCompletionChunk
			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(data), &chunk); err == nil {
				if len(chunk.Choices) > 0 && chunk.Choices[0].Delta.Content != "" {
					if w.onChunk != nil {
						w.onChunk(chunk.Choices[0].Delta.Content)
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	return n, nil
}

// buildContextChain builds the message chain from root to the specified message
// Uses optimized version to avoid N+1 query problem (10-100x faster)
func (s *ChatService) buildContextChain(messageID string) ([]ConversationMessage, error) {
	return s.repo.BuildMessageChainOptimized(messageID)
}

// convertToAIMessages converts conversation messages to AI service format
func (s *ChatService) convertToAIMessages(messages []ConversationMessage) []ai.Message {
	aiMessages := make([]ai.Message, 0, len(messages))

	for _, msg := range messages {
		// Skip system messages and error messages
		if msg.Role == MessageRoleSystem || msg.Error {
			continue
		}

		aiMessages = append(aiMessages, ai.Message{
			Role:    string(msg.Role),
			Content: msg.Content,
		})
	}

	return aiMessages
}

// sendEvent sends a Server-Sent Event to the client
func (s *ChatService) sendEvent(writer io.Writer, response ChatResponse) {
	data, err := json.Marshal(response)
	if err != nil {
		log.Printf("Failed to marshal response: %v", err)
		return
	}

	// SSE format: data: {json}\n\n
	fmt.Fprintf(writer, "data: %s\n\n", data)

	// Flush if possible
	if flusher, ok := writer.(interface{ Flush() }); ok {
		flusher.Flush()
	}
}

// GetMessageTree returns the complete message tree for a conversation
func (s *ChatService) GetMessageTree(conversationID uint, userID uint) (map[string]MessageChainResponse, error) {
	// Verify ownership
	_, err := s.repo.GetConversationByID(conversationID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("conversation not found: %w", err)
	}

	// Get all messages
	messages, err := s.repo.GetAllMessagesForTree(conversationID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// Build tree structure
	tree := make(map[string]MessageChainResponse)
	childrenMap := make(map[string][]string)

	// First pass: create all nodes and collect children
	for _, msg := range messages {
		tree[msg.MessageID] = MessageChainResponse{
			ConversationMessage: msg,
			Children:            []string{},
		}

		if msg.ParentMessageID != nil {
			parentID := *msg.ParentMessageID
			childrenMap[parentID] = append(childrenMap[parentID], msg.MessageID)
		}
	}

	// Second pass: assign children to nodes
	for parentID, children := range childrenMap {
		if node, exists := tree[parentID]; exists {
			node.Children = children
			tree[parentID] = node
		}
	}

	return tree, nil
}

// RegenerateMessage regenerates an assistant message by creating a new sibling
func (s *ChatService) RegenerateMessage(ctx context.Context, userID uint, messageID string, writer io.Writer) error {
	// Get the message to regenerate
	message, err := s.repo.GetMessageByMessageID(messageID)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("message not found: %w", err)
	}

	// Verify ownership
	_, err = s.repo.GetConversationByID(message.ConversationID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("conversation not found: %w", err)
	}

	// Only allow regenerating assistant messages
	if message.Role != MessageRoleAssistant {
		return fmt.Errorf("can only regenerate assistant messages")
	}

	// Get parent message (the user message we're responding to)
	if message.ParentMessageID == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("cannot regenerate root message")
	}

	// Build message chain from parent user message for context
	messageChain, err := s.buildContextChain(*message.ParentMessageID)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to build context: %w", err)
	}

	// Apply token window limiting
	contextMessages := s.tokenCounter.BuildContextWindow(messageChain)

	// Convert to AI service format
	aiMessages := s.convertToAIMessages(contextMessages)

	// Create new assistant message placeholder (as sibling to the old response)
	assistantMessageID := uuid.New().String()
	assistantMessage := &ConversationMessage{
		MessageID:       assistantMessageID,
		ConversationID:  message.ConversationID,
		ParentMessageID: message.ParentMessageID, // Same parent as original assistant message
		Role:            MessageRoleAssistant,
		Content:         "",
		Unfinished:      true,
	}

	if err := s.repo.UpsertMessage(assistantMessage); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create assistant message: %w", err)
	}

	// Send message_start event
	s.sendEvent(writer, ChatResponse{
		Type:      "message_start",
		MessageID: assistantMessageID,
		Metadata: map[string]interface{}{
			"parent_message_id": *message.ParentMessageID,
		},
	})

	// Stream AI response
	fullContent := ""
	var streamBuffer bytes.Buffer
	multiWriter := io.MultiWriter(&streamBuffer, writer)

	customWriter := &sseWriter{writer: multiWriter, onChunk: func(chunk string) {
		fullContent += chunk
		s.sendEvent(writer, ChatResponse{
			Type:    "content_delta",
			Content: chunk,
		})
	}}

	err = s.aiService.StreamChatCompletion(aiMessages, customWriter)
	if err != nil {
		s.sendEvent(writer, ChatResponse{
			Type:  "error",
			Error: err.Error(),
		})
		assistantMessage.Error = true
		assistantMessage.Unfinished = false
		s.repo.UpdateMessage(assistantMessage)
		return err
	}

	// Update assistant message with complete content
	assistantMessage.Content = fullContent
	assistantMessage.Unfinished = false
	assistantMessage.FinishReason = "stop"
	assistantMessage.TokenCount = s.tokenCounter.CountMessageTokens(assistantMessage)

	if err := s.repo.UpdateMessage(assistantMessage); err != nil {
		log.Printf("Warning: Failed to update assistant message: %v", err)
	}

	// Send message_end event
	s.sendEvent(writer, ChatResponse{
		Type:      "message_end",
		MessageID: assistantMessageID,
		Content:   fullContent,
	})

	return nil
}

// EditMessage allows editing a user message and regenerating the conversation from that point
func (s *ChatService) EditMessage(ctx context.Context, userID uint, messageID string, newContent string, writer io.Writer) error {
	// Get the message to edit
	message, err := s.repo.GetMessageByMessageID(messageID)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("message not found: %w", err)
	}

	// Verify ownership
	_, err = s.repo.GetConversationByID(message.ConversationID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("conversation not found: %w", err)
	}

	// Only allow editing user messages
	if message.Role != MessageRoleUser {
		return fmt.Errorf("can only edit user messages")
	}

	// Create new branch with edited content
	req := ChatRequest{
		ConversationID:  message.ConversationID,
		Content:         newContent,
		ParentMessageID: message.ParentMessageID,
	}

	// Stream new response
	return s.StreamChat(ctx, userID, req, writer)
}

// GetConversationHistory returns the main conversation path (no branches)
func (s *ChatService) GetConversationHistory(conversationID uint, userID uint) ([]ConversationMessage, error) {
	// Verify ownership
	_, err := s.repo.GetConversationByID(conversationID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("conversation not found: %w", err)
	}

	// Get latest message
	latestMessage, err := s.repo.GetLatestMessageInConversation(conversationID)
	if err != nil {
		// If no messages exist (empty conversation), return empty array
		// This can happen for newly created conversations or after schema reset
		return []ConversationMessage{}, nil
	}

	log.Printf("[DEBUG] Latest message ID: %s, Role: %s, Content preview: %.50s",
		latestMessage.MessageID, latestMessage.Role, latestMessage.Content)

	// Build chain from latest message (optimized version)
	chain, err := s.repo.BuildMessageChainOptimized(latestMessage.MessageID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	log.Printf("[DEBUG] Built chain for conversation %d: %d messages", conversationID, len(chain))
	for i, msg := range chain {
		log.Printf("[DEBUG]   Message %d: ID=%s, Role=%s, ParentID=%v, Content preview=%.30s",
			i, msg.MessageID, msg.Role, msg.ParentMessageID, msg.Content)
	}

	return chain, nil
}

// GetBranchChain returns the complete chain from root to the deepest leaf of a specific branch
// This is used when navigating to a sibling message - we want to show the complete conversation
// path for that branch, not just the sibling message itself
func (s *ChatService) GetBranchChain(messageID string, userID uint) ([]ConversationMessage, error) {
	// Get the starting message
	message, err := s.repo.GetMessageByMessageID(messageID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("message not found: %w", err)
	}

	// Verify ownership
	_, err = s.repo.GetConversationByID(message.ConversationID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("conversation not found: %w", err)
	}

	// Find the latest leaf (deepest child) starting from this message
	leafMessageID, err := s.repo.GetLatestLeafFromMessage(messageID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to find leaf message: %w", err)
	}

	// Build complete chain from root to the leaf (optimized version)
	chain, err := s.repo.BuildMessageChainOptimized(leafMessageID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to build branch chain: %w", err)
	}

	return chain, nil
}

// ContinueConversation 继续对话并使用之前消息的上下文
// 现在使用与智能分析相同的逻辑：始终执行MCP搜索并结合历史查询
func (s *Service) ContinueConversation(conversationID uint, userQuery string, writer io.Writer, userID uint, modelLevel thirdparty.ModelLevel) error {
	// Determine feature type based on model level
	var featureType string
	switch modelLevel {
	case thirdparty.ModelLevelLow:
		featureType = "advanced_search_low"
	case thirdparty.ModelLevelMid:
		featureType = "advanced_search_mid"
	case thirdparty.ModelLevelHigh:
		featureType = "advanced_search_high"
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid model level: %s", modelLevel)
	}

	// Atomically check and increment quota at the beginning
	// This ensures quota is enforced even before the API call starts
	if err := s.subscriptionService.IncrementUsage(userID, featureType); err != nil {
		// Return user-friendly error message
		return fmt.Errorf("配额不足：%s", err.Error())
	}

	// Get the user message (it should already exist, created by frontend)
	// We need to find the latest user message with this query
	messages, err := s.repo.GetConversationMessages(conversationID)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get messages: %w", err)
	}
	
	var userMessage *ConversationMessage
	// Find the latest user message with matching query
	for i := len(messages) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
		if messages[i].Role == MessageRoleUser && messages[i].SearchQuery == userQuery {
			userMessage = &messages[i]
			break
		}
	}
	
	if userMessage == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("user message not found")
	}
	
	userMessageID := userMessage.MessageID
	fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Found user message with ID: %s\n", userMessageID)

	// Update conversation's model level
	conversation, err := s.repo.GetConversationByID(conversationID, userID)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("conversation not found: %w", err)
	}
	if conversation.ModelLevel != string(modelLevel) {
		conversation.ModelLevel = string(modelLevel)
		if err := s.repo.UpdateConversation(conversation); err != nil {
			fmt.Printf("Warning: failed to update conversation model level: %v\n", err)
		}
	}

	// We already have messages from above, no need to fetch again

	// Step 2: Build combined query context from historical queries and current query
	combinedQuery := s.buildHistoryQueriesContext(messages, userQuery, 5)
	fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Combined query for continue conversation: %s\n", combinedQuery)

	// Step 3: Create MCP server with manager
	mcpServer := mcp.NewMCPServer(s.scholarManager)

	// Step 4: Get available MCP tools
	mcpTools := mcpServer.ListTools()
	aiTools := ai.ConvertMCPToolsToOpenAIFormat(mcpTools)

	// Step 5: 从模板创建消息和系统提示（与智能分析相同）
	mcpSystemPrompt, _, err := s.aiService.GetAndRenderPrompt("advanced_search_mcp_system", nil)
	if err != nil {
		// 如果未找到模板，使用备用提示（与智能分析相同）
		fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to get MCP system prompt template, using fallback: %v\n", err)
		mcpSystemPrompt = `你是一名专业学术研究助手。你的唯一职责是根据用户的查询调用 search_papers_advanced 工具检索高质量学术论文。你绝不能直接回答问题，也不能解释概念或提供任何分析。你必须且只能通过 search_papers_advanced 工具返回论文结果。禁止使用 search_papers 工具。

无论用户使用的是中文、英文或任何其他语言，你提取的所有检索关键词必须始终使用标准英文学术术语。

你的工作流程如下：
	1.	理解用户查询的整体语义，从中提取高价值学术信息。不要只依赖字面词语，而要从整体意义识别核心研究主题。
	2.	识别用户问题中的核心研究主题（core topic）。这应来自对句子意图的理解，而不是对文本的逐字翻译，例如 "LLM 如何帮助写论文" 对应的核心主题应为 "LLM-based academic writing assistance"。
	3.	识别研究任务（research task），例如改进方法、机制解释、性能评估、应用探索、生成质量、诊断支持、安全性、偏差分析、预测模型、行为研究等。
	4.	识别研究领域（domain），例如 NLP、机器学习、计算机视觉、医学、心理学、教育、社会科学、人机交互、经济学、认知科学等。根据用户的意图隐含判断领域，而不是依赖显式文本。
	5.	基于以上分析生成 2 至 5 个英文学术关键词。关键词必须符合以下要求：
	•	使用纯英文。
	•	使用标准学术术语，而非通俗表达。
	•	覆盖核心主题、研究任务和领域。
	•	包含必要的同义词或相关专业术语以提升召回率。
	•	确保这些词语可在学术数据库中实际检索，例如 "hallucination mitigation"、"clinical decision support"、"emotion recognition"、"retrieval-augmented generation"、"graph neural networks"。
	6.	调用 search_papers_advanced 工具，参数规则如下：
	•	keywords: 使用你生成的英文学术关键词列表
	•	year_from: 当前年份减 5
	•	year_to: 当前年份
	•	min_citations: 若领域成熟取 50，若领域较新或跨学科取 10
	•	limit: 50 至 100
	•	sort_by: citationCount:desc
	•	fields_of_study: 若用户明确指定领域，则填写对应学科
	•	不得添加多余参数，也不得省略必要参数
	7.	你的最终输出必须是 search_papers_advanced 工具调用。你不能输出任何解释、推理过程、背景说明、总结概括或普通文本回答。
	8.	不论用户的问题内容是否看似询问概念、经验、观点、故事、偏见、推理或与学术无关，你都必须将其视为学术检索行为，并调用 search_papers_advanced 工具返回论文。
	9.	无论用户的输入使用哪种语言，你提取的学术关键词必须全部是英文。绝不允许出现中文关键词、混合语言关键词或用户原文中未翻译的名词。

请严格遵守以上全部规则。`
	}

	systemMessage := ai.ChatMessage{
		Role:    "system",
		Content: mcpSystemPrompt,
	}

	// Use combined query instead of individual context messages
	initialMessages := []ai.ChatMessage{
		systemMessage,
		{
			Role:    "user",
			Content: combinedQuery,
		},
	}

	// Step 6: 调用AI获取工具调用（与智能分析相同）
	// Use low-level model for tool calling to save cost
	fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Calling AI with tools, messages count: %d, tools count: %d\n", len(initialMessages), len(aiTools))
	toolCallResponse, err := s.aiService.ChatCompletionWithTools(initialMessages, aiTools, "auto", thirdparty.ModelLevelLow)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("[ERROR] AI tool call failed: %v\n", err)
		// Still try fallback search below, don't send error to frontend yet
		toolCallResponse = nil
	}

	// Step 7: 执行工具调用并收集结果（与智能分析相同）
	var allPapers []map[string]interface{}
	var totalCount int

	if toolCallResponse != nil && len(toolCallResponse.Choices) > 0 && len(toolCallResponse.Choices[0].Message.ToolCalls) > 0 {
		fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Found %d tool calls\n", len(toolCallResponse.Choices[0].Message.ToolCalls))
		for _, toolCall := range toolCallResponse.Choices[0].Message.ToolCalls {
			fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Tool call name: %s\n", toolCall.Function.Name)
			fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Tool call arguments: %s\n", toolCall.Function.Arguments)

			// Support both search_papers and search_papers_advanced
			if toolCall.Function.Name == "search_papers" || toolCall.Function.Name == "search_papers_advanced" {
				// Parse tool arguments
				var args map[string]interface{}
				if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(toolCall.Function.Arguments), &args); err != nil {
					fmt.Printf("[ERROR] Failed to parse tool arguments: %v\n", err)
					continue
				}

				// Call MCP tool
				toolRequest := mcp.ToolRequest{
					Name:      toolCall.Function.Name,
					Arguments: args,
				}

				papers, total, err := s.executeMCPToolCall(mcpServer, toolRequest)
				if err != nil {
					fmt.Printf("[ERROR] MCP tool call failed: %v\n", err)
					// Don't send technical error to frontend, will handle at the end
					continue
				}

				allPapers = append(allPapers, papers...)
				if total > totalCount {
					totalCount = total
				}
			}
		}
	}

	// If no papers found, try a simple direct search with combined query
	if len(allPapers) == 0 {
		fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] No papers from tool calls, doing direct search\n")
		papers, total, err := s.mcpSearch(combinedQuery, mcpServer)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Printf("[ERROR] Direct search failed: %v\n", err)
			// Send friendly error message
			friendlyError := "网络异常，请稍后重试。如果问题持续，请联系管理员。"
			
			// Save error message to database with parent_message_id
			errorMessage := &ConversationMessage{
				ConversationID:    conversationID,
				ParentMessageID:   &userMessageID,
				Role:              MessageRoleAssistant,
				Content:           friendlyError,
				FollowUpQuestions: "",
			}
			
			if saveErr := s.repo.CreateMessage(errorMessage); saveErr != nil {
				fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to save error message: %v\n", saveErr)
			}
			
			// Send error to frontend
			fmt.Fprintf(writer, "data: [ERROR] %s\n\n", friendlyError)
			if flusher, ok := writer.(interface{ Flush() }); ok {
				flusher.Flush()
			}
			
			return fmt.Errorf("search failed: %w", err)
		}
		allPapers = papers
		totalCount = total
	}

	// Limit papers to top 50 for frontend display and AI analysis
	const maxPapersToShow = 50
	displayPapers := allPapers
	if len(displayPapers) > maxPapersToShow {
		fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Limiting papers from %d to %d for display and analysis\n", len(allPapers), maxPapersToShow)
		displayPapers = displayPapers[:maxPapersToShow]
	}

	// Step 8: Send papers to frontend (only top 50)
	papersData := map[string]interface{}{
		"papers": displayPapers,
		"total":  totalCount,  // Still show the real total count
	}
	papersJSON, _ := json.Marshal(papersData)
	fmt.Fprintf(writer, "data: [PAPERS]%s\n\n", string(papersJSON))
	if flusher, ok := writer.(interface{ Flush() }); ok {
		flusher.Flush()
	}

	// Update user message with search results
	if err := s.repo.UpdateMessageSearchResultsByID(userMessage.ID, displayPapers, totalCount); err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("Warning: failed to update user message with search results: %v\n", err)
	}

	// Step 9: 生成论文的AI分析（与智能分析相同）
	fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Formatting %d papers for AI analysis\n", len(displayPapers))
	// Use more papers for analysis (up to 30) with shorter abstracts
	papersForPrompt := ai.FormatPapersForPromptWithLimit(displayPapers, 30, 200)
	fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] Formatted papers, length: %d characters\n", len(papersForPrompt))

	// 获取分析提示模板（与智能分析相同）
	analysisSystemPrompt, _, err := s.aiService.GetAndRenderPrompt("advanced_search_analysis_system", nil)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to get analysis system prompt template, using fallback: %v\n", err)
		analysisSystemPrompt = "你是一名具有深厚研究背景的高级学术分析专家，能够对多篇论文进行深入解读、方法分析、研究发现抽象、理论联系与批判性整合，并以学术写作风格输出高质量分析报告。"
	}

	analysisPrompt, _, err := s.aiService.GetAndRenderPrompt("advanced_search_analysis", map[string]string{
		"query":  userQuery,
		"papers": papersForPrompt,
	})
	if err != nil {
		// 如果未找到模板，使用备用提示（与智能分析相同）
		fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to get analysis prompt template, using fallback: %v\n", err)
		analysisPrompt = fmt.Sprintf(`用户查询：%s
找到的论文：%s

请作为一名具备跨领域知识的资深学术研究专家，对以上论文进行深度整合分析，并给出具有洞察力、逻辑严密、贴合用户问题的学术级解读。

你的输出必须遵守以下原则：

一、输出结构不固定
你不需要使用预定义的标题，也不需要每次遵循同样的段落结构。
你应根据用户的查询内容、论文主题性质、研究领域特点，自主决定分析的组织方式。
输出形式可以是：
	•	连贯的长文
	•	分层的分析段落
	•	自定义的小节
	•	或混合结构
但必须确保内容严谨、有逻辑、有深度。

二、分析范围必须覆盖以下六大方面（但无需按固定标题呈现）
你要在整份分析中自然体现以下内容，但你可以自由组织顺序、结构与表达方式：
	1.	研究领域背景、核心问题、发展趋势
	2.	各论文的方法、技术路线与创新点
	3.	论文的发现、结论与学术贡献
	4.	实际应用价值、实践意义、产业影响
	5.	研究脉络、方法演进、论文之间的逻辑关系
	6.	批判性观点、研究不足与未来方向
这些内容要以"自然流畅、连贯而不刻意分段"的方式融入分析。

三、引用格式必须严格使用以下形式
【引用编号：具体内容】
所有论述性内容必须通过引用论文中的数据、方法、结论或关键描述进行支撑。
每一部分分析都必须至少使用 3–5 个引用标记。
引用必须具体，例如：
【引用3：模型在XXX数据集上提升了12.5%%】
而不是模糊表达。

四、分析必须基于论文内容本身
	•	不得编造不存在的论文结论
	•	不得使用无引用支持的判断
	•	必须结合论文中的数据、实验结果、方法细节
	•	必须保持学术严谨性和批判性

五、写作风格要求
	•	像一位 senior researcher 的深度综述
	•	不复述论文摘要，而是给"洞察"与"分析"
	•	不空洞、不堆叠句子
	•	强调交叉比较、研究关系、理论意义、应用前景
	•	在整体布局上做到自然流畅、有张力、有逻辑

六、最终输出
	•	使用 Markdown 格式
	•	无固定标题框架
	•	完全由你自由组织结构
	•	内容必须覆盖上述六大分析面向，但表达形式由你决定
	•	引用规范必须严格遵守

请开始你的深度综合分析。`, userQuery, papersForPrompt)
	}

	analysisMessages := []ai.ChatMessage{
		{
			Role:    "system",
			Content: analysisSystemPrompt,
		},
		{
			Role:    "user",
			Content: analysisPrompt,
		},
	}

	// Apply context truncation to ensure we stay within 128K limit
	const max128K = 128000 * 4 // Roughly 128K tokens * 4 chars per token
	analysisMessages = ai.TruncateContextForLimit(analysisMessages, max128K)

	fmt.Printf("[DEBUG] About to call StreamChatCompletionAndCollectWithLevel, modelLevel: %s, messages count: %d, prompt length: %d\n",
		modelLevel, len(analysisMessages), len(analysisPrompt))

	// Step 10: Stream AI response and collect full content using specified model level
	fullContent, err := s.aiService.StreamChatCompletionAndCollectWithLevel(analysisMessages, writer, modelLevel)
	if err != nil {
		// 生成友好的错误消息
		friendlyError := "网络异常，请稍后重试。如果问题持续，请联系管理员。"
		fmt.Printf("[ERROR] AI analysis failed: %v\n", err)

		// 将错误消息保存为 assistant 消息，以便历史记录中显示
		errorMessage := &ConversationMessage{
			ConversationID:    conversationID,
			ParentMessageID:   &userMessageID,
			Role:              MessageRoleAssistant,
			Content:           friendlyError,
			FollowUpQuestions: "",
		}

		if saveErr := s.repo.CreateMessage(errorMessage); saveErr != nil {
			fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to save error message: %v\n", saveErr)
		}

		// 通过流式接口发送错误消息
		fmt.Fprintf(writer, "data: %s\n\n", friendlyError)
		if flusher, ok := writer.(interface{ Flush() }); ok {
			flusher.Flush()
		}

		return fmt.Errorf("AI analysis failed: %w", err)
	}

	// Note: Usage was already incremented at the beginning

	// Step 11: Clear old follow-up questions from previous messages in this conversation
	if err := s.repo.ClearOldFollowUpQuestions(conversationID); err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("[WARN] Failed to clear old follow-up questions: %v\n", err)
	}

	// 保存助手消息到对话中（包含parent_message_id）
	// 后续问题将通过单独的端点按需生成（与智能分析相同）
	assistantMessage := &ConversationMessage{
		ConversationID:    conversationID,
		ParentMessageID:   &userMessageID, // Link to user message
		Role:              MessageRoleAssistant,
		Content:           fullContent,
		FollowUpQuestions: "", // Will be generated on-demand
	}

	if err := s.repo.CreateMessage(assistantMessage); err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("Warning: failed to save assistant message: %v\n", err)
	}

	return nil
}

// buildContextMessages builds context from recent conversation messages
// It limits the number of rounds and summarizes paper information to control token count
func (s *Service) buildContextMessages(messages []ConversationMessage, maxRounds int) []ai.ChatMessage {
	var contextMessages []ai.ChatMessage

	// Calculate how many messages to include (maxRounds * 2 for user + assistant pairs)
	startIdx := 0
	if len(messages) > maxRounds*2 {
		startIdx = len(messages) - maxRounds*2
	}

	for i := startIdx; i < len(messages); i++ {
		msg := messages[i]
		isLastMessage := (i == len(messages)-1)

		// Build message content
		var content string
		if msg.Role == MessageRoleUser {
			content = msg.Content

			// Add search results summary if available
			if len(msg.SearchResults) > 0 {
				// For older messages, use fewer papers; for recent messages, keep more
				maxPapersInContext := 5
				if isLastMessage || i >= len(messages)-2 {
					maxPapersInContext = 10 // Keep more papers for recent messages
				}
				papersSummary := s.summarizePapers(msg.SearchResults, maxPapersInContext)
				content += fmt.Sprintf("\n\n[搜索结果摘要：找到 %d 篇论文]\n%s", msg.SearchResultsTotal, papersSummary)
			}
		} else {
			// For assistant messages, truncate if too long (keep first 1000 chars)
			content = msg.Content
			if len(content) > 1000 {
				content = content[:1000] + "..."
			}
		}

		contextMessages = append(contextMessages, ai.ChatMessage{
			Role:    string(msg.Role),
			Content: content,
		})
	}

	return contextMessages
}

// summarizePapers creates a brief summary of papers for context
func (s *Service) summarizePapers(papers []map[string]interface{}, maxPapers int) string {
	var summaries []string

	count := len(papers)
	if count > maxPapers {
		count = maxPapers
	}

	for i := 0; i < count; i++ {
		paper := papers[i]
		title, _ := paper["title"].(string)
		abstract, _ := paper["abstract"].(string)

		// Truncate abstract to first 200 characters
		if len(abstract) > 200 {
			abstract = abstract[:200] + "..."
		}

		summary := fmt.Sprintf("%d. %s\n   摘要：%s", i+1, title, abstract)
		summaries = append(summaries, summary)
	}

	return strings.Join(summaries, "\n\n")
}

// buildHistoryQueriesContext extracts historical user queries for context
// Returns a combined query that includes both current query and historical context
func (s *Service) buildHistoryQueriesContext(messages []ConversationMessage, currentQuery string, maxRounds int) string {
	var historyQueries []string

	// Calculate how many messages to include
	startIdx := 0
	if len(messages) > maxRounds*2 {
		startIdx = len(messages) - maxRounds*2
	}

	// Extract user queries from history
	for i := startIdx; i < len(messages); i++ {
		msg := messages[i]
		if msg.Role == MessageRoleUser {
			// Use SearchQuery if available, otherwise use Content
			query := msg.SearchQuery
			if query == "" {
				query = msg.Content
			}
			if query != "" {
				historyQueries = append(historyQueries, query)
			}
		}
	}

	// If no history, return current query
	if len(historyQueries) == 0 {
		return currentQuery
	}

	// Build context string
	var contextBuilder strings.Builder
	contextBuilder.WriteString("历史对话中的提问：\n")
	for i, q := range historyQueries {
		contextBuilder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%d. %s\n", i+1, q))
	}
	contextBuilder.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("\n当前提问：%s", currentQuery))
	
	return contextBuilder.String()
}

// ========== 文件: backend/internal/conversation/token_counter.go ==========
// ============================================================================
// Scholay学术 V1.0
// Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
// 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
// All Rights Reserved.
// ============================================================================

package conversation

import (
	"strings"
	"unicode"
)

// TokenCounter provides methods for counting tokens in messages
// This is a simplified implementation. For production, consider using tiktoken or similar libraries
type TokenCounter struct {
	maxContextTokens int
}

// NewTokenCounter creates a new token counter with a maximum context window
func NewTokenCounter(maxContextTokens int) *TokenCounter {
	return &TokenCounter{
		maxContextTokens: maxContextTokens,
	}
}

// EstimateTokenCount estimates the number of tokens in a text
// Simplified approximation: ~4 characters per token for English text
// For more accurate counting, integrate tiktoken or similar library
func (tc *TokenCounter) EstimateTokenCount(text string) int {
	if text == "" {
		return 0
	}

	// Count words as a more accurate baseline
	words := strings.FieldsFunc(text, func(r rune) bool {
		return unicode.IsSpace(r) || unicode.IsPunct(r)
	})

	// Approximate: 1.3 tokens per word on average
	// Add some overhead for punctuation and special characters
	tokenCount := int(float64(len(words)) * 1.3)

	// Minimum 1 token for non-empty text
	if tokenCount == 0 && len(text) > 0 {
		tokenCount = 1
	}

	return tokenCount
}

// CountMessageTokens counts tokens for a single message including role
func (tc *TokenCounter) CountMessageTokens(message *ConversationMessage) int {
	// Count content tokens
	contentTokens := tc.EstimateTokenCount(message.Content)

	// Add overhead for message structure (role, formatting, etc.)
	// Typical overhead: ~4 tokens per message for formatting
	overhead := 4

	return contentTokens + overhead
}

// GetMessagesWithinTokenLimit returns messages that fit within the token limit
// Messages are processed from newest to oldest, maintaining context window
func (tc *TokenCounter) GetMessagesWithinTokenLimit(messages []ConversationMessage, tokenLimit int) []ConversationMessage {
	if len(messages) == 0 {
		return messages
	}

	var result []ConversationMessage
	totalTokens := 0

	// Process messages from newest to oldest
	for i := len(messages) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
		message := messages[i]

		// Calculate or use cached token count
		if message.TokenCount == 0 {
			message.TokenCount = tc.CountMessageTokens(&message)
		}

		// Check if adding this message would exceed limit
		if totalTokens+message.TokenCount > tokenLimit {
			break
		}

		totalTokens += message.TokenCount
		// Prepend to maintain chronological order
		result = append([]ConversationMessage{message}, result...)
	}

	return result
}

// BuildContextWindow builds a context window from a message chain
// Applies token limiting while maintaining the most recent context
func (tc *TokenCounter) BuildContextWindow(chain []ConversationMessage) []ConversationMessage {
	return tc.GetMessagesWithinTokenLimit(chain, tc.maxContextTokens)
}

// ShouldTruncateContext determines if the context needs truncation
func (tc *TokenCounter) ShouldTruncateContext(messages []ConversationMessage) bool {
	totalTokens := 0
	for i := range messages {
		if messages[i].TokenCount == 0 {
			messages[i].TokenCount = tc.CountMessageTokens(&messages[i])
		}
		totalTokens += messages[i].TokenCount
	}
	return totalTokens > tc.maxContextTokens
}

// GetTotalTokens calculates total tokens for all messages
func (tc *TokenCounter) GetTotalTokens(messages []ConversationMessage) int {
	totalTokens := 0
	for i := range messages {
		if messages[i].TokenCount == 0 {
			messages[i].TokenCount = tc.CountMessageTokens(&messages[i])
		}
		totalTokens += messages[i].TokenCount
	}
	return totalTokens
}

// CalculateAndCacheTokens calculates token counts for messages and caches them
func (tc *TokenCounter) CalculateAndCacheTokens(messages []ConversationMessage) {
	for i := range messages {
		if messages[i].TokenCount == 0 {
			messages[i].TokenCount = tc.CountMessageTokens(&messages[i])
		}
	}
}

// CalculateDiscount 计算折扣（预览）
func (h *Handler) CalculateDiscount(c *gin.Context) {
	userIDInterface, exists := c.Get("user_id")
	if !exists {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Unauthorized")
		return
	}
	userID := userIDInterface.(uint)

	couponID, err := strconv.ParseUint(c.Query("coupon_id"), 10, 64)
	if err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid coupon ID")
		return
	}

	amount, err := strconv.ParseFloat(c.Query("amount"), 64)
	if err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid amount")
		return
	}

	// 获取折扣券信息
	coupons, _, err := h.service.GetUserCoupons(uint64(userID), nil, 1, 1000)
	if err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
		return
	}

	var targetCoupon *UserCoupon
	for _, coupon := range coupons {
		if coupon.ID == couponID {
			targetCoupon = coupon
			break
		}
	}

	if targetCoupon == nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusNotFound, "Coupon not found")
		return
	}

	// 验证并计算折扣
	if targetCoupon.Status != CouponStatusUnused {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Coupon is not available")
		return
	}

	if !IsValidTime(targetCoupon.ValidFrom, targetCoupon.ValidUntil) {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Coupon has expired")
		return
	}

	if !IsValidAmount(targetCoupon.MinPurchaseAmount, amount) {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Amount does not meet minimum requirement")
		return
	}

	discountAmount := CalculateDiscount(
		DiscountType(targetCoupon.DiscountType),
		targetCoupon.DiscountValue,
		amount,
	)

	utils.Success(c, gin.H{
		"original_amount": amount,
		"discount_amount": discountAmount,
		"final_amount":    amount - discountAmount,
		"coupon":          targetCoupon,
	})
}

// GenerateInvitation 生成邀请码
func (h *Handler) GenerateInvitation(c *gin.Context) {
	userIDInterface, exists := c.Get("user_id")
	if !exists {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Unauthorized")
		return
	}
	userID := userIDInterface.(uint)

	invitation, err := h.service.GenerateInvitation(uint64(userID))
	if err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
		return
	}

	utils.Success(c, invitation)
}

// GetMyInvitation 获取我的邀请信息
func (h *Handler) GetMyInvitation(c *gin.Context) {
	userIDInterface, exists := c.Get("user_id")
	if !exists {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Unauthorized")
		return
	}
	userID := userIDInterface.(uint)

	invitation, err := h.service.GetUserInvitation(uint64(userID))
	if err != nil {
		// 用户还没有邀请码，返回 200 但 data 为 null
		utils.Success(c, gin.H{
			"invitation": nil,
			"has_invitation": false,
			"message": "No invitation code generated yet",
		})
		return
	}

	utils.Success(c, gin.H{
		"invitation": invitation,
		"has_invitation": true,
	})
}

// GetInvitationStatistics 获取邀请统计
func (h *Handler) GetInvitationStatistics(c *gin.Context) {
	userIDInterface, exists := c.Get("user_id")
	if !exists {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Unauthorized")
		return
	}
	userID := userIDInterface.(uint)

	invitation, relationships, err := h.service.GetInvitationStatistics(uint64(userID))
	if err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
		return
	}

	utils.Success(c, gin.H{
		"invitation":    invitation,
		"relationships": relationships,
	})
}

// ============================================
// Admin APIs - 批量发放管理
// ============================================

// CreateBatch 创建批量发放批次
func (h *Handler) CreateBatch(c *gin.Context) {
	var req CreateBatchRequest
	if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
		return
	}

	// 获取管理员ID
	adminIDInterface, exists := c.Get("user_id")
	if !exists {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Unauthorized")
		return
	}
	adminID := adminIDInterface.(uint)

	batch, err := h.service.CreateBatchFromRequest(&req, uint64(adminID))
	if err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
		return
	}

	utils.Success(c, batch)
}

// GetBatch 获取批次详情
func (h *Handler) GetBatch(c *gin.Context) {
	id, err := strconv.ParseUint(c.Param("id"), 10, 64)
	if err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid batch ID")
		return
	}

	batch, err := h.service.GetBatch(id)
	if err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusNotFound, "Batch not found")
		return
	}

	utils.Success(c, batch)
}

// ListBatches 获取批次列表
func (h *Handler) ListBatches(c *gin.Context) {
	page, _ := strconv.Atoi(c.DefaultQuery("page", "1"))
	pageSize, _ := strconv.Atoi(c.DefaultQuery("page_size", "20"))

	// 可选状态过滤
	var status *string
	if s := c.Query("status"); s != "" {
		status = &s
	}

	batches, total, err := h.service.ListBatches(status, page, pageSize)
	if err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
		return
	}

	utils.Success(c, gin.H{
		"batches":   batches,
		"total":     total,
		"page":      page,
		"page_size": pageSize,
	})
}

// ExecuteBatch 执行批次发放
func (h *Handler) ExecuteBatch(c *gin.Context) {
	id, err := strconv.ParseUint(c.Param("id"), 10, 64)
	if err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid batch ID")
		return
	}

	if err := h.service.ExecuteBatch(id); err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
		return
	}

	utils.Success(c, gin.H{"message": "Batch executed successfully"})
}

// CancelBatch 取消批次
func (h *Handler) CancelBatch(c *gin.Context) {
	id, err := strconv.ParseUint(c.Param("id"), 10, 64)
	if err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid batch ID")
		return
	}

	if err := h.service.CancelBatch(id); err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
		return
	}

	utils.Success(c, gin.H{"message": "Batch cancelled successfully"})
}

package coupon

import (
	"database/sql/driver"
	"encoding/json"
	"time"
)

// DiscountType 折扣类型
type DiscountType string

const (
	DiscountTypePercentage DiscountType = "percentage" // 百分比折扣
	DiscountTypeFixed      DiscountType = "fixed"      // 固定金额
	DiscountTypePriceOff   DiscountType = "price_off"  // 减免金额
)

// DistributionType 发放类型
type DistributionType string

const (
	DistributionTypeManual       DistributionType = "manual"        // 手动发放
	DistributionTypeAutoInvite   DistributionType = "auto_invite"   // 邀请自动发放
	DistributionTypeAutoRegister DistributionType = "auto_register" // 注册自动发放
	DistributionTypeBatch        DistributionType = "batch"         // 批量发放
	DistributionTypeTargeted     DistributionType = "targeted"      // 定向发放
)

// TemplateStatus 模板状态
type TemplateStatus string

const (
	TemplateStatusDraft   TemplateStatus = "draft"   // 草稿
	TemplateStatusActive  TemplateStatus = "active"  // 活动
	TemplateStatusPaused  TemplateStatus = "paused"  // 暂停
	TemplateStatusExpired TemplateStatus = "expired" // 过期
)

// CouponStatus 折扣券状态
type CouponStatus string

const (
	CouponStatusUnused    CouponStatus = "unused"    // 未使用
	CouponStatusReserved  CouponStatus = "reserved"  // 已预留（订单创建但未支付）
	CouponStatusUsed      CouponStatus = "used"      // 已使用
	CouponStatusExpired   CouponStatus = "expired"   // 已过期
	CouponStatusCancelled CouponStatus = "cancelled" // 已取消
)

// SourceType 来源类型
type SourceType string

const (
	SourceTypeManual   SourceType = "manual"   // 手动发放
	SourceTypeInvite   SourceType = "invite"   // 邀请获得
	SourceTypeRegister SourceType = "register" // 注册获得
	SourceTypeBatch    SourceType = "batch"    // 批量发放
	SourceTypeTargeted SourceType = "targeted" // 定向发放
	SourceTypeActivity SourceType = "activity" // 活动获得
)

// JSONArray 用于处理JSON数组
type JSONArray []interface{}

// Value 实现 driver.Valuer 接口
func (j JSONArray) Value() (driver.Value, error) {
	if j == nil {
		return nil, nil
	}
	return json.Marshal(j)
}

// Scan 实现 sql.Scanner 接口
func (j *JSONArray) Scan(value interface{}) error {
	if value == nil {
		*j = nil
		return nil
	}
	bytes, ok := value.([]byte)
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	return json.Unmarshal(bytes, j)
}

// JSONMap 用于处理JSON对象
type JSONMap map[string]interface{}

// Value 实现 driver.Valuer 接口
func (j JSONMap) Value() (driver.Value, error) {
	if j == nil {
		return nil, nil
	}
	return json.Marshal(j)
}

// Scan 实现 sql.Scanner 接口
func (j *JSONMap) Scan(value interface{}) error {
	if value == nil {
		*j = nil
		return nil
	}
	bytes, ok := value.([]byte)
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	return json.Unmarshal(bytes, j)
}

// CouponTemplate 折扣券模板
type CouponTemplate struct {
	ID          uint64    `gorm:"primaryKey;autoIncrement" json:"id"`
	Code        string    `gorm:"type:varchar(50);not null;uniqueIndex" json:"code"`
	Name        string    `gorm:"type:varchar(100);not null" json:"name"`
	Description string    `gorm:"type:text" json:"description"`
	Type        DiscountType `gorm:"type:enum('percentage','fixed','price_off');default:'percentage'" json:"type"`
	DiscountValue float64   `gorm:"type:decimal(10,2);not null" json:"discount_value"`

	// 使用条件
	MinPurchaseAmount float64   `gorm:"type:decimal(10,2);default:0" json:"min_purchase_amount"`
	ApplicablePlans   JSONArray `gorm:"type:json" json:"applicable_plans"`
	ApplicableProducts JSONArray `gorm:"type:json" json:"applicable_products"`

	// 发放规则
	DistributionType DistributionType `gorm:"type:enum('manual','auto_invite','auto_register','batch','targeted');default:'manual'" json:"distribution_type"`

	// 时间限制
	ValidDays       int       `gorm:"default:30" json:"valid_days"`
	FixedValidStart *time.Time `json:"fixed_valid_start"`
	FixedValidEnd   *time.Time `json:"fixed_valid_end"`

	// 使用限制
	MaxUsageTotal   *int `json:"max_usage_total"`
	MaxUsagePerUser int  `gorm:"default:1" json:"max_usage_per_user"`
	FirstPurchaseOnly bool `gorm:"default:false" json:"first_purchase_only"`
	NewUserOnly     bool `gorm:"default:false" json:"new_user_only"`

	// 状态管理
	Status   TemplateStatus `gorm:"type:enum('draft','active','paused','expired');default:'draft'" json:"status"`
	Priority int           `gorm:"default:0" json:"priority"`

	// 邀请相关
	IsInviteCoupon bool    `gorm:"default:false" json:"is_invite_coupon"`
	InviterBenefit JSONMap `gorm:"type:json" json:"inviter_benefit"`

	CreatedAt time.Time `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
	CreatedBy *uint64   `json:"created_by"`
}

// TableName 指定表名
func (CouponTemplate) TableName() string {
	return "coupon_templates"
}

// UserCoupon 用户折扣券
type UserCoupon struct {
	ID         uint64 `gorm:"primaryKey;autoIncrement" json:"id"`
	UserID     uint64 `gorm:"not null;index:idx_user_status" json:"user_id"`
	TemplateID uint64 `gorm:"not null;index" json:"template_id"`
	CouponCode string `gorm:"type:varchar(100);uniqueIndex" json:"coupon_code"`

	// 来源追踪
	SourceType   SourceType `gorm:"type:enum('manual','invite','register','batch','targeted','activity');not null" json:"source_type"`
	SourceID     string     `gorm:"type:varchar(100)" json:"source_id"`
	SourceDetail JSONMap    `gorm:"type:json" json:"source_detail"`

	// 有效期
	ValidFrom  time.Time `gorm:"not null" json:"valid_from"`
	ValidUntil time.Time `gorm:"not null" json:"valid_until"`

	// 使用状态
	Status      CouponStatus `gorm:"type:enum('unused','used','expired','cancelled');default:'unused';index:idx_user_status" json:"status"`
	UsedAt      *time.Time   `json:"used_at"`
	UsedOrderID *uint64      `json:"used_order_id"`

	// 折扣信息（冗余存储）
	DiscountType      string  `gorm:"type:varchar(20);not null" json:"discount_type"`
	DiscountValue     float64 `gorm:"type:decimal(10,2);not null" json:"discount_value"`
	MinPurchaseAmount float64 `gorm:"type:decimal(10,2);default:0" json:"min_purchase_amount"`

	CreatedAt time.Time `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt time.Time `json:"updated_at"`

	// 关联
	Template *CouponTemplate `gorm:"foreignKey:TemplateID" json:"template,omitempty"`
}

// TableName 指定表名
func (UserCoupon) TableName() string {
	return "user_coupons"
}

	OriginalAmount float64 `gorm:"type:decimal(10,2);not null" json:"original_amount"`
	DiscountAmount float64 `gorm:"type:decimal(10,2);not null" json:"discount_amount"`

	Status string `gorm:"type:enum('applied','confirmed','refunded');default:'applied'" json:"status"`

	AppliedAt   time.Time  `gorm:"default:CURRENT_TIMESTAMP" json:"applied_at"`

package coupon

import (
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

type Repository struct {
	db *gorm.DB
}

func NewRepository(db *gorm.DB) *Repository {
	return &Repository{db: db}
}

// ============================================
// 折扣券模板相关
// ============================================

// CreateTemplate 创建折扣券模板
func (r *Repository) CreateTemplate(template *CouponTemplate) error {
	return r.db.Create(template).Error
}

// GetTemplateByID 通过ID获取模板
func (r *Repository) GetTemplateByID(id uint64) (*CouponTemplate, error) {
	var template CouponTemplate
	err := r.db.Where("id = ?", id).First(&template).Error
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &template, nil
}

// GetTemplateByCode 通过代码获取模板
func (r *Repository) GetTemplateByCode(code string) (*CouponTemplate, error) {
	var template CouponTemplate
	err := r.db.Where("code = ?", code).First(&template).Error
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &template, nil
}

// GetActiveTemplateByCode 获取活动状态的模板
func (r *Repository) GetActiveTemplateByCode(code string) (*CouponTemplate, error) {
	var template CouponTemplate
	err := r.db.Where("code = ? AND status = ?", code, TemplateStatusActive).First(&template).Error
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &template, nil
}

// UpdateTemplate 更新模板
func (r *Repository) UpdateTemplate(id uint64, updates map[string]interface{}) error {
	return r.db.Model(&CouponTemplate{}).Where("id = ?", id).Updates(updates).Error
}

// ListTemplates 获取模板列表
func (r *Repository) ListTemplates(status *TemplateStatus, distributionType *DistributionType, offset, limit int) ([]*CouponTemplate, int64, error) {
	query := r.db.Model(&CouponTemplate{})

	if status != nil {
		query = query.Where("status = ?", *status)
	}
	if distributionType != nil {
		query = query.Where("distribution_type = ?", *distributionType)
	}

	var total int64
	if err := query.Count(&total).Error; err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}

	var templates []*CouponTemplate
	err := query.Order("created_at DESC").Offset(offset).Limit(limit).Find(&templates).Error
	return templates, total, err
}

// GetAutoDistributionTemplates 获取自动发放的模板
func (r *Repository) GetAutoDistributionTemplates(distributionType DistributionType) ([]*CouponTemplate, error) {
	var templates []*CouponTemplate
	err := r.db.Where("distribution_type = ? AND status = ?", distributionType, TemplateStatusActive).
		Find(&templates).Error
	return templates, err
}

// DeleteTemplate 删除模板（软删除）
func (r *Repository) DeleteTemplate(id uint64) error {
	// 检查是否有用户已经领取了该模板的券
	var userCouponCount int64
	if err := r.db.Model(&UserCoupon{}).Where("template_id = ?", id).Count(&userCouponCount).Error; err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if userCouponCount > 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("无法删除：该折扣券已发放给 %d 位用户，请先暂停该折扣券", userCouponCount)
	}

	// 检查是否有批次发放记录关联
	var batchCount int64
	if err := r.db.Model(&CouponBatch{}).Where("template_id = ?", id).Count(&batchCount).Error; err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if batchCount > 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("无法删除：该折扣券有 %d 个批次发放记录，请先删除相关批次", batchCount)
	}

	return r.db.Delete(&CouponTemplate{}, id).Error
}

// AdminListAllDistributedCoupons 管理员获取所有已发放折扣券列表（支持筛选）
func (r *Repository) AdminListAllDistributedCoupons(templateID *uint64, status *CouponStatus, userEmail string, offset, limit int) ([]*UserCoupon, int64, error) {
	query := r.db.Model(&UserCoupon{}).Preload("Template")

	// 如果指定了用户邮箱，需要join用户表进行筛选
	if userEmail != "" {
		query = query.Joins("JOIN users ON users.id = user_coupons.user_id").
			Where("users.email LIKE ?", "%"+userEmail+"%")
	}

	// 按模板筛选
	if templateID != nil {
		query = query.Where("template_id = ?", *templateID)
	}

	// 按状态筛选
	if status != nil {
		query = query.Where("user_coupons.status = ?", *status)
	}

	var total int64
	if err := query.Count(&total).Error; err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}

	var coupons []*UserCoupon
	err := query.Order("user_coupons.created_at DESC").Offset(offset).Limit(limit).Find(&coupons).Error
	return coupons, total, err
}

// GetAvailableCoupons 获取用户可用的折扣券
func (r *Repository) GetAvailableCoupons(userID uint64, amount float64) ([]*UserCoupon, error) {
	now := time.Now()
	var coupons []*UserCoupon

	err := r.db.Preload("Template").
		Joins("JOIN coupon_templates ON user_coupons.template_id = coupon_templates.id").
		Where("user_coupons.user_id = ? AND user_coupons.status = ? AND user_coupons.valid_from <= ? AND user_coupons.valid_until >= ?",
			userID, CouponStatusUnused, now, now).
		Where("user_coupons.min_purchase_amount <= ?", amount).
		Where("coupon_templates.status = ?", TemplateStatusActive).
		Order("user_coupons.discount_value DESC").
		Find(&coupons).Error

	return coupons, err
}

// UpdateUserCoupon 更新用户折扣券
func (r *Repository) UpdateUserCoupon(id uint64, updates map[string]interface{}) error {
	return r.db.Model(&UserCoupon{}).Where("id = ?", id).Updates(updates).Error
}

// UseCoupon 使用折扣券 (accepts both unused and reserved status)
func (r *Repository) UseCoupon(couponID uint64, orderID uint64) error {
	now := time.Now()
	return r.db.Model(&UserCoupon{}).
		Where("id = ? AND status IN (?)", couponID, []CouponStatus{CouponStatusUnused, CouponStatusReserved}).
		Updates(map[string]interface{}{
			"status":        CouponStatusUsed,
			"used_at":       now,
			"used_order_id": orderID,
		}).Error
}

// ExpireCoupons 过期折扣券
func (r *Repository) ExpireCoupons() (int64, error) {
	now := time.Now()
	result := r.db.Model(&UserCoupon{}).
		Where("status = ? AND valid_until < ?", CouponStatusUnused, now).
		Update("status", CouponStatusExpired)
	return result.RowsAffected, result.Error
}

// CountUserCouponUsage 统计用户使用某模板的次数
func (r *Repository) CountUserCouponUsage(userID uint64, templateID uint64) (int64, error) {
	var count int64
	err := r.db.Model(&UserCoupon{}).
		Where("user_id = ? AND template_id = ?", userID, templateID).
		Count(&count).Error
	return count, err
}

// ============================================
// 统计相关
// ============================================

// GetStatistics 获取统计信息
func (r *Repository) GetStatistics() (*CouponStatistics, error) {
	var stats CouponStatistics

	// 统计模板数量
	r.db.Model(&CouponTemplate{}).Count(&stats.TotalTemplates)
	r.db.Model(&CouponTemplate{}).Where("status = ?", TemplateStatusActive).Count(&stats.ActiveTemplates)

	// 统计发放和使用数量
	r.db.Model(&UserCoupon{}).Count(&stats.TotalDistributed)
	r.db.Model(&UserCoupon{}).Where("status = ?", CouponStatusUsed).Count(&stats.TotalUsed)

	// 计算使用率
	if stats.TotalDistributed > 0 {
		stats.UsageRate = float64(stats.TotalUsed) / float64(stats.TotalDistributed) * 100
	}

	// 统计折扣总金额
	var discountAmount float64
	r.db.Model(&CouponUsageLog{}).Where("status = ?", "confirmed").
		Select("COALESCE(SUM(discount_amount), 0)").Scan(&discountAmount)
	stats.TotalDiscountAmount = discountAmount

	return &stats, nil
}

// Transaction 执行事务
func (r *Repository) Transaction(fn func(*Repository) error) error {
	return r.db.Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error {
		txRepo := &Repository{db: tx}
		return fn(txRepo)
	})
}
