// 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
// All Rights Reserved.
// ============================================================================

package coupon

import (
	"log"
	"time"
)

// Scheduler 定时任务调度器
type Scheduler struct {
	service *Service
	stopCh  chan struct{}
}

// NewScheduler 创建新的调度器
func NewScheduler(service *Service) *Scheduler {
	return &Scheduler{
		service: service,
		stopCh:  make(chan struct{}),
	}
}

// Start 启动调度器
func (s *Scheduler) Start() {
	log.Println("[Coupon Scheduler] Starting coupon scheduler...")

	// 启动过期券清理任务（每小时执行一次）
	go s.runExpireCouponsTask()

	// 启动月度优惠券发放任务（每天检查一次）
	go s.runMonthlyDistributionTask()

	// 启动定期批次执行任务（每10分钟检查一次）
	go s.runScheduledBatchTask()

	log.Println("[Coupon Scheduler] Coupon scheduler started successfully")
}

// Stop 停止调度器
func (s *Scheduler) Stop() {
	close(s.stopCh)
	log.Println("[Coupon Scheduler] Coupon scheduler stopped")
}

// runExpireCouponsTask 运行过期券清理任务
func (s *Scheduler) runExpireCouponsTask() {
	ticker := time.NewTicker(1 * time.Hour)
	defer ticker.Stop()

	// 立即执行一次
	s.executeExpireCoupons()

	for {
		select {
		case <-ticker.C:
			s.executeExpireCoupons()
		case <-s.stopCh:
			return
		}
	}
}

// executeExpireCoupons 执行过期券清理
func (s *Scheduler) executeExpireCoupons() {
	count, err := s.service.ExpireOutdatedCoupons()
	if err != nil {
		log.Printf("[Coupon Scheduler] Failed to expire coupons: %v", err)
		return
	}
	if count > 0 {
		log.Printf("[Coupon Scheduler] Expired %d coupons", count)
	}
}

// runMonthlyDistributionTask 运行月度优惠券发放任务
func (s *Scheduler) runMonthlyDistributionTask() {
	ticker := time.NewTicker(24 * time.Hour)
	defer ticker.Stop()

	// 立即执行一次检查
	s.executeMonthlyDistribution()

	for {
		select {
		case <-ticker.C:
			s.executeMonthlyDistribution()
		case <-s.stopCh:
			return
		}
	}
}

// executeMonthlyDistribution 执行月度优惠券发放
func (s *Scheduler) executeMonthlyDistribution() {
	now := time.Now()

	// 检查是否是每月1号
	if now.Day() != 1 {
		return
	}

	log.Println("[Coupon Scheduler] Executing monthly coupon distribution...")

	// 获取所有标记为月度自动发放的模板
	templates, err := s.service.GetAutoDistributionTemplates("monthly")
	if err != nil {
		log.Printf("[Coupon Scheduler] Failed to get monthly templates: %v", err)
		return
	}

	if len(templates) == 0 {
		log.Println("[Coupon Scheduler] No monthly distribution templates found")
		return
	}

	// 为每个模板创建批次并执行
	for _, template := range templates {
		if template.Status != TemplateStatusActive {
			continue
		}

		// 创建月度发放批次
		batchName := time.Now().Format("2006年1月月度优惠券")
		batch, err := s.service.CreateBatch(
			template.ID,
			batchName,
			"all", // 发放给所有用户
			0,     // 不限制数量
			0,     // 系统自动创建
		)
		if err != nil {
			log.Printf("[Coupon Scheduler] Failed to create monthly batch for template %d: %v", template.ID, err)
			continue
		}

		// 执行批次发放
		if err := s.service.ExecuteBatch(batch.ID); err != nil {
			log.Printf("[Coupon Scheduler] Failed to execute monthly batch %d: %v", batch.ID, err)
			continue
		}

		log.Printf("[Coupon Scheduler] Successfully distributed monthly coupons for template %s (batch: %d)", template.Name, batch.ID)
	}
}

// runScheduledBatchTask 运行定时批次任务
func (s *Scheduler) runScheduledBatchTask() {
	ticker := time.NewTicker(10 * time.Minute)
	defer ticker.Stop()

	// 立即执行一次
	s.executeScheduledBatches()

	for {
		select {
		case <-ticker.C:
			s.executeScheduledBatches()
		case <-s.stopCh:
			return
		}
	}
}

// executeScheduledBatches 执行定时批次
func (s *Scheduler) executeScheduledBatches() {
	batches, err := s.service.GetScheduledBatches()
	if err != nil {
		log.Printf("[Coupon Scheduler] Failed to get scheduled batches: %v", err)
		return
	}

	now := time.Now()
	for _, batch := range batches {
		// 检查是否到达执行时间
		if batch.ScheduledAt != nil && batch.ScheduledAt.Before(now) {
			log.Printf("[Coupon Scheduler] Executing scheduled batch %d (%s)", batch.ID, batch.Name)

			if err := s.service.ExecuteBatch(batch.ID); err != nil {
				log.Printf("[Coupon Scheduler] Failed to execute scheduled batch %d: %v", batch.ID, err)
			} else {
				log.Printf("[Coupon Scheduler] Successfully executed scheduled batch %d", batch.ID)
			}
		}
	}
}

package coupon

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"scholar-backend/internal/user"

	"github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"
	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

type Service struct {
	repo       *Repository
	userRepo   *user.Repository
	cache      *redis.Client
	baseURL    string // 用于生成邀请链接
}

func NewService(db *gorm.DB, userRepo *user.Repository, cache *redis.Client, baseURL string) *Service {
	return &Service{
		repo:     NewRepository(db),
		userRepo: userRepo,
		cache:    cache,
		baseURL:  baseURL,
	}
}

// ============================================
// 折扣券模板管理
// ============================================

// CreateTemplate 创建折扣券模板
func (s *Service) CreateTemplate(req *CreateCouponTemplateRequest, createdBy uint64) (*CouponTemplate, error) {
	// 如果没有提供编码，自动生成
	code := req.Code
	if code == "" {
		code = GenerateTemplateCode(req.DistributionType)
		// 确保生成的编码不重复
		for {
			existingTemplate, err := s.repo.GetTemplateByCode(code)
			if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
				return nil, err
			}
			if existingTemplate == nil {
				break // 编码可用
			}
			// 编码已存在，重新生成
			code = GenerateTemplateCode(req.DistributionType)
		}
	} else {
		// 如果提供了编码，检查是否已存在
		existingTemplate, err := s.repo.GetTemplateByCode(code)
		if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
			return nil, err
		}
		if existingTemplate != nil {
			return nil, errors.New("template code already exists")
		}
	}

	template := &CouponTemplate{
		Code:              code,
		Name:              req.Name,
		Description:       req.Description,
		Type:              req.Type,
		DiscountValue:     req.DiscountValue,
		MinPurchaseAmount: req.MinPurchaseAmount,
		DistributionType:  req.DistributionType,
		ValidDays:         req.ValidDays,
		FixedValidStart:   req.FixedValidStart,
		FixedValidEnd:     req.FixedValidEnd,
		MaxUsageTotal:     req.MaxUsageTotal,
		MaxUsagePerUser:   req.MaxUsagePerUser,
		FirstPurchaseOnly: req.FirstPurchaseOnly,
		NewUserOnly:       req.NewUserOnly,
		IsInviteCoupon:    req.IsInviteCoupon,
		Status:            TemplateStatusDraft,
		Priority:          0,
		CreatedBy:         &createdBy,
	}

	// 处理JSON字段
	if len(req.ApplicablePlans) > 0 {
		plans := make(JSONArray, len(req.ApplicablePlans))
		for i, plan := range req.ApplicablePlans {
			plans[i] = plan
		}
		template.ApplicablePlans = plans
	}

	if len(req.ApplicableProducts) > 0 {
		products := make(JSONArray, len(req.ApplicableProducts))
		for i, product := range req.ApplicableProducts {
			products[i] = product
		}
		template.ApplicableProducts = products
	}

	if req.InviterBenefit != nil {
		template.InviterBenefit = JSONMap(req.InviterBenefit)
	}

	if err := s.repo.CreateTemplate(template); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return template, nil
}

// UpdateTemplate 更新模板
func (s *Service) UpdateTemplate(id uint64, req *UpdateCouponTemplateRequest) error {
	// 获取原模板
	template, err := s.repo.GetTemplateByID(id)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// 构建更新字段
	updates := make(map[string]interface{})
	if req.Name != "" {
		updates["name"] = req.Name
	}
	if req.Description != "" {
		updates["description"] = req.Description
	}
	updates["min_purchase_amount"] = req.MinPurchaseAmount
	updates["valid_days"] = req.ValidDays
	updates["max_usage_per_user"] = req.MaxUsagePerUser
	updates["first_purchase_only"] = req.FirstPurchaseOnly
	updates["new_user_only"] = req.NewUserOnly
	updates["priority"] = req.Priority

	if req.Status != "" {
		// 状态变更验证
		if template.Status == TemplateStatusExpired {
			return errors.New("cannot update expired template")
		}
		updates["status"] = req.Status
	}

	if req.FixedValidStart != nil {
		updates["fixed_valid_start"] = req.FixedValidStart
	}
	if req.FixedValidEnd != nil {
		updates["fixed_valid_end"] = req.FixedValidEnd
	}
	if req.MaxUsageTotal != nil {
		updates["max_usage_total"] = req.MaxUsageTotal
	}

	// 处理JSON字段
	if req.ApplicablePlans != nil {
		plans := make(JSONArray, len(req.ApplicablePlans))
		for i, plan := range req.ApplicablePlans {
			plans[i] = plan
		}
		updates["applicable_plans"] = plans
	}

	if req.ApplicableProducts != nil {
		products := make(JSONArray, len(req.ApplicableProducts))
		for i, product := range req.ApplicableProducts {
			products[i] = product
		}
		updates["applicable_products"] = products
	}

	return s.repo.UpdateTemplate(id, updates)
}

// ============================================
// 折扣券发放管理
// ============================================

// DistributeCoupons 发放折扣券
func (s *Service) DistributeCoupons(req *DistributeCouponRequest) error {
	// 获取模板
	template, err := s.repo.GetTemplateByID(req.TemplateID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if template.Status != TemplateStatusActive {
		return errors.New("template is not active")
	}

	// 检查发放限制
	if template.MaxUsageTotal != nil {
		// TODO: 检查总使用量
	}

	// 批量创建用户折扣券
	coupons := make([]*UserCoupon, 0, len(req.UserIDs))
	now := time.Now()
	validUntil := CalculateExpiry(template)

	for _, userID := range req.UserIDs {
		// 检查用户是否已达到领取限制
		count, err := s.repo.CountUserCouponUsage(userID, template.ID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if int(count) >= template.MaxUsagePerUser {
			continue // 跳过已达限制的用户
		}

		coupon := &UserCoupon{
			UserID:            userID,
			TemplateID:        template.ID,
			CouponCode:        GenerateCouponCode(template.Code),
			SourceType:        req.SourceType,
			SourceID:          req.SourceID,
			ValidFrom:         now,
			ValidUntil:        validUntil,
			Status:            CouponStatusUnused,
			DiscountType:      string(template.Type),
			DiscountValue:     template.DiscountValue,
			MinPurchaseAmount: template.MinPurchaseAmount,
		}

		coupons = append(coupons, coupon)
	}

	if len(coupons) == 0 {
		return errors.New("no coupons to distribute")
	}

	return s.repo.CreateUserCoupons(coupons)
}

// ClaimCoupon 用户领取折扣券
func (s *Service) ClaimCoupon(userID uint64, code string) (*UserCoupon, error) {
	// 获取模板
	template, err := s.repo.GetActiveTemplateByCode(code)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
			return nil, errors.New("invalid or inactive coupon code")
		}
		return nil, err
	}

	// 检查用户资格
	userInfo, err := s.userRepo.FindByID(uint(userID))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	isNewUser := userInfo.CreatedAt.After(time.Now().AddDate(0, 0, -30)) // 30天内注册的算新用户
	isFirstPurchase := false                                             // TODO: 从订单系统获取

	if !IsValidForUser(template, isNewUser, isFirstPurchase) {
		return nil, errors.New("you are not eligible for this coupon")
	}

	// 检查领取限制
	count, err := s.repo.CountUserCouponUsage(userID, template.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if int(count) >= template.MaxUsagePerUser {
		return nil, errors.New("you have reached the maximum claim limit for this coupon")
	}

	// 创建用户折扣券
	now := time.Now()
	validUntil := CalculateExpiry(template)

	coupon := &UserCoupon{
		UserID:            userID,
		TemplateID:        template.ID,
		CouponCode:        GenerateCouponCode(template.Code),
		SourceType:        SourceTypeManual,
		ValidFrom:         now,
		ValidUntil:        validUntil,
		Status:            CouponStatusUnused,
		DiscountType:      string(template.Type),
		DiscountValue:     template.DiscountValue,
		MinPurchaseAmount: template.MinPurchaseAmount,
	}

	if err := s.repo.CreateUserCoupon(coupon); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	coupon.Template = template
	return coupon, nil
}

	offset := (page - 1) * pageSize

	return s.repo.GetAvailableCoupons(userID, orderAmount)
}

// ApplyCoupon 应用折扣券
func (s *Service) ApplyCoupon(userID uint64, couponID uint64, orderID uint64, orderAmount float64) (*CouponUsageLog, error) {
	// 获取折扣券
	coupon, err := s.repo.GetUserCouponByID(couponID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// 验证所有权
	if coupon.UserID != userID {
		return nil, errors.New("coupon does not belong to you")
	}

	// 验证状态
	if coupon.Status != CouponStatusUnused {
		return nil, errors.New("coupon is not available")
	}

	// 验证时间
	if !IsValidTime(coupon.ValidFrom, coupon.ValidUntil) {
		return nil, errors.New("coupon has expired")
	}

	// 验证金额
	if !IsValidAmount(coupon.MinPurchaseAmount, orderAmount) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("minimum purchase amount is %.2f", coupon.MinPurchaseAmount)
	}

	// 计算折扣
	discountAmount := CalculateDiscount(
		DiscountType(coupon.DiscountType),
		coupon.DiscountValue,
		orderAmount,
	)
	finalAmount := orderAmount - discountAmount

	// 使用事务
	err = s.repo.Transaction(func(txRepo *Repository) error {
		// 使用折扣券
		if err := txRepo.UseCoupon(couponID, orderID); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		// 创建使用记录
		usageLog := &CouponUsageLog{
			UserCouponID:   couponID,
			UserID:         userID,
			OrderID:        orderID,
			OriginalAmount: orderAmount,
			DiscountAmount: discountAmount,
			FinalAmount:    finalAmount,
			Status:         "applied",
		}

		if err := txRepo.CreateUsageLog(usageLog); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		return nil
	})

	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &CouponUsageLog{
		UserCouponID:   couponID,
		UserID:         userID,
		OrderID:        orderID,
		OriginalAmount: orderAmount,
		DiscountAmount: discountAmount,
		FinalAmount:    finalAmount,
		Status:         "applied",
	}, nil
}

// ============================================
// 邀请系统
// ============================================

// GenerateInvitation 生成邀请码和链接
func (s *Service) GenerateInvitation(userID uint64) (*UserInvitation, error) {
	// 检查是否已有邀请信息
	existing, err := s.repo.GetUserInvitation(userID)
	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
		return nil, err
	}

	if existing != nil {
		// 如果已存在但未激活，重新激活
		if !existing.IsActive {
			updates := map[string]interface{}{
				"is_active": true,
			}
			if err := s.repo.UpdateUserInvitation(userID, updates); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			existing.IsActive = true
		}
		return existing, nil
	}

	// 创建新的邀请信息
	invitationCode := GenerateInvitationCode()
	invitationURL := BuildInvitationURL(s.baseURL, invitationCode)

	invitation := &UserInvitation{
		UserID:         userID,
		InvitationCode: invitationCode,
		InvitationURL:  invitationURL,
		IsActive:       true,
	}

	if err := s.repo.CreateUserInvitation(invitation); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return invitation, nil
}

// GetUserInvitation 获取用户邀请信息
func (s *Service) GetUserInvitation(userID uint64) (*UserInvitation, error) {
	return s.repo.GetUserInvitation(userID)
}

// RegisterWithInvitation 通过邀请码注册
func (s *Service) RegisterWithInvitation(invitationCode string, inviteeID uint64) error {
	// 获取邀请信息
	invitation, err := s.repo.GetUserInvitationByCode(invitationCode)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
			return errors.New("invalid invitation code")
		}
		return err
	}

	// 检查是否已有邀请关系
	existing, err := s.repo.GetInvitationRelationship(inviteeID)
	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
		return err
	}
	if existing != nil {
		return errors.New("user already has an inviter")
	}

	// 使用事务处理
	return s.repo.Transaction(func(txRepo *Repository) error {
		// 创建邀请关系
		relationship := &InvitationRelationship{
			InviterID:      invitation.UserID,
			InviteeID:      inviteeID,
			InvitationCode: invitationCode,
			Status:         "registered",
			RegisteredAt:   &[]time.Time{time.Now()}[0],
		}

		if err := txRepo.CreateInvitationRelationship(relationship); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		// 更新邀请统计
		if err := txRepo.IncrementInvitationCount(invitation.UserID, "total_invites"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := txRepo.IncrementInvitationCount(invitation.UserID, "successful_invites"); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		// 查找并发放邀请折扣券
		templates, err := txRepo.GetAutoDistributionTemplates(DistributionTypeAutoInvite)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		for _, template := range templates {
			if !template.IsInviteCoupon {
				continue
			}

			// 为被邀请人创建折扣券
			now := time.Now()
			validUntil := CalculateExpiry(template)

			coupon := &UserCoupon{
				UserID:            inviteeID,
				TemplateID:        template.ID,
				CouponCode:        GenerateCouponCode(template.Code),
				SourceType:        SourceTypeInvite,
				SourceID:          fmt.Sprintf("%d", invitation.UserID),
				SourceDetail:      JSONMap{"inviter_id": invitation.UserID, "invitation_code": invitationCode},
				ValidFrom:         now,
				ValidUntil:        validUntil,
				Status:            CouponStatusUnused,
				DiscountType:      string(template.Type),
				DiscountValue:     template.DiscountValue,
				MinPurchaseAmount: template.MinPurchaseAmount,
			}

			if err := txRepo.CreateUserCoupon(coupon); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			// 更新关系记录
			updates := map[string]interface{}{
				"invitee_coupon_id": coupon.ID,
			}
			if err := txRepo.UpdateInvitationRelationship(relationship.ID, updates); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}

		return nil
	})
}

// GetInvitationStatistics 获取邀请统计
func (s *Service) GetInvitationStatistics(userID uint64) (*UserInvitation, []*InvitationRelationship, error) {
	invitation, err := s.repo.GetUserInvitation(userID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}

	relationships, _, err := s.repo.ListInvitationRelationships(userID, nil, 0, 1000)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}

	return invitation, relationships, nil
}

// DistributeRegisterCoupons 为新注册用户发放注册自动折扣券
func (s *Service) DistributeRegisterCoupons(userID uint64) error {
	// 获取所有注册自动发放的活跃模板
	templates, err := s.repo.GetAutoDistributionTemplates(DistributionTypeAutoRegister)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if len(templates) == 0 {
		return nil // 没有配置注册自动发放的折扣券
	}

	now := time.Now()

	for _, template := range templates {
		// 检查用户是否已领取过该模板的券
		count, err := s.repo.CountUserCouponUsage(userID, template.ID)
		if err != nil {
			continue // 跳过错误，继续处理其他模板
		}
		if int(count) >= template.MaxUsagePerUser {
			continue // 已达到领取限制
		}

		// 计算过期时间
		validUntil := CalculateExpiry(template)

		// 创建用户折扣券
		coupon := &UserCoupon{
			UserID:            userID,
			TemplateID:        template.ID,
			CouponCode:        GenerateCouponCode(template.Code),
			SourceType:        SourceTypeRegister,
			SourceDetail:      JSONMap{"auto_distribute": true, "distribute_type": "register"},
			ValidFrom:         now,
			ValidUntil:        validUntil,
			Status:            CouponStatusUnused,
			DiscountType:      string(template.Type),
			DiscountValue:     template.DiscountValue,
			MinPurchaseAmount: template.MinPurchaseAmount,
		}

		if err := s.repo.CreateUserCoupon(coupon); err != nil {
			// 记录错误但继续处理
			fmt.Printf("Failed to distribute register coupon (template %d) to user %d: %v\n", template.ID, userID, err)
			continue
		}
	}

	return nil
}

// OnUserFirstPurchase 用户首次购买时的处理
func (s *Service) OnUserFirstPurchase(userID uint64, orderID uint64) error {
	// 获取邀请关系
	relationship, err := s.repo.GetInvitationRelationship(userID)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
			return nil // 没有邀请关系，直接返回
		}
		return err
	}

	if relationship.Status == "activated" || relationship.Status == "rewarded" {
		return nil // 已处理过
	}

	// 更新关系状态
	now := time.Now()
	updates := map[string]interface{}{
		"status":       "activated",
		"activated_at": now,
	}

	if err := s.repo.UpdateInvitationRelationship(relationship.ID, updates); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// 更新邀请人的付费邀请数
	return s.repo.IncrementInvitationCount(relationship.InviterID, "paid_invites")
}

// ============================================
// 批次管理
// ============================================

// CreateBatchFromRequest 从请求创建批次
func (s *Service) CreateBatchFromRequest(req *CreateBatchRequest, createdBy uint64) (*CouponBatch, error) {
	// 验证模板存在
	template, err := s.repo.GetTemplateByID(req.TemplateID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, errors.New("template not found")
	}

	if template.Status != TemplateStatusActive {
		return nil, errors.New("template is not active")
	}

	// 转换目标用户
	var targetUsers JSONArray
	if req.TargetUsers != nil && len(req.TargetUsers) > 0 {
		targetUsers = make(JSONArray, len(req.TargetUsers))
		for i, uid := range req.TargetUsers {
			targetUsers[i] = uid
		}
	}

	// 转换条件
	var targetConditions JSONMap
	if req.TargetConditions != nil {
		targetConditions = JSONMap(req.TargetConditions)
	}

	batch := &CouponBatch{
		BatchCode:        req.BatchCode,
		TemplateID:       req.TemplateID,
		Name:             req.Name,
		Description:      req.Description,
		TargetType:       req.TargetType,
		TargetUsers:      targetUsers,
		TargetConditions: targetConditions,
		TotalQuantity:    req.TotalQuantity,
		Status:           "draft",
		ScheduledAt:      req.ScheduledAt,
		CreatedBy:        &createdBy,
	}

	if err := s.repo.CreateBatch(batch); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return batch, nil
}

// CreateBatch 创建批次（简化版本，保持兼容性）
func (s *Service) CreateBatch(templateID uint64, name string, targetType string, totalQuantity int, createdBy uint64) (*CouponBatch, error) {
	batch := &CouponBatch{
		BatchCode:     GenerateBatchCode(),
		TemplateID:    templateID,
		Name:          name,
		TargetType:    targetType,
		TotalQuantity: totalQuantity,
		Status:        "draft",
		CreatedBy:     &createdBy,
	}

	if err := s.repo.CreateBatch(batch); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return batch, nil
}

// GetBatch 获取批次详情
func (s *Service) GetBatch(batchID uint64) (*CouponBatch, error) {
	return s.repo.GetBatchByID(batchID)
}

// ExecuteBatch 执行批次发放
func (s *Service) ExecuteBatch(batchID uint64) error {
	batch, err := s.repo.GetBatchByID(batchID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if batch.Status != "draft" {
		return errors.New("batch is not in draft status")
	}

	// 更新批次状态为处理中
	now := time.Now()
	if err := s.repo.UpdateBatch(batchID, map[string]interface{}{
		"status":     "processing",
		"started_at": now,
	}); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// 根据目标类型获取用户列表
	userIDs, err := s.getTargetUsers(batch)
	if err != nil {
		s.repo.UpdateBatch(batchID, map[string]interface{}{
			"status": "cancelled",
		})
		return err
	}

	// 如果指定了数量限制，只取前N个用户
	if batch.TotalQuantity > 0 && len(userIDs) > batch.TotalQuantity {
		userIDs = userIDs[:batch.TotalQuantity]
	}

	// 批量发放折扣券
	distributedCount := 0
	for _, userID := range userIDs {
		// 检查用户是否已经领取过此模板的券
		usageCount, _ := s.repo.CountUserCouponUsage(userID, batch.TemplateID)
		if usageCount >= int64(batch.Template.MaxUsagePerUser) {
			continue
		}

		// 创建用户券
		coupon := &UserCoupon{
			UserID:            userID,
			TemplateID:        batch.TemplateID,
			CouponCode:        GenerateCouponCode(batch.BatchCode),
			SourceType:        SourceTypeBatch,
			SourceID:          fmt.Sprintf("%d", batchID),
			SourceDetail:      JSONMap{"batch_code": batch.BatchCode, "batch_name": batch.Name},
			ValidFrom:         now,
			ValidUntil:        now.AddDate(0, 0, batch.Template.ValidDays),
			Status:            CouponStatusUnused,
			DiscountType:      string(batch.Template.Type),
			DiscountValue:     batch.Template.DiscountValue,
			MinPurchaseAmount: batch.Template.MinPurchaseAmount,
		}

		if err := s.repo.CreateUserCoupon(coupon); err != nil {
			// 记录错误但继续处理
			continue
		}

		distributedCount++
	}

	// 更新批次完成状态
	completedAt := time.Now()
	if err := s.repo.UpdateBatch(batchID, map[string]interface{}{
		"status":               "completed",
		"distributed_quantity": distributedCount,
		"completed_at":         completedAt,
	}); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	return nil
}

// getTargetUsers 根据批次目标类型获取用户ID列表
func (s *Service) getTargetUsers(batch *CouponBatch) ([]uint64, error) {
	switch batch.TargetType {
	case "all":
		// 获取所有用户
		return s.getAllUsers()
	case "new_users":
		// 获取新注册用户（比如最近30天）
		return s.getNewUsers(30)
	case "paid_users":
		// 获取付费用户
		return s.getPaidUsers()
	case "specific_users":
		// 指定的用户列表
		if batch.TargetUsers == nil || len(batch.TargetUsers) == 0 {
			return nil, errors.New("no target users specified")
		}
		userIDs := make([]uint64, 0, len(batch.TargetUsers))
		for _, v := range batch.TargetUsers {
			if uid, ok := v.(float64); ok {
				userIDs = append(userIDs, uint64(uid))
			}
		}
		return userIDs, nil
	case "user_group":
		// 根据条件筛选用户组
		return s.getUsersByConditions(batch.TargetConditions)
	default:
		return nil, errors.New("unsupported target type")
	}
}

// getAllUsers 获取所有用户ID
func (s *Service) getAllUsers() ([]uint64, error) {
	var userIDs []uint64
	err := s.repo.db.Table("users").
		Where("deleted_at IS NULL").
		Pluck("id", &userIDs).Error
	return userIDs, err
}

// getNewUsers 获取最近N天注册的新用户
func (s *Service) getNewUsers(days int) ([]uint64, error) {
	var userIDs []uint64
	since := time.Now().AddDate(0, 0, -days)
	err := s.repo.db.Table("users").
		Where("deleted_at IS NULL AND created_at >= ?", since).
		Pluck("id", &userIDs).Error
	return userIDs, err
}

// getPaidUsers 获取付费用户
func (s *Service) getPaidUsers() ([]uint64, error) {
	var userIDs []uint64
	err := s.repo.db.Table("orders").
		Where("status = ?", "paid").
		Distinct("user_id").
		Pluck("user_id", &userIDs).Error
	return userIDs, err
}

// getUsersByConditions 根据条件获取用户
func (s *Service) getUsersByConditions(conditions JSONMap) ([]uint64, error) {
	// 基于条件构建查询
	query := s.repo.db.Table("users").Where("deleted_at IS NULL")

	// 示例条件处理
	if registeredAfter, ok := conditions["registered_after"].(string); ok {
		query = query.Where("created_at >= ?", registeredAfter)
	}
	if registeredBefore, ok := conditions["registered_before"].(string); ok {
		query = query.Where("created_at <= ?", registeredBefore)
	}

	var userIDs []uint64
	err := query.Pluck("id", &userIDs).Error
	return userIDs, err
}

// CancelBatch 取消批次
func (s *Service) CancelBatch(batchID uint64) error {
	batch, err := s.repo.GetBatchByID(batchID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if batch.Status != "draft" && batch.Status != "processing" {
		return errors.New("batch cannot be cancelled")
	}

	return s.repo.UpdateBatch(batchID, map[string]interface{}{
		"status": "cancelled",
	})
}

// ============================================
// 统计
// ============================================

// GetStatistics 获取统计信息
func (s *Service) GetStatistics() (*CouponStatistics, error) {
	return s.repo.GetStatistics()
}

// ExpireOutdatedCoupons 过期折扣券（定时任务调用）
func (s *Service) ExpireOutdatedCoupons() (int64, error) {
	return s.repo.ExpireCoupons()
}

// GetAutoDistributionTemplates 获取自动发放模板（支持monthly等类型）
func (s *Service) GetAutoDistributionTemplates(distributionType string) ([]*CouponTemplate, error) {
	// 处理月度发放类型
	if distributionType == "monthly" {
		var templates []*CouponTemplate
		err := s.repo.db.Where("status = ? AND (description LIKE ? OR code LIKE ?)",
			TemplateStatusActive, "%月度%", "%MONTHLY%").
			Find(&templates).Error
		return templates, err
	}

	// 其他类型使用原有逻辑
	return s.repo.GetAutoDistributionTemplates(DistributionType(distributionType))
}

// GetScheduledBatches 获取待执行的定时批次
func (s *Service) GetScheduledBatches() ([]*CouponBatch, error) {
	var batches []*CouponBatch
	now := time.Now()
	err := s.repo.db.Where("status = ? AND scheduled_at IS NOT NULL AND scheduled_at <= ?", "draft", now).
		Preload("Template").
		Find(&batches).Error
	return batches, err
}

// MarkCouponAsUsed marks a coupon as used (called when payment succeeds)
func (s *Service) MarkCouponAsUsed(couponID uint64, orderID uint, usedAt time.Time) error {
	return s.repo.UseCoupon(couponID, uint64(orderID))
}

// UnreserveCoupon unreserves a coupon (called when order is cancelled)
func (s *Service) UnreserveCoupon(couponID uint64) error {
	return s.repo.UpdateUserCoupon(couponID, map[string]interface{}{
		"status": CouponStatusUnused,
	})
}

package coupon

import (
	"crypto/rand"
	"fmt"
	"math/big"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

// GenerateCouponCode 生成折扣券唯一码
func GenerateCouponCode(prefix string) string {
	const charset = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789"
	const length = 8

	b := make([]byte, length)
	for i := range b {
		n, _ := rand.Int(rand.Reader, big.NewInt(int64(len(charset))))
		b[i] = charset[n.Int64()]
	}

	if prefix != "" {
		return fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s", strings.ToUpper(prefix), string(b))
	}
	return string(b)
}

// GenerateInvitationCode 生成邀请码
func GenerateInvitationCode() string {
	const charset = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789"
	const length = 6

	b := make([]byte, length)
	for i := range b {
		n, _ := rand.Int(rand.Reader, big.NewInt(int64(len(charset))))
		b[i] = charset[n.Int64()]
	}

	return string(b)
}

// GenerateBatchCode 生成批次号
func GenerateBatchCode() string {
	timestamp := time.Now().Format("20060102150405")
	randomPart := GenerateCouponCode("")[:4]
	return fmt.Sprintf("BATCH-%s-%s", timestamp, randomPart)
}

// GenerateTemplateCode 生成模板编码
func GenerateTemplateCode(distributionType DistributionType) string {
	const charset = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789"
	const length = 6

	b := make([]byte, length)
	for i := range b {
		n, _ := rand.Int(rand.Reader, big.NewInt(int64(len(charset))))
		b[i] = charset[n.Int64()]
	}

	// 根据发放类型添加前缀
	var prefix string
	switch distributionType {
	case DistributionTypeAutoRegister:
		prefix = "REG"
	case DistributionTypeAutoInvite:
		prefix = "INV"
	case DistributionTypeManual:
		prefix = "MAN"
	case DistributionTypeBatch:
		prefix = "BAT"
	case DistributionTypeTargeted:
		prefix = "TGT"
	default:
		prefix = "CPN"
	}

	return fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", prefix, string(b))
}

// GenerateRandomCode 生成随机验证码
func GenerateRandomCode(length int) string {
	const charset = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789"

	b := make([]byte, length)
	for i := range b {
		n, _ := rand.Int(rand.Reader, big.NewInt(int64(len(charset))))
		b[i] = charset[n.Int64()]
	}

	return string(b)
}

// CalculateExpiry 计算过期时间
func CalculateExpiry(template *CouponTemplate) time.Time {
	now := time.Now()

	// 如果有固定结束时间，使用固定结束时间
	if template.FixedValidEnd != nil {
		return *template.FixedValidEnd
	}

	// 否则使用有效天数计算
	if template.ValidDays > 0 {
		return now.AddDate(0, 0, template.ValidDays)
	}

	// 默认30天
	return now.AddDate(0, 0, 30)
}

// CalculateDiscount 计算折扣金额
// 返回值是折扣金额,即原价减去的部分
func CalculateDiscount(discountType DiscountType, discountValue float64, originalAmount float64) float64 {
	switch discountType {
	case DiscountTypePercentage:
		// 百分比折扣: 例如20%折扣,原价100,折扣金额20,最终支付80
		return originalAmount * (discountValue / 100)
	case DiscountTypeFixed:
		// 固定金额支付: 例如固定支付99元,原价100,折扣金额1,最终支付99
		// 如果固定金额大于原价,则折扣金额为0(按原价支付)
		if discountValue >= originalAmount {
			return 0
		}
		return originalAmount - discountValue
	case DiscountTypePriceOff:
		// 减免金额: 例如减免20元,原价100,折扣金额20,最终支付80
		// 最多减免到0元
		if discountValue > originalAmount {
			return originalAmount
		}
		return discountValue
	default:
		return 0
	}
}

// IsValidForUser 检查折扣券是否对用户有效
func IsValidForUser(template *CouponTemplate, isNewUser bool, isFirstPurchase bool) bool {
	// 检查新用户限制
	if template.NewUserOnly && !isNewUser {
		return false
	}

	// 检查首购限制
	if template.FirstPurchaseOnly && !isFirstPurchase {
		return false
	}

	return true
}

// IsValidAmount 检查金额是否满足要求
func IsValidAmount(minPurchaseAmount float64, orderAmount float64) bool {
	return orderAmount >= minPurchaseAmount
}

// IsValidTime 检查时间是否有效
func IsValidTime(validFrom, validUntil time.Time) bool {
	now := time.Now()
	return now.After(validFrom) && now.Before(validUntil)
}

// BuildInvitationURL 构建邀请链接
func BuildInvitationURL(baseURL string, invitationCode string) string {
	if !strings.HasSuffix(baseURL, "/") {
		baseURL += "/"
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("%sregister?invite=%s", baseURL, invitationCode)
}

// Handler 反馈处理器
type Handler struct {
	service *Service
}

// NewHandler 创建反馈处理器
func NewHandler(service *Service, uploadPath string) *Handler {
	handler := &Handler{
		service: service,
	}

	// 启动定时清理未使用附件的任务
	go handler.startCleanupTask()

	return handler
}

// startCleanupTask 启动清理未使用附件的定时任务
func (h *Handler) startCleanupTask() {
	// 启动时先执行一次清理
	h.cleanupUnusedAttachments()

	ticker := time.NewTicker(10 * time.Minute) // 每10分钟检查一次
	defer ticker.Stop()

	for range ticker.C {
		h.cleanupUnusedAttachments()
	}
}

// cleanupUnusedAttachments 清理游离附件（未绑定反馈的附件）
func (h *Handler) cleanupUnusedAttachments() {
	// 策略1: 删除创建超过1小时且未绑定反馈的附件（用户上传后1小时内未提交反馈）
	olderThan := time.Now().Add(-1 * time.Hour).Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05")
	count, err := h.service.CleanupOrphanAttachments(olderThan)
	if err != nil {
		log.Printf("Failed to cleanup orphan attachments: %v", err)
		return
	}

	if count > 0 {
		log.Printf("Cleaned up %d orphan attachments from database (older than 1 hour)", count)
	}

	// 策略2: 如果游离附件总数超过限制，删除最旧的
	maxOrphanCount := 100 // 最多保留100个游离附件
	excessCount, err := h.service.CleanupExcessOrphanAttachments(maxOrphanCount)
	if err != nil {
		log.Printf("Failed to cleanup excess orphan attachments: %v", err)
		return
	}

	if excessCount > 0 {
		log.Printf("Cleaned up %d excess orphan attachments (limit: %d)", excessCount, maxOrphanCount)
	}
}

// 文件上传限制
const (
	MaxFileCount  = 2        // 最大文件数量
	MaxImageCount = 10       // 最大图片数量
	MaxFileSize   = 10 << 20 // 单个文件最大10MB
	MaxTotalSize  = 50 << 20 // 总文件大小最大50MB
)

// 允许的文件类型
var allowedImageTypes = map[string]bool{
	"image/jpeg": true,
	"image/png":  true,
	"image/gif":  true,
	"image/webp": true,
}

var allowedFileTypes = map[string]bool{
	"application/pdf":                                                        true,
	"application/msword":                                                     true,
	"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document": true,
	"application/vnd.ms-excel":                                               true,
	"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet":      true,
	"text/plain":                                                             true,
	"application/zip":                                                        true,
	"application/x-rar-compressed":                                           true,
	"application/x-zip-compressed":                                           true,
}

// CreateFeedbackRequestWithKey 创建反馈请求（带附件key）
type CreateFeedbackRequestWithKey struct {
	Email          string `json:"email" binding:"required,email"`
	Content        string `json:"content" binding:"required,min=10,max=5000"`
	AttachmentsKey string `json:"attachmentsKey"` // 上传附件时返回的key
}

// CreateFeedback 创建反馈（公共接口）
// POST /api/v1/public/feedback
func (h *Handler) CreateFeedback(c *gin.Context) {
	var req CreateFeedbackRequestWithKey
	if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 4001, "参数错误: "+err.Error())
		return
	}

	// 公共接口不获取用户信息，匿名反馈
	var userID *uint
	var username string

	// 获取IP
	ip := c.ClientIP()

	// 使用attachmentsKey从数据库获取附件
	feedback, err := h.service.CreateFeedbackWithAttachments(&req.Email, &req.Content, userID, username, ip, req.AttachmentsKey)
	if err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 5001, "创建反馈失败: "+err.Error())
		return
	}

	utils.Success(c, feedback)
}

// CreateFeedbackWithUser 创建反馈（已登录用户，会关联用户信息）
// POST /api/v1/user/feedback
func (h *Handler) CreateFeedbackWithUser(c *gin.Context) {
	var req CreateFeedbackRequestWithKey
	if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 4001, "参数错误: "+err.Error())
		return
	}

	// 从认证中间件获取用户信息
	var userID *uint
	var username string
	if uid, exists := c.Get("user_id"); exists {
		id := uid.(uint)
		userID = &id
	}
	if uname, exists := c.Get("username"); exists {
		username = uname.(string)
	}

	// 获取IP
	ip := c.ClientIP()

	// 使用attachmentsKey从数据库获取附件
	feedback, err := h.service.CreateFeedbackWithAttachments(&req.Email, &req.Content, userID, username, ip, req.AttachmentsKey)
	if err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 5001, "创建反馈失败: "+err.Error())
		return
	}

	utils.Success(c, feedback)
}

// UploadAttachments 上传附件（公共接口）
// POST /api/v1/public/feedback/upload
func (h *Handler) UploadAttachments(c *gin.Context) {
	// 解析multipart表单
	if err := c.Request.ParseMultipartForm(MaxTotalSize); err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 4002, "文件过大或格式错误")
		return
	}

	form := c.Request.MultipartForm
	if form == nil || form.File == nil {
		utils.Error(c, 4003, "没有上传文件")
		return
	}

	// 获取或生成上传批次key
	uploadKey := c.PostForm("uploadKey")
	if uploadKey == "" {
		uploadKey = uuid.New().String()
	}

	var savedAttachments []FeedbackAttachment
	var imageCount, fileCount int
	var totalSize int64

	// 处理文件
	files := form.File["files"]
	for _, fileHeader := range files {
		// 检查文件大小
		if fileHeader.Size > MaxFileSize {
			utils.Error(c, 4004, fmt.Sprintf("文件 %s 超过10MB限制", fileHeader.Filename))
			return
		}
		totalSize += fileHeader.Size

		// 检查总大小
		if totalSize > MaxTotalSize {
			utils.Error(c, 4005, "文件总大小超过50MB限制")
			return
		}

		// 打开文件
		file, err := fileHeader.Open()
		if err != nil {
			utils.Error(c, 5002, "打开文件失败")
			return
		}
		defer file.Close()

		// 读取整个文件到内存
		fileData, err := io.ReadAll(file)
		if err != nil {
			utils.Error(c, 5003, "读取文件失败")
			return
		}

		// 检测文件类型
		contentType := http.DetectContentType(fileData)

		// 判断是图片还是文件
		isImage := allowedImageTypes[contentType]
		isFile := allowedFileTypes[contentType]

		if !isImage && !isFile {
			utils.Error(c, 4006, fmt.Sprintf("不支持的文件类型: %s", contentType))
			return
		}

		// 检查数量限制
		if isImage {
			imageCount++
			if imageCount > MaxImageCount {
				utils.Error(c, 4007, fmt.Sprintf("图片数量超过%d张限制", MaxImageCount))
				return
			}
		} else {
			fileCount++
			if fileCount > MaxFileCount {
				utils.Error(c, 4008, fmt.Sprintf("文件数量超过%d个限制", MaxFileCount))
				return
			}
		}

		fileType := "file"
		if isImage {
			fileType = "image"
		}

		// 保存到数据库
		attachment := &FeedbackAttachment{
			UploadKey:    uploadKey,
			OriginalName: fileHeader.Filename,
			FileData:     fileData,
			FileSize:     fileHeader.Size,
			FileType:     fileType,
			MimeType:     contentType,
			IsUsed:       false,
		}

		if err := h.service.SaveAttachment(attachment); err != nil {
			utils.Error(c, 5007, "保存附件失败: "+err.Error())
			return
		}

		savedAttachments = append(savedAttachments, *attachment)
	}

	// 转换为前端期望的格式
	var attachments []Attachment
	for _, att := range savedAttachments {
		attachments = append(attachments, att.ToAttachment())
	}

	utils.Success(c, gin.H{
		"attachmentsKey": uploadKey,
		"uploadKey":      uploadKey,
		"attachments":    attachments,
		"files":          attachments, // 兼容前端期望的字段名
	})
}

// GetAttachment 获取附件（公共接口，用于下载/预览）
// GET /api/v1/public/feedback/attachment/:id
func (h *Handler) GetAttachment(c *gin.Context) {
	idStr := c.Param("id")
	id, err := strconv.ParseUint(idStr, 10, 32)
	if err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 4001, "无效的附件ID")
		return
	}

	attachment, err := h.service.GetAttachmentByID(uint(id))
	if err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 5001, "附件不存在")
		return
	}

	// 设置响应头
	c.Header("Content-Type", attachment.MimeType)
	c.Header("Content-Length", strconv.FormatInt(attachment.FileSize, 10))

	// 如果是文件类型，设置下载头
	if attachment.FileType == "file" {
		c.Header("Content-Disposition", fmt.Sprintf("attachment; filename=\"%s\"", attachment.OriginalName))
	} else {
		// 图片类型，设置为内联显示
		c.Header("Content-Disposition", fmt.Sprintf("inline; filename=\"%s\"", attachment.OriginalName))
	}

	// 写入文件数据
	c.Data(http.StatusOK, attachment.MimeType, attachment.FileData)
}

package feedback

import (
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

// FeedbackStatus 反馈状态
type FeedbackStatus string

const (
	StatusPending   FeedbackStatus = "pending"   // 待处理
	StatusProcessed FeedbackStatus = "processed" // 已处理
	StatusReplied   FeedbackStatus = "replied"   // 已回复
	StatusClosed    FeedbackStatus = "closed"    // 已关闭
)

// Feedback 反馈模型
type Feedback struct {
	ID          uint           `gorm:"primarykey" json:"id"`
	Email       string         `gorm:"size:255;not null;index" json:"email"`                   // 反馈者邮箱
	Content     string         `gorm:"type:text;not null" json:"content"`                      // 反馈内容
	Attachments string         `gorm:"type:text" json:"attachments"`                           // 附件列表（JSON格式）
	UserID      *uint          `gorm:"index" json:"userId"`                                    // 用户ID（登录用户）
	Username    string         `gorm:"size:100" json:"username"`                               // 用户名（登录用户）
	IP          string         `gorm:"size:45" json:"ip"`                                      // 反馈者IP
	IPLocation  string         `gorm:"size:255" json:"ipLocation"`                             // IP归属地
	Status      FeedbackStatus `gorm:"size:20;default:pending;index" json:"status"`            // 状态
	ReplyContent string        `gorm:"type:text" json:"replyContent"`                          // 回复内容
	RepliedAt   *time.Time     `json:"repliedAt"`                                              // 回复时间
	RepliedBy   string         `gorm:"size:100" json:"repliedBy"`                              // 回复人
	CreatedAt   time.Time      `gorm:"index" json:"createdAt"`
	UpdatedAt   time.Time      `json:"updatedAt"`
}

// TableName 指定表名
func (Feedback) TableName() string {
	return "feedbacks"
}

// Attachment 附件信息（用于JSON序列化，兼容旧数据）
type Attachment struct {
	Name string `json:"name"` // 文件名
	URL  string `json:"url"`  // 文件URL
	Size int64  `json:"size"` // 文件大小（字节）
	Type string `json:"type"` // 文件类型（image/file）
}

// FeedbackAttachment 反馈附件数据库模型
type FeedbackAttachment struct {
	ID           uint      `gorm:"primarykey" json:"id"`
	UploadKey    string    `gorm:"size:36;not null;index" json:"uploadKey"`       // 上传批次key
	FeedbackID   *uint     `gorm:"index" json:"feedbackId"`                       // 关联的反馈ID
	OriginalName string    `gorm:"size:255;not null" json:"originalName"`         // 原始文件名
	FileData     []byte    `gorm:"type:longblob;not null" json:"-"`               // 文件二进制数据（不返回给前端）
	FileSize     int64     `gorm:"not null" json:"fileSize"`                      // 文件大小
	FileType     string    `gorm:"size:20;not null" json:"fileType"`              // 文件类型 image/file
	MimeType     string    `gorm:"size:100;not null" json:"mimeType"`             // MIME类型
	IsUsed       bool      `gorm:"default:false;index" json:"isUsed"`             // 是否已使用
	CreatedAt    time.Time `json:"createdAt"`
	UpdatedAt    time.Time `json:"updatedAt"`
}

// TableName 指定表名
func (FeedbackAttachment) TableName() string {
	return "feedback_attachments"
}

// ToAttachment 转换为Attachment格式（用于响应，URL指向下载接口）
func (fa *FeedbackAttachment) ToAttachment() Attachment {
	return Attachment{
		Name: fa.OriginalName,
		URL:  fmt.Sprintf("/api/v1/public/feedback/attachment/%d", fa.ID),
		Size: fa.FileSize,
		Type: fa.FileType,
	}
}

// CreateFeedbackRequest 创建反馈请求
type CreateFeedbackRequest struct {
	Email   string `json:"email" binding:"required,email"`
	Content string `json:"content" binding:"required,min=10,max=5000"`
}

// ReplyFeedbackRequest 回复反馈请求
type ReplyFeedbackRequest struct {
	ReplyContent string `json:"replyContent" binding:"required,min=1,max=5000"`
}

// UpdateStatusRequest 更新状态请求
type UpdateStatusRequest struct {
	Status FeedbackStatus `json:"status" binding:"required,oneof=pending processed replied closed"`
}

// FeedbackListRequest 反馈列表请求
type FeedbackListRequest struct {
	Page     int            `form:"page" binding:"min=1"`
	PageSize int            `form:"pageSize" binding:"min=1,max=100"`
	Status   FeedbackStatus `form:"status"`
	Email    string         `form:"email"`
	Keyword  string         `form:"keyword"`
	StartDate string        `form:"startDate"`
	EndDate   string        `form:"endDate"`
}

// FeedbackListResponse 反馈列表响应
type FeedbackListResponse struct {
	List     []Feedback `json:"list"`
	Total    int64      `json:"total"`
	Page     int        `json:"page"`
	PageSize int        `json:"pageSize"`
}

// FeedbackStats 反馈统计
type FeedbackStats struct {
	Total     int64 `json:"total"`
	Pending   int64 `json:"pending"`
	Processed int64 `json:"processed"`
	Replied   int64 `json:"replied"`
	Closed    int64 `json:"closed"`
}

package feedback

import (
	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// Repository 反馈仓库
type Repository struct {
	db *gorm.DB
}

// NewRepository 创建反馈仓库
func NewRepository(db *gorm.DB) *Repository {
	return &Repository{db: db}
}

// Create 创建反馈
func (r *Repository) Create(feedback *Feedback) error {
	return r.db.Create(feedback).Error
}

// GetByID 根据ID获取反馈
func (r *Repository) GetByID(id uint) (*Feedback, error) {
	var feedback Feedback
	err := r.db.First(&feedback, id).Error
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &feedback, nil
}

// Update 更新反馈
func (r *Repository) Update(feedback *Feedback) error {
	return r.db.Save(feedback).Error
}

// Delete 删除反馈
func (r *Repository) Delete(id uint) error {
	return r.db.Delete(&Feedback{}, id).Error
}

// List 获取反馈列表
func (r *Repository) List(req *FeedbackListRequest) (*FeedbackListResponse, error) {
	var feedbacks []Feedback
	var total int64

	query := r.db.Model(&Feedback{})

	// 状态筛选
	if req.Status != "" {
		query = query.Where("status = ?", req.Status)
	}

	// 邮箱筛选
	if req.Email != "" {
		query = query.Where("email LIKE ?", "%"+req.Email+"%")
	}

	// 关键词搜索（搜索内容和邮箱）
	if req.Keyword != "" {
		query = query.Where("content LIKE ? OR email LIKE ?", "%"+req.Keyword+"%", "%"+req.Keyword+"%")
	}

	// 日期范围筛选
	if req.StartDate != "" {
		query = query.Where("created_at >= ?", req.StartDate+" 00:00:00")
	}
	if req.EndDate != "" {
		query = query.Where("created_at <= ?", req.EndDate+" 23:59:59")
	}

	// 获取总数
	if err := query.Count(&total).Error; err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// 分页
	offset := (req.Page - 1) * req.PageSize
	if err := query.Order("created_at DESC").Offset(offset).Limit(req.PageSize).Find(&feedbacks).Error; err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &FeedbackListResponse{
		List:     feedbacks,
		Total:    total,
		Page:     req.Page,
		PageSize: req.PageSize,
	}, nil
}

// GetStats 获取反馈统计
func (r *Repository) GetStats() (*FeedbackStats, error) {
	var stats FeedbackStats

	// 总数
	if err := r.db.Model(&Feedback{}).Count(&stats.Total).Error; err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// 各状态数量
	if err := r.db.Model(&Feedback{}).Where("status = ?", StatusPending).Count(&stats.Pending).Error; err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := r.db.Model(&Feedback{}).Where("status = ?", StatusProcessed).Count(&stats.Processed).Error; err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := r.db.Model(&Feedback{}).Where("status = ?", StatusReplied).Count(&stats.Replied).Error; err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := r.db.Model(&Feedback{}).Where("status = ?", StatusClosed).Count(&stats.Closed).Error; err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &stats, nil
}

// UpdateStatus 更新反馈状态
func (r *Repository) UpdateStatus(id uint, status FeedbackStatus) error {
	return r.db.Model(&Feedback{}).Where("id = ?", id).Update("status", status).Error
}

// ========== 附件相关方法 ==========

// CreateAttachment 创建附件记录
func (r *Repository) CreateAttachment(attachment *FeedbackAttachment) error {
	return r.db.Create(attachment).Error
}

// GetAttachmentsByUploadKey 根据上传key获取附件列表
func (r *Repository) GetAttachmentsByUploadKey(uploadKey string) ([]FeedbackAttachment, error) {
	var attachments []FeedbackAttachment
	err := r.db.Where("upload_key = ?", uploadKey).Find(&attachments).Error
	return attachments, err
}

// GetAttachmentsByFeedbackID 根据反馈ID获取附件列表（不包含文件数据）
func (r *Repository) GetAttachmentsByFeedbackID(feedbackID uint) ([]FeedbackAttachment, error) {
	var attachments []FeedbackAttachment
	// 不查询 file_data 字段以提高性能
	err := r.db.Select("id, upload_key, feedback_id, original_name, file_size, file_type, mime_type, is_used, created_at, updated_at").
		Where("feedback_id = ?", feedbackID).Find(&attachments).Error
	return attachments, err
}

// GetAttachmentByID 根据ID获取单个附件（包含文件数据）
func (r *Repository) GetAttachmentByID(id uint) (*FeedbackAttachment, error) {
	var attachment FeedbackAttachment
	err := r.db.First(&attachment, id).Error
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &attachment, nil
}

// BindAttachmentsToFeedback 将附件绑定到反馈
func (r *Repository) BindAttachmentsToFeedback(uploadKey string, feedbackID uint) error {
	return r.db.Model(&FeedbackAttachment{}).
		Where("upload_key = ?", uploadKey).
		Updates(map[string]interface{}{
			"feedback_id": feedbackID,
			"is_used":     true,
		}).Error
}

// DeleteOrphanAttachments 删除游离附件（未绑定反馈且创建超过指定时间的），返回删除数量
func (r *Repository) DeleteOrphanAttachments(olderThan string) (int64, error) {
	// 删除 feedback_id IS NULL 且创建时间超过指定时间的附件
	result := r.db.Where("feedback_id IS NULL AND created_at < ?", olderThan).Delete(&FeedbackAttachment{})
	return result.RowsAffected, result.Error
}

// DeleteExcessOrphanAttachments 删除超出限制的游离附件（保留最新的maxCount个）
func (r *Repository) DeleteExcessOrphanAttachments(maxCount int) (int64, error) {
	// 获取游离附件总数（feedback_id IS NULL）
	var totalCount int64
	if err := r.db.Model(&FeedbackAttachment{}).Where("feedback_id IS NULL").Count(&totalCount).Error; err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}

	// 如果未超过限制，不需要删除
	if totalCount <= int64(maxCount) {
		return 0, nil
	}

	// 计算需要删除的数量
	deleteCount := totalCount - int64(maxCount)

	// 获取需要删除的附件ID（最旧的）
	var idsToDelete []uint
	if err := r.db.Model(&FeedbackAttachment{}).
		Select("id").
		Where("feedback_id IS NULL").
		Order("created_at ASC").
		Limit(int(deleteCount)).
		Pluck("id", &idsToDelete).Error; err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}

	// 删除这些附件
	if len(idsToDelete) > 0 {
		result := r.db.Where("id IN ?", idsToDelete).Delete(&FeedbackAttachment{})
		return result.RowsAffected, result.Error
	}

	return 0, nil
}

// GetOrphanAttachmentStats 获取游离附件的统计信息
func (r *Repository) GetOrphanAttachmentStats() (count int64, totalSize int64, err error) {
	err = r.db.Model(&FeedbackAttachment{}).
		Where("feedback_id IS NULL").
		Count(&count).Error
	if err != nil {
		return
	}

	// 获取总大小
	var result struct {
		TotalSize int64
	}
	err = r.db.Model(&FeedbackAttachment{}).
		Select("COALESCE(SUM(file_size), 0) as total_size").
		Where("feedback_id IS NULL").
		Scan(&result).Error
	totalSize = result.TotalSize
	return
}

// DeleteAttachmentsByFeedbackID 删除反馈相关的所有附件记录
func (r *Repository) DeleteAttachmentsByFeedbackID(feedbackID uint) ([]FeedbackAttachment, error) {
	var attachments []FeedbackAttachment
	// 先查询要删除的附件
	err := r.db.Where("feedback_id = ?", feedbackID).Find(&attachments).Error
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	
	// 删除数据库记录
	if len(attachments) > 0 {
		err = r.db.Where("feedback_id = ?", feedbackID).Delete(&FeedbackAttachment{}).Error
	}
	
	return attachments, err
}

// ============================================================================

package feedback

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"scholar-backend/internal/common/model"
	"scholar-backend/internal/common/utils"
)

// ConfigService 配置服务接口（用于获取邮件配置）
type ConfigService interface {
	GetActiveEmailConfig() (*model.EmailConfig, error)
}

// UserRepository 用户仓库接口（用于查询用户信息）
type UserRepository interface {
	FindByID(id uint) (*UserInfo, error)
	FindByIDs(ids []uint) (map[uint]*UserInfo, error)
}

// UserInfo 用户信息（简化版，用于反馈显示）
type UserInfo struct {
	ID        uint    `json:"id"`
	Username  *string `json:"username"`
	Email     *string `json:"email"`
	Phone     *string `json:"phone"`
	AvatarURL *string `json:"avatar_url"`
}

// Service 反馈服务
type Service struct {
	repo          *Repository
	configService ConfigService
	userRepo      UserRepository
}

// NewService 创建反馈服务
func NewService(repo *Repository) *Service {
	return &Service{
		repo: repo,
	}
}

// SetConfigService 设置配置服务（用于依赖注入）
func (s *Service) SetConfigService(configService ConfigService) {
	s.configService = configService
}

// SetUserRepository 设置用户仓库（用于依赖注入）
func (s *Service) SetUserRepository(userRepo UserRepository) {
	s.userRepo = userRepo
}

// CreateFeedback 创建反馈
func (s *Service) CreateFeedback(req *CreateFeedbackRequest, userID *uint, username, ip string, attachments []Attachment) (*Feedback, error) {
	// 序列化附件
	attachmentsJSON := ""
	if len(attachments) > 0 {
		data, err := json.Marshal(attachments)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to serialize attachments: %v", err)
		}
		attachmentsJSON = string(data)
	}

	// 获取IP归属地
	ipLocation := ""
	if ip != "" {
		loc := utils.ParseIPLocation(ip)
		if loc != nil {
			ipLocation = utils.GetSimpleLocationString(loc)
		}
	}

	feedback := &Feedback{
		Email:       req.Email,
		Content:     req.Content,
		Attachments: attachmentsJSON,
		UserID:      userID,
		Username:    username,
		IP:          ip,
		IPLocation:  ipLocation,
		Status:      StatusPending,
	}

	if err := s.repo.Create(feedback); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return feedback, nil
}

// GetFeedback 获取反馈详情
func (s *Service) GetFeedback(id uint) (*Feedback, error) {
	feedback, err := s.repo.GetByID(id)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// 填充附件信息到 Attachments 字段（JSON格式）
	attachments, _ := s.GetAttachments(feedback)
	if len(attachments) > 0 {
		data, _ := json.Marshal(attachments)
		feedback.Attachments = string(data)
	}

	// 如果有 user_id，查询用户信息填充 username
	if feedback.UserID != nil && s.userRepo != nil {
		if userInfo, err := s.userRepo.FindByID(*feedback.UserID); err == nil && userInfo != nil {
			if userInfo.Username != nil && *userInfo.Username != "" {
				feedback.Username = *userInfo.Username
			}
		}
	}

	return feedback, nil
}

// ListFeedbacks 获取反馈列表
func (s *Service) ListFeedbacks(req *FeedbackListRequest) (*FeedbackListResponse, error) {
	// 设置默认值
	if req.Page <= 0 {
		req.Page = 1
	}
	if req.PageSize <= 0 {
		req.PageSize = 20
	}
	result, err := s.repo.List(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// 收集所有需要查询的 user_id
	userIDs := make([]uint, 0)
	for _, fb := range result.List {
		if fb.UserID != nil {
			userIDs = append(userIDs, *fb.UserID)
		}
	}

	// 批量查询用户信息
	var userMap map[uint]*UserInfo
	if len(userIDs) > 0 && s.userRepo != nil {
		userMap, _ = s.userRepo.FindByIDs(userIDs)
	}

	// 为每个反馈填充附件信息和用户信息
	for i := range result.List {
		// 填充附件
		attachments, _ := s.GetAttachments(&result.List[i])
		if len(attachments) > 0 {
			data, _ := json.Marshal(attachments)
			result.List[i].Attachments = string(data)
		}

		// 填充用户名（如果 username 为空但有 user_id）
		if result.List[i].UserID != nil && userMap != nil {
			if userInfo, ok := userMap[*result.List[i].UserID]; ok && userInfo != nil {
				if userInfo.Username != nil && *userInfo.Username != "" {
					result.List[i].Username = *userInfo.Username
				}
			}
		}
	}

	return result, nil
}

// GetStats 获取反馈统计
func (s *Service) GetStats() (*FeedbackStats, error) {
	return s.repo.GetStats()
}

// UpdateStatus 更新反馈状态
func (s *Service) UpdateStatus(id uint, status FeedbackStatus) error {
	return s.repo.UpdateStatus(id, status)
}

// ReplyFeedback 回复反馈
func (s *Service) ReplyFeedback(id uint, replyContent, repliedBy string) error {
	feedback, err := s.repo.GetByID(id)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// 更新反馈信息
	now := time.Now()
	feedback.ReplyContent = replyContent
	feedback.RepliedAt = &now
	feedback.RepliedBy = repliedBy
	feedback.Status = StatusReplied

	if err := s.repo.Update(feedback); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// 发送回复邮件
	fmt.Printf("[Feedback Reply] Starting email send process for feedback #%d to %s\n", id, feedback.Email)
	
	if s.configService != nil {
		fmt.Printf("[Feedback Reply] ConfigService is available, getting email config...\n")
		emailConfig, err := s.configService.GetActiveEmailConfig()
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Printf("[Feedback Reply] Error getting email config: %v\n", err)
		} else if emailConfig == nil {
			fmt.Printf("[Feedback Reply] Email config is nil (not configured)\n")
		} else {
			fmt.Printf("[Feedback Reply] Email config loaded: host=%s, port=%d, from=%s\n", 
				emailConfig.SMTPHost, emailConfig.SMTPPort, emailConfig.FromEmail)
			
			subject := "您的反馈已收到回复 - Scholay"
			body := s.buildReplyEmailBody(feedback, replyContent)

			config := utils.EmailConfig{
				SMTPHost:     emailConfig.SMTPHost,
				SMTPPort:     emailConfig.SMTPPort,
				SMTPUser:     emailConfig.SMTPUser,
				SMTPPassword: emailConfig.SMTPPassword,
				FromEmail:    emailConfig.FromEmail,
				FromName:     emailConfig.FromName,
			}

			fmt.Printf("[Feedback Reply] Sending email to %s...\n", feedback.Email)
			if err := utils.SendEmailWithTLS(config, []string{feedback.Email}, subject, body); err != nil {
				// 记录错误但不影响主流程
				fmt.Printf("[Feedback Reply] ✗ Failed to send reply email to %s: %v\n", feedback.Email, err)
			} else {
				fmt.Printf("[Feedback Reply] ✓ Reply email sent successfully to %s for feedback #%d\n", feedback.Email, id)
			}
		}
	} else {
		fmt.Printf("[Feedback Reply] ✗ ConfigService not set, skipping reply email for feedback #%d\n", id)
	}

	return nil
}

// buildReplyEmailBody 构建回复邮件内容
func (s *Service) buildReplyEmailBody(feedback *Feedback, replyContent string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(`
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <style>
        body { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; line-height: 1.6; color: #333; }
        .container { max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px; }
        .header { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #10a37f, #0d8a6a); color: white; padding: 20px; border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0; }
        .content { background: #f9f9f9; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #e0e0e0; border-top: none; border-radius: 0 0 8px 8px; }
        .original { background: #fff; padding: 15px; border-left: 4px solid #10a37f; margin: 15px 0; }
        .reply { background: #e8f5e9; padding: 15px; border-radius: 8px; margin: 15px 0; }
        .footer { text-align: center; color: #888; font-size: 12px; margin-top: 20px; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="container">
        <div class="header">
            <h2 style="margin: 0;">您的反馈已收到回复</h2>
        </div>
        <div class="content">
            <p>您好，</p>
            <p>感谢您的反馈，我们已经处理了您的问题。以下是我们的回复：</p>
            
            <h4>您的原始反馈：</h4>
            <div class="original">
                %s
            </div>
            
            <h4>我们的回复：</h4>
            <div class="reply">
                %s
            </div>

</html>

// DeleteFeedback 删除反馈
func (s *Service) DeleteFeedback(id uint) error {
	return s.repo.Delete(id)
}

// GetAttachments 获取附件列表（优先从数据库获取，兼容旧的JSON格式）
func (s *Service) GetAttachments(feedback *Feedback) ([]Attachment, error) {
	// 优先从数据库获取附件
	dbAttachments, err := s.repo.GetAttachmentsByFeedbackID(feedback.ID)
	if err == nil && len(dbAttachments) > 0 {
		attachments := make([]Attachment, len(dbAttachments))
		for i, att := range dbAttachments {
			attachments[i] = att.ToAttachment()
		}
		return attachments, nil
	}

	// 兼容旧数据：从JSON字段解析
	if feedback.Attachments == "" {
		return []Attachment{}, nil
	}
	var attachments []Attachment
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(feedback.Attachments), &attachments); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return attachments, nil
}

// ========== 附件相关方法 ==========

// SaveAttachment 保存附件记录到数据库
func (s *Service) SaveAttachment(attachment *FeedbackAttachment) error {
	return s.repo.CreateAttachment(attachment)
}

// GetAttachmentsByUploadKey 根据上传key获取附件列表
func (s *Service) GetAttachmentsByUploadKey(uploadKey string) ([]FeedbackAttachment, error) {
	return s.repo.GetAttachmentsByUploadKey(uploadKey)
}

// GetAttachmentByID 根据ID获取单个附件（包含文件数据）
func (s *Service) GetAttachmentByID(id uint) (*FeedbackAttachment, error) {
	return s.repo.GetAttachmentByID(id)
}

// CreateFeedbackWithAttachments 创建反馈并关联附件
func (s *Service) CreateFeedbackWithAttachments(email, content *string, userID *uint, username, ip, attachmentsKey string) (*Feedback, error) {
	// 获取IP归属地
	ipLocation := ""
	if ip != "" {
		loc := utils.ParseIPLocation(ip)
		if loc != nil {
			ipLocation = utils.GetSimpleLocationString(loc)
		}
	}

	feedback := &Feedback{
		Email:      *email,
		Content:    *content,
		UserID:     userID,
		Username:   username,
		IP:         ip,
		IPLocation: ipLocation,
		Status:     StatusPending,
	}

	// 创建反馈
	if err := s.repo.Create(feedback); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// 如果有附件key，绑定附件到反馈
	if attachmentsKey != "" {
		if err := s.repo.BindAttachmentsToFeedback(attachmentsKey, feedback.ID); err != nil {
			// 记录错误但不影响主流程
			fmt.Printf("Failed to bind attachments to feedback %d: %v\n", feedback.ID, err)
		}
	}

	return feedback, nil
}

// CleanupOrphanAttachments 清理游离附件（未绑定反馈的过期附件），返回删除数量
func (s *Service) CleanupOrphanAttachments(olderThan string) (int64, error) {
	return s.repo.DeleteOrphanAttachments(olderThan)
}

// CleanupExcessOrphanAttachments 清理超出限制的游离附件（保留最新的maxCount个）
func (s *Service) CleanupExcessOrphanAttachments(maxCount int) (int64, error) {
	return s.repo.DeleteExcessOrphanAttachments(maxCount)
}

// GetOrphanAttachmentStats 获取游离附件的统计信息
func (s *Service) GetOrphanAttachmentStats() (count int64, totalSize int64, err error) {
	return s.repo.GetOrphanAttachmentStats()
}

// DeleteFeedbackWithAttachments 删除反馈及其附件
func (s *Service) DeleteFeedbackWithAttachments(id uint) ([]FeedbackAttachment, error) {
	// 先获取附件列表
	attachments, err := s.repo.DeleteAttachmentsByFeedbackID(id)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// 删除反馈（附件会级联删除）
	if err := s.repo.Delete(id); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return attachments, nil
}

package mcp

import (
	"scholar-backend/internal/common/utils"
	"scholar-backend/internal/semanticscholar"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// Handler handles MCP HTTP requests
type Handler struct {
	server *MCPServer
}

// NewHandler creates a new MCP handler
func NewHandler(manager *semanticscholar.Manager) *Handler {
	return &Handler{
		server: NewMCPServer(manager),
	}
}

// ListTools handles GET /api/v1/mcp/tools
func (h *Handler) ListTools(c *gin.Context) {
	tools := h.server.ListTools()
	utils.Success(c, map[string]interface{}{
		"tools": tools,
	})
}

// CallTool handles POST /api/v1/mcp/call
func (h *Handler) CallTool(c *gin.Context) {
	var req ToolRequest
	if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 5001, "Invalid request body: "+err.Error())
		return
	}

	result, err := h.server.CallTool(req)
	if err != nil {
		utils.Error(c, 5002, "Tool call failed: "+err.Error())
		return
	}

	utils.Success(c, result)
}

}

// ToolResponse represents an MCP tool call response

	Content []map[string]interface{} `json:"content"`
}

// CallTool executes an MCP tool call
func (s *MCPServer) CallTool(req ToolRequest) (*ToolResponse, error) {
	switch req.Name {
	case "search_papers":
		return s.handleSearchPapers(req.Arguments)
	case "search_papers_advanced":
		return s.handleSearchPapersAdvanced(req.Arguments)
	case "get_paper":
		return s.handleGetPaper(req.Arguments)
	case "get_paper_citations":
		return s.handleGetPaperCitations(req.Arguments)
	case "get_paper_references":
		return s.handleGetPaperReferences(req.Arguments)
	case "search_authors":
		return s.handleSearchAuthors(req.Arguments)
	case "get_author":
		return s.handleGetAuthor(req.Arguments)
	case "get_author_papers":
		return s.handleGetAuthorPapers(req.Arguments)
	case "get_recommendations":
		return s.handleGetRecommendations(req.Arguments)
	default:
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown tool: %s", req.Name)
	}
}

func (s *MCPServer) handleSearchPapers(args map[string]interface{}) (*ToolResponse, error) {
	query, ok := args["query"].(string)
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("query is required")
	}

	// Default fields to return for complete paper information
	defaultFields := []string{
		"paperId", "title", "abstract", "year", "authors",
		"citationCount", "venue", "publicationDate", "url",
		"referenceCount", "fieldsOfStudy", "externalIds", "tldr",
	}

	opts := semanticscholar.PaperSearchOptions{
		Query:  query,
		Limit:  getIntArg(args, "limit", 40),
		Offset: getIntArg(args, "offset", 0),
		Fields: defaultFields,
	}

	if year, ok := args["year"].(string); ok {
		opts.Year = year
	}
	if fields, ok := args["fieldsOfStudy"].([]interface{}); ok {
		opts.FieldsOfStudy = interfaceSliceToStringSlice(fields)
	}

	// Use manager which will automatically get API key from backend config
	result, err := s.manager.SearchPapers(opts)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return createJSONResponse(result)
}

func (s *MCPServer) handleSearchPapersAdvanced(args map[string]interface{}) (*ToolResponse, error) {
	// Get keywords array
	keywords, ok := args["keywords"].([]interface{})
	if !ok || len(keywords) == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("keywords array is required")
	}

	fmt.Printf("[MCP DEBUG] ============ search_papers_advanced called ============\n")
	fmt.Printf("[MCP DEBUG] Raw keywords from AI: %v\n", keywords)

	// Get parameters with defaults
	yearFrom := getStringArg(args, "year_from", "2020")
	yearTo := getStringArg(args, "year_to", "2024")
	minCitations := getIntArg(args, "min_citations", 10)
	sortBy := getStringArg(args, "sort_by", "citationCount:desc")
	limit := getIntArg(args, "limit", 50)

	fmt.Printf("[MCP DEBUG] Parameters: yearFrom=%s, yearTo=%s, minCitations=%d, sortBy=%s, limit=%d\n",
		yearFrom, yearTo, minCitations, sortBy, limit)

	// Get optional fields of study
	var fieldsOfStudy []string
	if fields, ok := args["fields_of_study"].([]interface{}); ok {
		fieldsOfStudy = interfaceSliceToStringSlice(fields)
	}

	// Build year range
	yearRange := fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s", yearFrom, yearTo)

	// Convert keywords to query with OR operator
	keywordStrings := interfaceSliceToStringSlice(keywords)
	query := strings.Join(keywordStrings, " | ")

	fmt.Printf("[MCP DEBUG] Converted keywords to strings: %v\n", keywordStrings)
	fmt.Printf("[MCP DEBUG] Final query with OR operator: %s\n", query)
	fmt.Printf("[MCP DEBUG] Year range: %s\n", yearRange)

	// Default fields to return
	// Note: tldr is not supported in bulk search API, only in regular search
	defaultFields := []string{
		"paperId", "title", "abstract", "year", "authors",
		"citationCount", "venue", "publicationDate", "url",
		"referenceCount", "fieldsOfStudy", "externalIds",
		"openAccessPdf", "journal",
	}

	// Use bulk search for better performance and features
	opts := semanticscholar.BulkSearchOptions{
		Query:            query,
		Year:             yearRange,
		MinCitationCount: minCitations,
		Sort:             sortBy,
		FieldsOfStudy:    fieldsOfStudy,
		Fields:           defaultFields,
	}

	// Use manager which will handle API key rotation
	result, err := s.manager.SearchPapersBulk(opts)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// Add search parameters to response for transparency
	responseData := map[string]interface{}{
		"data":  result.Data,
		"total": result.Total,
		"search_params": map[string]interface{}{
			"keywords":      keywordStrings,
			"query":         query,
			"year_range":    yearRange,
			"min_citations": minCitations,
			"sort_by":       sortBy,
			"limit":         limit,
		},
	}

	return createJSONResponse(responseData)
}

func (s *MCPServer) handleGetPaper(args map[string]interface{}) (*ToolResponse, error) {
	paperID, ok := args["paperId"].(string)
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("paperId is required")
	}

	opts := semanticscholar.PaperDetailsOptions{}
	if fields, ok := args["fields"].([]interface{}); ok {
		opts.Fields = interfaceSliceToStringSlice(fields)
	}

	result, err := s.manager.GetPaper(paperID, opts)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return createJSONResponse(result)
}

// Helper functions

func getIntArg(args map[string]interface{}, key string, defaultValue int) int {
	if val, ok := args[key]; ok {
		switch v := val.(type) {
		case float64:
			return int(v)
		case int:
			return v
		}
	}
	return defaultValue
}

func getStringArg(args map[string]interface{}, key string, defaultValue string) string {
	if val, ok := args[key]; ok {
		if str, ok := val.(string); ok {
			return str
		}
	}
	return defaultValue
}

func interfaceSliceToStringSlice(slice []interface{}) []string {
	result := make([]string, 0, len(slice))
	for _, item := range slice {
		if str, ok := item.(string); ok {
			result = append(result, str)
		}
	}
	return result
}

func createJSONResponse(data interface{}) (*ToolResponse, error) {
	jsonData, err := json.Marshal(data)
	if err != nil {
		log.Printf("Failed to marshal response: %v", err)
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal response: %w", err)
	}

	return &ToolResponse{
		Content: []map[string]interface{}{
			{
				"type": "text",
				"text": string(jsonData),
			},
		},
	}, nil
}

// CreateOrder handles POST /api/v1/user/orders/create
// Creates a new order for subscription
func (h *Handler) CreateOrder(c *gin.Context) {
	userID, exists := c.Get("user_id")
	if !exists {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Unauthorized")
		return
	}

	var req CreateOrderRequest
	if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
		return
	}

	order, err := h.service.CreateOrder(userID.(uint), req)
	if err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to create order: "+err.Error())
		return
	}

	utils.SuccessResponse(c, http.StatusOK, "success", order)
}

		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Unauthorized")
		return
	}

	orderNo := c.Param("order_no")
	if orderNo == "" {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Order number is required")
		return
	}

	if err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusNotFound, "Order not found")
		return
	}

		return
	}

	utils.SuccessResponse(c, http.StatusOK, "success", order)
}

// AdminGrantSubscription handles POST /api/v1/admin/users/:id/grant-subscription
// Grants a subscription to a user (admin only)
// This creates a complete order and payment record as if the user paid
func (h *Handler) AdminGrantSubscription(c *gin.Context) {
	// Get admin ID from context
	adminID, exists := c.Get("user_id")
	if !exists {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Unauthorized")
		return
	}

	// Get user ID from URL parameter
	userIDStr := c.Param("id")
	userID, err := strconv.ParseUint(userIDStr, 10, 64)
	if err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid user ID")
		return
	}

	// Parse request body
	var req AdminGrantSubscriptionRequest
	if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request: "+err.Error())
		return
	}

	// Override user ID from URL (for security)
	req.UserID = uint(userID)

	// Grant subscription
	order, err := h.service.AdminGrantSubscription(adminID.(uint), req)
	if err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to grant subscription: "+err.Error())
		return
	}

	utils.SuccessResponse(c, http.StatusOK, "success", gin.H{
		"message": "Subscription granted successfully",
		"order":   order,
	})
}

// ============================================================================
// Scholay学术 V1.0

// 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26

package order

import "time"

// Order represents a subscription order
type Order struct {
	ID             uint       `gorm:"primaryKey" json:"id"`
	UserID         uint       `gorm:"not null;index" json:"user_id"`
	OrderNo        string     `gorm:"uniqueIndex;size:64;not null" json:"order_no"`
	PlanCode       string     `gorm:"size:20;not null" json:"plan_code"`
	PlanName       string     `gorm:"size:50;not null" json:"plan_name"`
	BillingCycle   string     `gorm:"size:20;not null" json:"billing_cycle"` // monthly or yearly
	Amount         float64    `gorm:"type:decimal(10,2);not null" json:"amount"` // Original amount before discount
	CouponID       *uint64    `gorm:"index" json:"coupon_id"` // Which coupon was applied (nullable)
	DiscountAmount float64    `gorm:"type:decimal(10,2);default:0" json:"discount_amount"` // Amount discounted
	FinalAmount    float64    `gorm:"type:decimal(10,2);not null" json:"final_amount"` // Final amount after discount (what user pays)
	Status         string     `gorm:"size:20;not null;default:'pending'" json:"status"` // pending, paid, cancelled, refunded
	PaymentMethod  string     `gorm:"size:50" json:"payment_method"`
	PaymentTime    *time.Time `json:"payment_time"`
	CreatedAt      time.Time  `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt      time.Time  `json:"updated_at"`
}

// PaymentTransaction represents a payment transaction record
type PaymentTransaction struct {
	ID            uint      `gorm:"primaryKey" json:"id"`
	OrderID       uint      `gorm:"not null;index" json:"order_id"`
	TransactionNo string    `gorm:"size:100;index" json:"transaction_no"`
	PaymentMethod string    `gorm:"size:50;not null" json:"payment_method"`
	Amount        float64   `gorm:"type:decimal(10,2);not null" json:"amount"`
	Status        string    `gorm:"size:20;not null;default:'pending'" json:"status"` // pending, success, failed
	PaymentData   string    `gorm:"type:json;default:'{}'" json:"payment_data"` // IMPORTANT: MySQL JSON type cannot be empty string, use {} or null
	CreatedAt     time.Time `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt     time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
}

// TableName specifies the table name for Order
func (Order) TableName() string {
	return "orders"
}

// TableName specifies the table name for PaymentTransaction
func (PaymentTransaction) TableName() string {
	return "payment_transactions"
}

// OrderWithUserInfo represents an order with user information for admin display
type OrderWithUserInfo struct {
	Order
	Username      *string `gorm:"column:username" json:"username"`
	Email         *string `gorm:"column:email" json:"email"`
	Phone         *string `gorm:"column:phone" json:"phone"`
	WechatName    *string `gorm:"column:wechat_name" json:"wechat_name"`
	WechatUnionID *string `gorm:"column:wechat_union_id" json:"wechat_union_id"`
	GithubName    *string `gorm:"column:github_name" json:"github_name"`
}

// ============================================================================
// Scholay学术 V1.0
