// Service handles WeChat OAuth operations
type Service struct {
	repo *Repository
}

// NewService creates a new WeChat service
func NewService(db *gorm.DB) *Service {
	return &Service{
		repo: NewRepository(db),
	}
}

// WeChatAccessTokenResponse represents the access token response from WeChat
type WeChatAccessTokenResponse struct {
	AccessToken  string `json:"access_token"`
	ExpiresIn    int    `json:"expires_in"`
	RefreshToken string `json:"refresh_token"`
	OpenID       string `json:"openid"`
	Scope        string `json:"scope"`
	UnionID      string `json:"unionid"`
	ErrCode      int    `json:"errcode"`
	ErrMsg       string `json:"errmsg"`
}

// WeChatUserInfo represents user information from WeChat
type WeChatUserInfo struct {
	OpenID     string   `json:"openid"`
	Nickname   string   `json:"nickname"`
	Sex        int      `json:"sex"` // 1=male, 2=female, 0=unknown
	Province   string   `json:"province"`
	City       string   `json:"city"`
	Country    string   `json:"country"`
	HeadImgURL string   `json:"headimgurl"`
	Privilege  []string `json:"privilege"`
	UnionID    string   `json:"unionid"`
	ErrCode    int      `json:"errcode"`
	ErrMsg     string   `json:"errmsg"`
}

// GenerateLoginURL generates the WeChat QR code login URL
func (s *Service) GenerateLoginURL(state string) (string, error) {
	config, err := s.repo.GetActiveConfig()
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("no active WeChat configuration: %w", err)
	}

	// For web-based QR code login
	params := url.Values{}
	params.Set("appid", config.AppID)
	params.Set("redirect_uri", config.RedirectURI)
	params.Set("response_type", "code")
	params.Set("scope", config.Scope)
	params.Set("state", state)

	loginURL := "https://open.weixin.qq.com/connect/qrconnect?" + params.Encode() + "#wechat_redirect"
	return loginURL, nil
}

// GetAccessToken exchanges authorization code for access token
func (s *Service) GetAccessToken(code string) (*WeChatAccessTokenResponse, error) {
	config, err := s.repo.GetActiveConfig()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no active WeChat configuration: %w", err)
	}

	// Build request URL
	params := url.Values{}
	params.Set("appid", config.AppID)
	params.Set("secret", config.AppSecret)
	params.Set("code", code)
	params.Set("grant_type", "authorization_code")

	tokenURL := "https://api.weixin.qq.com/sns/oauth2/access_token?" + params.Encode()

	// Make HTTP request
	resp, err := http.Get(tokenURL)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get access token: %w", err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read response: %w", err)
	}

	var tokenResp WeChatAccessTokenResponse
	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &tokenResp); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse response: %w", err)
	}

	if tokenResp.ErrCode != 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("WeChat API error: %s (code: %d)", tokenResp.ErrMsg, tokenResp.ErrCode)
	}

	return &tokenResp, nil
}

// GetUserInfo retrieves user information using access token
func (s *Service) GetUserInfo(accessToken, openID string) (*WeChatUserInfo, error) {
	params := url.Values{}
	params.Set("access_token", accessToken)
	params.Set("openid", openID)
	params.Set("lang", "zh_CN")

	userInfoURL := "https://api.weixin.qq.com/sns/userinfo?" + params.Encode()

	resp, err := http.Get(userInfoURL)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get user info: %w", err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read response: %w", err)
	}

	var userInfo WeChatUserInfo
	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &userInfo); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse response: %w", err)
	}

	if userInfo.ErrCode != 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("WeChat API error: %s (code: %d)", userInfo.ErrMsg, userInfo.ErrCode)
	}

	return &userInfo, nil
}

// RefreshAccessToken refreshes the access token
func (s *Service) RefreshAccessToken(refreshToken string) (*WeChatAccessTokenResponse, error) {
	config, err := s.repo.GetActiveConfig()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no active WeChat configuration: %w", err)
	}

	params := url.Values{}
	params.Set("appid", config.AppID)
	params.Set("grant_type", "refresh_token")
	params.Set("refresh_token", refreshToken)

	tokenURL := "https://api.weixin.qq.com/sns/oauth2/refresh_token?" + params.Encode()

	resp, err := http.Get(tokenURL)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to refresh token: %w", err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read response: %w", err)
	}

	var tokenResp WeChatAccessTokenResponse
	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &tokenResp); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse response: %w", err)
	}

	if tokenResp.ErrCode != 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("WeChat API error: %s (code: %d)", tokenResp.ErrMsg, tokenResp.ErrCode)
	}

	return &tokenResp, nil
}

// VerifySignature verifies WeChat callback signature
func (s *Service) VerifySignature(signature, timestamp, nonce string) (bool, error) {
	config, err := s.repo.GetActiveConfig()
	if err != nil {
		return false, fmt.Errorf("no active WeChat configuration: %w", err)
	}

	// WeChat uses token for signature verification (different from OAuth flow)
	// This is typically used for message callbacks, not OAuth
	token := config.AppSecret // Using AppSecret as token for simplicity

	// Sort parameters
	params := []string{token, timestamp, nonce}
	sort.Strings(params)

	// Concatenate and hash
	str := strings.Join(params, "")
	hash := sha1.New()
	hash.Write([]byte(str))
	calculatedSignature := hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil))

	return calculatedSignature == signature, nil
}

// GetActiveConfig retrieves the active WeChat configuration
func (s *Service) GetActiveConfig() (*model.WeChatConfig, error) {
	return s.repo.GetActiveConfig()
}

// ListConfigs retrieves all WeChat configurations
func (s *Service) ListConfigs() ([]model.WeChatConfig, error) {
	return s.repo.ListConfigs()
}

// CreateConfig creates a new WeChat configuration
func (s *Service) CreateConfig(config *model.WeChatConfig) error {
	// Validate required fields
	if config.AppID == "" || config.AppSecret == "" || config.RedirectURI == "" {
		return errors.New("app_id, app_secret, and redirect_uri are required")
	}

	// If this is set as active, deactivate others
	if config.IsActive {
		if err := s.repo.DeactivateAllConfigs(); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("failed to deactivate existing configs: %w", err)
		}
	}

	return s.repo.CreateConfig(config)
}

// UpdateConfig updates a WeChat configuration
func (s *Service) UpdateConfig(config *model.WeChatConfig) error {
	// If this is set as active, deactivate others
	if config.IsActive {
		if err := s.repo.SetActiveConfig(config.ID); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("failed to set active config: %w", err)
		}
	}

	return s.repo.UpdateConfig(config)
}

// DeleteConfig deletes a WeChat configuration
func (s *Service) DeleteConfig(id uint) error {
	return s.repo.DeleteConfig(id)
}

// SetActiveConfig sets a specific configuration as active
func (s *Service) SetActiveConfig(id uint) error {
	return s.repo.SetActiveConfig(id)
}

// GenerateState generates a random state parameter for OAuth
func GenerateState() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
}

// ServiceAdapter adapts wechat.Service to user.WeChatService interface
type ServiceAdapter struct {
	service *Service
}

// NewServiceAdapter creates a new adapter
func NewServiceAdapter(service *Service) *ServiceAdapter {
	return &ServiceAdapter{service: service}
}

// GetAccessToken implements user.WeChatService interface
func (a *ServiceAdapter) GetAccessToken(code string) (accessToken, openID, unionID string, err error) {
	resp, err := a.service.GetAccessToken(code)
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", "", err
	}
	return resp.AccessToken, resp.OpenID, resp.UnionID, nil
}

// GetUserInfo implements user.WeChatService interface
func (a *ServiceAdapter) GetUserInfo(accessToken, openID string) (nickname, headImgURL, unionID string, err error) {
	resp, err := a.service.GetUserInfo(accessToken, openID)
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", "", err
	}
	return resp.Nickname, resp.HeadImgURL, resp.UnionID, nil
}

package wechatofficial

import (
	"encoding/xml"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"time"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"

	"scholar-backend/internal/common/utils"
)

// Handler handles HTTP requests for WeChat Official Account
type Handler struct {
	service *Service
}

// NewHandler creates a new handler
func NewHandler(service *Service) *Handler {
	return &Handler{service: service}
}

// HandleVerification handles WeChat server verification (GET request)
func (h *Handler) HandleVerification(c *gin.Context) {
	signature := c.Query("signature")
	timestamp := c.Query("timestamp")
	nonce := c.Query("nonce")
	echostr := c.Query("echostr")

	// Get config to retrieve token
	config, err := h.service.GetConfig()
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Failed to get config: %v\n", err)
		c.String(http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to get config")
		return
	}

	// Verify signature
	if h.service.VerifySignature(signature, timestamp, nonce, config.Token) {
		fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Verification successful\n")
		c.String(http.StatusOK, echostr)
	} else {
		fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Verification failed\n")
		c.String(http.StatusUnauthorized, "Verification failed")
	}
}

// HandleMessage handles WeChat messages (POST request)
func (h *Handler) HandleMessage(c *gin.Context) {
	// Read request body
	body, err := io.ReadAll(c.Request.Body)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Failed to read body: %v\n", err)
		c.String(http.StatusBadRequest, "Failed to read body")
		return
	}

	fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Received message: %s\n", string(body))

	// Parse XML to determine message type
	var baseMsg struct {
		MsgType string `xml:"MsgType"`
	}
	if err := xml.Unmarshal(body, &baseMsg); err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Failed to parse XML: %v\n", err)
		c.String(http.StatusBadRequest, "Failed to parse XML")
		return
	}

	fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Message type: %s\n", baseMsg.MsgType)

	var reply string
	var toUser, fromUser string

	switch baseMsg.MsgType {
	case "text":
		// Handle text message
		var msg WeChatTextMessage
		if err := xml.Unmarshal(body, &msg); err != nil {
			fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Failed to parse text message: %v\n", err)
			c.String(http.StatusBadRequest, "Failed to parse text message")
			return
		}

		fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Text message - From: %s, Content: %s\n", msg.FromUserName, msg.Content)

		toUser = msg.FromUserName
		fromUser = msg.ToUserName

		// Get AI reply (text only)
		reply, err = h.service.GetAIReply(msg.Content, "")
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Failed to get AI reply: %v\n", err)
			reply = "抱歉，我暂时无法处理您的消息，请稍后再试。"
		}

	case "image":
		// Handle image message
		var msg WeChatImageMessage
		if err := xml.Unmarshal(body, &msg); err != nil {
			fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Failed to parse image message: %v\n", err)
			c.String(http.StatusBadRequest, "Failed to parse image message")
			return
		}

		fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Image message - From: %s, PicUrl: %s, MediaId: %s\n",
			msg.FromUserName, msg.PicUrl, msg.MediaId)

		toUser = msg.FromUserName
		fromUser = msg.ToUserName

		// Download image from WeChat
		base64Image, err := h.service.DownloadImage(msg.MediaId)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Failed to download image: %v\n", err)
			reply = "抱歉，我无法处理这张图片，请稍后再试。"
		} else {
			// Get AI reply with image
			userMessage := "请分析这张图片并回答相关问题。"
			reply, err = h.service.GetAIReplyWithImage(userMessage, base64Image, "")
			if err != nil {
				fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Failed to get AI reply with image: %v\n", err)
				reply = "抱歉，我暂时无法处理您的图片，请稍后再试。"
			}
		}

	default:
		// Ignore other message types
		fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Ignoring message type: %s\n", baseMsg.MsgType)
		c.String(http.StatusOK, "success")
		return
	}

	fmt.Printf("[WeChat] AI reply: %s\n", reply)

	// Build response
	response := WeChatTextResponse{
		ToUserName:   toUser,
		FromUserName: fromUser,
		CreateTime:   time.Now().Unix(),
		MsgType:      "text",
		Content:      reply,
	}

	// Convert to XML
	xmlData, err := xml.Marshal(response)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Failed to marshal XML: %v\n", err)
		c.String(http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to create response")
		return
	}

	fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Sending response: %s\n", string(xmlData))

	// Return XML response
	c.Header("Content-Type", "application/xml")
	c.String(http.StatusOK, string(xmlData))
}

// GetConfig handles GET /api/v1/admin/wechat-official/config
func (h *Handler) GetConfig(c *gin.Context) {
	config, err := h.service.GetConfig()
	if err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to get config")
		return
	}

	// Check if request wants to show sensitive data
	showSensitive := c.Query("show_sensitive") == "true"

	if showSensitive {
		// Return real values without masking
		utils.SuccessResponse(c, http.StatusOK, "success", config)
	} else {
		// Mask sensitive fields for display
		maskedConfig := config.MaskSensitiveData()
		utils.SuccessResponse(c, http.StatusOK, "success", maskedConfig)
	}
}

// UpdateConfig handles PUT /api/v1/admin/wechat-official/config
func (h *Handler) UpdateConfig(c *gin.Context) {
	var config WeChatOfficialConfig
	if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&config); err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request")
		return
	}

	if err := h.service.UpdateConfig(&config); err != nil {
		utils.ErrorResponse(c, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to update config")
		return
	}

	utils.SuccessResponse(c, http.StatusOK, "Config updated successfully", gin.H{"message": "Config updated successfully"})
}

package wechatofficial

import (
	"encoding/xml"
	"time"

// WeChatOfficialConfig represents WeChat Official Account auto-reply configuration
type WeChatOfficialConfig struct {
	ID              uint      `json:"id" gorm:"primaryKey"`
	AppID           string    `json:"app_id" gorm:"column:app_id;type:varchar(100);not null;default:''"`
	AppSecret       string    `json:"app_secret" gorm:"column:app_secret;type:varchar(255);not null;default:''"`
	Token           string    `json:"token" gorm:"column:token;type:varchar(100);not null;default:''"`
	EncodingAESKey  string    `json:"encoding_aes_key" gorm:"column:encoding_aes_key;type:varchar(100);not null;default:''"`
	EncryptionMode  string    `json:"encryption_mode" gorm:"column:encryption_mode;type:varchar(20);not null;default:'plaintext'"` // plaintext, compatible, secure
	AutoReplyEnabled bool     `json:"auto_reply_enabled" gorm:"column:auto_reply_enabled;not null;default:false"`
	AIModelLevel    string    `json:"ai_model_level" gorm:"column:ai_model_level;type:varchar(20);not null;default:'low'"` // low, medium, high
	SystemPrompt    string    `json:"system_prompt" gorm:"column:system_prompt;type:text"`
	CreatedAt       time.Time `json:"created_at" gorm:"column:created_at;autoCreateTime"`
	UpdatedAt       time.Time `json:"updated_at" gorm:"column:updated_at;autoUpdateTime"`
}

// TableName specifies the table name
func (WeChatOfficialConfig) TableName() string {
	return "wechat_official_config"
}

// WeChatTextMessage represents a text message from WeChat
type WeChatTextMessage struct {
	ToUserName   string `xml:"ToUserName"`
	FromUserName string `xml:"FromUserName"`
	CreateTime   int64  `xml:"CreateTime"`
	MsgType      string `xml:"MsgType"`
	Content      string `xml:"Content"`
	MsgID        int64  `xml:"MsgId"`
}

// WeChatImageMessage represents an image message from WeChat
type WeChatImageMessage struct {
	ToUserName   string `xml:"ToUserName"`
	FromUserName string `xml:"FromUserName"`
	CreateTime   int64  `xml:"CreateTime"`
	MsgType      string `xml:"MsgType"`
	PicUrl       string `xml:"PicUrl"`
	MediaId      string `xml:"MediaId"`
	MsgID        int64  `xml:"MsgId"`
}

// WeChatTextResponse represents a text response to WeChat
type WeChatTextResponse struct {
	XMLName      xml.Name `xml:"xml"`
	ToUserName   string   `xml:"ToUserName"`
	FromUserName string   `xml:"FromUserName"`
	CreateTime   int64    `xml:"CreateTime"`
	MsgType      string   `xml:"MsgType"`
	Content      string   `xml:"Content"`
}

// WeChatAccessTokenResponse represents WeChat access token response
type WeChatAccessTokenResponse struct {
	AccessToken string `json:"access_token"`
	ExpiresIn   int    `json:"expires_in"`
	ErrCode     int    `json:"errcode"`
	ErrMsg      string `json:"errmsg"`
}

// MaskSensitiveData masks sensitive fields in the config for display
func (c *WeChatOfficialConfig) MaskSensitiveData() *WeChatOfficialConfig {
	masked := *c
	masked.AppSecret = maskString(c.AppSecret)
	masked.Token = maskString(c.Token)
	masked.EncodingAESKey = maskString(c.EncodingAESKey)
	return &masked
}

// maskString masks a string by showing first 4 and last 4 characters
func maskString(s string) string {
	if s == "" {
		return ""
	}

	length := len(s)
	if length <= 8 {
		// For short strings, show only asterisks
		return "****"
	}

	// Show first 4 and last 4 characters, mask the middle
	return s[:4] + "****" + s[length-4:]
}

package wechatofficial

import (
	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// Repository handles database operations for WeChat Official Account
type Repository struct {
	db *gorm.DB
}

// NewRepository creates a new repository
func NewRepository(db *gorm.DB) *Repository {
	return &Repository{db: db}
}

// GetConfig gets the WeChat Official Account configuration
func (r *Repository) GetConfig() (*WeChatOfficialConfig, error) {
	var config WeChatOfficialConfig
	err := r.db.First(&config).Error
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &config, nil
}

// UpdateConfig updates the WeChat Official Account configuration
func (r *Repository) UpdateConfig(config *WeChatOfficialConfig) error {
	// Check if config exists
	var existingConfig WeChatOfficialConfig
	err := r.db.First(&existingConfig).Error

	if err == gorm.ErrRecordNotFound {
		// Create new config
		return r.db.Create(config).Error
	} else if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// Update existing config - use Updates to avoid overwriting timestamps
	return r.db.Model(&existingConfig).Updates(map[string]interface{}{
		"app_id":             config.AppID,
		"app_secret":         config.AppSecret,
		"token":              config.Token,
		"encoding_aes_key":   config.EncodingAESKey,
		"encryption_mode":    config.EncryptionMode,
		"auto_reply_enabled": config.AutoReplyEnabled,
		"ai_model_level":     config.AIModelLevel,
		"system_prompt":      config.SystemPrompt,
	}).Error
}

package wechatofficial

import (
	"crypto/sha1"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"gorm.io/gorm"

	"scholar-backend/internal/ai"
	"scholar-backend/internal/thirdparty"
)

// Service handles WeChat Official Account operations
type Service struct {
	repo               *Repository
	aiService          *ai.Service
	accessToken        string
	accessTokenExpires time.Time
	accessTokenMutex   sync.RWMutex
}

// NewService creates a new service
func NewService(db *gorm.DB, aiService *ai.Service) *Service {
	return &Service{
		repo:      NewRepository(db),
		aiService: aiService,
	}
}

// GetConfig gets the WeChat Official Account configuration
func (s *Service) GetConfig() (*WeChatOfficialConfig, error) {
	return s.repo.GetConfig()
}

// UpdateConfig updates the WeChat Official Account configuration
func (s *Service) UpdateConfig(config *WeChatOfficialConfig) error {
	return s.repo.UpdateConfig(config)
}

// VerifySignature verifies the WeChat signature for server validation
func (s *Service) VerifySignature(signature, timestamp, nonce, token string) bool {
	// Sort the parameters
	params := []string{token, timestamp, nonce}
	sort.Strings(params)

	// Join and hash
	str := strings.Join(params, "")
	hash := sha1.New()
	hash.Write([]byte(str))
	hashStr := hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil))

	return hashStr == signature
}

// GetAccessToken gets WeChat access token (cached)
func (s *Service) GetAccessToken() (string, error) {
	s.accessTokenMutex.RLock()
	if s.accessToken != "" && time.Now().Before(s.accessTokenExpires) {
		token := s.accessToken
		s.accessTokenMutex.RUnlock()
		return token, nil
	}
	s.accessTokenMutex.RUnlock()

	// Need to fetch new token
	s.accessTokenMutex.Lock()
	defer s.accessTokenMutex.Unlock()

	// Double check after acquiring write lock
	if s.accessToken != "" && time.Now().Before(s.accessTokenExpires) {
		return s.accessToken, nil
	}

	// Get config
	config, err := s.GetConfig()
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get config: %w", err)
	}

	// Fetch access token from WeChat API
	url := fmt.Sprintf("https://api.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/token?grant_type=client_credential&appid=%s&secret=%s",
		config.AppID, config.AppSecret)

	resp, err := http.Get(url)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to fetch access token: %w", err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	var tokenResp WeChatAccessTokenResponse
	if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&tokenResp); err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to decode access token response: %w", err)
	}

	if tokenResp.ErrCode != 0 {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("WeChat API error %d: %s", tokenResp.ErrCode, tokenResp.ErrMsg)
	}

	// Cache token (expire 5 minutes earlier than actual expiration)
	s.accessToken = tokenResp.AccessToken
	s.accessTokenExpires = time.Now().Add(time.Duration(tokenResp.ExpiresIn-300) * time.Second)

	fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Access token refreshed, expires at: %s\n", s.accessTokenExpires)

	return s.accessToken, nil
}

// DownloadImage downloads image from WeChat server and returns base64 encoded data
func (s *Service) DownloadImage(mediaID string) (string, error) {
	// Get access token
	accessToken, err := s.GetAccessToken()
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get access token: %w", err)
	}

	// Download image from WeChat
	url := fmt.Sprintf("https://api.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/media/get?access_token=%s&media_id=%s",
		accessToken, mediaID)

	resp, err := http.Get(url)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to download image: %w", err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	// Read image data
	imageData, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to read image data: %w", err)
	}

	// Check if response is error (JSON)
	if resp.Header.Get("Content-Type") == "application/json" || resp.Header.Get("Content-Type") == "text/plain" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to download image, response: %s", string(imageData))
	}

	// Encode to base64
	base64Image := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(imageData)

	fmt.Printf("[WeChat] Downloaded image, size: %d bytes, base64 length: %d\n", len(imageData), len(base64Image))

	return base64Image, nil
}

// GetAIReply gets AI reply for user message (text only)
func (s *Service) GetAIReply(userMessage string, aiModelLevel string) (string, error) {
	return s.GetAIReplyWithImage(userMessage, "", aiModelLevel)
}

// GetAIReplyWithImage gets AI reply for user message with optional image
func (s *Service) GetAIReplyWithImage(userMessage string, base64Image string, aiModelLevel string) (string, error) {
	// Get config to check if auto-reply is enabled
	config, err := s.GetConfig()
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get config: %w", err)
	}

	if !config.AutoReplyEnabled {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("auto-reply is disabled")
	}

	// Use configured AI model level or default to low
	modelLevel := aiModelLevel
	if modelLevel == "" {
		modelLevel = config.AIModelLevel
	}

	// Convert string to thirdparty.ModelLevel
	var level thirdparty.ModelLevel
	switch modelLevel {
	case "low":
		level = thirdparty.ModelLevelLow
	case "medium", "mid":
		level = thirdparty.ModelLevelMid
	case "high":
		level = thirdparty.ModelLevelHigh
	default:
		level = thirdparty.ModelLevelLow
	}

	// Prepare system prompt
	systemPrompt := config.SystemPrompt
	if systemPrompt == "" {
		// Default system prompt if not configured
		systemPrompt = "你是一个友好的助手，请简洁准确地回答用户的问题。回复不要超过200字。"
	}

	// Prepare messages for AI
	messages := []ai.ChatMessage{
		{
			Role:    "system",
			Content: systemPrompt,
		},
	}

	// Build user message content
	var userContent ai.MessageContent
	if base64Image != "" {
		// Multimodal message with image
		contentParts := []interface{}{
			ai.TextContent{
				Type: "text",
				Text: userMessage,
			},
		}

		// Add image if provided
		imageContent := ai.ImageURLContent{
			Type: "image_url",
		}
		imageContent.ImageURL.URL = "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64Image
		imageContent.ImageURL.Detail = "auto"
		contentParts = append(contentParts, imageContent)

		userContent = contentParts
	} else {
		// Text-only message
		userContent = userMessage
	}

	messages = append(messages, ai.ChatMessage{
		Role:    "user",
		Content: userContent,
	})

	// Call AI service (non-streaming)
	response, err := s.aiService.ChatCompletionWithTools(messages, nil, "", level)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get AI response: %w", err)
	}

	// Extract reply from response
	if len(response.Choices) == 0 {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("no response from AI")
	}

	// Response content is always string in non-streaming mode
	reply := response.Choices[0].Message.Content
	return reply, nil
}

/**

 * Scholay学术 V1.0

import React, { useState, useEffect, lazy, Suspense } from 'react';
import { BrowserRouter as Router, Routes, Route, Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { HelmetProvider } from 'react-helmet-async';
import { AuthProvider } from './utils/AuthContext';
import { ToastProvider } from './components/ToastContainer';
import { SubscriptionProvider } from './contexts/SubscriptionContext';
import { SidebarProvider } from './contexts/SidebarContext';
import { ThemeProvider } from './contexts/ThemeContext';
import ProtectedRoute from './components/ProtectedRoute';
import MainLayout from './components/MainLayout';

// 首页立即加载(最常访问)
import Home from './pages/Home';

// 其他页面使用懒加载 - 大幅减少初始bundle大小
const SearchResultsPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/SearchResultsPage'));
const AdvancedSearchPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/AdvancedSearchPage'));
const PaperDetailPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/PaperDetailPage'));
const ChatPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/ChatPage'));
const PeerReviewPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/PeerReviewPage'));
const AssistantPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/AssistantPage'));
const Pricing = lazy(() => import('./pages/Pricing'));
const Settings = lazy(() => import('./pages/Settings'));
const WeChatCallback = lazy(() => import('./pages/WeChatCallback'));
const GithubCallback = lazy(() => import('./pages/GithubCallback'));
const OrderConfirmation = lazy(() => import('./pages/OrderConfirmation'));
const FeedbackPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/FeedbackPage'));
const AboutPage = lazy(() => import('./pages/AboutPage'));
const AuthModal = lazy(() => import('./components/AuthModal'));

function App() {
  const [showAuthModal, setShowAuthModal] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Listen for auth:required event from API interceptor
    const handleAuthRequired = () => {
      setShowAuthModal(true);
    };

    window.addEventListener('auth:required', handleAuthRequired);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('auth:required', handleAuthRequired);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <HelmetProvider>
      <ThemeProvider>
      <ToastProvider>
        <AuthProvider>
          <SubscriptionProvider>
            <SidebarProvider>
              <Router>
                <Suspense fallback={null}>
                  <Routes>
                    {/* 使用 MainLayout 包裹需要侧边栏的路由 */}
                    <Route element={<MainLayout />}>
                      {/* 公开路由 - 无需登录即可访问 */}
                      <Route path="/" element={<Home />} />
                      <Route path="/search-results" element={<SearchResultsPage />} />
                      
                      {/* 智能分析页面 - 允许未登录访问 */}
                      <Route path="/advanced-search" element={<AdvancedSearchPage />} />
                      {/* 文献助手页面 - 允许未登录访问 */}
                      <Route path="/assistant" element={<AssistantPage />} />
                      {/* AI对话页面 - 允许未登录访问 */}
                      <Route path="/chat" element={<ChatPage />} />
                      {/* AI审稿人页面 - 允许未登录访问 */}
                      <Route path="/peer-review" element={<PeerReviewPage />} />
                    </Route>

                    {/* 不需要侧边栏的路由 */}
                    <Route path="/search" element={<Navigate to="/" replace />} />
                    <Route path="/pricing" element={<Pricing />} />
                    <Route path="/settings" element={
                      <ProtectedRoute>
                        <Settings />
                      </ProtectedRoute>
                    } />
                    <Route path="/paper/:paperId" element={<PaperDetailPage />} />
                    <Route path="/order-confirmation" element={
                      <ProtectedRoute>
                        <OrderConfirmation />
                      </ProtectedRoute>
                    } />
                    
                    {/* WeChat callback - PUBLIC route (must be accessible without login for OAuth flow) */}
                    <Route path="/wechat/callback" element={<WeChatCallback />} />

                    {/* GitHub callback - PUBLIC route (must be accessible without login for OAuth flow) */}
                    <Route path="/github/callback" element={<GithubCallback />} />

                    {/* 反馈和关于我们页面 - 公开访问 */}
                    <Route path="/feedback" element={<FeedbackPage />} />
                    <Route path="/about" element={<AboutPage />} />

                    {/* 404 redirect to home */}
                    <Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/" replace />} />
                  </Routes>

                  {/* Global auth modal for session expiry - 条件渲染避免不必要的组件加载 */}
                  {showAuthModal && (
                    <AuthModal
                      isOpen={showAuthModal}
                      onClose={() => setShowAuthModal(false)}
                      onLoginSuccess={() => setShowAuthModal(false)}
                    />
                  )}
                </Suspense>
              </Router>
            </SidebarProvider>
          </SubscriptionProvider>
        </AuthProvider>
      </ToastProvider>
    </ThemeProvider>
    </HelmetProvider>
  );
}

export default App;

  const [tooltipPosition, setTooltipPosition] = useState({ top: 0, left: 0 });
  const [openHistoryMenuId, setOpenHistoryMenuId] = useState(null); // 记录哪个历史项的菜单是打开的
  const [historyMenuPosition, setHistoryMenuPosition] = useState({ top: 0, left: 0 });
  const [editingItemId, setEditingItemId] = useState(null); // 正在编辑的历史项ID
  const [editingValue, setEditingValue] = useState(''); // 编辑中的值
  const [originalValue, setOriginalValue] = useState(''); // 原始值，用于比较是否有变化
  const [showDeleteConfirm, setShowDeleteConfirm] = useState(false); // 显示删除确认弹窗
  const [deleteTargetId, setDeleteTargetId] = useState(null); // 要删除的项ID
  const logoRef = useRef(null);
  const navItemRefs = useRef({});
  const hoverTimeoutRef = useRef(null); // 用于延迟清除 hoveredItem
  const historyMenuRef = useRef(null);
  const historyMenuButtonRefs = useRef({}); // 记录每个三点按钮的ref
  const editInputRef = useRef(null); // 编辑输入框的ref

  // 获取订阅信息
  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchSubscription = async () => {
      try {
        const response = await api.get('/user/subscription/my');
        if (response.data.code === 0) {
          setSubscription(response.data.data);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to fetch subscription:', error);
      }
    };

    if (user) {
      fetchSubscription();
    }
  }, [user]);


  // 点击外部关闭用户菜单和历史项菜单
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event) => {
      // 关闭用户菜单
      if (showUserMenu &&
          userMenuRef.current &&
          !userMenuRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
        setShowUserMenu(false);
      }

      // 关闭历史项菜单
      if (openHistoryMenuId !== null &&
          historyMenuRef.current &&
          !historyMenuRef.current.contains(event.target) &&
          !Object.values(historyMenuButtonRefs.current).some(ref => ref && ref.contains(event.target))) {
        setOpenHistoryMenuId(null);
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, [showUserMenu, openHistoryMenuId]);

  // 获取用户头像首字母
  const getUserInitial = () => {
    if (!user) return '?';
    // 优先使用用户名，如果没有则使用邮箱
    const displayName = user.username || user.email;
    if (!displayName) return '?';
    return displayName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
  };

  // 获取用户显示标识（邮箱 > 手机号 > 微信昵称 > GitHub用户名）
  const getUserIdentifier = () => {
    if (!user) return '未登录';
    
    // 优先级1: 邮箱
    if (user.email) {
      return user.email;
    }
    
    // 优先级2: 手机号
    if (user.phone) {
      return user.phone;
    }
    
    // 优先级3: 微信昵称
    if (user.wechat_name) {
      return `微信: ${user.wechat_name}`;
    }
    
    // 优先级4: GitHub用户名
    if (user.github_login) {
      return `GitHub: ${user.github_login}`;
    }
    
    // 兜底：用户名
    if (user.username) {
      return user.username;
    }
    
    return '用户';
  };

  // 更新菜单位置 - 向上弹出
  const updateMenuPosition = () => {
    if (avatarRef.current) {
      const rect = avatarRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      // 菜单向上弹出，所以bottom应该是avatar的top位置
      setMenuPosition({
        bottom: window.innerHeight - rect.top + 8, // 距离底部的距离
        left: collapsed ? rect.left : rect.left
      });
    }
  };

  // 更新tooltip位置
  const updateTooltipPosition = (refElement) => {
    if (refElement) {
      const rect = refElement.getBoundingClientRect();
      setTooltipPosition({
        top: rect.top + rect.height / 2,
        left: rect.right + 12
      });
    }
  };

  // 当显示菜单时更新位置
  useEffect(() => {
    if (showUserMenu) {
      updateMenuPosition();
      window.addEventListener('resize', updateMenuPosition);
      window.addEventListener('scroll', updateMenuPosition);
      return () => {
        window.removeEventListener('resize', updateMenuPosition);
        window.removeEventListener('scroll', updateMenuPosition);
      };
    }
  }, [showUserMenu, collapsed]);

  // 当进入编辑模式时，自动聚焦并选中输入框
  useEffect(() => {
    if (editingItemId !== null && editInputRef.current) {
      editInputRef.current.focus();
      editInputRef.current.select();
    }
  }, [editingItemId]);

  // Logo点击处理
  const handleLogoClick = () => {
    if (collapsed) {
      onToggleCollapse();
    } else {
      navigate('/');
    }
  };

  // 处理 hover 进入，立即设置 hoveredItem
  const handleMouseEnter = (item, refElement) => {
    // 清除任何待处理的 timeout
    if (hoverTimeoutRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(hoverTimeoutRef.current);
      hoverTimeoutRef.current = null;
    }
    setHoveredItem(item);
    if (item === 'logo') {
      setLogoHovered(true);
    }
    if (refElement) {
      updateTooltipPosition(refElement);
    }
  };

  // 处理 hover 离开，延迟清除 hoveredItem
  const handleMouseLeave = () => {
    // 设置一个短暂的延迟（50ms），如果在此期间进入另一个项目，则取消清除
    hoverTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setHoveredItem(null);
      setLogoHovered(false);
      hoverTimeoutRef.current = null;
    }, 50);
  };

  // 清理 timeout
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (hoverTimeoutRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(hoverTimeoutRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, []);

  // 格式化时间
  const formatDate = (dateString) => {
    const date = new Date(dateString);
    const now = new Date();
    const diffMs = now - date;
    const diffMins = Math.floor(diffMs / 60000);
    const diffHours = Math.floor(diffMs / 3600000);
    const diffDays = Math.floor(diffMs / 86400000);

    if (diffMins < 1) return '刚刚';
    if (diffMins < 60) return `${diffMins}分钟前`;
    if (diffHours < 24) return `${diffHours}小时前`;
    if (diffDays < 7) return `${diffDays}天前`;
    return date.toLocaleDateString('zh-CN');
  };

  // 打开历史项菜单
  const handleOpenHistoryMenu = (e, itemId) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const buttonRef = historyMenuButtonRefs.current[itemId];
    if (buttonRef) {
      const rect = buttonRef.getBoundingClientRect();
      setHistoryMenuPosition({
        top: rect.top,
        left: rect.left - 160 // 菜单宽度约160px，显示在按钮左侧
      });
      setOpenHistoryMenuId(itemId);
    }
  };

  // 处理菜单操作
  const handleHistoryMenuAction = (action, itemId) => {
    setOpenHistoryMenuId(null);

    switch (action) {
      case 'rename':
        // 进入重命名模式
        const item = historyItems.find(h => h.id === itemId);
        if (item) {
          const currentTitle = item.title || item.query || '未命名';
          setEditingItemId(itemId);
          setEditingValue(currentTitle);
          setOriginalValue(currentTitle);
        }
        break;
      case 'delete':
        // 显示自定义删除确认弹窗
        setDeleteTargetId(itemId);
        setShowDeleteConfirm(true);
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
  };

  // 处理重命名提交
  const handleRenameSubmit = (itemId) => {
    const newTitle = editingValue.trim();

    // 只有当标题非空且与原始值不同时才提交
    if (newTitle && newTitle !== '' && newTitle !== originalValue) {
      // 调用重命名回调
      if (onRenameItem) {
        onRenameItem(itemId, newTitle);
      }
    }

    // 清除编辑状态
    setEditingItemId(null);
    setEditingValue('');
    setOriginalValue('');
  };

  // 处理重命名取消
  const handleRenameCancel = () => {
    setEditingItemId(null);
    setEditingValue('');
    setOriginalValue('');
  };

  // 确认删除
  const handleConfirmDelete = () => {
    if (deleteTargetId !== null && onDeleteItem) {
      onDeleteItem(deleteTargetId);
    }
    setShowDeleteConfirm(false);
    setDeleteTargetId(null);
  };

  // 取消删除
  const handleCancelDelete = () => {
    setShowDeleteConfirm(false);
    setDeleteTargetId(null);
  };

  // 判断当前页面
  const isSearchPage = location.pathname === '/search-results';
  const isAdvancedSearchPage = location.pathname === '/advanced-search';

  // 处理导航点击（移动端自动关闭侧边栏）
  const handleNavClick = (path) => {
    navigate(path);
    if (isMobile) {
      closeMobileSidebar();
    }
  };

  // 处理历史项点击（移动端自动关闭侧边栏）
  const handleHistoryItemClick = (itemId) => {
    if (onSelectItem) {
      onSelectItem(itemId);
    }
    if (isMobile) {
      closeMobileSidebar();
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      {/* 移动端遮罩层 */}
      {isMobile && isMobileOpen && (
        <div 
          className="mobile-sidebar-overlay"
          onClick={closeMobileSidebar}
        />
      )}

      <div className={`app-sidebar ${collapsed && !isMobile ? 'collapsed' : ''} ${isMobile ? 'mobile' : ''} ${isMobileOpen ? 'mobile-open' : ''}`}>
      {/* 顶部Logo区域 */}
      <div className="app-sidebar-header">
        <div className="sidebar-header-top">
          <div
            ref={logoRef}
            className={`sidebar-logo ${collapsed ? 'collapsed-logo' : ''}`}
            onClick={handleLogoClick}
            onMouseEnter={() => {
              if (collapsed && !isMobile) {
                handleMouseEnter('logo', logoRef.current);
              }
            }}
            onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
            style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}
          >
            {collapsed && !isMobile && hoveredItem ? (
              // 收起状态且hover任何项时显示展开图标（仅桌面端）
              <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                <path d="M6.83496 3.99992C6.38353 4.00411 6.01421 4.0122 5.69824 4.03801C5.31232 4.06954 5.03904 4.12266 4.82227 4.20012L4.62207 4.28606C4.18264 4.50996 3.81498 4.85035 3.55859 5.26848L3.45605 5.45207C3.33013 5.69922 3.25006 6.01354 3.20801 6.52824C3.16533 7.05065 3.16504 7.71885 3.16504 8.66301V11.3271C3.16504 12.2712 3.16533 12.9394 3.20801 13.4618C3.25006 13.9766 3.33013 14.2909 3.45605 14.538L3.55859 14.7216C3.81498 15.1397 4.18266 15.4801 4.62207 15.704L4.82227 15.79C5.03904 15.8674 5.31234 15.9205 5.69824 15.9521C6.01398 15.9779 6.383 15.986 6.83398 15.9902L6.83496 3.99992ZM18.165 11.3271C18.165 12.2493 18.1653 12.9811 18.1172 13.5702C18.0745 14.0924 17.9916 14.5472 17.8125 14.9648L17.7295 15.1415C17.394 15.8 16.8834 16.3511 16.2568 16.7353L15.9814 16.8896C15.5157 17.1268 15.0069 17.2285 14.4102 17.2773C13.821 17.3254 13.0893 17.3251 12.167 17.3251H7.83301C6.91071 17.3251 6.17898 17.3254 5.58984 17.2773C5.06757 17.2346 4.61294 17.1508 4.19531 16.9716L4.01855 16.8896C3.36014 16.5541 2.80898 16.0434 2.4248 15.4169L2.27051 15.1415C2.03328 14.6758 1.93158 14.167 1.88281 13.5702C1.83468 12.9811 1.83496 12.2493 1.83496 11.3271V8.66301C1.83496 7.74072 1.83468 7.00898 1.88281 6.41985C1.93157 5.82309 2.03329 5.31432 2.27051 4.84856L2.4248 4.57317C2.80898 3.94666 3.36012 3.436 4.01855 3.10051L4.19531 3.0175C4.61285 2.83843 5.06771 2.75548 5.58984 2.71281C6.17898 2.66468 6.91071 2.66496 7.83301 2.66496H12.167C13.0893 2.66496 13.821 2.66468 14.4102 2.71281C15.0069 2.76157 15.5157 2.86329 15.9814 3.10051L16.2568 3.25481C16.8833 3.63898 17.394 4.19012 17.7295 4.84856L17.8125 5.02531C17.9916 5.44285 18.0745 5.89771 18.1172 6.41985C18.1653 7.00898 18.165 7.74072 18.165 8.66301V11.3271ZM8.16406 15.995H12.167C13.1112 15.995 13.7794 12.9394 16.835 12.2712 16.835 11.3271V8.66301C16.835 7.71885 16.8347 7.05065 16.792 6.52824C16.7605 6.14232 16.7073 5.86904 16.6299 5.65227L16.5439 5.45207C16.32 5.01264 15.9796 4.64498 15.5615 4.3886L15.3779 4.28606C15.1308 4.16013 14.8165 4.08006 14.3018 4.03801C13.7794 3.99533 13.1112 3.99504 12.167 3.99504H8.16406C8.16407 3.99667 8.16504 3.99829 8.16504 3.99992L8.16406 15.995Z"></path>
              </svg>
            ) : (
              // 始终显示18x18的icon.png,无论展开还是收起
              <img src="/logo.png" alt="Scholay" style={{ width: '18px', height: '18px', objectFit: 'contain' }} />
            )}
          </div>

          {/* 移动端关闭按钮 - 放在右侧 */}
          {isMobile && (
            <button
              className="mobile-sidebar-close"
              onClick={closeMobileSidebar}
              aria-label="关闭菜单"
            >
              <X size={22} />
            </button>
          )}

          {/* 收起按钮 - 展开状态显示（仅桌面端） */}
          {!isMobile && (
          <button
            className={`sidebar-collapse-btn ${collapsed ? 'hidden' : ''}`}
            onClick={onToggleCollapse}
            title="收起侧边栏"
            style={{ pointerEvents: collapsed ? 'none' : 'auto' }}
          >
            <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
              <path d="M6.83496 3.99992C6.38353 4.00411 6.01421 4.0122 5.69824 4.03801C5.31232 4.06954 5.03904 4.12266 4.82227 4.20012L4.62207 4.28606C4.18264 4.50996 3.81498 4.85035 3.55859 3.99992ZM18.165 11.3271C18.165 12.2493 18.1653 12.9811 18.1172 13.5702C18.0745 14.0924 17.9916 14.5472 17.8125 14.9648L17.7295 15.1415C17.394 15.8 16.8834 16.3511 16.2568 16.7353L15.9814 16.8896C15.5157 17.1268 15.0069 17.2285 14.4102 17.2773C13.821 17.3254 13.0893 17.3251 12.167 17.3251H7.83301C6.91071 17.3251 6.17898 17.3254 5.58984 17.2773C5.06757 17.2346 4.61294 17.1508 4.19531 16.9716L4.01855 16.8896C3.36014 16.5541 2.80898 16.0434 2.4248 15.4169L2.27051 15.1415C2.03328 14.6758 1.93158 14.167 1.88281 13.5702C1.83468 12.9811 1.83496 12.2493 1.83496 11.3271V8.66301C1.83496 7.74072 1.83468 7.00898 1.88281 6.41985C1.93157 5.82309 2.03329 5.31432 2.27051 4.84856L2.4248 4.57317C2.80898 3.94666 3.36012 3.436 4.01855 3.10051L4.19531 3.0175C4.61285 2.83843 5.06771 2.75548 5.58984 2.71281C6.17898 2.66468 6.91071 2.66496 7.83301 2.66496H12.167C13.0893 2.66496 13.821 2.66468 14.4102 2.71281C15.0069 2.76157 15.5157 2.86329 15.9814 3.10051L16.2568 3.25481C16.8833 3.63898 17.394 4.19012 17.7295 4.84856L17.8125 5.02531C17.9916 5.44285 18.0745 5.89771 18.1172 6.41985C18.1653 7.00898 18.165 7.74072 18.165 8.66301V11.3271ZM8.16406 15.995H12.167C13.1112 15.995 13.7794 15.9947 14.3018 15.9521C14.8164 15.91 15.1308 15.8299 15.3779 15.704L15.5615 15.6015C15.9797 15.3451 16.32 14.9774 16.5439 14.538L16.6299 14.3378C16.7074 14.121 16.7605 13.8478 16.792 13.4618C16.8347 12.9394 16.835 12.2712 16.835 11.3271V8.66301C16.835 7.71885 16.8347 7.05065 16.792 6.52824C16.7605 6.14232 16.7073 5.86904 16.6299 5.65227L16.5439 5.45207C16.32 5.01264 15.9796 4.64498 15.5615 4.3886L15.3779 4.28606C15.1308 4.16013 14.8165 4.08006 14.3018 4.03801C13.7794 3.99533 13.1112 3.99504 12.167 3.99504H8.16406C8.16407 3.99667 8.16504 3.99829 8.16504 3.99992L8.16406 15.995Z"></path>
            </svg>
          </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 功能导航 - 始终显示 */}
      <div className="sidebar-section navigation-section">
        <div className="navigation-items">
          <button
            ref={(el) => (navItemRefs.current['normal-search'] = el)}
            className={`nav-item ${isSearchPage ? 'active' : ''}`}
            onClick={() => handleNavClick('/search-results?query=')}
            onMouseEnter={() => {
              if (collapsed && !isMobile) {
                handleMouseEnter('normal-search', navItemRefs.current['normal-search']);
              }
            }}
            onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
          >
            <NormalSearchIcon size={20} />
            <span>学术检索</span>
          </button>

          <button
            ref={(el) => (navItemRefs.current['advanced-search'] = el)}
            className={`nav-item ${isAdvancedSearchPage ? 'active' : ''}`}
            onClick={() => handleNavClick('/advanced-search')}
            onMouseEnter={() => {
              if (collapsed && !isMobile) {
                handleMouseEnter('advanced-search', navItemRefs.current['advanced-search']);
              }
            }}
            onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
          >
            <AdvancedSearchIcon size={20} />
            <span>智能分析</span>
          </button>

          {/* 文献助手 - 点击进入选择页面 */}
          <button
            ref={(el) => (navItemRefs.current['assistant'] = el)}
            className={`nav-item ${(location.pathname === '/assistant' || location.pathname === '/chat' || location.pathname === '/peer-review') ? 'active' : ''}`}
            onClick={() => handleNavClick('/assistant')}
            onMouseEnter={() => {
              if (collapsed && !isMobile) {
                handleMouseEnter('assistant', navItemRefs.current['assistant']);
              }
            }}
            onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
          >
            <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <path d="M14.7 6.3a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.4l1.6 1.6a1 1 0 0 0 1.4 0l3.77-3.77a6 6 0 0 1-7.94 7.94l-6.91 6.91a2.12 2.12 0 0 1-3-3l6.91-6.91a6 6 0 0 1 7.94-7.94l-3.76 3.76z"/>
            </svg>
            <span>文献助手</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 侧边栏内容区域 - 历史记录部分 */}
      {(!collapsed || isMobile) && (
        <div className="app-sidebar-content">

          {/* 第二部分: 历史记录 (仅在搜索页面显示) */}
          {showHistory && (
            <div className="sidebar-section history-section">
              {/* 可折叠的分区标题 */}
              <button
                className="history-toggle"
                onClick={() => setHistoryExpanded(!historyExpanded)}
              >
                <span className="history-title">记录</span>
                <svg
                  width="12"
                  height="12"
                  viewBox="0 0 12 12"
                  fill="none"
                  className={`toggle-icon ${historyExpanded ? 'expanded' : ''}`}
                >
                  <path d="M3 4.5L6 7.5L9 4.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"/>
                </svg>
              </button>

              {/* 历史记录列表 - 根据展开状态显示 */}
              {historyExpanded && (
                <div className="history-list">
                  {historyLoading ? (
                    <div className="history-loading">加载中...</div>
                  ) : historyItems.length > 0 ? (
                    historyItems.map((item) => (
                      <div
                        key={item.id}
                        className={`history-item ${!disableActiveState && currentItemId === item.id ? 'active' : ''} ${openHistoryMenuId === item.id ? 'menu-open' : ''}`}
                        onClick={() => handleHistoryItemClick(item.id)}
                      >
                        <div className="history-item-main">
                          {editingItemId === item.id ? (
                            // 编辑模式：显示输入框
                            <input
                              ref={editInputRef}
                              type="text"
                              className="history-item-edit-input"
                              value={editingValue}
                              onChange={(e) => setEditingValue(e.target.value)}
                              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                                if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                                  handleRenameSubmit(item.id);
                                } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                                  handleRenameCancel();
                                }
                              }}
                              onBlur={() => handleRenameSubmit(item.id)}
                              onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                            />
                          ) : (
                            // 正常模式：显示标题
                            <div className="history-item-title">
                              {item.title || item.query || '未命名'}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>

                        {onDeleteItem && editingItemId !== item.id && (
                          <button
                            ref={(el) => (historyMenuButtonRefs.current[item.id] = el)}
                            className="btn-history-menu"
                            onClick={(e) => handleOpenHistoryMenu(e, item.id)}
                            title="更多操作"
                          >
                            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                              <path d="M15.498 8.50159C16.3254 8.50159 16.9959 9.17228 16.9961 9.99963C16.9961 10.8271 16.3256 11.4987 15.498 11.4987C14.6705 11.4987 14 10.8271 14 9.99963C14.0002 9.17228 14.6706 8.50159 15.498 8.50159Z"></path>
                              <path d="M4.49805 8.50159C5.32544 8.50159 5.99689 9.17228 5.99707 9.99963C5.99707 10.8271 5.32555 11.4987 4.49805 11.4987C3.67069 11.4985 3 10.827 3 9.99963C3.00018 9.17239 3.6708 8.50176 4.49805 8.50159Z"></path>
                              <path d="M10.0003 8.50159C10.8276 8.50176 11.4982 9.17239 11.4984 9.99963C11.4984 10.827 10.8277 11.4985 10.0003 11.4987C9.17283 11.4987 8.50131 10.8271 8.50131 9.99963C8.50149 9.17228 9.17294 8.50159 10.0003 8.50159Z"></path>
                            </svg>
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    ))
                  ) : null}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* 保留原有的children,以便向后兼容 */}
          {children}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 底部用户信息区域 */}
      <div className="sidebar-user-section sidebar-footer">
        {isAuthenticated ? (
          // 已登录：显示用户头像
          <div
            ref={avatarRef}
            className="sidebar-user-info"
            onClick={() => setShowUserMenu(!showUserMenu)}
            onMouseEnter={() => {
              if (collapsed) {
                handleMouseEnter('user', avatarRef.current);
              }
            }}
            onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
          >
            <div className="user-avatar">
              {getUserInitial()}
            </div>
            {!collapsed && (
              <div className="user-email-wrapper">
                <span className="user-email" title={getUserIdentifier()}>{getUserIdentifier()}</span>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          // 未登录：显示登录按钮
          <button
            className="sidebar-login-btn"
            onClick={() => {
              // 如果提供了显示登录弹窗的回调，使用它；否则导航到首页
              if (onShowLogin) {
                onShowLogin();
              } else {
                navigate('/');
              }
            }}
            onMouseEnter={() => {
              if (collapsed) {
                handleMouseEnter('login', avatarRef.current);
              }
            }}
            onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
          >
            <svg className="login-icon" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
              <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M10 9a3 3 0 100-6 3 3 0 000 6zm-7 9a7 7 0 1114 0H3z" clipRule="evenodd" />
            </svg>
            {!collapsed && <span className="login-text">登录</span>}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* 用户菜单弹窗 - 使用Portal渲染到body，向上弹出 */}
      {showUserMenu && isAuthenticated && ReactDOM.createPortal(
        <div
          ref={userMenuRef}
          className={`user-menu-popup ${collapsed ? 'collapsed-menu' : ''}`}
          style={{
            position: 'fixed',
            bottom: `${menuPosition.bottom}px`,
            left: `${menuPosition.left}px`,
            zIndex: 10000
          }}
        >
              <div className={`user-menu-header ${subscription && subscription.plan_code === 'pro' ? 'premium-pro' : ''} ${subscription && subscription.plan_code === 'max' ? 'premium-max' : ''}`}>
                <div className="user-avatar-large">
                  {getUserInitial()}
                </div>
                <div className="user-info-text">
                  <div className="user-name">{user?.username || user?.email?.split('@')[0] || '用户'}</div>
                  <div className="user-email-small" title={getUserIdentifier()}>{getUserIdentifier()}</div>
                </div>
                {subscription && (
                  <div className="user-subscription-badge">
                    <span className={`subscription-plan-badge ${subscription.plan_code}`}>
                      {subscription.plan_name}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="user-menu-divider"></div>

              <div className="user-menu-options">
                <button
                  className="user-menu-item"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setShowUserMenu(false);
                    navigate('/settings');
                  }}
                >
                  <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                    <path d="M20 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H8a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/>
                    <circle cx="12" cy="7" r="4"/>
                  </svg>
                  <span>个人资料</span>
                </button>

                <button
                  className="user-menu-item"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setShowUserMenu(false);
                    navigate('/settings?tab=subscription');
                  }}
                >
                  <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                    <rect x="3" y="8" width="18" height="12" rx="2" ry="2"/>
                    <path d="M3 8v-2a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"/>
                    <line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12.01" y2="16"/>
                  </svg>
                  <span>管理订阅</span>
                </button>

                <button
                  className="user-menu-item"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setShowUserMenu(false);
                    navigate('/settings?tab=invitation');
                  }}
                >
                  <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                    <path d="M17 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H5a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/>
                    <circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"/>
                    <path d="M23 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87"/>
                    <path d="M16 3.13a4 4 0 0 1 0 7.75"/>
                  </svg>
                  <span>邀请推广</span>
                </button>

                <button
                  className="user-menu-item"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setShowUserMenu(false);
                    navigate('/settings?tab=account');
                  }}
                >
                  <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                    <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/>
                    <path d="M12 1v6m0 6v6M5.64 5.64l4.24 4.24m4.24 4.24l4.24 4.24M1 12h6m6 0h6M5.64 18.36l4.24-4.24m4.24-4.24l4.24-4.24"/>
                  </svg>
                  <span>账户管理</span>
                </button>

                <div className="user-menu-divider"></div>

                {/* 底部操作区域：主题切换 + 退出登录 */}
                <div className="user-menu-bottom-actions">
                  <div className="user-menu-theme-toggle-wrapper">
                    <ThemeToggle />
                  </div>
                  
                  <button
                    className="user-menu-bottom-btn logout-btn"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setShowUserMenu(false);
                      if (onLogout) {
                        onLogout();
                      }
                      // 跳转回首页
                      navigate('/');
                    }}
                  >
                    <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                      <path d="M9 21H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4"/>
                      <polyline points="16 17 21 12 16 7"/>
                      <line x1="21" y1="12" x2="9" y2="12"/>
                    </svg>
                    <span>退出</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
        </div>,
        document.body
      )}

      {/* Tooltip Portal - 渲染到body，确保在最上层 */}
      {collapsed && hoveredItem && ReactDOM.createPortal(
        <div
          className="sidebar-tooltip-portal"
          style={{
            position: 'fixed',
            top: `${tooltipPosition.top}px`,
            left: `${tooltipPosition.left}px`,
            transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
            background: '#000000',
            color: '#FFFFFF',
            padding: '8px 12px',
            borderRadius: '8px',
            fontSize: '13px',
            fontWeight: 500,
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            pointerEvents: 'none',
            zIndex: 99999,
            boxShadow: 'none',
            animation: 'tooltipFadeIn 0.15s ease',
            border: 'none'
          }}
        >
          {hoveredItem === 'logo' && '展开侧边栏'}
          {hoveredItem === 'normal-search' && '学术检索'}
          {hoveredItem === 'advanced-search' && '智能分析'}
          {hoveredItem === 'assistant' && '文献助手'}
          {hoveredItem === 'user' && (user?.username || user?.email?.split('@')[0] || '用户')}
        </div>,
        document.body
      )}

      {/* 历史记录菜单弹窗 - 使用Portal渲染到body */}
      {openHistoryMenuId !== null && ReactDOM.createPortal(
        <div
          ref={historyMenuRef}
          className="history-menu-popup"
          style={{
            position: 'fixed',
            top: `${historyMenuPosition.top}px`,
            left: `${historyMenuPosition.left}px`,
            zIndex: 10000
          }}
        >
          <button
            className="history-menu-item"
            onClick={() => handleHistoryMenuAction('rename', openHistoryMenuId)}
          >
            <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
              <path d="M17 3a2.828 2.828 0 1 1 4 4L7.5 20.5 2 22l1.5-5.5L17 3z"/>
            </svg>
            <span>重命名</span>
          </button>

          <div className="history-menu-divider"></div>

          <button
            className="history-menu-item delete-item"
            onClick={() => handleHistoryMenuAction('delete', openHistoryMenuId)}
          >
            <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
              <polyline points="3 6 5 6 21 6"/>
              <path d="M19 6v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6m3 0V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"/>
            </svg>
            <span>删除</span>
          </button>
        </div>,
        document.body
      )}

      {/* 自定义删除确认弹窗 */}
      {showDeleteConfirm && ReactDOM.createPortal(
        <div className="delete-confirm-overlay" onClick={handleCancelDelete}>
          <div className="delete-confirm-dialog" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div className="delete-confirm-icon">
              <svg width="48" height="48" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                <path d="M10.29 3.86L1.82 18a2 2 0 0 0 1.71 3h16.94a2 2 0 0 0 1.71-3L13.71 3.86a2 2 0 0 0-3.42 0z"/>
                <line x1="12" y1="9" x2="12" y2="13"/>
                <line x1="12" y1="17" x2="12.01" y2="17"/>
              </svg>
            </div>
            <h3 className="delete-confirm-title">
              {historyType === 'conversation' ? '删除对话' : '删除搜索记录'}
            </h3>
            <p className="delete-confirm-message">
              {historyType === 'conversation'
                ? '确定要删除这个对话吗？此操作将永久删除该对话及其所有消息，无法恢复。'
                : '确定要删除这条搜索记录吗？此操作将永久删除该记录，无法恢复。'}
            </p>
            <div className="delete-confirm-actions">
              <button className="btn-cancel" onClick={handleCancelDelete}>
                取消
              </button>
              <button className="btn-confirm-delete" onClick={handleConfirmDelete}>
                删除
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>,
        document.body
      )}
    </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default AppSidebar;

// ========== 文件: frontend-user/src/components/AuthModal.js ==========
/**

 * Scholay学术 V1.0
