import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../utils/AuthContext';
import { userAPI } from '../services/api';
import TurnstileCaptcha from './TurnstileCaptcha';
import { useToast } from './ToastContainer';
import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown';
import remarkGfm from 'remark-gfm';
import './styles/auth-modal/index.css';

const AuthModal = ({ isOpen, onClose, onLoginSuccess }) => {
  const { login } = useAuth();
  const { showError, showSuccess } = useToast();
  const [mode, setMode] = useState('welcome'); // 'welcome', 'login', 'register', 'phone-welcome', 'phone-login', 'phone-register', 'forgot-password-email', 'forgot-password-phone'
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState('');
  const [code, setCode] = useState('');
  const [turnstileToken, setTurnstileToken] = useState('');
  const [agreedToPolicy, setAgreedToPolicy] = useState(false);
  const [useCodeLogin, setUseCodeLogin] = useState(false); // Toggle between password and code login

  // Refs for captcha components
  const emailCaptchaRef = useRef(null);
  const phoneCaptchaRef = useRef(null);

  // 每次打开弹窗时重置条款同意状态
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setAgreedToPolicy(false);
    }
  }, [isOpen]);
  const [showPolicy, setShowPolicy] = useState(false);
  const [policyType, setPolicyType] = useState('privacy'); // 'privacy' or 'terms'
  const [privacyContent, setPrivacyContent] = useState('');
  const [termsContent, setTermsContent] = useState('');
  const [countdown, setCountdown] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [passwordError, setPasswordError] = useState('');
  const [requireEmailVerification, setRequireEmailVerification] = useState(true);
  const [enableTurnstile, setEnableTurnstile] = useState(false);
  const [enableGithubOAuth, setEnableGithubOAuth] = useState(false);
  const [invitationCode, setInvitationCode] = useState('');
  const [inviterInfo, setInviterInfo] = useState(null);
  const [isComposing, setIsComposing] = useState(false); // 跟踪输入法状态

  // 读取URL中的邀请码参数
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const inviteParam = urlParams.get('invite');
      if (inviteParam) {
        setInvitationCode(inviteParam);
        // 可以在这里调用API验证邀请码并获取邀请人信息
        // 暂时不验证,直接使用
      }
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  // 获取隐私协议、用户协议和系统配置
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      // 获取隐私协议
      fetch('/api/v1/config/privacy-policy')
        .then(res => res.json())
        .then(data => {
          if (data.code === 0 && data.data) {
            setPrivacyContent(data.data.content);
          }
        })
        .catch(() => {
          setPrivacyContent('隐私协议加载失败');
        });

      // 获取用户协议
      fetch('/api/v1/config/terms-of-service')
        .then(res => res.json())
        .then(data => {
          if (data.code === 0 && data.data) {
            setTermsContent(data.data.content);
          }
        })
        .catch(() => {
          setTermsContent('用户协议加载失败');
        });

      // 获取系统配置
      fetch('/api/v1/config/system')
        .then(res => res.json())
        .then(data => {
          if (data.code === 0 && data.data) {
            setRequireEmailVerification(data.data.require_email_verification ?? true);
            const turnstileEnabled = data.data.enable_turnstile ?? false;
            setEnableTurnstile(turnstileEnabled);
            // GitHub login is available if client_id is configured
            setEnableGithubOAuth(!!(data.data.github_client_id && data.data.github_client_id.trim() !== ''));
            // If Turnstile is disabled, set a placeholder token to allow form submission
            if (!turnstileEnabled) {
              setTurnstileToken('disabled');
            }
          }
        })
        .catch(() => {
          setRequireEmailVerification(true);
          setEnableTurnstile(false);
          setEnableGithubOAuth(false);
          // On error, assume Turnstile is disabled and set placeholder token
          setTurnstileToken('disabled');
        });
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  // 倒计时
  useEffect(() => {
    if (countdown > 0) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => setCountdown(countdown - 1), 1000);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [countdown]);

  // 验证确认密码
  const validateConfirmPassword = () => {
    if (confirmPassword && password !== confirmPassword) {
      setPasswordError('两次输入的密码不一致');
    } else {
      setPasswordError('');
    }
  };

  // 重置状态
  const resetState = () => {
    setMode('welcome');
    setEmail('');
    setPhone('');
    setPassword('');
    setConfirmPassword('');
    setCode('');
    setTurnstileToken('');
    setAgreedToPolicy(false);
    setPasswordError('');
    setInvitationCode('');
    setInviterInfo(null);
    setUseCodeLogin(false);
  };

  // 清空输入框内容（切换登录方式时使用）
  const clearInputs = () => {
    setPassword('');
    setConfirmPassword('');
    setCode('');
    setPasswordError('');
    setCountdown(0);
    if (emailCaptchaRef.current) {
      emailCaptchaRef.current.reset();
    }
    if (phoneCaptchaRef.current) {
      phoneCaptchaRef.current.reset();
    }
  };

  // 关闭弹窗
  const handleClose = () => {
    resetState();
    onClose();
  };

  // 检查邮箱并进入下一步
  const handleEmailContinue = async () => {
    if (!email || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) {
      showError('请输入有效的邮箱地址');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    

    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/v1/user/check-email', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email }),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (data.code === 0) {
        // 根据邮箱是否存在决定是登录还是注册
        setMode(data.data.exists ? 'login' : 'register');
      } else {
        showError(data.message || '检查邮箱失败');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showError('网络错误，请稍后重试');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // 发送验证码
  const handleSendCode = async (purpose = 'register') => {
    if (countdown > 0) return;

    setLoading(true);


    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/v1/user/send-code', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email, purpose }),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (data.code === 0) {
        setCountdown(60);
        showSuccess('验证码已发送');
      } else {
        showError(data.message || '发送验证码失败');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showError('网络错误，请稍后重试');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // 登录
  const handleLogin = async () => {
    if (!password) {
      showError('请输入密码');
      return;
    }

    // Only check Turnstile token if Turnstile is enabled
    if (enableTurnstile && !turnstileToken) {
      showError('请完成人机验证');
      return;
    }

    if (!agreedToPolicy) {
      showError('请阅读并同意使用条款和隐私政策');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);


    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/v1/user/login', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email, password, turnstile_token: turnstileToken }),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (data.code === 0) {
        login(data.data.token, data.data.user);
        if (onLoginSuccess) onLoginSuccess(data.data.user);
        handleClose();
      } else {
        showError(data.message || '登录失败');
        // Reset captcha state to allow re-verification
        setTurnstileToken('');
        if (emailCaptchaRef.current) {
          emailCaptchaRef.current.reset();
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showError('网络错误，请稍后重试');
      // Reset captcha state to allow re-verification
      setTurnstileToken('');
      if (emailCaptchaRef.current) {
        emailCaptchaRef.current.reset();
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // 注册
  const handleRegister = async () => {
    if (!password || password.length < 8) {
      showError('密码长度至少8位');
      return;
    }

    if (password !== confirmPassword) {
      showError('两次输入的密码不一致');
      return;
    }

    if (requireEmailVerification && !code) {
      showError('请输入验证码');
      return;
    }

    // Only check Turnstile token if Turnstile is enabled
    if (enableTurnstile && !turnstileToken) {
      showError('请完成人机验证');
      return;
    }

    if (!agreedToPolicy) {
      showError('请阅读并同意使用条款和隐私政策');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);


    try {
      const requestBody = {
        email,
        password,
        code,
        turnstile_token: turnstileToken
      };

      // 如果有邀请码，添加到请求中
      if (invitationCode) {
        requestBody.invitation_code = invitationCode;
      }

      const response = await fetch('/api/v1/user/register', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(requestBody),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (data.code === 0) {
        login(data.data.token, data.data.user);
        if (onLoginSuccess) onLoginSuccess(data.data.user);
        handleClose();
      } else {
        showError(data.message || '注册失败');
        // Reset verification state but keep password and countdown
        setCode('');
        setTurnstileToken('');
        // Reset turnstile captcha to allow re-verification
        if (emailCaptchaRef.current) {
          emailCaptchaRef.current.reset();
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showError('网络错误,请稍后重试');
      // Reset verification state but keep password and countdown
      setCode('');
      setTurnstileToken('');
      // Reset turnstile captcha to allow re-verification
      if (emailCaptchaRef.current) {
        emailCaptchaRef.current.reset();
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // 检查手机号并进入下一步
  const handlePhoneContinue = async () => {
    if (!phone || !/^1[3-9]\d{9}$/.test(phone)) {
      showError('请输入有效的手机号码');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    

    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/v1/user/check-phone', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ phone }),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (data.code === 0) {
        // 根据手机号是否存在决定是登录还是注册
        setMode(data.data.exists ? 'phone-login' : 'phone-register');
      } else {
        showError(data.message || '检查手机号失败');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showError('网络错误,请稍后重试');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // 发送手机验证码
  const handleSendPhoneCode = async (purpose) => {
    if (countdown > 0) return;

    setLoading(true);
    

    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/v1/user/send-phone-code', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ phone, purpose }),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (data.code === 0) {
        setCountdown(60);
        
      } else {
        showError(data.message || '发送验证码失败');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showError('网络错误,请稍后重试');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // 手机号登录
  const handlePhoneLogin = async () => {
    if (!password) {
      showError('请输入密码');
      return;
    }

    // Only check Turnstile token if Turnstile is enabled
    if (enableTurnstile && !turnstileToken) {
      showError('请完成人机验证');
      return;
    }

    if (!agreedToPolicy) {
      showError('请阅读并同意使用条款和隐私政策');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);


    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/v1/user/login-phone', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ phone, password }),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (data.code === 0) {
        login(data.data.token, data.data.user);
        if (onLoginSuccess) onLoginSuccess(data.data.user);
        handleClose();
      } else {
        showError(data.message || '登录失败');
        // Reset captcha state to allow re-verification
        setTurnstileToken('');
        if (phoneCaptchaRef.current) {
          phoneCaptchaRef.current.reset();
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showError('网络错误,请稍后重试');
      // Reset captcha state to allow re-verification
      setTurnstileToken('');
      if (phoneCaptchaRef.current) {
        phoneCaptchaRef.current.reset();
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // 手机号注册
  const handlePhoneRegister = async () => {
    if (!password || password.length < 8) {
      showError('密码长度至少8位');
      return;
    }

    if (password !== confirmPassword) {
      showError('两次输入的密码不一致');
      return;
    }

    if (!code) {
      showError('请输入验证码');
      return;
    }

    // Only check Turnstile token if Turnstile is enabled
    if (enableTurnstile && !turnstileToken) {
      showError('请完成人机验证');
      return;
    }

    if (!agreedToPolicy) {
      showError('请阅读并同意使用条款和隐私政策');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);


    try {
      const requestBody = {
        phone,
        password,
        code
      };

      // 如果有邀请码，添加到请求中
      if (invitationCode) {
        requestBody.invitation_code = invitationCode;
      }

      const response = await fetch('/api/v1/user/register-phone', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(requestBody),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (data.code === 0) {
        login(data.data.token, data.data.user);
        if (onLoginSuccess) onLoginSuccess(data.data.user);
        handleClose();
      } else {
        showError(data.message || '注册失败');
        // Reset verification state but keep password and countdown
        setCode('');
        setTurnstileToken('');
        // Reset turnstile captcha to allow re-verification
        if (phoneCaptchaRef.current) {
          phoneCaptchaRef.current.reset();
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showError('网络错误,请稍后重试');
      // Reset verification state but keep password and countdown
      setCode('');
      setTurnstileToken('');
      // Reset turnstile captcha to allow re-verification
      if (phoneCaptchaRef.current) {
        phoneCaptchaRef.current.reset();
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // 邮箱重置密码
  const handleResetPassword = async () => {
    if (!code) {
      showError('请输入验证码');
      return;
    }

    if (!password || password.length < 8) {
      showError('密码长度至少8位');
      return;
    }

    if (password !== confirmPassword) {
      showError('两次输入的密码不一致');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/v1/user/reset-password', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email, code, new_password: password }),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (data.code === 0) {
        showSuccess('密码重置成功');
        setMode('login');
        setPassword('');
        setConfirmPassword('');
        setCode('');
      } else {
        showError(data.message || '重置密码失败');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showError('网络错误，请稍后重试');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // 手机号重置密码
  const handleResetPasswordPhone = async () => {
    if (!code) {
      showError('请输入验证码');
      return;
    }

    if (!password || password.length < 8) {
      showError('密码长度至少8位');
      return;
    }

    if (password !== confirmPassword) {
      showError('两次输入的密码不一致');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/v1/user/reset-password-phone', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ phone, code, new_password: password }),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (data.code === 0) {
        showSuccess('密码重置成功');
        setMode('phone-login');
        setPassword('');
        setConfirmPassword('');
        setCode('');
      } else {
        showError(data.message || '重置密码失败');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showError('网络错误，请稍后重试');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // 邮箱验证码登录
  const handleLoginWithCode = async () => {
    if (!code) {
      showError('请输入验证码');
      return;
    }

    // Only check Turnstile token if Turnstile is enabled
    if (enableTurnstile && !turnstileToken) {
      showError('请完成人机验证');
      return;
    }

    if (!agreedToPolicy) {
      showError('请阅读并同意使用条款和隐私政策');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/v1/user/login-with-code', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email, code, turnstile_token: turnstileToken }),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (data.code === 0) {
        login(data.data.token, data.data.user);
        if (onLoginSuccess) onLoginSuccess(data.data.user);
        handleClose();
      } else {
        showError(data.message || '登录失败');
        setCode('');
        setTurnstileToken('');
        if (emailCaptchaRef.current) {
          emailCaptchaRef.current.reset();
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showError('网络错误，请稍后重试');
      setCode('');
      setTurnstileToken('');
      if (emailCaptchaRef.current) {
        emailCaptchaRef.current.reset();
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // 手机号验证码登录
  const handleLoginPhoneWithCode = async () => {
    if (!code) {
      showError('请输入验证码');
      return;
    }

    // Only check Turnstile token if Turnstile is enabled
    if (enableTurnstile && !turnstileToken) {
      showError('请完成人机验证');
      return;
    }

    if (!agreedToPolicy) {
      showError('请阅读并同意使用条款和隐私政策');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/v1/user/login-phone-with-code', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ phone, code, turnstile_token: turnstileToken }),
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (data.code === 0) {
        login(data.data.token, data.data.user);
        if (onLoginSuccess) onLoginSuccess(data.data.user);
        handleClose();
      } else {
        showError(data.message || '登录失败');
        setCode('');
        setTurnstileToken('');
        if (phoneCaptchaRef.current) {
          phoneCaptchaRef.current.reset();
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showError('网络错误，请稍后重试');
      setCode('');
      setTurnstileToken('');
      if (phoneCaptchaRef.current) {
        phoneCaptchaRef.current.reset();
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // 微信登录
  const handleWeChatLogin = async () => {
    try {
      // CRITICAL: Clean up any bind-related data from previous operations
      // This prevents state mismatch when different users attempt login
      // after a previous bind operation left data in localStorage
      localStorage.removeItem('wechat_bind_state');
      localStorage.removeItem('wechat_bind_mode');

      // Get WeChat login URL from backend (backend will generate state)
      const response = await userAPI.getWeChatLoginURL();

      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
        const loginURL = response.data.data.login_url;
        const state = response.data.data.state;

        // Save state for verification after callback
        localStorage.setItem('wechat_oauth_state', state);

        // Save current URL for redirect after login (whitelist check will be done in callback)
        const currentPath = window.location.pathname + window.location.search;
        if (currentPath !== '/') {
          localStorage.setItem('wechat_return_url', currentPath);
        }

        // 保存邀请码（如果有）- 用于OAuth回调后处理新用户注册
        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        const inviteParam = urlParams.get('invite');
        if (inviteParam) {
          localStorage.setItem('oauth_invitation_code', inviteParam);
        } else {
          localStorage.removeItem('oauth_invitation_code');
        }

        // Redirect to WeChat OAuth page
        window.location.href = loginURL;
      } else {
        showError(response.data.message || '获取微信登录链接失败');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('WeChat login error:', err);
      showError('微信登录失败,请稍后重试');
    }
  };

  // GitHub 登录
  const handleGithubLogin = async () => {
    try {
      // Get GitHub login URL from backend
      const response = await userAPI.getGithubLoginURL();

      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
        const loginURL = response.data.data.url;
        const state = response.data.data.state;

        // Save state for verification after callback
        localStorage.setItem('github_oauth_state', state);

        // Save current URL for redirect after login
        const currentPath = window.location.pathname + window.location.search;
        if (currentPath !== '/') {
          localStorage.setItem('github_return_url', currentPath);
        }

        // 保存邀请码（如果有）- 用于OAuth回调后处理新用户注册
        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        const inviteParam = urlParams.get('invite');
        if (inviteParam) {
          localStorage.setItem('oauth_invitation_code', inviteParam);
        } else {
          localStorage.removeItem('oauth_invitation_code');
        }

        // Redirect to GitHub OAuth page
        window.location.href = loginURL;
      } else {
        showError(response.data.message || '获取 GitHub 登录链接失败');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('GitHub login error:', err);
      showError('GitHub 登录失败，请稍后重试');
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="auth-modal-overlay">
      <div className="auth-modal-container">
        <button className="auth-modal-close" onClick={handleClose}>
          <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
            <line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"/>
            <line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"/>
          </svg>
        </button>
        <div className="auth-modal-body">
        {/* 欢迎页面 */}
        {mode === 'welcome' && (
          <div className="auth-content">
            <div className="auth-headline">
              <h1 className="auth-title">开始使用 Scholay</h1>
              <p className="auth-subtitle">邮箱或其他方式快速进入。</p>
            </div>

            <div className="auth-form">
              <div className="auth-social-buttons">
                <button className="auth-social-button" onClick={() => { clearInputs(); setMode('phone-welcome'); }}>
                  <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                    <path d="M22 16.92v3a2 2 0 0 1-2.18 2 19.79 19.79 0 0 1-8.63-3.07 19.5 19.5 0 0 1-6-6 19.79 19.79 0 0 1-3.07-8.67A2 2 0 0 1 4.11 2h3a2 2 0 0 1 2 1.72 12.84 12.84 0 0 0 .7 2.81 2 2 0 0 1-.45 2.11L8.09 9.91a16 16 0 0 0 6 6l1.27-1.27a2 2 0 0 1 2.11-.45 12.84 12.84 0 0 0 2.81.7A2 2 0 0 1 22 16.92z"/>
                  </svg>
                  <span>继续手机登录</span>
                </button>
                <button className="auth-social-button auth-wechat-button" onClick={handleWeChatLogin}>
                  <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
                    <path d="M8.691 2.188C3.891 2.188 0 5.476 0 9.53c0 2.212 1.17 4.203 3.002 5.55a.59.59 0 0 1 .213.665l-.39 1.48c-.019.07-.048.141-.048.213 0 .163.13.295.29.295a.326.326 0 0 0 .167-.054l1.903-1.114a.864.864 0 0 1 .717-.098 10.16 10.16 0 0 0 2.837.403c.276 0 .543-.027.811-.05-.857-2.578.157-4.972 1.932-6.446 1.703-1.415 3.882-1.98 5.853-1.838-0.576-3.583-4.196-6.348-8.596-6.348zM5.785 5.991c.642 0 1.162.529 1.162 1.18a1.17 1.17 0 0 1-1.162 1.178A1.17 1.17 0 0 1 4.623 7.17c0-.651.52-1.18 1.162-1.18zm5.813 0c.642 0 1.162.529 1.162 1.18a1.17 1.17 0 0 1-1.162 1.178 1.17 1.17 0 0 1-1.162-1.178c0-.651.52-1.18 1.162-1.18zm5.34 2.867c-1.797-.052-3.746.512-5.28 1.786-1.72 1.428-2.687 3.72-1.78 6.22.942 2.453 3.666 4.229 6.884 4.229.826 0 1.622-.12 2.361-.336a.722.722 0 0 1 .598.082l1.584.926a.272.272 0 0 0 .14.047c.134 0 .24-.111.24-.247 0-.06-.023-.12-.038-.177l-.327-1.233a.582.582 0 0 1-.023-.156.49.49 0 0 1 .201-.398C23.024 18.48 24 16.82 24 14.98c0-3.21-2.931-5.837-6.656-6.088V8.89c-.135-.01-.27-.027-.407-.03zm-2.53 3.274c.535 0 .969.44.969.982a.976.976 0 0 1-.969.983.976.976 0 0 1-.969-.983c0-.542.434-.982.969-.982zm4.844 0c.535 0 .969.44.969.982a.976.976 0 0 1-.969.983.976.976 0 0 1-.969-.983c0-.542.434-.982.969-.982z"/>
                  </svg>
                  <span>继续微信扫码登录</span>
                </button>
                {enableGithubOAuth && (
                  <button className="auth-social-button auth-github-button" onClick={handleGithubLogin}>
                    <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
                      <path d="M12 0c-6.626 0-12 5.373-12 12 0 5.302 3.438 9.8 8.207 11.387.599.111.793-.261.793-.577v-2.234c-3.338.726-4.033-1.416-4.033-1.416-.546-1.387-1.333-1.756-1.333-1.756-1.089-.745.083-.729.083-.729 1.205.084 1.839 1.237 1.839 1.237 1.07 1.834 2.807 1.304 3.492.997.107-.775.418-1.305.762-1.604-2.665-.305-5.467-1.334-5.467-5.931 0-1.311.469-2.381 1.236-3.221-.124-.303-.535-1.524.117-3.176 0 0 1.008-.322 3.301 1.23.957-.266 1.983-.399 3.003-.404 1.02.005 2.047.138 3.006.404 2.291-1.552 3.297-1.23 3.297-1.23.653 1.653.242 2.874.118 3.176.77.84 1.235 1.911 1.235 3.221 0 4.609-2.807 5.624-5.479 5.921.43.372.823 1.102.823 2.222v3.293c0 .319.192.694.801.576 4.765-1.589 8.199-6.086 8.199-11.386 0-6.627-5.373-12-12-12z"/>
                    </svg>
                    <span>继续GitHub 登录</span>
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="auth-separator">
                <span>或</span>
              </div>

              <input
                type="email"
                className="auth-input"
                value={email}
                onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="电子邮件地址"
                onCompositionStart={() => setIsComposing(true)}
                onCompositionEnd={() => setIsComposing(false)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && !isComposing && handleEmailContinue()}
                autoFocus
              />

              <button
                className="auth-button auth-button-primary"
                onClick={handleEmailContinue}
                disabled={loading}
              >
                {loading ? '检查中...' : '继续'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 登录页面 */}
        {mode === 'login' && (
          <div className="auth-content">
            <div className="auth-headline">
              <h1 className="auth-title">输入密码</h1>
            </div>

            <div className="auth-form">
              <div className="auth-email-input-group">
                <input
                  type="email"
                  className="auth-input"
                  value={email}
                  disabled
                  placeholder="电子邮件地址"
                />
                <button className="auth-edit-button" onClick={() => { clearInputs(); setMode('welcome'); }}>编辑</button>
              </div>

              <input
                type="password"
                className="auth-input"
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="密码"
                onCompositionStart={() => setIsComposing(true)}
                onCompositionEnd={() => setIsComposing(false)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && !isComposing && handleLogin()}
                autoFocus
              />

              <div className="auth-forgot-password">
                <button className="auth-link" onClick={() => setMode('forgot-password-email')}>
                  忘记了密码?
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="auth-turnstile">
                <TurnstileCaptcha
                  ref={emailCaptchaRef}
                  onSuccess={(token) => setTurnstileToken(token)}
                  onFail={() => setTurnstileToken('')}
                  onExpire={() => setTurnstileToken('')}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="auth-checkbox">
                <label>
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={agreedToPolicy}
                    onChange={(e) => setAgreedToPolicy(e.target.checked)}
                  />
                  <span>
                    我已阅读并同意
                    <button className="auth-policy-link" onClick={() => { setPolicyType('terms'); setShowPolicy(true); }}>
                      使用条款
                    </button>
                    和
                    <button className="auth-policy-link" onClick={() => { setPolicyType('privacy'); setShowPolicy(true); }}>
                      隐私政策
                    </button>
                  </span>
                </label>
              </div>

              <button
                className="auth-button auth-button-primary"
                onClick={handleLogin}
                disabled={loading || (enableTurnstile && !turnstileToken) || !agreedToPolicy}
              >
                {loading ? '登录中...' : '继续'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 注册页面 */}
        {mode === 'register' && (
          <div className="auth-content">
            <div className="auth-headline">
              <h1 className="auth-title">注册 Scholay</h1>
              <p className="auth-subtitle">1 分钟完成，立即上手。</p>
            </div>

            <div className="auth-email-display">
              <span>{email || '输入邮箱地址'}</span>
              {email && (
                <button className="auth-change-email" onClick={() => { clearInputs(); setMode('welcome'); }}>更换</button>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="auth-form">
              {!email && (
                <input
                  type="email"
                  className="auth-input"
                  value={email}
                  onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="电子邮件地址"
                  autoFocus
                />
              )}

              <input
                type="password"
                className="auth-input"
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="密码（至少8位）"
                autoFocus={!!email}
              />

              <input
                type="password"
                className="auth-input"
                value={confirmPassword}
                onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
                onBlur={validateConfirmPassword}
                placeholder="确认密码"
              />

              {/* 密码错误提示 - 预留位置 */}
              <div className="auth-password-error-placeholder">
                {passwordError && <div className="auth-password-error">{passwordError}</div>}
              </div>

              {requireEmailVerification && (
                <div className="auth-code-group">
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    className="auth-input auth-code-input"
                    value={code}
                    onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="验证码"
                    maxLength={6}
                  />
                  <button
                    className="auth-code-button"
                    onClick={() => handleSendCode('register')}
                    disabled={countdown > 0 || loading || !email}
                  >
                    {countdown > 0 ? `${countdown}秒` : '发送'}
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}

              <input
                type="text"
                className={`auth-input ${invitationCode ? 'auth-input-highlight' : ''}`}
                value={invitationCode}
                onChange={(e) => setInvitationCode(e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
                placeholder="邀请码（可选）"
                maxLength={20}
              />

              <div className="auth-turnstile">
                <TurnstileCaptcha
                  ref={emailCaptchaRef}
                  onSuccess={(token) => setTurnstileToken(token)}
                  onFail={() => setTurnstileToken('')}
                  onExpire={() => setTurnstileToken('')}
                />
              </div>


              <div className="auth-checkbox">
                <label>
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={agreedToPolicy}
                    onChange={(e) => setAgreedToPolicy(e.target.checked)}
                  />
                  <span>
                    我已阅读并同意
                    <button className="auth-policy-link" onClick={() => { setPolicyType('terms'); setShowPolicy(true); }}>
                      使用条款
                    </button>
                    和
                    <button className="auth-policy-link" onClick={() => { setPolicyType('privacy'); setShowPolicy(true); }}>
                      隐私政策
                    </button>
                  </span>
                </label>
              </div>

              <button
                className="auth-button auth-button-primary"
                onClick={handleRegister}
                disabled={(enableTurnstile && !turnstileToken) || !agreedToPolicy}
              >
                注册
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 手机号欢迎页面 */}
        {mode === 'phone-welcome' && (
          <div className="auth-content">
            <div className="auth-headline">
              <h1 className="auth-title">手机快速登录</h1>
              <p className="auth-subtitle">短信验证，更快进入。</p>
            </div>

            <div className="auth-form">
              <input
                type="tel"
                className="auth-input"
                value={phone}
                onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ''))}
                placeholder="手机号码"
                onCompositionStart={() => setIsComposing(true)}
                onCompositionEnd={() => setIsComposing(false)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && !isComposing && handlePhoneContinue()}
                maxLength={11}
                autoFocus
              />


              <button
                className="auth-button auth-button-primary"
                onClick={handlePhoneContinue}
                disabled={loading}
              >
                {loading ? '检查中...' : '继续'}
              </button>

              <div className="auth-divider">
                <button className="auth-link" onClick={() => { clearInputs(); setMode('welcome'); }}>更多登录方式</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 手机号登录页面 */}
        {mode === 'phone-login' && (
          <div className="auth-content">
            <div className="auth-headline">
              <h1 className="auth-title">使用手机登录</h1>
              <p className="auth-subtitle">密码或验证码皆可。</p>
            </div>

            <div className="auth-email-display">
              <span>{phone}</span>
              <button className="auth-change-email" onClick={() => { clearInputs(); setMode('phone-welcome'); }}>更换</button>
            </div>

            <div className="auth-form">
              {!useCodeLogin ? (
                <>
                  <input
                    type="password"
                    className="auth-input"
                    value={password}
                    onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="密码"
                    onCompositionStart={() => setIsComposing(true)}
                    onCompositionEnd={() => setIsComposing(false)}
                    onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && !isComposing && handlePhoneLogin()}
                    autoFocus
                  />

                  <div className="auth-forgot-password">
                    <button className="auth-link" onClick={() => setUseCodeLogin(true)}>
                      使用验证码
                    </button>
                    <button className="auth-link" onClick={() => setMode('forgot-password-phone')}>
                      忘记密码？
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <div className="auth-code-group">
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      className="auth-input auth-code-input"
                      value={code}
                      onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="验证码"
                      maxLength={6}
                      autoFocus
                    />
                    <button
                      className="auth-code-button"
                      onClick={() => handleSendPhoneCode('login')}
                      disabled={countdown > 0 || loading || !phone}
                    >
                      {countdown > 0 ? `${countdown}秒` : '发送'}
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  <div className="auth-forgot-password">
                    <button className="auth-link" onClick={() => setUseCodeLogin(false)}>
                      使用密码
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </>
              )}

              <div className="auth-turnstile">
                <TurnstileCaptcha
                  ref={phoneCaptchaRef}
                  onSuccess={(token) => setTurnstileToken(token)}
                  onFail={() => setTurnstileToken('')}
                  onExpire={() => setTurnstileToken('')}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="auth-checkbox">
                <label>
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={agreedToPolicy}
                    onChange={(e) => setAgreedToPolicy(e.target.checked)}
                  />
                  <span>
                    我已阅读并同意
                    <button className="auth-policy-link" onClick={() => { setPolicyType('terms'); setShowPolicy(true); }}>
                      使用条款
                    </button>
                    和
                    <button className="auth-policy-link" onClick={() => { setPolicyType('privacy'); setShowPolicy(true); }}>
                      隐私政策
                    </button>
                  </span>
                </label>
              </div>

              <button
                className="auth-button auth-button-primary"
                onClick={useCodeLogin ? handleLoginPhoneWithCode : handlePhoneLogin}
                disabled={loading || (enableTurnstile && !turnstileToken) || !agreedToPolicy}
              >
                {loading ? '登录中...' : '登录'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 手机号注册页面 */}
        {mode === 'phone-register' && (
          <div className="auth-content">
            <div className="auth-headline">
              <h1 className="auth-title">注册 Scholay</h1>
              <p className="auth-subtitle">输入手机号 快速上手。</p>
            </div>

            <div className="auth-email-display">
              <span>{phone || '输入手机号码'}</span>
              {phone && (
                <button className="auth-change-email" onClick={() => { clearInputs(); setMode('phone-welcome'); }}>更换</button>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="auth-form">
              {!phone && (
                <input
                  type="tel"
                  className="auth-input"
                  value={phone}
                  onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ''))}
                  placeholder="手机号码"
                  maxLength={11}
                  autoFocus
                />
              )}

              <input
                type="password"
                className="auth-input"
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="密码(至少8位)"
                autoFocus={!!phone}
              />

              <input
                type="password"
                className="auth-input"
                value={confirmPassword}
                onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
                onBlur={validateConfirmPassword}
                placeholder="确认密码"
              />

              {/* 密码错误提示 - 预留位置 */}
              <div className="auth-password-error-placeholder">
                {passwordError && <div className="auth-password-error">{passwordError}</div>}
              </div>

              <div className="auth-code-group">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  className="auth-input auth-code-input"
                  value={code}
                  onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="验证码"
                  maxLength={6}
                />
                <button
                  className="auth-code-button"
                  onClick={() => handleSendPhoneCode('register')}
                  disabled={countdown > 0 || loading || !phone}
                >
                  {countdown > 0 ? `${countdown}秒` : '发送'}
                </button>
              </div>

              <input
                type="text"
                className={`auth-input ${invitationCode ? 'auth-input-highlight' : ''}`}
                value={invitationCode}
                onChange={(e) => setInvitationCode(e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
                placeholder="邀请码（可选）"
                maxLength={20}
              />

              <div className="auth-turnstile">
                <TurnstileCaptcha
                  ref={phoneCaptchaRef}
                  onSuccess={(token) => setTurnstileToken(token)}
                  onFail={() => setTurnstileToken('')}
                  onExpire={() => setTurnstileToken('')}
                />
              </div>


              <div className="auth-checkbox">
                <label>
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={agreedToPolicy}
                    onChange={(e) => setAgreedToPolicy(e.target.checked)}
                  />
                  <span>
                    我已阅读并同意
                    <button className="auth-policy-link" onClick={() => { setPolicyType('terms'); setShowPolicy(true); }}>
                      使用条款
                    </button>
                    和
                    <button className="auth-policy-link" onClick={() => { setPolicyType('privacy'); setShowPolicy(true); }}>
                      隐私政策
                    </button>
                  </span>
                </label>
              </div>

              <button
                className="auth-button auth-button-primary"
                onClick={handlePhoneRegister}
                disabled={(enableTurnstile && !turnstileToken) || !agreedToPolicy}
              >
                注册
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 忘记密码 - 邮箱 */}
        {mode === 'forgot-password-email' && (
          <div className="auth-content">
            <div className="auth-headline">
              <h1 className="auth-title">重置密码</h1>
              <p className="auth-subtitle">输入验证码后立刻修改。</p>
            </div>

            <div className="auth-email-display">
              <span>{email}</span>
              <button className="auth-change-email" onClick={() => setMode('welcome')}>更换</button>
            </div>

            <div className="auth-form">
              <div className="auth-code-group">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  className="auth-input auth-code-input"
                  value={code}
                  onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="验证码"
                  maxLength={6}
                  autoFocus
                />
                <button
                  className="auth-code-button"
                  onClick={() => handleSendCode('reset_password')}
                  disabled={countdown > 0 || loading || !email}
                >
                  {countdown > 0 ? `${countdown}秒` : '发送'}
                </button>
              </div>

              <input
                type="password"
                className="auth-input"
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="新密码（至少8位）"
              />

              <input
                type="password"
                className="auth-input"
                value={confirmPassword}
                onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
                onBlur={validateConfirmPassword}
                placeholder="确认新密码"
              />

              {/* 密码错误提示 - 预留位置 */}
              <div className="auth-password-error-placeholder">
                {passwordError && <div className="auth-password-error">{passwordError}</div>}
              </div>

              <button
                className="auth-button auth-button-primary"
                onClick={handleResetPassword}
                disabled={loading}
              >
                {loading ? '重置中...' : '重置密码'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 忘记密码 - 手机号 */}
        {mode === 'forgot-password-phone' && (
          <div className="auth-content">
            <div className="auth-headline">
              <h1 className="auth-title">短信重置密码</h1>
              <p className="auth-subtitle">短信验证码后即可修改。</p>
            </div>

            <div className="auth-email-display">
              <span>{phone}</span>
              <button className="auth-change-email" onClick={() => { clearInputs(); setMode('phone-welcome'); }}>更换</button>
            </div>

            <div className="auth-form">
              <div className="auth-code-group">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  className="auth-input auth-code-input"
                  value={code}
                  onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="验证码"
                  maxLength={6}
                  autoFocus
                />
                <button
                  className="auth-code-button"
                  onClick={() => handleSendPhoneCode('reset_password')}
                  disabled={countdown > 0 || loading || !phone}
                >
                  {countdown > 0 ? `${countdown}秒` : '发送'}
                </button>
              </div>

              <input
                type="password"
                className="auth-input"
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="新密码（至少8位）"
              />

              <input
                type="password"
                className="auth-input"
                value={confirmPassword}
                onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
                onBlur={validateConfirmPassword}
                placeholder="确认新密码"
              />

              {/* 密码错误提示 - 预留位置 */}
              <div className="auth-password-error-placeholder">
                {passwordError && <div className="auth-password-error">{passwordError}</div>}
              </div>

              <button
                className="auth-button auth-button-primary"
                onClick={handleResetPasswordPhone}
                disabled={loading}
              >
                {loading ? '重置中...' : '重置密码'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 只在没有政策复选框的页面显示 footer */}
        {mode !== 'login' && mode !== 'register' && mode !== 'phone-login' && mode !== 'phone-register' && (
          <div className="auth-footer">
            <button className="auth-footer-link" onClick={() => { setPolicyType('terms'); setShowPolicy(true); }}>使用条款</button>
            <span>|</span>
            <button className="auth-footer-link" onClick={() => { setPolicyType('privacy'); setShowPolicy(true); }}>隐私政策</button>
          </div>
        )}
        </div>

        {/* 隐私协议弹窗 */}
        {showPolicy && (
          <div className="policy-overlay" onClick={() => setShowPolicy(false)}>
            <div className="policy-container" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
              <div className="policy-header">
                <h3>{policyType === 'privacy' ? '隐私政策' : '使用条款'}</h3>
                <button onClick={() => setShowPolicy(false)}>×</button>
              </div>
              <div className="policy-body">
                <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]}>
                  {policyType === 'privacy' ? privacyContent : termsContent}
                </ReactMarkdown>
              </div>
              <div className="policy-footer">
                <button
                  className="auth-button auth-button-primary"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setAgreedToPolicy(true);
                    setShowPolicy(false);
                  }}
                >
                  同意并继续
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default AuthModal;

// ========== 文件: frontend-user/src/components/CiteModal.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import './CiteModal.css';

const STORAGE_KEY = 'scholar_default_citation_format';

const CiteModal = ({ paper, onClose }) => {
  // 从 localStorage 读取默认格式
  const [citationFormat, setCitationFormat] = useState(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    return saved || 'bibtex';
  });
  const [defaultFormat, setDefaultFormat] = useState(() => {
    return localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) || 'bibtex';
  });
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  if (!paper) return null;

  // 切换格式
  const handleFormatChange = (format) => {
    setCitationFormat(format);
  };

  // 设置为默认格式
  const setAsDefault = (format) => {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, format);
    setDefaultFormat(format); // 立即更新状态
  };

  // 生成引用格式
  const generateCitation = (format) => {
    const authors = paper.authors || [];
    const title = paper.title || 'Untitled';
    const year = paper.year || 'n.d.';
    const venue = paper.venue || '';
    const doi = paper.externalIds?.DOI || '';
    const corpusId = paper.paperId || '';

    // 获取期刊信息
    const journal = paper.journal || {};
    const volume = journal.volume || '';
    const pages = journal.pages || '';

    switch (format) {
      case 'bibtex':
        const firstAuthor = authors[0]?.name || 'Unknown';
        const lastName = firstAuthor.split(' ').pop();

        const stopWords = ['of', 'the', 'in', 'for', 'and', 'a', 'an', 'to', 'on'];
        const titleWords = title.split(' ').filter(w =>
          w.length > 2 && !stopWords.includes(w.toLowerCase())
        );

        const firstTitleWord = titleWords[0]?.replace(/[^a-zA-Z]/g, '') || 'Paper';
        const secondTitleWord = titleWords[1]?.replace(/[^a-zA-Z]/g, '') || '';
        const secondWordInitials = secondTitleWord.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();

        const bibtexKey = `${lastName}${year}${firstTitleWord}${secondWordInitials}`;

        let bibtex = `@article{${bibtexKey},\n  title={${title}},\n  author={${authors.map(a => a.name).join(' and ')}}`;
        if (venue) bibtex += `,\n  journal={${venue}}`;
        if (year) bibtex += `,\n  year={${year}}`;
        if (volume) bibtex += `,\n  volume={${volume}}`;
        if (pages) bibtex += `,\n  pages={${pages}}`;
        bibtex += `,\n  url={https://api.semanticscholar.org/CorpusID:${corpusId}}\n}`;
        return bibtex;

      case 'mla':
        // MLA: 第一作者 姓, 名，超过3人用 et al.
        // MLA格式：期刊名斜体
        let mlaAuthorStr = '';
        if (authors.length > 0) {
          const firstAuthorParts = authors[0].name.split(' ');
          const firstAuthorFormatted = firstAuthorParts.length > 1
            ? `${firstAuthorParts[firstAuthorParts.length - 1]}, ${firstAuthorParts.slice(0, -1).join(' ')}`
            : authors[0].name;
          
          if (authors.length === 1) {
            mlaAuthorStr = firstAuthorFormatted;
          } else if (authors.length === 2) {
            mlaAuthorStr = `${firstAuthorFormatted}, and ${authors[1].name}`;
          } else {
            // 3人及以上使用 et al.
            mlaAuthorStr = `${firstAuthorFormatted} et al.`;
          }
        } else {
          mlaAuthorStr = 'Unknown';
        }

        let mla = `${mlaAuthorStr}. "${title}."`;
        if (venue) mla += ` <i>${venue}</i>`;
        if (volume) mla += ` ${volume}`;
        if (year && pages) mla += ` (${year}): ${pages}`;
        else if (year) mla += ` (${year})`;
        else if (pages) mla += `: ${pages}`;
        mla += '.';
        return mla;

      case 'apa':
        // APA: 姓, 名首字母., 最后一个作者用 & 连接
        // APA格式：期刊名和卷号斜体
        let apaAuthorStr = '';
        if (authors.length > 0) {
          const apaFormatted = authors.map(a => {
            const nameParts = a.name.split(' ');
            if (nameParts.length > 1) {
              const initials = nameParts.slice(0, -1).map(n => n[0] + '.').join(' ');
              return `${nameParts[nameParts.length - 1]}, ${initials}`;
            }
            return a.name;
          });
          
          if (apaFormatted.length === 1) {
            apaAuthorStr = apaFormatted[0];
          } else if (apaFormatted.length === 2) {
            apaAuthorStr = `${apaFormatted[0]}, & ${apaFormatted[1]}`;
          } else {
            apaAuthorStr = `${apaFormatted.slice(0, -1).join(', ')}, & ${apaFormatted[apaFormatted.length - 1]}`;
          }
        } else {
          apaAuthorStr = 'Unknown';
        }

        let apa = `${apaAuthorStr} (${year}). ${title}.`;
        if (venue && volume) apa += ` <i>${venue}, ${volume}</i>`;
        else if (venue) apa += ` <i>${venue}</i>`;
        else if (volume) apa += ` <i>${volume}</i>`;
        if (pages) apa += `, ${pages}`;
        apa += '.';
        return apa;

      case 'chicago':
        // Chicago: 所有作者都是 姓, 名 格式，最后用 and 连接
        // Chicago格式：期刊名斜体
        let chicagoAuthorStr = '';
        if (authors.length > 0) {
          const chicagoFormatted = authors.map(a => {
            const nameParts = a.name.split(' ');
            if (nameParts.length > 1) {
              // 所有作者都是：姓, 名
              return `${nameParts[nameParts.length - 1]}, ${nameParts.slice(0, -1).join(' ')}`;
            }
            return a.name;
          });
          if (chicagoFormatted.length === 1) {
            chicagoAuthorStr = chicagoFormatted[0];
          } else if (chicagoFormatted.length === 2) {
            chicagoAuthorStr = `${chicagoFormatted[0]}, and ${chicagoFormatted[1]}`;
          } else {
            chicagoAuthorStr = `${chicagoFormatted.slice(0, -1).join(', ')}, and ${chicagoFormatted[chicagoFormatted.length - 1]}`;
          }
        } else {
          chicagoAuthorStr = 'Unknown';
        }

        let chicago = `${chicagoAuthorStr}. "${title}."`;
        if (venue) chicago += ` <i>${venue}</i>`;
        if (volume) chicago += ` ${volume}`;
        if (year && pages) chicago += ` (${year}): ${pages}`;
        else if (year) chicago += ` (${year})`;
        else if (pages) chicago += `: ${pages}`;
        chicago += '.';
        return chicago;

      default:
        return '';
    }
  };

  // 获取纯文本引用（去除HTML标签，用于复制）
  const getPlainCitation = (format) => {
    const citation = generateCitation(format);
    return citation.replace(/<\/?i>/g, '');
  };

  const copyCitation = () => {
    const citation = getPlainCitation(citationFormat);
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(citation);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="cite-modal-overlay" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="cite-modal" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="cite-modal-header">
          <h2>引用格式</h2>
          <button className="cite-close-btn" onClick={onClose}>
            <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"></line>
              <line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"></line>
            </svg>
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="cite-format-tabs">
          {['bibtex', 'mla', 'apa', 'chicago'].map((format) => {
            const isActive = citationFormat === format;
            const isDefault = defaultFormat === format;
            const labels = { bibtex: 'BibTeX', mla: 'MLA', apa: 'APA', chicago: 'Chicago' };
            
            return (
              <button
                key={format}
                className={`${isActive ? 'active' : ''} ${isDefault ? 'is-default' : ''}`}
                onClick={() => handleFormatChange(format)}
                onDoubleClick={() => setAsDefault(format)}
              >
                {labels[format]}
                <span className={`default-indicator ${isDefault ? 'visible' : ''}`}>
                  <svg width="10" height="10" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
                    <path d="M12 2l3.09 6.26L22 9.27l-5 4.87 1.18 6.88L12 17.77l-6.18 3.25L7 14.14 2 9.27l6.91-1.01L12 2z"/>
                  </svg>
                </span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
          <span className="format-hint">双击设为默认</span>
        </div>

        <div className="cite-content">
          <div className="cite-content-wrapper">
            <pre 
              className={citationFormat === 'bibtex' ? 'bibtex' : ''}
              dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: generateCitation(citationFormat) }}
            />
            <button className={`cite-inline-copy ${copied ? 'copied' : ''}`} onClick={copyCitation}>
              {copied ? (
                <>
                  <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                    <polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"></polyline>
                  </svg>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                    <rect x="9" y="9" width="13" height="13" rx="2" ry="2"></rect>
                    <path d="M5 15H4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h9a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v1"></path>
                  </svg>
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default CiteModal;


// ========== 文件: frontend-user/src/components/ConversationSidebar.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../utils/AuthContext';
import { conversationAPI } from '../services/api';
import './ConversationSidebar.css';

const ConversationSidebar = ({ currentConversationId, onSelectConversation, onNewConversation, collapsed, onToggleSidebar, onLogout }) => {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [conversations, setConversations] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadConversations();
  }, []);

  // Refresh when currentConversationId changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (currentConversationId) {
      loadConversations();
    }
  }, [currentConversationId]);

  const loadConversations = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await conversationAPI.getConversations(1, 50);
      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
        setConversations(response.data.data.conversations || []);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to load conversations:', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (e, conversationId) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!window.confirm('确定删除这个对话吗？')) return;

    try {
      await conversationAPI.deleteConversation(conversationId);
      setConversations(conversations.filter(c => c.id !== conversationId));
      if (currentConversationId === conversationId) {
        onNewConversation();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to delete conversation:', error);
      alert('删除失败');
    }
  };

  const formatDate = (dateString) => {
    const date = new Date(dateString);
    const now = new Date();
    const diffMs = now - date;
    const diffMins = Math.floor(diffMs / 60000);
    const diffHours = Math.floor(diffMs / 3600000);
    const diffDays = Math.floor(diffMs / 86400000);

    if (diffMins < 1) return '刚刚';
    if (diffMins < 60) return `${diffMins}分钟前`;
    if (diffHours < 24) return `${diffHours}小时前`;
    if (diffDays < 7) return `${diffDays}天前`;
    return date.toLocaleDateString('zh-CN');
  };

  return (
    <div className={`conversation-sidebar ${collapsed ? 'collapsed' : ''}`}>
      <div className="sidebar-top">
        {collapsed ? (
          <button className="icon-btn logo-btn" onClick={onToggleSidebar} title="展开侧边栏">
            <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 48 48" fill="none">
              <defs>
                <linearGradient id="logo-gradient-sidebar" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
                  <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#667eea" />
                  <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#764ba2" />
                </linearGradient>
              </defs>
              <path d="M24 10L34 20H29V34H19V20H14L24 10Z" fill="url(#logo-gradient-sidebar)"/>
              <rect x="14" y="36" width="20" height="2" rx="1" fill="url(#logo-gradient-sidebar)"/>
            </svg>
          </button>
        ) : (
          <div className="sidebar-header">
            <button className="logo logo-clickable" onClick={onToggleSidebar} title="收起侧边栏">
              <svg width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 48 48" fill="none">
                <defs>
                  <linearGradient id="logo-gradient-full" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
                    <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#667eea" />
                    <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#764ba2" />
                  </linearGradient>
                </defs>
                <circle cx="24" cy="24" r="24" fill="url(#logo-gradient-full)" opacity="0.2"/>
                <path d="M24 10L34 20H29V34H19V20H14L24 10Z" fill="url(#logo-gradient-full)"/>
                <rect x="14" y="36" width="20" height="2" rx="1" fill="url(#logo-gradient-full)"/>
              </svg>
              <span className="logo-text">Scholar</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        <button
          className={`btn-new-chat ${collapsed ? 'icon-only' : ''}`}
          onClick={onNewConversation}
          title="新建对话"
        >
          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
            <path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/>
          </svg>
          {!collapsed && <span>新建对话</span>}
        </button>
      </div>

      {!collapsed && (
        <>
          <div className="conversation-list">
            {loading ? (
              <div className="loading">加载中...</div>
            ) : conversations.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="empty-state">
                <p>暂无对话</p>
                <p className="hint">点击右上角 + 开始新对话</p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              conversations.map((conversation) => (
                <div
                  key={conversation.id}
                  className={`conversation-item ${currentConversationId === conversation.id ? 'active' : ''}`}
                  onClick={() => onSelectConversation(conversation.id)}
                >
                  <div className="conversation-content">
                    <div className="conversation-title">{conversation.title}</div>
                    <div className="conversation-time">{formatDate(conversation.updated_at)}</div>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    className="btn-delete"
                    onClick={(e) => handleDelete(e, conversation.id)}
                    title="删除对话"
                  >
                    <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                      <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M9 2a1 1 0 00-.894.553L7.382 4H4a1 1 0 000 2v10a2 2 0 002 2h8a2 2 0 002-2V6a1 1 0 100-2h-3.382l-.724-1.447A1 1 0 0011 2H9zM7 8a1 1 0 012 0v6a1 1 0 11-2 0V8zm5-1a1 1 0 00-1 1v6a1 1 0 102 0V8a1 1 0 00-1-1z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
                    </svg>
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="sidebar-footer">
            <div className="user-info">
              <div className="user-avatar-small">
                {user?.avatar_url ? (
                  <img src={user.avatar_url} alt="User" />
                ) : (
                  <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                    <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M10 9a3 3 0 100-6 3 3 0 000 6zm-7 9a7 7 0 1114 0H3z" clipRule="evenodd" />
                  </svg>
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="user-details">
                <div className="user-email-small">{user?.email || 'User'}</div>
              </div>
              <button className="btn-logout-small" onClick={onLogout} title="退出登录">
                <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                  <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M3 3a1 1 0 00-1 1v12a1 1 0 102 0V4a1 1 0 00-1-1zm10.293 9.293a1 1 0 001.414 1.414l3-3a1 1 0 000-1.414l-3-3a1 1 0 10-1.414 1.414L14.586 9H7a1 1 0 100 2h7.586l-1.293 1.293z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      {collapsed && (
        <div className="sidebar-footer-collapsed">
          <button className="icon-btn user-icon-btn" title={user?.email || 'User'}>
            <div className="user-avatar-small">
              {user?.avatar_url ? (
                <img src={user.avatar_url} alt="User" />
              ) : (
                <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                  <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M10 9a3 3 0 100-6 3 3 0 000 6zm-7 9a7 7 0 1114 0H3z" clipRule="evenodd" />
                </svg>
              )}
            </div>
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default ConversationSidebar;

// ========== 文件: frontend-user/src/components/FilterSidebar.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React from 'react';
import YearHistogram from './YearHistogram';
import './FilterSidebar.css';

const FilterSidebar = ({ filters, onFiltersChange, resultsTotal }) => {

  const publicationTypes = [
    { value: 'JournalArticle', label: 'Journal Article' },
    { value: 'Conference', label: 'Conference' },
    { value: 'Book', label: 'Book' },
    { value: 'BookSection', label: 'Book Section' },
    { value: 'Dataset', label: 'Dataset' },
  ];

  const fieldsOfStudy = [
    'Computer Science',
    'Medicine',
    'Biology',
    'Chemistry',
    'Physics',
    'Mathematics',
    'Engineering',
    'Materials Science',
    'Economics',
    'Psychology',
  ];

  const handleYearChange = (yearFrom, yearTo) => {
    onFiltersChange({ ...filters, yearFrom: String(yearFrom), yearTo: String(yearTo) });
  };

  const handlePublicationTypeToggle = (type) => {
    const current = filters.publicationTypes || [];
    const updated = current.includes(type)
      ? current.filter(t => t !== type)
      : [...current, type];
    onFiltersChange({ ...filters, publicationTypes: updated });
  };

  const handleFieldOfStudyToggle = (field) => {
    const current = filters.fieldsOfStudy || [];
    const updated = current.includes(field)
      ? current.filter(f => f !== field)
      : [...current, field];
    onFiltersChange({ ...filters, fieldsOfStudy: updated });
  };

  const handleOpenAccessToggle = () => {
    onFiltersChange({ ...filters, openAccessPdf: filters.openAccessPdf ? '' : 'true' });
  };

  const handleVenueChange = (e) => {
    onFiltersChange({ ...filters, venue: e.target.value });
  };

  const handleClearFilters = () => {
    onFiltersChange({
      yearFrom: '',
      yearTo: '',
      publicationTypes: [],
      fieldsOfStudy: [],
      openAccessPdf: '',
      venue: '',
    });
  };

  const hasActiveFilters = () => {
    return filters.yearFrom || filters.yearTo ||
           (filters.publicationTypes && filters.publicationTypes.length > 0) ||
           (filters.fieldsOfStudy && filters.fieldsOfStudy.length > 0) ||
           filters.openAccessPdf || filters.venue;
  };

  return (
    <div className="filter-sidebar">
      <div className="filter-sidebar-header">
        <h2>筛选条件</h2>
        {hasActiveFilters() && (
          <button className="clear-all-btn" onClick={handleClearFilters}>
            清除
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="filter-sidebar-content">
        {/* Year Range with Histogram */}
        <div className="filter-section">
          <div className="filter-section-title-wrapper">
            <h3 className="filter-section-title">发表年份</h3>
            {(filters.yearFrom || filters.yearTo) && (
              <span className="year-range-display">
                {filters.yearFrom || '1920'} - {filters.yearTo || '2026'}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
          <YearHistogram
            yearFrom={filters.yearFrom ? parseInt(filters.yearFrom) : undefined}
            yearTo={filters.yearTo ? parseInt(filters.yearTo) : undefined}
            onChange={handleYearChange}
          />
        </div>

        {/* Open Access */}
        <div className="filter-section">
          <label className="filter-option open-access">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={filters.openAccessPdf === 'true'}
              onChange={handleOpenAccessToggle}
            />
            <span>仅开放获取</span>
          </label>
        </div>

        {/* Fields of Study */}
        <div className="filter-section">
          <h3 className="filter-section-title">研究领域</h3>
          <div className="filter-options scrollable">
            {fieldsOfStudy.map(field => (
              <label key={field} className="filter-option">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={(filters.fieldsOfStudy || []).includes(field)}
                  onChange={() => handleFieldOfStudyToggle(field)}
                />
                <span>{field}</span>
              </label>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default FilterSidebar;

                          <path d="M22 3h-6a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v14a3 3 0 0 1 3-3h7z"/>
                        </svg>
                      </span>
                      <div>
                        <strong>研究趋势洞察</strong>
                        <p>分析领域热点，把握学术前沿动态</p>
                      </div>
                    </li>
                  </ul>
                </>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* CTA按钮 */}
            <div className="modal-actions">
              <a 
                href="/" 
                className="action-primary"
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  handleClose();
                  window.location.href = '/';
                }}
              >
                立即体验 Scholay
                <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                  <path d="M5 12h14M12 5l7 7-7 7"/>
                </svg>
              </a>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 右侧：GIF展示 */}
          <div className="modal-right">
            <div className="gif-container">
              <img 
                src={activeDemo === 0 ? "/assets/academic-search.gif" : "/assets/smart-analysis.gif"}
                alt={activeDemo === 0 ? "学术检索演示" : "智能分析演示"}
                className="demo-gif"
              />
              <div className="gif-caption">
                {activeDemo === 0 ? "智能学术检索演示" : "深度智能分析演示"}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
};
