import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback, lazy, Suspense } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { publicScholarAPI, analysisDimensionAPI } from '../services/api';
import { useAuth } from '../utils/AuthContext';
import './PaperTableView.css';

// 懒加载 AuthModal
const AuthModal = lazy(() => import('./AuthModal'));

// 分析结果缓存
const analysisCache = new Map();

// 每次显示的论文数量
const PAPERS_PER_DISPLAY = 10;
// 每次从后端加载的论文数量（需要多加载一些，因为要过滤无摘要的）
const PAPERS_PER_FETCH = 50;
// 未登录用户最多显示的论文数量
const GUEST_MAX_PAPERS = 5;

// Loading期间的占位列（6个）
const LOADING_COLUMNS = [
  { key: 'paper', label: '论文', sticky: true },
  { key: 'loading1', label: '加载中...' },
  { key: 'loading2', label: '加载中...' },
  { key: 'loading3', label: '加载中...' },
  { key: 'loading4', label: '加载中...' },
  { key: 'loading5', label: '加载中...' },
  { key: 'loading6', label: '加载中...' },
];

const PaperTableView = ({ 
  searchQuery, 
  filters, 
  onPaperClick, 
  totalResults, 
  selectedDimensionKey, 
  onDimensionSelect, 
  reloadTrigger,
  // 新增：直接传入论文数据的模式
  papers: providedPapers,
  onLoadMore,
  hasMore: providedHasMore,
  loadingMore: providedLoadingMore,
  // 是否隐藏加载更多按钮（用于相似论文未登录状态）
  hideLoadMore = false,
  // 标识是否是相似论文表格视图（用于登录后恢复状态）
  isSimilarPapersTable = false,
  // 使用推荐搜索词搜索的回调
  onSearchWithQuery,
}) => {
  // 判断是否使用传入的论文数据模式
  const useProvidedPapers = !!providedPapers;
  // 获取用户认证状态
  const { isAuthenticated } = useAuth();
  
  // 登录弹窗状态
  const [showAuthModal, setShowAuthModal] = useState(false);
  
  // 已加载的有摘要论文列表
  const [papersWithAbstract, setPapersWithAbstract] = useState([]);
  // 当前显示的数量
  const [displayCount, setDisplayCount] = useState(PAPERS_PER_DISPLAY);
  // 后端数据的偏移量
  const [offset, setOffset] = useState(0);
  // 是否正在加载更多
  const [loadingMore, setLoadingMore] = useState(false);
  // 是否还有更多数据可以从后端加载
  const [hasMoreFromBackend, setHasMoreFromBackend] = useState(true);
  // 初始加载状态
  const [initialLoading, setInitialLoading] = useState(true);
  // 重新加载提示
  const [reloadNotice, setReloadNotice] = useState(null);
  // 重新加载计数器（用于触发数据重新加载）
  const [reloadCounter, setReloadCounter] = useState(0);
  
  const [analysisResults, setAnalysisResults] = useState({});
  const [loadingPapers, setLoadingPapers] = useState({});
  const [expandedCells, setExpandedCells] = useState({});
  // 动态列定义（从API获取）
  const [dynamicColumns, setDynamicColumns] = useState(null);
  // 列加载状态
  const [columnsLoading, setColumnsLoading] = useState(true);
  // AI翻译后的搜索词（用于推荐搜索）
  const [translatedQuery, setTranslatedQuery] = useState(null);
  // 搜索策略: combined, original, translated
  const [searchStrategy, setSearchStrategy] = useState('');
  const tableRef = useRef(null);
  const tableWrapperRef = useRef(null);
  const columnRefs = useRef({}); // 列头引用，用于滚动定位
  const observerRef = useRef(null);
  const paperRefs = useRef({});

  // 重新加载数据（清除缓存并重新获取）
  const reloadData = useCallback(() => {
    // 清除分析缓存
    analysisCache.clear();
    // 重置状态
    setAnalysisResults({});
    setDynamicColumns(null);
    setColumnsLoading(true); // 重置列加载状态，触发重新加载维度
    setPapersWithAbstract([]);
    setDisplayCount(PAPERS_PER_DISPLAY);
    setOffset(0);
    setHasMoreFromBackend(true);
    setInitialLoading(true);
    setReloadNotice(null);
    // 增加计数器以触发数据重新加载
    setReloadCounter(prev => prev + 1);
  }, []);

  // 监听 reloadTrigger 变化，触发重新加载
  useEffect(() => {
    if (reloadTrigger && reloadTrigger.timestamp) {
      // 显示提示
      const actionText = reloadTrigger.action === 'add' ? '新增' : '修改';
      setReloadNotice({
        message: `维度"${reloadTrigger.dimensionName}"已${actionText}，正在重新加载数据...`,
        type: 'info'
      });
      
      // 延迟一下再重新加载，让用户看到提示
      setTimeout(() => {
        reloadData();
      }, 500);
    }
  }, [reloadTrigger, reloadData]);

  // 当用户登录状态变化时，清除缓存并重新加载
  // 因为登录/登出会影响使用的维度配置
  useEffect(() => {
    // 清除缓存
    analysisCache.clear();
    // 重置分析结果和动态列
    setAnalysisResults({});
    setDynamicColumns(null);
    setColumnsLoading(true);
  }, [isAuthenticated]);

  // 组件加载时从API获取分析维度列
  // 依赖 reloadCounter 以便在维度修改后重新加载
  useEffect(() => {
    const loadDimensions = async () => {
      setColumnsLoading(true);
      try {
        let response;
        if (isAuthenticated) {
          // 已登录用户：获取用户自定义维度或系统默认
          response = await analysisDimensionAPI.getDimensions();
        } else {
          // 未登录用户：获取系统默认维度
          response = await publicScholarAPI.getSystemDimensions();
        }

        if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
          const dims = response.data.data.dimensions || [];
          if (dims.length > 0) {
            const cols = [
              { key: 'paper', label: '论文', sticky: true },
              ...dims.map(dim => ({
                key: dim.dimensionKey,
                label: dim.name
              }))
            ];
            setDynamicColumns(cols);
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to load dimensions:', err);
      } finally {
        setColumnsLoading(false);
      }
    };

    loadDimensions();
  }, [isAuthenticated, reloadCounter]);

  // 当选中维度变化时，自动滚动到对应列
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedDimensionKey && columnRefs.current[selectedDimensionKey] && tableWrapperRef.current) {
      const columnElement = columnRefs.current[selectedDimensionKey];
      const wrapperElement = tableWrapperRef.current;
      
      // 计算需要滚动的位置
      const columnRect = columnElement.getBoundingClientRect();
      const wrapperRect = wrapperElement.getBoundingClientRect();
      
      // 第一列是固定的，宽度约340px
      const stickyColumnWidth = 340;
      
      // 计算列相对于wrapper的位置
      const columnLeft = columnElement.offsetLeft;
      const scrollTarget = columnLeft - stickyColumnWidth - 20; // 留一点边距
      
      // 平滑滚动到目标位置
      wrapperElement.scrollTo({
        left: Math.max(0, scrollTarget),
        behavior: 'smooth'
      });
    }
  }, [selectedDimensionKey]);

  // 点击列头处理
  const handleColumnHeaderClick = (key) => {
    if (key === 'paper') return; // 论文列不可选中
    if (onDimensionSelect) {
      // 如果已经选中，则取消选中；否则选中
      onDimensionSelect(selectedDimensionKey === key ? null : key);
    }
  };

  // 从后端加载论文数据
  // 返回: { totalFetched: number, withAbstract: number, hasMore: boolean }
  const fetchPapers = useCallback(async (query, currentFilters, currentOffset, append = false) => {
    if (!query) {
      console.log('[PaperTableView] No query provided, skipping fetch');
      return { totalFetched: 0, withAbstract: 0, hasMore: false };
    }
    
    console.log('[PaperTableView] Fetching papers:', { query, currentOffset, append });
    
    try {
      const params = {
        query: query,
        offset: currentOffset,
        limit: PAPERS_PER_FETCH,
        enableTranslation: true, // 启用翻译以获取AI优化后的搜索词
        fields: ['paperId', 'title', 'abstract', 'authors', 'year', 'citationCount', 'url', 'venue', 'publicationDate', 'openAccessPdf', 'fieldsOfStudy', 'isOpenAccess', 'referenceCount', 'influentialCitationCount', 'tldr', 'journal', 'externalIds']
      };

      // 添加筛选条件
      if (currentFilters) {
        if (currentFilters.yearFrom || currentFilters.yearTo) {
          params.yearFrom = currentFilters.yearFrom;
          params.yearTo = currentFilters.yearTo;
        }
        if (currentFilters.publicationTypes && currentFilters.publicationTypes.length > 0) {
          params.publicationTypes = currentFilters.publicationTypes;
        }
        if (currentFilters.fieldsOfStudy && currentFilters.fieldsOfStudy.length > 0) {
          params.fieldsOfStudy = currentFilters.fieldsOfStudy;
        }
        if (currentFilters.openAccessPdf) {
          params.openAccessPdf = currentFilters.openAccessPdf;
        }
        if (currentFilters.venue) {
          params.venue = currentFilters.venue;
        }
        if (currentFilters.minCitationCount) {
          params.minCitationCount = currentFilters.minCitationCount;
        }
      }

      console.log('[PaperTableView] Request params:', params);
      const response = await publicScholarAPI.searchPapers(params);
      console.log('[PaperTableView] Response:', response.data);
      
      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
        // 数据结构: response.data.data.data.data (Semantic Scholar返回的嵌套结构)
        const searchData = response.data.data.data || response.data.data;
        const newPapers = searchData.data || searchData.papers || [];
        console.log('[PaperTableView] Got papers:', newPapers.length, 'from searchData:', searchData);
        
        // 保存AI翻译后的搜索词和搜索策略（用于推荐搜索）
        // 数据可能在不同层级：response.data.data.translatedQuery 或 searchData.translatedQuery
        const translated = response.data.data?.translatedQuery || searchData?.translatedQuery;
        const strategy = response.data.data?.searchStrategy || searchData?.searchStrategy || '';
        console.log('[PaperTableView] Looking for translatedQuery and searchStrategy:', {
          'response.data.data': response.data.data,
          'searchData': searchData,
          'translatedQuery': translated,
          'searchStrategy': strategy
        });
        if (translated && translated !== query) {
          setTranslatedQuery(translated);
          console.log('[PaperTableView] Set translated query:', translated);
        }
        if (strategy) {
          setSearchStrategy(strategy);
          console.log('[PaperTableView] Set search strategy:', strategy);
        }
        
        // 过滤出有摘要的论文
        const newPapersWithAbstract = newPapers.filter(p => p.abstract && p.abstract.trim().length > 0);
        console.log('[PaperTableView] Papers with abstract:', newPapersWithAbstract.length);
        
        if (append) {
          setPapersWithAbstract(prev => {
            // 去重
            const existingIds = new Set(prev.map(p => p.paperId));
            const uniqueNew = newPapersWithAbstract.filter(p => !existingIds.has(p.paperId));
            return [...prev, ...uniqueNew];
          });
        } else {
          setPapersWithAbstract(newPapersWithAbstract);
        }
        
        // 判断是否还有更多数据
        const total = searchData.total || response.data.data.total || 0;
        console.log('[PaperTableView] Total papers:', total);
        const hasMore = currentOffset + PAPERS_PER_FETCH < total;
        setHasMoreFromBackend(hasMore);
        
        return { totalFetched: newPapers.length, withAbstract: newPapersWithAbstract.length, hasMore };
      }
      return { totalFetched: 0, withAbstract: 0, hasMore: false };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[PaperTableView] Failed to fetch papers:', error);
      return { totalFetched: 0, withAbstract: 0, hasMore: false };
    }
  }, []);

  // 初始加载 - 当searchQuery、filters或reloadCounter变化时重新加载
  // 自动继续加载直到有摘要的论文或没有更多数据
  useEffect(() => {
    // 如果使用传入的论文数据模式，不需要自己加载
    if (useProvidedPapers) {
      console.log('[PaperTableView] Using provided papers, count:', providedPapers?.length);
      // 过滤出有摘要的论文
      const papersWithAbs = (providedPapers || []).filter(p => p.abstract && p.abstract.trim().length > 0);
      setPapersWithAbstract(papersWithAbs);
      setInitialLoading(false);
      setHasMoreFromBackend(providedHasMore !== undefined ? providedHasMore : false);
      return;
    }
    
    console.log('[PaperTableView] useEffect triggered, searchQuery:', searchQuery, 'reloadCounter:', reloadCounter);
    
    if (!searchQuery) {
      console.log('[PaperTableView] No searchQuery, skipping');
      setInitialLoading(false);
      return;
    }
    
    const loadInitial = async () => {
      setInitialLoading(true);
      setPapersWithAbstract([]);
      setOffset(0);
      setDisplayCount(PAPERS_PER_DISPLAY);
      setHasMoreFromBackend(true);
      
      // 自动加载直到有摘要的论文或没有更多数据
      let currentOffset = 0;
      let totalWithAbstract = 0;
      let hasMore = true;
      const maxAttempts = 10; // 最多尝试10次，避免无限循环
      let attempts = 0;
      
      while (totalWithAbstract === 0 && hasMore && attempts < maxAttempts) {
        console.log(`[PaperTableView] Auto-loading attempt ${attempts + 1}, offset: ${currentOffset}`);
        const result = await fetchPapers(searchQuery, filters, currentOffset, currentOffset > 0);
        totalWithAbstract = result.withAbstract;
        hasMore = result.hasMore;
        
        if (totalWithAbstract === 0 && hasMore) {
          currentOffset += PAPERS_PER_FETCH;
          setOffset(currentOffset);
        }
        attempts++;
      }
      
      if (attempts > 1) {
        console.log(`[PaperTableView] Auto-loaded ${attempts} pages to find papers with abstract`);
      }
      
      setInitialLoading(false);
    };
    
    loadInitial();
  }, [searchQuery, filters, fetchPapers, reloadCounter, useProvidedPapers, providedPapers, providedHasMore]);

  // 当前显示的论文
  const displayedPapers = useProvidedPapers 
    ? papersWithAbstract  // 传入数据模式：显示所有有摘要的论文
    : papersWithAbstract.slice(0, displayCount);

  // 是否可以显示更多（本地已有数据或后端还有数据）- 仅登录用户可用
  const canLoadMore = useProvidedPapers 
    ? (providedHasMore && onLoadMore)  // 传入数据模式：由外部控制
    : (isAuthenticated && (displayCount < papersWithAbstract.length || hasMoreFromBackend));

  // 当前是否正在加载
  const isLoadingMore = useProvidedPapers ? providedLoadingMore : loadingMore;

  // 剩余可加载数量提示
  const remainingHint = useProvidedPapers 
    ? (providedHasMore ? '加载更多...' : '')
    : (displayCount < papersWithAbstract.length 
        ? `还有 ${papersWithAbstract.length - displayCount} 篇已加载`
        : hasMoreFromBackend ? '加载更多...' : '');

  // 加载更多论文
  // 自动继续加载直到有新的摘要论文或没有更多数据
  const handleLoadMore = useCallback(async () => {
    // 如果使用传入数据模式，调用外部的加载更多函数
    if (useProvidedPapers) {
      if (onLoadMore) {
        onLoadMore();
      }
      return;
    }
    
    if (loadingMore) return;
    
    // 如果本地已有足够数据，直接显示更多
    if (displayCount + PAPERS_PER_DISPLAY <= papersWithAbstract.length) {
      setDisplayCount(prev => prev + PAPERS_PER_DISPLAY);
      return;
    }
    
    // 需要从后端加载更多数据
    if (hasMoreFromBackend) {
      setLoadingMore(true);
      
      // 记录加载前的摘要论文数量
      const previousCount = papersWithAbstract.length;
      let currentOffset = offset;
      let hasMore = true;
      const maxAttempts = 10; // 最多尝试10次
      let attempts = 0;
      let newWithAbstract = 0;
      
      // 自动加载直到有新的摘要论文或没有更多数据
      while (newWithAbstract === 0 && hasMore && attempts < maxAttempts) {
        currentOffset += PAPERS_PER_FETCH;
        console.log(`[PaperTableView] LoadMore attempt ${attempts + 1}, offset: ${currentOffset}`);
        const result = await fetchPapers(searchQuery, filters, currentOffset, true);
        newWithAbstract = result.withAbstract;
        hasMore = result.hasMore;
        attempts++;
      }
      
      setOffset(currentOffset);
      
      if (attempts > 1) {
        console.log(`[PaperTableView] LoadMore: loaded ${attempts} pages to find papers with abstract`);
      }
      
      // 增加显示数量
      if (newWithAbstract > 0 || displayCount < papersWithAbstract.length) {
        setDisplayCount(prev => prev + PAPERS_PER_DISPLAY);
      }
      setLoadingMore(false);
    } else {
      // 没有更多后端数据，显示所有已加载的
      setDisplayCount(papersWithAbstract.length);
    }
  }, [loadingMore, displayCount, papersWithAbstract.length, hasMoreFromBackend, offset, fetchPapers, searchQuery, filters, useProvidedPapers, onLoadMore]);

  // 使用 ref 来跟踪正在请求的论文，避免闭包问题导致的重复请求
  const pendingRequestsRef = useRef(new Set());

  // 分析单篇论文
  const analyzePaper = useCallback(async (paper) => {
    // 检查是否有摘要
    if (!paper.abstract) {
      return;
    }

    // 使用 ref 检查是否正在请求，避免闭包问题
    if (pendingRequestsRef.current.has(paper.paperId)) {
      return;
    }

    // 检查缓存（注意：如果用户登录状态变化，缓存可能不适用）
    if (analysisCache.has(paper.paperId)) {
      setAnalysisResults(prev => {
        // 再次检查，避免重复设置
        if (prev[paper.paperId]) return prev;
        return {
          ...prev,
          [paper.paperId]: analysisCache.get(paper.paperId)
        };
      });
      return;
    }

    // 标记为正在请求
    pendingRequestsRef.current.add(paper.paperId);
    setLoadingPapers(prev => ({ ...prev, [paper.paperId]: true }));

    try {
      // 根据登录状态选择API：
      // - 已登录：使用带认证的API，获取用户自定义维度的分析结果
      // - 未登录：使用公共API，获取系统默认维度的分析结果
      const response = isAuthenticated
        ? await analysisDimensionAPI.analyzePaper(paper.paperId, paper.title, paper.abstract)
        : await publicScholarAPI.analyzePaper(paper.paperId, paper.title, paper.abstract);
      
      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
        const result = response.data.data;
        // 存入缓存
        analysisCache.set(paper.paperId, result);
        setAnalysisResults(prev => ({
          ...prev,
          [paper.paperId]: result
        }));
      } else {
        // 请求成功但返回错误码，也标记为已处理，避免无限重试
        console.warn('Analysis API returned error code:', response.data.code, response.data.message);
        setAnalysisResults(prev => ({
          ...prev,
          [paper.paperId]: { error: true, message: response.data.message || '分析失败' }
        }));
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to analyze paper:', paper.paperId, error);
      // 设置错误状态
      setAnalysisResults(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        [paper.paperId]: { error: true }
      }));
    } finally {
      // 清除正在请求标记
      pendingRequestsRef.current.delete(paper.paperId);
      setLoadingPapers(prev => ({ ...prev, [paper.paperId]: false }));
    }
  }, [isAuthenticated]); // 移除 loadingPapers 和 analysisResults 依赖，使用 ref 代替

  // 使用 ref 存储最新的 analysisResults，避免 Observer 回调中的闭包问题
  const analysisResultsRef = useRef(analysisResults);
  useEffect(() => {
    analysisResultsRef.current = analysisResults;
  }, [analysisResults]);

  // 使用 Intersection Observer 实现懒加载
  useEffect(() => {
    observerRef.current = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            const paperId = entry.target.dataset.paperId;
            const paper = displayedPapers.find(p => p.paperId === paperId);
            // 使用 ref 检查最新状态，避免闭包问题
            const alreadyAnalyzed = analysisResultsRef.current[paperId];
            const isPending = pendingRequestsRef.current.has(paperId);
            
            if (paper && paper.abstract && !alreadyAnalyzed && !isPending) {
              analyzePaper(paper);
            }
          }
        });
      },
      {
        root: null,
        rootMargin: '100px',
        threshold: 0.1
      }
    );

    // 观察所有论文行
    Object.values(paperRefs.current).forEach(ref => {
      if (ref) {
        observerRef.current.observe(ref);
      }
    });

    return () => {
      if (observerRef.current) {
        observerRef.current.disconnect();
      }
    };
  }, [displayedPapers, analyzePaper]); // 移除 analysisResults 和 loadingPapers 依赖

  // 切换单元格展开状态
  const toggleCellExpand = (paperId, column) => {
    const key = `${paperId}-${column}`;
    setExpandedCells(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [key]: !prev[key]
    }));
  };

  // 渲染单元格内容
  const renderCell = (paperId, column, content, isLoading) => {
    const key = `${paperId}-${column}`;
    const isExpanded = expandedCells[key];
    
    if (isLoading) {
      return (
        <div className="ptv-cell-loading">
          <div className="ptv-loading-spinner"></div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    if (!content || content === '未提及' || content === '解析失败') {
      return <span className="ptv-cell-empty">{content || '未提及'}</span>;
    }

    const shouldTruncate = content.length > 100;
    const displayContent = shouldTruncate && !isExpanded 
      ? content.substring(0, 100) + '...' 
      : content;

    return (
      <div className="ptv-cell-content">
        <span>{displayContent}</span>
        {shouldTruncate && (
          <button 
            className="ptv-expand-btn"
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              toggleCellExpand(paperId, column);
            }}
          >
            {isExpanded ? '收起' : '展开'}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  };

  // 表格列定义 - 优先使用动态列，加载中时使用占位列
  const columns = dynamicColumns || (columnsLoading ? LOADING_COLUMNS : LOADING_COLUMNS);

  // 打开登录弹窗
  const handleOpenAuthModal = () => {
    setShowAuthModal(true);
  };

  // 登录成功回调
  const handleLoginSuccess = () => {
    setShowAuthModal(false);
    // 设置标记，让页面刷新后自动切换到表格视图
    localStorage.setItem('returnToTableView', 'true');
    // 如果是相似论文表格视图，额外保存标记
    if (isSimilarPapersTable) {
      localStorage.setItem('returnToSimilarPapersTable', 'true');
    }
    // 刷新页面以重新加载数据
    window.location.reload();
  };
  
  // 获取分析数据中的某个维度值
  const getAnalysisValue = (analysis, key) => {
    if (!analysis) return null;
    // 新的动态格式：从 data 字段获取
    if (analysis.data && analysis.data[key] !== undefined) {
      return analysis.data[key];
    }
    // 兼容旧的固定字段格式
    if (analysis[key] !== undefined) {
      return analysis[key];
    }
    return null;
  };

  // 初始加载中
  if (initialLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="ptv-container">
        <div className="ptv-loading-state">
          <div className="ptv-loading-spinner-large"></div>
          <p>正在加载论文数据...</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // 如果没有有摘要的论文
  if (papersWithAbstract.length === 0) {
    // 判断是否有可用的推荐搜索词
    // 只有在搜索策略是 combined 时才显示推荐按钮
    // 因为 original 策略已经在用原始词搜索，translated 策略已经在用翻译词搜索
    const hasRecommendedQuery = translatedQuery && 
                                 translatedQuery !== searchQuery && 
                                 onSearchWithQuery && 
                                 searchStrategy === 'combined';
    
    return (
      <div className="ptv-container">
        <div className="ptv-empty-state">
          <svg width="48" height="48" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5">
            <path d="M9 12h6M12 9v6M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z" />
          </svg>
          <p>当前搜索结果中没有包含摘要的论文</p>
          <span className="ptv-empty-hint">表格视图需要论文摘要进行AI分析，已自动检索了多页数据但未找到带摘要的论文</span>
          
          <div className="ptv-empty-suggestions">
            <p className="ptv-suggestion-title">建议尝试以下方式：</p>
            <ul className="ptv-suggestion-list">
              <li>使用更精准的英文学术关键词进行搜索</li>
              <li>尝试缩小搜索范围或添加筛选条件</li>
              <li>检查搜索词是否有拼写错误</li>
            </ul>
            
            {/* 如果有AI翻译的搜索词且搜索策略是combined，显示推荐搜索按钮 */}
            {hasRecommendedQuery && (
              <div className="ptv-recommended-search">
                <p className="ptv-recommended-label">推荐使用AI优化后的搜索词：</p>
                <div className="ptv-recommended-query">
                  <span className="ptv-query-text">{translatedQuery}</span>
                  <button 
                    className="ptv-use-query-btn"
                    onClick={() => onSearchWithQuery(translatedQuery)}
                  >
                    使用此搜索词
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="ptv-container">

      {/* 重新加载提示 */}
      {reloadNotice && (
        <div className={`ptv-reload-notice ptv-reload-notice-${reloadNotice.type}`}>
          <div className="ptv-reload-notice-icon">
            <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <path d="M23 4v6h-6M1 20v-6h6"/>
              <path d="M3.51 9a9 9 0 0 1 14.85-3.36L23 10M1 14l4.64 4.36A9 9 0 0 0 20.49 15"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <span className="ptv-reload-notice-text">{reloadNotice.message}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="ptv-table-wrapper" ref={tableWrapperRef}>
        <table className="ptv-table" ref={tableRef}>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              {columns.map(col => (
                <th 
                  key={col.key} 
                  ref={el => { if (!col.sticky) columnRefs.current[col.key] = el; }}
                  className={`${col.sticky ? 'ptv-sticky-col' : ''} ${!col.sticky ? 'ptv-clickable-header' : ''} ${selectedDimensionKey === col.key ? 'ptv-selected-header' : ''}`}
                  onClick={() => handleColumnHeaderClick(col.key)}
                >
                  {col.label}
                  {selectedDimensionKey === col.key && (
                    <span className="ptv-selected-indicator"></span>
                  )}
                </th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {displayedPapers.map((paper, index) => {
              const analysis = analysisResults[paper.paperId];
              const isLoading = loadingPapers[paper.paperId];
              // 未登录用户第5行之后需要限制
              const isRestricted = !isAuthenticated && index >= GUEST_MAX_PAPERS;

              return (
                <tr 
                  key={paper.paperId || index}
                  ref={el => paperRefs.current[paper.paperId] = el}
                  data-paper-id={paper.paperId}
                  className={isRestricted ? 'ptv-restricted-row' : ''}
                >
                  {/* 论文列 - 固定，使用类似列表的布局 */}
                  <td className="ptv-sticky-col ptv-paper-cell">
                    <div className="ptv-paper-info">
                      {/* 标题 */}
                      <h4 
                        className="ptv-paper-title"
                        onClick={() => onPaperClick && onPaperClick(paper)}
                      >
                        {paper.title || 'Untitled'}
                      </h4>
                      
                      {/* 作者标签 */}
                      {paper.authors && paper.authors.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="ptv-authors-row">
                          {paper.authors.slice(0, 3).map((author, idx) => (
                            <span key={idx} className="ptv-author-tag">{author.name}</span>
                          ))}
                          {paper.authors.length > 3 && (
                            <span className="ptv-author-tag ptv-author-more">+{paper.authors.length - 3}</span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      )}
                      
                      {/* 期刊/年份/引用 */}
                      <div className="ptv-paper-meta">
                        {paper.venue && (
                          <span className="ptv-venue">{paper.venue}</span>
                        )}
                        {paper.year && (
                          <span className="ptv-year">{paper.year}年</span>
                        )}
                        {paper.citationCount > 0 && (
                          <span className="ptv-citations">{paper.citationCount} 被引</span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      
                      {/* 摘要缩略 */}
                      {paper.abstract && (
                        <p className="ptv-abstract">
                          {paper.abstract.length > 150 
                            ? paper.abstract.substring(0, 150) + '...' 
                            : paper.abstract}
                        </p>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </td>

                  {/* 动态渲染分析维度列 */}
                  {isRestricted ? (
                    // 未登录受限行：合并所有分析列，只显示一个登录提示
                    <td 
                      colSpan={columns.filter(col => !col.sticky).length} 
                      className="ptv-restricted-cell ptv-restricted-merged"
                      onClick={handleOpenAuthModal}
                    >
                      <div className="ptv-restricted-overlay">
                        <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                          <rect x="3" y="11" width="18" height="11" rx="2" ry="2"/>
                          <path d="M7 11V7a5 5 0 0 1 10 0v4"/>
                        </svg>
                        <span>登录查看分析结果</span>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  ) : (
                    // 正常渲染每个分析列
                    columns.filter(col => !col.sticky).map(col => (
                      <td key={col.key}>
                        {renderCell(paper.paperId, col.key, getAnalysisValue(analysis, col.key), isLoading)}
                      </td>
                    ))
                  )}
                </tr>
              );
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {/* 未登录用户的登录引导 */}
      {!isAuthenticated && displayedPapers.length > GUEST_MAX_PAPERS && (
        <div className="ptv-guest-prompt">
          <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
            <rect x="3" y="11" width="18" height="11" rx="2" ry="2"/>
            <path d="M7 11V7a5 5 0 0 1 10 0v4"/>
          </svg>
          <span>登录后查看全部分析结果</span>
          <button className="ptv-guest-login-btn" onClick={handleOpenAuthModal}>
            登录 / 注册
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 登录弹窗 - 使用 Portal 渲染到 body，确保相对于整个浏览器窗口定位 */}
      {showAuthModal && createPortal(
        <Suspense fallback={null}>
          <AuthModal
            isOpen={showAuthModal}
            onClose={() => setShowAuthModal(false)}
            onLoginSuccess={handleLoginSuccess}
          />
        </Suspense>,
        document.body
      )}

      {/* 加载更多按钮 - 仅登录用户可见（或传入数据模式下由外部控制），可通过 hideLoadMore 隐藏 */}
      {canLoadMore && !hideLoadMore && (
        <div className="ptv-load-more">
          <button 
            className="ptv-load-more-btn"
            onClick={handleLoadMore}
            disabled={isLoadingMore}
          >
            {isLoadingMore ? (
              <>
                <div className="ptv-loading-spinner"></div>
                <span>加载中...</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                  <path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14" />
                </svg>
                <span>加载更多论文</span>
              </>
            )}
          </button>
          {remainingHint && (
            <span className="ptv-load-more-hint">{remainingHint}</span>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default PaperTableView;

// ========== 文件: frontend-user/src/components/ProtectedRoute.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React from 'react';
import { Navigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../utils/AuthContext';

/**
 * ProtectedRoute - 保护需要登录才能访问的路由
 *
 * 如果用户未登录，自动重定向到首页
 */
const ProtectedRoute = ({ children }) => {
  const { isAuthenticated, loading } = useAuth();
  const location = useLocation();

  // 等待认证状态加载完成
  if (loading) {
    return null; // 或者返回一个加载指示器
  }

  // 如果未登录，重定向到首页
  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    // 使用 replace 避免在浏览器历史中留下记录
    return <Navigate to="/" replace state={{ from: location }} />;
  }

  // 已登录，渲染子组件
  return children;
};

export default ProtectedRoute;

/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React from 'react';
import { Helmet } from 'react-helmet-async';

/**
 * SEO Component - 用于管理页面的 meta 标签和结构化数据
 *
 * @param {string} title - 页面标题
 * @param {string} description - 页面描述
 * @param {string} keywords - 关键词（可选）
 * @param {string} canonical - 规范链接
 * @param {string} ogType - Open Graph类型（默认: website）
 * @param {string} ogImage - 社交分享图片
 * @param {Object} structuredData - 结构化数据（JSON-LD）
 */
const SEO = ({
  title = 'Scholay - AI驱动的学术搜索平台',
  description = 'Scholay是一个创新的学术搜索平台，提供AI驱动的文献检索、智能论文分析、引用图谱可视化等功能。',
  keywords,
  canonical,
  ogType = 'website',
  ogImage = '/og-image.png',
  structuredData,
  noindex = false,
}) => {
  const siteUrl = 'https://www.scholay.com';
  const fullCanonical = canonical ? `${siteUrl}${canonical}` : siteUrl;
  const fullOgImage = ogImage.startsWith('http') ? ogImage : `${siteUrl}${ogImage}`;

  return (
    <Helmet>
      {/* Primary Meta Tags */}
      <title>{title}</title>
      <meta name="title" content={title} />
      <meta name="description" content={description} />
      {keywords && <meta name="keywords" content={keywords} />}
      <link rel="canonical" href={fullCanonical} />

      {/* Robots */}
      {noindex ? (
        <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow" />
      ) : (
        <meta name="robots" content="index, follow, max-image-preview:large, max-snippet:-1, max-video-preview:-1" />
      )}

      {/* Open Graph / Facebook */}
      <meta property="og:type" content={ogType} />
      <meta property="og:url" content={fullCanonical} />
      <meta property="og:title" content={title} />
      <meta property="og:description" content={description} />
      <meta property="og:image" content={fullOgImage} />
      <meta property="og:site_name" content="Scholay" />

      {/* Twitter Card */}
      <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image" />
      <meta name="twitter:url" content={fullCanonical} />
      <meta name="twitter:title" content={title} />
      <meta name="twitter:description" content={description} />
      <meta name="twitter:image" content={fullOgImage} />

      {/* Structured Data */}
      {structuredData && (
        <script type="application/ld+json">
          {JSON.stringify(structuredData)}
        </script>
      )}
    </Helmet>
  );
};

export default SEO;

// ========== 文件: frontend-user/src/components/SearchFilters.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React, { useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import YearHistogram from './YearHistogram';
import './SearchFilters.css';

const SearchFilters = ({ filters, onFiltersChange, isExpanded, onToggle }) => {
  const filtersPanelRef = useRef(null);
  const overlayRef = useRef(null);

  const handleOverlayClick = (e) => {
    if (e.target === overlayRef.current) {
      onToggle();
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const updateMaxHeight = () => {
      if (filtersPanelRef.current && isExpanded) {
        const rect = filtersPanelRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
        const viewportHeight = window.innerHeight;
        const availableHeight = viewportHeight - rect.top - 20; // 20px bottom padding
        filtersPanelRef.current.style.maxHeight = `${Math.max(200, availableHeight)}px`;
      }
    };

    if (isExpanded) {
      // Update on mount and when expanded
      setTimeout(updateMaxHeight, 0);

      // Update on window resize
      window.addEventListener('resize', updateMaxHeight);
      return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', updateMaxHeight);
    }
  }, [isExpanded]);

  const publicationTypes = [
    { value: 'JournalArticle', label: 'Journal Article' },
    { value: 'Conference', label: 'Conference' },
    { value: 'Book', label: 'Book' },
    { value: 'BookSection', label: 'Book Section' },
    { value: 'Dataset', label: 'Dataset' },
  ];

  const fieldsOfStudy = [
    { value: 'Computer Science', label: '计算机科学' },
    { value: 'Medicine', label: '医学' },
    { value: 'Biology', label: '生物学' },
    { value: 'Chemistry', label: '化学' },
    { value: 'Physics', label: '物理学' },
    { value: 'Mathematics', label: '数学' },
    { value: 'Engineering', label: '工程学' },
    { value: 'Materials Science', label: '材料科学' },
    { value: 'Economics', label: '经济学' },
    { value: 'Psychology', label: '心理学' },
    { value: 'Sociology', label: '社会学' },
    { value: 'Political Science', label: '政治学' },
    { value: 'Business', label: '商业' },
    { value: 'Environmental Science', label: '环境科学' },
    { value: 'Geography', label: '地理学' },
    { value: 'History', label: '历史学' },
    { value: 'Philosophy', label: '哲学' },
    { value: 'Art', label: '艺术' },
  ];

  const handleYearChange = (yearFrom, yearTo) => {
    onFiltersChange({ ...filters, yearFrom: String(yearFrom), yearTo: String(yearTo) });
  };

  const handlePublicationTypeToggle = (type) => {
    const current = filters.publicationTypes || [];
    const updated = current.includes(type)
      ? current.filter(t => t !== type)
      : [...current, type];
    onFiltersChange({ ...filters, publicationTypes: updated });
  };

  const handleFieldOfStudyToggle = (field) => {
    const current = filters.fieldsOfStudy || [];
    const updated = current.includes(field)
      ? current.filter(f => f !== field)
      : [...current, field];
    onFiltersChange({ ...filters, fieldsOfStudy: updated });
  };

  const handleClearFieldsOfStudy = () => {
    onFiltersChange({ ...filters, fieldsOfStudy: [] });
  };

  const handleOpenAccessToggle = () => {
    onFiltersChange({ ...filters, openAccessPdf: filters.openAccessPdf ? '' : 'true' });
  };

  const handleVenueChange = (e) => {
    onFiltersChange({ ...filters, venue: e.target.value });
  };

  const handleClearFilters = () => {
    onFiltersChange({
      yearFrom: '',
      yearTo: '',
      publicationTypes: [],
      fieldsOfStudy: [],
      openAccessPdf: '',
      venue: '',
    });
  };

  const hasActiveFilters = () => {
    return filters.yearFrom || filters.yearTo ||
           (filters.publicationTypes && filters.publicationTypes.length > 0) ||
           (filters.fieldsOfStudy && filters.fieldsOfStudy.length > 0) ||
           filters.openAccessPdf || filters.venue;
  };

  return (
    <div className={`filters-container ${isExpanded ? 'expanded' : ''}`}>
      {/* 蒙层 */}
      <div className="filters-overlay" ref={overlayRef} onClick={handleOverlayClick} />

      {/* 筛选面板 */}
      <div className="search-filters" ref={filtersPanelRef}>
      <div className="filters-header">
        <h3>筛选条件</h3>
        <button
          className={`clear-filters-btn ${hasActiveFilters() ? 'visible' : ''}`}
          onClick={handleClearFilters}
          disabled={!hasActiveFilters()}
        >
          清除全部
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="filters-content">
        {/* Year Range with Histogram */}
        <div className="filter-group year-filter-group">
          <label className="filter-label">发表年份</label>
          <YearHistogram
            yearFrom={filters.yearFrom ? parseInt(filters.yearFrom) : undefined}
            yearTo={filters.yearTo ? parseInt(filters.yearTo) : undefined}
            onChange={handleYearChange}
          />
        </div>

        {/* Open Access - Toggle Switch */}
        <div className="filter-group">
          <div className="open-access-switch-container">
            <span className="switch-label">仅显示开放获取论文 (Open Access)</span>
            <label className="toggle-switch">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={filters.openAccessPdf === 'true'}
                onChange={handleOpenAccessToggle}
              />
              <span className="toggle-slider"></span>
            </label>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Fields of Study */}
        <div className="filter-group">
          <div className="filter-label-row">
            <label className="filter-label">研究领域</label>
            {filters.fieldsOfStudy && filters.fieldsOfStudy.length > 0 && (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="clear-section-btn"
                onClick={handleClearFieldsOfStudy}
              >
                清除
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="checkbox-list scrollable">
            {fieldsOfStudy.map(field => {
              const isChecked = (filters.fieldsOfStudy || []).includes(field.value);
              return (
                <label key={field.value} className="checkbox-item">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={isChecked}
                    onChange={() => handleFieldOfStudyToggle(field.value)}
                  />
                  <span>{field.label}</span>
                </label>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 底部应用按钮 */}
      <div className="filters-footer">
        <button
          className="apply-filters-btn"
          onClick={onToggle}
        >
          应用筛选
        </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default SearchFilters;

/**

 * Scholay学术 V1.0

 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { publicScholarAPI } from '../services/api';
import './SearchSuggestions.css';

/**
 * SearchSuggestions Component
 * 显示搜索建议下拉框，包含论文标题匹配和作者搜索结果
 * 
 * Props:
 * - query: 当前搜索查询
 * - onSelectPaper: 选择论文建议时的回调 (paper) => void
 * - onSelectAuthor: 选择作者建议时的回调 (author) => void
 * - onClose: 关闭下拉框的回调
 * - visible: 是否显示下拉框
 * - inputRef: 输入框的ref，用于定位下拉框
 */
const SearchSuggestions = ({ 
  query, 
  onSelectPaper, 
  onSelectAuthor, 
  onClose, 
  visible,
  inputRef
}) => {
  const [suggestions, setSuggestions] = useState({ papers: [], authors: [] });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [selectedIndex, setSelectedIndex] = useState(-1);
  const dropdownRef = useRef(null);
  const debounceTimerRef = useRef(null);

  // 计算总建议数量
  const totalSuggestions = suggestions.papers.length + suggestions.authors.length;

  // 获取搜索建议
  const fetchSuggestions = useCallback(async (searchQuery) => {
    if (!searchQuery || searchQuery.trim().length < 2) {
      setSuggestions({ papers: [], authors: [] });
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const response = await publicScholarAPI.getSearchSuggestions(searchQuery.trim(), 5, 5);
      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
        setSuggestions({
          papers: response.data.data.papers || [],
          authors: response.data.data.authors || []
        });
      } else {
        setSuggestions({ papers: [], authors: [] });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch search suggestions:', err);
      setError('获取搜索建议失败');
      setSuggestions({ papers: [], authors: [] });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  // 防抖处理查询变化
  useEffect(() => {
    if (debounceTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(debounceTimerRef.current);
    }

    if (!visible || !query || query.trim().length < 2) {
      setSuggestions({ papers: [], authors: [] });
      return;
    }

    debounceTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      fetchSuggestions(query);
    }, 300); // 300ms 防抖

    return () => {
      if (debounceTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(debounceTimerRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, [query, visible, fetchSuggestions]);

  // 重置选中索引当建议变化时
  useEffect(() => {
    setSelectedIndex(-1);
  }, [suggestions]);

  // 点击外部关闭
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event) => {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target) &&
          inputRef?.current && !inputRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
        onClose?.();
      }
    };

    if (visible) {
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    }

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    };
  }, [visible, onClose, inputRef]);

  // 键盘导航
  const handleKeyDown = useCallback((event) => {
    if (!visible || totalSuggestions === 0) return;

    switch (event.key) {
      case 'ArrowDown':
        event.preventDefault();
        setSelectedIndex(prev => 
          prev < totalSuggestions - 1 ? prev + 1 : 0
        );
        break;
      case 'ArrowUp':
        event.preventDefault();
        setSelectedIndex(prev => 
          prev > 0 ? prev - 1 : totalSuggestions - 1
        );
        break;
      case 'Enter':
        event.preventDefault();
        if (selectedIndex >= 0) {
          const papersCount = suggestions.papers.length;
          if (selectedIndex < papersCount) {
            onSelectPaper?.(suggestions.papers[selectedIndex]);
          } else {
            onSelectAuthor?.(suggestions.authors[selectedIndex - papersCount]);
          }
        }
        break;
      case 'Escape':
        onClose?.();
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
  }, [visible, totalSuggestions, selectedIndex, suggestions, onSelectPaper, onSelectAuthor, onClose]);

  // 绑定键盘事件到输入框
  useEffect(() => {
    const input = inputRef?.current;
    if (input && visible) {
      input.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    }
    return () => {
      if (input) {
        input.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      }
    };
  }, [inputRef, visible, handleKeyDown]);

  // 处理论文选择
  const handlePaperClick = (paper) => {
    onSelectPaper?.(paper);
    onClose?.();
  };

  // 处理作者选择
  const handleAuthorClick = (author) => {
    onSelectAuthor?.(author);
    onClose?.();
  };

  // 计算弹窗最大高度，确保不超出视口底部
  const [maxHeight, setMaxHeight] = useState(400);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (visible && dropdownRef.current) {
      const updateMaxHeight = () => {
        const dropdown = dropdownRef.current;
        if (dropdown) {
          const rect = dropdown.getBoundingClientRect();
          const viewportHeight = window.innerHeight;
          // 计算弹窗顶部到视口底部的距离，留出20px的边距
          const availableHeight = viewportHeight - rect.top - 20;
          // 限制在100-500px之间
          setMaxHeight(Math.max(100, Math.min(500, availableHeight)));
        }
      };
      
      // 初始计算
      setTimeout(updateMaxHeight, 0);
      
      // 监听窗口大小变化
      window.addEventListener('resize', updateMaxHeight);
      return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', updateMaxHeight);
    }
  }, [visible, totalSuggestions]);

  // 不显示时返回null
  if (!visible) return null;

  // 查询太短时不显示
  if (query?.trim().length < 2) return null;

  // 加载中时不显示弹窗（等结果返回后再显示）
  if (loading) return null;

  // 没有任何结果时不显示弹窗
  if (totalSuggestions === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className="search-suggestions-dropdown" ref={dropdownRef} style={{ maxHeight: `${maxHeight}px` }}>
      {error && (
        <div className="suggestions-error">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 可滚动的内容区域 */}
      <div className="suggestions-content">
        {suggestions.papers.length > 0 && (
        <div className="suggestions-section">
          <div className="suggestions-section-header">
            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/>
              <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/>
              <line x1="16" y1="13" x2="8" y2="13"/>
              <line x1="16" y1="17" x2="8" y2="17"/>
              <polyline points="10 9 9 9 8 9"/>
            </svg>
            <span>论文匹配</span>
          </div>
          <div className="suggestions-list">
            {suggestions.papers.map((paper, index) => (
              <div
                key={paper.id}
                className={`suggestion-item paper-item ${selectedIndex === index ? 'selected' : ''}`}
                onClick={() => handlePaperClick(paper)}
                onMouseEnter={() => setSelectedIndex(index)}
              >
                <div className="suggestion-content">
                  <div className="suggestion-title">{paper.title}</div>
                  <div className="suggestion-meta">{paper.authorsYear}</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

        {suggestions.authors.length > 0 && (
        <div className="suggestions-section">
          <div className="suggestions-section-header">
            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <path d="M20 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H8a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/>
              <circle cx="12" cy="7" r="4"/>
            </svg>
            <span>作者</span>
          </div>
          <div className="suggestions-list">
            {suggestions.authors.map((author, index) => {
              const actualIndex = suggestions.papers.length + index;
              return (
                <div
                  key={author.authorId}
                  className={`suggestion-item author-item ${selectedIndex === actualIndex ? 'selected' : ''}`}
                  onClick={() => handleAuthorClick(author)}
                  onMouseEnter={() => setSelectedIndex(actualIndex)}
                >
                  <div className="suggestion-content">
                    <div className="suggestion-title">{author.name}</div>
                    {(author.affiliations?.length > 0 || author.paperCount > 0) && (
                      <div className="suggestion-meta">
                        {author.affiliations?.[0] && <span>{author.affiliations[0]}</span>}
                        {author.paperCount > 0 && (
                          <span className="author-stats">
                            {author.paperCount} 篇论文
                            {author.citationCount > 0 && ` · ${author.citationCount} 次引用`}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      </div>

      {/* 固定在底部的提示 */}
      {query?.trim().length >= 2 && (
        <div className="suggestions-footer">
          <span>按 Enter 搜索 "{query}"</span>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default SearchSuggestions;


// ========== 文件: frontend-user/src/components/SimilarPapersGuide.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
