import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { X } from 'lucide-react';
import './SimilarPapersGuide.css';

// 模拟的相似论文数据
const mockPapers = [
  {
    title: 'Deep Learning Applications in Medical Imaging',
    authors: 'Wang X., Chen Y.',
    year: 2024,
    citations: 156,
    similarity: '95%',
    topics: 'AI, Healthcare, Imaging'
  },
  {
    title: 'Neural Networks for Clinical Decision Support',
    authors: 'Smith J., Brown K.',
    year: 2023,
    citations: 89,
    similarity: '87%',
    topics: 'Neural Networks, Clinical'
  },
  {
    title: 'Big Data Analytics in Healthcare Systems',
    authors: 'Zhang L., Li M.',
    year: 2024,
    citations: 72,
    similarity: '82%',
    topics: 'Big Data, Healthcare'
  },
];

const SimilarPapersGuide = ({ onClose, onTryIt, onDismiss, targetRef }) => {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const [showingRow, setShowingRow] = useState(-1);
  const [arrowPosition, setArrowPosition] = useState({ top: 0, left: 0 });
  const [highlightRect, setHighlightRect] = useState(null);
  const [modalPosition, setModalPosition] = useState({ top: 'auto', left: 'auto', transform: 'translateY(-50%)' });

  useEffect(() => {
    // 计算箭头位置和弹窗位置（弹窗在标签右侧，箭头从弹窗左侧水平指向标签）
    const calculatePositions = () => {
      if (targetRef?.current) {
        const rect = targetRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
        const viewportHeight = window.innerHeight;
        const viewportWidth = window.innerWidth;
        
        // 标签中心点位置
        const tabCenterY = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
        const tabRight = rect.right;
        
        // 箭头+线的总宽度
        const arrowTotalWidth = 70; // 60px line + 10px arrow
        const gapToArrow = 8;
        
        // 弹窗左边缘位置 = 标签右边 + 间距 + 箭头宽度
        const modalLeftX = tabRight + gapToArrow + arrowTotalWidth;
        
        // 弹窗垂直位置 - 与标签中心对齐
        let modalCenterY = tabCenterY;
        
        // 确保弹窗不超出顶部和底部
        const modalHeight = 500;
        const minY = modalHeight / 2 + 20;
        const maxY = viewportHeight - modalHeight / 2 - 20;
        modalCenterY = Math.max(minY, Math.min(maxY, modalCenterY));
        
        // 箭头位置 - 箭头尖端靠近标签右侧
        setArrowPosition({
          top: tabCenterY,
          left: tabRight + gapToArrow, // 箭头尖端距离标签8px
        });
        
        // 弹窗位置
        setModalPosition({
          top: `${modalCenterY}px`,
          left: `${modalLeftX}px`,
          transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
        });
      }
    };
    
    calculatePositions();
    
    // 监听窗口大小变化
    window.addEventListener('resize', calculatePositions);
    
    // 延迟显示动画
    setTimeout(() => setVisible(true), 100);
    
    // 逐行显示动画
    let row = 0;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setShowingRow(row);
      row++;
      if (row >= mockPapers.length) {
        clearInterval(timer);
      }
    }, 500);
    
    return () => {
      clearInterval(timer);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', calculatePositions);
    };

    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [targetRef]);

  // 计算高亮区域
  useEffect(() => {
    if (targetRef?.current && visible) {
      const rect = targetRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      setHighlightRect({
        top: rect.top - 6,
        left: rect.left - 6,
        width: rect.width + 12,
        height: rect.height + 12,
      });
    }
  }, [targetRef, visible]);

  // X 按钮 - 只关闭弹窗，下次还会显示
  const handleDismiss = () => {
    setVisible(false);
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (onDismiss) {
        onDismiss();
      } else {
        onClose();
      }
    }, 200);
  };

  // "稍后再说" 按钮 - 关闭并记住，下次不再显示
  const handleClose = () => {
    setVisible(false);
    setTimeout(onClose, 200);
  };

  // "立即体验" 按钮
  const handleTryIt = () => {
    setVisible(false);
    setTimeout(() => {
      onClose();
      if (onTryIt) onTryIt();
    }, 200);
  };

  return (
    <div className={`spg-overlay ${visible ? 'spg-visible' : ''}`}>
      {/* 遮罩层 - 点击蒙层关闭但下次还会显示 */}
      <div 
        className="spg-mask"
        onClick={handleDismiss}
        style={highlightRect ? {
          clipPath: `polygon(
            0% 0%, 
            0% 100%, 
            ${highlightRect.left}px 100%, 
            ${highlightRect.left}px ${highlightRect.top}px, 
            ${highlightRect.left + highlightRect.width}px ${highlightRect.top}px, 
            ${highlightRect.left + highlightRect.width}px ${highlightRect.top + highlightRect.height}px, 
            ${highlightRect.left}px ${highlightRect.top + highlightRect.height}px, 
            ${highlightRect.left}px 100%, 
            100% 100%, 
            100% 0%
          )`
        } : {}}
      />
      
      {/* 高亮边框 */}
      {highlightRect && (
        <div 
          className={`spg-highlight ${visible ? 'spg-highlight-show' : ''}`}
          style={{
            top: highlightRect.top,
            left: highlightRect.left,
            width: highlightRect.width,
            height: highlightRect.height,
          }}
        />
      )}
      
      {/* 指向标签的箭头 - 水平方向，从右向左指 */}
      {arrowPosition.left > 0 && (
        <div 
          className={`spg-pointer ${visible ? 'spg-pointer-show' : ''}`}
          style={{ 
            top: arrowPosition.top, 
            left: arrowPosition.left,
            transform: 'translateY(-50%)', // 垂直居中
          }}
        >
          <div className="spg-pointer-arrow" />
          <div className="spg-pointer-line" />
        </div>
      )}
      
      <div 
        className="spg-modal" 
        onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          top: modalPosition.top,
          left: modalPosition.left,
          transform: modalPosition.transform,
        }}
      >
        {/* 关闭按钮 - 点击后下次还会显示 */}
        <button className="spg-close-btn" onClick={handleDismiss}>
          <X size={18} />
        </button>

        {/* 头部 */}
        <div className="spg-header">
          <div className="spg-badge">新功能</div>
          <h3>发现相似论文</h3>
          <p>基于当前论文的内容和引用关系，智能推荐相关研究文献</p>
        </div>

        {/* 模拟论文列表预览 */}
        <div className="spg-preview">
          <div className="spg-list-container">
            {mockPapers.map((paper, index) => (
              <div 
                key={index} 
                className={`spg-paper-item ${index <= showingRow ? 'spg-paper-show' : ''}`}
              >
                <div className="spg-paper-similarity">
                  <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                    <circle cx="18" cy="5" r="3"/><circle cx="6" cy="12" r="3"/><circle cx="18" cy="19" r="3"/>
                    <path d="M8.59 13.51l6.83 3.98M15.41 6.51l-6.82 3.98"/>
                  </svg>
                  <span>{paper.similarity}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="spg-paper-content">
                  <div className="spg-paper-title">{paper.title}</div>
                  <div className="spg-paper-meta">
                    {paper.authors} · {paper.year} · {paper.citations} citations
                  </div>
                  <div className="spg-paper-topics">{paper.topics}</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          
          {/* 渐变遮罩 */}
          <div className="spg-preview-fade" />
        </div>

        {/* 功能亮点 */}
        <div className="spg-features">
          <div className="spg-feature">
            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <path d="M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14"/>
              <polyline points="22 4 12 14.01 9 11.01"/>
            </svg>
            <span>智能推荐</span>
          </div>
          <div className="spg-feature">
            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <path d="M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14"/>
              <polyline points="22 4 12 14.01 9 11.01"/>
            </svg>
            <span>相似度排序</span>
          </div>
          <div className="spg-feature">
            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <path d="M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14"/>
              <polyline points="22 4 12 14.01 9 11.01"/>
            </svg>
            <span>快速拓展研究</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 操作按钮 */}
        <div className="spg-actions">
          <button className="spg-btn-skip" onClick={handleClose}>
            稍后再说
          </button>
          <button className="spg-btn-try" onClick={handleTryIt}>
            <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <circle cx="18" cy="5" r="3"/><circle cx="6" cy="12" r="3"/><circle cx="18" cy="19" r="3"/>
              <path d="M8.59 13.51l6.83 3.98M15.41 6.51l-6.82 3.98"/>
            </svg>
            立即体验
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default SimilarPapersGuide;


// ========== 文件: frontend-user/src/components/SliderCaptcha.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback, forwardRef, useImperativeHandle } from 'react';
import './SliderCaptcha.css';

const SliderCaptcha = forwardRef(({ onSuccess, onFail }, ref) => {
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
  const [position, setPosition] = useState(0);
  const [verified, setVerified] = useState(false);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);

  const sliderRef = useRef(null);
  const containerRef = useRef(null);
  const startXRef = useRef(0);
  const currentPositionRef = useRef(0);
  const isDraggingRef = useRef(false);

  const handleStart = useCallback((clientX) => {
    if (verified || failed) return;
    isDraggingRef.current = true;
    setIsDragging(true);
    startXRef.current = clientX - currentPositionRef.current;
  }, [verified, failed]);

  const handleMove = useCallback((clientX) => {
    if (!isDraggingRef.current) return;

    const container = containerRef.current;
    if (!container) return;

    const maxMove = container.offsetWidth - 60;
    let newPosition = clientX - startXRef.current;
    newPosition = Math.max(0, Math.min(newPosition, maxMove));

    currentPositionRef.current = newPosition;
    setPosition(newPosition);
  }, []);

  const handleEnd = useCallback(() => {
    if (!isDraggingRef.current) return;
    isDraggingRef.current = false;
    setIsDragging(false);

    const container = containerRef.current;
    if (!container) return;

    const maxMove = container.offsetWidth - 60;
    const currentPercent = (currentPositionRef.current / maxMove) * 100;

    // 验证是否滑动到最右边 (95%以上)
    if (currentPercent >= 95) {
      setVerified(true);
      // 自动吸附到最右边
      setPosition(maxMove);
      currentPositionRef.current = maxMove;
      if (onSuccess) {
        setTimeout(() => onSuccess(), 300);
      }
    } else {
      setFailed(true);
      if (onFail) {
        onFail();
      }
      setTimeout(() => {
        setPosition(0);
        currentPositionRef.current = 0;
        setFailed(false);
      }, 1000);
    }
  }, [onSuccess, onFail]);

  // 鼠标事件
  const handleMouseDown = useCallback((e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    handleStart(e.clientX);
  }, [handleStart]);

  // 触摸事件
  const handleTouchStart = useCallback((e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (e.touches.length > 0) {
      handleStart(e.touches[0].clientX);
    }
  }, [handleStart]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onMouseMove = (e) => handleMove(e.clientX);
    const onTouchMove = (e) => {
      if (e.touches.length > 0) {
        handleMove(e.touches[0].clientX);
      }
    };
    const onEnd = () => handleEnd();

    if (isDragging) {
      document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
      document.addEventListener('mouseup', onEnd);
      document.addEventListener('touchmove', onTouchMove, { passive: false });
      document.addEventListener('touchend', onEnd);

      return () => {
        document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
        document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onEnd);
        document.removeEventListener('touchmove', onTouchMove);
        document.removeEventListener('touchend', onEnd);
      };
    }
  }, [isDragging, handleMove, handleEnd]);

  const reset = useCallback(() => {
    setPosition(0);
    currentPositionRef.current = 0;
    setVerified(false);
    setFailed(false);
    setIsDragging(false);
    isDraggingRef.current = false;
  }, []);

  // Expose reset method to parent component via ref
  useImperativeHandle(ref, () => ({
    reset
  }), [reset]);

  // 计算进度百分比用于显示
  const getProgressPercent = () => {
    const container = containerRef.current;
    if (!container) return 0;
    const maxMove = container.offsetWidth - 60;
    return Math.round((position / maxMove) * 100);
  };

  return (
    <div className="slider-captcha-container">
      {/* 滑块轨道 */}
      <div
        ref={containerRef}
        className={`slider-captcha-track ${verified ? 'verified' : ''} ${failed ? 'failed' : ''}`}
      >
        <div className="slider-captcha-bg-text">
          {verified ? '✓ 验证成功' : failed ? '✗ 请重试' : '向右滑动滑块完成验证'}
        </div>

        <div
          className="slider-captcha-progress"
          style={{ width: `${position}px` }}
        />

        <div
          ref={sliderRef}
          className={`slider-captcha-button ${isDragging ? 'dragging' : ''}`}
          style={{ left: `${position}px` }}
          onMouseDown={handleMouseDown}
          onTouchStart={handleTouchStart}
        >
          <div className="slider-icon">
            {verified ? '✓' : failed ? '✗' : '››'}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="captcha-hint">
        {isDragging ? `已滑动 ${getProgressPercent()}%` : '按住滑块，向右拖动至最右端'}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});

export default SliderCaptcha;

// ========== 文件: frontend-user/src/components/TableColumnPanel.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, lazy, Suspense } from 'react';
import { publicScholarAPI, analysisDimensionAPI } from '../services/api';
import { useAuth } from '../utils/AuthContext';
import { AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import './TableColumnPanel.css';

// 懒加载 AuthModal
const AuthModal = lazy(() => import('./AuthModal'));

// 生成随机维度标识
const generateDimensionKey = () => {
  const chars = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789';
  let result = 'custom_';
  for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
    result += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
  }
  return result;
};

// 维度数量限制
const MAX_DIMENSIONS = 15;

const TableColumnPanel = ({ onDimensionsChange, selectedDimensionKey, onDimensionSelect, onDimensionsUpdated }) => {
  const { isAuthenticated } = useAuth();
  const [dimensions, setDimensions] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [expandedColumn, setExpandedColumn] = useState(null);
  const [isCustom, setIsCustom] = useState(false);
  // 维度数量限制相关
  const [maxDimensions, setMaxDimensions] = useState(MAX_DIMENSIONS);
  const [customCount, setCustomCount] = useState(0); // 用户新增的自定义维度数量
  // 控制绿色提示的显示/隐藏，从 localStorage 读取初始值
  const [showHint, setShowHint] = useState(() => {
    const hidden = localStorage.getItem('hideTableColumnHint');
    return hidden !== 'true';
  });
  
  // 编辑相关状态
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);
  const [isAdding, setIsAdding] = useState(false); // 是否正在添加新维度
  const [editForm, setEditForm] = useState({ name: '', description: '' });
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  
  // 登录弹窗状态
  const [showAuthModal, setShowAuthModal] = useState(false);

  // 当外部选中维度变化时，同步更新展开状态
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedDimensionKey && selectedDimensionKey !== expandedColumn) {
      setExpandedColumn(selectedDimensionKey);
      setIsEditing(false);
      setIsAdding(false);
      // 初始化编辑表单
      const column = dimensions.find(c => c.dimensionKey === selectedDimensionKey);
      if (column) {
        setEditForm({ name: column.name, description: column.description });
      }
    }
  }, [selectedDimensionKey, dimensions]);

  // 加载分析维度
  const loadDimensions = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      let response;
      if (isAuthenticated) {
        // 已登录用户：获取用户自定义维度或系统默认
        response = await analysisDimensionAPI.getDimensions();
      } else {
        // 未登录用户：获取系统默认维度
        response = await publicScholarAPI.getSystemDimensions();
      }

      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
        const dims = response.data.data.dimensions || [];
        setDimensions(dims);
        setIsCustom(response.data.data.isCustom || false);
        // 设置维度数量限制信息
        if (response.data.data.maxDimensions) {
          setMaxDimensions(response.data.data.maxDimensions);
        }
        if (typeof response.data.data.customCount === 'number') {
          setCustomCount(response.data.data.customCount);
        }
        // 通知父组件维度已更新
        if (onDimensionsChange) {
          onDimensionsChange(dims);
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load dimensions:', err);
      setError('加载分析维度失败');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [isAuthenticated, onDimensionsChange]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadDimensions();
  }, [loadDimensions]);

  const handleColumnClick = (key) => {
    setExpandedColumn(key);
    setIsEditing(false);
    // 初始化编辑表单
    const column = dimensions.find(c => c.dimensionKey === key);
    if (column) {
      setEditForm({ name: column.name, description: column.description });
    }
    // 通知父组件选中了某个维度
    if (onDimensionSelect) {
      onDimensionSelect(key);
    }
  };

  const handleBack = () => {
    setExpandedColumn(null);
    setIsEditing(false);
    // 清除选中状态
    if (onDimensionSelect) {
      onDimensionSelect(null);
    }
  };

  // 切换提示显示状态
  const toggleHint = () => {
    const newValue = !showHint;
    setShowHint(newValue);
    // 保存到 localStorage
    if (newValue) {
      localStorage.removeItem('hideTableColumnHint');
    } else {
      localStorage.setItem('hideTableColumnHint', 'true');
    }
  };

  // 开始编辑
  const handleStartEdit = () => {
    if (!isAuthenticated) {
      alert('请先登录后再编辑维度');
      return;
    }
    setIsEditing(true);
  };

  // 取消编辑
  const handleCancelEdit = () => {
    setIsEditing(false);
    // 恢复原始值
    const column = dimensions.find(c => c.dimensionKey === expandedColumn);
    if (column) {
      setEditForm({ name: column.name, description: column.description });
    }
  };

  // 保存编辑
  const handleSaveEdit = async () => {
    if (!isAuthenticated) {
      alert('请先登录');
      return;
    }

    const column = dimensions.find(c => c.dimensionKey === expandedColumn);
    if (!column) return;

    setSaving(true);
    try {
      let response;
      
      // 判断是用户自定义维度还是系统维度（userId > 0 为用户自定义，-1 为系统默认）
      if (column.userId && column.userId > 0) {
        // 用户自定义维度：直接更新
        response = await analysisDimensionAPI.updateDimension(
          column.id,
          editForm.name,
          editForm.description,
          column.sortOrder
        );
      } else {
        // 系统维度：创建一个同key的用户维度来覆盖
        response = await analysisDimensionAPI.createDimension(
          column.dimensionKey,  // 使用相同的key来覆盖
          editForm.name,
          editForm.description,
          column.sortOrder
        );
      }

      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        // 重新加载维度列表
        await loadDimensions();
        setIsEditing(false);
        // 更新当前展开的维度
        const updatedColumn = dimensions.find(c => c.dimensionKey === expandedColumn);
        if (updatedColumn) {
          setEditForm({ name: updatedColumn.name, description: updatedColumn.description });
        }
        // 通知父组件维度已更新，需要重新加载表格数据
        if (onDimensionsUpdated) {
          onDimensionsUpdated('edit', editForm.name);
        }
      } else {
        alert('保存失败: ' + (response.data.message || '未知错误'));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to save dimension:', err);
      alert('保存失败: ' + (err.response?.data?.message || err.message));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  // 检查是否已达到维度数量上限
  const isAtMaxDimensions = dimensions.length >= maxDimensions;

  // 添加自定义维度 - 进入添加模式
  const handleAddDimension = () => {
    if (!isAuthenticated) {
      alert('请先登录后再添加自定义维度');
      return;
    }
    // 检查维度数量限制
    if (isAtMaxDimensions) {
      alert(`已达到维度数量上限（${maxDimensions}个），请删除部分自定义维度后再添加`);
      return;
    }
    setIsAdding(true);
    setIsEditing(true);
    setExpandedColumn('__new__'); // 特殊标记表示新建
    setEditForm({ name: '', description: '' });
  };

  // 保存新维度
  const handleSaveNewDimension = async () => {
    if (!isAuthenticated) {
      alert('请先登录');
      return;
    }

    if (!editForm.name.trim() || !editForm.description.trim()) {
      alert('请填写完整的维度信息');
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);
    try {
      // 生成随机维度标识
      const dimensionKey = generateDimensionKey();
      
      // 计算排序顺序（放在最后）
      const maxSortOrder = dimensions.length > 0 
        ? Math.max(...dimensions.map(d => d.sortOrder || 0)) 
        : 0;

      // 创建新维度
      const response = await analysisDimensionAPI.createDimension(
        dimensionKey,
        editForm.name,
        editForm.description,
        maxSortOrder + 1
      );

      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        // 重新加载维度列表
        await loadDimensions();
        // 退出添加模式
        setIsAdding(false);
        setIsEditing(false);
        setExpandedColumn(null);
        // 通知父组件维度已更新，需要重新加载表格数据
        if (onDimensionsUpdated) {
          onDimensionsUpdated('add', editForm.name);
        }
      } else {
        alert('创建失败: ' + (response.data.message || '未知错误'));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to create dimension:', err);
      alert('创建失败: ' + (err.response?.data?.message || err.message));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  // 取消添加
  const handleCancelAdd = () => {
    setIsAdding(false);
    setIsEditing(false);
    setExpandedColumn(null);
    setEditForm({ name: '', description: '' });
  };

  // 打开登录弹窗
  const handleOpenAuthModal = () => {
    setShowAuthModal(true);
  };

  // 登录成功回调
  const handleLoginSuccess = () => {
    setShowAuthModal(false);
    // 设置标记，让页面刷新后自动切换到表格视图
    localStorage.setItem('returnToTableView', 'true');
    // 刷新页面以重新加载数据
    window.location.reload();
  };

  // 加载中状态
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="tcp-container">
        <div className="tcp-loading">
          <div className="tcp-loading-spinner"></div>
          <span>加载中...</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // 错误状态
  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="tcp-container">
        <div className="tcp-error">
          <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/>
            <line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="12"/>
            <line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12.01" y2="16"/>
          </svg>
          <span>{error}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // 新建维度视图
  if (isAdding && expandedColumn === '__new__') {
    return (
      <div className="tcp-container">
        <div className="tcp-detail-header">
          <button className="tcp-back-btn" onClick={handleCancelAdd}>
            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <path d="M19 12H5M12 19l-7-7 7-7"/>
            </svg>
            返回
          </button>
          <span className="tcp-detail-title">新建维度</span>
        </div>
        
        <div className="tcp-detail-content">
          <div className="tcp-detail-section">
            <h4 className="tcp-detail-label">名称 <span className="tcp-required">*</span></h4>
            <input
              type="text"
              className="tcp-input"
              value={editForm.name}
              onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, name: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="例如：研究方法"
              autoFocus
            />
          </div>
          <div className="tcp-detail-section">
            <h4 className="tcp-detail-label">分析指示 <span className="tcp-required">*</span></h4>
            <textarea
              className="tcp-textarea"
              value={editForm.description}
              onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, description: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="描述AI应该如何分析这个维度，例如：提取论文中使用的研究方法，包括定量研究、定性研究、混合方法等"
              rows={8}
            />
            <p className="tcp-input-hint">描述AI分析论文摘要时应该关注的内容和提取方式</p>
          </div>
          
          {/* 操作按钮 */}
          <div className="tcp-edit-actions">
            <button 
              className="tcp-btn tcp-btn-secondary" 
              onClick={handleCancelAdd}
              disabled={saving}
            >
              取消
            </button>
            <button 
              className="tcp-btn tcp-btn-primary" 
              onClick={handleSaveNewDimension}
              disabled={saving || !editForm.name.trim() || !editForm.description.trim()}
            >
              {saving ? (
                <>
                  <div className="tcp-btn-spinner"></div>
                  <span>创建中...</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                    <line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/>
                    <line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/>
                  </svg>
                  <span>创建维度</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // 展开的列详情视图
  if (expandedColumn && expandedColumn !== '__new__') {
    const column = dimensions.find(c => c.dimensionKey === expandedColumn);
    if (!column) {
      setExpandedColumn(null);
      return null;
    }

    return (
      <div className="tcp-container">
        <div className="tcp-detail-header">
          <button className="tcp-back-btn" onClick={handleBack}>
            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <path d="M19 12H5M12 19l-7-7 7-7"/>
            </svg>
            返回
          </button>
          <span className="tcp-detail-title">列详情</span>
          {!isEditing && isAuthenticated && (
            <button className="tcp-edit-btn" onClick={handleStartEdit} title="编辑">
              <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                <path d="M11 4H4a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h14a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-7"/>
                <path d="M18.5 2.5a2.121 2.121 0 0 1 3 3L12 15l-4 1 1-4 9.5-9.5z"/>
              </svg>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
        
        <div className="tcp-detail-content">
          {isEditing ? (
            // 编辑模式
            <>
              <div className="tcp-detail-section">
                <h4 className="tcp-detail-label">名称 <span className="tcp-required">*</span></h4>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  className="tcp-input"
                  value={editForm.name}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, name: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="输入维度名称"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="tcp-detail-section">
                <h4 className="tcp-detail-label">分析指示 <span className="tcp-required">*</span></h4>
                <textarea
                  className="tcp-textarea"
                  value={editForm.description}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, description: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="输入分析指示，描述AI应该如何分析这个维度"
                  rows={8}
                />
                <p className="tcp-input-hint">描述AI分析论文摘要时应该关注的内容和提取方式</p>
              </div>
              
              {/* 编辑操作按钮 */}
              <div className="tcp-edit-actions">
                <button 
                  className="tcp-btn tcp-btn-secondary" 
                  onClick={handleCancelEdit}
                  disabled={saving}
                >
                  取消
                </button>
                <button 
                  className="tcp-btn tcp-btn-primary" 
                  onClick={handleSaveEdit}
                  disabled={saving || !editForm.name.trim() || !editForm.description.trim()}
                >
                  {saving ? (
                    <>
                      <div className="tcp-btn-spinner"></div>
                      <span>保存中...</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                        <path d="M19 21H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h11l5 5v11a2 2 0 0 1-2 2z"/>
                        <polyline points="17 21 17 13 7 13 7 21"/>
                        <polyline points="7 3 7 8 15 8"/>
                      </svg>
                      <span>保存</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            </>
          ) : (
            // 查看模式
            <>
              <div className="tcp-detail-section">
                <h4 className="tcp-detail-label">名称</h4>
                <p className="tcp-detail-value">{column.name}</p>
              </div>
              <div className="tcp-detail-section">
                <h4 className="tcp-detail-label">分析指示</h4>
                <p className="tcp-detail-value tcp-detail-description">{column.description}</p>
              </div>
              {column.userId && column.userId > 0 && (
                <div className="tcp-detail-section">
                  <span className="tcp-custom-badge-large">自定义维度</span>
                </div>
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // 列列表视图
  return (
    <div className="tcp-container">
      <div className="tcp-header">
        <h3 className="tcp-title">列</h3>
        <button 
          className="tcp-info-btn"
          title={showHint ? "隐藏提示" : "显示提示"}
          onClick={toggleHint}
        >
          <AlertCircle size={18} />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* 添加提取列提示 - 可隐藏 */}
      {showHint && (
        <div className="tcp-add-hint">
          <div className="tcp-add-icon">
            <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/>
              <path d="M9 12l2 2 4-4"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div className="tcp-add-text">
            <h4>添加提取列</h4>
            <p>使用建议的提取列或添加您自己的提取列。评估提取结果并根据需要完善列定义。</p>
            <button className="tcp-hide-btn" onClick={toggleHint}>隐藏</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 列列表 */}
      <div className="tcp-list">
        {dimensions.map((column) => (
          <div 
            key={column.dimensionKey} 
            className={`tcp-list-item ${column.userId && column.userId > 0 ? 'tcp-list-item-custom' : ''}`}
            onClick={() => handleColumnClick(column.dimensionKey)}
          >
            <div className="tcp-item-icon">
              <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                <line x1="3" y1="6" x2="21" y2="6"/>
                <line x1="3" y1="12" x2="21" y2="12"/>
                <line x1="3" y1="18" x2="21" y2="18"/>
              </svg>
            </div>
            <span className="tcp-item-name">{column.name}</span>
            {column.userId && column.userId > 0 && (
              <span className="tcp-item-custom-tag">自定义</span>
            )}
            <svg className="tcp-item-arrow" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <path d="M9 18l6-6-6-6"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* 添加自定义维度按钮 / 登录引导 */}
      <div className="tcp-add-dimension">
        {isAuthenticated ? (
          <>
            {/* 维度数量提示 */}
            <div className="tcp-dimension-count">
              <span className={`tcp-count-text ${isAtMaxDimensions ? 'tcp-count-max' : ''}`}>
                {dimensions.length} / {maxDimensions} 个维度
                {customCount > 0 && <span className="tcp-count-custom">（{customCount}个自定义）</span>}
              </span>
            </div>
            <button 
              className={`tcp-add-dimension-btn ${isAtMaxDimensions ? 'tcp-add-dimension-btn-disabled' : ''}`}
              onClick={handleAddDimension}
              disabled={isAtMaxDimensions}
              title={isAtMaxDimensions ? `已达到维度数量上限（${maxDimensions}个）` : '添加自定义维度'}
            >
              <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                <line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/>
                <line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/>
              </svg>
              <span>{isAtMaxDimensions ? '已达上限' : '添加自定义维度'}</span>
            </button>
            {isAtMaxDimensions && (
              <p className="tcp-max-hint">删除部分自定义维度后可继续添加</p>
            )}
          </>
        ) : (
          <div className="tcp-login-prompt">
            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <rect x="3" y="11" width="18" height="11" rx="2" ry="2"/>
              <path d="M7 11V7a5 5 0 0 1 10 0v4"/>
            </svg>
            <p>登录后可自定义维度</p>
            <button className="tcp-login-btn" onClick={handleOpenAuthModal}>
              登录
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* 登录弹窗 */}
      {showAuthModal && (
        <Suspense fallback={null}>
          <AuthModal
            isOpen={showAuthModal}
            onClose={() => setShowAuthModal(false)}
            onLoginSuccess={handleLoginSuccess}
          />
        </Suspense>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default TableColumnPanel;

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { X } from 'lucide-react';
import './TableViewGuide.css';

// 模拟的分析数据
const mockData = [
  {
    title: 'Big Data Analytics in Healthcare Systems',

    year: 2024,
    citations: 128,
    analysis: {
      studyType: '系统综述',
      technologies: 'Hadoop, Spark',

    }

    analysis: {

      technologies: 'TensorFlow, PyTorch',

      keyFindings: '预测精度达92%',
    }

      technologies: 'Kafka, Flink',
      useCases: '实时监控、智能制造',
      keyFindings: '延迟降至毫秒级',
    }
  },
];

const TableViewGuide = ({ onClose, onTryIt, onDismiss, targetRef }) => {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const [typingRow, setTypingRow] = useState(-1);
  const [arrowPosition, setArrowPosition] = useState({ top: 0, left: 0 });
  const [modalPosition, setModalPosition] = useState({ top: 'auto', right: 'auto', transform: 'translateY(-50%)' });

  useEffect(() => {
    // 计算箭头位置和弹窗位置（弹窗在按钮左侧，箭头从弹窗指向按钮）
    const calculatePositions = () => {
    if (targetRef?.current) {
      const rect = targetRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
        const viewportHeight = window.innerHeight;
        const viewportWidth = window.innerWidth;
        
        // 按钮中心点的垂直位置
        const buttonCenterY = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
        // 按钮左边缘
        const buttonLeft = rect.left;
        
        // 箭头+线的总宽度 (线60px + 箭头10px)
        const arrowTotalWidth = 70;
        // 弹窗和箭头之间的间距
        const gapToArrow = 8;
        
        // 弹窗右边缘位置 = 按钮左边 - 箭头宽度 - 间距
        const modalRightX = buttonLeft - arrowTotalWidth - gapToArrow;
        
        // 弹窗垂直位置 - 与按钮中心对齐，但确保不超出视口
        const modalHeight = 480;
        let modalCenterY = buttonCenterY;
        const minY = modalHeight / 2 + 20;
        const maxY = viewportHeight - modalHeight / 2 - 20;
        modalCenterY = Math.max(minY, Math.min(maxY, modalCenterY));
        
        // 箭头位置 - 箭头尖端靠近按钮
      setArrowPosition({
          top: buttonCenterY,
          left: buttonLeft - 8, // 箭头尖端距离按钮8px
        });
        
        // 弹窗位置 - 使用 right 定位，弹窗右边缘到视口右边的距离
        const modalRightFromViewport = viewportWidth - modalRightX;
        setModalPosition({
          top: `${modalCenterY}px`,
          right: `${modalRightFromViewport}px`,
          transform: 'translateY(-50%)', // 只垂直居中
      });
    }
    };
    
    calculatePositions();
    
    // 监听窗口大小变化
    window.addEventListener('resize', calculatePositions);
    
    // 延迟显示动画
    setTimeout(() => setVisible(true), 100);
    
    // 逐行显示动画
    let row = 0;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setTypingRow(row);
      row++;
      if (row >= mockData.length) {
        clearInterval(timer);
      }
    }, 600);

    return () => {
      clearInterval(timer);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', calculatePositions);
    };
  }, [targetRef]);

  // X 按钮 - 只关闭弹窗，下次还会显示
  const handleDismiss = () => {
    setVisible(false);
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (onDismiss) {
        onDismiss();
      } else {
        onClose();
      }
    }, 200);
  };

  // "稍后再说" 按钮 - 关闭并记住，下次不再显示
  const handleClose = () => {
    setVisible(false);
    setTimeout(onClose, 200);
  };

  // "立即体验" 按钮
  const handleTryIt = () => {
    setVisible(false);
    setTimeout(() => {
      onClose();
      onTryIt();
    }, 200);
  };

  // 计算高亮区域（表格按钮）
  const [highlightRect, setHighlightRect] = useState(null);
  
  useEffect(() => {
    if (targetRef?.current && visible) {
      const rect = targetRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      setHighlightRect({
        top: rect.top - 6,
        left: rect.left - 6,
        width: rect.width + 12,
        height: rect.height + 12,
      });
    }
  }, [targetRef, visible]);

  return (
    <div className={`tvg-overlay ${visible ? 'tvg-visible' : ''}`}>
      {/* 遮罩层 - 使用 clip-path 留出高亮区域，点击蒙层关闭但下次还会显示 */}
      <div 
        className="tvg-mask"
        onClick={handleDismiss}
        style={highlightRect ? {
          clipPath: `polygon(
            0% 0%, 
            0% 100%, 
            ${highlightRect.left}px 100%, 
            ${highlightRect.left}px ${highlightRect.top}px, 
            ${highlightRect.left + highlightRect.width}px ${highlightRect.top}px, 
            ${highlightRect.left + highlightRect.width}px ${highlightRect.top + highlightRect.height}px, 
            ${highlightRect.left}px ${highlightRect.top + highlightRect.height}px, 
            ${highlightRect.left}px 100%, 
            100% 100%, 
            100% 0%
          )`
        } : {}}
      />
      
      {/* 高亮边框 */}
      {highlightRect && (
        <div 
          className={`tvg-highlight ${visible ? 'tvg-highlight-show' : ''}`}
          style={{
            top: highlightRect.top,
            left: highlightRect.left,
            width: highlightRect.width,
            height: highlightRect.height,
          }}
        />
      )}
      
      {/* 指向表格按钮的箭头 - 水平方向，从左向右指 */}
      {arrowPosition.left > 0 && (
        <div 
          className={`tvg-pointer ${visible ? 'tvg-pointer-show' : ''}`}
          style={{ 
            top: arrowPosition.top, 
            left: arrowPosition.left,
            transform: 'translate(-100%, -50%)', // 箭头尖端对齐到 left 位置
          }}
        >
          <div className="tvg-pointer-line" />
          <div className="tvg-pointer-arrow" />
        </div>
      )}
      
      <div 
        className="tvg-modal" 
        onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          top: modalPosition.top,
          right: modalPosition.right,
          left: 'auto',
          transform: modalPosition.transform,
        }}
      >
        {/* 关闭按钮 - 点击后下次还会显示 */}
        <button className="tvg-close-btn" onClick={handleDismiss}>
          <X size={18} />
        </button>

        {/* 头部 */}
        <div className="tvg-header">
          <div className="tvg-badge">新功能</div>
          <h3>AI 智能表格分析</h3>
          <p>自动提取论文关键信息，多维度对比研究成果</p>
        </div>

        {/* 模拟表格预览 */}
        <div className="tvg-preview">
          <div className="tvg-table-container">
            <table className="tvg-table">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th className="tvg-th-paper">论文</th>
                  <th>研究类型</th>
                  <th>技术/平台</th>
                  <th>使用场景</th>
                  <th>关键发现</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {mockData.map((paper, index) => (
                  <tr 
                    key={index} 
                    className={`tvg-row ${index <= typingRow ? 'tvg-row-show' : ''}`}
                  >
                    <td className="tvg-td-paper">
                      <div className="tvg-paper-title">{paper.title}</div>
                      <div className="tvg-paper-meta">
                        {paper.authors} · {paper.year} · {paper.citations}引用
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td>
                      <span className={`tvg-cell ${index <= typingRow ? 'tvg-cell-show' : ''}`}>
                        {paper.analysis.studyType}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td>
                      <span className={`tvg-cell ${index <= typingRow ? 'tvg-cell-show' : ''}`}>
                        {paper.analysis.technologies}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td>
                      <span className={`tvg-cell ${index <= typingRow ? 'tvg-cell-show' : ''}`}>
                        {paper.analysis.useCases}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td>
                      <span className={`tvg-cell ${index <= typingRow ? 'tvg-cell-show' : ''}`}>
                        {paper.analysis.keyFindings}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
          
          {/* 渐变遮罩 */}
          <div className="tvg-preview-fade" />
        </div>

        {/* 功能亮点 */}
        <div className="tvg-features">
          <div className="tvg-feature">
            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <path d="M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14"/>
              <polyline points="22 4 12 14.01 9 11.01"/>
            </svg>
            <span>AI 自动分析</span>
          </div>
          <div className="tvg-feature">
            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <path d="M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14"/>
              <polyline points="22 4 12 14.01 9 11.01"/>
            </svg>
            <span>多维度对比</span>
          </div>
          <div className="tvg-feature">
            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">

// ========== 文件: frontend-user/src/components/Toast.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import './Toast.css';

/**
 * Toast notification component
 * @param {string} message - The message to display
 * @param {string} type - Type of toast: 'success', 'error', 'warning', 'info'
 * @param {number} duration - Duration in milliseconds (default: 3000)
 * @param {function} onClose - Callback when toast closes
 */
const Toast = ({ message, type = 'info', duration = 3000, onClose }) => {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (duration > 0) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        onClose();
      }, duration);

      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [duration, onClose]);

  const getIcon = () => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'success':
        return (
          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
            <path d="M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14"></path>
            <polyline points="22 4 12 14.01 9 11.01"></polyline>
          </svg>
        );
      case 'error':
        return (
          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle>
            <line x1="15" y1="9" x2="9" y2="15"></line>
            <line x1="9" y1="9" x2="15" y2="15"></line>
          </svg>
        );
      case 'warning':
        return (
          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
            <path d="M10.29 3.86L1.82 18a2 2 0 0 0 1.71 3h16.94a2 2 0 0 0 1.71-3L13.71 3.86a2 2 0 0 0-3.42 0z"></path>
            <line x1="12" y1="9" x2="12" y2="13"></line>
            <line x1="12" y1="17" x2="12.01" y2="17"></line>
          </svg>
        );
      case 'info':
      default:
        return (
          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle>
            <line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12" y2="12"></line>
            <line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12.01" y2="8"></line>
          </svg>
        );
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={`toast toast-${type}`}>
      <div className="toast-icon">{getIcon()}</div>
      <div className="toast-message">{message}</div>
      <button className="toast-close" onClick={onClose}>
        <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
          <line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"></line>
          <line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"></line>
        </svg>
      </button>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Toast;

// ========== 文件: frontend-user/src/components/ToastContainer.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import Toast from './Toast';
import ErrorDialog from './ErrorDialog';
import './Toast.css';

const ToastContext = createContext();

export const useToast = () => {
  const context = useContext(ToastContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useToast must be used within ToastProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

export const ToastProvider = ({ children }) => {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState([]);
  const [errorDialog, setErrorDialog] = useState(null);

  const showToast = useCallback((message, type = 'info', duration = 3000) => {
    const id = Date.now() + Math.random();
    const toast = { id, message, type, duration };

    setToasts((prevToasts) => [...prevToasts, toast]);

    return id;
  }, []);

  const hideToast = useCallback((id) => {
    setToasts((prevToasts) => prevToasts.filter((toast) => toast.id !== id));
  }, []);

  const showSuccess = useCallback((message, duration = 3000) => {
    return showToast(message, 'success', duration);
  }, [showToast]);

  // showError now shows a modal dialog that requires user acknowledgment
  const showError = useCallback((message, title = '错误') => {
    setErrorDialog({ message, title });
  }, []);

  const hideError = useCallback(() => {
    setErrorDialog(null);
  }, []);

  const showWarning = useCallback((message, duration = 3000) => {
    return showToast(message, 'warning', duration);
  }, [showToast]);

  const showInfo = useCallback((message, duration = 3000) => {
    return showToast(message, 'info', duration);
  }, [showToast]);

  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider
      value={{
        showToast,
        hideToast,
        showSuccess,
        showError,
        showWarning,
        showInfo,
      }}
    >
      {children}
      <div className="toast-container">
        {toasts.map((toast) => (
          <Toast
            key={toast.id}
            message={toast.message}
            type={toast.type}
            duration={toast.duration}
            onClose={() => hideToast(toast.id)}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
      {errorDialog && (
        <ErrorDialog
          message={errorDialog.message}
          title={errorDialog.title}
          onClose={hideError}
        />
      )}
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  );
};

// ========== 文件: frontend-user/src/components/TurnstileCaptcha.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React, { forwardRef, useImperativeHandle, useRef, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Turnstile } from '@marsidev/react-turnstile';
import './TurnstileCaptcha.css';

/**
 * TurnstileCaptcha - Cloudflare Turnstile CAPTCHA component
 *
 * Props:
 *  - onSuccess: Callback when verification succeeds (receives token)
 *  - onFail: Callback when verification fails
 *  - onExpire: Callback when token expires
 *  - theme: 'light' or 'dark' (default: 'dark')
 *
 * Ref methods:
 *  - reset(): Reset the captcha
 */
const TurnstileCaptcha = forwardRef(({ onSuccess, onFail, onExpire, theme = 'dark' }, ref) => {
  const turnstileRef = useRef(null);
  const [config, setConfig] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  // Fetch system configuration on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchConfig = async () => {
      try {
        const response = await fetch('/api/v1/config/system');
        const data = await response.json();
        if (data.code === 0 && data.data) {
          setConfig(data.data);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('[Turnstile] Failed to load system config:', err);
        // Use fallback config if fetch fails
        setConfig({
          enable_turnstile: false,
          turnstile_site_key: '1x00000000000000000000AA'
        });
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    fetchConfig();
  }, []);

  // Expose reset method to parent
  useImperativeHandle(ref, () => ({
    reset: () => {
      if (turnstileRef.current) {
        turnstileRef.current.reset();
      }
    }
  }));

  // If Turnstile is disabled, call onSuccess immediately with empty token
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!loading && config && !config.enable_turnstile) {
      console.log('[Turnstile] Turnstile is disabled, auto-succeeding');
      if (onSuccess) onSuccess('');
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [loading, config]);

  // Don't render anything while loading or if Turnstile is disabled
  if (loading || !config || !config.enable_turnstile) {
    return null;
  }

  // Get site key from config or use test key as fallback
  const siteKey = config.turnstile_site_key || '1x00000000000000000000AA';

  return (
    <div className="turnstile-container">
      <Turnstile
        ref={turnstileRef}
        siteKey={siteKey}
        onSuccess={(token) => {
          console.log('[Turnstile] Verification successful');
          if (onSuccess) onSuccess(token);
        }}
        onError={() => {
          console.error('[Turnstile] Verification error');
          if (onFail) onFail();
        }}
        onExpire={() => {
          console.log('[Turnstile] Token expired');
          if (onExpire) onExpire();
        }}
        options={{
          theme: theme,
          size: 'normal',
          action: 'login',
          cData: 'scholar-auth'
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
});

TurnstileCaptcha.displayName = 'TurnstileCaptcha';

export default TurnstileCaptcha;

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';

const UnifiedSidebar = ({
  user,
  onLogout,
  collapsed,
  onToggleCollapse,
  // 历史记录相关 props
  showHistory = false, // 是否显示历史记录部分
  historyType = 'conversation', // 'conversation' 或 'search'
  historyItems = [], // 历史记录列表
  currentItemId = null, // 当前选中的项目ID
  onSelectItem = null, // 选择历史记录项的回调
  onDeleteItem = null, // 删除历史记录项的回调
  onNewItem = null, // 新建项目的回调
  historyLoading = false // 历史记录加载状态
}) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const { theme, toggleTheme } = useTheme();
  const [showUserMenu, setShowUserMenu] = useState(false);
  const [logoHovered, setLogoHovered] = useState(false);
  const userMenuRef = useRef(null);
  const avatarRef = useRef(null);
  const [menuPosition, setMenuPosition] = useState({ top: 0, left: 0 });
  const [subscription, setSubscription] = useState(null);

  // 获取订阅信息
  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchSubscription = async () => {
      try {
        const response = await api.get('/user/subscription/my');
        if (response.data.code === 0) {
          setSubscription(response.data.data);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to fetch subscription:', error);
      }
    };

    if (user) {
      fetchSubscription();
    }
  }, [user]);

  // 点击外部关闭用户菜单
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event) => {
      if (showUserMenu &&
          userMenuRef.current &&
          !userMenuRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
        setShowUserMenu(false);
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, [showUserMenu]);

  // 获取用户头像首字母
  const getUserInitial = () => {
    if (!user || !user.email) return '?';
    return user.email.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
  };

  // 更新菜单位置 - 向上弹出
  const updateMenuPosition = () => {
    if (avatarRef.current) {
      const rect = avatarRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      setMenuPosition({
        bottom: window.innerHeight - rect.top + 8,
        left: collapsed ? rect.left : rect.left
      });
    }
  };

  // 当显示菜单时更新位置
  useEffect(() => {
    if (showUserMenu) {
      updateMenuPosition();
      window.addEventListener('resize', updateMenuPosition);
      window.addEventListener('scroll', updateMenuPosition);
      return () => {
        window.removeEventListener('resize', updateMenuPosition);
        window.removeEventListener('scroll', updateMenuPosition);
      };
    }
  }, [showUserMenu, collapsed]);

  // Logo点击处理
  const handleLogoClick = () => {
    if (collapsed) {
      onToggleCollapse();
    } else {
      navigate('/');
    }
  };

  // 格式化时间
  const formatDate = (dateString) => {
    const date = new Date(dateString);
    const now = new Date();
    const diffMs = now - date;
    const diffMins = Math.floor(diffMs / 60000);
    const diffHours = Math.floor(diffMs / 3600000);
    const diffDays = Math.floor(diffMs / 86400000);

    if (diffMins < 1) return '刚刚';
    if (diffMins < 60) return `${diffMins}分钟前`;
    if (diffHours < 24) return `${diffHours}小时前`;
    if (diffDays < 7) return `${diffDays}天前`;
    return date.toLocaleDateString('zh-CN');
  };

  // 处理删除
  const handleDelete = (e, itemId) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!window.confirm(historyType === 'conversation' ? '确定删除这个对话吗？' : '确定删除这条搜索记录吗？')) return;

    if (onDeleteItem) {
      onDeleteItem(itemId);
    }
  };

  // 判断当前页面
  const isSearchPage = location.pathname === '/search-results';
  const isAdvancedSearchPage = location.pathname === '/advanced-search';

  return (
    <div className={`unified-sidebar ${collapsed ? 'collapsed' : ''}`}>
      {/* 顶部Logo区域 */}
      <div className="unified-sidebar-header">
        <div className="sidebar-header-top">
          <div
            className={`sidebar-logo ${collapsed ? 'collapsed-logo' : ''}`}
            onClick={handleLogoClick}
            onMouseEnter={() => collapsed && setLogoHovered(true)}
            onMouseLeave={() => setLogoHovered(false)}
            style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}
            title={collapsed ? '展开侧边栏' : '返回首页'}
          >
            {collapsed && logoHovered ? (
              // 收起状态且hover时显示展开图标
              <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                <path d="M6.83496 3.99992C6.38353 4.00411 6.01421 4.0122 5.69824 4.03801C5.31232 4.06954 5.03904 4.12266 4.82227 4.20012L4.62207 4.28606C4.18264 4.50996 3.81498 4.85035 3.55859 5.26848L3.45605 5.45207C3.33013 5.69922 3.25006 6.01354 3.20801 6.52824C3.16533 7.05065 3.16504 7.71885 3.16504 8.66301V11.3271C3.16504 12.2712 3.16533 12.9394 3.20801 13.4618C3.25006 13.9766 3.33013 14.2909 3.45605 14.538L3.55859 14.7216C3.81498 15.1397 4.18266 15.4801 4.62207 15.704L4.82227 15.79C5.03904 15.8674 5.31234 15.9205 5.69824 15.9521C6.01398 15.9779 6.383 15.986 6.83398 15.9902L6.83496 3.99992ZM18.165 11.3271C18.165 12.2493 18.1653 12.9811 18.1172 13.5702C18.0745 14.0924 17.9916 14.5472 17.8125 14.9648L17.7295 15.1415C17.394 15.8 16.8834 16.3511 16.2568 16.7353L15.9814 16.8896C15.5157 17.1268 15.0069 17.2285 14.4102 17.2773C13.821 17.3254 13.0893 17.3251 12.167 17.3251H7.83301C6.91071 17.3251 6.17898 17.3254 5.58984 17.2773C5.06757 17.2346 4.61294 17.1508 4.19531 16.9716L4.01855 16.8896C3.36014 16.5541 2.80898 16.0434 2.4248 15.4169L2.27051 15.1415C2.03328 14.6758 1.93158 14.167 1.88281 13.5702C1.83468 12.9811 1.83496 12.2493 1.83496 11.3271V8.66301C1.83496 7.74072 1.83468 7.00898 1.88281 6.41985C1.93157 5.82309 2.03329 5.31432 2.27051 4.84856L2.4248 4.57317C2.80898 3.94666 3.36012 3.436 4.01855 3.10051L4.19531 3.0175C4.61285 2.83843 5.06771 2.75548 5.58984 2.71281C6.17898 2.66468 6.91071 2.66496 7.83301 2.66496H12.167C13.0893 2.66496 13.821 2.66468 14.4102 2.71281C15.0069 2.76157 15.5157 2.86329 15.9814 3.10051L16.2568 3.25481C16.8833 3.63898 17.394 4.19012 17.7295 4.84856L17.8125 5.02531C17.9916 5.44285 18.0745 5.89771 18.1172 6.41985C18.1653 7.00898 18.165 7.74072 18.165 8.66301V11.3271ZM8.16406 15.995H12.167C13.1112 15.995 13.7794 15.9947 14.3018 15.9521C14.8164 15.91 15.1308 15.8299 15.3779 15.704L15.5615 15.6015C15.9797 15.3451 16.32 14.9774 16.5439 14.538L16.6299 14.3378C16.7074 14.121 16.7605 13.8478 16.792 13.4618C16.8347 12.9394 16.835 12.2712 16.835 11.3271V8.66301C16.835 7.71885 16.8347 7.05065 16.792 6.52824C16.7605 6.14232 16.7073 5.86904 16.6299 5.65227L16.5439 5.45207C16.32 5.01264 15.9796 4.64498 15.5615 4.3886L15.3779 4.28606C15.1308 4.16013 14.8165 4.08006 14.3018 4.03801C13.7794 3.99533 13.1112 3.99504 12.167 3.99504H8.16406C8.16407 3.99667 8.16504 3.99829 8.16504 3.99992L8.16406 15.995Z"></path>
              </svg>
            ) : (
              // 默认显示Logo
              <Logo width={20} height={20} variant="color" />
            )}
          </div>

          {/* 收起按钮 - 展开状态显示 */}
          <button
            className={`sidebar-collapse-btn ${collapsed ? 'hidden' : ''}`}
            onClick={onToggleCollapse}
            title="收起侧边栏"
            style={{ pointerEvents: collapsed ? 'none' : 'auto' }}
          >
            <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
              <path d="M6.83496 3.99992C6.38353 4.00411 6.01421 4.0122 5.69824 4.03801C5.31232 4.06954 5.03904 4.12266 4.82227 4.20012L4.62207 4.28606C4.18264 4.50996 3.81498 4.85035 3.55859 5.26848L3.45605 5.45207C3.33013 5.69922 3.25006 6.01354 3.20801 6.52824C3.16533 7.05065 3.16504 7.71885 3.16504 8.66301V11.3271C3.16504 12.2712 3.16533 12.9394 3.20801 13.4618C3.25006 13.9766 3.33013 16.9716L4.01855 16.8896C3.36014 16.5541 2.80898 16.0434 2.4248 15.4169L2.27051 15.1415C2.03328 14.6758 1.93158 14.167 1.88281 13.5702C1.83468 12.9811 1.83496 12.2493 1.83496 11.3271V8.66301C1.83496 7.74072 1.83468 7.00898 1.88281 6.41985C1.93157 5.82309 2.03329 5.31432 2.27051 4.84856L2.4248 4.57317C2.80898 3.94666 3.36012 3.436 4.01855 3.10051L4.19531 3.0175C4.61285 2.83843 5.06771 2.75548 5.58984 2.71281C6.17898 2.66468 6.91071 2.66496 7.83301 2.66496H12.167C13.0893 2.66496 13.821 2.66468 14.4102 2.71281C15.0069 2.76157 15.5157 2.86329 15.9814 3.10051L16.2568 3.25481C16.8833 3.63898 17.394 4.19012 17.7295 4.84856L17.8125 5.02531C17.9916 5.44285 18.0745 5.89771 18.1172 6.41985C18.1653 7.00898 18.165 7.74072 18.165 8.66301V11.3271ZM8.16406 15.995H12.167C13.1112 15.995 13.7794 12.9394 16.835 12.2712 16.835 11.3271V8.66301C16.835 7.71885 16.8347 7.05065 16.792 6.52824C16.7605 6.14232 16.7073 5.86904 16.6299 5.65227L16.5439 5.45207C16.32 5.01264 15.9796 4.64498 15.5615             </svg>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 侧边栏内容区域 */}
      {!collapsed && (
        <div className="unified-sidebar-content">
          {/* 第一部分: 功能导航 */}
          <div className="sidebar-section navigation-section">
            <div className="section-title">功能</div>
            <div className="navigation-items">
              <button
                className={`nav-item ${isSearchPage ? 'active' : ''}`}
                onClick={() => navigate('/search-results?query=')}
                title="学术检索"
              >
                <NormalSearchIcon size={20} />
                <span>学术检索</span>
              </button>

              <button
                className={`nav-item ${isAdvancedSearchPage ? 'active' : ''}`}
                onClick={() => navigate('/advanced-search')}
                title="智能分析"
              >
                <AdvancedSearchIcon size={20} />
                <span>智能分析</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 第二部分: 历史记录 (仅在搜索页面显示) */}
          {showHistory && (
            <>
              <div className="sidebar-divider"></div>
              <div className="sidebar-section history-section">
                <div className="section-header">
                  <div className="section-title">
                    {historyType === 'conversation' ? '对话历史' : '搜索历史'}
                  </div>
                  {onNewItem && (
                    <button
                      className="btn-new-item"
                      onClick={onNewItem}
                      title={historyType === 'conversation' ? '新建对话' : '新建搜索'}
                    >
                      <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                        <path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/>
                      </svg>
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="history-list">
                  {historyLoading ? (
                    <div className="history-loading">加载中...</div>
                  ) : historyItems.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="history-empty">
                      <p>暂无{historyType === 'conversation' ? '对话' : '搜索'}记录</p>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    historyItems.map((item) => (
                      <div
                        key={item.id}
                        className={`history-item ${currentItemId === item.id ? 'active' : ''}`}
                        onClick={() => onSelectItem && onSelectItem(item.id)}
                      >
                        <div className="history-content">
                          <div className="history-title">
                            {item.title || item.query || '未命名'}
                          </div>
                          {item.updated_at && (
                            <div className="history-time">
                              {formatDate(item.updated_at)}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        {onDeleteItem && (
                          <button
                            className="btn-delete-item"
                            onClick={(e) => handleDelete(e, item.id)}
                            title="删除"
                          >
                            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                              <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M9 2a1 1 0 00-.894.553L7.382 4H4a1 1 0 000 2v10a2 2 0 002 2h8a2 2 0 002-2V6a1 1 0 100-2h-3.382l-.724-1.447A1 1 0 0011 2H9zM7 8a1 1 0 012 0v6a1 1 0 11-2 0V8zm5-1a1 1 0 00-1 1v6a1 1 0 102 0V8a1 1 0 00-1-1z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
                            </svg>
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    ))
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 底部用户信息区域 */}
      <div className="sidebar-user-section sidebar-footer">
        <div
          ref={avatarRef}
          className="sidebar-user-info"
          onClick={() => setShowUserMenu(!showUserMenu)}
          title={collapsed ? user?.email : ''}
        >
          <div className="user-avatar">
            {getUserInitial()}
          </div>
          {!collapsed && (
            <div className="user-email-wrapper">
              <span className="user-email">{user?.email || '未登录'}</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 用户菜单弹窗 */}
      {showUserMenu && ReactDOM.createPortal(
        <div
          ref={userMenuRef}
          className={`user-menu-popup ${collapsed ? 'collapsed-menu' : ''}`}
          style={{
            position: 'fixed',
            bottom: `${menuPosition.bottom}px`,
            left: `${menuPosition.left}px`,
            zIndex: 10000
          }}
        >
          <div className={`user-menu-header ${subscription && subscription.plan_code === 'pro' ? 'premium-pro' : ''} ${subscription && subscription.plan_code === 'max' ? 'premium-max' : ''}`}>
            <div className="user-avatar-large">
              {getUserInitial()}
            </div>
            <div className="user-info-text">
              <div className="user-name">{user?.username || user?.email?.split('@')[0] || '用户'}</div>
              <div className="user-email-small">{user?.email}</div>
              {subscription && (
                <div className="user-subscription-badge">
                  <span className={`subscription-plan-badge ${subscription.plan_code}`}>
                    {subscription.plan_name}
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="user-menu-divider"></div>

          <div className="user-menu-options">
            <button
              className="user-menu-item"
              onClick={() => {
                setShowUserMenu(false);
                navigate('/settings');
              }}
            >
              <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                <path d="M20 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H8a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/>
                <circle cx="12" cy="7" r="4"/>
              </svg>
              <span>个人资料</span>
            </button>

            <button
              className="user-menu-item"
              onClick={() => {
                setShowUserMenu(false);
                navigate('/settings?tab=subscription');
              }}
            >
              <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                <rect x="3" y="8" width="18" height="12" rx="2" ry="2"/>
                <path d="M3 8v-2a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"/>
                <line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12.01" y2="16"/>
              </svg>
              <span>管理订阅</span>
            </button>

            <button
              className="user-menu-item"
              onClick={() => {
                setShowUserMenu(false);
                navigate('/settings?tab=account');
              }}
            >
              <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/>
                <path d="M12 1v6m0 6v6M5.64 5.64l4.24 4.24m4.24 4.24l4.24 4.24M1 12h6m6 0h6M5.64 18.36l4.24-4.24m4.24-4.24l4.24-4.24"/>
              </svg>
              <span>设置</span>
            </button>

            <div className="user-menu-divider"></div>

            {/* 底部操作区域：主题切换 + 退出登录 */}
            <div className="user-menu-bottom-actions">
              <button
                className={`user-menu-bottom-btn theme-btn ${theme}`}
                onClick={toggleTheme}
              >
                <div className="theme-icon-wrapper">
                  <svg className="theme-icon sun-icon" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                    <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5"/>
                    <line x1="12" y1="1" x2="12" y2="3"/>
                    <line x1="12" y1="21" x2="12" y2="23"/>
                    <line x1="4.22" y1="4.22" x2="5.64" y2="5.64"/>
                    <line x1="18.36" y1="18.36" x2="19.78" y2="19.78"/>
                    <line x1="1" y1="12" x2="3" y2="12"/>
                    <line x1="21" y1="12" x2="23" y2="12"/>
                    <line x1="4.22" y1="19.78" x2="5.64" y2="18.36"/>
                    <line x1="18.36" y1="5.64" x2="19.78" y2="4.22"/>
                  </svg>
                  <svg className="theme-icon moon-icon" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                    <path d="M21 12.79A9 9 0 1 1 11.21 3 7 7 0 0 0 21 12.79z"/>
                  </svg>
                </div>
                <span className="theme-text">{theme === 'dark' ? '夜间' : '日间'}</span>
              </button>
              
              <button
                className="user-menu-bottom-btn logout-btn"
                onClick={() => {
                  setShowUserMenu(false);
                  if (onLogout) {
                    onLogout();
                  }
                }}
              >
                <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                  <path d="M9 21H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4"/>
                  <polyline points="16 17 21 12 16 7"/>
                  <line x1="21" y1="12" x2="9" y2="12"/>
                </svg>
                <span>退出</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>,
        document.body
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default UnifiedSidebar;

    { key: "1976-1978", docCount: 1880037 },
    { key: "1978-1980", docCount: 2046456 },
    { key: "1980-1982", docCount: 2272791 },
    { key: "1982-1984", docCount: 2372634 },
    { key: "1984-1986", docCount: 2611105 },
    { key: "1986-1988", docCount: 2899608 },
    { key: "1988-1990", docCount: 3234007 },
    { key: "1990-1992", docCount: 3644881 },
    { key: "1992-1994", docCount: 3909273 },
    { key: "1994-1996", docCount: 4341130 },
    { key: "1996-1998", docCount: 4915565 },
    { key: "1998-2000", docCount: 5527797 },
    { key: "2000-2002", docCount: 6605968 },
    { key: "2002-2004", docCount: 7683128 },
    { key: "2004-2006", docCount: 9449516 },
    { key: "2006-2008", docCount: 10933510 },
    { key: "2008-2010", docCount: 12740297 },
    { key: "2010-2012", docCount: 14576809 },
    { key: "2012-2014", docCount: 16237484 },
    { key: "2014-2016", docCount: 17277493 },
    { key: "2016-2018", docCount: 17205503 },
    { key: "2018-2020", docCount: 16796627 },
    { key: "2020-2022", docCount: 15815647 },
    { key: "2022-2024", docCount: 12550600 },
    { key: "2024-2026", docCount: 10286528 }
  ];

  const startYear = 1920;
  const endYear = 2026;
  const totalYears = endYear - startYear;

  // Initialize with provided values or defaults
  const [lowYear, setLowYear] = useState(yearFrom || startYear);
  const [highYear, setHighYear] = useState(yearTo || endYear);
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(null); // 'low' or 'high'
  const sliderRef = useRef(null);

  // Update internal state when props change (e.g., when filters are cleared)
  // But only if not currently dragging
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!dragging) {
      setLowYear(yearFrom || startYear);
      setHighYear(yearTo || endYear);
    }
  }, [yearFrom, yearTo, dragging, startYear, endYear]);

  const maxValue = Math.max(...HISTOGRAM_DATA.map(d => d.docCount));

  // Convert year to slider position (0-100%)
  const yearToPercent = (year) => {
    return ((year - startYear) / totalYears) * 100;
  };

  // Convert slider position to year
  const percentToYear = (percent) => {
    return Math.round(startYear + (percent / 100) * totalYears);
  };

  // Handle slider drag
  const handleMouseDown = (handle) => (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    setDragging(handle);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!dragging) return;

    const handleMouseMove = (e) => {
      if (!sliderRef.current) return;

      const rect = sliderRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      const padding = 12; // Match the CSS padding
      const effectiveWidth = rect.width - padding * 2;
      const x = Math.max(padding, Math.min(e.clientX - rect.left, rect.width - padding));
      const percent = ((x - padding) / effectiveWidth) * 100;
      const year = percentToYear(percent);

      if (dragging === 'low') {
        const newLowYear = Math.min(year, highYear - 1);
        setLowYear(newLowYear);
        // Call onChange immediately during drag for real-time update
        onChange(newLowYear, highYear);
      } else if (dragging === 'high') {
        const newHighYear = Math.max(year, lowYear + 1);
        setHighYear(newHighYear);
        // Call onChange immediately during drag for real-time update
        onChange(lowYear, newHighYear);
      }
    };

    const handleMouseUp = () => {
      // Call onChange one final time when dragging ends (in case of any rounding)
      onChange(lowYear, highYear);
      setDragging(null);
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    };
  }, [dragging, lowYear, highYear, onChange, startYear, totalYears, yearToPercent, percentToYear]);

  const lowPercent = yearToPercent(lowYear);
  const highPercent = yearToPercent(highYear);

  return (
    <div className="year-histogram">
      {/* 年份范围显示 */}
      <div className="year-range-display">
        <span className="year-value">{lowYear}</span>
        <span className="year-separator-display">至</span>
        <span className="year-value">{highYear}</span>
      </div>

      {/* Histogram visualization with integrated handles */}
      <div className="histogram-container" ref={sliderRef}>
        <svg className="histogram-svg" viewBox="0 0 100 50" preserveAspectRatio="none">
          <defs>
            <linearGradient id="barGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
              <stop offset="0%" stopColor="rgb(16, 163, 127)" stopOpacity="0.3" />
              <stop offset="100%" stopColor="rgb(16, 163, 127)" stopOpacity="0.15" />
            </linearGradient>
            <linearGradient id="barGradientSelected" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
              <stop offset="0%" stopColor="rgb(16, 163, 127)" stopOpacity="0.9" />
              <stop offset="100%" stopColor="rgb(16, 163, 127)" stopOpacity="0.6" />
            </linearGradient>
          </defs>

          {HISTOGRAM_DATA.map((item, index) => {
            // Parse year range
            const [rangeStart, rangeEnd] = item.key.split('-').map(Number);
            const midYear = (rangeStart + rangeEnd) / 2;

            // Calculate position and size
            const x = ((midYear - startYear) / totalYears) * 100;
            const barWidth = ((rangeEnd - rangeStart) / totalYears) * 100 * 0.85; // 85% width for gaps
            const height = (item.docCount / maxValue) * 50;
            const y = 50 - height;

            // Check if in selected range
            const isInRange = rangeEnd >= lowYear && rangeStart <= highYear;

            return (
              <rect
                key={item.key}
                x={x - barWidth / 2}
                y={y}
                width={barWidth}
                height={height}
                fill={isInRange ? "url(#barGradientSelected)" : "url(#barGradient)"}
                opacity={isInRange ? 1 : 0.25}
                rx="0.5"
              />
            );
          })}
        </svg>

        {/* Low handle */}
        <div
          className="slider-handle slider-handle-low"
          style={{ left: `calc(${lowPercent}%)` }}
          onMouseDown={handleMouseDown('low')}
        />

        {/* High handle */}
        <div
          className="slider-handle slider-handle-high"
          style={{ left: `calc(${highPercent}%)` }}
          onMouseDown={handleMouseDown('high')}
        />
      </div>

    </div>
  );
};

export default YearHistogram;

// ========== 文件: frontend-user/src/contexts/SidebarContext.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26

 * ============================================================================
