import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';

const SidebarContext = createContext();

export const useSidebar = () => {
  const context = useContext(SidebarContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useSidebar must be used within SidebarProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

export const SidebarProvider = ({ children }) => {
  // 侧边栏配置状态
  const [sidebarConfig, setSidebarConfig] = useState({
    showHistory: false,
    historyType: 'conversation',
    historyItems: [],
    currentItemId: null,
    onSelectItem: null,
    onDeleteItem: null,
    onRenameItem: null,
    onNewItem: null,
    historyLoading: false,
  });

  // 移动端侧边栏状态
  const [isMobileOpen, setIsMobileOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = useState(false);

  // 检测是否为移动端
  useEffect(() => {
    const checkMobile = () => {
      setIsMobile(window.innerWidth <= 768);
    };
    
    checkMobile();
    window.addEventListener('resize', checkMobile);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', checkMobile);
  }, []);

  // 移动端打开侧边栏时禁止body滚动
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isMobileOpen && isMobile) {
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    } else {
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    };
  }, [isMobileOpen, isMobile]);

  // 更新侧边栏配置
  const updateSidebarConfig = useCallback((config) => {
    setSidebarConfig(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      ...config,
    }));
  }, []);

  // 重置侧边栏配置（用于无历史记录的页面）
  const resetSidebarConfig = useCallback(() => {
    setSidebarConfig({
      showHistory: false,
      historyType: 'conversation',
      historyItems: [],
      currentItemId: null,
      onSelectItem: null,
      onDeleteItem: null,
      onRenameItem: null,
      onNewItem: null,
      historyLoading: false,
    });
  }, []);

  // 打开移动端侧边栏
  const openMobileSidebar = useCallback(() => {
    setIsMobileOpen(true);
  }, []);

  // 关闭移动端侧边栏
  const closeMobileSidebar = useCallback(() => {
    setIsMobileOpen(false);
  }, []);

  // 切换移动端侧边栏
  const toggleMobileSidebar = useCallback(() => {
    setIsMobileOpen(prev => !prev);
  }, []);

  return (
    <SidebarContext.Provider
      value={{
        sidebarConfig,
        updateSidebarConfig,
        resetSidebarConfig,
        isMobile,
        isMobileOpen,
        openMobileSidebar,
        closeMobileSidebar,
        toggleMobileSidebar,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </SidebarContext.Provider>
  );
};


// ========== 文件: frontend-user/src/contexts/SubscriptionContext.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import * as subscriptionAPI from '../services/subscriptionService';

const SubscriptionContext = createContext();

// 缓存有效期：5分钟
const CACHE_TTL = 5 * 60 * 1000;

export const SubscriptionProvider = ({ children }) => {
  const [subscriptionData, setSubscriptionData] = useState(null);
  const [usageData, setUsageData] = useState(null);
  const [quotaData, setQuotaData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  // 缓存时间戳
  const lastFetchTime = useRef({
    subscription: 0,
    usage: 0,
    quota: 0
  });

  // 防止并发请求
  const fetchingRef = useRef({
    subscription: false,
    usage: false,
    quota: false
  });

  /**
   * 获取订阅信息
   * @param {boolean} force - 是否强制刷新缓存
   */
  const fetchSubscription = useCallback(async (force = false) => {
    const now = Date.now();
    const cacheKey = 'subscription';

    // 检查缓存
    if (!force && subscriptionData && (now - lastFetchTime.current[cacheKey] < CACHE_TTL)) {
      return subscriptionData;
    }

    // 防止并发请求
    if (fetchingRef.current[cacheKey]) {
      return subscriptionData;
    }

    try {
      fetchingRef.current[cacheKey] = true;
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);

      const response = await subscriptionAPI.getMySubscription();
      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        const data = response.data.data;
        setSubscriptionData(data);
        lastFetchTime.current[cacheKey] = now;
        return data;
      } else {
        throw new Error(response.data.message || '获取订阅信息失败');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const errorMsg = err.response?.data?.message || err.message || '获取订阅信息失败';
      setError(errorMsg);
      console.error('Failed to fetch subscription:', err);
      return null;
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      fetchingRef.current[cacheKey] = false;
    }
  }, [subscriptionData]);

  /**
   * 获取使用情况
   * @param {boolean} force - 是否强制刷新缓存
   */
  const fetchUsage = useCallback(async (force = false) => {
    const now = Date.now();
    const cacheKey = 'usage';

    // 检查缓存
    if (!force && usageData && (now - lastFetchTime.current[cacheKey] < CACHE_TTL)) {
      return usageData;
    }

    // 防止并发请求
    if (fetchingRef.current[cacheKey]) {
      return usageData;
    }

    try {
      fetchingRef.current[cacheKey] = true;
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);

      const response = await subscriptionAPI.getUsage();
      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        const data = response.data.data;
        setUsageData(data);
        lastFetchTime.current[cacheKey] = now;
        return data;
      } else {
        throw new Error(response.data.message || '获取使用情况失败');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const errorMsg = err.response?.data?.message || err.message || '获取使用情况失败';
      setError(errorMsg);
      console.error('Failed to fetch usage:', err);
      return null;
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      fetchingRef.current[cacheKey] = false;
    }
  }, [usageData]);

  /**
   * 获取配额信息
   * @param {boolean} force - 是否强制刷新缓存
   */
  const fetchQuota = useCallback(async (force = false) => {
    const now = Date.now();
    const cacheKey = 'quota';

    // 检查缓存
    if (!force && quotaData && (now - lastFetchTime.current[cacheKey] < CACHE_TTL)) {
      return quotaData;
    }

    // 防止并发请求
    if (fetchingRef.current[cacheKey]) {
      return quotaData;
    }

    try {
      fetchingRef.current[cacheKey] = true;
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);

      const response = await subscriptionAPI.getQuota();
      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        const data = response.data.data;
        setQuotaData(data);
        lastFetchTime.current[cacheKey] = now;
        return data;
      } else {
        throw new Error(response.data.message || '获取配额信息失败');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const errorMsg = err.response?.data?.message || err.message || '获取配额信息失败';
      setError(errorMsg);
      console.error('Failed to fetch quota:', err);
      return null;
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      fetchingRef.current[cacheKey] = false;
    }
  }, [quotaData]);

  /**
   * 批量获取所有数据（并行）
   * @param {boolean} force - 是否强制刷新缓存
   */
  const fetchAll = useCallback(async (force = false) => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);

      const [subscription, usage, quota] = await Promise.all([
        fetchSubscription(force),
        fetchUsage(force),
        fetchQuota(force)
      ]);

      return { subscription, usage, quota };
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || '获取数据失败');
      return null;
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [fetchSubscription, fetchUsage, fetchQuota]);

  /**
   * 清除缓存
   */
  const clearCache = useCallback(() => {
    setSubscriptionData(null);
    setUsageData(null);
    setQuotaData(null);
    lastFetchTime.current = {
      subscription: 0,
      usage: 0,
      quota: 0
    };
  }, []);

  /**
   * 更新使用量（扣减配额后调用）
   * @param {object} updates - 要更新的使用量字段
   */
  const incrementUsage = useCallback((updates) => {
    setUsageData(prev => {
      if (!prev) return prev;
      return {
        ...prev,
        ...updates
      };
    });
  }, []);

  const value = {
    // 数据
    subscriptionData,
    usageData,
    quotaData,
    loading,
    error,

    // 方法
    fetchSubscription,
    fetchUsage,
    fetchQuota,
    fetchAll,
    clearCache,
    incrementUsage,

    // 辅助方法
    isSubscriptionValid: subscriptionData?.status === 'active',
    hasQuotaRemaining: (quotaType) => {
      if (!usageData || !subscriptionData) return false;
      const used = usageData[quotaType] || 0;
      const quota = subscriptionData[`${quotaType}_quota`];
      return quota === -1 || used < quota; // -1 表示无限制
    }
  };

  return (
    <SubscriptionContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
    </SubscriptionContext.Provider>
  );
};

/**
 * 使用订阅上下文的 Hook
 */
export const useSubscription = () => {
  const context = useContext(SubscriptionContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useSubscription must be used within a SubscriptionProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

export default SubscriptionContext;

// ========== 文件: frontend-user/src/contexts/ThemeContext.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from 'react';

const ThemeContext = createContext();

// localStorage 键名
const THEME_KEY = 'theme';
const USER_PREFERENCE_KEY = 'theme_user_preference'; // 用户是否手动设置过主题

// 根据当前时间获取推荐主题
// 日间模式: 6:00 - 18:00
// 夜间模式: 18:00 - 6:00
const getThemeByTime = () => {
  const hour = new Date().getHours();
  return (hour >= 6 && hour < 18) ? 'light' : 'dark';
};

export const useTheme = () => {
  const context = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useTheme must be used within a ThemeProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

export const ThemeProvider = ({ children }) => {
  // 初始化主题
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState(() => {
    const userPreference = localStorage.getItem(USER_PREFERENCE_KEY);
    const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem(THEME_KEY);
    
    // 如果用户手动设置过主题，使用用户的偏好
    if (userPreference === 'true' && savedTheme) {
      return savedTheme;
    }
    
    // 否则根据当前时间自动设置
    return getThemeByTime();
  });

  // 切换主题（用户手动切换）
  const toggleTheme = () => {
    setTheme(prevTheme => {
      const newTheme = prevTheme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
      localStorage.setItem(THEME_KEY, newTheme);
      localStorage.setItem(USER_PREFERENCE_KEY, 'true'); // 标记用户已手动设置
      return newTheme;
    });
  };

  // 设置特定主题（用户手动设置）
  const setSpecificTheme = (themeName) => {
    setTheme(themeName);
    localStorage.setItem(THEME_KEY, themeName);
    localStorage.setItem(USER_PREFERENCE_KEY, 'true'); // 标记用户已手动设置
  };

  // 重置为自动模式（根据时间自动切换）
  const resetToAutoTheme = () => {
    localStorage.removeItem(USER_PREFERENCE_KEY);
    const autoTheme = getThemeByTime();
    setTheme(autoTheme);
    localStorage.setItem(THEME_KEY, autoTheme);
  };

  // 检查是否为用户手动设置的主题
  const isUserPreference = () => {
    return localStorage.getItem(USER_PREFERENCE_KEY) === 'true';
  };

  // 当主题改变时，更新document的class
  useEffect(() => {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    root.className = theme;
    
    // 也可以设置data-theme属性，方便CSS选择器使用
    root.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
    
    // 更新meta标签的theme-color（影响浏览器地址栏颜色）
    const metaThemeColor = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]');
    if (metaThemeColor) {
      metaThemeColor.content = theme === 'dark' ? '#212121' : '#ffffff';
    } else {
      const meta = document.createElement('meta');
      meta.name = 'theme-color';
      meta.content = theme === 'dark' ? '#212121' : '#ffffff';
      document.head.appendChild(meta);
    }
  }, [theme]);

  // 定时检查是否需要根据时间自动切换主题（仅在非用户手动设置时）
  useEffect(() => {
    // 如果用户手动设置过，不自动切换
    if (isUserPreference()) {
      return;
    }

    // 每分钟检查一次是否需要切换主题
    const checkAndUpdateTheme = () => {
      if (!isUserPreference()) {
        const timeBasedTheme = getThemeByTime();
        if (timeBasedTheme !== theme) {
          setTheme(timeBasedTheme);
          localStorage.setItem(THEME_KEY, timeBasedTheme);
        }
      }
    };

    const intervalId = setInterval(checkAndUpdateTheme, 60000); // 每分钟检查

    return () => clearInterval(intervalId);
  }, [theme]);

  const value = {
    theme,
    toggleTheme,
    setTheme: setSpecificTheme,
    resetToAutoTheme,
    isUserPreference: isUserPreference(),
    isDark: theme === 'dark',
    isLight: theme === 'light'
  };

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
};

// ========== 文件: frontend-user/src/hooks/useTypewriter.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';

/**
 * 优化的打字机效果Hook
 * 使用单个定时器和requestAnimationFrame优化性能
 */
export const useTypewriter = (phrases, options = {}) => {
  const {
    typingSpeed = 100,
    deletingSpeed = 50,
    pauseAfterComplete = 2000,
    pauseAfterDelete = 500,
    enabled = true,
  } = options;

  const [displayedText, setDisplayedText] = useState('');
  const [currentPhraseIndex, setCurrentPhraseIndex] = useState(0);
  const [isDeleting, setIsDeleting] = useState(false);
  const [showCursor, setShowCursor] = useState(true);

  const timeoutRef = useRef(null);
  const cursorIntervalRef = useRef(null);

  // 清理所有定时器
  const cleanup = useCallback(() => {
    if (timeoutRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
      timeoutRef.current = null;
    }
    if (cursorIntervalRef.current) {
      clearInterval(cursorIntervalRef.current);
      cursorIntervalRef.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled || !phrases || phrases.length === 0) {
      return;
    }

    const currentPhrase = phrases[currentPhraseIndex];

    // 光标闪烁 - 使用单一interval
    if (!cursorIntervalRef.current) {
      cursorIntervalRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        setShowCursor(prev => !prev);
      }, 530);
    }

    // 打字机逻辑
    if (!isDeleting && displayedText === currentPhrase) {
      // 完成打字,暂停后开始删除
      timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        setIsDeleting(true);
      }, pauseAfterComplete);
      return;
    }

    if (isDeleting && displayedText === '') {
      // 删除完成,切换到下一个短语
      setIsDeleting(false);
      setCurrentPhraseIndex((prev) => (prev + 1) % phrases.length);
      timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        // 小延迟后开始下一个短语
      }, pauseAfterDelete);
      return;
    }

    // 打字或删除字符
    const speed = isDeleting ? deletingSpeed : typingSpeed + Math.random() * 20;
    timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setDisplayedText(prev => {
        if (isDeleting) {
          return currentPhrase.substring(0, prev.length - 1);
        } else {
          return currentPhrase.substring(0, prev.length + 1);
        }
      });
    }, speed);

    return cleanup;
  }, [displayedText, isDeleting, currentPhraseIndex, phrases, enabled, typingSpeed, deletingSpeed, pauseAfterComplete, pauseAfterDelete, cleanup]);

  // 组件卸载时清理
  useEffect(() => {
    return cleanup;
  }, [cleanup]);

  return { displayedText, showCursor };
};

// 辅助函数：根据parent_message_id组织消息，确保问答对正确匹配
// 对于有parent_message_id的新消息，使用严格的父子关系
// 对于没有parent_message_id的旧消息，回退到时间顺序
const organizeMessagesByParentId = (messages) => {
  if (!messages || messages.length === 0) return [];
  
  // 检查是否有消息包含parent_message_id
  const hasParentIds = messages.some(m => m.parent_message_id);
  
  // 如果没有parent_message_id，使用原始顺序（向后兼容旧数据）
  if (!hasParentIds) {
    return messages;
  }
  
  // 构建消息映射
  const messageMap = {};
  messages.forEach(msg => {
    messageMap[msg.message_id] = msg;
  });
  
  // 找到所有根消息（用户消息且没有parent_message_id的）
  const rootMessages = messages.filter(m => m.role === 'user' && !m.parent_message_id);
  
  // 构建有序的消息列表
  const organized = [];
  const processedIds = new Set();
  
  // 对每个根消息，递归添加其子消息
  const addMessageAndChildren = (msg) => {
    if (processedIds.has(msg.id)) return;
    
    organized.push(msg);
    processedIds.add(msg.id);
    
    // 查找以当前消息为parent的子消息
    const children = messages.filter(m => 
      m.parent_message_id === msg.message_id && !processedIds.has(m.id)
    );
    
    // 按时间排序子消息
    children.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.created_at) - new Date(b.created_at));
    
    children.forEach(child => {
      addMessageAndChildren(child);
    });
  };
  
  // 按时间排序根消息
  rootMessages.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.created_at) - new Date(b.created_at));
  
  // 处理所有根消息
  rootMessages.forEach(rootMsg => {
    addMessageAndChildren(rootMsg);
  });
  
  // 添加任何未被处理的消息（孤儿消息，可能是数据不一致）
  messages.forEach(msg => {
    if (!processedIds.has(msg.id)) {
      organized.push(msg);
    }
  });
  
  return organized;
};

    const fetchQuotaAndUsage = async () => {

        const response = await subscriptionAPI.getUsage();

        if (response.data.code === 0) {

            advancedSearchHighQuota: data.limits?.advanced_search_high?.limit ?? -1,
          };

          // 将 usage 映射为前端格式
          const usageData = {
            advancedSearchLowCount: data.usage?.advanced_search_low ?? 0,
            advancedSearchMidCount: data.usage?.advanced_search_mid ?? 0,
            advancedSearchHighCount: data.usage?.advanced_search_high ?? 0,
          };

          setQuota(quotaData);
          setUsage(usageData);
        }

      }

      setCurrentExampleIndex((prevIndex) => (prevIndex + 1) % searchExamples.length);

  const loadConversations = async () => {
    setConversationsLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await conversationAPI.getConversations(1, 50, 'search');
      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
        setConversations(response.data.data.conversations || []);
      }

      console.error('Failed to load search conversations:', error);
    } finally {
      setConversationsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // 获取当前模型的剩余次数
  const getRemainingCount = () => {
    if (!quota || !usage) return null;

    // 映射配额和使用情况字段
    const quotaFieldMap = {
      'low': 'advancedSearchLowQuota',
      'mid': 'advancedSearchMidQuota',
      'high': 'advancedSearchHighQuota'
    };

    const usageFieldMap = {
      'low': 'advancedSearchLowCount',
      'mid': 'advancedSearchMidCount',
      'high': 'advancedSearchHighCount'
    };

    const quotaField = quotaFieldMap[modelLevel];
    const usageField = usageFieldMap[modelLevel];

    const quotaValue = quota[quotaField];
    const usageValue = usage[usageField] || 0;

    // -1 表示无限制
    if (quotaValue === -1) return null; // 无限制时不显示提示

    const remaining = Math.max(0, quotaValue - usageValue);
    return remaining;
  };

  // 从URL参数读取对话ID或初始查询（仅执行一次）
  useEffect(() => {
    const urlConversationId = searchParams.get('conversation');
    const query = searchParams.get('query');
    const urlModelLevel = searchParams.get('modelLevel');

    // 如果URL中有模型级别参数，设置模型级别
    if (urlModelLevel && ['low', 'mid', 'high'].includes(urlModelLevel)) {
      setModelLevel(urlModelLevel);
    }

    if (urlConversationId && isAuthenticated && !currentConversationId && conversations.length > 0) {
      // 恢复对话 - 确保对话列表已加载
      const conversation = conversations.find(c => c.id === parseInt(urlConversationId));
      if (conversation) {
        handleSelectConversation(urlConversationId);
      }
    } else if (query && isAuthenticated && messages.length === 0 && !urlConversationId) {
      // 立即清除URL参数
