// 检测是否为移动端
const useIsMobile = () => {
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const checkMobile = () => {
      setIsMobile(window.innerWidth <= 768);
    };
    
    checkMobile();
    window.addEventListener('resize', checkMobile);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', checkMobile);
  }, []);

  return isMobile;
};

const Home = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { isAuthenticated, user } = useAuth();
  const { resetSidebarConfig, isMobile, openMobileSidebar } = useSidebar();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const outletContext = useOutletContext();
  const sidebarCollapsed = outletContext?.sidebarCollapsed ?? true;
  
  const [showAuthModal, setShowAuthModal] = useState(false);
  const [showHelpModal, setShowHelpModal] = useState(false);
  const [searchMode, setSearchMode] = useState('normal'); // 'normal' or 'advanced'
  const [showFilters, setShowFilters] = useState(false); // 显示筛选条件
  const [modelLevel, setModelLevel] = useState('low'); // 'low', 'mid', 'high' - 默认普通模型
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState({
    yearFrom: '',
    yearTo: '',
    publicationTypes: [],
    fieldsOfStudy: [],
    openAccessPdf: '',
    venue: '',
  });
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [showSuggestions, setShowSuggestions] = useState(false); // 搜索建议下拉框
  const textareaRef = useRef(null);
  const composerRef = useRef(null); // 用于定位搜索建议下拉框
  const lastTypingDelayRef = useRef(90);
  const [isComposing, setIsComposing] = useState(false); // 跟踪输入法状态

  // Typewriter effect for welcome title
  const [displayedText, setDisplayedText] = useState('');
  const [currentPhraseIndex, setCurrentPhraseIndex] = useState(0);
  const [isDeleting, setIsDeleting] = useState(false);

  // Placeholder examples carousel
  const [currentExampleIndex, setCurrentExampleIndex] = useState(0);
  
  // 搜索示例数据 - 覆盖多个学科领域
  const searchExamples = {
    normal: [
      '搜索论文标题、作者、关键词...',                                    // 说明文字
      '示例：深度学习在医学影像诊断中的应用',                             // 计算机+医学
      '示例：量子纠缠在量子通信中的研究',                                 // 物理学
      '示例：CRISPR基因编辑技术的伦理问题',                              // 生物+伦理
      '示例：碳纳米管在新能源电池中的应用',                               // 材料+化学
      '示例：行为经济学对消费决策的影响',                                 // 经济学+心理学
      '示例：气候变化对海洋生态系统的影响',                               // 环境+生态
      '示例：人工智能在药物研发中的应用',                                 // AI+医药
      '示例：区块链技术在供应链管理中的创新',                             // 计算机+管理
      '示例：纳米机器人在精准医疗中的前景',                               // 工程+医学
      '示例：社交媒体对青少年心理健康的影响'                              // 社会学+心理学
    ],
    advanced: [
      '用自然语言描述研究需求，AI 智能解析并搜索...',                      // 说明文字
      '示例：帮我找一些关于肿瘤免疫治疗最新突破的高引用论文',              // 医学
      '示例：我想了解拓扑量子计算在容错量子计算中的应用研究',              // 物理+计算机
      '示例：寻找关于可持续城市发展和智慧城市建设的综述文章',              // 城市规划+工程
      '示例：推荐一些讨论人工智能在金融风险预测中的机器学习方法',          // 金融+AI
      '示例：我需要了解石墨烯在光电器件中的最新应用进展',                  // 材料+物理
      '示例：帮我找关于神经退行性疾病发病机制的前沿研究',                  // 神经科学+医学
      '示例：想看看生物降解塑料材料的环境友好型设计研究',                  // 环境+化学
      '示例：寻找探讨社会不平等对教育机会影响的实证研究',                  // 社会学+教育
      '示例：推荐一些关于合成生物学在生物制造中的应用论文',                // 生物+工程
      '示例：我想研究脑机接口技术在神经康复中的临床应用'                   // 神经科学+工程
    ]
  };

  // 重置侧边栏配置（Home 页面不需要历史记录）
  useEffect(() => {
    resetSidebarConfig();
  }, [resetSidebarConfig]);

  // 搜索示例轮播效果
  useEffect(() => {
    const currentExamples = searchExamples[searchMode];
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setCurrentExampleIndex((prevIndex) => (prevIndex + 1) % currentExamples.length);
    }, 3000); // 每3秒切换一次

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [searchMode]); // 当searchMode变化时重新开始轮播

  // 当切换搜索模式时，重置示例索引
  useEffect(() => {
    setCurrentExampleIndex(0);
  }, [searchMode]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const phrases = [
      '探索学术世界,从这里开始',
      '发现前沿研究,开启智慧之旅',
      '用AI连接知识,让学术触手可及',
      '搜索论文,理解文献,推动创新'
    ];

    const currentPhrase = phrases[currentPhraseIndex];
    const pauseAfterComplete = 30000; // 30s 展示间隔
    const pauseAfterDelete = 500;

    if (!isDeleting && displayedText === currentPhrase) {
      // Finished typing, pause then start deleting
      const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
        setIsDeleting(true);
      }, pauseAfterComplete);
      return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
    }

    if (isDeleting && displayedText === '') {
      // Finished deleting, move to next phrase
      setIsDeleting(false);
      setCurrentPhraseIndex((prev) => (prev + 1) % phrases.length);
      const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
      }, pauseAfterDelete);
      return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
    }

    const phraseLength = currentPhrase.length || 1;
    const rawProgress = displayedText.length / phraseLength;
    const directionalProgress = isDeleting ? 1 - rawProgress : rawProgress;
    const clampedProgress = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, directionalProgress));
    const wave = Math.sin(Math.PI * clampedProgress);
    const config = isDeleting
      ? { base: 60, variance: 18, min: 28 }
      : { base: 115, variance: 35, min: 60 };
    const targetDelay = Math.max(
      config.min,
      config.base - wave * config.variance
    );
    const smoothDelay = lastTypingDelayRef.current * 0.4 + targetDelay * 0.6;
    lastTypingDelayRef.current = smoothDelay;

    // Type or delete character
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
      setDisplayedText(prev => {
        if (isDeleting) {
          return currentPhrase.substring(0, prev.length - 1);
        } else {
          return currentPhrase.substring(0, prev.length + 1);
        }
      });
    }, smoothDelay);

    return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
  }, [displayedText, isDeleting, currentPhraseIndex]);

  const handleLoginSuccess = () => {
    setShowAuthModal(false);
  };

  // 处理选择论文建议
  const handleSelectPaper = (paper) => {
    // 使用论文标题作为搜索查询

    const paperId = paper.id || '';
    setSearchQuery(title);
    setShowSuggestions(false);
    // 跳转到搜索结果页面，并带上 paperId 以显示论文详情

    if (paperId) params.set('paperId', paperId);
    navigate(`/search-results?${params.toString()}`);
  };

  // 处理选择作者建议
  const handleSelectAuthor = (author) => {
    // 使用作者名字作为搜索查询
    const name = author.name || '';
    const authorId = author.authorId || '';
    setSearchQuery(name);
    setShowSuggestions(false);
    // 跳转到搜索结果页面，并带上 authorId 以显示作者详情
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    if (name) params.set('query', name);
    if (authorId) params.set('authorId', authorId);
    navigate(`/search-results?${params.toString()}`);
  };

  const handleSearch = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return;

    const userMessage = searchQuery.trim();

    // 学术检索模式：允许未登录用户使用
    if (searchMode === 'normal') {
      const params = new URLSearchParams({ query: userMessage });

      // 添加筛选条件到URL参数
      if (filters.yearFrom) params.set('yearFrom', filters.yearFrom);
      if (filters.yearTo) params.set('yearTo', filters.yearTo);
      if (filters.publicationTypes.length > 0) params.set('publicationTypes', filters.publicationTypes.join(','));
      if (filters.fieldsOfStudy.length > 0) params.set('fieldsOfStudy', filters.fieldsOfStudy.join(','));
      if (filters.openAccessPdf) params.set('openAccessPdf', filters.openAccessPdf);
      if (filters.venue) params.set('venue', filters.venue);

      navigate(`/search-results?${params.toString()}`);
      return;
    }

    // 智能分析模式：需要登录才能使用
    if (searchMode === 'advanced') {
      // Check if user is authenticated
      if (!isAuthenticated) {
        setShowAuthModal(true);
        return;
      }

      const params = new URLSearchParams({
        query: userMessage,
        modelLevel: modelLevel  // 传递模型级别
      });
      navigate(`/advanced-search?${params.toString()}`);
      return;
    }
  };

  // FAQ数据用于结构化数据
  const faqData = [
    {
      question: '什么是Scholay学术搜索平台？',
      answer: 'Scholay是一个AI驱动的学术搜索平台，提供智能文献检索、论文分析、引用图谱可视化等功能，帮助研究人员快速找到高质量学术资源。'
    },
    {
      question: 'Scholay支持哪些搜索模式？',
      answer: 'Scholay支持学术检索和智能分析两种模式。学术检索可以快速检索论文标题、作者和关键词；智能分析使用AI智能理解并解析您的研究需求，提供更精准的结果。'
    },
    {
      question: 'Scholay的数据来源是什么？',
      answer: 'Scholay基于Semantic Scholay学术图谱API，提供来自计算机科学、生物医学等多个领域的数百万篇学术论文数据。'
    }
  ];

  // Main search interface
  return (
    <div className="home-search">
      <SEO
        title="Scholay - AI驱动的学术搜索平台 | 智能文献检索与分析"
        description="Scholay是创新的学术搜索平台，提供AI驱动的文献检索、智能论文分析、引用图谱可视化等功能。支持学术检索和智能分析两种模式，帮助研究人员快速找到高质量学术资源，提升科研效率。"
        keywords="学术搜索,论文检索,文献查找,AI论文分析,学术资源,科研工具,Semantic Scholar,论文引用,学术数据库,研究助手,智能搜索"
        canonical="/"
        structuredData={generateFAQSchema(faqData)}
      />
      
      <div className={`main-container ${isAuthenticated ? (sidebarCollapsed ? 'sidebar-collapsed-narrow' : 'has-sidebar') : 'sidebar-collapsed'}`}>
        <nav className="top-navbar">
          <div className="navbar-left">
            {/* 移动端菜单按钮 - 登录状态下显示 */}
            {isMobile && isAuthenticated && (
              <button 
                className="mobile-menu-btn"
                onClick={openMobileSidebar}
                aria-label="打开菜单"
              >
                <svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round">
                  <line x1="4" y1="8" x2="20" y2="8" />
                  <line x1="4" y1="16" x2="14" y2="16" />
                </svg>
              </button>
            )}
            <div className="logo">
              <span className="logo-text">Scholay</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="navbar-right">
            {!isAuthenticated && (
              <div className="auth-buttons">
                {/* 桌面端显示的按钮 */}
                <button
                  onClick={() => navigate('/pricing')}
                  className="btn-auth btn-pricing desktop-only"
                >
                  价格方案
                </button>
                <div className="desktop-only">
                <ThemeToggle />
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setShowAuthModal(true)}
                  className="btn-auth btn-login desktop-only"
                >
                  登录
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setShowAuthModal(true)}
                  className="btn-auth btn-register desktop-only"
                >
                  免费注册
                </button>

                {/* 移动端显示的按钮 */}
                <button
                  onClick={() => setShowHelpModal(true)}
                  className="btn-mobile-help mobile-only"
                  aria-label="帮助与设置"
                >
                  <HelpCircle size={20} strokeWidth={2} />
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setShowAuthModal(true)}
                  className="btn-auth btn-login-mobile mobile-only"
                >
                  登录
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </nav>

        <div className="search-content">
          <div className="chat-container">
            <div className="welcome-screen">
              <h1 className="welcome-title">
                {displayedText}
              </h1>
            </div>

            {/* 底部链接 */}
            <div className="home-footer-links">
              <button 
                className="footer-link-btn"
                onClick={() => navigate('/feedback')}
              >
                反馈
              </button>
              <span className="footer-link-divider">|</span>
              <button 
                className="footer-link-btn"
                onClick={() => navigate('/about')}
              >
                关于我们
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleSearch} className="home-composer-wrapper" ref={composerRef}>
              {/* 输入区域 */}
              <div className="home-composer-input-area">
                    <textarea
                      ref={textareaRef}
                      className="home-chat-input"
                      placeholder={searchExamples[searchMode][currentExampleIndex]}
                      value={searchQuery}
                      maxLength={1000}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        setSearchQuery(e.target.value);
                        // Auto-resize textarea
                        e.target.style.height = 'auto';
                        e.target.style.height = Math.min(e.target.scrollHeight, 200) + 'px';
                        // 学术检索模式下显示搜索建议
                        if (searchMode === 'normal' && e.target.value.trim().length >= 2) {
                          setShowSuggestions(true);
                        } else {
                          setShowSuggestions(false);
                        }
                      }}
                      onFocus={() => {
                        // 学术检索模式下，如果有输入内容则显示搜索建议
                        if (searchMode === 'normal' && searchQuery.trim().length >= 2) {
                          setShowSuggestions(true);
                        }
                      }}
                      onBlur={() => {
                        // 延迟关闭，以便点击建议项时不会立即关闭
                        setTimeout(() => setShowSuggestions(false), 200);
                      }}
                      onCompositionStart={() => setIsComposing(true)}
                      onCompositionEnd={() => setIsComposing(false)}
                      onKeyDown={(e) => {
                        // Submit on Enter, new line on Shift+Enter
                        // 但要避免在输入法输入过程中触发提交
                        if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey && !isComposing) {
                          e.preventDefault();
                          setShowSuggestions(false);
                          if (searchQuery.trim()) {
                            handleSearch(e);
                          }
                        }
                        // Escape 关闭搜索建议
                        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                          setShowSuggestions(false);
                        }
                      }}
                      rows={1}
                    />
                    <button type="submit" className="btn-send" disabled={!searchQuery.trim()}>
                      <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                        <path d="M5 12h14M12 5l7 7-7 7"/>
                      </svg>
                    </button>
                  </div>

              {/* 搜索建议下拉框 - 仅在学术检索模式下显示 */}
              {searchMode === 'normal' && (
                <SearchSuggestions
                  query={searchQuery}
                  onSelectPaper={handleSelectPaper}
                  onSelectAuthor={handleSelectAuthor}
                  onClose={() => setShowSuggestions(false)}
                  visible={showSuggestions}
                  inputRef={textareaRef}
                />
              )}

                  {/* 底部操作栏 */}
                  <div className="home-composer-footer">
                    <div className="home-composer-footer-left">
                      {/* 搜索模式切换 - 分段控制器设计 */}
                      <div className="home-search-mode-segmented">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          className={`mode-segment ${searchMode === 'normal' ? 'active' : ''}`}
                          onClick={() => setSearchMode('normal')}
                        >
                          <span className="mode-segment-icon">
                            <NormalSearchIcon size={16} />
                          </span>
                          <span className="mode-segment-label">学术检索</span>
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          className={`mode-segment ${searchMode === 'advanced' ? 'active' : ''}`}
                          onClick={() => setSearchMode('advanced')}
                        >
                          <span className="mode-segment-icon">
                            <AdvancedSearchIcon size={16} />
                          </span>
                          <span className="mode-segment-label">智能分析</span>
                        </button>
                      </div>

                      {/* 分隔线 */}
                      <div className="footer-divider"></div>

                      {/* 筛选按钮 - 仅在学术检索模式显示 */}
                      {searchMode === 'normal' && (() => {
                        const hasFilters = filters.yearFrom ||
                                         filters.yearTo ||
                                         filters.publicationTypes.length > 0 ||
                                         filters.fieldsOfStudy.length > 0 ||
                                         filters.openAccessPdf ||
                                         filters.venue;

                        const handleClearClick = (e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          setFilters({
                            yearFrom: '',
                            yearTo: '',
                            publicationTypes: [],
                            fieldsOfStudy: [],
                            openAccessPdf: '',
                            venue: '',
                          });
                        };

                        return (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            className={`footer-btn filter-btn ${showFilters ? 'panel-open' : ''} ${hasFilters ? 'has-filters' : ''}`}
                            onClick={() => setShowFilters(!showFilters)}
                            onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.classList.add('is-hovering')}
                            onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.classList.remove('is-hovering')}
                            title={hasFilters ? "点击打开筛选" : "筛选条件"}
                          >
                            <div className="filter-icon-wrapper" onClick={(e) => {
                              if (hasFilters && e.currentTarget.parentElement.classList.contains('is-hovering')) {
                                e.stopPropagation();
                                handleClearClick(e);
                              }
                            }}>
                              <svg className="filter-icon" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                                <path d="M2.5 3.75C2.5 3.19772 2.94772 2.75 3.5 2.75H16.5C17.0523 2.75 17.5 3.19772 17.5 3.75V5.25C17.5 5.51522 17.3946 5.76957 17.2071 5.95711L11.75 11.4142V16.25C11.75 16.6297 11.5085 16.9705 11.1522 17.1094L8.65217 18.1094C8.15522 18.3078 7.58333 17.9469 7.58333 17.4167V11.4142L2.79289 5.95711C2.60536 5.76957 2.5 5.51522 2.5 5.25V3.75Z"/>
                              </svg>
                              <svg className="clear-icon" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                                <path d="M13.5355 5.46447C13.9261 5.85499 13.9261 6.48816 13.5355 6.87868L11.4142 9L13.5355 11.1213C13.9261 11.5118 13.9261 12.145 13.5355 12.5355C13.145 12.9261 12.5118 12.9261 12.1213 12.5355L10 10.4142L7.87868 12.5355C7.48816 12.9261 6.85499 12.9261 6.46447 12.5355C6.07394 12.145 6.07394 11.5118 6.46447 11.1213L8.58579 9L6.46447 6.87868C6.07394 6.48816 6.07394 5.85499 6.46447 5.46447C6.85499 5.07394 7.48816 5.07394 7.87868 5.46447L10 7.58579L12.1213 5.46447C12.5118 5.07394 13.145 5.07394 13.5355 5.46447Z"/>
                              </svg>
                            </div>
                            <span>筛选</span>
                          </button>
                        );
                      })()}

                      {/* 模型选择器 - 仅在智能分析模式显示 */}
                      {searchMode === 'advanced' && (
                        <div className="model-selector-wrapper">
                          <ModelSelector
                            value={modelLevel}
                            onChange={setModelLevel}
                            userSubscription={user?.subscription}
                            isAuthenticated={isAuthenticated}
                          />
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
            </form>

            {/* 学术检索模式下的筛选条件 */}
            {searchMode === 'normal' && (
              <SearchFilters
                filters={filters}
                onFiltersChange={setFilters}
                isExpanded={showFilters}
                onToggle={() => setShowFilters(!showFilters)}
              />
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 条件渲染 AuthModal - 只在需要时加载 */}
      {showAuthModal && (
        <Suspense fallback={null}>
          <AuthModal
            isOpen={showAuthModal}
            onClose={() => setShowAuthModal(false)}
            onLoginSuccess={handleLoginSuccess}
          />
        </Suspense>
      )}

      {/* 移动端帮助弹窗 */}
      <MobileHelpModal
        isOpen={showHelpModal}
        onClose={() => setShowHelpModal(false)}
      />

    </div>
  );
};

// ========== 文件: frontend-user/src/pages/MyCoupons.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import api from '../services/api';
import './MyCoupons.css';

const MyCoupons = () => {
  const [coupons, setCoupons] = useState([]);
  const [invitation, setInvitation] = useState(null);
  const [statistics, setStatistics] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('available');
  const [showClaimModal, setShowClaimModal] = useState(false);
  const [claimCode, setClaimCode] = useState('');
  const [invitationCopied, setInvitationCopied] = useState(false);
  const [isComposing, setIsComposing] = useState(false); // 跟踪输入法状态
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchData();
  }, [activeTab]);

  const fetchData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      // 获取用户的折扣券
      const statusFilter = activeTab === 'available' ? 'unused' : activeTab === 'used' ? 'used' : 'expired';
      const couponsRes = await api.get(`/user/coupons?status=${statusFilter}`);
      setCoupons(couponsRes.data.data.coupons || []);

      // 获取邀请信息
      try {
        const inviteRes = await api.get('/user/invitation/my');
        setInvitation(inviteRes.data.data);
      } catch (error) {
        // 用户可能还没有生成邀请码
      }

      // 获取邀请统计
      try {
        const statsRes = await api.get('/user/invitation/statistics');
        setStatistics(statsRes.data.data);
      } catch (error) {
        // 可能没有统计数据
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch data:', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const generateInvitation = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await api.post('/user/invitation/generate');
      setInvitation(response.data.data);
      alert('邀请码生成成功！');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to generate invitation:', error);
      alert('生成邀请码失败：' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
    }
  };

  const claimCoupon = async () => {
    if (!claimCode.trim()) {
      alert('请输入折扣券代码');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const response = await api.post('/user/coupons/claim', {
        code: claimCode
      });
      alert('领取成功！');
      setShowClaimModal(false);
      setClaimCode('');
      fetchData();
    } catch (error) {
      alert('领取失败：' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
    }
  };

  const copyInvitationCode = () => {
    if (invitation) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(invitation.invitation_code);
      setInvitationCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setInvitationCopied(false), 2000);
    }
  };

  const copyInvitationUrl = () => {
    if (invitation) {
      const url = `${window.location.origin}/register?invite=${invitation.invitation_code}`;
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
      alert('邀请链接已复制到剪贴板');
    }
  };

  const formatDate = (dateString) => {
    if (!dateString) return '-';
    return new Date(dateString).toLocaleDateString('zh-CN');
  };

  const getDiscountDisplay = (type, value) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'percentage':
        return `${value}% OFF`;
      case 'fixed':
      case 'price_off':
        return `¥${value}`;
      default:
        return value;
    }
  };

  const getCouponStatusClass = (status) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'unused':
        return 'status-available';
      case 'used':
        return 'status-used';
      case 'expired':
        return 'status-expired';
      default:
        return '';
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="coupons-container">
        <div className="loading">加载中...</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="coupons-container">
      <div className="page-header">
        <h1>我的折扣券</h1>
        <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={() => setShowClaimModal(true)}>
          领取折扣券
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* 邀请卡片 */}
      <div className="invitation-card">
        <div className="invitation-header">
          <h2>邀请好友，赚取奖励</h2>
          {!invitation && (
            <button className="btn btn-success" onClick={generateInvitation}>
              生成邀请码
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {invitation && (
          <div className="invitation-content">
            <div className="invitation-code-section">
              <div className="code-display">
                <span className="label">我的邀请码：</span>
                <span className="code">{invitation.invitation_code}</span>
                <button
                  className="btn-copy"
                  onClick={copyInvitationCode}
                >
                  {invitationCopied ? '已复制' : '复制'}
                </button>
              </div>
              <button className="btn btn-outline" onClick={copyInvitationUrl}>
                复制邀请链接
              </button>
            </div>

            {statistics && (
              <div className="invitation-stats">
                <div className="stat-item">
                  <div className="stat-value">{statistics.invitation?.total_invites || 0}</div>
                  <div className="stat-label">总邀请数</div>
                </div>
                <div className="stat-item">
                  <div className="stat-value">{statistics.invitation?.successful_invites || 0}</div>
                  <div className="stat-label">成功注册</div>
                </div>
                <div className="stat-item">
                  <div className="stat-value">{statistics.invitation?.paid_invites || 0}</div>
                  <div className="stat-label">付费用户</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* 折扣券标签页 */}
      <div className="tabs">
        <button
          className={`tab ${activeTab === 'available' ? 'active' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('available')}
        >
          可用 ({coupons.filter(c => c.status === 'unused').length})
        </button>
        <button
          className={`tab ${activeTab === 'used' ? 'active' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('used')}
        >
          已使用
        </button>
        <button
          className={`tab ${activeTab === 'expired' ? 'active' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('expired')}
        >
          已过期
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* 折扣券列表 */}
      <div className="coupons-grid">
        {coupons.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="empty-state">
            <p>暂无{activeTab === 'available' ? '可用' : activeTab === 'used' ? '已使用' : '已过期'}的折扣券</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          coupons.map(coupon => (
            <div key={coupon.id} className={`coupon-card ${getCouponStatusClass(coupon.status)}`}>
              <div className="coupon-header">
                <div className="discount">
                  {getDiscountDisplay(coupon.discount_type, coupon.discount_value)}
                </div>
                <div className="coupon-code">{coupon.coupon_code}</div>
              </div>
              <div className="coupon-body">
                <div className="coupon-name">{coupon.template?.name || '优惠券'}</div>
                <div className="coupon-desc">{coupon.template?.description || ''}</div>
                <div className="coupon-conditions">
                  {coupon.min_purchase_amount > 0 && (
                    <span>满¥{coupon.min_purchase_amount}可用</span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="coupon-validity">
                  有效期：{formatDate(coupon.valid_from)} - {formatDate(coupon.valid_until)}
                </div>
              </div>
              {coupon.status === 'unused' && (
                <div className="coupon-footer">
                  <button
                    className="btn btn-use"
                    onClick={() => navigate('/subscription-plans')}
                  >
                    立即使用
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
              {coupon.status === 'used' && coupon.used_at && (
                <div className="coupon-footer">
                  <span className="used-info">已于 {formatDate(coupon.used_at)} 使用</span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          ))
        )}
      </div>

      {/* 领取折扣券弹窗 */}
      {showClaimModal && (
        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => setShowClaimModal(false)}>
          <div className="modal-content" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div className="modal-header">
              <h3>领取折扣券</h3>
              <button className="close-btn" onClick={() => setShowClaimModal(false)}>×</button>
            </div>
            <div className="modal-body">
              <div className="form-group">
                <label>折扣券代码</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={claimCode}
                  onChange={e => setClaimCode(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="请输入折扣券代码"
                  onCompositionStart={() => setIsComposing(true)}
                  onCompositionEnd={() => setIsComposing(false)}
                  onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && !isComposing && claimCoupon()}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="modal-footer">
              <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={() => setShowClaimModal(false)}>
                取消
              </button>
              <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={claimCoupon}>
                领取
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default MyCoupons;

/**

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import api, { orderAPI, paymentAPI } from '../services/api';
import { useToast } from '../components/ToastContainer';
import './OrderConfirmation.css';

const OrderConfirmation = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const { showError } = useToast();

  const [order, setOrder] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [paymentLoading, setPaymentLoading] = useState(false);
  const [selectedPaymentMethod, setSelectedPaymentMethod] = useState('alipay');
  const [isDevMode, setIsDevMode] = useState(false);
  const [isPolling, setIsPolling] = useState(false);
  const [pollingCount, setPollingCount] = useState(0);

  // 折扣券相关状态
  const [availableCoupons, setAvailableCoupons] = useState([]);
  const [selectedCoupon, setSelectedCoupon] = useState(null);
  const [showCouponModal, setShowCouponModal] = useState(false);
  const [discountPreview, setDiscountPreview] = useState(null);

  // 微信支付相关状态
  const [showWeChatQRModal, setShowWeChatQRModal] = useState(false);
  const [wechatQRCodeURL, setWechatQRCodeURL] = useState('');
  const [wechatPaymentPolling, setWechatPaymentPolling] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Check if in development mode (localhost or dev environment)
    const isDev = window.location.hostname === 'localhost' || window.location.hostname === '127.0.0.1';
    setIsDevMode(isDev);

    // Check if we have plan details (new flow - order not created yet)
    const { planCode, billingCycle } = location.state || {};

    if (planCode && billingCycle) {
      // New flow: order not created yet, fetch plan details and show preview
      fetchPlanDetails(planCode, billingCycle);
      return;
    }

    // Old flow: order already created (for backward compatibility or payment callback)
    const orderNo = location.state?.orderNo || new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('orderNo');
    if (orderNo) {
      fetchOrderDetails(orderNo);
      fetchAvailableCoupons(orderNo);
      return;
    }

    // No valid state
    showError('订单信息不存在,请重新下单');
    navigate('/pricing');
  }, [location.state, location.search]);

  // 获取可用折扣券
  const fetchAvailableCoupons = async (orderNo) => {
    try {
      // 先获取订单详情以获取订单金额
      const orderResponse = await orderAPI.getOrderDetail(orderNo);
      if (orderResponse.data.code === 0 && orderResponse.data.data) {
        const orderAmount = orderResponse.data.data.amount;

        // 获取可用的折扣券
        const couponsResponse = await api.get(`/user/coupons/available?amount=${orderAmount}`);
        if (couponsResponse.data.code === 0) {
          setAvailableCoupons(couponsResponse.data.data || []);
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch available coupons:', error);
    }
  };

  // Polling effect - check order status periodically after payment redirect
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!order || order.status !== 'pending') {
      return;
    }

    // Start polling if we came from payment (URL has orderNo parameter)
    const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    const orderNoFromURL = searchParams.get('orderNo');

    if (orderNoFromURL && !isPolling) {
      setIsPolling(true);
      console.log('[Payment Polling] Starting payment status polling...');
    }

    if (!isPolling) {
      return;
    }

    // Maximum polling duration: 60 seconds (30 attempts × 2 seconds)
    if (pollingCount >= 30) {
      console.log('[Payment Polling] Polling timeout, stopping');
      setIsPolling(false);
      return;
    }

    // Poll every 2 seconds
    const pollTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      console.log(`[Payment Polling] Checking order status (attempt ${pollingCount + 1}/30)...`);
      fetchOrderDetails(order.order_no, true);
      setPollingCount(prev => prev + 1);
    }, 2000);

    return () => clearTimeout(pollTimer);
  }, [order, isPolling, pollingCount, location.search]);

  // Fetch plan details and create a preview order object (order not created on backend yet)
  const fetchPlanDetails = async (planCode, billingCycle) => {
    try {
      const response = await api.get(`/user/subscription/plans/${planCode}`);
      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
        const plan = response.data.data;
        const amount = billingCycle === 'monthly' ? plan.current_price_monthly : plan.current_price_yearly;

        // Create a preview order object (not saved to backend yet)
        const previewOrder = {
          plan_code: plan.plan_code,
          plan_name: plan.plan_name,
          billing_cycle: billingCycle,
          amount: amount,
          final_amount: amount, // Will be updated when coupon is selected
          discount_amount: 0,
          coupon_id: null,
          status: 'preview', // Special status to indicate this is a preview
          order_no: null, // Will be generated on payment
          created_at: new Date().toISOString(), // Add current time for preview
        };

        setOrder(previewOrder);

        // Fetch available coupons
        const couponsResponse = await api.get(`/user/coupons/available?amount=${amount}`);
        if (couponsResponse.data.code === 0 && couponsResponse.data.data) {
          setAvailableCoupons(couponsResponse.data.data || []);
        }
      }
      setLoading(false);
    } catch (error) {
      showError('获取套餐信息失败,请重试');
      console.error('Failed to fetch plan details:', error);
      setLoading(false);
      navigate('/pricing');
    }
  };

  const fetchOrderDetails = async (orderNo, isPollingRequest = false) => {
    try {
      const response = await orderAPI.getOrderDetail(orderNo);
      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
        const newOrder = response.data.data;
        const previousStatus = order?.status;
        setOrder(newOrder);

        console.log(`[Order Status] Current: ${newOrder.status}, Previous: ${previousStatus}, IsPolling: ${isPollingRequest}`);

        // If polling and order status changed to paid, stop polling and show success
        if (isPollingRequest && newOrder.status === 'paid') {
          console.log('[Payment Polling] Payment confirmed! Status changed to paid');
          setIsPolling(false);
          setPollingCount(0);

          // Show a brief success message before redirecting
          console.log('[Payment Polling] Redirecting to subscription page in 2 seconds...');
          setTimeout(() => {
            console.log('[Payment Polling] Executing redirect now');
            navigate('/settings?tab=subscription');
          }, 2000);
        }

        // Also handle case where user refreshes a paid order page - auto redirect
        if (!isPollingRequest && newOrder.status === 'paid' && !previousStatus) {
          console.log('[Order] Detected paid order on initial load, redirecting in 3 seconds...');
          setTimeout(() => {
            console.log('[Order] Executing redirect for paid order');
            navigate('/settings?tab=subscription');
          }, 3000);
        }
      } else {
        if (!isPollingRequest) {
          showError('获取订单详情失败：' + (response.data.message || '未知错误'));
          navigate('/settings');
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (!isPollingRequest) {
        showError('获取订单详情失败,请重试');
        console.error('Failed to fetch order details:', error);
        navigate('/settings');
      } else {
        console.error('[Payment Polling] Failed to fetch order status:', error);
      }
    } finally {
      if (!isPollingRequest) {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
  };

  // 选择折扣券
  const handleSelectCoupon = async (coupon) => {
    if (!coupon || !order) return;

    try {
      // 计算折扣预览
      const response = await api.get(`/user/coupons/calculate-discount?coupon_id=${coupon.id}&amount=${order.amount}`);
      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        setSelectedCoupon(coupon);
        setDiscountPreview(response.data.data);
        setShowCouponModal(false);

        // If order is in preview mode, update the preview order with discount information
        if (order.status === 'preview') {
          const discountData = response.data.data;
          setOrder({
            ...order,
            coupon_id: coupon.id,
            discount_amount: discountData.discount_amount,
            final_amount: discountData.final_amount,
          });
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      showError('计算折扣失败：' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
    }
  };

  // 取消选择折扣券
  const handleRemoveCoupon = () => {
    setSelectedCoupon(null);
    setDiscountPreview(null);

    // If order is in preview mode, reset the discount information
    if (order && order.status === 'preview') {
      setOrder({
        ...order,
        coupon_id: null,
        discount_amount: 0,
        final_amount: order.amount,
      });
    }
  };

  // 获取最终支付金额
  const getFinalAmount = () => {
    if (discountPreview) {
      return discountPreview.final_amount;
    }
    return order.amount;
  };

  const handlePayment = async () => {
    if (!order) return;

    setPaymentLoading(true);

    // If order is in preview status, create the order first
    let actualOrder = order;
    if (order.status === 'preview') {
      try {
        console.log('[Order Creation] Creating order with coupon:', selectedCoupon?.id);
        const createOrderResponse = await orderAPI.createOrder(
          order.plan_code,
          order.billing_cycle,
          selectedCoupon?.id // Pass coupon_id if selected
        );

        if (createOrderResponse.data.code !== 0 || !createOrderResponse.data.data) {
          showError('创建订单失败：' + (createOrderResponse.data.message || '未知错误'));
          setPaymentLoading(false);
          return;
        }

        actualOrder = createOrderResponse.data.data;
        setOrder(actualOrder);
        console.log('[Order Creation] Order created successfully:', actualOrder.order_no);
      } catch (error) {
        showError('创建订单失败：' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
        setPaymentLoading(false);
        return;
      }
    }

    try {
      // Use the final_amount from the order (backend has already calculated discount)
      const finalAmount = actualOrder.final_amount;

      if (selectedPaymentMethod === 'simulate') {
        // Simulate payment for development
        const response = await api.post('/user/payment/simulate', {
          order_no: actualOrder.order_no,
          amount: finalAmount
        });

        if (response.data.code === 0) {
          // Payment simulated successfully, start polling
          setIsPolling(true);
          console.log('[Simulate Payment] Payment simulated, starting polling...');
        } else {
          showError('模拟支付失败：' + (response.data.message || '未知错误'));
          setPaymentLoading(false);
        }
      } else if (selectedPaymentMethod === 'alipay') {
        // Create Alipay payment
        // Return to order confirmation page with order number so user can see payment result
        const returnURL = `${window.location.origin}/order-confirmation?orderNo=${actualOrder.order_no}`;
        const subject = `Scholar ${actualOrder.plan_name} ${actualOrder.billing_cycle === 'monthly' ? '月付' : '年付'}订阅`;
        const description = `订单号: ${actualOrder.order_no}`;

        const paymentResponse = await paymentAPI.createAlipayPayment(
          actualOrder.order_no,
          subject,
          finalAmount, // Use discounted amount if coupon applied
          returnURL,
          description
        );

        if (paymentResponse.data.code === 0 && paymentResponse.data.data) {
          // Redirect to Alipay payment page
          window.location.href = paymentResponse.data.data.payment_url;
        } else {
          showError('创建支付失败：' + (paymentResponse.data.message || '未知错误'));
          setPaymentLoading(false);
        }
      } else if (selectedPaymentMethod === 'wechat') {
        // Create WeChat Pay payment
        const paymentResponse = await paymentAPI.createWeChatPayment(
          actualOrder.order_no,
          finalAmount // Use discounted amount if coupon applied
        );

        if (paymentResponse.data.code === 0 && paymentResponse.data.data) {
          // Show QR code modal for user to scan
          setWechatQRCodeURL(paymentResponse.data.data.code_url);
          setShowWeChatQRModal(true);
          setPaymentLoading(false);
          // Start polling for payment status
          startWeChatPaymentPolling(actualOrder.order_no);
        } else {
          showError('创建微信支付失败：' + (paymentResponse.data.message || '未知错误'));
          setPaymentLoading(false);
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      showError('支付失败,请稍后重试');
      console.error('Payment failed:', error);
      setPaymentLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // WeChat Pay polling function
  const startWeChatPaymentPolling = (orderNo) => {
    setWechatPaymentPolling(true);
    let attempts = 0;
    const maxAttempts = 60; // 60 attempts × 3 seconds = 3 minutes

    const pollingInterval = setInterval(async () => {
      attempts++;
      console.log(`[WeChat Pay Polling] Checking payment status (attempt ${attempts}/${maxAttempts})...`);

      try {
        const response = await orderAPI.getOrderDetail(orderNo);
        if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
          const orderData = response.data.data;

          if (orderData.status === 'paid') {
            console.log('[WeChat Pay Polling] Payment successful!');
            clearInterval(pollingInterval);
            setWechatPaymentPolling(false);
            setShowWeChatQRModal(false);
            setOrder(orderData);
            // Will trigger the success UI update through order state change
          } else if (orderData.status === 'cancelled' || orderData.status === 'failed') {
            console.log(`[WeChat Pay Polling] Payment ${orderData.status}`);
            clearInterval(pollingInterval);
            setWechatPaymentPolling(false);
            setShowWeChatQRModal(false);
            showError('支付已取消或失败');
          }
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('[WeChat Pay Polling] Error checking payment status:', error);
      }

      // Stop polling after max attempts
      if (attempts >= maxAttempts) {
        console.log('[WeChat Pay Polling] Polling timeout, stopping');
        clearInterval(pollingInterval);
        setWechatPaymentPolling(false);
        showError('支付超时,请检查支付状态或重试');
      }
    }, 3000); // Poll every 3 seconds
  };

  const handleCancel = () => {
    navigate('/settings');
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="order-confirmation-container">
        <div className="loading">加载订单信息...</div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!order) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div className="order-confirmation-container">
      {/* Top Header with Logo */}
      <div className="pricing-top-header" style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        top: 0,
        left: 0,
        right: 0,
        width: '100%',
        zIndex: 1000,
        background: '#212121',
        padding: '20px 24px',
        borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)'
      }}>
        <div
          onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          style={{
            cursor: 'pointer',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: '8px',
            width: 'fit-content'
          }}
        >
          <img
            src="/logo.png"
            alt="Scholay"
            style={{
              width: '18px',
              height: '18px',
              objectFit: 'contain'
            }}
          />
          <span style={{
            fontSize: '16px',
            fontWeight: '600',
            color: 'white',
            letterSpacing: '0.5px'
          }}>
            Scholay
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="order-confirmation-card">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="order-header">
          <h1>{order.status === 'paid' ? '支付成功' : order.status === 'cancelled' ? '订单已取消' : '订单确认'}</h1>
          {order.status !== 'preview' && (
            <span className={`status-badge ${order.status}`}>
              {order.status === 'pending' ? '待支付' :
               order.status === 'paid' ? '已支付' :
               order.status === 'cancelled' ? '已取消' : '未知'}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Polling Indicator */}
        {isPolling && order.status === 'pending' && (
          <div className="polling-indicator">
            <div className="spinner"></div>
            <p>正在确认支付结果，请稍候...</p>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Success Message for Paid Orders */}
        {order.status === 'paid' && (
          <div className="payment-success-message">
            <div className="success-icon">✓</div>
            <h2>恭喜您,订阅已激活!</h2>
            <p>您的 {order.plan_name} 订阅已成功激活,现在可以享受所有功能。</p>
            <p className="redirect-hint">即将跳转到订阅管理页面...</p>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Two Column Layout */}
        <div className="order-content">
          {/* Left Column - Order Details */}
          <div className="order-details-column">
            {/* Order Info */}
            <div className="info-section">
              <h3>订单信息</h3>
              {order.order_no && (
                <div className="info-row">
                  <span className="label">订单号</span>
                  <span className="value">{order.order_no}</span>
                </div>
              )}
              {order.created_at && (
                <div className="info-row">
                  <span className="label">{order.status === 'preview' ? '预计创建时间' : '创建时间'}</span>
                  <span className="value">{new Date(order.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-CN')}</span>
                </div>
              )}
              {order.status === 'preview' && (
                <div className="info-row">
                  <span className="label">订单状态</span>
                  <span className="value" style={{color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)'}}>待创建</span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Plan Info */}
            <div className="plan-info">
              <div className="plan-name">{order.plan_name || 'PRO'}</div>
              <div className="plan-cycle">
                {order.billing_cycle === 'monthly' ? '按月付费' : '按年付费'}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right Column - Payment */}
          <div className="payment-column">
            {/* Amount Summary */}
            <div className="amount-summary">
              <h3>支付金额</h3>
              <div className="amount-row">
                <span className="amount-label">套餐价格</span>
                <span className="amount-value">¥{order.amount.toFixed(2)}</span>
              </div>

              {/* 折扣券选择 */}
              <div className="coupon-selection">
                {selectedCoupon ? (
                  <div className="selected-coupon">
                    <div className="coupon-info">
                      <span className="coupon-name">{selectedCoupon.template?.name || '优惠券'}</span>
                      <span className="coupon-discount">-¥{discountPreview?.discount_amount?.toFixed(2)}</span>
                    </div>
                    <button className="btn-remove-coupon" onClick={handleRemoveCoupon}>×</button>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <button
                    className="btn-select-coupon"
                    onClick={() => setShowCouponModal(true)}
                    disabled={availableCoupons.length === 0}
                  >
                    {availableCoupons.length > 0 ? (
                      <>
                        <span>🎟️ 使用折扣券</span>
                        <span className="coupon-count">{availableCoupons.length}张可用</span>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <span>暂无可用折扣券</span>
                    )}
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="amount-divider"></div>
              <div className="amount-row total">
                <span className="amount-label">实付金额</span>
                <span className="amount-value amount-final">¥{getFinalAmount().toFixed(2)}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Payment Method */}
            <div className="payment-method-section">
              <h3>支付方式</h3>
              <div className="payment-methods">
                <div
                  className={`payment-method-item ${selectedPaymentMethod === 'alipay' ? 'selected' : ''}`}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedPaymentMethod('alipay')}
                >
                  <div className="payment-icon">
                    <img
                      src="/支付宝logo.png"
                      alt="支付宝"
                      style={{width: '32px', height: '32px', borderRadius: '6px'}}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div className="payment-method-info">
                    <div className="payment-name">支付宝</div>
                  </div>
                  {selectedPaymentMethod === 'alipay' && (
                    <div className="payment-check">✓</div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* 暂时注释掉手动支付 */}
                {/* {isDevMode && (
                  <div
                    className={`payment-method-item ${selectedPaymentMethod === 'simulate' ? 'selected' : ''}`}
                    onClick={() => setSelectedPaymentMethod('simulate')}
                  >
                    <div className="payment-icon">
                      <div style={{
                        width: '32px',
                        height: '32px',
                        borderRadius: '6px',
                        background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #10a37f 0%, #0d8566 100%)',
                        display: 'flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        justifyContent: 'center',
                        fontSize: '16px'
                      }}>
                        🧪
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="payment-method-info">
                      <div className="payment-name">手动支付</div>
                      <div className="payment-coming-soon" style={{color: '#10a37f'}}>开发模式</div>
                    </div>
                    {selectedPaymentMethod === 'simulate' && (
                      <div className="payment-check">✓</div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )} */}

                {/* 暂时注释掉微信支付 */}
                {/* <div
                  className={`payment-method-item ${selectedPaymentMethod === 'wechat' ? 'selected' : ''}`}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedPaymentMethod('wechat')}
                >
                  <div className="payment-icon">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 1024 1024" width="32" height="32">
                      <path d="M664.250054 368.541681c10.015098 0 19.892049 0.732687 29.67281 1.795902-26.647917-122.810047-159.358451-214.077703-310.826188-214.077703-169.353083 0-308.085774 114.232694-308.085774 259.274068 0 83.708494 46.165436 152.460344 123.281791 205.78483l-30.80868 92.49925 107.688651-53.455469c38.558178 7.53665 69.459978 15.308661 107.924012 15.308661 9.66308 0 19.230993-0.470721 28.752858-1.225921-6.025227-20.36584-9.521864-41.723264-9.521864-63.862493C402.328693 476.632491 517.908058 368.541681 664.250054 368.541681zM498.62897 285.87389c23.200398 0 38.557154 15.120372 38.557154 38.061874 0 22.846334-15.356756 38.156018-38.557154 38.156018-23.107277 0-46.260603-15.309684-46.260603-38.156018C452.368366 300.994262 475.522716 285.87389 498.62897 285.87389zM283.016307 362.090758c-23.107277 0-46.402843-15.309684-46.402843-38.156018 0-22.941502 23.295566-38.061874 46.402843-38.061874 23.081695 0 38.46301 15.120372 38.46301 38.061874C321.479317 346.782098 306.098002 362.090758 283.016307 362.090758zM945.448458 606.151333c0-121.888048-123.258255-221.236753-261.683954-221.236753-146.57838 0-262.015505 99.348706-262.015505 221.236753 0 122.06508 115.437126 221.200938 262.015505 221.200938 30.66644 0 61.617359-7.609305 92.423993-15.262612l84.513836 45.786813-23.178909-76.17082C899.379213 735.776599 945.448458 674.90216 945.448458 606.151333zM598.803483 567.994292c-15.332197 0-30.807656-15.096836-30.807656-30.501688 0-15.190981 15.47546-30.477129 30.807656-30.477129 23.295566 0 38.558178 15.286148 38.558178 30.477129C637.361661 552.897456 622.099049 567.994292 598.803483 567.994292zM768.25071 567.994292c-15.213493 0-30.594809-15.096836-30.594809-30.501688 0-15.190981 15.381315-30.477129 30.594809-30.477129 23.107277 0 38.558178 15.286148 38.558178 30.477129C806.808888 552.897456 791.357987 567.994292 768.25071 567.994292z" fill="#09BB07"/>
                    </svg>
                  </div>
                  <div className="payment-method-info">
                    <div className="payment-name">微信支付</div>
                  </div>
                  {selectedPaymentMethod === 'wechat' && (
                    <div className="payment-check">✓</div>
                  )}
                </div> */}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Actions */}
            <div className="order-actions">
              {(order.status === 'pending' || order.status === 'preview') && (
                <>
                  <button
                    className="btn-cancel"
                    onClick={handleCancel}
                    disabled={paymentLoading}
                  >
                    取消
                  </button>
                  <button
                    className="btn-pay"
                    onClick={handlePayment}
                    disabled={paymentLoading}
                  >
                    {paymentLoading ? '跳转中...' : '去支付'}
                  </button>
                </>
              )}

              {order.status === 'paid' && (
                <>
                  <button
                    className="btn-cancel"
                    onClick={() => navigate('/pricing')}
                  >
                    查看其他方案
                  </button>
                  <button
                    className="btn-pay"
                    onClick={() => navigate('/settings?tab=subscription')}
                  >
                    查看我的订阅
                  </button>
                </>
              )}

              {order.status === 'cancelled' && (
                <button
                  className="btn-pay"
                  onClick={() => navigate('/pricing')}
                >
                  重新选择方案
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 折扣券选择弹窗 */}
        {showCouponModal && (
          <div className="coupon-modal-overlay" onClick={() => setShowCouponModal(false)}>
            <div className="coupon-modal" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
              <div className="coupon-modal-header">
                <h3>选择折扣券</h3>
                <button className="btn-close-modal" onClick={() => setShowCouponModal(false)}>×</button>
              </div>
              <div className="coupon-modal-body">
                {availableCoupons.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="empty-coupons">
                    <p>暂无可用的折扣券</p>
                    <small>快去领取专属折扣券吧~</small>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="coupon-list">
                    {availableCoupons.map(coupon => (
                      <div
                        key={coupon.id}
                        className="coupon-item"
                        onClick={() => handleSelectCoupon(coupon)}
                      >
                        <div className="coupon-header">
                          <div className="coupon-title">
                            <div className="coupon-name">{coupon.template?.name || '优惠券'}</div>
                            <div className="coupon-desc">{coupon.template?.description || ''}</div>
                          </div>
                          <div className="coupon-discount-badge">
                            {coupon.template?.type === 'percentage'
                              ? `${coupon.discount_value}%`
                              : coupon.template?.type === 'fixed'
                              ? `¥${coupon.discount_value}`
                              : `-¥${coupon.discount_value}`}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="coupon-details">
                          <div className="coupon-detail-item">
                            {coupon.min_purchase_amount > 0
                              ? `满¥${coupon.min_purchase_amount}可用`
                              : '无门槛'}
                          </div>
                          <div className="coupon-detail-item">
                            有效期至: {new Date(coupon.valid_until).toLocaleDateString('zh-CN')}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 微信支付二维码弹窗 */}
        {showWeChatQRModal && (
          <div className="wechat-qr-modal-overlay" onClick={() => setShowWeChatQRModal(false)}>
            <div className="wechat-qr-modal" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
              <div className="wechat-qr-header">
                <h3>微信扫码支付</h3>
                <button className="btn-close-modal" onClick={() => setShowWeChatQRModal(false)}>×</button>
              </div>
              <div className="wechat-qr-body">
                <div className="qr-code-container">
                  {wechatQRCodeURL && (
                    <img
                      src={`https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=280x280&data=${encodeURIComponent(wechatQRCodeURL)}`}
                      alt="微信支付二维码"
                      className="qr-code-image"
                    />
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="wechat-pay-tips">
                  <p className="main-tip">请使用微信扫码完成支付</p>
                  <p className="sub-tip">支付金额: ¥{getFinalAmount().toFixed(2)}</p>
                  {wechatPaymentPolling && (
                    <div className="polling-status">
                      <div className="polling-spinner"></div>
                      <span>等待支付中...</span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default OrderConfirmation;

// ========== 文件: frontend-user/src/pages/PaperDetailPage.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React, { useEffect, useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import api, { publicScholarAPI } from '../services/api';
import SEO from '../components/SEO';
import FloatingGuide from '../components/FloatingGuide';
import { generateScholarlyArticleSchema, generateBreadcrumbSchema, truncateText } from '../utils/seoHelpers';
import './PaperDetailPage.css';

const PaperDetailPage = () => {
  const { paperId } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [paper, setPaper] = useState(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('citations'); // 'citations' or 'references'
  const [showCiteModal, setShowCiteModal] = useState(false);
  const [citationFormat, setCitationFormat] = useState('bibtex'); // 'bibtex', 'mla', 'apa', 'chicago'
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [copiedDoi, setCopiedDoi] = useState(false);
  const [copiedCorpusId, setCopiedCorpusId] = useState(false);
  
  // 搜索结果相关状态
  const [searchResults, setSearchResults] = useState([]);
  const [searchTotal, setSearchTotal] = useState(0); // 搜索结果总数
  const [isSearching, setIsSearching] = useState(false);
  const [searchError, setSearchError] = useState(null);
  const [hasSearched, setHasSearched] = useState(false);

  // 相似论文弹窗状态
  const [showSimilarPopup, setShowSimilarPopup] = useState(false);
  const [similarPapers, setSimilarPapers] = useState([]);
  const [similarPapersLoading, setSimilarPapersLoading] = useState(false);
  const [similarPapersLoaded, setSimilarPapersLoaded] = useState(false);
  const isHoveringTitleRef = useRef(false); // 使用 ref 来跟踪 hover 状态，避免闭包问题

  // 构建 Semantic Scholar 的 URL
  const semanticScholarUrl = `https://www.semanticscholar.org/paper/${paperId}`;

  useEffect(() => {
    // 从公开API获取论文详情(无需认证)
    const fetchPaperDetails = async () => {
      try {
        setIsLoading(true);
        const response = await api.get(`/public/papers/${paperId}`, {
          params: {
            fields: 'paperId,title,abstract,authors,year,citationCount,referenceCount,venue,publicationDate,publicationTypes,fieldsOfStudy,s2FieldsOfStudy,externalIds,url,openAccessPdf,influentialCitationCount,isOpenAccess,tldr,journal,citations.paperId,citations.externalIds,citations.url,citations.title,citations.abstract,citations.venue,citations.publicationVenue,citations.year,citations.referenceCount,citations.citationCount,citations.influentialCitationCount,citations.openAccessPdf,citations.s2FieldsOfStudy,citations.publicationTypes,citations.publicationDate,citations.journal,citations.citationStyles,citations.authors,references.paperId,references.externalIds,references.url,references.title,references.abstract,references.venue,references.publicationVenue,references.year,references.referenceCount,references.citationCount,references.influentialCitationCount,references.openAccessPdf,references.s2FieldsOfStudy,references.publicationTypes,references.publicationDate,references.journal,references.citationStyles,references.authors'
          }
        });
        // API返回格式: { code: 0, message: "success", data: {...} }
        setPaper(response.data.data);
        setError(null);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to fetch paper details:', err);
        setError(err.response?.data?.message || 'Failed to load paper details');
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    };

    if (paperId) {
      fetchPaperDetails();
    }
  }, [paperId]);

  // 预加载相似论文数据（单独的 useEffect，在 paperId 变化时触发）
  useEffect(() => {
    const prefetchSimilarPapers = async () => {
      console.log('[Prefetch] Starting to prefetch similar papers for paperId:', paperId);
      setSimilarPapersLoading(true);
      setSimilarPapersLoaded(false);
      setSimilarPapers([]);
      
      try {
        // 获取推荐论文列表
        const recResponse = await publicScholarAPI.getRecommendations(paperId, 5);
        const recommendedPapers = recResponse.data?.data?.recommendedPapers || recResponse.data?.recommendedPapers || [];
        
        if (recommendedPapers.length === 0) {
          console.log('[Prefetch] No recommended papers found');
          setSimilarPapers([]);
          setSimilarPapersLoaded(true);
          setSimilarPapersLoading(false);
          return;
        }
        
        // 提取论文ID列表 - 只取第一个
        const paperIds = recommendedPapers.map(p => p.paperId).filter(id => id).slice(0, 1);
        
        // 通过batch接口获取详细信息
        const batchResponse = await publicScholarAPI.getPaperBatch(
          paperIds,
          ['paperId', 'title', 'authors', 'year', 'citationCount', 'venue']
        );
        
        const papers = batchResponse.data?.data || batchResponse.data || [];
        console.log('[Prefetch] Similar papers loaded:', papers.length);
        setSimilarPapers(papers);
        setSimilarPapersLoaded(true);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('[Prefetch] Failed to prefetch similar papers:', err);
        setSimilarPapers([]);
        setSimilarPapersLoaded(true);
      } finally {
        setSimilarPapersLoading(false);
      }
    };

    if (paperId) {
      prefetchSimilarPapers();
    }
  }, [paperId]);

  const handleLogoClick = () => {
    navigate('/');
  };

  const handleSearch = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return;
    
    setIsSearching(true);
    setSearchError(null);
    setHasSearched(true);
    
    try {
      const response = await publicScholarAPI.searchPapers({
        query: searchQuery.trim(),
        limit: 10, // 最多获取10篇
        fields: ['paperId', 'title', 'abstract', 'authors', 'year', 'venue', 'citationCount', 'openAccessPdf', 's2FieldsOfStudy', 'tldr']
      });
      
      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
        const results = response.data.data.data?.data || [];
        const total = response.data.data.data?.total || results.length;
        setSearchResults(results);
        setSearchTotal(total);
      } else {
        setSearchResults([]);
        setSearchTotal(0);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Search failed:', err);
      setSearchError('搜索失败，请稍后重试');
      setSearchResults([]);
      setSearchTotal(0);
    } finally {
      setIsSearching(false);
    }
  };
  
  // 清除搜索结果
  const clearSearchResults = () => {
    setSearchResults([]);
    setHasSearched(false);
    setSearchQuery('');
  };
  
  // 跳转到学术检索页面进行完整搜索
  const goToHomeSearch = () => {
    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      navigate(`/search-results?query=${encodeURIComponent(searchQuery.trim())}`);
    } else {
      navigate('/search-results');
    }
  };

  const handleSignIn = () => {
    navigate('/');
  };

  const handleSignUp = () => {
    navigate('/');
  };

  // 处理标题hover
  const handleTitleMouseEnter = () => {
    console.log('[Hover] Mouse enter title, similarPapersLoaded:', similarPapersLoaded, 'similarPapersLoading:', similarPapersLoading, 'similarPapers:', similarPapers.length);
    isHoveringTitleRef.current = true;
    // 立即显示弹窗（数据通常已预加载完成，如果还在加载则显示loading状态）
    setShowSimilarPopup(true);
  };

  const handleTitleMouseLeave = () => {
    console.log('[Hover] Mouse leave title');
    isHoveringTitleRef.current = false;
    setShowSimilarPopup(false);
  };

  // 点击推荐论文 - 跳转到搜索结果页
  const handleSimilarPaperClick = (similarPaperId) => {
    navigate(`/search-results?query=&paperId=${similarPaperId}`);
  };

  // 查看更多相似论文
  const handleViewMoreSimilar = () => {
    navigate(`/search-results?query=&paperId=${paperId}`);
  };

  // 点击作者 - 跳转到作者页面
  const handleAuthorClick = (authorId, e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (authorId) {
      navigate(`/search-results?query=&authorId=${authorId}`);
    }
  };

  // 生成引用格式
  const generateCitation = (format) => {
    if (!paper) return '';

    const authors = paper.authors || [];
    const title = paper.title || 'Untitled';
    const year = paper.year || 'n.d.';
    const venue = paper.venue || '';
    const corpusId = paper.paperId || '';

    // 获取期刊信息
    const journal = paper.journal || {};
    const volume = journal.volume || '';
    const pages = journal.pages || '';

    switch (format) {
      case 'bibtex':
        const firstAuthor = authors[0]?.name || 'Unknown';
        const lastName = firstAuthor.split(' ').pop();

        const stopWords = ['of', 'the', 'in', 'for', 'and', 'a', 'an', 'to', 'on'];
        const titleWords = title.split(' ').filter(w =>
          w.length > 2 && !stopWords.includes(w.toLowerCase())
        );

        const firstTitleWord = titleWords[0]?.replace(/[^a-zA-Z]/g, '') || 'Paper';
        const secondTitleWord = titleWords[1]?.replace(/[^a-zA-Z]/g, '') || '';
        const secondWordInitials = secondTitleWord.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();

        const bibtexKey = `${lastName}${year}${firstTitleWord}${secondWordInitials}`;

        let bibtex = `@article{${bibtexKey},\n  title={${title}},\n  author={${authors.map(a => a.name).join(' and ')}}`;
        if (venue) bibtex += `,\n  journal={${venue}}`;
        if (year) bibtex += `,\n  year={${year}}`;
        if (volume) bibtex += `,\n  volume={${volume}}`;
        if (pages) bibtex += `,\n  pages={${pages}}`;
        bibtex += `,\n  url={https://api.semanticscholar.org/CorpusID:${corpusId}}\n}`;
        return bibtex;

      case 'mla':
        // MLA: 第一作者 姓, 名，超过3人用 et al.
        // MLA格式：期刊名斜体
        let mlaAuthorStr = '';
        if (authors.length > 0) {
          const firstAuthorParts = authors[0].name.split(' ');
          const firstAuthorFormatted = firstAuthorParts.length > 1
            ? `${firstAuthorParts[firstAuthorParts.length - 1]}, ${firstAuthorParts.slice(0, -1).join(' ')}`
            : authors[0].name;
          
          if (authors.length === 1) {
            mlaAuthorStr = firstAuthorFormatted;
          } else if (authors.length === 2) {
            mlaAuthorStr = `${firstAuthorFormatted}, and ${authors[1].name}`;
          } else {
            // 3人及以上使用 et al.
            mlaAuthorStr = `${firstAuthorFormatted} et al.`;
          }
        } else {
          mlaAuthorStr = 'Unknown';
        }

        let mla = `${mlaAuthorStr}. "${title}."`;
        if (venue) mla += ` <i>${venue}</i>`;
        if (volume) mla += ` ${volume}`;
        if (year && pages) mla += ` (${year}): ${pages}`;
        else if (year) mla += ` (${year})`;
        else if (pages) mla += `: ${pages}`;
        mla += '.';
        return mla;

      case 'apa':
        // APA: 姓, 名首字母., 最后一个作者用 & 连接
        // APA格式：期刊名和卷号斜体
        let apaAuthorStr = '';
        if (authors.length > 0) {
          const apaFormatted = authors.map(a => {
            const nameParts = a.name.split(' ');
            if (nameParts.length > 1) {
              const initials = nameParts.slice(0, -1).map(n => n[0] + '.').join(' ');
              return `${nameParts[nameParts.length - 1]}, ${initials}`;
            }
            return a.name;
          });
          
          if (apaFormatted.length === 1) {
            apaAuthorStr = apaFormatted[0];
          } else if (apaFormatted.length === 2) {
            apaAuthorStr = `${apaFormatted[0]}, & ${apaFormatted[1]}`;
          } else {
            apaAuthorStr = `${apaFormatted.slice(0, -1).join(', ')}, & ${apaFormatted[apaFormatted.length - 1]}`;
          }
        } else {
          apaAuthorStr = 'Unknown';
        }

        let apa = `${apaAuthorStr} (${year}). ${title}.`;
        if (venue && volume) apa += ` <i>${venue}, ${volume}</i>`;
        else if (venue) apa += ` <i>${venue}</i>`;
        else if (volume) apa += ` <i>${volume}</i>`;
        if (pages) apa += `, ${pages}`;
        apa += '.';
        return apa;

      case 'chicago':
        // Chicago: 所有作者都是 姓, 名 格式，最后用 and 连接
        // Chicago格式：期刊名斜体
        let chicagoAuthorStr = '';
        if (authors.length > 0) {
          const chicagoFormatted = authors.map(a => {
            const nameParts = a.name.split(' ');
            if (nameParts.length > 1) {
              // 所有作者都是：姓, 名
              return `${nameParts[nameParts.length - 1]}, ${nameParts.slice(0, -1).join(' ')}`;
            }
            return a.name;
          });
          if (chicagoFormatted.length === 1) {
            chicagoAuthorStr = chicagoFormatted[0];
          } else if (chicagoFormatted.length === 2) {
            chicagoAuthorStr = `${chicagoFormatted[0]}, and ${chicagoFormatted[1]}`;
          } else {
            chicagoAuthorStr = `${chicagoFormatted.slice(0, -1).join(', ')}, and ${chicagoFormatted[chicagoFormatted.length - 1]}`;
          }
        } else {
          chicagoAuthorStr = 'Unknown';
        }

        let chicago = `${chicagoAuthorStr}. "${title}."`;
        if (venue) chicago += ` <i>${venue}</i>`;
        if (volume) chicago += ` ${volume}`;
        if (year && pages) chicago += ` (${year}): ${pages}`;
        else if (year) chicago += ` (${year})`;
        else if (pages) chicago += `: ${pages}`;
        chicago += '.';
        return chicago;

      default:
        return '';
    }
  };

  const copyCitation = () => {
    const citation = generateCitation(citationFormat);
    // 去除 HTML 标签后复制
    const plainCitation = citation.replace(/<\/?i>/g, '');
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(plainCitation);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000); // 2秒后恢复
  };

  // 复制 DOI
  const copyDoi = (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (paper?.externalIds?.DOI) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(paper.externalIds.DOI);
      setCopiedDoi(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedDoi(false), 2000);
    }
  };

  // 复制 Corpus ID
  const copyCorpusId = (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (paper?.externalIds?.CorpusId) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(paper.externalIds.CorpusId.toString());
      setCopiedCorpusId(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedCorpusId(false), 2000);
    }
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="pd-page">
        <div className="pd-loading">
          <div className="pd-loading-spinner"></div>
          <p>Loading paper details...</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error || !paper) {
    return (
      <div className="pd-page">
        <div className="pd-error">
          <svg width="64" height="64" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5">
            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" />
            <line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="12" />
            <line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12.01" y2="16" />
          </svg>
          <h2>Failed to load</h2>
          <p>{error || 'Paper not found'}</p>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem', marginTop: '1.5rem' }}>
            <button onClick={handleLogoClick} className="pd-error-btn">
              Back to Home
            </button>
            <button onClick={() => window.open(semanticScholarUrl, '_blank')} className="pd-error-btn secondary">
              View on Semantic Scholar
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // 生成SEO数据
  const pageTitle = paper?.title
    ? `${paper.title} - Scholay`
    : 'Paper Details - Scholay';

  const pageDescription = paper?.abstract
    ? truncateText(paper.abstract, 160)
    : `View details for this ${paper?.year || ''} academic paper by ${paper?.authors?.slice(0, 3).map(a => a.name).join(', ')} et al.`;

  const breadcrumbData = [
    { name: 'Home', url: '/' },
    { name: 'Paper Details', url: `/paper/${paperId}` }
  ];

  return (
    <div className="pd-page">
      {/* 悬浮引导卡片 */}
      <FloatingGuide />
      
      <SEO
        title={pageTitle}
        description={pageDescription}
        keywords={`${paper?.title},${paper?.authors?.slice(0, 5).map(a => a.name).join(',')},${paper?.fieldsOfStudy?.join(',')}`}
        canonical={`/paper/${paperId}`}
        ogType="article"
        structuredData={paper ? generateScholarlyArticleSchema(paper) : generateBreadcrumbSchema(breadcrumbData)}
      />

      {/* 顶部导航栏 - 带搜索框和登录/注册按钮 */}
      <div className="pd-top-header">
        {/* Logo */}
        <div className="pd-header-left">
          <div className="pd-header-logo" onClick={handleLogoClick}>
            <img src="/logo.png" alt="Scholay" className="pd-logo-image" />
            <span className="pd-logo-text">Scholay</span>
          </div>
          <div 
            className="pd-new-feature-tag"
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              if (window.openFloatingGuide) {
                window.openFloatingGuide();
              }
            }}
          >
            <span className="pd-new-badge">NEW</span>
            <span className="pd-feature-text">AI Analysis</span>
            <svg className="pd-feature-arrow" width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <path d="M9 18l6-6-6-6"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 搜索框 - 居中 */}
        <form className="pd-header-search-form" onSubmit={handleSearch}>
