 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useOutletContext, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { peerReviewAPI } from '../services/api';
import { useAuth } from '../utils/AuthContext';
import { useSidebar } from '../contexts/SidebarContext';
import ModelSelector from '../components/ModelSelector';
import MarkdownRenderer from '../components/MarkdownRenderer';
import MessageModal from '../components/MessageModal';
import './styles/PeerReviewPage.css';
import './styles/ReviewReport.css';

// 任务状态映射
const STATUS_MAP = {
  draft: { label: '草稿', color: 'gray' },
  pending: { label: '等待处理', color: 'orange' },
  processing: { label: '处理中', color: 'blue' },
  completed: { label: '已完成', color: 'green' },
  failed: { label: '失败', color: 'red' },
};

// 视图模式
const VIEW_MODE = {
  HOME: 'home',       // 主页（创建+列表）
  DETAIL: 'detail',   // 任务详情
};

// 截取字符串（按字符数，不截断中文）
const truncateString = (str, maxLen) => {
  if (!str) return '';
  if (str.length <= maxLen) return str;
  return str.slice(0, maxLen) + '...';
};

export default function PeerReviewPage() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { sidebarCollapsed, openMobileSidebar, isMobile } = useOutletContext() || {};
  const { user, openLoginModal } = useAuth();
  const { resetSidebarConfig } = useSidebar();

  // 进入页面时清空侧边栏历史记录
  useEffect(() => {
    resetSidebarConfig();
  }, [resetSidebarConfig]);

  // 视图状态
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState(VIEW_MODE.HOME);
  const [selectedTaskId, setSelectedTaskId] = useState(null);

  // 任务列表状态
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState([]);
  const [totalTasks, setTotalTasks] = useState(0);
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  // 草稿状态（从后端加载）
  const [draftId, setDraftId] = useState(null);
  const [inputType, setInputType] = useState('text');
  const [manuscriptText, setManuscriptText] = useState('');
  const [targetVenue, setTargetVenue] = useState('');
  const [modelLevel, setModelLevel] = useState('low'); // 默认普通模式
  const [fileName, setFileName] = useState('');
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
  const [draftLoading, setDraftLoading] = useState(false);

  // 任务详情状态
  const [taskDetail, setTaskDetail] = useState(null);
  const [detailLoading, setDetailLoading] = useState(false);

  // 弹窗状态
  const [modal, setModal] = useState({ isOpen: false, type: 'info', title: '', message: '', onConfirm: null });

  // 轮询和防抖相关
  const pollingRef = useRef(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef(null);
  const saveDraftTimeoutRef = useRef(null);

  // 显示弹窗
  const showMessage = (type, title, message) => {
    setModal({ isOpen: true, type, title, message, onConfirm: null });
  };

  // 显示确认弹窗
  const showConfirm = (title, message, onConfirm) => {
    setModal({ isOpen: true, type: 'confirm', title, message, onConfirm });
  };

  // 关闭弹窗
  const closeModal = () => {
    setModal({ ...modal, isOpen: false });
  };

  // 从后端加载草稿
  const loadDraft = async () => {
    if (!user) return;
    
    setDraftLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await peerReviewAPI.getDraft();
      if (response.data?.code === 0) {
        const draft = response.data.data;
        setDraftId(draft.id);
        setInputType(draft.input_type || 'text');
        setManuscriptText(draft.manuscript_text || '');
        setTargetVenue(draft.target_venue || '');
        setModelLevel(draft.model_level || 'low');
        setFileName(draft.file_name || '');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('加载草稿失败:', error);
    } finally {
      setDraftLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // 保存草稿到后端（防抖）
  const saveDraftToServer = async (data) => {
    if (!user) return;
    
    try {
      await peerReviewAPI.saveDraft(data);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('保存草稿失败:', error);
    }
  };

  // 防抖保存草稿
  const debouncedSaveDraft = (data) => {
    if (saveDraftTimeoutRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(saveDraftTimeoutRef.current);
    }
    saveDraftTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      saveDraftToServer(data);
    }, 1000); // 1秒防抖
  };

  // 当草稿内容变化时自动保存
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user || draftLoading) return;
    
    debouncedSaveDraft({
      input_type: inputType,
      manuscript_text: manuscriptText,
      target_venue: targetVenue,
      model_level: modelLevel,
      file_name: fileName,
    });
  }, [inputType, manuscriptText, targetVenue, modelLevel, fileName, user, draftLoading]);

  // 初始加载：获取草稿和任务列表
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return;
    loadDraft();
    loadTasks();
  }, [user]);

  // 分页变化时重新加载任务列表
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return;
    loadTasks();
  }, [currentPage]);

  // 清理轮询
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (pollingRef.current) {
        clearInterval(pollingRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, []);

  // 加载任务列表
  const loadTasks = async () => {
    if (!user) return;
    
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await peerReviewAPI.getTaskList(currentPage, 10);
      if (response.data?.code === 0) {
        setTasks(response.data.data.tasks || []);
        setTotalTasks(response.data.data.total || 0);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('加载任务列表失败:', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // 验证文件
  const validateFile = (file) => {
    if (!file) return null;

    // 检查文件类型
    const allowedTypes = ['.txt', '.doc', '.docx', '.rtf', '.odt', '.pdf'];
    const ext = '.' + file.name.split('.').pop().toLowerCase();
    if (!allowedTypes.includes(ext)) {
      showMessage('warning', '文件类型不支持', '请上传 txt、doc、docx、rtf、odt 或 pdf 文件');
      return null;
    }

    // 检查文件大小
    if (file.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) {
      showMessage('warning', '文件过大', '文件大小不能超过 10MB');
      return null;
    }

    return file;
  };

  // 上传文件（解析并保存到草稿）
  const uploadFile = async (file) => {
    if (!user) {
      showMessage('warning', '请先登录', '上传文件需要登录');
      openLoginModal();
      return;
    }

    setUploading(true);
    try {
      const response = await peerReviewAPI.uploadFile(file);
      if (response.data?.code === 0) {
        const data = response.data.data;
        // 文件上传后，后端会自动保存到草稿，更新本地状态
        setInputType('file');
        setManuscriptText(data.extracted_text || '');
        setFileName(data.file_name || file.name);
        if (data.draft_id) {
          setDraftId(data.draft_id);
        }
        // 上传成功不弹窗，直接显示在输入框中
      } else {
        showMessage('error', '上传失败', response.data?.message || '文件上传失败');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('文件上传失败:', error);
      showMessage('error', '上传失败', error.response?.data?.message || error.message);
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
    }
  };

  // 文件选择处理
  const handleFileSelect = async (e) => {
    const file = validateFile(e.target.files[0]);
    if (file) {
      await uploadFile(file);
    }
    // 清空 input 以便重新选择同一文件
    if (fileInputRef.current) {
      fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    }
  };

  // 拖拽上传处理
  const handleDragEnter = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsDragging(true);
  };

  const handleDragOver = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsDragging(true);
  };

  const handleDragLeave = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    // 只有当离开上传区域时才取消拖拽状态
    if (e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget)) return;
    setIsDragging(false);
  };

  const handleDrop = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsDragging(false);
    
    const file = validateFile(e.dataTransfer.files[0]);
    if (file) {
      await uploadFile(file);
    }
  };

  // 提交草稿开始审稿
  const handleSubmitDraft = async () => {
    if (!user) {
      openLoginModal();
      return;
    }

    // 验证输入
    if (!manuscriptText.trim()) {
      showMessage('warning', '请输入内容', '请输入或上传稿件内容后再开始审稿');
      return;
    }

    if (manuscriptText.trim().length < 100) {
      showMessage('warning', '内容太短', '稿件内容至少需要100个字符');
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const response = await peerReviewAPI.submitDraft(targetVenue, modelLevel);
      if (response.data?.code === 0) {
        const taskId = response.data.data.task_id;
        
        // 清空本地草稿状态
        clearDraft();
        
        // 跳转到详情页
        setSelectedTaskId(taskId);
        setViewMode(VIEW_MODE.DETAIL);
        
        // 刷新列表
        loadTasks();
        
        // 提交成功不弹窗，直接跳转到详情页
      } else {
        showMessage('error', '提交失败', response.data?.message || '提交审稿失败');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('提交审稿失败:', error);
      showMessage('error', '提交失败', error.response?.data?.message || error.message);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // 清空草稿（本地状态）
  const clearDraft = () => {
    setManuscriptText('');
    setTargetVenue('');
    setFileName('');
    setInputType('text');
    // 同时保存空草稿到后端
    saveDraftToServer({
      input_type: 'text',
      manuscript_text: '',
      target_venue: '',
      model_level: modelLevel,
      file_name: '',
    });
  };

  // 查看任务详情
  const viewTaskDetail = async (taskId) => {
    setSelectedTaskId(taskId);
    setViewMode(VIEW_MODE.DETAIL);
    await loadTaskDetail(taskId);
  };

  // 加载任务详情
  const loadTaskDetail = async (taskId) => {
    setDetailLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await peerReviewAPI.getTaskDetail(taskId);
      if (response.data?.code === 0) {
        setTaskDetail(response.data.data);
        
        // 如果任务还在处理中，启动轮询
        if (response.data.data.status === 'pending' || response.data.data.status === 'processing') {
          startPolling(taskId);
        } else {
          stopPolling();
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('加载任务详情失败:', error);
    } finally {
      setDetailLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // 启动轮询
  const startPolling = (taskId) => {
    stopPolling();
    pollingRef.current = setInterval(async () => {
      try {
        const response = await peerReviewAPI.getTaskProgress(taskId);
        if (response.data?.code === 0) {
          const progress = response.data.data;
          setTaskDetail(prev => ({
            ...prev,
            status: progress.status,
            progress: progress.progress,
            progress_stage: progress.progress_stage,
          }));

          // 如果完成或失败，停止轮询并重新加载详情
          if (progress.status === 'completed' || progress.status === 'failed') {
            stopPolling();
            loadTaskDetail(taskId);
          }
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('轮询失败:', error);
      }
    }, 2000);
  };

  // 停止轮询
  const stopPolling = () => {
    if (pollingRef.current) {
      clearInterval(pollingRef.current);
      pollingRef.current = null;
    }
  };

  // 删除任务
  const handleDeleteTask = async (taskId) => {
    showConfirm('确认删除', '确定要删除这个审稿任务吗？删除后无法恢复。', async () => {
      try {
        const response = await peerReviewAPI.deleteTask(taskId);
        if (response.data?.code === 0) {
          loadTasks();
          if (selectedTaskId === taskId) {
            setViewMode(VIEW_MODE.HOME);
            setSelectedTaskId(null);
          }
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('删除任务失败:', error);
        showMessage('error', '删除失败', error.response?.data?.message || error.message);
      }
    });
  };

  // 返回主页
  const backToHome = () => {
    stopPolling();
    setViewMode(VIEW_MODE.HOME);
    setSelectedTaskId(null);
    setTaskDetail(null);
    loadTasks();
  };

  // 启动草稿任务（保留用于详情页中的草稿任务）
  const handleStartTask = async (taskId, targetVenue, modelLevel) => {
    try {
      const response = await peerReviewAPI.startTask(taskId, targetVenue, modelLevel);
      if (response.data?.code === 0) {
        // 重新加载任务详情
        await loadTaskDetail(taskId);
        loadTasks();
      } else {
        showMessage('error', '启动失败', response.data?.message || '启动任务失败');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('启动任务失败:', error);
      showMessage('error', '启动失败', error.response?.data?.message || error.message);
    }
  };

  // 未登录提示
  if (!user) {
    return (
      <div className={`prv-page-wrapper ${sidebarCollapsed ? 'prv-sidebar-collapsed' : 'prv-sidebar-expanded'}`}>
        <div className="prv-main-container">
          <div className="prv-content">
            <div className="prv-login-prompt">
              <svg width="64" height="64" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5">
                <path d="M12 22C17.5228 22 22 17.5228 22 12C22 6.47715 17.5228 2 12 2C6.47715 2 2 6.47715 2 12C2 17.5228 6.47715 22 12 22Z"/>
                <path d="M12 8V12M12 16H12.01"/>
              </svg>
              <h2>请先登录</h2>
              <p>AI 审稿人功能需要登录后才能使用</p>
              <button className="prv-login-btn" onClick={openLoginModal}>
                立即登录
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className={`prv-page-wrapper ${sidebarCollapsed ? 'prv-sidebar-collapsed' : 'prv-sidebar-expanded'}`}>
      <div className="prv-main-container">
        <div className="prv-content">
          <div className="prv-layout">
            {/* 顶部导航 */}
            <nav className="prv-navbar">
              {isMobile && (
                <button className="prv-mobile-menu-btn" onClick={openMobileSidebar}>
                  <svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                    <line x1="4" y1="8" x2="20" y2="8" />
                    <line x1="4" y1="16" x2="14" y2="16" />
                  </svg>
                </button>
              )}
              
              <div className="prv-navbar-left">
                {/* 面包屑导航 */}
                <div className="prv-breadcrumb">
                  <button className="prv-breadcrumb-link" onClick={() => navigate('/assistant')}>
                    <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                      <path d="M14.7 6.3a1 1 0 0 0 0 1.4l1.6 1.6a1 1 0 0 0 1.4 0l3.77-3.77a6 6 0 0 1-7.94 7.94l-6.91 6.91a2.12 2.12 0 0 1-3-3l6.91-6.91a6 6 0 0 1 7.94-7.94l-3.76 3.76z"/>
                    </svg>
                    文献助手
                  </button>
                  <span className="prv-breadcrumb-separator">/</span>
                  <span className="prv-breadcrumb-current">AI 审稿</span>
                </div>
                
                {viewMode === VIEW_MODE.DETAIL && (
                  <button className="prv-back-btn" onClick={backToHome}>
                    <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                      <path d="M19 12H5M12 19l-7-7 7-7"/>
                    </svg>
                    返回列表
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </nav>

            {/* 主内容区 - 仅用于首页 */}
            {viewMode === VIEW_MODE.HOME && (
              <div className="prv-main">
                {/* 上半部分：创建任务区域 */}
                <CreateSection
                  inputType={inputType}
                  setInputType={setInputType}
                  manuscriptText={manuscriptText}
                  setManuscriptText={setManuscriptText}
                  targetVenue={targetVenue}
                  setTargetVenue={setTargetVenue}
                  fileName={fileName}
                  uploading={uploading}
                  submitting={submitting}
                  isDragging={isDragging}
                  draftLoading={draftLoading}
                  modelLevel={modelLevel}
                  setModelLevel={setModelLevel}
                  fileInputRef={fileInputRef}
                  onFileSelect={handleFileSelect}
                  onDragEnter={handleDragEnter}
                  onDragOver={handleDragOver}
                  onDragLeave={handleDragLeave}
                  onDrop={handleDrop}
                  onRemoveFile={() => { 
                    setFileName(''); 
                    setManuscriptText(''); 
                    setInputType('text');
                    // 同步清空后端草稿中的文件信息
                    saveDraftToServer({
                      input_type: 'text',
                      manuscript_text: '',
                      target_venue: targetVenue,
                      model_level: modelLevel,
                      file_name: '',
                    });
                  }}
                  onSubmit={handleSubmitDraft}
                  onClearDraft={clearDraft}
                />

                {/* 下半部分：历史任务列表 */}
                <HistorySection
                  tasks={tasks}
                  loading={loading}
                  totalTasks={totalTasks}
                  currentPage={currentPage}
                  onPageChange={setCurrentPage}
                  onViewDetail={viewTaskDetail}
                  onDelete={handleDeleteTask}
                />
              </div>
            )}

            {/* 详情视图 - 独立布局，不在 prv-main 内 */}
            {viewMode === VIEW_MODE.DETAIL && (
              <TaskDetailView
                task={taskDetail}
                loading={detailLoading}
                onBack={backToHome}
                onDelete={() => handleDeleteTask(selectedTaskId)}
                onStartTask={handleStartTask}
              />
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 消息弹窗 */}
      <MessageModal
        isOpen={modal.isOpen}
        onClose={closeModal}
        type={modal.type}
        title={modal.title}
        message={modal.message}
        onConfirm={modal.onConfirm}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

// ========== 子组件 ==========

// 创建任务区域（上半部分）
function CreateSection({
  inputType, setInputType,
  manuscriptText, setManuscriptText,
  targetVenue, setTargetVenue,
  fileName,
  uploading, submitting, isDragging, draftLoading,
  modelLevel, setModelLevel,
  fileInputRef,
  onFileSelect, onDragEnter, onDragOver, onDragLeave, onDrop,
  onRemoveFile, onSubmit, onClearDraft
}) {
  const hasContent = manuscriptText.trim().length > 0;

  return (
    <div className="prv-create-section">
      <div className="prv-section-header">
        <div className="prv-section-intro">
          <h2 className="prv-section-title">
            <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5">
              <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/>
              <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/>
              <path d="M12 18l-2.4-1.2L7 18v-4l2.6 1.3L12 14l2.4 1.3L17 14v4l-2.6-1.2L12 18z"/>
            </svg>
            AI 审稿
          </h2>
          <p className="prv-section-desc">上传论文，获取专业审稿意见</p>
        </div>
        <div className="prv-header-right">
          {hasContent && (
            <button className="prv-clear-btn" onClick={onClearDraft}>
              <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                <line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"/>
                <line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"/>
              </svg>
              清空
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>


      {/* 输入区域 - 毛玻璃效果，支持粘贴文本和拖拽上传 */}
      <div 
        className={`prv-composer-wrapper ${isDragging ? 'prv-dragging' : ''}`}
        onDragEnter={onDragEnter}
        onDragOver={onDragOver}
        onDragLeave={onDragLeave}
        onDrop={onDrop}
      >
        {/* 拖拽上传遮罩 */}
        {isDragging && (
          <div className="prv-drag-overlay">
            <svg width="48" height="48" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5">
              <path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/>
              <polyline points="17 8 12 3 7 8"/>
              <line x1="12" y1="3" x2="12" y2="15"/>
            </svg>
            <p>松开鼠标上传文件</p>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 上传中遮罩 */}
        {uploading && (
          <div className="prv-upload-overlay">
            <div className="prv-spinner"></div>
            <p>正在解析文件...</p>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="prv-input-area">
          {draftLoading ? (
            <div className="prv-draft-loading">
              <div className="prv-spinner-small"></div>
              <span>加载草稿中...</span>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              {/* 已上传文件信息条 */}
              {fileName && (
                <div className="prv-file-bar">
                  <div className="prv-file-bar-info">
                    <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                      <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/>
                      <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/>
                    </svg>
                    <span className="prv-file-bar-name">{fileName}</span>
                  </div>
                  <button className="prv-file-bar-remove" onClick={onRemoveFile}>
                    <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                      <line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"/>
                      <line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"/>
                    </svg>
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
              
              {/* 文本输入区域 */}
              <div className="prv-textarea-wrapper">
                <textarea
                  className={`prv-textarea ${fileName ? 'prv-textarea-readonly' : ''}`}
                  placeholder=""
                  value={manuscriptText}
                  onChange={(e) => !fileName && setManuscriptText(e.target.value)}
                  readOnly={!!fileName}
                  maxLength={50000}
                />
                
                {/* 空状态引导提示 */}
                {!manuscriptText && !fileName && (
                  <div className="prv-empty-guide">
                    <div className="prv-guide-methods">
                      {/* 文字输入方式 */}
                      <div className="prv-guide-method">
                        <div className="prv-method-icon prv-method-text">
                          <svg width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5">
                            <path d="M17 3a2.828 2.828 0 1 1 4 4L7.5 20.5 2 22l1.5-5.5L17 3z"/>
                          </svg>
                        </div>
                        <p className="prv-method-title">直接输入</p>
                        <p className="prv-method-desc">粘贴或输入论文内容</p>
                      </div>
                      
                      <div className="prv-guide-divider">
                        <span>或</span>
                      </div>
                      
                      {/* 文件上传方式 */}
                      <div className="prv-guide-method">
                        <div className="prv-method-icon prv-method-file">
                          <svg width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5">
                            <path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/>
                            <polyline points="17 8 12 3 7 8"/>
                            <line x1="12" y1="3" x2="12" y2="15"/>
                          </svg>
                        </div>
                        <p className="prv-method-title">上传文件</p>
                        <p className="prv-method-desc">拖拽文件到此处</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div className="prv-guide-formats">
                      <span>支持格式：</span>
                      <span className="prv-format-tag">TXT</span>
                      <span className="prv-format-tag">DOC</span>
                      <span className="prv-format-tag">DOCX</span>
                      <span className="prv-format-tag">PDF</span>
                      <span className="prv-format-tag">RTF</span>
                      <span className="prv-format-tag">ODT</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
              
              {/* 隐藏的文件输入 */}
              <input
                ref={fileInputRef}
                type="file"
                accept=".txt,.doc,.docx,.rtf,.odt,.pdf"
                onChange={onFileSelect}
                style={{ display: 'none' }}
              />
            </>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Composer Footer */}
        <div className="prv-composer-footer">
          {/* 左侧：模型选择和上传 */}
          <div className="prv-composer-footer-left">
            <ModelSelector 
              value={modelLevel} 
              onChange={setModelLevel}
              compact={true}
            />
            
            <button 
              className="prv-footer-btn"
              onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
              disabled={uploading}
              title="上传文件"
            >
              <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                <path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/>
                <polyline points="17 8 12 3 7 8"/>
                <line x1="12" y1="3" x2="12" y2="15"/>
              </svg>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* 中间：目标期刊 - 可展开的输入 */}
          <div className="prv-venue-section">
            <div className="prv-venue-toggle">
              <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                <path d="M4 19.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 6.5 17H20"/>
                <path d="M6.5 2H20v20H6.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 4 19.5v-15A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 6.5 2z"/>
              </svg>
              <input
                type="text"
                className="prv-venue-input"
                placeholder="投稿期刊（可选，让审稿更有针对性）"
                value={targetVenue}
                onChange={(e) => setTargetVenue(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
          
          {/* 右侧：字符计数 + 提交按钮 */}
          <div className="prv-composer-footer-right">
            <div className="prv-char-count">
              <span className={manuscriptText.length > 45000 ? 'prv-char-warning' : ''}>
                {manuscriptText.length.toLocaleString()}
              </span>
              <span className="prv-char-separator">/</span>
              <span className="prv-char-max">50,000</span>
            </div>
            
            <button 
              className="prv-submit-btn" 
              onClick={onSubmit}
              disabled={submitting || !hasContent || draftLoading}
            >
              {submitting ? (
                <>
                  <div className="prvr-btn-spinner"></div>
                  审稿中...
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                    <line x1="22" y1="2" x2="11" y2="13"/>
                    <polygon points="22 2 15 22 11 13 2 9 22 2"/>
                  </svg>
                  开始审稿
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// 历史任务区域（下半部分）
function HistorySection({ tasks, loading, totalTasks, currentPage, onPageChange, onViewDetail, onDelete }) {
  const pageSize = 10;
  const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalTasks / pageSize);

  return (
    <div className="prv-history-section">
      <div className="prv-section-header">
        <h2 className="prv-section-title">
          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/>
            <polyline points="12 6 12 12 16 14"/>
          </svg>
          历史任务
          {totalTasks > 0 && <span className="prv-task-count">({totalTasks})</span>}
        </h2>
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <div className="prv-loading-inline">
          <div className="prv-spinner-small"></div>
          <span>加载中...</span>
        </div>
      ) : tasks.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="prv-empty-history">
          <p>暂无审稿记录，开始您的第一次审稿吧</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="prv-task-list-compact">
            {tasks.map(task => (
              <div key={task.id} className="prv-task-item" onClick={() => onViewDetail(task.id)}>
                <div className="prv-task-item-main">
                  <span className={`prv-task-status-dot prv-dot-${task.status}`}></span>
                  <div className="prv-task-item-info">
                    <h4 className="prv-task-item-title">{task.title || '未命名稿件'}</h4>
                    <span className="prv-task-item-time">
                      {new Date(task.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-CN')}
                      {task.target_venue && ` · ${task.target_venue}`}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="prv-task-item-right">
                  <span className={`prv-task-status-badge prv-status-${task.status}`}>
                    {STATUS_MAP[task.status]?.label || task.status}
                  </span>
                  {(task.status === 'draft' || task.status === 'failed') && (
                    <button 
                      className="prv-task-item-delete" 
                      onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onDelete(task.id); }}
                    >
                      <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                        <polyline points="3 6 5 6 21 6"/>
                        <path d="M19 6v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6m3 0V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"/>
                      </svg>
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {totalPages > 1 && (
            <div className="prv-pagination-compact">
              <button 
                className="prv-page-btn-small" 
                disabled={currentPage <= 1}
                onClick={() => onPageChange(currentPage - 1)}
              >
                ‹ 上一页
              </button>
              <span className="prv-page-info-small">{currentPage} / {totalPages}</span>
              <button 
                className="prv-page-btn-small" 
                disabled={currentPage >= totalPages}
                onClick={() => onPageChange(currentPage + 1)}
              >
                下一页 ›
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// 创建任务视图
function CreateTaskView({
  inputType, setInputType,
  manuscriptText, setManuscriptText,
  targetVenue, setTargetVenue,
  modelLevel, setModelLevel,
  uploadedFile, filePreview,
  uploading, creating, isDragging,
  fileInputRef,
  onFileSelect, onDragEnter, onDragOver, onDragLeave, onDrop, onRemoveFile,
  onSubmit, onCancel
}) {
  return (
    <div className="prv-create-view">
      <div className="prv-create-card">
        <h2 className="prv-create-title">创建审稿任务</h2>
        
        {/* 输入类型选择 */}
        <div className="prv-form-group">
          <label className="prv-form-label">输入方式</label>
          <div className="prv-input-type-tabs">
            <button 
              className={`prv-tab ${inputType === 'text' ? 'active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => setInputType('text')}
            >
              <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/>
                <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/>
                <line x1="16" y1="13" x2="8" y2="13"/>
                <line x1="16" y1="17" x2="8" y2="17"/>
              </svg>
              直接输入文本
            </button>
            <button 
              className={`prv-tab ${inputType === 'file' ? 'active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => setInputType('file')}
            >
              <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                <path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/>
                <polyline points="17 8 12 3 7 8"/>
                <line x1="12" y1="3" x2="12" y2="15"/>
              </svg>
              上传文件
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 文本输入 */}
        {inputType === 'text' && (
          <div className="prv-form-group">
            <label className="prv-form-label">稿件内容 *</label>
            <textarea
              className="prv-textarea"
              placeholder="请粘贴您的论文稿件内容（摘要或全文）..."
              value={manuscriptText}
              onChange={(e) => setManuscriptText(e.target.value)}
              rows={15}
            />
            <span className="prv-char-count">{manuscriptText.length} 字符</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 文件上传 */}
        {inputType === 'file' && (
          <div className="prv-form-group">
            <label className="prv-form-label">上传文件 *</label>
            
            {!uploadedFile ? (
              <div 
                className={`prv-upload-area ${isDragging ? 'prv-dragging' : ''}`}
                onClick={() => !uploading && fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                onDragEnter={onDragEnter}
                onDragOver={onDragOver}
                onDragLeave={onDragLeave}
                onDrop={onDrop}
              >
                {uploading ? (
                  <div className="prv-upload-loading">
                    <div className="prv-spinner"></div>
                    <p>正在上传并解析文件...</p>
                    <span className="prv-upload-hint">请稍候，正在提取文本内容</span>
                  </div>
                ) : isDragging ? (
                  <div className="prv-upload-drop-hint">
                    <svg width="56" height="56" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5">
                      <path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/>
                      <polyline points="17 8 12 3 7 8"/>
                      <line x1="12" y1="3" x2="12" y2="15"/>
                    </svg>
                    <p>松开鼠标上传文件</p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="prv-upload-default">
                    <div className="prv-upload-icon">
                      <svg width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5">
                        <path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/>
                        <polyline points="17 8 12 3 7 8"/>
                        <line x1="12" y1="3" x2="12" y2="15"/>
                      </svg>
                    </div>
                    <p className="prv-upload-title">拖拽文件到此处，或点击选择</p>
                    <span className="prv-upload-hint">支持 .txt, .doc, .docx, .rtf, .odt, .pdf 文件，最大 10MB</span>
                    <button type="button" className="prv-upload-btn">
                      <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                        <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/>
                        <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/>
                      </svg>
                      选择文件
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}
                <input
                  ref={fileInputRef}
                  type="file"
                  accept=".txt,.doc,.docx,.rtf,.odt,.pdf"
                  onChange={onFileSelect}
                  style={{ display: 'none' }}
                />
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="prv-uploaded-file">
                <div className="prv-file-info">
                  <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                    <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/>
                    <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/>
                  </svg>
                  <div>
                    <p className="prv-file-name">{uploadedFile.file_name}</p>
                    <span className="prv-file-size">{(uploadedFile.file_size / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB</span>
                  </div>
                  <button className="prv-remove-file" onClick={onRemoveFile}>
                    <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                      <line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"/>
                      <line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"/>
                    </svg>
                  </button>
                </div>
                {filePreview && (
                  <div className="prv-file-preview">
                    <p className="prv-preview-label">内容预览：</p>
                    <p className="prv-preview-text">{filePreview}</p>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 目标期刊 */}
        <div className="prv-form-group">
          <label className="prv-form-label">目标期刊/会议（可选）</label>
          <input
            type="text"
            className="prv-input"
            placeholder="例如：Nature, Science, NeurIPS..."
            value={targetVenue}
            onChange={(e) => setTargetVenue(e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>

        {/* 模型选择 */}
        <div className="prv-form-group">
          <label className="prv-form-label">AI 模型</label>
          <div className="prv-model-selector-wrapper">
            <ModelSelector
              value={modelLevel}
              onChange={setModelLevel}
              dropdownAlign="left"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 提交按钮 */}
        <div className="prv-form-actions">
          <button className="prvr-btn prvr-btn-secondary" onClick={onCancel}>
            取消
          </button>
          <button 
            className="prvr-btn prvr-btn-primary" 
            onClick={onSubmit}
            disabled={creating || (inputType === 'text' && !manuscriptText.trim()) || (inputType === 'file' && !uploadedFile)}
          >
            {creating ? (
              <>
                <div className="prvr-btn-spinner"></div>
                创建中...
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                  <path d="M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14"/>
                  <polyline points="22 4 12 14.01 9 11.01"/>
                </svg>
                开始审稿
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// 任务详情视图 - 左右分栏布局
function TaskDetailView({ task, loading, onBack, onDelete, onStartTask }) {
  const [activeSection, setActiveSection] = useState('report'); // 当前激活的模块

  if (loading || !task) {
    return (
      <div className="prvr-page">
        <div className="prvr-loading">
          <div className="prvr-loading-content">
            <div className="prvr-spinner"></div>
            <h3>正在加载审稿报告...</h3>
            <p>请稍候</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const isProcessing = task.status === 'pending' || task.status === 'processing';
  const isCompleted = task.status === 'completed';
  const isFailed = task.status === 'failed';

  // 解析稿件内容获取预览
  const getManuscriptPreview = () => {
    if (!task.manuscript_text) return '暂无内容';
    return task.manuscript_text.length > 300 
      ? task.manuscript_text.substring(0, 300) + '...' 
      : task.manuscript_text;
  };

  // 格式化日期
  const formatDate = (dateStr) => {
    if (!dateStr) return '-';
    return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleString('zh-CN', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: '2-digit',
      day: '2-digit',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit'
    });
  };

  // 获取模型名称
  const getModelName = (level) => {
    const models = { low: '普通模式', mid: '进阶模式', high: '高级模式' };
    return models[level] || level;
  };

  return (
    <div className="prvr-page">
      {/* 左侧边栏 - 稿件信息 */}
      <aside className="prvr-sidebar">
        {/* 状态卡片 */}
        <div className="prvr-card">
          <div className="prvr-card-title">
            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/>
              <path d="M12 6v6l4 2"/>
            </svg>
            任务状态
          </div>
          <div className={`prvr-status prvr-status-${task.status}`}>
            {isProcessing && (
              <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="prvr-spin">
                <path d="M21 12a9 9 0 11-6.219-8.56"/>
              </svg>
            )}
            {isCompleted && (
              <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                <polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/>
              </svg>
            )}
            {isFailed && (
              <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><line x1="15" y1="9" x2="9" y2="15"/><line x1="9" y1="9" x2="15" y2="15"/>
              </svg>
            )}
            {STATUS_MAP[task.status]?.label || task.status}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 稿件信息卡片 */}
        <div className="prvr-card">
          <div className="prvr-card-title">
            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/>
              <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/>
            </svg>
            稿件信息
          </div>
          <div className="prvr-info-item">
            <span className="prvr-info-label">标题</span>
            <span className="prvr-info-value">{task.title || '未命名稿件'}</span>
          </div>
          {task.target_venue && (
            <div className="prvr-info-item">
              <span className="prvr-info-label">目标期刊</span>
              <span className="prvr-info-value">{task.target_venue}</span>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="prvr-info-item">
            <span className="prvr-info-label">AI 模型</span>
            <span className="prvr-info-value">{getModelName(task.model_level)}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="prvr-info-item">
            <span className="prvr-info-label">创建时间</span>
            <span className="prvr-info-value">{formatDate(task.created_at)}</span>
          </div>
          {task.completed_at && (
            <div className="prvr-info-item">
              <span className="prvr-info-label">完成时间</span>
              <span className="prvr-info-value">{formatDate(task.completed_at)}</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* 稿件预览卡片 */}
        <div className="prvr-card">
          <div className="prvr-card-title">
            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <path d="M1 12s4-8 11-8 11 8 11 8-4 8-11 8-11-8-11-8z"/>
              <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/>
            </svg>
            稿件预览
          </div>
          <div className="prvr-preview">
            {getManuscriptPreview()}
          </div>
        </div>
      </aside>

      {/* 右侧主内容 - 审稿报告 */}
      <main className="prvr-main">
        {/* 报告头部 */}
        <div className="prvr-header">
          <div className="prvr-title">
            <div className="prvr-title-icon">
              <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/>
                <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/>
                <path d="M12 18l-2.4-1.2L7 18v-4l2.6 1.3L12 14l2.4 1.3L17 14v4l-2.6-1.2L12 18z"/>
              </svg>
            </div>
            <h2>审稿报告</h2>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 处理中状态 */}
        {isProcessing && (
          <div className="prvr-processing-status">
            <div className="prvr-processing-animation">
              <div className="prvr-processing-ring"></div>
              <div className="prvr-processing-icon">
                <svg width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                  <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/>
                  <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/>
                </svg>
              </div>
            </div>
            <h3>正在生成审稿报告...</h3>
            <p>{task.progress_stage || '请稍候，AI 正在分析您的论文'}</p>
            <div className="prvr-progress-bar-wrapper">
              <div className="prvr-progress-bar">
                <div className="prvr-progress-fill" style={{ width: `${task.progress || 0}%` }}></div>
              </div>
              <div className="prvr-progress-text">
                <span>{task.progress || 0}%</span>
                <span>预计需要 2-5 分钟</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 错误状态 */}
        {isFailed && (
          <div className="prvr-error">
            <div className="prvr-error-icon">
              <svg width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/>
                <line x1="15" y1="9" x2="9" y2="15"/>
                <line x1="9" y1="9" x2="15" y2="15"/>
              </svg>
            </div>
            <h3>审稿失败</h3>
            <p>{task.error_message || '处理过程中发生错误，请重试'}</p>
            <button className="prvr-btn prvr-btn-secondary" onClick={onDelete}>
              删除任务
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 已完成 - 显示审稿报告 */}
        {isCompleted && (
          <>
          {/* 模块1: 稿件分析 */}
          {task.manuscript_meta && (
            <div className="prvr-section">
              <div className="prvr-section-header">
                <div className="prvr-section-icon analysis">
                  <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                    <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/>
                    <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/>
                    <line x1="16" y1="13" x2="8" y2="13"/>
                    <line x1="16" y1="17" x2="8" y2="17"/>
                  </svg>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="prvr-section-title">稿件分析</h3>
                  <p className="prvr-section-desc">论文基本信息与研究概述</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="prvr-section-body">
                <div className="prvr-analysis-grid">
                  <div className="prvr-analysis-item">
                    <span className="prvr-analysis-label">论文标题</span>
                    <span className="prvr-analysis-value">{task.manuscript_meta.title}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="prvr-analysis-item">
                    <span className="prvr-analysis-label">研究领域</span>
                    <span className="prvr-analysis-value">{task.manuscript_meta.field}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="prvr-analysis-item full-width">
                    <span className="prvr-analysis-label">研究主题</span>
                    <span className="prvr-analysis-value">{task.manuscript_meta.main_topic}</span>
                  </div>
                  {task.manuscript_meta.main_methods?.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="prvr-analysis-item full-width">
                      <span className="prvr-analysis-label">研究方法</span>
                      <div className="prvr-analysis-tags">
                        {task.manuscript_meta.main_methods.map((method, idx) => (
                          <span key={idx} className="prvr-analysis-tag">{method}</span>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {task.manuscript_meta.keywords?.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="prvr-analysis-item full-width">
                      <span className="prvr-analysis-label">关键词</span>
                      <div className="prvr-analysis-tags">
                        {task.manuscript_meta.keywords.map((keyword, idx) => (
                          <span key={idx} className="prvr-analysis-tag">{keyword}</span>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {task.manuscript_meta.claimed_novelty?.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="prvr-analysis-item full-width">
                      <span className="prvr-analysis-label">声称的创新点</span>
                      <ul className="prvr-analysis-list">
                        {task.manuscript_meta.claimed_novelty.map((item, idx) => (
                          <li key={idx}>{item}</li>
                        ))}
                      </ul>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* 模块2: 相似论文 */}
          {task.literature_summary?.closest_papers?.length > 0 && (
            <div className="prvr-section">
              <div className="prvr-section-header">
                <div className="prvr-section-icon papers">
                  <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                    <path d="M4 19.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 6.5 17H20"/>
                    <path d="M6.5 2H20v20H6.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 4 19.5v-15A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 6.5 2z"/>
                  </svg>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="prvr-section-title">相似论文</h3>
                  <p className="prvr-section-desc">与您研究相关的已发表文献</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="prvr-section-body">
                {task.literature_summary.field_state && (
                  <p style={{ marginBottom: '16px', color: 'var(--text-secondary)', fontSize: '14px', lineHeight: '1.7' }}>
                    {task.literature_summary.field_state}
                  </p>
                )}
                <div className="prvr-papers-list">
                  {task.literature_summary.closest_papers.map((paper, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} className="prvr-paper-card">
                      <div className="prvr-paper-index">{idx + 1}</div>
                      <div className="prvr-paper-content">
                        <h4 className="prvr-paper-title">{paper.title}</h4>
                        <div className="prvr-paper-meta">
                          <span>{paper.year}</span>
                        </div>
                        <p className="prvr-paper-reason">{paper.reason}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* 模块3: 研究空白 */}
          {(task.literature_summary?.typical_gaps?.length > 0 || task.gap_literature?.length > 0) && (
            <div className="prvr-section">
              <div className="prvr-section-header">
                <div className="prvr-section-icon gaps">
                  <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                    <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/>
                    <path d="M9.09 9a3 3 0 0 1 5.83 1c0 2-3 3-3 3"/>
                    <line x1="12" y1="17" x2="12.01" y2="17"/>
                  </svg>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="prvr-section-title">研究空白</h3>
                  <p className="prvr-section-desc">该领域尚待探索的研究方向</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="prvr-section-body">
                <div className="prvr-gap-list">
                  {task.gap_literature?.map((item, gapIdx) => (
                    <div key={gapIdx} className="prvr-gap-card">
                      <div className="prvr-gap-header">
                        <span className="prvr-gap-number">{gapIdx + 1}</span>
                        <span className="prvr-gap-text">{item.gap}</span>
                      </div>
                      {item.papers?.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="prvr-gap-papers">
                          {item.papers.map((paper, paperIdx) => (
                            <div key={paperIdx} className="prvr-gap-paper">
                              <span className="prvr-gap-paper-title">
                                {paper.url ? (
                                  <a href={paper.url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                                    {paper.title}
                                  </a>
                                ) : (
                                  paper.title
                                )}
                              </span>
                              <span className="prvr-gap-paper-info">
                                <span>{paper.year}</span>
                                {paper.citationCount !== undefined && (
                                  <span>引用 {paper.citationCount}</span>
                                )}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )) || task.literature_summary?.typical_gaps?.map((gap, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} className="prvr-gap-card">
                      <div className="prvr-gap-header">
                        <span className="prvr-gap-number">{idx + 1}</span>
                        <span className="prvr-gap-text">{gap}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* 模块4: 审稿报告 */}
          {task.review_content && (
            <div className="prvr-section">
              <div className="prvr-section-header">
                <div className="prvr-section-icon report">
                  <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                    <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/>
                    <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/>
                    <path d="M12 18l-2.4-1.2L7 18v-4l2.6 1.3L12 14l2.4 1.3L17 14v4l-2.6-1.2L12 18z"/>
                  </svg>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="prvr-section-title">审稿报告</h3>
                  <p className="prvr-section-desc">详细的审稿意见与改进建议</p>
                </div>
                {task.recommendation && (
                  <div className={`prvr-recommendation ${task.recommendation.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-')}`} style={{ marginLeft: 'auto' }}>
                    {task.recommendation}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="prvr-section-body">
                <div className="prvr-review-report">
                  <MarkdownRenderer content={task.review_content} />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import api from '../services/api';
import { useToast } from '../components/ToastContainer';
import AuthModal from '../components/AuthModal';
import './Pricing.css';

const PLAN_DISPLAY_ORDER = ['free', 'pro', 'max'];

const HERO_STATS = [
  { value: '2亿+', label: '可检索文献' },
  { value: '< 10 秒', label: '平均响应时间' },
  { value: '99.9%', label: '服务可用率' }
];

const HERO_CARD_BULLETS = [
  '批量摘要与引用溯源',
  '多模态搜索 + 对话',
  '团队共享与历史同步'
];

const PLAN_DESCRIPTIONS = {
  free: '体验基础检索与 AI 问答，快速验证灵感',
  pro: '稳定调用高级模型，满足日常深入研究',
  max: '无限访问与最强模型，覆盖高频科研场景'
};

const PLAN_BADGES = {
  pro: '最受欢迎',
  max: '旗舰方案'
};

const FAQ_ITEMS = [
  {
    question: '如何升级我的订阅？',
    answer: '点击任意付费方案的“立即订阅”或“升级至此方案”按钮即可完成升级，支付成功后立即生效。'
  },
  {
    question: '订阅会自动续费吗？',
    answer: '目前订阅不会自动续费，到期前我们会提醒您手动续费，也可在订阅管理页查看到期时间。'
  },
  {
    question: '我可以随时取消订阅吗？',
    answer: '可以。取消后将在当前订阅周期结束时生效，期间仍可继续使用已付费的所有服务。'
  },
  {
    question: '支持哪些支付方式？',
    answer: '我们支持支付宝等方式，陆续推出更多支付方式，确保支付过程安全可靠。'
  }
];

const formatPrice = (value) => {
  if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') {
    return '--';
  }
  const numeric = Number(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(numeric)) {
    return value;
  }
  if (Number.isInteger(numeric)) {
    return numeric.toString();
  }
  return numeric.toFixed(2);
};

const getPlanDescription = (planCode) => PLAN_DESCRIPTIONS[planCode] || '保持高效研究节奏';
const getPlanBadge = (planCode) => PLAN_BADGES[planCode];
const Pricing = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { showError } = useToast();
  const [plans, setPlans] = useState([]);
  const [currentPlan, setCurrentPlan] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [billingCycle, setBillingCycle] = useState('monthly'); // monthly or yearly
  const [showAuthModal, setShowAuthModal] = useState(false);

  const scrollToPlans = () => {
    const section = document.getElementById('plans-section');
    if (section) {
      section.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    }
  };

  const fetchPlans = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const response = await api.get('/user/subscription/plans');
      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        setPlans(response.data.data);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch plans:', error);
      showError('获取套餐列表失败，请稍后重试');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [showError]);

  const fetchCurrentSubscription = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const token = localStorage.getItem('user_token');
      if (!token) {
        // User is not logged in, skip fetching current subscription
        return;
      }
      const response = await api.get('/user/subscription/my');
      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        setCurrentPlan(response.data.data);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch current subscription:', error);
      showError('获取当前订阅信息失败，请稍后重试');
    }
  }, [showError]);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.body.classList.add('pricing-page-active');
    return () => {
      document.body.classList.remove('pricing-page-active');
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchPlans();
    fetchCurrentSubscription();
  }, [fetchPlans, fetchCurrentSubscription]);

  const handlePlanAction = async (planCode, action) => {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('user_token');
    if (!token) {
      // User is not logged in, show auth modal
      setShowAuthModal(true);
      return;
    }

    // Ignore if action is 'none'
    if (action === 'none') {
      return;
    }

    // Navigate to order confirmation page with plan details (order will be created on payment)
    navigate('/order-confirmation', {
      state: {
        planCode,
        billingCycle
      }
    });
  };

  const handleAuthSuccess = () => {
    setShowAuthModal(false);
    // Refresh current subscription after login
    fetchCurrentSubscription();
  };

  const getPricePerMonth = (plan) => {
    if (billingCycle === 'monthly') {
      return plan.current_price_monthly || plan.price_monthly;
    }
    const yearlyPrice = plan.current_price_yearly || plan.price_yearly;
    return (yearlyPrice / 12).toFixed(2);
  };

  const hasDiscount = (plan) => {
    if (billingCycle === 'monthly') {
      return plan.price_monthly !== plan.current_price_monthly;
    }
    // For yearly: compare configured yearly price with monthly price × 12
    const monthlyBasedYearlyPrice = (plan.current_price_monthly || plan.price_monthly) * 12;
    const actualYearlyPrice = plan.current_price_yearly || plan.price_yearly;
    return monthlyBasedYearlyPrice > actualYearlyPrice;
  };

  const getOriginalTotalPrice = (plan) => {
    if (billingCycle === 'monthly') {
      return plan.price_monthly ?? plan.current_price_monthly ?? 0;
    }
    // For yearly: original total is always monthly price × 12
    const monthlyBase = plan.current_price_monthly ?? plan.price_monthly ?? 0;
    return Number((monthlyBase * 12).toFixed(2));
  };

  const isCurrentPlan = (planCode) => {
    return currentPlan && currentPlan.plan_code === planCode;
  };

  // Determine button state and text for each plan
  const getPlanButtonInfo = (planCode) => {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('user_token');

    // Plan hierarchy: free < pro < max
    const planOrder = { 'free': 0, 'pro': 1, 'max': 2 };

    // Not logged in
    if (!token) {
      if (planCode === 'free') {
        return { text: '免费使用', disabled: true, action: 'none' };
      }
      return { text: '立即订阅', disabled: false, action: 'subscribe' };
    }

    // Logged in but no subscription data yet (should not happen, but handle gracefully)
    if (!currentPlan) {
      if (planCode === 'free') {
        return { text: '免费使用', disabled: true, action: 'none' };
      }
      return { text: '立即订阅', disabled: false, action: 'subscribe' };
    }

    const currentOrder = planOrder[currentPlan.plan_code];
    const targetOrder = planOrder[planCode];

    // Current plan
    if (planCode === currentPlan.plan_code) {
      if (planCode === 'free') {
        return { text: '当前方案', disabled: true, action: 'none' };
      }
      return { text: '续期订阅', disabled: false, action: 'renew' };
    }

    // Higher plan - upgrade
    if (targetOrder > currentOrder) {
      return { text: '升级至此方案', disabled: false, action: 'upgrade' };
    }

    // Lower plan - cannot downgrade, show disabled
    return { text: '已是更高套餐', disabled: true, action: 'none' };
  };

  const getPlanFeatureList = (plan) => {
    const featureSet = plan.features || {};
    const features = [
      {
        key: 'normal',
        label: '学术检索',
        value: featureSet.normal_search?.description || '无限制'
      },
      {
        key: 'advanced',
        label: '智能分析',
        value: formatMultiLevelFeature(
          featureSet.advanced_search_low?.description,
          featureSet.advanced_search_mid?.description,
          featureSet.advanced_search_high?.description
        )
      },
      {
        key: 'chat',
        label: 'AI 聊天',
        value: formatMultiLevelFeature(
          featureSet.ai_chat_normal?.description,
          featureSet.ai_chat_mid?.description,
          featureSet.ai_chat_high?.description
        )
      },
      {
        key: 'history',
        label: '历史记录',
        value: featureSet.ai_history_data?.enabled ? '云端同步与多端共享' : '最近会话'
      },
      {
        key: 'data',
        label: '数据洞察',
        value: featureSet.advanced_search_data?.enabled ? '智能分析数据导出' : '基础使用统计'
      }
    ];

    if (plan.plan_code === 'max') {
      features.push({
        key: 'early-access',
        label: '提前尝鲜新功能',
        value: '优先体验最新能力'
      });
    }

    return features;
  };

  // Get total price for display purposes only (actual payment uses backend-calculated order.amount)
  const getTotalPrice = (plan) => {
    if (billingCycle === 'monthly') {
      return plan.current_price_monthly || plan.price_monthly;
    }
    return plan.current_price_yearly || plan.price_yearly;
  };

  // Calculate yearly discount badge text based on backend configuration
  const getYearlyDiscountText = () => {
    // Find any plan with yearly pricing to determine discount display
    const paidPlan = plans.find(p => p.price_yearly > 0);
    if (!paidPlan) return null;

    // Method 1: Percentage discount (if enabled and percentage is set)
    if (paidPlan.yearly_discount_enabled && paidPlan.yearly_discount_percent > 0) {
      return `优惠 ${paidPlan.yearly_discount_percent}%`;
    }

    // Method 2: Price optimization (calculate savings if prices differ)
    if (paidPlan.price_yearly > paidPlan.current_price_yearly) {
      const savings = paidPlan.price_yearly - paidPlan.current_price_yearly;
      return `省 ¥${savings.toFixed(0)}`;
    }

    // Fallback: Calculate equivalent months saved (original behavior)
    const monthlyEquivalent = paidPlan.price_monthly * 12;
    if (monthlyEquivalent > paidPlan.current_price_yearly) {
      const monthsSaved = Math.round((monthlyEquivalent - paidPlan.current_price_yearly) / paidPlan.price_monthly);
      if (monthsSaved > 0) {
        return `省 ${monthsSaved} 个月`;
      }
    }

    return null;
  };

  // Simplify multi-level feature display
  // If all unlimited -> "无限制请求"
  // If some have limits -> "较少次数限制"
  // If all disabled -> "-"
  const formatMultiLevelFeature = (low, mid, high) => {
    const features = [low, mid, high].filter(f => f && f !== '-');

    // All disabled
    if (features.length === 0) {
      return '-';
    }

    // Check if all are unlimited
    const allUnlimited = features.every(f =>
      f.includes('无限制') || f.includes('unlimited') || f === '不限'
    );

    if (allUnlimited) {
      return '无限制请求';
    }

    // Some have limits
    return '较少次数限制';
  };

  // Generate dynamic comparison data from plans
  const getComparisonData = () => {
    if (plans.length === 0) return { sections: [] };

    // Find plans by code for easy access
    const plansByCode = {};
    plans.forEach(plan => {
      plansByCode[plan.plan_code] = plan;
    });

    const freePlan = plansByCode['free'];
    const proPlan = plansByCode['pro'];
    const maxPlan = plansByCode['max'];

    if (!freePlan || !proPlan || !maxPlan) {
      return { sections: [] };
    }

    return {
      sections: [
        {
          title: '核心功能',
          features: [
            {
              name: '学术检索',
              free: freePlan.features?.normal_search?.description || '无限制',
              pro: proPlan.features?.normal_search?.description || '无限制',
              max: maxPlan.features?.normal_search?.description || '无限制'
            },
            { name: '聊天历史记录', free: true, pro: true, max: true },
            { name: '访问网页、移动端应用', free: true, pro: true, max: true },
          ]
        },
        {
          title: 'AI 模型',
          features: [
            {
              name: '智能分析 - 低级模型',
              free: freePlan.features?.advanced_search_low?.description || '-',
              pro: proPlan.features?.advanced_search_low?.description || '-',
              max: maxPlan.features?.advanced_search_low?.description || '-'

            {
              name: '智能分析 - 中级模型',
              free: freePlan.features?.advanced_search_mid?.description || '-',
              pro: proPlan.features?.advanced_search_mid?.description || '-',
              max: maxPlan.features?.advanced_search_mid?.description || '-'
            },
            {
              name: '智能分析 - 高级模型',
              free: freePlan.features?.advanced_search_high?.description || '-',
              pro: proPlan.features?.advanced_search_high?.description || '-',
              max: maxPlan.features?.advanced_search_high?.description || '-'
            },
            {
              name: 'AI 聊天 - 普通模型',
              free: freePlan.features?.ai_chat_normal?.description || '-',
              pro: proPlan.features?.ai_chat_normal?.description || '-',
              max: maxPlan.features?.ai_chat_normal?.description || '-'
            },
            {
              name: 'AI 聊天 - 中级模型',
              free: freePlan.features?.ai_chat_mid?.description || '-',
              pro: proPlan.features?.ai_chat_mid?.description || '-',
              max: maxPlan.features?.ai_chat_mid?.description || '-'
            },
            {
              name: 'AI 聊天 - 高级模型',
              free: freePlan.features?.ai_chat_high?.description || '-',
              pro: proPlan.features?.ai_chat_high?.description || '-',
              max: maxPlan.features?.ai_chat_high?.description || '-'
            },
          ]
        },
        {
          title: '数据与分析',
          features: [
            {
              name: '智能分析数据',
              free: freePlan.features?.advanced_search_data?.enabled,
              pro: proPlan.features?.advanced_search_data?.enabled,
              max: maxPlan.features?.advanced_search_data?.enabled
            },

              name: 'AI 对话历史数据',
              free: freePlan.features?.ai_history_data?.enabled,
              pro: proPlan.features?.ai_history_data?.enabled,

  const yearlyDiscountText = getYearlyDiscountText();
  const comparisonData = getComparisonData();
  const orderedPlans = PLAN_DISPLAY_ORDER
    .map(code => plans.find(plan => plan.plan_code === code))
    .filter(Boolean);
  const remainingPlans = plans.filter(plan => !PLAN_DISPLAY_ORDER.includes(plan.plan_code));
  const finalPlans = [...orderedPlans, ...remainingPlans];
  const showcasePlan = finalPlans.find(plan => plan.plan_code === 'pro') || finalPlans[0];

  if (loading) {

  }

          </button>

            查看套餐
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

                const showOriginalPrice = hasDiscount(plan) && Number(originalPrice) > Number(displayPrice);
                const savingsValue = showOriginalPrice ? Number(originalPrice) - Number(displayPrice) : 0;

                let buttonClass = 'btn-upgrade';
                if (buttonInfo.disabled) {
                  buttonClass = buttonInfo.action === 'none' && plan.plan_code === 'free' ? 'btn-free' : 'btn-current';

                        </li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>

                        className={buttonClass}
                        onClick={() => handlePlanAction(plan.plan_code, buttonInfo.action)}

                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </article>
                );
              })

              <h2>细致比较每项能力</h2>
              <p>了解不同套餐在模型、配额与协作能力上的差异，帮助你快速决策。</p>
            </div>
            <div className="comparison-plan-cards">
              {finalPlans.map(plan => (
                <div key={plan.plan_code} className="comparison-plan-card">
                  <p className="plan-tier-label">{plan.plan_name}</p>
                  <p className="plan-tier-price">
                    {plan.plan_code === 'free'
                      ? '免费使用'
                      : `¥${formatPrice(plan.current_price_monthly ?? plan.price_monthly ?? 0)}/月`}
                  </p>
                  <button
                    className={`plan-tier-btn ${plan.plan_code === 'free' ? 'btn-free' : 'btn-upgrade'}`}
                    onClick={() => handlePlanAction(plan.plan_code, plan.plan_code === 'free' ? 'none' : 'subscribe')}
                  >
                    {plan.plan_code === 'free' ? '免费使用' : '立即订阅'}
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div className="comparison-table">
              <div className="table-header">
                <div className="table-header-cell">功能</div>
                {['free', 'pro', 'max'].map(code => {
                  const plan = plans.find(p => p.plan_code === code);
                  return (
                    <div key={code} className="table-header-cell">
                      {plan ? plan.plan_name : code.toUpperCase()}
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              {comparisonData.sections.map((section, sectionIndex) => (
                <div key={sectionIndex} className="table-section">
                  <div className="section-title">{section.title}</div>
                  {section.features.map((feature, featureIndex) => (
                    <div key={featureIndex} className="table-row">
                      <div className="table-cell">{feature.name}</div>
                      <div className="table-cell">
                        {typeof feature.free === 'boolean' ? (
                          feature.free ? <span className="check-icon">✓</span> : <span className="cross-icon">—</span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="feature-text">{feature.free}</span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className="table-cell">
                        {typeof feature.pro === 'boolean' ? (
                          feature.pro ? <span className="check-icon">✓</span> : <span className="cross-icon">—</span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="feature-text">{feature.pro}</span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className="table-cell">
                        {typeof feature.max === 'boolean' ? (
                          feature.max ? <span className="check-icon">✓</span> : <span className="cross-icon">—</span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="feature-text">{feature.max}</span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </section>
        )}

        <section className="pricing-faq">
          <div className="section-heading">
            <p className="section-eyebrow">常见问题</p>
            <h2>关于订阅的更多解答</h2>
            <p className="section-description">
              如果还有疑问，随时联系支持团队，我们会第一时间响应。
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="faq-grid">
            {FAQ_ITEMS.map(item => (
              <div key={item.question} className="faq-item">
                <h3>{item.question}</h3>
                <p>{item.answer}</p>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </section>
      </main>

      <AuthModal
        isOpen={showAuthModal}
        onClose={() => setShowAuthModal(false)}
        onLoginSuccess={handleAuthSuccess}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default Pricing;

    const hasAuthorId = !!urlParams.get('authorId');
    const returnToTable = localStorage.getItem('returnToTableView') === 'true';
    const returnToSimilarTableFlag = localStorage.getItem('returnToSimilarPapersTable') === 'true';
    
    // 清除 localStorage 标记
    if (returnToTable) {
      localStorage.removeItem('returnToTableView');
    }
    if (returnToSimilarTableFlag) {
      localStorage.removeItem('returnToSimilarPapersTable');
    }
    
    console.log('[SearchResultsPage] initState:', { hasPaperId, hasAuthorId, returnToTable, returnToSimilarTableFlag });
    
    return {
      hasPaperId,
      hasAuthorId,
      returnToTable,
      returnToSimilarTable: returnToSimilarTableFlag,
    };
  }, []);
  
  // 设置 ref 标记（在渲染阶段之外）
  useEffect(() => {
    if (initState.returnToTable) {
      returnedFromLogin.current = true;
    }
    if (initState.returnToSimilarTable) {
      returnedToSimilarTable.current = true;
    }
  }, [initState]);
  
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState(() => {
    // 检查URL中是否有authorId参数，如果有则显示作者详情视图
    if (initState.hasAuthorId) {
      return 'author';
    }
    // 检查URL中是否有paperId参数，如果有则显示论文详情视图
    if (initState.hasPaperId) {
      return 'paper';
    }
    if (initState.returnToTable) {
      // 如果是从相似论文表格视图登录返回，需要进入论文详情视图
      if (initState.returnToSimilarTable) {
        return 'paper'; // 进入论文详情视图
      }
      return 'table';
    }
    return 'list';
  }); // 视图模式: 'list', 'table', 'paper' 或 'author'
  const [selectedDimensionKey, setSelectedDimensionKey] = useState(null); // 表格视图中选中的维度
  const [tableReloadTrigger, setTableReloadTrigger] = useState(null); // 触发表格重新加载
  const [showTableGuide, setShowTableGuide] = useState(false); // 表格视图引导弹窗

  // 论文详情视图相关状态
  const [showDetailSearch, setShowDetailSearch] = useState(false); // 论文详情页搜索框显示状态
  const [detailPaper, setDetailPaper] = useState(null); // 选中的论文详情数据
  const [detailPaperId, setDetailPaperId] = useState(null); // 选中的论文ID
  const [detailLoading, setDetailLoading] = useState(false); // 论文详情加载状态
  const [detailError, setDetailError] = useState(null); // 论文详情错误状态

  // 作者详情视图相关状态
  const [detailAuthor, setDetailAuthor] = useState(null); // 选中的作者详情数据
  const [detailAuthorId, setDetailAuthorId] = useState(null); // 选中的作者ID
  const [authorLoading, setAuthorLoading] = useState(false); // 作者详情加载状态
  const [authorError, setAuthorError] = useState(null); // 作者详情错误状态
  const [authorPapers, setAuthorPapers] = useState([]); // 作者论文列表
  const [authorPapersLoading, setAuthorPapersLoading] = useState(false); // 作者论文加载状态
  const [authorPapersPage, setAuthorPapersPage] = useState(1); // 作者论文当前页
  const [authorPapersTotalPages, setAuthorPapersTotalPages] = useState(0); // 作者论文总页数
  const [authorPapersTotal, setAuthorPapersTotal] = useState(0); // 作者论文总数
  const [authorPapersPerPage] = useState(20); // 每页论文数
  const [authorPapersViewMode, setAuthorPapersViewMode] = useState('list'); // 作者论文视图模式: 'list' 或 'table'
  const [allAuthorPapers, setAllAuthorPapers] = useState([]); // 表格视图累积的所有论文（用于表格视图）
  // authorSelectedPaper 已移除，统一使用 selectedPaper
  const [authorActiveTab, setAuthorActiveTab] = useState('publications'); // 作者详情 Tab: 'publications', 'citingAuthors', 'coAuthors'
  const [detailActiveTab, setDetailActiveTab] = useState(() => {
    // 如果是从相似论文表格视图登录返回，默认选中相似论文 tab
    if (initState.returnToSimilarTable) {
      return 'similar';
    }
    return 'citations';
  }); // 详情页 Tab: 'citations', 'references' 或 'similar'
  const [detailHeaderCollapsed, setDetailHeaderCollapsed] = useState(() => {
    // 如果是从相似论文表格视图登录返回，默认收起头部（与点击相似论文 tab 行为一致）
    if (initState.returnToSimilarTable) {
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }); // 论文详情头部折叠状态
  const [detailCopiedDoi, setDetailCopiedDoi] = useState(false); // DOI复制状态
  const [detailCopiedCorpusId, setDetailCopiedCorpusId] = useState(false); // CorpusId复制状态
  const [detailAbstractExpanded, setDetailAbstractExpanded] = useState(false); // 摘要展开状态
  
  // 引用/参考文献分页加载状态
  const [citationsData, setCitationsData] = useState({ papers: [], currentPage: 1, total: 0, totalPages: 0 });
  const [referencesData, setReferencesData] = useState({ papers: [], currentPage: 1, total: 0, totalPages: 0 });
  const [citationsLoading, setCitationsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [referencesLoading, setReferencesLoading] = useState(false);
  const REFS_PER_PAGE = 10; // 每页显示的引用/参考文献数量
  
  // 相似论文状态
  const [similarPapersData, setSimilarPapersData] = useState({ papers: [], currentPage: 1, total: 0, totalPages: 0 });
  const [similarPapersLoading, setSimilarPapersLoading] = useState(false);
  const [similarPapersViewMode, setSimilarPapersViewMode] = useState(() => {
    // 如果是从相似论文表格视图登录返回，默认使用表格视图
    if (initState.returnToSimilarTable) {
      return 'table';
    }
    return 'list';
  }); // 'list' 或 'table'
  const [allSimilarPapers, setAllSimilarPapers] = useState([]); // 存储所有相似论文数据（用于分页）
  const [similarSelectedDimensionKey, setSimilarSelectedDimensionKey] = useState(null); // 相似论文表格视图选中的维度
  const [similarTableReloadTrigger, setSimilarTableReloadTrigger] = useState(null); // 相似论文表格视图重新加载触发器
  const [showSimilarPapersGuide, setShowSimilarPapersGuide] = useState(false); // 相似论文新手引导
