import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../utils/AuthContext';
import { useToast } from '../components/ToastContainer';
import api, { orderAPI, paymentAPI } from '../services/api';
import './styles/settings/index.css';

const Settings = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const { isAuthenticated, user, logout, refreshUser } = useAuth();
  const { showSuccess, showError, showInfo } = useToast();

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('profile'); // profile, account, subscription, invitation
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [isEditingProfile, setIsEditingProfile] = useState(false); // 控制个人介绍编辑状态

  // Profile form state
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState({
    name: '',
    userId: '',
    bio: ''
  });

  // Account security form state
  const [accountForm, setAccountForm] = useState({
    currentPassword: '',
    newPassword: '',
    confirmPassword: ''
  });

  // Binding form state
  const [bindPhone, setBindPhone] = useState('');
  const [bindEmail, setBindEmail] = useState('');
  const [bindPhoneCode, setBindPhoneCode] = useState('');
  const [bindEmailCode, setBindEmailCode] = useState('');
  const [phoneCodeCountdown, setPhoneCodeCountdown] = useState(0);
  const [emailCodeCountdown, setEmailCodeCountdown] = useState(0);

  // Account management modal state
  const [accountModal, setAccountModal] = useState({
    show: false,
    type: '', // 'bind-email', 'bind-phone', 'bind-wechat', 'unbind-email', 'unbind-phone', 'unbind-wechat', 'rebind-email', 'rebind-phone'
    title: '',
    currentValue: '', // for unbind/rebind
    step: 1 // 1 = enter email/phone, 2 = enter verification code
  });
  const [modalForm, setModalForm] = useState({
    email: '',
    phone: '',
    code: '',
    password: '',
    newPassword: '',
    confirmPassword: ''
  });
  const [modalCodeCountdown, setModalCodeCountdown] = useState(0);

  // Subscription state
  const [currentSubscription, setCurrentSubscription] = useState(null);
  const [subscriptionLoading, setSubscriptionLoading] = useState(false);

  // Billing history state
  const [billingHistory, setBillingHistory] = useState([]);
  const [billingPage, setBillingPage] = useState(1);
  const [billingTotal, setBillingTotal] = useState(0);
  const [billingLoading, setBillingLoading] = useState(false);

  // Invitation state
  const [invitation, setInvitation] = useState(null);
  const [invitees, setInvitees] = useState([]);
  const [invitationLoading, setInvitationLoading] = useState(false);
  const [copySuccess, setCopySuccess] = useState('');

  // Handle URL parameters for WeChat/GitHub binding feedback and tab switching
  useEffect(() => {
    const tab = searchParams.get('tab');
    const wechatBindStatus = searchParams.get('wechat_bind_status');
    const githubBindStatus = searchParams.get('github_bind_status');
    const message = searchParams.get('message');

    // Switch to specified tab if provided
    if (tab && ['profile', 'account', 'subscription', 'invitation'].includes(tab)) {
      setActiveTab(tab);
    }

    // Show WeChat binding feedback
    if (wechatBindStatus && message) {
      if (wechatBindStatus === 'success') {
        showSuccess(message);
      } else if (wechatBindStatus === 'error') {
        showError(message);
      }

      // Clean up URL parameters after showing toast
      const newParams = new URLSearchParams(searchParams);
      newParams.delete('wechat_bind_status');
      newParams.delete('message');
      newParams.delete('tab');
      setSearchParams(newParams);
    }

    // Show GitHub binding feedback
    if (githubBindStatus && message) {
      if (githubBindStatus === 'success') {
        showSuccess(message);
        // Refresh user profile to show updated GitHub binding
        fetchUserProfile();
      } else if (githubBindStatus === 'error') {
        showError(message);
      }

      // Clean up URL parameters after showing toast
      const newParams = new URLSearchParams(searchParams);
      newParams.delete('github_bind_status');
      newParams.delete('message');
      newParams.delete('tab');
      setSearchParams(newParams);
    }
  }, [searchParams, setSearchParams, showSuccess, showError]);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Allow authenticated users to stay on this page
    // No redirect needed - if not authenticated, they can still view the page structure
    if (isAuthenticated) {
      fetchUserProfile();
      fetchSubscriptionData();
    }
  }, [isAuthenticated]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeTab === 'subscription') {
      fetchSubscriptionData();
      fetchBillingHistory(1);
    } else if (activeTab === 'invitation') {
      fetchInvitationData();
    }
  }, [activeTab]);


  // Countdown for phone code
  useEffect(() => {
    if (phoneCodeCountdown > 0) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => setPhoneCodeCountdown(phoneCodeCountdown - 1), 1000);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [phoneCodeCountdown]);

  // Countdown for email code
  useEffect(() => {
    if (emailCodeCountdown > 0) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => setEmailCodeCountdown(emailCodeCountdown - 1), 1000);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [emailCodeCountdown]);

  // Countdown for modal code
  useEffect(() => {
    if (modalCodeCountdown > 0) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => setModalCodeCountdown(modalCodeCountdown - 1), 1000);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [modalCodeCountdown]);

  const fetchUserProfile = async () => {
    try {
      // Call refreshUser to get latest data from backend
      const userData = await refreshUser();
      if (userData) {
        setProfile({
          name: userData.username || userData.email || '',
          userId: userData.id || '',
          bio: userData.bio || ''
        });
      } else if (user) {
        // Fallback to cached user data
        setProfile({
          name: user.username || user.email || '',
          userId: user.id || '',
          bio: user.bio || ''
        });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch user profile:', error);
    }
  };

  const fetchSubscriptionData = async () => {
    try {
      setSubscriptionLoading(true);

      // Fetch current subscription only
      const subResponse = await api.get('/user/subscription/my');
      if (subResponse.data.code === 0) {
        setCurrentSubscription(subResponse.data.data);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch subscription data:', error);
    } finally {
      setSubscriptionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const fetchBillingHistory = async (page = 1) => {
    try {
      setBillingLoading(true);
      const response = await orderAPI.getBillingHistory(page, 10);
      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        setBillingHistory(response.data.data.orders || []);
        setBillingTotal(response.data.data.total || 0);
        setBillingPage(page);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch billing history:', error);
      showError('获取历史账单失败');
    } finally {
      setBillingLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const fetchInvitationData = async () => {
    setInvitationLoading(true);
    try {
      // 获取邀请信息
      const inviteRes = await api.get('/user/invitation/my');
      if (inviteRes.data.code === 0) {
        // 新的API返回格式: { invitation: {...}, has_invitation: true/false }
        const { invitation: invitationData, has_invitation } = inviteRes.data.data;
        setInvitation(has_invitation ? invitationData : null);

        // 只有当用户有邀请码时才获取统计信息
        if (has_invitation) {
          // 获取邀请统计（包含被邀请者列表）
          const statsRes = await api.get('/user/invitation/statistics');
          if (statsRes.data.code === 0) {
            setInvitees(statsRes.data.data.relationships || []);
          }
        } else {
          // 没有邀请码时清空被邀请者列表
          setInvitees([]);
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch invitation data:', error);
    } finally {
      setInvitationLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const generateInvitation = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await api.post('/user/invitation/generate');
      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        setInvitation(response.data.data);
        showSuccess('邀请码生成成功！');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      showError('生成邀请码失败：' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
    }
  };

  const copyToClipboard = async (text, label) => {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      setCopySuccess(label);
      showSuccess(`${label}已复制到剪贴板！`);
      setTimeout(() => setCopySuccess(''), 2000);
    } catch (err) {
      showError('复制失败，请手动复制');
    }
  };

  const maskEmail = (email) => {
    if (!email) return '***';
    const [username, domain] = email.split('@');
    if (username.length <= 2) {
      return `${username[0]}***@${domain}`;
    }
    return `${username.substring(0, 2)}***@${domain}`;
  };

  const maskPhone = (phone) => {
    if (!phone) return '***';
    return phone.replace(/(\d{3})\d{4}(\d{4})/, '$1****$2');
  };

  const getInvitationUrl = () => {
    if (!invitation) return '';
    return `${window.location.origin}/?invite=${invitation.invitation_code}`;
  };

  const handleLogout = () => {
    logout();
    navigate('/');
  };


  const handleProfileSave = async () => {
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      // API call to update profile
      const response = await api.put('/user/profile', {
        username: profile.name,
        bio: profile.bio
      });

      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        showSuccess('个人信息已保存');
        // 保存成功后重新获取用户信息
        await fetchUserProfile();
        // 退出编辑模式
        setIsEditingProfile(false);
      } else {
        showError('保存失败：' + response.data.message);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      showError('保存失败，请稍后重试');
      console.error('Failed to update profile:', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePasswordChange = async () => {
    if (accountForm.newPassword !== accountForm.confirmPassword) {
      showError('两次输入的密码不一致');
      return;
    }

    if (accountForm.newPassword.length < 8) {
      showError('新密码长度至少为8个字符');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await api.post('/user/change-password', {
        current_password: accountForm.currentPassword,
        new_password: accountForm.newPassword
      });

      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        showSuccess('密码修改成功');
        setAccountForm({
          currentPassword: '',
          newPassword: '',
          confirmPassword: ''
        });
      } else {
        showError('密码修改失败：' + response.data.message);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      showError('密码修改失败,请稍后重试');
      console.error('Failed to change password:', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Send phone verification code
  const handleSendPhoneCode = async () => {
    if (!bindPhone || !/^1[3-9]\d{9}$/.test(bindPhone)) {
      showError('请输入有效的手机号码');
      return;
    }

    if (phoneCodeCountdown > 0) return;

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await api.post('/user/send-phone-code', {
        phone: bindPhone,
        purpose: 'bind'
      });

      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        setPhoneCodeCountdown(60);
        showSuccess('验证码已发送');
      } else {
        showError('发送验证码失败：' + response.data.message);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      showError('发送验证码失败,请稍后重试');
      console.error('Failed to send phone code:', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Send email verification code
  const handleSendEmailCode = async () => {
    if (!bindEmail || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(bindEmail)) {
      showError('请输入有效的邮箱地址');
      return;
    }

    if (emailCodeCountdown > 0) return;

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await api.post('/user/send-code', {
        email: bindEmail,
        purpose: 'bind'
      });

      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        setEmailCodeCountdown(60);
        showSuccess('验证码已发送');
      } else {
        showError('发送验证码失败：' + response.data.message);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      showError('发送验证码失败,请稍后重试');
      console.error('Failed to send email code:', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Bind phone
  const handleBindPhone = async () => {
    if (!bindPhone || !/^1[3-9]\d{9}$/.test(bindPhone)) {
      showError('请输入有效的手机号码');
      return;
    }

    if (!bindPhoneCode) {
      showError('请输入验证码');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await api.post('/user/bind-phone', {
        phone: bindPhone,
        code: bindPhoneCode
      });

      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        showSuccess('手机号绑定成功');
        setBindPhone('');
        setBindPhoneCode('');
        // Refresh user profile
        fetchUserProfile();
      } else {
        showError('绑定失败：' + response.data.message);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      showError('绑定失败,请稍后重试');
      console.error('Failed to bind phone:', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Bind email
  const handleBindEmail = async () => {
    if (!bindEmail || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(bindEmail)) {
      showError('请输入有效的邮箱地址');
      return;
    }

    if (!bindEmailCode) {
      showError('请输入验证码');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await api.post('/user/bind-email', {
        email: bindEmail,
        code: bindEmailCode
      });

      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        showSuccess('邮箱绑定成功');
        setBindEmail('');
        setBindEmailCode('');
        // Refresh user profile
        fetchUserProfile();
      } else {
        showError('绑定失败：' + response.data.message);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      showError('绑定失败,请稍后重试');
      console.error('Failed to bind email:', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // WeChat binding
  const handleBindWeChat = async () => {
    try {
      // Clean up old state before starting new binding flow
      localStorage.removeItem('wechat_bind_state');

      // Mark as binding mode
      localStorage.setItem('wechat_bind_mode', 'bind');

      // Get WeChat login URL from backend (backend will generate state)
      const response = await api.get('/user/wechat/login-url');

      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
        const loginURL = response.data.data.login_url;
        const state = response.data.data.state;

        // Save backend-generated state for verification after callback
        localStorage.setItem('wechat_bind_state', state);

        // Redirect to WeChat OAuth page
        window.location.href = loginURL;
      } else {
        showError('获取微信登录链接失败');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('WeChat binding error:', err);
      showError('微信绑定失败,请稍后重试');
    }
  };

  // Handle GitHub binding
  const handleBindGitHub = async () => {
    try {
      // Save current page URL for return after binding
      const currentPath = window.location.pathname + window.location.search;
      localStorage.setItem('github_return_url', currentPath);

      // Get GitHub login URL
      const response = await api.get('/user/github/login-url');

      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
        const { url, state } = response.data.data;

        // Store state and bind mode in localStorage for verification
        localStorage.setItem('github_bind_state', state);
        localStorage.setItem('github_bind_mode', 'bind');

        // Redirect to GitHub OAuth
        window.location.href = url;
      } else {
        showError('获取 GitHub 登录链接失败');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('GitHub binding error:', err);
      showError('GitHub 绑定失败,请稍后重试');
    }
  };

  // Count available login methods
  const getLoginMethodCount = () => {
    let count = 0;
    if (user?.email) count++;
    if (user?.phone) count++;
    if (user?.wechat_openid) count++;
    if (user?.github_id) count++;
    return count;
  };

  // Modal handlers
  const handleOpenModal = (type, currentValue) => {
    const titles = {
      'bind-email': '绑定邮箱',
      'bind-phone': '绑定手机号',
      'rebind-email': '换绑邮箱',
      'rebind-phone': '换绑手机号',
      'unbind-email': '解绑邮箱',
      'unbind-phone': '解绑手机号',
      'unbind-wechat': '解绑微信',
      'unbind-github': '解绑 GitHub',
      'change-password': '修改密码'
    };

    setAccountModal({
      show: true,
      type,
      title: titles[type] || '',
      currentValue,
      step: 1 // Always start at step 1
    });

    // Reset form
    setModalForm({
      email: '',
      phone: '',
      code: '',
      password: '',
      newPassword: '',
      confirmPassword: ''
    });
    setModalCodeCountdown(0);
  };

  const handleCloseModal = () => {
    setAccountModal({
      show: false,
      type: '',
      title: '',
      currentValue: '',
      step: 1
    });
    setModalForm({
      email: '',
      phone: '',
      code: '',
      password: '',
      newPassword: '',
      confirmPassword: ''
    });
    setModalCodeCountdown(0);
  };

  // Check availability and proceed to step 2 (for bind/rebind operations)
  const handleCheckAvailability = async () => {
    const type = accountModal.type;
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      let response;

      if (type.includes('email')) {
        // Validate email format
        if (!modalForm.email || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(modalForm.email)) {
          showError('请输入有效的邮箱地址');
          setLoading(false);
          return;
        }

        // Check email availability
        response = await api.post('/user/check-email-availability', {
          email: modalForm.email
        });
      } else if (type.includes('phone')) {
        // Validate phone format
        if (!modalForm.phone || !/^1[3-9]\d{9}$/.test(modalForm.phone)) {
          showError('请输入有效的手机号码');
          setLoading(false);
          return;
        }

        // Check phone availability
        response = await api.post('/user/check-phone-availability', {
          phone: modalForm.phone
        });
      }

      if (response && response.data.code === 0) {
        if (response.data.data.available) {
          // Available - proceed to step 2
          setAccountModal(prev => ({ ...prev, step: 2 }));
          showSuccess('验证通过,请继续输入验证码');
        } else {
          // Not available
          if (type.includes('email')) {
            showError('该邮箱已被其他账号绑定');
          } else {
            showError('该手机号已被其他账号绑定');
          }
        }
      } else {
        showError('检查失败：' + (response?.data?.message || '未知错误'));
      }
    } catch (error) {
      showError('检查失败,请稍后重试');
      console.error('Failed to check availability:', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Send modal verification code
  const handleSendModalCode = async () => {
    if (modalCodeCountdown > 0) return;

    const type = accountModal.type;
    let endpoint = '';
    let payload = {};
    let purpose = '';

    // Determine endpoint and purpose based on modal type
    if (type.includes('email')) {
      if (!modalForm.email || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(modalForm.email)) {
        showError('请输入有效的邮箱地址');
        return;
      }
      endpoint = '/user/send-code';
      payload = { email: modalForm.email, purpose: type.includes('bind') ? 'bind' : 'unbind' };
    } else if (type.includes('phone')) {
      if (!modalForm.phone || !/^1[3-9]\d{9}$/.test(modalForm.phone)) {
        showError('请输入有效的手机号码');
        return;
      }
      endpoint = '/user/send-phone-code';
      payload = { phone: modalForm.phone, purpose: type.includes('bind') ? 'bind' : 'unbind' };
    }

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await api.post(endpoint, payload);

      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        setModalCodeCountdown(60);
        showSuccess('验证码已发送');
      } else {
        showError('发送验证码失败：' + response.data.message);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      showError('发送验证码失败,请稍后重试');
      console.error('Failed to send code:', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Handle modal submit
  const handleModalSubmit = async () => {
    const type = accountModal.type;
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      let response;

      switch (type) {
        case 'bind-email':
          if (!modalForm.email || !modalForm.code) {
            showError('请填写完整信息');
            setLoading(false);
            return;
          }
          response = await api.post('/user/bind-email', {
            email: modalForm.email,
            code: modalForm.code
          });
          break;

        case 'bind-phone':
          if (!modalForm.phone || !modalForm.code) {
            showError('请填写完整信息');
            setLoading(false);
            return;
          }
          response = await api.post('/user/bind-phone', {
            phone: modalForm.phone,
            code: modalForm.code
          });
          break;

        case 'rebind-email':
          if (!modalForm.email || !modalForm.code) {
            showError('请填写完整信息');
            setLoading(false);
            return;
          }
          // Direct replacement - bind new email (will replace the old one)
          response = await api.post('/user/bind-email', {
            email: modalForm.email,
            code: modalForm.code
          });
          break;

        case 'rebind-phone':
          if (!modalForm.phone || !modalForm.code) {
            showError('请填写完整信息');
            setLoading(false);
            return;
          }
          // Direct replacement - bind new phone (will replace the old one)
          response = await api.post('/user/bind-phone', {
            phone: modalForm.phone,
            code: modalForm.code
          });
          break;

        case 'unbind-email':
          if (!modalForm.code) {
            showError('请输入验证码');
            setLoading(false);
            return;
          }
          response = await api.post('/user/unbind-email', { code: modalForm.code });
          break;

        case 'unbind-phone':
          if (!modalForm.code) {
            showError('请输入验证码');
            setLoading(false);
            return;
          }
          response = await api.post('/user/unbind-phone', { code: modalForm.code });
          break;

        case 'unbind-wechat':
          response = await api.post('/user/unbind-wechat');
          break;

        case 'unbind-github':
          response = await api.post('/user/unbind-github');
          break;

        case 'change-password':
          if (!modalForm.password || !modalForm.newPassword || !modalForm.confirmPassword) {
            showError('请填写完整信息');
            setLoading(false);
            return;
          }
          if (modalForm.newPassword !== modalForm.confirmPassword) {
            showError('两次输入的密码不一致');
            setLoading(false);
            return;
          }
          if (modalForm.newPassword.length < 8) {
            showError('新密码长度至少为8个字符');
            setLoading(false);
            return;
          }
          response = await api.post('/user/change-password', {
            current_password: modalForm.password,
            new_password: modalForm.newPassword
          });
          break;

        default:
          setLoading(false);
          return;
      }

      if (response && response.data.code === 0) {
        showSuccess('操作成功');
        handleCloseModal();
        // Refresh user profile
        fetchUserProfile();
      } else {
        showError('操作失败：' + (response?.data?.message || '未知错误'));
      }
    } catch (error) {
      showError('操作失败,请稍后重试');
      console.error('Modal submit error:', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Render modal content based on type
  const renderModalContent = () => {
    const type = accountModal.type;
    const step = accountModal.step;

    if (type === 'bind-email' || type === 'rebind-email') {
      if (step === 1) {
        // Step 1: Enter email and check availability
        return (
          <>
            {type === 'rebind-email' && (
              <div className="modal-info">
                <p>当前邮箱: <strong>{accountModal.currentValue}</strong></p>
                <p>请输入新邮箱地址</p>
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="modal-form-group">
              <label>新邮箱地址</label>
              <input
                type="email"
                value={modalForm.email}
                onChange={(e) => setModalForm({ ...modalForm, email: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="输入邮箱地址"
              />
            </div>
            <button className="btn-modal-submit" onClick={handleCheckAvailability} disabled={loading}>
              {loading ? '检查中...' : '继续'}
            </button>
          </>
        );
      } else {
        // Step 2: Enter verification code
        return (
          <>
            <div className="modal-info">
              <p>邮箱: <strong>{modalForm.email}</strong></p>

                返回修改
              </button>

                  type="text"

                >
                  {modalCodeCountdown > 0 ? `${modalCodeCountdown}秒` : '发送验证码'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button className="btn-modal-submit" onClick={handleModalSubmit} disabled={loading}>
              {loading ? '处理中...' : '确认'}
            </button>
          </>
        );
      }
    }

    if (type === 'bind-phone' || type === 'rebind-phone') {
      if (step === 1) {
        // Step 1: Enter phone and check availability
        return (
          <>
            {type === 'rebind-phone' && (
              <div className="modal-info">
                <p>当前手机号: <strong>{accountModal.currentValue}</strong></p>

            <div className="modal-form-group">

            <button className="btn-modal-submit" onClick={handleCheckAvailability} disabled={loading}>
              {loading ? '检查中...' : '继续'}
            </button>
          </>
        );
      } else {
        // Step 2: Enter verification code

          <>
            <div className="modal-info">
              <p>手机号: <strong>{modalForm.phone}</strong></p>
              <button
                className="btn-link"
                onClick={() => setAccountModal(prev => ({ ...prev, step: 1 }))}

                返回修改
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="modal-form-group">
              <label>验证码</label>
              <div className="modal-code-input">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={modalForm.code}
                  onChange={(e) => setModalForm({ ...modalForm, code: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="输入验证码"
                  maxLength={6}
                />
                <button
                  className="btn-send-code"
                  onClick={handleSendModalCode}

                >
                  {modalCodeCountdown > 0 ? `${modalCodeCountdown}秒` : '发送验证码'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button className="btn-modal-submit" onClick={handleModalSubmit} disabled={loading}>

          </>

      }
    }

    if (type === 'unbind-email') {

              type="password"

        {isEditingProfile ? (

  const renderAccountTab = () => (

              <>

        <button className="btn-change-password" onClick={() => handleOpenModal('change-password', '')}>
          <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
            <rect x="3" y="11" width="18" height="11" rx="2" ry="2"/>
            <path d="M7 11V7a5 5 0 0 1 10 0v4"/>
          </svg>
          <span>修改密码</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Account Modal */}
      {accountModal.show && (
        <div className="account-modal-overlay" onClick={handleCloseModal}>
          <div className="account-modal" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div className="modal-header">
              <h3>{accountModal.title}</h3>
              <button className="modal-close" onClick={handleCloseModal}>
                <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                  <line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"/>
                  <line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"/>
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="modal-body">
              {renderModalContent()}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  // Invitation Tab
  const renderInvitationTab = () => {

    if (invitationLoading) {
      return (
        <div className="settings-section">
          <h2>邀请推广</h2>
          <div className="invitation-loading">
            <div className="spinner"></div>
            <p>加载中...</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return (
      <div className="settings-section">
        <h2>邀请推广</h2>
        <p className="section-description">
          邀请好友注册，双方都可获得折扣券奖励
        </p>

        {/* Invitation Code Card */}
        <div className="invitation-card">
          {!invitation ? (
            <div className="invitation-empty">
              <div className="invitation-empty-icon">
                <svg width="48" height="48" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5">
                  <path d="M17 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H5a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/>
                  <circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"/>
                  <path d="M23 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87"/>
                  <path d="M16 3.13a4 4 0 0 1 0 7.75"/>
                </svg>
              </div>
              <h3>开始邀请好友</h3>
              <p>生成你的专属邀请码，分享给好友即可获得奖励</p>
              <button className="btn-generate-code" onClick={generateInvitation}>
                生成邀请码
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="invitation-content">
              <h3>我的邀请码</h3>

              {/* Invitation Code */}
              <div className="invitation-field">
                <label>邀请码</label>
                <div className="invitation-input-group">
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={invitation.invitation_code}
                    readOnly
                    className="invitation-code-input"
                  />
                  <button
                    className={`btn-copy ${copySuccess === '邀请码' ? 'copied' : ''}`}
                    onClick={() => copyToClipboard(invitation.invitation_code, '邀请码')}
                  >
                    {copySuccess === '邀请码' ? '✓ 已复制' : '复制'}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Invitation URL */}
              <div className="invitation-field">
                <label>邀请链接</label>
                <div className="invitation-input-group">
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={getInvitationUrl()}
                    readOnly
                    className="invitation-url-input"
                  />
                  <button
                    className={`btn-copy ${copySuccess === '邀请链接' ? 'copied' : ''}`}
                    onClick={() => copyToClipboard(getInvitationUrl(), '邀请链接')}
                  >
                    {copySuccess === '邀请链接' ? '✓ 已复制' : '复制'}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Invitees List */}
        {invitation && (
          <div className="invitees-section">
            <h3>被邀请者列表</h3>
            {invitees.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="invitees-empty">
                <svg width="40" height="40" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5">
                  <path d="M17 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H5a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/>
                  <circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"/>
                  <line x1="19" y1="8" x2="19" y2="14"/>
                  <line x1="22" y1="11" x2="16" y2="11"/>
                </svg>
                <p>还没有人使用你的邀请码注册</p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="invitees-list">
                {invitees.map((invitee, index) => (
                  <div key={index} className="invitee-item">
                    <div className="invitee-info">
                      <span className="invitee-name">
                        {invitee.invitee_email ? maskEmail(invitee.invitee_email) :
                         invitee.invitee_phone ? maskPhone(invitee.invitee_phone) : '用户***'}
                      </span>
                      <span className="invitee-date">
                        {new Date(invitee.created_at).toLocaleDateString('zh-CN')}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <span className={`invitee-status ${invitee.has_purchased ? 'paid' : 'registered'}`}>
                      {invitee.has_purchased ? '✓ 已付费' : '已注册'}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  };

  const renderSubscriptionTab = () => {
    return (
      <div className="settings-section subscription-section">
        <h2>管理订阅</h2>

        {/* Current Subscription Card - Compact Design */}
        <div className={`subscription-compact ${subscriptionLoading ? 'loading' : ''}`}>
          {subscriptionLoading ? (
            <div className="subscription-compact-skeleton">
              <div className="skeleton-badge"></div>
              <div className="skeleton-text"></div>
              <div className="skeleton-btn"></div>
            </div>
          ) : currentSubscription ? (
            <div className="subscription-compact-content">
              <div className="subscription-compact-left">
                <span className={`subscription-plan-badge ${currentSubscription.plan_code}`}>
                  {currentSubscription.plan_name}
                </span>
                {currentSubscription.plan_code !== 'free' && currentSubscription.end_date && (() => {
                  const endDate = new Date(currentSubscription.end_date);
                  const today = new Date();
                  const diffTime = endDate - today;
                  const diffDays = Math.ceil(diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                  const isExpiring = diffDays <= 7;
                  const isUrgent = diffDays <= 3;
                  
                  return (
                    <span className={`subscription-compact-expiry ${isUrgent ? 'urgent' : isExpiring ? 'warning' : ''}`}>
                      {diffDays <= 0 ? (
                        '已到期'
                      ) : diffDays <= 7 ? (
                        <>剩余 <strong>{diffDays}</strong> 天</>
                      ) : (
                        <>{endDate.toLocaleDateString('zh-CN')} 到期</>
                      )}
                    </span>
                  );
                })()}
                {currentSubscription.plan_code === 'free' && (
                  <span className="subscription-compact-hint">升级享受更多权益</span>
                )}
              </div>
              <button
                className="btn-upgrade-compact"
                onClick={() => navigate('/pricing')}
              >
                {currentSubscription.plan_code === 'free' ? '升级方案' : '管理方案'}
                <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                  <polyline points="9 18 15 12 9 6"/>
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </div>

        {/* Billing History */}
        <div className="billing-section">
          <div className="billing-section-header">
            <h3>
              <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/>
                <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/>
                <line x1="16" y1="13" x2="8" y2="13"/>
                <line x1="16" y1="17" x2="8" y2="17"/>
                <polyline points="10 9 9 9 8 9"/>
              </svg>
              历史账单
            </h3>
          </div>
          
          {billingLoading ? (
            <div className="billing-loading">
              <div className="spinner"></div>
              <p>加载中...</p>
            </div>
          ) : billingHistory.length > 0 ? (
            <>
              <div className="billing-list">
                {billingHistory.map((order) => (
                  <div key={order.id} className="billing-item">
                    <div className="billing-item-main">
                      <div className="billing-item-plan">
                        <span className="billing-plan-name">{order.plan_name}</span>
                        <span className="billing-cycle-tag">
                          {order.billing_cycle === 'monthly' ? '月付' : '年付'}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="billing-item-amount">
                        {order.discount_amount > 0 ? (
                          <>
                            <span className="billing-final">¥{order.final_amount.toFixed(2)}</span>
                            <span className="billing-original">¥{order.amount.toFixed(2)}</span>
                          </>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="billing-final">¥{order.final_amount.toFixed(2)}</span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="billing-item-meta">
                      <span className="billing-order-no">订单号：{order.order_no}</span>
                      <span className="billing-time">{new Date(order.payment_time).toLocaleString('zh-CN')}</span>
                    </div>
                    {order.payment_method && (
                      <div className="billing-payment-tag">
                        {order.payment_method === 'system' ? '系统发放' : 
                         order.payment_method === 'alipay' ? '支付宝' :
                         order.payment_method === 'wechat' ? '微信支付' :
                         order.payment_method}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              {/* Pagination */}
              {billingTotal > 10 && (
                <div className="pagination">
                  <button
                    className="pagination-btn"
                    disabled={billingPage === 1}
                    onClick={() => fetchBillingHistory(billingPage - 1)}
                  >
                    上一页
                  </button>
                  <span className="pagination-info">
                    第 {billingPage} 页，共 {Math.ceil(billingTotal / 10)} 页
                  </span>
                  <button
                    className="pagination-btn"
                    disabled={billingPage >= Math.ceil(billingTotal / 10)}
                    onClick={() => fetchBillingHistory(billingPage + 1)}
                  >
                    下一页
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </>
          ) : (
            <div className="empty-billing">
              <svg width="48" height="48" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5">
                <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/>
                <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/>
              </svg>
              <p>暂无订单记录</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  const renderExternalLinks = () => null;

  const renderLogoutSection = () => (
    <div className="settings-section logout-section">
      <button className="btn-logout" onClick={handleLogout}>
        <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
          <path d="M9 21H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4"/>
          <polyline points="16 17 21 12 16 7"/>
          <line x1="21" y1="12" x2="9" y2="12"/>
        </svg>
        <span>注销登录</span>
      </button>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="settings-page">
      {/* Header with Logo - fixed at top, full width */}
      <div className="settings-header">
        <div className="settings-header-content">
          <button className="settings-header-back-btn" onClick={() => navigate(-1)} title="返回">
            <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <path d="M19 12H5M12 19l-7-7 7-7"/>
            </svg>
          </button>
        <div
          onClick={() => navigate('/')}
            className="settings-header-logo"
        >
          <img
            src="/logo.png"
            alt="Scholay"
          />
            <span>Scholay</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="settings-container">
        <div className="settings-layout">
          {/* Left Sidebar */}
          <div className="settings-sidebar">
            <div className="settings-title-row">
              <button className="settings-back-btn" onClick={() => navigate(-1)} title="返回">
                <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                  <path d="M19 12H5M12 19l-7-7 7-7"/>
                </svg>
              </button>
            <h1 className="settings-title">设置</h1>
            </div>

            <div className="settings-menu">
              <div className="menu-section">
                <div className="menu-section-title">我的账户</div>
                <button
                  className={`menu-item ${activeTab === 'profile' ? 'active' : ''}`}
                  onClick={() => setActiveTab('profile')}
                >
                  <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                    <path d="M20 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H8a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/>
                    <circle cx="12" cy="7" r="4"/>
                  </svg>
                  <span>个人资料</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  className={`menu-item ${activeTab === 'subscription' ? 'active' : ''}`}
                  onClick={() => setActiveTab('subscription')}
                >
                  <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                    <rect x="3" y="8" width="18" height="12" rx="2" ry="2"/>
                    <path d="M3 8v-2a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"/>
                    <line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12.01" y2="16"/>
                  </svg>
                  <span>管理订阅</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  className={`menu-item ${activeTab === 'invitation' ? 'active' : ''}`}
                  onClick={() => setActiveTab('invitation')}
                >
                  <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                    <path d="M17 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H5a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/>
                    <circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"/>
                    <path d="M23 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87"/>
                    <path d="M16 3.13a4 4 0 0 1 0 7.75"/>
                  </svg>
                  <span>邀请推广</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  className={`menu-item ${activeTab === 'account' ? 'active' : ''}`}
                  onClick={() => setActiveTab('account')}
                >
                  <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                    <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/>
                    <path d="M12 1v6m0 6v6M5.64 5.64l4.24 4.24m4.24 4.24l4.24 4.24M1 12h6m6 0h6M5.64 18.36l4.24-4.24m4.24-4.24l4.24-4.24"/>
                  </svg>
                  <span>账户管理</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              {renderExternalLinks()}
              {renderLogoutSection()}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right Content */}
          <div className="settings-content">
            {activeTab === 'profile' && renderProfileTab()}
            {activeTab === 'subscription' && renderSubscriptionTab()}
            {activeTab === 'invitation' && renderInvitationTab()}
            {activeTab === 'account' && renderAccountTab()}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Mobile Bottom Tab Bar */}
      <div className="settings-mobile-tabs">
        <button
          className={`mobile-tab-item ${activeTab === 'profile' ? 'active' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('profile')}
        >
          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
            <path d="M20 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H8a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/>
            <circle cx="12" cy="7" r="4"/>
          </svg>
          <span>资料</span>
        </button>
        <button
          className={`mobile-tab-item ${activeTab === 'subscription' ? 'active' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('subscription')}
        >
          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
            <rect x="3" y="8" width="18" height="12" rx="2" ry="2"/>
            <path d="M3 8v-2a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"/>
            <line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12.01" y2="16"/>
          </svg>
          <span>订阅</span>
        </button>
        <button
          className={`mobile-tab-item ${activeTab === 'invitation' ? 'active' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('invitation')}
        >
          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
            <path d="M17 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H5a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/>
            <circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"/>
            <path d="M23 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87"/>
            <path d="M16 3.13a4 4 0 0 1 0 7.75"/>
          </svg>
          <span>邀请</span>
        </button>
        <button
          className={`mobile-tab-item ${activeTab === 'account' ? 'active' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('account')}
        >
          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/>
            <path d="M12 1v6m0 6v6M5.64 5.64l4.24 4.24m4.24 4.24l4.24 4.24M1 12h6m6 0h6M5.64 18.36l4.24-4.24m4.24-4.24l4.24-4.24"/>
          </svg>
          <span>账户</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Settings;

// ========== 文件: frontend-user/src/pages/SubscriptionManagement.js ==========
/**

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../utils/AuthContext';
import api, { orderAPI, paymentAPI } from '../services/api';
import AppSidebar from '../components/AppSidebar';
import './SubscriptionManagement.css';

const SubscriptionManagement = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { isAuthenticated, user, logout } = useAuth();
  const [subscription, setSubscription] = useState(null);
  const [usage, setUsage] = useState(null);
  const [plans, setPlans] = useState([]);
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(false);
  const [billingCycle, setBillingCycle] = useState('monthly');
  const [sidebarCollapsed, setSidebarCollapsed] = useState(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed');
    return saved !== null ? JSON.parse(saved) : true;
  });
  const [message, setMessage] = useState({ type: '', text: '' });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isAuthenticated) {
      navigate('/');
      return;
    }
    fetchAllData();
  }, [isAuthenticated, navigate]);

  useEffect(() => {
    localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', JSON.stringify(sidebarCollapsed));
  }, [sidebarCollapsed]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (message.text) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => setMessage({ type: '', text: '' }), 5000);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [message]);

  const fetchAllData = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const [subRes, usageRes, plansRes, ordersRes] = await Promise.all([
        api.get('/user/subscription/my'),
        api.get('/user/subscription/usage'),
        api.get('/user/subscription/plans'),
        api.get('/user/orders/my')
      ]);

      if (subRes.data.code === 0) {
        setSubscription(subRes.data.data);
      }
      if (usageRes.data.code === 0) {
        setUsage(usageRes.data);
      }
      if (plansRes.data.code === 0) {
        setPlans(plansRes.data.data);
      }
      if (ordersRes.data.code === 0) {
        setOrders(ordersRes.data.data.orders || []);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch data:', error);
      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: '加载数据失败，请刷新重试' });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleLogout = () => {
    logout();
    navigate('/');
  };

  const handleToggleSidebar = () => {
    setSidebarCollapsed(!sidebarCollapsed);
  };

  const handleViewPlans = () => {
    // Navigate to pricing page
    navigate('/pricing');
  };

  const getPricePerMonth = (plan) => {
    if (billingCycle === 'monthly') {
      return plan.price_monthly;
    }
    return (plan.price_yearly / 12).toFixed(2);
  };

  const getUsagePercentage = (used, limit) => {
    if (limit === -1) return 0;
    return Math.min((used / limit) * 100, 100);
  };

  const formatUsageText = (used, limitInfo) => {
    if (limitInfo.limit === -1) {
      return `今日已使用 ${used} 次`;
    }
    return `${used} / ${limitInfo.limit}`;
  };

  const formatOrderStatus = (status) => {
    const statusMap = {
      pending: { text: '待支付', class: 'pending' },
      paid: { text: '已支付', class: 'paid' },
      cancelled: { text: '已取消', class: 'cancelled' },
      refunded: { text: '已退款', class: 'refunded' }
    };
    return statusMap[status] || { text: status, class: 'unknown' };
  };

  const formatDate = (dateString) => {
    const date = new Date(dateString);
    return date.toLocaleDateString('zh-CN', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: '2-digit',
      day: '2-digit',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit'
    });
  };

  const handlePayOrder = async (order) => {
    setActionLoading(true);
    setMessage({ type: '', text: '' });

    try {
      // Get plan details for payment
      const plan = plans.find(p => p.plan_code === order.plan_code);
      if (!plan) {
        setMessage({ type: 'error', text: '无法找到订阅方案信息' });
        setActionLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      // Create Alipay payment
      const returnURL = `${window.location.origin}/subscription`;
      const subject = `Scholar ${order.plan_name} ${order.billing_cycle === 'monthly' ? '月付' : '年付'}订阅`;
      const description = `订单号: ${order.order_no}`;

      const paymentResponse = await paymentAPI.createAlipayPayment(
        order.order_no,
        subject,
        order.amount,
        returnURL,
        description
      );

      if (paymentResponse.data.code === 0 && paymentResponse.data.data) {
        // Redirect to Alipay payment page
        window.location.href = paymentResponse.data.data.payment_url;
      } else {
        setMessage({ type: 'error', text: '创建支付失败：' + (paymentResponse.data.message || '未知错误') });
        setActionLoading(false);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: '创建支付失败，请稍后重试' });
      console.error('Payment failed:', error);
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCancelOrder = async (orderNo) => {
    if (!window.confirm('确认取消此订单吗？')) {
      return;
    }

    setActionLoading(true);
    setMessage({ type: '', text: '' });

    try {
      const response = await orderAPI.cancelOrder(orderNo);

      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        setMessage({ type: 'success', text: '订单已取消' });
        await fetchAllData();
      } else {
        setMessage({ type: 'error', text: '取消订单失败：' + (response.data.message || '未知错误') });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: '取消订单失败，请稍后重试' });
      console.error('Cancel order failed:', error);
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="subscription-management">
        {isAuthenticated && (
          <AppSidebar
            user={user}
            onLogout={handleLogout}
            collapsed={sidebarCollapsed}
            onToggleCollapse={handleToggleSidebar}
            showHistory={false}
          />
        )}
        <div className={`main-container ${isAuthenticated ? (sidebarCollapsed ? 'sidebar-collapsed-narrow' : 'has-sidebar') : 'sidebar-collapsed'}`}>
          <div className="loading-container">
            <div className="loading-spinner"></div>
            <p>加载中...</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="subscription-management">
      {isAuthenticated && (
        <AppSidebar
          user={user}
          onLogout={handleLogout}
          collapsed={sidebarCollapsed}
          onToggleCollapse={handleToggleSidebar}
          showHistory={false}
        />
      )}

      <div className={`main-container ${isAuthenticated ? (sidebarCollapsed ? 'sidebar-collapsed-narrow' : 'has-sidebar') : 'sidebar-collapsed'}`}>
        <div className="sub-management-content">
          {/* Message Display */}
          {message.text && (
            <div className={`message message-${message.type}`}>
              {message.text}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Header */}
          <div className="sub-header">

                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Quick Usage Stats */}
                {usage && usage.usage && usage.limits && (
                  <div className="quick-usage">
                    <div className="usage-stat">
                      <div className="stat-icon">🔍</div>
                      <div className="stat-info">

              {subscription.plan_code !== 'free' && (

          {/* Plans Section - Link to Pricing Page */}

                                  ? 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3) 0%, rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1) 100%)'

                <div className="upgrade-tip">

                  <p>升级到 PRO 或 MAX 方案，享受无限制使用高级功能！</p>

          {/* Billing History */}
          <div className="billing-section">
            <div className="section-header">

            </div>

            {orders.length === 0 ? (

// ========== 文件: frontend-user/src/pages/WeChatCallback.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../utils/AuthContext';
import { userAPI } from '../services/api';
import logger from '../utils/logger';

// Whitelist of allowed return URLs (paths only, no query params validation)
// Only these paths are allowed for redirect after WeChat login
const RETURN_URL_WHITELIST = [
  '/pricing',
  '/search-results',
  '/advanced-search',
  '/chat',
  '/settings',
  '/dashboard',
  '/order-confirmation',
];

/**
 * Check if a return URL is in the whitelist
 * @param {string} url - The URL to check (can be full path or just pathname)
 * @returns {boolean} - True if the URL is whitelisted
 */
const isWhitelistedReturnURL = (url) => {
  if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') return false;

  // Extract pathname from URL (remove query string and hash)
  let pathname;
  try {
    // Handle both absolute URLs and relative paths
    if (url.startsWith('http://') || url.startsWith('https://')) {
      pathname = new URL(url).pathname;
    } else {
      // Relative path - extract pathname before query/hash
      pathname = url.split('?')[0].split('#')[0];
    }
  } catch (e) {
    return false;
  }

  // Check if pathname is in whitelist
  return RETURN_URL_WHITELIST.includes(pathname);
};

// CRITICAL: Clear old tokens IMMEDIATELY before component renders
// This prevents AuthContext from starting heartbeat with expired tokens
// Must be outside the component to run before React lifecycle
// NOTE: We only clear auth tokens, NOT OAuth state which is needed for verification
const bindMode = localStorage.getItem('wechat_bind_mode');
if (bindMode !== 'bind') {
  // Only clear tokens in login mode, not binding mode
  // DO NOT clear wechat_oauth_state here - it's needed for verification
  localStorage.removeItem('user_token');
  localStorage.removeItem('user_data');
}

const WeChatCallback = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const { login } = useAuth();

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleCallback = async () => {
      const code = searchParams.get('code');
      const state = searchParams.get('state');

      if (!code || !state) {
        console.error('Invalid WeChat callback parameters');
        navigate('/');
        return;
      }

      // Check if this is a binding operation
      const bindMode = localStorage.getItem('wechat_bind_mode');
      const stateKey = bindMode === 'bind' ? 'wechat_bind_state' : 'wechat_oauth_state';
      const savedState = localStorage.getItem(stateKey);

      // Debug logging
      logger.log('WeChat callback - bindMode:', bindMode);
      logger.log('WeChat callback - State key:', stateKey);
      logger.log('WeChat callback - URL state:', state);
      logger.log('WeChat callback - Saved state:', savedState);
      logger.log('WeChat callback - All localStorage keys:', Object.keys(localStorage));

      if (state !== savedState) {
        console.error('State mismatch!');
        console.error('  Expected (from localStorage):', savedState);
        console.error('  Received (from URL):', state);
        console.error('  Storage key used:', stateKey);
        console.error('  All localStorage:', JSON.stringify({
          wechat_oauth_state: localStorage.getItem('wechat_oauth_state'),
          wechat_bind_state: localStorage.getItem('wechat_bind_state'),
          wechat_bind_mode: localStorage.getItem('wechat_bind_mode'),
        }));

        // Redirect with error state
        if (bindMode === 'bind') {
          const params = new URLSearchParams({
            tab: 'account',
            wechat_bind_status: 'error',
            message: '安全验证失败，请重试'
          });
          navigate(`/settings?${params.toString()}`);
        } else {
          navigate('/');
        }
        return;
      }

      // Note: Old tokens were already cleared at module load time (lines 10-17)
      // to prevent AuthContext from starting heartbeat with expired tokens

      try {
        let response;

        if (bindMode === 'bind') {
          // Binding mode
          response = await userAPI.bindWeChatAccount(code, state);

          if (response.data.code === 0) {
            // Clean up
            localStorage.removeItem('wechat_bind_state');
            localStorage.removeItem('wechat_bind_mode');

            // Redirect to settings with success state
            const params = new URLSearchParams({
              tab: 'account',
              wechat_bind_status: 'success',
              message: '微信账号绑定成功！'
            });
            navigate(`/settings?${params.toString()}`);
          } else {
            throw new Error(response.data.message || '微信绑定失败');
          }
        } else {
          // Login mode
          // 获取保存的邀请码（如果有）
          const invitationCode = localStorage.getItem('oauth_invitation_code');
          response = await userAPI.wechatCallback(code, state, invitationCode);

          if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
            const { token, user } = response.data.data;

            // Save token and user data
            localStorage.setItem('user_token', token);
            localStorage.setItem('user_data', JSON.stringify(user));

            // Check for return URL and validate against whitelist
            const returnURL = localStorage.getItem('wechat_return_url');
            let redirectPath = '/'; // Default to home

            if (returnURL && isWhitelistedReturnURL(returnURL)) {
              // URL is whitelisted, use it for redirect
              redirectPath = returnURL;
              logger.log('WeChat login success - redirecting to whitelisted URL:', redirectPath);
            } else if (returnURL) {
              // URL provided but not whitelisted - log warning and use default
              logger.warn('WeChat login - return URL not whitelisted:', returnURL);
            }

            // Clean up
            localStorage.removeItem('wechat_oauth_state');
            localStorage.removeItem('wechat_return_url');
            localStorage.removeItem('oauth_invitation_code'); // 清理邀请码

            // Update auth context (token first, then user data)
            login(token, user);

            // Redirect to target page
            navigate(redirectPath);
          } else {
            throw new Error(response.data.message || '微信登录失败');
          }
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('WeChat callback error:', error);
        const errorMessage = error.response?.data?.message || error.message || (bindMode === 'bind' ? '微信绑定失败' : '微信登录失败');

        // Clean up on error
        if (bindMode === 'bind') {
          localStorage.removeItem('wechat_bind_state');
          localStorage.removeItem('wechat_bind_mode');

          // Redirect to settings with error state
          const params = new URLSearchParams({
            tab: 'account',
            wechat_bind_status: 'error',
            message: errorMessage
          });
          navigate(`/settings?${params.toString()}`);
        } else {
          localStorage.removeItem('wechat_oauth_state');
          localStorage.removeItem('wechat_return_url'); // Clean up return URL on error
          localStorage.removeItem('oauth_invitation_code'); // 清理邀请码
          navigate('/');
        }
      }
    };

    handleCallback();
  }, [searchParams, navigate, login]);

  // No UI - just processing in background
  return null;
};

export default WeChatCallback;

// ========== 文件: frontend-user/src/services/api.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import axios from 'axios';

// Use relative path so requests go through Nginx reverse proxy
// In production, this will be '' (empty), making requests to /api/v1/*
// In development, you can set REACT_APP_API_URL=http://localhost:8080 for direct backend access
const API_URL = process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL || '';

const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: `${API_URL}/api/v1`,
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  },
});

// Request interceptor to add auth token
api.interceptors.request.use(
  (config) => {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('user_token');
    if (token) {
      config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
    }
    return config;
  },
  (error) => {
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
);

// Response interceptor to handle errors
api.interceptors.response.use(
  (response) => response,
  (error) => {
    // 处理 401 (未授权) 和 403 (禁止访问) 错误
    if (error.response?.status === 401 || error.response?.status === 403) {
      // Unauthorized/Forbidden - clear token and state
      localStorage.removeItem('user_token');
      localStorage.removeItem('user_data');

      // Show notification to user
      const message = error.response?.data?.message ||
        (error.response?.status === 403 ? '访问被拒绝，请重新登录' : '登录已失效，请重新登录');

      // Dispatch custom event with message
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('auth:expired', {
        detail: { message }
      }));

      // Redirect to home page immediately if not already there
      if (window.location.pathname !== '/') {
        window.location.href = '/';
      }
    }
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
);

// ========== 文件: frontend-user/src/utils/AuthContext.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { userAPI, subscriptionAPI } from '../services/api';

const AuthContext = createContext(null);

// 配置常量
const HEARTBEAT_CONFIG = {
  ACTIVE_INTERVAL: 30000,      // 活跃状态下的心跳间隔：30秒
  IDLE_INTERVAL: 120000,       // 空闲状态下的心跳间隔：2分钟
  IDLE_TIMEOUT: 60000,         // 空闲超时时间：1分钟无操作视为空闲
  INACTIVE_TIMEOUT: 300000,    // 不活跃超时时间：5分钟无操作停止心跳
};

// 需要监听的用户活动事件
const USER_ACTIVITY_EVENTS = [
  'mousedown',
  'mousemove', 
  'keydown',
  'scroll',
  'touchstart',
  'click',
  'focus',
];

export const AuthProvider = ({ children }) => {
  const [isAuthenticated, setIsAuthenticated] = useState(false);
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  
  // 心跳相关的 refs
  const heartbeatIntervalRef = useRef(null);
  const lastActivityRef = useRef(Date.now());
  const isIdleRef = useRef(false);
  const activityCheckIntervalRef = useRef(null);
  
  // 使用 ref 存储函数引用，避免循环依赖
  const startHeartbeatRef = useRef(null);

  // Heartbeat function to keep session alive
  const sendHeartbeat = useCallback(async () => {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('user_token');
    if (!token) {
      return false;
    }

    try {
      await userAPI.heartbeat();
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      // If 401, axios interceptor will handle it (clear token, redirect, etc.)
      // For other errors, just log
      if (error.response?.status !== 401) {
        console.error('Heartbeat error:', error);
      }
      return false;
    }
  }, []);

  // 重新设置心跳间隔
  const restartHeartbeatWithInterval = useCallback((interval) => {
    if (heartbeatIntervalRef.current) {
      clearInterval(heartbeatIntervalRef.current);
    }
    heartbeatIntervalRef.current = setInterval(sendHeartbeat, interval);
  }, [sendHeartbeat]);

  // Stop heartbeat - 定义在前面以便其他函数使用
  const stopHeartbeat = useCallback(() => {
    if (heartbeatIntervalRef.current) {
      clearInterval(heartbeatIntervalRef.current);
      heartbeatIntervalRef.current = null;
    }
    if (activityCheckIntervalRef.current) {
      clearInterval(activityCheckIntervalRef.current);
      activityCheckIntervalRef.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  // 检查用户活动状态
  const checkActivityStatus = useCallback(() => {
    const now = Date.now();
    const timeSinceLastActivity = now - lastActivityRef.current;

    // 如果超过不活跃时间，停止心跳
    if (timeSinceLastActivity >= HEARTBEAT_CONFIG.INACTIVE_TIMEOUT) {
      if (heartbeatIntervalRef.current) {
        stopHeartbeat();
      }
      return;
    }

    // 如果超过空闲时间但未超过不活跃时间，降低心跳频率
    if (timeSinceLastActivity >= HEARTBEAT_CONFIG.IDLE_TIMEOUT && !isIdleRef.current) {
      isIdleRef.current = true;
      restartHeartbeatWithInterval(HEARTBEAT_CONFIG.IDLE_INTERVAL);
    }
  }, [stopHeartbeat, restartHeartbeatWithInterval]);

  // 更新最后活动时间
  const updateLastActivity = useCallback(() => {
    lastActivityRef.current = Date.now();
    
    // 如果之前是空闲状态，现在变为活跃
    if (isIdleRef.current) {
      isIdleRef.current = false;
      // 立即发送一次心跳，然后重新设置活跃间隔
      const token = localStorage.getItem('user_token');
      if (token) {
        sendHeartbeat();
        restartHeartbeatWithInterval(HEARTBEAT_CONFIG.ACTIVE_INTERVAL);
      }
    }
  }, [sendHeartbeat, restartHeartbeatWithInterval]);

  // Handle page visibility change
  const handleVisibilityChange = useCallback(() => {
    if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
      // Page became visible, update activity
      lastActivityRef.current = Date.now();
      const token = localStorage.getItem('user_token');
      if (token && !heartbeatIntervalRef.current) {
        // Restart heartbeat if it was stopped - 使用 ref 引用
        if (startHeartbeatRef.current) {
          startHeartbeatRef.current();
        }
      }
    }
  }, []);

  // Start heartbeat with activity detection
  const startHeartbeat = useCallback(() => {
    // Clear any existing intervals
    if (heartbeatIntervalRef.current) {
      clearInterval(heartbeatIntervalRef.current);
    }
    if (activityCheckIntervalRef.current) {
      clearInterval(activityCheckIntervalRef.current);
    }

    // Reset activity state
    lastActivityRef.current = Date.now();
    isIdleRef.current = false;

    // Send initial heartbeat
    sendHeartbeat();

    // Set up interval to send heartbeat (active interval initially)
    heartbeatIntervalRef.current = setInterval(sendHeartbeat, HEARTBEAT_CONFIG.ACTIVE_INTERVAL);

    // Set up activity status check (every 10 seconds)
    activityCheckIntervalRef.current = setInterval(checkActivityStatus, 10000);

    // Add activity event listeners
    USER_ACTIVITY_EVENTS.forEach(event => {
      window.addEventListener(event, updateLastActivity, { passive: true });
    });

    // Also listen for visibility change
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);
  }, [sendHeartbeat, checkActivityStatus, updateLastActivity, handleVisibilityChange]);

  // 更新 ref
  useEffect(() => {
    startHeartbeatRef.current = startHeartbeat;
  }, [startHeartbeat]);

  // 完整的 stopHeartbeat（包含清理事件监听器）
  const fullStopHeartbeat = useCallback(() => {
    stopHeartbeat();
    
    // Remove activity event listeners
    USER_ACTIVITY_EVENTS.forEach(event => {
      window.removeEventListener(event, updateLastActivity);
    });
    document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);
  }, [stopHeartbeat, updateLastActivity, handleVisibilityChange]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const initializeAuth = async () => {
    // Check for existing token on mount
    const token = localStorage.getItem('user_token');
    const userData = localStorage.getItem('user_data');

    if (token && userData && userData !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        setIsAuthenticated(true);
        setUser(JSON.parse(userData));
        startHeartbeat(); // Start heartbeat for existing session
          
          // 立即获取最新的用户信息和订阅信息
          try {
            const [profileResponse, subscriptionResponse] = await Promise.all([
              userAPI.getProfile(),
              subscriptionAPI.getMySubscription().catch(err => {
                console.error('Failed to fetch subscription:', err);
                return null;
              })
            ]);

            if (profileResponse.data.code === 0 && profileResponse.data.data) {
              const freshUserData = profileResponse.data.data;
              
              // 如果成功获取订阅信息，将其添加到用户数据中
              if (subscriptionResponse && subscriptionResponse.data.code === 0) {
                freshUserData.subscription = subscriptionResponse.data.data;
              }
              
              localStorage.setItem('user_data', JSON.stringify(freshUserData));
              setUser(freshUserData);
            }
          } catch (error) {
            console.error('Failed to refresh user data on init:', error);
          }
      } catch (error) {
        // Clear invalid data
        localStorage.removeItem('user_token');
        localStorage.removeItem('user_data');
      }
    }
    setLoading(false);
    };

    initializeAuth();

    // Listen for auth expiration events
    const handleAuthExpired = (event) => {
      // Stop heartbeat and clear state
      fullStopHeartbeat();
      setIsAuthenticated(false);
      setUser(null);

      // 静默处理，不显示 alert 弹窗
      // API 拦截器已经处理了重定向到首页
      console.log('Auth expired:', event.detail?.message || '登录已失效');
    };

    window.addEventListener('auth:expired', handleAuthExpired);

    // Cleanup on unmount
    return () => {
      fullStopHeartbeat();
      window.removeEventListener('auth:expired', handleAuthExpired);
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const login = async (token, userData) => {
    localStorage.setItem('user_token', token);
    localStorage.setItem('user_data', JSON.stringify(userData));
    setIsAuthenticated(true);
    setUser(userData);
    startHeartbeat(); // Start heartbeat when user logs in
    
    // 登录后立即获取订阅信息
    try {
      const subscriptionResponse = await subscriptionAPI.getMySubscription();
      if (subscriptionResponse.data.code === 0) {
        const updatedUserData = { ...userData, subscription: subscriptionResponse.data.data };
        localStorage.setItem('user_data', JSON.stringify(updatedUserData));
        setUser(updatedUserData);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch subscription after login:', error);
    }
  };

  const logout = async () => {
    // Stop heartbeat first
    fullStopHeartbeat();

    // Call backend logout API to delete session
    try {
      await userAPI.logout();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Logout API call failed:', error);
    }

    // Clear local storage and state
    localStorage.removeItem('user_token');
    localStorage.removeItem('user_data');
    setIsAuthenticated(false);
    setUser(null);
  };

  // Update user data in state and localStorage
  const updateUser = (userData) => {
    localStorage.setItem('user_data', JSON.stringify(userData));
    setUser(userData);
  };

  // Refresh user data from backend
  const refreshUser = async () => {
    try {
      // 同时获取用户信息和订阅信息
      const [profileResponse, subscriptionResponse] = await Promise.all([
        userAPI.getProfile(),
        subscriptionAPI.getMySubscription().catch(err => {
          console.error('Failed to fetch subscription:', err);
          return null;
        })
      ]);

      if (profileResponse.data.code === 0 && profileResponse.data.data) {
        const userData = profileResponse.data.data;
        
        // 如果成功获取订阅信息，将其添加到用户数据中
        if (subscriptionResponse && subscriptionResponse.data.code === 0) {
          userData.subscription = subscriptionResponse.data.data;
        }
        
        updateUser(userData);
        return userData;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to refresh user data:', error);
    }
    return null;
  };

  const value = {
    isAuthenticated,
    user,
    login,
    logout,
    updateUser,
    refreshUser,
    loading,
  };

  return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>;
};

export const useAuth = () => {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

/**

 * Scholay学术 V1.0
