import { useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';

/**
 * 防抖函数 - 延迟执行,多次调用只执行最后一次
 * @param {Function} func - 要防抖的函数
 * @param {number} delay - 延迟时间(毫秒)
 * @returns {Function} 防抖后的函数
 */
export function debounce(func, delay = 300) {
  let timeoutId;
  return function debounced(...args) {
    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    timeoutId = setTimeout(() => func.apply(this, args), delay);
  };
}

/**
 * 节流函数 - 固定时间间隔执行,限制执行频率
 * @param {Function} func - 要节流的函数
 * @param {number} limit - 时间间隔(毫秒)
 * @returns {Function} 节流后的函数
 */
export function throttle(func, limit = 300) {
  let inThrottle;
  let lastResult;

  return function throttled(...args) {
    if (!inThrottle) {
      inThrottle = true;
      lastResult = func.apply(this, args);

      setTimeout(() => {
        inThrottle = false;
      }, limit);
    }
    return lastResult;
  };
}

/**
 * React Hook: 使用防抖
 * @param {Function} callback - 回调函数
 * @param {number} delay - 延迟时间(毫秒)
 * @param {Array} deps - 依赖数组
 * @returns {Function} 防抖后的回调
 *
 * @example
 * const handleSearch = useDebounce((query) => {
 *   // API call
 * }, 500);
 */
export function useDebounce(callback, delay = 300, deps = []) {
  const timeoutRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (timeoutRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, []);

  return useCallback((...args) => {
    if (timeoutRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
    }

    timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      callback(...args);
    }, delay);
  }, [callback, delay, ...deps]);
}

/**
 * React Hook: 使用节流
 * @param {Function} callback - 回调函数
 * @param {number} limit - 时间间隔(毫秒)
 * @param {Array} deps - 依赖数组
 * @returns {Function} 节流后的回调
 *
 * @example
 * const handleScroll = useThrottle(() => {
 *   // Handle scroll
 * }, 100);
 */
export function useThrottle(callback, limit = 300, deps = []) {
  const inThrottleRef = useRef(false);

  return useCallback((...args) => {
    if (!inThrottleRef.current) {
      callback(...args);
      inThrottleRef.current = true;

      setTimeout(() => {
        inThrottleRef.current = false;
      }, limit);
    }
  }, [callback, limit, ...deps]);
}

/**
 * 请求去重 - 防止相同请求并发执行
 * @param {Function} requestFn - 返回 Promise 的请求函数
 * @returns {Function} 去重后的请求函数
 *
 * @example
 * const fetchData = dedupe(async (id) => {
 *   return await api.get(`/data/${id}`);
 * });
 */
export function dedupe(requestFn) {
  const pendingRequests = new Map();

  return async function deduped(...args) {
    const key = JSON.stringify(args);

    // 如果相同请求正在进行,返回同一个 Promise
    if (pendingRequests.has(key)) {
      return pendingRequests.get(key);
    }

    // 创建新请求
    const promise = requestFn(...args).finally(() => {
      pendingRequests.delete(key);
    });

    pendingRequests.set(key, promise);
    return promise;
  };
}

/**
 * React Hook: 使用请求去重
 * @param {Function} requestFn - 异步请求函数
 * @returns {Function} 去重后的请求函数
 *
 * @example
 * const fetchPaper = useDedupe(async (paperId) => {
 *   return await api.get(`/papers/${paperId}`);
 * });
 */
export function useDedupe(requestFn) {
  const pendingRef = useRef(new Map());

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      // 组件卸载时清理待处理请求
      pendingRef.current.clear();
    };
  }, []);

  return useCallback(async (...args) => {
    const key = JSON.stringify(args);

    if (pendingRef.current.has(key)) {
      return pendingRef.current.get(key);
    }

    const promise = requestFn(...args).finally(() => {
      pendingRef.current.delete(key);
    });

    pendingRef.current.set(key, promise);
    return promise;
  }, [requestFn]);
}

/**
 * 简单的LRU缓存实现
 */
export class LRUCache {
  constructor(capacity = 50) {
    this.capacity = capacity;
    this.cache = new Map();
  }

  get(key) {
    if (!this.cache.has(key)) {
      return null;
    }

    // LRU: 移到最后
    const value = this.cache.get(key);
    this.cache.delete(key);
    this.cache.set(key, value);

    return value;
  }

  set(key, value) {
    // 删除旧的
    if (this.cache.has(key)) {
      this.cache.delete(key);
    }

    // 添加新的
    this.cache.set(key, value);

    // 超过容量,删除最旧的
    if (this.cache.size > this.capacity) {
      const oldestKey = this.cache.keys().next().value;
      this.cache.delete(oldestKey);
    }
  }

  has(key) {
    return this.cache.has(key);
  }

  clear() {
    this.cache.clear();
  }

  get size() {
    return this.cache.size;
  }
}

/**
 * 带过期时间的缓存
 */
export class TTLCache {
  constructor(ttl = 5 * 60 * 1000) { // 默认5分钟
    this.ttl = ttl;
    this.cache = new Map();
  }

  get(key) {
    const item = this.cache.get(key);

    if (!item) {
      return null;
    }

    // 检查是否过期
    if (Date.now() > item.expiry) {
      this.cache.delete(key);
      return null;
    }

    return item.value;
  }

  set(key, value, customTTL) {
    const ttl = customTTL || this.ttl;
    this.cache.set(key, {
      value,
      expiry: Date.now() + ttl
    });
  }

  has(key) {
    const item = this.cache.get(key);
    if (!item) return false;

    if (Date.now() > item.expiry) {
      this.cache.delete(key);
      return false;
    }

    return true;
  }

  delete(key) {
    return this.cache.delete(key);
  }

  clear() {
    this.cache.clear();
  }

  // 清理过期项
  cleanup() {
    const now = Date.now();
    for (const [key, item] of this.cache.entries()) {
      if (now > item.expiry) {
        this.cache.delete(key);
      }
    }
  }

  get size() {
    return this.cache.size;
  }
}

/**
 * React Hook: 使用带TTL的缓存
 * @param {number} ttl - 缓存时间(毫秒)
 * @returns {TTLCache} 缓存实例
 */
export function useTTLCache(ttl = 5 * 60 * 1000) {
  const cacheRef = useRef(null);

  if (!cacheRef.current) {
    cacheRef.current = new TTLCache(ttl);
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    const cache = cacheRef.current;

    // 定期清理过期项(每分钟)
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      cache.cleanup();
    }, 60 * 1000);

    return () => {
      clearInterval(interval);
      cache.clear();
    };
  }, []);

  return cacheRef.current;
}

/**
 * 批量请求合并 - 将多个请求合并为一次批量请求
 * @param {Function} batchFn - 批量请求函数,接收ID数组,返回结果数组
 * @param {Object} options - 配置选项
 * @returns {Function} 合并后的请求函数
 */
export function batchRequests(batchFn, options = {}) {
  const {
    maxBatchSize = 50,    // 最大批量大小
    maxWaitTime = 50,     // 最大等待时间(毫秒)
  } = options;

  let batch = [];
  let timeoutId = null;

  const executeBatch = async () => {
    if (batch.length === 0) return;

    const currentBatch = batch;
    batch = [];

    try {
      const ids = currentBatch.map(item => item.id);
      const results = await batchFn(ids);

      // 分发结果
      currentBatch.forEach((item, index) => {
        item.resolve(results[index]);
      });
    } catch (error) {
      currentBatch.forEach(item => {
        item.reject(error);
      });
    }
  };

  return function batched(id) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      batch.push({ id, resolve, reject });

      if (batch.length >= maxBatchSize) {
        // 达到批量大小,立即执行
        clearTimeout(timeoutId);
        executeBatch();
      } else if (!timeoutId) {
        // 设置定时器,等待更多请求
        timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
          timeoutId = null;
          executeBatch();
        }, maxWaitTime);
      }
    });
  };
}

export default {
  debounce,
  throttle,
  useDebounce,
  useThrottle,
  dedupe,
  useDedupe,
  LRUCache,
  TTLCache,
  useTTLCache,
  batchRequests
};

/**

// 搜索历史管理工具
const SEARCH_HISTORY_KEY_PREFIX = 'scholar_search_history';
const MAX_HISTORY_ITEMS = 50; // 最多保存50条历史记录

/**
 * 获取用户特定的localStorage键名
 * @param {number|null} userId - 用户ID (null表示游客用户)
 * @returns {string} localStorage键名
 */
const getUserHistoryKey = (userId) => {
  return userId ? `${SEARCH_HISTORY_KEY_PREFIX}_${userId}` : `${SEARCH_HISTORY_KEY_PREFIX}_guest`;
};

// 搜索历史项目结构:
// {
//   id: number,
//   query: string,           // 实际的搜索查询词（不可变，用于搜索）
//   displayName: string,     // 显示名称（可重命名，用于界面显示）
//   filters: object,         // 包含所有搜索过滤条件
//   timestamp: number,
//   resultsCount: number (optional)
// }

/**
 * 获取指定用户的所有搜索历史
 * @param {number|null} userId - 用户ID (null表示游客用户)
 * @returns {Array} 搜索历史数组,按时间倒序排列
 */
export const getSearchHistory = (userId = null) => {
  try {
    const historyKey = getUserHistoryKey(userId);
    const historyJson = localStorage.getItem(historyKey);
    if (!historyJson) return [];

    const history = JSON.parse(historyJson);

    // 迁移旧数据：为没有displayName的项目添加displayName字段
    let needsSave = false;
    history.forEach(item => {
      if (!item.displayName) {
        item.displayName = item.query;
        needsSave = true;
      }
    });

    // 如果有数据被迁移，保存回localStorage
    if (needsSave) {
      localStorage.setItem(historyKey, JSON.stringify(history));
    }

    // 按时间戳倒序排列(最新的在前)
    return history.sort((a, b) => b.timestamp - a.timestamp);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to get search history:', error);
    return [];
  }
};

/**
 * 添加搜索历史记录
 * @param {string} query - 搜索关键词
 * @param {object} filters - 搜索过滤条件
 * @param {number} resultsCount - 搜索结果数量(可选)
 * @param {number|null} userId - 用户ID (null表示游客用户)
 * @returns {object} 新添加的历史记录项
 */
export const addSearchHistory = (query, filters = {}, resultsCount = null, userId = null) => {
  if (!query || query.trim() === '') {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    const historyKey = getUserHistoryKey(userId);
    const history = getSearchHistory(userId);

    // 检查是否已存在相同的搜索(query和主要filters相同)
    const existingIndex = history.findIndex(item =>
      item.query === query &&
      JSON.stringify(item.filters) === JSON.stringify(filters)
    );

    let newItem;

    if (existingIndex !== -1) {
      // 如果已存在,更新时间戳并移到最前面
      newItem = {
        ...history[existingIndex],
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        resultsCount: resultsCount !== null ? resultsCount : history[existingIndex].resultsCount
      };
      history.splice(existingIndex, 1);
    } else {
      // 创建新项目
      newItem = {
        id: Date.now(),
        query: query.trim(),
        displayName: query.trim(), // 初始时显示名称和查询词相同
        filters: filters || {},
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        resultsCount
      };
    }

    // 添加到数组开头
    history.unshift(newItem);

    // 保持最大数量限制
    if (history.length > MAX_HISTORY_ITEMS) {
      history.splice(MAX_HISTORY_ITEMS);
    }

    // 保存到localStorage
    localStorage.setItem(historyKey, JSON.stringify(history));

    return newItem;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to add search history:', error);
    return null;
  }
};

/**
 * 重命名搜索历史记录 (只更新displayName字段，不改变实际的query)
 * @param {number} id - 历史记录ID
 * @param {string} newDisplayName - 新的显示名称
 * @param {number|null} userId - 用户ID (null表示游客用户)
 * @returns {boolean} 是否重命名成功
 */
export const renameSearchHistory = (id, newDisplayName, userId = null) => {
  if (!newDisplayName || newDisplayName.trim() === '') {
    return false;
  }

  try {
    const historyKey = getUserHistoryKey(userId);
    const history = getSearchHistory(userId);
    const itemIndex = history.findIndex(item => item.id === id);

    if (itemIndex !== -1) {
      // 只更新displayName，保持query不变
      history[itemIndex].displayName = newDisplayName.trim();
      localStorage.setItem(historyKey, JSON.stringify(history));
      return true;
    }

    return false;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to rename search history:', error);
    return false;
  }
};

/**
 * 删除搜索历史记录
 * @param {number} id - 历史记录ID
 * @param {number|null} userId - 用户ID (null表示游客用户)
 * @returns {boolean} 是否删除成功
 */
export const deleteSearchHistory = (id, userId = null) => {
  try {
    const historyKey = getUserHistoryKey(userId);
    const history = getSearchHistory(userId);
    const filteredHistory = history.filter(item => item.id !== id);

    localStorage.setItem(historyKey, JSON.stringify(filteredHistory));
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to delete search history:', error);
    return false;
  }
};

/**
 * 清空指定用户的所有搜索历史
 * @param {number|null} userId - 用户ID (null表示游客用户)
 * @returns {boolean} 是否清空成功
 */
export const clearSearchHistory = (userId = null) => {
  try {
    const historyKey = getUserHistoryKey(userId);
    localStorage.removeItem(historyKey);
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to clear search history:', error);
    return false;
  }
};

/**
 * 格式化历史记录用于显示
 * @param {object} item - 历史记录项
 * @returns {object} 格式化后的对象,包含title和updated_at
 */
export const formatHistoryItem = (item) => {
  // 使用displayName作为基础标题，如果不存在则使用query（兼容旧数据）
  let title = item.displayName || item.query;

  // 添加过滤条件到标题(可选)
  const filterParts = [];

  if (item.filters?.year) {
    filterParts.push(`年份: ${item.filters.year}`);
  }

  if (item.filters?.publicationTypes && item.filters.publicationTypes.length > 0) {
    filterParts.push(`类型: ${item.filters.publicationTypes.length}项`);
  }

  if (item.filters?.fieldsOfStudy && item.filters.fieldsOfStudy.length > 0) {
    filterParts.push(`领域: ${item.filters.fieldsOfStudy.length}项`);
  }

  if (filterParts.length > 0) {
    title = `${item.displayName || item.query} (${filterParts.join(', ')})`;
  }

  if (item.resultsCount !== null && item.resultsCount !== undefined) {
    title = `${title} - ${item.resultsCount}条结果`;
  }

  return {
    id: item.id,
    title: title,
    query: item.query,              // 实际查询词，用于搜索
    displayName: item.displayName || item.query,  // 显示名称，用于界面展示
    filters: item.filters,
    updated_at: new Date(item.timestamp).toISOString(),
    resultsCount: item.resultsCount
  };
};

/**
 * 获取格式化的搜索历史(用于侧边栏显示)
 * @param {number|null} userId - 用户ID (null表示游客用户)
 * @returns {Array} 格式化后的历史记录数组
 */
export const getFormattedSearchHistory = (userId = null) => {
  const history = getSearchHistory(userId);
  return history.map(formatHistoryItem);
};

/**
 * 迁移旧的搜索历史数据到新的用户特定格式
 * 仅在用户首次使用新系统时调用一次
 * @param {number} userId - 当前用户ID
 */
export const migrateOldSearchHistory = (userId) => {
  try {
    const oldKey = 'scholar_search_history';
    const newKey = getUserHistoryKey(userId);

    // 如果用户已有新格式的历史数据，不进行迁移
    if (localStorage.getItem(newKey)) {
      return;
    }

    // 获取旧格式的历史数据
    const oldHistoryJson = localStorage.getItem(oldKey);
    if (oldHistoryJson) {
      // 将旧数据复制到新的用户特定key
      localStorage.setItem(newKey, oldHistoryJson);
      console.log(`Migrated search history for user ${userId}`);
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to migrate search history:', error);
  }
};

/**

/**
 * 生成学术论文的结构化数据
 */
export const generateScholarlyArticleSchema = (paper) => {
  if (!paper) return null;

  return {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'ScholarlyArticle',
    headline: paper.title,
    abstract: paper.abstract,
    author: paper.authors?.map(author => ({
      '@type': 'Person',
      name: author.name,
      identifier: author.authorId ? `https://www.semanticscholar.org/author/${author.authorId}` : undefined,
    })),
    datePublished: paper.year ? `${paper.year}-01-01` : undefined,
    publisher: paper.venue ? {
      '@type': 'Organization',
      name: paper.venue,
    } : undefined,
    citation: paper.citationCount ? {
      '@type': 'CreativeWork',
      identifier: `${paper.citationCount} citations`,
    } : undefined,
    url: paper.url || `https://www.semanticscholar.org/paper/${paper.paperId}`,
    identifier: {
      '@type': 'PropertyValue',
      propertyID: 'Semantic Scholar ID',
      value: paper.paperId,
    },
    ...(paper.externalIds?.DOI && {
      sameAs: `https://doi.org/${paper.externalIds.DOI}`,
    }),
  };
};

/**
 * 生成面包屑导航的结构化数据
 */
export const generateBreadcrumbSchema = (items) => {
  return {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'BreadcrumbList',
    itemListElement: items.map((item, index) => ({
      '@type': 'ListItem',
      position: index + 1,
      name: item.name,
      item: item.url ? `https://www.scholay.com${item.url}` : undefined,
    })),
  };
};

/**
 * 生成搜索结果页的结构化数据
 */
export const generateSearchResultsSchema = (query, results) => {
  if (!results || results.length === 0) return null;

  return {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'SearchResultsPage',
    name: `"${query}"的搜索结果`,
    about: {
      '@type': 'Thing',
      name: query,
    },
    mainEntity: {
      '@type': 'ItemList',
      numberOfItems: results.length,
      itemListElement: results.slice(0, 10).map((paper, index) => ({
        '@type': 'ListItem',
        position: index + 1,
        item: {
          '@type': 'ScholarlyArticle',
          headline: paper.title,
          author: paper.authors?.slice(0, 3).map(author => ({
            '@type': 'Person',
            name: author.name,
          })),
          datePublished: paper.year ? `${paper.year}-01-01` : undefined,
          url: `https://www.scholay.com/paper/${paper.paperId}`,
        },
      })),
    },
  };
};

/**
 * 生成FAQ的结构化数据
 */
export const generateFAQSchema = (faqs) => {
  return {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'FAQPage',
    mainEntity: faqs.map(faq => ({
      '@type': 'Question',
      name: faq.question,
      acceptedAnswer: {
        '@type': 'Answer',
        text: faq.answer,
      },
    })),
  };
};

/**
 * 截断文本用于描述
 */
export const truncateText = (text, maxLength = 160) => {
  if (!text) return '';
  if (text.length <= maxLength) return text;
  return text.substring(0, maxLength - 3) + '...';
};

/**
 * 生成页面标题
 */
export const generatePageTitle = (pageTitle, includePrefix = true) => {
  if (!includePrefix) return pageTitle;
  return `${pageTitle} | Scholay - AI驱动的学术搜索平台`;
};

/**
 * 清理和格式化关键词
 */
export const formatKeywords = (keywords) => {
  if (Array.isArray(keywords)) {
    return keywords.join(',');
  }
  return keywords;
};

import React, { lazy, Suspense } from 'react';
import { BrowserRouter as Router, Routes, Route, Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import Toast from './components/Toast';
import { AuthProvider, useAuth } from './utils/AuthContext';

// Lazy load all page components for better performance
const Login = lazy(() => import('./pages/Login'));
const DashboardLayout = lazy(() => import('./components/DashboardLayout'));
const DashboardHome = lazy(() => import('./pages/DashboardHome'));
const SystemSettings = lazy(() => import('./pages/SystemSettings'));
const UserManagement = lazy(() => import('./pages/UserManagement'));
const ThirdPartyAccounts = lazy(() => import('./pages/ThirdPartyAccounts'));
const PromptTemplates = lazy(() => import('./pages/PromptTemplates'));
const SubscriptionPlans = lazy(() => import('./pages/SubscriptionPlans'));
const OrderManagement = lazy(() => import('./pages/OrderManagement'));
const CouponManagement = lazy(() => import('./pages/CouponManagement'));
const CouponBatchManagement = lazy(() => import('./pages/CouponBatchManagement'));
const DistributedCoupons = lazy(() => import('./pages/DistributedCoupons'));
const DefaultBusinessData = lazy(() => import('./pages/DefaultBusinessData'));
const FeedbackManagement = lazy(() => import('./pages/FeedbackManagement'));

// Loading component for Suspense fallback
const LoadingFallback = () => (
  <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', height: '100vh' }}>
    <div>Loading...</div>
  </div>
);

const PrivateRoute = ({ children }) => {
  const { isAuthenticated, loading } = useAuth();

  if (loading) {
    return <LoadingFallback />;
  }

  return isAuthenticated ? children : <Navigate to="/login" />;
};

function App() {
  return (
    <AuthProvider>
      <Router>
        <Suspense fallback={<LoadingFallback />}>
          <Routes>
            <Route path="/login" element={<Login />} />
            <Route
              path="/dashboard"
              element={
                <PrivateRoute>
                  <DashboardLayout />
                </PrivateRoute>
              }
            >
              <Route index element={<DashboardHome />} />
              <Route path="users" element={<UserManagement />} />
              <Route path="orders" element={<OrderManagement />} />
              <Route path="coupons" element={<CouponManagement />} />
              <Route path="coupon-batches" element={<CouponBatchManagement />} />
              <Route path="distributed-coupons" element={<DistributedCoupons />} />
              <Route path="third-party-accounts" element={<ThirdPartyAccounts />} />
              <Route path="prompt-templates" element={<PromptTemplates />} />
              <Route path="subscription-plans" element={<SubscriptionPlans />} />
              <Route path="default-business-data" element={<DefaultBusinessData />} />
              <Route path="feedbacks" element={<FeedbackManagement />} />
              <Route path="settings" element={<SystemSettings />} />
              {/* 保留旧路由以防万一，但重定向到设置页 */}
              <Route path="alipay-config" element={<Navigate to="/dashboard/settings?tab=alipay" replace />} />
              <Route path="wechat-config" element={<Navigate to="/dashboard/settings?tab=wechat" replace />} />
            </Route>
            <Route path="/" element={<Navigate to="/dashboard" />} />
          </Routes>
        </Suspense>
        <Toast />
      </Router>
    </AuthProvider>
  );
}

export default App;

/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Outlet, useNavigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../utils/AuthContext';
import { showToast } from './Toast';
import './DashboardLayout.css';

const DashboardLayout = () => {
  const { user, logout } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const [showPasswordModal, setShowPasswordModal] = useState(false);
  const [mobileMenuOpen, setMobileMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [couponMenuOpen, setCouponMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [passwordForm, setPasswordForm] = useState({
    oldPassword: '',
    newPassword: '',
    confirmPassword: '',
  });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const handlePasswordChange = (e) => {
    setPasswordForm({
      ...passwordForm,
      [e.target.name]: e.target.value,
    });
  };

  const handlePasswordSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (passwordForm.newPassword !== passwordForm.confirmPassword) {
      showToast('新密码两次输入不一致', 'error');
      return;
    }

    if (passwordForm.newPassword.length < 8) {
      showToast('密码长度至少为8个字符', 'error');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const { adminAPI } = await import('../services/api');
      const response = await adminAPI.updatePassword(
        passwordForm.oldPassword,
        passwordForm.newPassword
      );

      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        showToast('密码修改成功', 'success');
        setPasswordForm({
          oldPassword: '',
          newPassword: '',
          confirmPassword: '',
        });
        setTimeout(() => {
          setShowPasswordModal(false);
        }, 1000);
      } else {
        showToast(response.data.message || '密码修改失败', 'error');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(err.response?.data?.message || '操作失败', 'error');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleLogout = () => {
    logout();
    navigate('/login');
  };

  const isActive = (path) => {
    return location.pathname === path;
  };

  return (

              <rect width="48" height="48" rx="12" fill="#2563eb"/>
              <path d="M24 12L32 20H28V32H20V20H16L24 12Z" fill="white"/>
              <rect x="16" y="34" width="16" height="2" fill="white"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <h2>Scholar</h2>
        </div>

        <nav className="sidebar-nav">
          <a
            onClick={() => { navigate('/dashboard'); setMobileMenuOpen(false); }}
            className={`nav-item ${isActive('/dashboard') ? 'active' : ''}`}
          >
            <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
              <path d="M3 4a1 1 0 011-1h12a1 1 0 011 1v2a1 1 0 01-1 1H4a1 1 0 01-1-1V4zM3 10a1 1 0 011-1h6a1 1 0 011 1v6a1 1 0 01-1 1H4a1 1 0 01-1-1v-6zM14 9a1 1 0 00-1 1v6a1 1 0 001 1h2a1 1 0 001-1v-6a1 1 0 00-1-1h-2z"/>
            </svg>
            仪表盘
          </a>
          <a
            onClick={() => { navigate('/dashboard/users'); setMobileMenuOpen(false); }}
            className={`nav-item ${isActive('/dashboard/users') ? 'active' : ''}`}
          >
            <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
              <path d="M9 6a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0zM17 6a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0zM12.93 17c.046-.327.07-.66.07-1a6.97 6.97 0 00-1.5-4.33A5 5 0 0119 16v1h-6.07zM6 11a5 5 0 015 5v1H1v-1a5 5 0 015-5z"/>
            </svg>
            用户管理
          </a>
          <a
            onClick={() => { navigate('/dashboard/orders'); setMobileMenuOpen(false); }}
            className={`nav-item ${isActive('/dashboard/orders') ? 'active' : ''}`}
          >
            <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
              <path d="M3 1a1 1 0 000 2h1.22l.305 1.222a.997.997 0 00.01.042l1.358 5.43-.893.892C3.74 11.846 4.632 14 6.414 14H15a1 1 0 000-2H6.414l1-1H14a1 1 0 00.894-.553l3-6A1 1 0 0017 3H6.28l-.31-1.243A1 1 0 005 1H3zM16 16.5a1.5 1.5 0 11-3 0 1.5 1.5 0 013 0zM6.5 18a1.5 1.5 0 100-3 1.5 1.5 0 000 3z"/>
            </svg>
            订单管理
          </a>

          {/* Coupon Management Parent Menu */}
          <div className="nav-group">

                  className={`submenu-item ${isActive('/dashboard/coupons') ? 'active' : ''}`}
                >

                <a
                  onClick={() => { navigate('/dashboard/coupon-batches'); setMobileMenuOpen(false); }}
                  className={`submenu-item ${isActive('/dashboard/coupon-batches') ? 'active' : ''}`}
                >
                  批量发放
                </a>
                <a
                  onClick={() => { navigate('/dashboard/distributed-coupons'); setMobileMenuOpen(false); }}
                  className={`submenu-item ${isActive('/dashboard/distributed-coupons') ? 'active' : ''}`}

            )}
          </div>
          <a

          >

            </svg>
            套餐管理
          </a>
          <a

          <a
            onClick={() => { navigate('/dashboard/feedbacks'); setMobileMenuOpen(false); }}
            className={`nav-item ${isActive('/dashboard/feedbacks') ? 'active' : ''}`}

            <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">

              <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M5 9V7a5 5 0 0110 0v2a2 2 0 012 2v5a2 2 0 01-2 2H5a2 2 0 01-2-2v-5a2 2 0 012-2zm8-2v2H7V7a3 3 0 016 0z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
            </svg>
            修改密码
          </button>
        </div>
      </aside>

      <main className="main-content">
        <header className="top-bar">
          <div className="top-bar-left">
            <button
              className="mobile-menu-btn"
              onClick={() => setMobileMenuOpen(!mobileMenuOpen)}
              aria-label="Toggle menu"
            >
              <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                <path d="M3 12h18M3 6h18M3 18h18" />
              </svg>
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="user-menu">
            <div className="user-info">
              <div className="user-avatar">
                {user?.username?.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
              </div>
              <div className="user-details">
                <span className="user-name">{user?.username}</span>
                <span className="user-role">管理员</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button onClick={handleLogout} className="btn-logout">
              <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M3 3a1 1 0 00-1 1v12a1 1 0 001 1h12a1 1 0 001-1V4a1 1 0 00-1-1H3zm11 4.414l-4.293 4.293a1 1 0 01-1.414 0L4 7.414 5.414 6l3.293 3.293L13.586 6 15 7.414z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
              </svg>
              退出登录
            </button>
          </div>
        </header>

        <div className="dashboard-content">
          <Outlet />
        </div>
      </main>

      {showPasswordModal && (
        <div className="modal-overlay">
          <div className="modal fade-in">
            <div className="modal-header">
              <h2>修改密码</h2>
              <button onClick={() => setShowPasswordModal(false)} className="modal-close">
                <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth="2" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"/>
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handlePasswordSubmit} className="modal-body">
              <div className="form-group">
                <label htmlFor="oldPassword">当前密码</label>
                <input
                  type="password"
                  id="oldPassword"
                  name="oldPassword"
                  className="input"
                  value={passwordForm.oldPassword}
                  onChange={handlePasswordChange}
                  required
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label htmlFor="newPassword">新密码</label>
                <input
                  type="password"
                  id="newPassword"
                  name="newPassword"
                  className="input"
                  value={passwordForm.newPassword}
                  onChange={handlePasswordChange}
                  required
                  minLength={8}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label htmlFor="confirmPassword">确认新密码</label>
                <input
                  type="password"
                  id="confirmPassword"
                  name="confirmPassword"
                  className="input"
                  value={passwordForm.confirmPassword}
                  onChange={handlePasswordChange}
                  required
                />
              </div>

              <div className="modal-actions">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowPasswordModal(false)}
                  className="btn btn-secondary"
                >
                  取消
                </button>
                <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary" disabled={loading}>
                  {loading ? (
                    <>
                      <span className="spinner"></span>
                      <span style={{ marginLeft: '0.5rem' }}>修改中...</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    '确认修改'
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default DashboardLayout;

 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26

import React, { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { LineChart, Line, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, Legend, ResponsiveContainer } from 'recharts';
import { adminAPI } from '../services/api';
import './UserStatisticsChart.css';

const OnlineUserChart = () => {
  const [data, setData] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [showFilter, setShowFilter] = useState(false);
  
  // 时间范围和粒度
  const [startTime, setStartTime] = useState(() => {
    const date = new Date();
    date.setHours(date.getHours() - 24);
    return formatDateTimeLocal(date);
  });
  const [endTime, setEndTime] = useState(() => {
    const date = new Date();
    return formatDateTimeLocal(date);
  });
  const [granularity, setGranularity] = useState('5min');

  // 格式化日期为 datetime-local 输入格式
  function formatDateTimeLocal(date) {
    const year = date.getFullYear();
    const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    const hours = String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
    const minutes = String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
    const seconds = String(date.getSeconds()).padStart(2, '0');
    return `${year}-${month}-${day}T${hours}:${minutes}:${seconds}`;
  }

  // 格式化日期为 API 格式
  function formatDateTimeAPI(dateTimeLocal) {
    return dateTimeLocal.replace('T', ' ');
  }

  const fetchData = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const params = {
        start_time: formatDateTimeAPI(startTime),
        end_time: formatDateTimeAPI(endTime),
        granularity: granularity
      };
      const response = await adminAPI.getOnlineUserChart(params);
      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        setData(response.data.data.snapshots || []);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch online user data:', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [startTime, endTime, granularity]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchData();
    // Refresh every 5 minutes
    const interval = setInterval(fetchData, 5 * 60 * 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [fetchData]);

  const handleSearch = () => {
    fetchData();
    setShowFilter(false);
  };

  const handleCancel = () => {
    setShowFilter(false);
  };

  // 快捷时间选择
  const setQuickRange = (type) => {
    const now = new Date();
    let start = new Date();
    let gran = '5min';

    switch (type) {
      case 'hour':
        start.setHours(start.getHours() - 1);
        gran = '5min';
        break;
      case 'today':
        start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
        gran = '5min';
        break;
      case 'day':
        start.setHours(start.getHours() - 24);
        gran = '5min';
        break;
      case 'week':
        start.setDate(start.getDate() - 7);
        gran = 'hour';
        break;
      case 'month':
        start.setDate(start.getDate() - 30);
        gran = 'hour';
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }

    setStartTime(formatDateTimeLocal(start));
    setEndTime(formatDateTimeLocal(now));
    setGranularity(gran);
  };

  const granularityOptions = [
    { value: '5min', label: '5分钟' },
    { value: 'hour', label: '小时' },
  ];

  const quickRangeOptions = [
    { value: 'hour', label: '近1小时' },
    { value: 'today', label: '今日' },
    { value: 'day', label: '近24小时' },
    { value: 'week', label: '近7天' },
    { value: 'month', label: '近30天' },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="chart-wrapper">
      {/* 搜索条件按钮 */}
      <div className="chart-toolbar">
        <button 
          className="filter-trigger-btn"
          onClick={() => setShowFilter(true)}
        >
          <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
            <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/>
            <path d="M21 21l-4.35-4.35"/>
          </svg>
          搜索条件
        </button>
        <div className="current-range">
          {startTime.replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 16)} ~ {endTime.replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 16)}
          <span className="granularity-tag">{granularityOptions.find(g => g.value === granularity)?.label}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 搜索条件弹窗 */}
      {showFilter && (
        <div className="filter-modal-overlay" onClick={handleCancel}>
          <div className="filter-modal" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div className="filter-modal-header">
              <h4>搜索条件</h4>
              <button className="filter-modal-close" onClick={handleCancel}>×</button>
            </div>
            <div className="filter-modal-body">
              {/* 快捷选择 */}
              <div className="filter-section">
                <label>快捷选择</label>
                <div className="quick-range-btns">
                  {quickRangeOptions.map(opt => (
                    <button
                      key={opt.value}
                      className="quick-range-btn"
                      onClick={() => setQuickRange(opt.value)}
                    >
                      {opt.label}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="filter-section">
                <label>起始时间</label>
                <input
                  type="datetime-local"
                  value={startTime}
                  onChange={e => setStartTime(e.target.value)}
                  className="filter-input"
                  step="1"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="filter-section">
                <label>结束时间</label>
                <input
                  type="datetime-local"
                  value={endTime}
                  onChange={e => setEndTime(e.target.value)}
                  className="filter-input"
                  step="1"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="filter-section">
                <label>时间粒度</label>
                <select
                  value={granularity}
                  onChange={e => setGranularity(e.target.value)}
                  className="filter-select"
                >
                  {granularityOptions.map(opt => (
                    <option key={opt.value} value={opt.value}>{opt.label}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="filter-modal-footer">
              <button className="filter-btn filter-btn-cancel" onClick={handleCancel}>取消</button>
              <button className="filter-btn filter-btn-confirm" onClick={handleSearch}>确定</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 图表区域 */}
      {loading ? (
        <div className="chart-loading">
          <div className="loading-spinner"></div>
          <p>加载中...</p>
        </div>
      ) : !data || data.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="chart-no-data">
          <p>暂无数据</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={300}>
          <LineChart data={data} margin={{ top: 10, right: 20, left: 0, bottom: 5 }}>
            <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#e0e0e0" vertical={false} />
            <XAxis
              dataKey="label"
              stroke="#999"
              tick={{ fontSize: 11 }}
              tickLine={false}
              axisLine={{ stroke: '#e0e0e0' }}
              interval="preserveStartEnd"
              angle={data.length > 20 ? -45 : 0}
              textAnchor={data.length > 20 ? "end" : "middle"}
              height={data.length > 20 ? 60 : 30}
            />
            <YAxis
              stroke="#999"
              tick={{ fontSize: 11 }}
              tickLine={false}
              axisLine={false}
              allowDecimals={false}
              width={35}
            />
            <Tooltip
              contentStyle={{
                backgroundColor: '#1f2937',
                border: '1px solid #374151',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                color: '#fff'
              }}
              labelStyle={{ color: '#9ca3af' }}
              formatter={(value) => [value, '在线用户']}
              labelFormatter={(label, payload) => {
                if (payload && payload[0]) {
                  return payload[0].payload.time || label;
                }
                return label;
              }}
            />
            <Legend
              wrapperStyle={{ fontSize: '13px', paddingTop: '10px' }}
              iconType="line"
            />
            <Line
              type="monotone"
              dataKey="online_count"
              stroke="#ff7300"
              strokeWidth={2}
              name="在线用户数"
              dot={false}
              activeDot={{ r: 4, strokeWidth: 0 }}
            />
          </LineChart>
        </ResponsiveContainer>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default OnlineUserChart;

// ========== 文件: frontend-admin/src/components/SensitiveField.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0

 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import './SensitiveField.css';

/**
 * 敏感信息字段组件
 * 默认显示遮罩，需要二次验证后才能查看
 */
const SensitiveField = ({ label, value, isVerified, onRequestVerify, type = 'text' }) => {
  const [showValue, setShowValue] = useState(false);
  const [copySuccess, setCopySuccess] = useState(false);

  const handleViewClick = () => {
    if (!isVerified) {
      if (onRequestVerify) {
        onRequestVerify();
      }
    } else {
      setShowValue(!showValue);
    }
  };

  const handleCopyClick = async () => {
    if (!isVerified || !showValue || !value) return;

    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);
      setCopySuccess(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopySuccess(false), 2000);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to copy:', err);
    }
  };

  const maskedValue = value ? '●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●●' : '未设置';
  const displayValue = (isVerified && showValue) ? value : maskedValue;

  return (
    <div className="sensitive-field">
      {label && <label>{label}</label>}
      <div className="sensitive-field-input-group">
        <input
          type={showValue ? 'text' : 'password'}
          value={displayValue}
          readOnly
          className="sensitive-field-input"
        />
        {isVerified && showValue && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleCopyClick}
            className="sensitive-field-btn sensitive-field-copy-btn"
            title={copySuccess ? '已复制' : '复制'}
          >
            {copySuccess ? (
              <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M16.707 5.293a1 1 0 010 1.414l-8 8a1 1 0 01-1.414 0l-4-4a1 1 0 011.414-1.414L8 12.586l7.293-7.293a1 1 0 011.414 0z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
              </svg>
            ) : (
              <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                <path d="M8 3a1 1 0 011-1h2a1 1 0 110 2H9a1 1 0 01-1-1z"/>
                <path d="M6 3a2 2 0 00-2 2v11a2 2 0 002 2h8a2 2 0 002-2V5a2 2 0 00-2-2 3 3 0 01-3 3H9a3 3 0 01-3-3z"/>
              </svg>
            )}
          </button>
        )}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleViewClick}
          className="sensitive-field-btn"
          title={isVerified ? (showValue ? '隐藏' : '显示') : '需要验证'}
        >
          {isVerified ? (
            showValue ? (
              <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M3.707 2.293a1 1 0 00-1.414 1.414l14 14a1 1 0 001.414-1.414l-1.473-1.473A10.014 10.014 0 0019.542 10C18.268 5.943 14.478 3 10 3a9.958 9.958 0 00-4.512 1.074l-1.78-1.781zm4.261 4.26l1.514 1.515a2.003 2.003 0 012.45 2.45l1.514 1.514a4 4 0 00-5.478-5.478z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
                <path d="M12.454 16.697L9.75 13.992a4 4 0 01-3.742-3.741L2.335 6.578A9.98 9.98 0 00.458 10c1.274 4.057 5.065 7 9.542 7 .847 0 1.669-.105 2.454-.303z"/>
              </svg>
            ) : (
              <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                <path d="M10 12a2 2 0 100-4 2 2 0 000 4z"/>
                <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M.458 10C1.732 5.943 5.522 3 10 3s8.268 2.943 9.542 7c-1.274 4.057-5.064 7-9.542 7S1.732 14.057.458 10zM14 10a4 4 0 11-8 0 4 4 0 018 0z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
              </svg>
            )
          ) : (
            <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
              <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M5 9V7a5 5 0 0110 0v2a2 2 0 012 2v5a2 2 0 01-2 2H5a2 2 0 01-2-2v-5a2 2 0 012-2zm8-2v2H7V7a3 3 0 016 0z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
            </svg>
          )}
        </button>
      </div>
      {!isVerified && (
        <p className="sensitive-field-hint">
          <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
            <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M18 10a8 8 0 11-16 0 8 8 0 0116 0zm-7-4a1 1 0 11-2 0 1 1 0 012 0zM9 9a1 1 0 000 2v3a1 1 0 001 1h1a1 1 0 100-2v-3a1 1 0 00-1-1H9z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
          </svg>
          查看此敏感信息需要验证管理员密码
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default SensitiveField;

// ========== 文件: frontend-admin/src/components/SliderCaptcha.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import './SliderCaptcha.css';

const SliderCaptcha = ({ onSuccess, onFail }) => {
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
  const [position, setPosition] = useState(0);
  const [verified, setVerified] = useState(false);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);

  const sliderRef = useRef(null);
  const containerRef = useRef(null);
  const startXRef = useRef(0);
  const currentPositionRef = useRef(0);
  const isDraggingRef = useRef(false);

  const handleStart = useCallback((clientX) => {
    if (verified || failed) return;
    isDraggingRef.current = true;
    setIsDragging(true);
    startXRef.current = clientX - currentPositionRef.current;
  }, [verified, failed]);

  const handleMove = useCallback((clientX) => {
    if (!isDraggingRef.current) return;

    const container = containerRef.current;
    if (!container) return;

    const maxMove = container.offsetWidth - 60;
    let newPosition = clientX - startXRef.current;
    newPosition = Math.max(0, Math.min(newPosition, maxMove));

    currentPositionRef.current = newPosition;
    setPosition(newPosition);
  }, []);

  const handleEnd = useCallback(() => {
    if (!isDraggingRef.current) return;
    isDraggingRef.current = false;
    setIsDragging(false);

    const container = containerRef.current;
    if (!container) return;

    const maxMove = container.offsetWidth - 60;
    const currentPercent = (currentPositionRef.current / maxMove) * 100;

    // 验证是否滑动到最右边 (95%以上)
    if (currentPercent >= 95) {
      setVerified(true);
      // 自动吸附到最右边
      setPosition(maxMove);
      currentPositionRef.current = maxMove;
      if (onSuccess) {
        setTimeout(() => onSuccess(), 300);
      }
    } else {
      setFailed(true);
      if (onFail) {
        onFail();
      }
      setTimeout(() => {
        setPosition(0);
        currentPositionRef.current = 0;
        setFailed(false);
      }, 1000);
    }
  }, [onSuccess, onFail]);

  // 鼠标事件
  const handleMouseDown = useCallback((e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    handleStart(e.clientX);
  }, [handleStart]);

  // 触摸事件
  const handleTouchStart = useCallback((e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (e.touches.length > 0) {
      handleStart(e.touches[0].clientX);
    }
  }, [handleStart]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onMouseMove = (e) => handleMove(e.clientX);
    const onTouchMove = (e) => {
      if (e.touches.length > 0) {
        handleMove(e.touches[0].clientX);
      }
    };
    const onEnd = () => handleEnd();

    if (isDragging) {
      document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
      document.addEventListener('mouseup', onEnd);
      document.addEventListener('touchmove', onTouchMove, { passive: false });
      document.addEventListener('touchend', onEnd);

      return () => {
        document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
        document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onEnd);
        document.removeEventListener('touchmove', onTouchMove);
        document.removeEventListener('touchend', onEnd);
      };
    }
  }, [isDragging, handleMove, handleEnd]);

  const reset = useCallback(() => {
    setPosition(0);
    currentPositionRef.current = 0;
    setVerified(false);
    setFailed(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (sliderRef.current) {
      sliderRef.current.reset = reset;
    }
  }, [reset]);

  // 计算进度百分比用于显示
  const getProgressPercent = () => {
    const container = containerRef.current;
    if (!container) return 0;
    const maxMove = container.offsetWidth - 60;
    return Math.round((position / maxMove) * 100);
  };

  return (
    <div className="slider-captcha-container">
      {/* 滑块轨道 */}
      <div
        ref={containerRef}
        className={`slider-captcha-track ${verified ? 'verified' : ''} ${failed ? 'failed' : ''}`}
      >
        <div className="slider-captcha-bg-text">
          {verified ? '✓ 验证成功' : failed ? '✗ 请重试' : '向右滑动滑块完成验证'}
        </div>

        <div
          className="slider-captcha-progress"
          style={{ width: `${position}px` }}
        />

        <div
          ref={sliderRef}
          className={`slider-captcha-button ${isDragging ? 'dragging' : ''}`}
          style={{ left: `${position}px` }}
          onMouseDown={handleMouseDown}
          onTouchStart={handleTouchStart}
        >
          <div className="slider-icon">
            {verified ? '✓' : failed ? '✗' : '››'}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="captcha-hint">
        {isDragging ? `已滑动 ${getProgressPercent()}%` : '按住滑块，向右拖动至最右端'}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default SliderCaptcha;

// ========== 文件: frontend-admin/src/components/Toast.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import './Toast.css';

let toastId = 0;
let toastCallbacks = [];

export const showToast = (message, type = 'success', duration = 3000) => {
  const id = toastId++;
  const toast = { id, message, type, duration };
  toastCallbacks.forEach(callback => callback(toast));
};

const Toast = () => {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState([]);

  const addToast = useCallback((toast) => {
    setToasts(prev => [...prev, toast]);

    // Auto remove after duration
    setTimeout(() => {
      removeToast(toast.id);
    }, toast.duration);
  }, []);

  const removeToast = (id) => {
    setToasts(prev => prev.filter(toast => toast.id !== id));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    toastCallbacks.push(addToast);
    return () => {
      toastCallbacks = toastCallbacks.filter(cb => cb !== addToast);
    };
  }, [addToast]);

  return (
    <div className="toast-container">
      {toasts.map(toast => (
        <div
          key={toast.id}
          className={`toast toast-${toast.type} toast-slide-in`}
          onClick={() => removeToast(toast.id)}
        >
          <div className="toast-icon">
            {toast.type === 'success' && (
              <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M10 18a8 8 0 100-16 8 8 0 000 16zm3.707-9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414-1.414L9 10.586 7.707 9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414 1.414l2 2a1 1 0 001.414 0l4-4z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
              </svg>
            )}
            {toast.type === 'error' && (
              <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M10 18a8 8 0 100-16 8 8 0 000 16zM8.707 7.293a1 1 0 00-1.414 1.414L8.586 10l-1.293 1.293a1 1 0 101.414 1.414L10 11.414l1.293 1.293a1 1 0 001.414-1.414L11.414 10l1.293-1.293a1 1 0 00-1.414-1.414L10 8.586 8.707 7.293z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
              </svg>
            )}
            {toast.type === 'warning' && (
              <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M8.257 3.099c.765-1.36 2.722-1.36 3.486 0l5.58 9.92c.75 1.334-.213 2.98-1.742 2.98H4.42c-1.53 0-2.493-1.646-1.743-2.98l5.58-9.92zM11 13a1 1 0 11-2 0 1 1 0 012 0zm-1-8a1 1 0 00-1 1v3a1 1 0 002 0V6a1 1 0 00-1-1z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
              </svg>
            )}
            {toast.type === 'info' && (
              <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M18 10a8 8 0 11-16 0 8 8 0 0116 0zm-7-4a1 1 0 11-2 0 1 1 0 012 0zM9 9a1 1 0 000 2v3a1 1 0 001 1h1a1 1 0 100-2v-3a1 1 0 00-1-1H9z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
              </svg>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="toast-message">{toast.message}</div>
          <button
            className="toast-close"
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              removeToast(toast.id);
            }}
          >
            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
              <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M4.293 4.293a1 1 0 011.414 0L10 8.586l4.293-4.293a1 1 0 111.414 1.414L11.414 10l4.293 4.293a1 1 0 01-1.414 1.414L10 11.414l-4.293 4.293a1 1 0 01-1.414-1.414L8.586 10 4.293 5.707a1 1 0 010-1.414z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
            </svg>
          </button>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Toast;

// ========== 文件: frontend-admin/src/components/UserDetailDrawer.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { adminAPI } from '../services/api';
import { showToast } from './Toast';
import './UserDetailDrawer.css';

const UserDetailDrawer = ({ userId, onClose }) => {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [detail, setDetail] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (userId) {
      loadUserDetail();
    }
  }, [userId]);

  const loadUserDetail = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await adminAPI.getUserDetail(userId);
      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
        setDetail(response.data.data);
      } else {
        showToast('加载用户详情失败', 'error');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(err.response?.data?.message || '加载用户详情失败', 'error');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const formatDate = (dateStr) => {
    if (!dateStr) return '-';
    return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleString('zh-CN');
  };

  const formatCurrency = (amount) => {
    return `¥${amount.toFixed(2)}`;
  };

  const getStatusLabel = (status) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 1:
        return <span className="status-badge status-active">正常</span>;
      case 0:
        return <span className="status-badge status-inactive">未激活</span>;
      case 2:
        return <span className="status-badge status-suspended">已封禁</span>;
      default:
        return <span className="status-badge">未知</span>;
    }
  };

  const getPlanBadgeClass = (code) => {
    if (code === 'free') return 'plan-badge plan-free';
    if (code === 'pro') return 'plan-badge plan-pro';
    if (code === 'max') return 'plan-badge plan-max';
    return 'plan-badge';
  };

  if (!userId) return null;

  return (
    <div className="drawer-overlay" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="drawer-container" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="drawer-header">
          <h2>用户详情</h2>
          <button className="drawer-close" onClick={onClose}>
            <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"></line>
              <line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"></line>
            </svg>
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="drawer-content">
          {loading ? (
            <div className="drawer-loading">
              <div className="spinner"></div>
              <p>加载中...</p>
            </div>
          ) : detail ? (
            <>
              {/* Basic Info */}
              <div className="detail-section">
                <h3 className="section-title">基本信息</h3>
                <div className="info-grid">
                  <div className="info-item">
                    <label>用户ID</label>
                    <span>{detail.id}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="info-item">
                    <label>状态</label>
                    <span>{getStatusLabel(detail.status)}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="info-item">
                    <label>会员状态</label>
                    <span>
                      {detail.current_subscription ? (
                        <span className={getPlanBadgeClass(detail.current_subscription.plan_code)}>
                          {detail.current_subscription.plan_name}
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="plan-badge plan-free">免费用户</span>
                      )}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="info-item">
                    <label>用户名</label>
                    <span>{detail.username || '-'}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="info-item">
                    <label>邮箱</label>
                    <span>
                      {detail.email || '-'}
                      {detail.email && (
                        <span className={`verify-badge ${detail.email_verified ? 'verified' : 'unverified'}`}>
                          {detail.email_verified ? '已验证' : '未验证'}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="info-item">
                    <label>手机号</label>
                    <span>
                      {detail.phone || '-'}
                      {detail.phone && (
                        <span className={`verify-badge ${detail.phone_verified ? 'verified' : 'unverified'}`}>
                          {detail.phone_verified ? '已验证' : '未验证'}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="info-item">
                    <label>登录方式</label>
                    <span>
                      {detail.auth_providers && detail.auth_providers.length > 0
                        ? detail.auth_providers.map(p => (
                            <span key={p} className="provider-tag">{p}</span>
                          ))
                        : '-'}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="info-item">
                    <label>注册时间</label>
                    <span>{formatDate(detail.created_at)}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="info-item">
                    <label>最后登录</label>
                    <span>{formatDate(detail.last_login_at)}</span>
                  </div>
                  {detail.current_subscription && (
                    <>
                      <div className="info-item">
                        <label>订阅到期</label>
                        <span>
                          {formatDate(detail.current_subscription.end_date)}
                          {detail.current_subscription.remaining_days >= 0 && (
                            <span className={`days-badge ${detail.current_subscription.remaining_days <= 7 ? 'warning' : ''}`}>
                              剩余 {detail.current_subscription.remaining_days} 天
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="info-item">
                        <label>自动续费</label>
                        <span>
                          <span className={`auto-renew-badge ${detail.current_subscription.auto_renew ? 'enabled' : 'disabled'}`}>
                            {detail.current_subscription.auto_renew ? '已开启' : '未开启'}
                          </span>
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Subscription Info */}
              {detail.current_subscription && (
                <div className="detail-section">
                  <h3 className="section-title">当前订阅</h3>
                  <div className="subscription-card">
                    <div className="subscription-header">
                      <span className={getPlanBadgeClass(detail.current_subscription.plan_code)}>
                        {detail.current_subscription.plan_name}
                      </span>
                      <span className="billing-cycle-badge">
                        {detail.current_subscription.billing_cycle === 'monthly' ? '月付' : '年付'}
                      </span>
                      <span className={`auto-renew-badge ${detail.current_subscription.auto_renew ? 'enabled' : 'disabled'}`}>
                        {detail.current_subscription.auto_renew ? '自动续费' : '不自动续费'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="subscription-info">
                      <div className="info-row">
                        <span>订阅状态：</span>
                        <span className="highlight">{detail.current_subscription.status}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="info-row">
                        <span>开始时间：</span>
                        <span>{formatDate(detail.current_subscription.start_date)}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="info-row">
                        <span>到期时间：</span>
                        <span>{formatDate(detail.current_subscription.end_date)}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="info-row">
                        <span>剩余天数：</span>
                        <span className="highlight">{detail.current_subscription.remaining_days} 天</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="info-row">
                        <span>配额使用：</span>
                        <span>
                          {detail.current_subscription.used_quota} / {detail.current_subscription.total_quota}
                          <span className="usage-percent">
                            ({((detail.current_subscription.used_quota / detail.current_subscription.total_quota) * 100).toFixed(1)}%)
                          </span>
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Order Statistics */}
              <div className="detail-section">
                <h3 className="section-title">订单统计</h3>
                <div className="stats-grid-small">
                  <div className="stat-card-small">
                    <div className="stat-icon-small stat-orders">
                      <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                        <path d="M3 1a1 1 0 000 2h1.22l.305 1.222a.997.997 0 00.01.042l1.358 5.43-.893.892C3.74 11.846 4.632 14 6.414 14H15a1 1 0 000-2H6.414l1-1H14a1 1 0 00.894-.553l3-6A1 1 0 0017 3H6.28l-.31-1.243A1 1 0 005 1H3zM16 16.5a1.5 1.5 0 11-3 0 1.5 1.5 0 013 0zM6.5 18a1.5 1.5 0 100-3 1.5 1.5 0 000 3z"/>
                      </svg>
                    </div>
                    <div className="stat-content-small">
                      <div className="stat-label-small">总订单数</div>
                      <div className="stat-value-small">{detail.order_stats.total_orders}</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="stat-card-small">
                    <div className="stat-icon-small stat-amount">
                      <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                        <path d="M8.433 7.418c.155-.103.346-.196.567-.267v1.698a2.305 2.305 0 01-.567-.267C8.07 8.34 8 8.114 8 8c0-.114.07-.34.433-.582zM11 12.849v-1.698c.22.071.412.164.567.267.364.243.433.468.433.582 0 .114-.07.34-.433.582a2.305 2.305 0 01-.567.267z"/>
                        <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M10 18a8 8 0 100-16 8 8 0 000 16zm1-13a1 1 0 10-2 0v.092a4.535 4.535 0 00-1.676.662C6.602 6.234 6 7.009 6 8c0 .99.602 1.765 1.324 2.246.48.32 1.054.545 1.676.662v1.941c-.391-.127-.68-.317-.843-.504a1 1 0 10-1.51 1.31c.562.649 1.413 1.076 2.353 1.253V15a1 1 0 102 0v-.092a4.535 4.535 0 001.676-.662C13.398 13.766 14 12.991 14 12c0-.99-.602-1.765-1.324-2.246A4.535 4.535 0 0011 9.092V7.151c.391.127.68.317.843.504a1 1 0 101.511-1.31c-.563-.649-1.413-1.076-2.354-1.253V5z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
                      </svg>
                    </div>
                    <div className="stat-content-small">
                      <div className="stat-label-small">总消费金额</div>
                      <div className="stat-value-small">{formatCurrency(detail.order_stats.total_amount)}</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="stat-card-small">
                    <div className="stat-icon-small stat-saved">
                      <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                        <path d="M10 2a1 1 0 011 1v1.323l3.954 1.582 1.599-.8a1 1 0 01.894 1.79l-1.233.616 1.738 5.42a1 1 0 01-.285 1.05L11.949 18H6.051L.333 13.98a1 1 0 01-.285-1.049l1.738-5.42-1.233-.617a1 1 0 11.894-1.788l1.599.799L7 4.323V3a1 1 0 011-1h2zm0 2.274L7 5.607v3.893a1 1 0 01-1 1H4.268l-1.2 3.748L7.586 17h4.828l4.519-2.752-1.2-3.748H14a1 1 0 01-1-1V5.607L10 4.274z"/>
                      </svg>
                    </div>
                    <div className="stat-content-small">
                      <div className="stat-label-small">累计节省</div>
                      <div className="stat-value-small">{formatCurrency(detail.order_stats.total_saved)}</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  {detail.order_stats.last_order_at && (
                    <div className="stat-card-small full-width">
                      <div className="stat-label-small">最后订单时间</div>
                      <div className="stat-value-small text-muted">{formatDate(detail.order_stats.last_order_at)}</div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Invitation Statistics */}
              {detail.invitation_stats && detail.invitation_stats.invitation_code && (
                <div className="detail-section">
                  <h3 className="section-title">邀请统计</h3>
                  <div className="invitation-card">
                    <div className="invitation-code">
                      <label>邀请码：</label>
                      <span className="code">{detail.invitation_stats.invitation_code}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="invitation-stats">
                      <div className="stat-item">
                        <div className="stat-number">{detail.invitation_stats.total_invited}</div>
                        <div className="stat-label">总邀请数</div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="stat-item">
                        <div className="stat-number success">{detail.invitation_stats.success_invited}</div>
                        <div className="stat-label">成功邀请</div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="stat-item">
                        <div className="stat-number reward">{detail.invitation_stats.rewards_earned}</div>
                        <div className="stat-label">获得奖励</div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Coupon Statistics */}
              <div className="detail-section">
                <h3 className="section-title">折扣券统计</h3>
                <div className="coupon-stats">
                  <div className="coupon-stat-item">
                    <span className="coupon-label">总领取：</span>
                    <span className="coupon-value">{detail.coupon_stats.total_coupons}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="coupon-stat-item">
                    <span className="coupon-label">已使用：</span>
                    <span className="coupon-value used">{detail.coupon_stats.used_coupons}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="coupon-stat-item">
                    <span className="coupon-label">可用：</span>
                    <span className="coupon-value available">{detail.coupon_stats.available_coupons}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="coupon-stat-item">
                    <span className="coupon-label">已过期：</span>
                    <span className="coupon-value expired">{detail.coupon_stats.expired_coupons}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Invitation Relationships */}
              <div className="detail-section">
                <h3 className="section-title">邀请关系</h3>
                
                {/* Invited By */}
                {detail.invited_by ? (
                  <div className="relationship-card">
                    <div className="relationship-header">
                      <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                        <path d="M16 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H5a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"></path>
                        <circle cx="8.5" cy="7" r="4"></circle>
                        <polyline points="17 11 19 13 23 9"></polyline>
                      </svg>
                      <span>邀请人</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="inviter-info">
                      <div className="inviter-details">
                        <div className="inviter-name">
                          {detail.invited_by.username || detail.invited_by.email || `用户 ${detail.invited_by.user_id}`}
                        </div>
                        <div className="inviter-meta">
                          <span>ID: {detail.invited_by.user_id}</span>
                          {detail.invited_by.email && <span>{detail.invited_by.email}</span>}
                          <span>邀请时间: {formatDate(detail.invited_by.invited_at)}</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="relationship-empty">
                    <span>该用户无邀请人（直接注册）</span>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Invited Users */}
                {detail.invited_users && detail.invited_users.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="relationship-card">
                    <div className="relationship-header">
                      <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                        <path d="M17 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H5a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"></path>
                        <circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"></circle>
                        <path d="M23 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87"></path>
                        <path d="M16 3.13a4 4 0 0 1 0 7.75"></path>
                      </svg>
                      <span>已邀请用户 ({detail.invited_users.length})</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="invited-users-list">
                      {detail.invited_users.map((user) => (
                        <div key={user.user_id} className="invited-user-item">
                          <div className="invited-user-main">
                            <div className="invited-user-name">
                              {user.username || user.email || `用户 ${user.user_id}`}
                            </div>
                            <div className="invited-user-badges">
                              {user.is_registered && (
                                <span className="user-badge registered">已注册</span>
                              )}
                              {user.has_ordered && (
                                <span className="user-badge ordered">已下单</span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div className="invited-user-meta">
                            <span>ID: {user.user_id}</span>
                            {user.email && <span>{user.email}</span>}
                            <span>{formatDate(user.invited_at)}</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* AI Conversation Statistics */}
              <div className="detail-section">
                <h3 className="section-title">AI对话统计</h3>
                <div className="conversation-stats-card">
                  <div className="conv-stats-overview">
                    <div className="conv-stat-main">
                      <div className="conv-stat-number">{detail.ai_conversation_stats.total_conversations}</div>
                      <div className="conv-stat-label">总对话数</div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="conv-stat-main">
                      <div className="conv-stat-number">{detail.ai_conversation_stats.total_rounds}</div>
                      <div className="conv-stat-label">总轮次</div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="conv-stat-main">
                      <div className="conv-stat-number">{detail.ai_conversation_stats.avg_rounds_per_conv.toFixed(1)}</div>
                      <div className="conv-stat-label">平均轮次/对话</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="conv-stats-timeline">
                    <div className="timeline-item">
                      <span className="timeline-label">今日</span>
                      <span className="timeline-value">{detail.ai_conversation_stats.today_rounds} 轮</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="timeline-item">
                      <span className="timeline-label">本周</span>
                      <span className="timeline-value">{detail.ai_conversation_stats.week_rounds} 轮</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="timeline-item">
                      <span className="timeline-label">本月</span>
                      <span className="timeline-value">{detail.ai_conversation_stats.month_rounds} 轮</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  {detail.ai_conversation_stats.last_conv_at && (
                    <div className="conv-last-activity">
                      最后对话: {formatDate(detail.ai_conversation_stats.last_conv_at)}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Analysis Conversation Statistics */}
              <div className="detail-section">
                <h3 className="section-title">智能分析统计</h3>
                <div className="conversation-stats-card analysis">
                  <div className="conv-stats-overview">
                    <div className="conv-stat-main">
                      <div className="conv-stat-number">{detail.analysis_conversation_stats.total_conversations}</div>
                      <div className="conv-stat-label">总分析数</div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="conv-stat-main">
                      <div className="conv-stat-number">{detail.analysis_conversation_stats.total_rounds}</div>
                      <div className="conv-stat-label">总轮次</div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="conv-stat-main">
                      <div className="conv-stat-number">{detail.analysis_conversation_stats.avg_rounds_per_conv.toFixed(1)}</div>
                      <div className="conv-stat-label">平均轮次/分析</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="conv-stats-timeline">
                    <div className="timeline-item">
                      <span className="timeline-label">今日</span>
                      <span className="timeline-value">{detail.analysis_conversation_stats.today_rounds} 轮</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="timeline-item">
                      <span className="timeline-label">本周</span>
                      <span className="timeline-value">{detail.analysis_conversation_stats.week_rounds} 轮</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="timeline-item">
                      <span className="timeline-label">本月</span>
                      <span className="timeline-value">{detail.analysis_conversation_stats.month_rounds} 轮</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  {detail.analysis_conversation_stats.last_conv_at && (
                    <div className="conv-last-activity">
                      最后分析: {formatDate(detail.analysis_conversation_stats.last_conv_at)}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          ) : (
            <div className="drawer-error">
              <p>加载失败，请重试</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default UserDetailDrawer;
