import React, { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { LineChart, Line, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, Legend, ResponsiveContainer } from 'recharts';
import { adminAPI } from '../services/api';
import './UserStatisticsChart.css';

const UserStatisticsChart = () => {
  const [data, setData] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [showFilter, setShowFilter] = useState(false);
  
  // 时间范围和粒度
  const [startTime, setStartTime] = useState(() => {
    const date = new Date();
    date.setDate(date.getDate() - 29);
    date.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    return formatDateTimeLocal(date);
  });
  const [endTime, setEndTime] = useState(() => {
    const date = new Date();
    date.setHours(23, 59, 59, 0);
    return formatDateTimeLocal(date);
  });
  const [granularity, setGranularity] = useState('day');

  // 格式化日期为 datetime-local 输入格式
  function formatDateTimeLocal(date) {
    const year = date.getFullYear();
    const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    const hours = String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
    const minutes = String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
    const seconds = String(date.getSeconds()).padStart(2, '0');
    return `${year}-${month}-${day}T${hours}:${minutes}:${seconds}`;
  }

  // 格式化日期为 API 格式
  function formatDateTimeAPI(dateTimeLocal) {
    return dateTimeLocal.replace('T', ' ');
  }

  const fetchData = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const params = {
        start_time: formatDateTimeAPI(startTime),
        end_time: formatDateTimeAPI(endTime),
        granularity: granularity
      };
      const response = await adminAPI.getUserStatisticsChart(params);
      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        setData(response.data.data.statistics || []);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch user statistics:', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [startTime, endTime, granularity]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchData();
  }, [fetchData]);

  const handleSearch = () => {
    fetchData();
    setShowFilter(false);
  };

  const handleCancel = () => {
    setShowFilter(false);
  };

  // 快捷时间选择
  const setQuickRange = (type) => {
    const now = new Date();
    let start = new Date();
    let gran = 'day';

    switch (type) {
      case 'today':
        start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
        gran = 'hour';
        break;
      case 'yesterday':
        start.setDate(start.getDate() - 1);
        start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
        now.setDate(now.getDate() - 1);
        now.setHours(23, 59, 59, 0);
        gran = 'hour';
        break;
      case 'week':
        start.setDate(start.getDate() - 6);
        start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
        gran = 'day';
        break;
      case 'month':
        start.setDate(start.getDate() - 29);
        start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
        gran = 'day';
        break;
      case 'quarter':
        start.setMonth(start.getMonth() - 3);
        start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
        gran = 'week';
        break;
      case 'year':
        start.setFullYear(start.getFullYear() - 1);
        start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
        gran = 'month';
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }

    setStartTime(formatDateTimeLocal(start));
    setEndTime(formatDateTimeLocal(now));
    setGranularity(gran);
  };

  const granularityOptions = [
    { value: 'hour', label: '小时' },
    { value: 'day', label: '天' },
    { value: 'week', label: '周' },
    { value: 'month', label: '月' }
  ];

  const quickRangeOptions = [
    { value: 'today', label: '今日' },
    { value: 'yesterday', label: '昨日' },
    { value: 'week', label: '近7天' },
    { value: 'month', label: '近30天' },
    { value: 'quarter', label: '近3月' },
    { value: 'year', label: '近1年' }
  ];

  return (
    <div className="chart-wrapper">
      {/* 搜索条件按钮 */}
      <div className="chart-toolbar">
        <button 
          className="filter-trigger-btn"
          onClick={() => setShowFilter(true)}
        >
          <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
            <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/>
            <path d="M21 21l-4.35-4.35"/>
          </svg>
          搜索条件
        </button>
        <div className="current-range">
          {startTime.replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 16)} ~ {endTime.replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 16)}
          <span className="granularity-tag">{granularityOptions.find(g => g.value === granularity)?.label}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 搜索条件弹窗 */}
      {showFilter && (
        <div className="filter-modal-overlay" onClick={handleCancel}>
          <div className="filter-modal" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div className="filter-modal-header">
              <h4>搜索条件</h4>
              <button className="filter-modal-close" onClick={handleCancel}>×</button>
            </div>
            <div className="filter-modal-body">
              {/* 快捷选择 */}
              <div className="filter-section">
                <label>快捷选择</label>
                <div className="quick-range-btns">
                  {quickRangeOptions.map(opt => (
                    <button
                      key={opt.value}
                      className="quick-range-btn"
                      onClick={() => setQuickRange(opt.value)}
                    >
                      {opt.label}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="filter-section">
                <label>起始时间</label>
                <input
                  type="datetime-local"
                  value={startTime}
                  onChange={e => setStartTime(e.target.value)}
                  className="filter-input"
                  step="1"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="filter-section">
                <label>结束时间</label>
                <input
                  type="datetime-local"
                  value={endTime}
                  onChange={e => setEndTime(e.target.value)}
                  className="filter-input"
                  step="1"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="filter-section">
                <label>时间粒度</label>
                <select
                  value={granularity}
                  onChange={e => setGranularity(e.target.value)}
                  className="filter-select"
                >
                  {granularityOptions.map(opt => (
                    <option key={opt.value} value={opt.value}>{opt.label}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="filter-modal-footer">
              <button className="filter-btn filter-btn-cancel" onClick={handleCancel}>取消</button>
              <button className="filter-btn filter-btn-confirm" onClick={handleSearch}>确定</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 图表区域 */}
      {loading ? (
        <div className="chart-loading">
          <div className="loading-spinner"></div>
          <p>加载中...</p>
        </div>
      ) : !data || data.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="chart-no-data">
          <p>暂无数据</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={300}>
          <LineChart data={data} margin={{ top: 10, right: 20, left: 0, bottom: 5 }}>
            <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#e0e0e0" vertical={false} />
            <XAxis
              dataKey="label"
              stroke="#999"
              tick={{ fontSize: 11 }}
              tickLine={false}
              axisLine={{ stroke: '#e0e0e0' }}
              interval="preserveStartEnd"
              angle={data.length > 15 ? -45 : 0}
              textAnchor={data.length > 15 ? "end" : "middle"}
              height={data.length > 15 ? 60 : 30}
            />
            <YAxis
              stroke="#999"
              tick={{ fontSize: 11 }}
              tickLine={false}
              axisLine={false}
              allowDecimals={false}
              width={35}
            />
            <Tooltip
              contentStyle={{
                backgroundColor: '#1f2937',
                border: '1px solid #374151',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                color: '#fff'
              }}
              labelStyle={{ color: '#9ca3af' }}
              formatter={(value) => [value, '新注册用户']}
              labelFormatter={(label, payload) => {
                if (payload && payload[0]) {
                  return payload[0].payload.time || label;
                }
                return label;
              }}
            />
            <Legend
              wrapperStyle={{ fontSize: '13px', paddingTop: '10px' }}
              iconType="line"
            />
            <Line
              type="monotone"
              dataKey="new_users"
              stroke="#667eea"
              strokeWidth={2}
              name="新注册用户"
              dot={false}
              activeDot={{ r: 4, strokeWidth: 0 }}
            />
          </LineChart>
        </ResponsiveContainer>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default UserStatisticsChart;

// ========== 文件: frontend-admin/src/components/VerifyPasswordModal.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { adminAPI } from '../services/api';
import { showToast } from './Toast';
import './VerifyPasswordModal.css';

/**
 * 二次验证密码模态框
 * 用于查看敏感信息前验证管理员身份
 */
const VerifyPasswordModal = ({ isOpen, onClose, onVerified }) => {
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (!password.trim()) {
      showToast('请输入密码', 'error');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      // 验证密码（使用修改密码接口，传入相同的旧密码和新密码作为验证）
      const response = await adminAPI.verifyPassword(password);

      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        showToast('验证成功', 'success');
        setPassword('');
        onVerified();
        onClose();
      } else {
        showToast(response.data.message || '密码错误', 'error');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(err.response?.data?.message || '验证失败', 'error');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleClose = () => {
    setPassword('');
    onClose();
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={handleClose}>
      <div className="verify-password-modal" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="modal-header">
          <div className="modal-icon-warning">
            <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <path d="M12 1v6m0 6v6m0 0h.01M12 21a9 9 0 110-18 9 9 0 010 18z"/>
              <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/>
              <path d="M12 8v4m0 4h.01"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <h3>安全验证</h3>
          <p>查看敏感信息需要验证您的管理员密码</p>
          <button onClick={handleClose} className="modal-close">
            <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
              <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M4.293 4.293a1 1 0 011.414 0L10 8.586l4.293-4.293a1 1 0 111.414 1.414L11.414 10l4.293 4.293a1 1 0 01-1.414 1.414L10 11.414l-4.293 4.293a1 1 0 01-1.414-1.414L8.586 10 4.293 5.707a1 1 0 010-1.414z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
            </svg>
          </button>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="modal-body">
          <div className="form-group">
            <label htmlFor="verify-password">管理员密码</label>
            <input
              type="password"
              id="verify-password"
              className="input"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="请输入管理员密码"
              autoFocus
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="modal-actions">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleClose}
              className="btn btn-secondary"
              disabled={loading}
            >
              取消
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="btn btn-primary"
              disabled={loading}
            >
              {loading ? (
                <>
                  <span className="spinner"></span>
                  <span style={{ marginLeft: '0.5rem' }}>验证中...</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                '验证并查看'
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default VerifyPasswordModal;

import React from 'react';

// ========== 文件: frontend-admin/src/pages/CouponBatchManagement.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import api from '../services/api';
import './CouponsBase.css';

const CouponBatchManagement = () => {
  const [batches, setBatches] = useState([]);
  const [templates, setTemplates] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [showCreateModal, setShowCreateModal] = useState(false);
  const [showDetailsModal, setShowDetailsModal] = useState(false);
  const [selectedBatch, setSelectedBatch] = useState(null);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    batch_code: '',
    template_id: '',
    name: '',
    description: '',
    target_type: 'all',
    target_users: '',
    total_quantity: 100
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchBatches();
    fetchTemplates();
  }, []);

  const fetchBatches = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await api.get('/admin/coupon-batches');
      setBatches(response.data.data.batches || []);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch batches:', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const fetchTemplates = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await api.get('/admin/coupon-templates?page_size=100');
      setTemplates(response.data.data.templates || []);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch templates:', error);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateBatch = async () => {
    try {
      // Parse target users if it's a specific_users type
      const payload = { ...formData };
      if (formData.target_type === 'specific_users' && formData.target_users) {
        payload.target_users = formData.target_users
          .split(',')
          .map(id => parseInt(id.trim()))
          .filter(id => !isNaN(id));
      } else {
        delete payload.target_users;
      }

      // Convert template_id to number
      payload.template_id = parseInt(payload.template_id);
      payload.total_quantity = parseInt(payload.total_quantity);

      await api.post('/admin/coupon-batches', payload);
      setShowCreateModal(false);
      resetForm();
      fetchBatches();
      alert('批次创建成功！');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to create batch:', error);
      alert('创建失败: ' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
    }
  };

  const handleExecuteBatch = async (batchId) => {
    if (!window.confirm('确定要执行此批次发放吗？此操作不可撤销！')) return;

    try {
      await api.post(`/admin/coupon-batches/${batchId}/execute`);
      fetchBatches();
      alert('批次执行成功！');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to execute batch:', error);
      alert('执行失败: ' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
    }
  };

  const handleCancelBatch = async (batchId) => {
    if (!window.confirm('确定要取消此批次吗？')) return;

    try {
      await api.post(`/admin/coupon-batches/${batchId}/cancel`);
      fetchBatches();
      alert('批次已取消');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to cancel batch:', error);
      alert('取消失败: ' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
    }
  };

  const viewBatchDetails = async (batchId) => {
    try {
      const response = await api.get(`/admin/coupon-batches/${batchId}`);
      setSelectedBatch(response.data.data);
      setShowDetailsModal(true);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch batch details:', error);
    }
  };

  const resetForm = () => {
    setFormData({
      batch_code: '',
      template_id: '',
      name: '',
      description: '',
      target_type: 'all',
      target_users: '',
      total_quantity: 100
    });
  };

  const getStatusBadgeClass = (status) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'draft':
        return 'badge-secondary';
      case 'processing':
        return 'badge-warning';
      case 'completed':
        return 'badge-success';
      case 'cancelled':
        return 'badge-danger';
      default:
        return 'badge-secondary';
    }
  };

  const getTargetTypeDisplay = (type) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'all':
        return '全部用户';
      case 'new_users':
        return '新用户';
      case 'paid_users':
        return '付费用户';
      case 'specific_users':
        return '指定用户';
      case 'user_group':
        return '用户组';
      default:
        return type;
    }
  };

  const formatDate = (dateString) => {
    if (!dateString) return '-';
    return new Date(dateString).toLocaleString('zh-CN');
  };

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="loading">加载中...</div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="batch-management">
      <div className="page-header">
        <h2>批量发放管理</h2>
        <button
          className="btn btn-primary"
          onClick={() => setShowCreateModal(true)}
        >
          创建批次
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="batches-table">
        <table>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>批次编号</th>
              <th>批次名称</th>
              <th>折扣券模板</th>
              <th>目标类型</th>
              <th>计划发放</th>
              <th>已发放</th>
              <th>状态</th>
              <th>创建时间</th>
              <th>操作</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {batches.map(batch => (
              <tr key={batch.id}>
                <td className="code">{batch.batch_code}</td>
                <td>
                  <div className="batch-name">{batch.name}</div>
                  {batch.description && (
                    <div className="batch-desc">{batch.description}</div>
                  )}
                </td>
                <td>{batch.template?.name || '-'}</td>
                <td>{getTargetTypeDisplay(batch.target_type)}</td>
                <td>{batch.total_quantity}</td>
                <td>{batch.distributed_quantity || 0}</td>
                <td>
                  <span className={`badge ${getStatusBadgeClass(batch.status)}`}>
                    {batch.status}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td>{formatDate(batch.created_at)}</td>
                <td className="actions">
                  <button
                    className="btn btn-sm btn-secondary"
                    onClick={() => viewBatchDetails(batch.id)}
                  >
                    详情
                  </button>
                  {batch.status === 'draft' && (
                    <>
                      <button
                        className="btn btn-sm btn-success"
                        onClick={() => handleExecuteBatch(batch.id)}
                      >
                        执行
                      </button>
                      <button
                        className="btn btn-sm btn-danger"
                        onClick={() => handleCancelBatch(batch.id)}
                      >
                        取消
                      </button>
                    </>
                  )}
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {/* Create Modal */}
      {showCreateModal && (
        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => setShowCreateModal(false)}>
          <div className="modal-content" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div className="modal-header">
              <h3>创建批量发放批次</h3>
              <button className="close-btn" onClick={() => setShowCreateModal(false)}>×</button>
            </div>
            <div className="modal-body">
              <div className="form-group">
                <label>批次编号 *</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.batch_code}
                  onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, batch_code: e.target.value})}
                  placeholder="如: BATCH20250101"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="form-group">
                <label>折扣券模板 *</label>
                <select
                  value={formData.template_id}
                  onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, template_id: e.target.value})}
                >
                  <option value="">请选择模板</option>
                  {templates.filter(t => t.status === 'active').map(template => (
                    <option key={template.id} value={template.id}>
                      {template.name} ({template.code})
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div className="form-group">
                <label>批次名称 *</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.name}
                  onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, name: e.target.value})}
                  placeholder="批次名称"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="form-group">
                <label>描述</label>
                <textarea
                  value={formData.description}
                  onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, description: e.target.value})}
                  placeholder="批次描述"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="form-row">
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label>目标类型 *</label>
                  <select
                    value={formData.target_type}
                    onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, target_type: e.target.value})}
                  >
                    <option value="all">全部用户</option>
                    <option value="new_users">新用户</option>
                    <option value="paid_users">付费用户</option>
                    <option value="specific_users">指定用户</option>
                    <option value="user_group">用户组</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label>发放数量 *</label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    value={formData.total_quantity}
                    onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, total_quantity: e.target.value})}
                    min="1"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              {formData.target_type === 'specific_users' && (
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label>用户ID列表</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={formData.target_users}
                    onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, target_users: e.target.value})}
                    placeholder="用逗号分隔，如: 1, 2, 3"
                  />
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="modal-footer">
              <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={() => setShowCreateModal(false)}>
                取消
              </button>
              <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={handleCreateBatch}>
                创建
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Details Modal */}
      {showDetailsModal && selectedBatch && (
        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => setShowDetailsModal(false)}>
          <div className="modal-content" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div className="modal-header">
              <h3>批次详情</h3>
              <button className="close-btn" onClick={() => setShowDetailsModal(false)}>×</button>
            </div>
            <div className="modal-body">
              <div className="detail-row">
                <span className="detail-label">批次编号:</span>
                <span className="detail-value">{selectedBatch.batch_code}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="detail-row">
                <span className="detail-label">批次名称:</span>
                <span className="detail-value">{selectedBatch.name}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="detail-row">
                <span className="detail-label">描述:</span>
                <span className="detail-value">{selectedBatch.description || '-'}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="detail-row">
                <span className="detail-label">折扣券模板:</span>
                <span className="detail-value">{selectedBatch.template?.name}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="detail-row">
                <span className="detail-label">目标类型:</span>
                <span className="detail-value">{getTargetTypeDisplay(selectedBatch.target_type)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="detail-row">
                <span className="detail-label">计划发放数量:</span>
                <span className="detail-value">{selectedBatch.total_quantity}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="detail-row">
                <span className="detail-label">已发放数量:</span>
                <span className="detail-value">{selectedBatch.distributed_quantity || 0}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="detail-row">
                <span className="detail-label">状态:</span>
                <span className={`badge ${getStatusBadgeClass(selectedBatch.status)}`}>
                  {selectedBatch.status}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="detail-row">
                <span className="detail-label">创建时间:</span>
                <span className="detail-value">{formatDate(selectedBatch.created_at)}</span>
              </div>
              {selectedBatch.started_at && (
                <div className="detail-row">
                  <span className="detail-label">开始时间:</span>
                  <span className="detail-value">{formatDate(selectedBatch.started_at)}</span>
                </div>
              )}
              {selectedBatch.completed_at && (
                <div className="detail-row">
                  <span className="detail-label">完成时间:</span>
                  <span className="detail-value">{formatDate(selectedBatch.completed_at)}</span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="modal-footer">
              <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={() => setShowDetailsModal(false)}>
                关闭
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default CouponBatchManagement;

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import api from '../services/api';
import './CouponsBase.css';

// 数字输入组件
const NumberInput = ({ value, onChange, min = 0, max, step = 1, unit, placeholder }) => {
  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = React.useState(value?.toString() || '');
  const [isFocused, setIsFocused] = React.useState(false);

  // 同步外部 value 变化
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!isFocused) {
      setInputValue(value?.toString() || '');
    }
  }, [value, isFocused]);

  const handleDecrease = () => {
    const currentValue = parseFloat(inputValue) || 0;
    const newValue = Math.max(min, currentValue - step);
    setInputValue(newValue.toString());
    onChange(newValue);
  };

  const handleIncrease = () => {
    const currentValue = parseFloat(inputValue) || 0;
    let newValue = currentValue + step;
    if (max !== undefined) {
      newValue = Math.min(max, newValue);
    }
    setInputValue(newValue.toString());
    onChange(newValue);
  };

  const handleInputChange = (e) => {
    const val = e.target.value;
    // 允许空值和正在输入的状态
    setInputValue(val);
  };

  const handleFocus = (e) => {
    setIsFocused(true);
    // 如果当前值是0，选中全部以便覆盖输入
    if (value === 0 || inputValue === '0') {
      e.target.select();
    }
  };

  const handleBlur = () => {
    setIsFocused(false);
    // 失焦时验证并提交值
    let finalValue = parseFloat(inputValue);
    if (isNaN(finalValue) || inputValue === '') {
      finalValue = min;
    }
    if (max !== undefined) {
      finalValue = Math.min(max, finalValue);
    }
    finalValue = Math.max(min, finalValue);
    setInputValue(finalValue.toString());
    onChange(finalValue);
  };

  const displayValue = isFocused ? inputValue : (value?.toString() || '');

  return (
    <div className="number-input-wrapper">
      <button 
        type="button"
        className="number-btn decrease" 
        onClick={handleDecrease}
        disabled={value <= min}
      >
        −
      </button>
      <input
        type="text"
        inputMode="decimal"
        value={displayValue}
        onChange={handleInputChange}
        onFocus={handleFocus}
        onBlur={handleBlur}
        placeholder={placeholder || '输入数值'}
      />
      {unit && <span className="number-input-unit">{unit}</span>}
      <button 
        type="button"
        className="number-btn increase" 
        onClick={handleIncrease}
        disabled={max !== undefined && value >= max}
      >
        +
      </button>
    </div>
  );
};

const CouponManagement = () => {
  const [templates, setTemplates] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [showCreateModal, setShowCreateModal] = useState(false);
  const [showEditModal, setShowEditModal] = useState(false);
  const [selectedTemplate, setSelectedTemplate] = useState(null);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    code: '',
    name: '',
    description: '',
    type: 'percentage',
    discount_value: 0,
    min_purchase_amount: 0,
    distribution_type: 'manual',
    valid_days: 30,
    max_usage_per_user: 1,
    first_purchase_only: false,
    is_invite_coupon: false
  });

  // 折扣类型配置
  const discountTypes = [
    {
      value: 'percentage',
      label: '百分比折扣',
      icon: '%',
      description: '按订单金额的百分比减免',
      valueLabel: '折扣比例',
      valueUnit: '%',
      valuePlaceholder: '例如：10 表示打9折',
      valueHelp: '输入1-100的数字，如10表示减免10%（即打9折）',
      exampleCalc: (value, amount) => `订单 ¥${amount} × ${value}% = 优惠 ¥${(amount * value / 100).toFixed(2)}，实付 ¥${(amount - amount * value / 100).toFixed(2)}`
    },
    {
      value: 'fixed',
      label: '固定价格',
      icon: '¥',
      description: '用户只需支付固定金额，无论原价多少',
      valueLabel: '固定支付金额',
      valueUnit: '元',
      valuePlaceholder: '例如：99 表示只需支付99元',
      valueHelp: '用户使用此券后只需支付此固定金额',
      exampleCalc: (value, amount) => value >= amount 
        ? `订单 ¥${amount}，固定价 ¥${value} ≥ 原价，无优惠`
        : `订单 ¥${amount}，使用后只需支付 ¥${value}，优惠 ¥${(amount - value).toFixed(2)}`
    },
    {
      value: 'price_off',
      label: '立减金额',
      icon: '-¥',
      description: '直接减免固定金额',
      valueLabel: '减免金额',
      valueUnit: '元',
      valuePlaceholder: '例如：20 表示立减20元',
      valueHelp: '订单金额直接减去此数值',
      exampleCalc: (value, amount) => `订单 ¥${amount} - ¥${value} = 实付 ¥${Math.max(0, amount - value).toFixed(2)}`
    }
  ];

  // 发放方式配置
  const distributionTypes = [
    {
      value: 'manual',
      label: '手动发放',
      icon: 'M',
      description: '管理员手动选择用户发放'
    },
    {
      value: 'auto_register',
      label: '注册自动发放',
      icon: 'R',
      description: '新用户注册时自动获得'
    },
    {
      value: 'auto_invite',
      label: '邀请自动发放',
      icon: 'I',
      description: '成功邀请新用户后自动获得'
    }
  ];

  // 获取当前折扣类型配置
  const getCurrentDiscountType = () => {
    return discountTypes.find(t => t.value === formData.type) || discountTypes[0];
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchTemplates();
  }, []);

  const fetchTemplates = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await api.get('/admin/coupon-templates');
      setTemplates(response.data.data.templates || []);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch templates:', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateTemplate = async () => {
    try {
      await api.post('/admin/coupon-templates', formData);
      setShowCreateModal(false);
      resetForm();
      fetchTemplates();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to create template:', error);
      alert('创建失败: ' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateTemplate = async () => {
    try {
      await api.put(`/admin/coupon-templates/${selectedTemplate.id}`, formData);
      setShowEditModal(false);
      resetForm();
      fetchTemplates();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to update template:', error);
      alert('更新失败: ' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
    }
  };

  const [deleteModalVisible, setDeleteModalVisible] = useState(false);
  const [deleteTargetId, setDeleteTargetId] = useState(null);
  const [deleteError, setDeleteError] = useState('');
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);
  
  // 点击删除按钮，显示确认弹窗
  const handleDeleteClick = (id) => {
    setDeleteTargetId(id);
    setDeleteError('');
    setDeleteModalVisible(true);
  };

  // 确认删除
  const handleConfirmDelete = async () => {
    if (deleting || !deleteTargetId) return;
    
    setDeleting(true);
    setDeleteError('');
    
    try {
      await api.delete(`/admin/coupon-templates/${deleteTargetId}`);
      setDeleteModalVisible(false);
      setDeleteTargetId(null);
      fetchTemplates();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to delete template:', error);
      const errorMsg = error.response?.data?.message || error.message;
      setDeleteError(errorMsg);
    } finally {
      setDeleting(false);
    }
  };

  // 取消删除
  const handleCancelDelete = () => {
    setDeleteModalVisible(false);
    setDeleteTargetId(null);
    setDeleteError('');
  };

  const handleActivateTemplate = async (id) => {
    try {
      await api.post(`/admin/coupon-templates/${id}/activate`);
      fetchTemplates();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to activate template:', error);
    }
  };

  const handlePauseTemplate = async (id) => {
    try {
      await api.post(`/admin/coupon-templates/${id}/pause`);
      fetchTemplates();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to pause template:', error);
    }
  };

  const resetForm = () => {
    setFormData({
      code: '',
      name: '',
      description: '',
      type: 'percentage',
      discount_value: 0,
      min_purchase_amount: 0,
      distribution_type: 'manual',
      valid_days: 30,
      max_usage_per_user: 1,
      first_purchase_only: false,
      is_invite_coupon: false
    });
    setSelectedTemplate(null);
  };

  const openEditModal = (template) => {
    setSelectedTemplate(template);
    setFormData({
      name: template.name,
      description: template.description,
      min_purchase_amount: template.min_purchase_amount,
      valid_days: template.valid_days,
      max_usage_per_user: template.max_usage_per_user,
      first_purchase_only: template.first_purchase_only,
      status: template.status
    });
    setShowEditModal(true);
  };

  const getDiscountDisplay = (type, value) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'percentage':
        return `${value}%`;
      case 'fixed':
      case 'price_off':
        return `¥${value}`;
      default:
        return value;
    }
  };

  const getTypeDisplay = (type) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'percentage':
        return '百分比折扣';
      case 'fixed':
        return '固定价格';
      case 'price_off':
        return '立减金额';
      default:
        return type;
    }
  };

  const getDistributionDisplay = (type) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'manual':
        return '手动发放';
      case 'auto_register':
        return '注册自动';
      case 'auto_invite':
        return '邀请自动';
      case 'batch':
        return '批量发放';
      case 'targeted':
        return '定向发放';
      default:
        return type;
    }
  };

  const getStatusBadgeClass = (status) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'active':
        return 'badge-success';
      case 'paused':
        return 'badge-warning';
      case 'expired':
        return 'badge-danger';
      default:
        return 'badge-secondary';
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="loading">加载中...</div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="coupon-management">
      <div className="page-header">
        <h2>折扣券管理</h2>
        <button
          className="btn btn-primary"
          onClick={() => setShowCreateModal(true)}
        >
          创建折扣券
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="templates-table">
        <table>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>编码</th>
              <th>名称</th>
              <th>类型</th>
              <th>折扣</th>
              <th>最低消费</th>
              <th>发放方式</th>
              <th>有效天数</th>
              <th>状态</th>
              <th>操作</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {templates.map(template => (
              <tr key={template.id}>
                <td className="code">{template.code}</td>
                <td>
                  <div className="template-name">{template.name}</div>
                  <div className="template-desc">{template.description}</div>
                </td>
                <td>{getTypeDisplay(template.type)}</td>
                <td className="discount">
                  {getDiscountDisplay(template.type, template.discount_value)}
                </td>
                <td>¥{template.min_purchase_amount}</td>
                <td>{getDistributionDisplay(template.distribution_type)}</td>
                <td>{template.valid_days}天</td>
                <td>
                  <span className={`badge ${getStatusBadgeClass(template.status)}`}>
                    {template.status}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td className="actions">
                  <button
                    className="btn btn-sm btn-secondary"
                    onClick={() => openEditModal(template)}
                  >
                    编辑
                  </button>
                  {template.status === 'active' ? (
                    <button
                      className="btn btn-sm btn-warning"
                      onClick={() => handlePauseTemplate(template.id)}
                    >
                      暂停
                    </button>
                  ) : (
                    <button
                      className="btn btn-sm btn-success"
                      onClick={() => handleActivateTemplate(template.id)}
                    >
                      激活
                    </button>
                  )}
                  <button
                    className="btn btn-sm btn-danger"
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      handleDeleteClick(template.id);
                    }}
                  >
                    删除
                  </button>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {/* Create Modal */}
      {showCreateModal && (

          <div className="modal-content modal-large" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div className="modal-header">
              <h3>创建折扣券</h3>
              <button className="close-btn" onClick={() => setShowCreateModal(false)}>×</button>
            </div>
            <div className="modal-body">
              {/* 基本信息 */}
              <div className="form-section">
                <div className="form-section-title">基本信息</div>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label>折扣券名称 *</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={formData.name}
                    onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, name: e.target.value})}
                    placeholder="例如：新用户专享8折券"
                  />
                  <div className="form-hint">折扣券编码将根据发放方式自动生成</div>
                </div>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label>描述</label>
                  <textarea
                    value={formData.description}
                    onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, description: e.target.value})}
                    placeholder="简要描述折扣券的用途和优惠内容"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* 折扣类型 */}
              <div className="form-section">
                <div className="form-section-title">折扣类型 *</div>
                <div className="radio-card-group">
                  {discountTypes.map(type => (
                    <div 
                      key={type.value}
                      className={`radio-card ${formData.type === type.value ? 'active' : ''}`}
                      onClick={() => setFormData({...formData, type: type.value})}
                    >
                      <div className="radio-card-icon">{type.icon}</div>
                      <div className="radio-card-content">
                        <div className="radio-card-label">{type.label}</div>

                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* 折扣值 */}
              <div className="form-section">

                  step={formData.type === 'percentage' ? 5 : 10}
                  unit={getCurrentDiscountType().valueUnit}
                  placeholder={getCurrentDiscountType().valuePlaceholder}
                />
                {formData.discount_value > 0 && (
                  <div className="calc-preview">
                    <div className="calc-preview-title">计算示例</div>
                    <div className="calc-preview-content">
                      {getCurrentDiscountType().exampleCalc(formData.discount_value, 100)}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

              <div className="form-section">
                <div className="form-section-title">
                  使用门槛
                  <span className="form-section-hint">订单金额需达到此金额才能使用，设为0表示无门槛</span>
                </div>
                <NumberInput
                  value={formData.min_purchase_amount}
                  onChange={(val) => setFormData({...formData, min_purchase_amount: val})}
                  min={0}
                  step={10}
                  unit="元"
                />
                {formData.min_purchase_amount > 0 && (
                  <div className="form-hint" style={{marginTop: '8px'}}>
                    订单满 ¥{formData.min_purchase_amount} 可用
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* 发放方式 */}
              <div className="form-section">
                <div className="form-section-title">发放方式 *</div>
                <div className="radio-card-group">
                  {distributionTypes.map(type => (
                    <div 
                      key={type.value}
                      className={`radio-card ${formData.distribution_type === type.value ? 'active' : ''}`}

                        distribution_type: type.value,
                        is_invite_coupon: type.value === 'auto_invite'

                      <div className="radio-card-content">
                        <div className="radio-card-label">{type.label}</div>
                        <div className="radio-card-desc">{type.description}</div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="radio-card-check">
                        {formData.distribution_type === type.value && <span>✓</span>}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* 其他设置 */}

                  <div className="form-group">

                    <NumberInput
                      value={formData.valid_days}
                      onChange={(val) => setFormData({...formData, valid_days: val})}
                      min={1}
                      step={7}

                    />
                    <div className="form-hint">领取后的有效使用期限</div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="form-group">
                    <label>每用户可用次数</label>
                    <NumberInput
                      value={formData.max_usage_per_user}
                      onChange={(val) => setFormData({...formData, max_usage_per_user: val})}
                      min={1}
                      max={10}
                      step={1}
                      unit="次"
                    />
                    <div className="form-hint">每个用户最多可使用次数</div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <div className="checkbox-styled">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      id="first_purchase_only"

                      <span className="checkbox-box"></span>
                      <div className="checkbox-content">
                        <span className="checkbox-text">仅限首次购买</span>
                        <span className="checkbox-hint">勾选后，仅从未购买过的用户可使用此券</span>
                      </div>
                    </label>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="modal-footer">
              <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={() => setShowCreateModal(false)}>
                取消
              </button>
              <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={handleCreateTemplate}>
                创建折扣券
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Edit Modal */}
      {showEditModal && (
        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => setShowEditModal(false)}>
          <div className="modal-content" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div className="modal-header">
              <h3>编辑折扣券</h3>
              <button className="close-btn" onClick={() => setShowEditModal(false)}>×</button>
            </div>
            <div className="modal-body">
              <div className="form-section">
                <div className="form-section-title">基本信息</div>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label>折扣券名称</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={formData.name}
                    onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, name: e.target.value})}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label>描述</label>
                  <textarea
                    value={formData.description}
                    onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, description: e.target.value})}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="form-section">
                <div className="form-section-title">使用规则</div>
                <div className="form-row">
                  <div className="form-group">
                    <label>使用门槛</label>
                    <NumberInput
                      value={formData.min_purchase_amount}
                      onChange={(val) => setFormData({...formData, min_purchase_amount: val})}
                      min={0}
                      step={10}
                      unit="元"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div className="form-group">
                    <label>有效天数</label>
                    <NumberInput
                      value={formData.valid_days}
                      onChange={(val) => setFormData({...formData, valid_days: val})}
                      min={1}
                      step={7}
                      unit="天"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label>每用户可用次数</label>
                  <div style={{maxWidth: '200px'}}>
                    <NumberInput
                      value={formData.max_usage_per_user}
                      onChange={(val) => setFormData({...formData, max_usage_per_user: val})}
                      min={1}
                      max={10}
                      step={1}
                      unit="次"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="form-group">
                  <div className="checkbox-styled">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      id="edit_first_purchase_only"
                      checked={formData.first_purchase_only}
                      onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, first_purchase_only: e.target.checked})}
                    />
                    <label htmlFor="edit_first_purchase_only">
                      <span className="checkbox-box"></span>
                      <div className="checkbox-content">
                        <span className="checkbox-text">仅限首次购买</span>
                        <span className="checkbox-hint">勾选后，仅从未购买过的用户可使用此券</span>
                      </div>
                    </label>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="modal-footer">
              <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={() => setShowEditModal(false)}>
                取消
              </button>
              <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={handleUpdateTemplate}>
                保存修改
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 删除确认弹窗 */}
      {deleteModalVisible && (
        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={handleCancelDelete}>
          <div className="modal-content delete-modal" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div className="modal-header">
              <h3>确认删除</h3>
              <button className="modal-close" onClick={handleCancelDelete}>&times;</button>
            </div>
            <div className="modal-body">
              <p className="delete-warning">确定要删除这个折扣券吗？</p>
              <p className="delete-hint">注意：已发放给用户或有批次记录的折扣券无法删除。</p>
              {deleteError && (
                <div className="delete-error">
                  {deleteError}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="modal-footer">
              <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={handleCancelDelete}>
                取消
              </button>
              <button 
                className="btn btn-danger" 
                onClick={handleConfirmDelete}
                disabled={deleting}
              >
                {deleting ? '删除中...' : '确认删除'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default CouponManagement;

  const [stats, setStats] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadStatistics();
    // 每30秒刷新一次统计数据
    const interval = setInterval(loadStatistics, 30000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  const loadStatistics = async () => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      const response = await adminAPI.getDashboardStatistics();
      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        setStats(response.data.data);
      } else {
        setError(response.data.message || '加载统计数据失败');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load dashboard statistics:', err);
      setError('加载统计数据失败');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const formatCurrency = (value) => {
    return `¥${value.toFixed(2)}`;
  };

  const formatNumber = (value) => {
    if (value >= 10000) {
      return `${(value / 10000).toFixed(1)}万`;
    }
    return value.toString();
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="dashboard-home">
        <div className="loading-skeleton">

        </div>
      </div>

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="dashboard-home">

          </svg>
          <p>{error}</p>

        </div>

            </svg>

              <span className="stat-badge">30天 +{stats.new_users_30d}</span>

              <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M10 18a8 8 0 100-16 8 8 0 000 16zm3.707-9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414-1.414L9 10.586 7.707 9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414 1.414l2 2a1 1 0 001.414 0l4-4z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
            </svg>
          </div>

            <p className="stat-label">在线用户</p>
            <h3 className="stat-value">{stats.online_users}</h3>
            <p className="stat-hint">30天活跃: {formatNumber(stats.active_users_30d)}</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 总收入 */}
        <div className="stat-card highlight-card">
          <div className="stat-icon" style={{ backgroundColor: '#fef3c7' }}>

              />

        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
