/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { adminAPI } from '../services/api';
import './DefaultBusinessData.css';

const DefaultBusinessData = () => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('dimensions');
  const [dimensions, setDimensions] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [showModal, setShowModal] = useState(false);
  const [editingDimension, setEditingDimension] = useState(null);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    sortOrder: 0,
    isActive: true
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeTab === 'dimensions') {
      loadDimensions();
    }
  }, [activeTab]);

  const loadDimensions = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await adminAPI.getAnalysisDimensions();
      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
        setDimensions(response.data.data.dimensions || []);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to load dimensions:', error);
      alert('加载分析维度失败');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleEdit = (dimension) => {
    setEditingDimension(dimension);
    setFormData({
      name: dimension.name,
      description: dimension.description,
      sortOrder: dimension.sortOrder,
      isActive: dimension.isActive
    });
    setShowModal(true);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    try {
      const response = await adminAPI.updateAnalysisDimension(editingDimension.id, formData);
      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        alert('分析维度更新成功');
        setShowModal(false);
        loadDimensions();
      } else {
        alert('更新失败: ' + response.data.message);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to update dimension:', error);
      alert('更新失败: ' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
    }
  };

  const tabs = [
    { key: 'dimensions', label: '分析维度', icon: (
      <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
        <rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2" ry="2"/>
        <line x1="3" y1="9" x2="21" y2="9"/>
        <line x1="9" y1="21" x2="9" y2="9"/>
      </svg>
    )},
    // 可以在这里添加更多的默认业务数据 tab
  ];

  return (
    <div className="default-business-data-page">
      <div className="page-header">
        <h1>默认业务数据</h1>
        <p className="page-description">管理系统默认的业务配置数据</p>
      </div>

      {/* Tab 导航 */}
      <div className="tabs-container">
        <div className="tabs-nav">
          {tabs.map(tab => (
            <button
              key={tab.key}
              className={`tab-btn ${activeTab === tab.key ? 'active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.key)}
            >
              {tab.icon}
              <span>{tab.label}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tab 内容 */}
      <div className="tab-content">
        {activeTab === 'dimensions' && (
          <div className="dimensions-section">
            <div className="section-header">
              <div className="section-title">
                <h2>论文分析维度</h2>
                <p>配置表格视图中AI分析论文摘要的维度，包括维度名称和分析指示</p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {loading ? (
              <div className="loading-container">
                <div className="spinner"></div>
                <p>加载中...</p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="dimensions-list">
                {dimensions.map((dimension) => (
                  <div 
                    key={dimension.id} 
                    className={`dimension-card ${!dimension.isActive ? 'inactive' : ''}`}
                  >
                    <div className="dimension-header">
                      <div className="dimension-info">
                        <div className="dimension-order">{dimension.sortOrder}</div>
                        <div className="dimension-title">
                          <h3>{dimension.name}</h3>
                          <span className="dimension-key">{dimension.dimensionKey}</span>
                        </div>
                        <span className={`badge ${dimension.isActive ? 'badge-success' : 'badge-secondary'}`}>
                          {dimension.isActive ? '启用' : '停用'}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="dimension-actions">
                        <button 
                          className="btn-icon" 
                          onClick={() => handleEdit(dimension)}
                          title="编辑"
                        >
                          <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor">
                            <path d="M12.146.146a.5.5 0 0 1 .708 0l3 3a.5.5 0 0 1 0 .708l-10 10a.5.5 0 0 1-.168.11l-5 2a.5.5 0 0 1-.65-.65l2-5a.5.5 0 0 1 .11-.168l10-10zM11.207 2.5 13.5 4.793 14.793 3.5 12.5 1.207 11.207 2.5zm1.586 3L10.5 3.207 4 9.707V10h.5a.5.5 0 0 1 .5.5v.5h.5a.5.5 0 0 1 .5.5v.5h.293l6.5-6.5zm-9.761 5.175-.106.106-1.528 3.821 3.821-1.528.106-.106A.5.5 0 0 1 5 12.5V12h-.5a.5.5 0 0 1-.5-.5V11h-.5a.5.5 0 0 1-.468-.325z"/>
                          </svg>
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="dimension-description">
                      <strong>分析指示：</strong>
                      <p>{dimension.description}</p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="dimension-footer">
                      <small>更新时间: {new Date(dimension.updatedAt).toLocaleString('zh-CN')}</small>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* 编辑弹窗 */}
      {showModal && (
        <div className="modal-overlay">
          <div className="modal-content modal-large">
            <div className="modal-header">
              <h2>编辑分析维度</h2>
              <button className="btn-close" onClick={() => setShowModal(false)}>
                <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                  <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M4.293 4.293a1 1 0 011.414 0L10 8.586l4.293-4.293a1 1 0 111.414 1.414L11.414 10l4.293 4.293a1 1 0 01-1.414 1.414L10 11.414l-4.293 4.293a1 1 0 01-1.414-1.414L8.586 10 4.293 5.707a1 1 0 010-1.414z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="modal-body">
              <div className="form-section">
                <div className="section-header">
                  <h3>基本信息</h3>
                </div>

                <div className="form-group">
                  <label>维度标识 <span className="readonly-hint">(不可修改)</span></label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    className="form-control"
                    value={editingDimension?.dimensionKey || ''}
                    disabled
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="form-group">
                  <label>维度名称 <span className="required">*</span></label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    className="form-control"
                    value={formData.name}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
                    required
                    placeholder="例如：研究类型"
                  />
                  <small className="form-help">显示在表格列头的名称</small>
                </div>

                <div className="form-row">
                  <div className="form-group form-group-small">
                    <label>排序顺序</label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      className="form-control"
                      value={formData.sortOrder}
                      onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, sortOrder: parseInt(e.target.value) || 0 })}
                      min="0"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="form-group">
                    <label className="checkbox-label">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={formData.isActive}
                        onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, isActive: e.target.checked })}
                      />
                      <span>启用此维度</span>
                    </label>
                    <small className="form-help">停用的维度不会在表格中显示</small>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="form-section">
                <div className="section-header">
                  <h3>分析指示 <span className="required">*</span></h3>
                  <p>AI分析论文摘要时使用的提示词，描述如何提取和分析该维度的信息</p>
                </div>

                <div className="form-group">
                  <textarea
                    className="form-control description-textarea"
                    value={formData.description}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
                    required
                    rows="8"
                    placeholder="输入分析指示内容..."
                  />
                  <div className="textarea-stats">
                    <span>字符数: {formData.description.length}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="modal-footer">
                <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={() => setShowModal(false)}>
                  取消
                </button>
                <button type="submit" className="btn-primary">
                  <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" style={{marginRight: '6px'}}>
                    <path d="M12.736 3.97a.733.733 0 0 1 1.047 0c.286.289.29.756.01 1.05L7.88 12.01a.733.733 0 0 1-1.065.02L3.217 8.384a.757.757 0 0 1 0-1.06.733.733 0 0 1 1.047 0l3.052 3.093 5.4-6.425a.247.247 0 0 1 .02-.022Z"/>
                  </svg>
                  保存修改
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default DefaultBusinessData;


// ========== 文件: frontend-admin/src/pages/DistributedCoupons.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { adminAPI } from '../services/api';
import { showToast } from '../components/Toast';
import './DistributedCoupons.css';

const DistributedCoupons = () => {
  const [coupons, setCoupons] = useState([]);
  const [templates, setTemplates] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [pageSize] = useState(20);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);

  // Filters
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState({
    templateId: '',
    status: '',
    userEmail: ''
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchTemplates();
    fetchCoupons();
  }, [page, filters]);

  const fetchTemplates = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await adminAPI.getCouponTemplates(1, 100);
      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        setTemplates(response.data.data.templates || []);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch templates:', error);
    }
  };

  const fetchCoupons = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await adminAPI.getDistributedCoupons(
        page,
        pageSize,
        filters.templateId,
        filters.status,
        filters.userEmail
      );

      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        setCoupons(response.data.data.coupons || []);
        setTotal(response.data.data.total || 0);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch distributed coupons:', error);
      showToast('获取折扣券列表失败', 'error');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleFilterChange = (key, value) => {
    setFilters({ ...filters, [key]: value });
    setPage(1); // Reset to first page when filters change
  };

  const handleResetFilters = () => {
    setFilters({
      templateId: '',
      status: '',
      userEmail: ''
    });
    setPage(1);
  };

  const getStatusBadge = (status) => {
    const statusMap = {
      unused: { text: '未使用', className: 'status-unused' },
      reserved: { text: '已预留', className: 'status-reserved' },
      used: { text: '已使用', className: 'status-used' },
      expired: { text: '已过期', className: 'status-expired' }
    };
    const config = statusMap[status] || { text: status, className: '' };
    return <span className={`status-badge ${config.className}`}>{config.text}</span>;
  };

  const getDiscountDisplay = (template) => {
    if (!template) return '-';

    if (template.type === 'percentage') {
      return `${template.discount_value}%`;
    } else if (template.type === 'fixed') {
      return `¥${template.discount_value}`;
    } else if (template.type === 'price_off') {
      return `满减¥${template.discount_value}`;
    }
    return '-';
  };

  const formatDate = (dateString) => {
    if (!dateString) return '-';
    return new Date(dateString).toLocaleString('zh-CN');
  };

  const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / pageSize);

  return (
    <div className="distributed-coupons-container">
      <div className="page-header">
        <h1>已发放折扣券列表</h1>
        <p className="page-description">查看和管理所有已发放给用户的折扣券</p>
      </div>

      {/* Filters */}
      <div className="filters-section">
        <div className="filter-group">
          <label>折扣券模板</label>
          <select
            value={filters.templateId}
            onChange={(e) => handleFilterChange('templateId', e.target.value)}
          >
            <option value="">全部模板</option>
            {templates.map((template) => (
              <option key={template.id} value={template.id}>
                {template.name} ({template.code})
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>

        <div className="filter-group">
          <label>状态</label>
          <select
            value={filters.status}
            onChange={(e) => handleFilterChange('status', e.target.value)}
          >
            <option value="">全部状态</option>
            <option value="unused">未使用</option>
            <option value="reserved">已预留</option>
            <option value="used">已使用</option>
            <option value="expired">已过期</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <div className="filter-group">
          <label>用户邮箱</label>
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="输入用户邮箱搜索"
            value={filters.userEmail}
            onChange={(e) => handleFilterChange('userEmail', e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>

        <button className="btn-reset" onClick={handleResetFilters}>
          重置筛选
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Statistics */}
      <div className="statistics-bar">
        <div className="stat-item">
          <span className="stat-label">总计:</span>
          <span className="stat-value">{total}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Table */}
      {loading ? (
        <div className="loading-container">
          <div className="spinner"></div>
          <p>加载中...</p>
        </div>
      ) : coupons.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="empty-state">
          <svg width="64" height="64" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor">
            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" strokeWidth="2"/>
            <path d="M12 8v4M12 16h.01" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round"/>
          </svg>
          <p>暂无折扣券数据</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="table-container">
            <table className="coupons-table">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>折扣券代码</th>
                  <th>模板名称</th>
                  <th>折扣力度</th>
                  <th>用户ID</th>
                  <th>状态</th>
                  <th>发放时间</th>
                  <th>有效期至</th>
                  <th>使用时间</th>
                  <th>使用订单</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {coupons.map((coupon) => (
                  <tr key={coupon.id}>
                    <td className="coupon-code">{coupon.coupon_code}</td>
                    <td>{coupon.template?.name || '-'}</td>
                    <td className="discount-value">{getDiscountDisplay(coupon.template)}</td>
                    <td>{coupon.user_id}</td>
                    <td>{getStatusBadge(coupon.status)}</td>
                    <td>{formatDate(coupon.created_at)}</td>
                    <td>{formatDate(coupon.valid_until)}</td>
                    <td>{formatDate(coupon.used_at)}</td>
                    <td>{coupon.used_order_id || '-'}</td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>

          {/* Pagination */}
          {totalPages > 1 && (
            <div className="pagination">
              <button
                className="btn-page"
                onClick={() => setPage(page - 1)}
                disabled={page === 1}
              >
                上一页
              </button>
              <span className="page-info">
                第 {page} / {totalPages} 页，共 {total} 条
              </span>
              <button
                className="btn-page"
                onClick={() => setPage(page + 1)}
                disabled={page === totalPages}
              >
                下一页
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default DistributedCoupons;

// ========== 文件: frontend-admin/src/pages/FeedbackManagement.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { adminAPI } from '../services/api';
import { showToast } from '../components/Toast';
import './FeedbackManagement.css';

const STATUS_MAP = {
  pending: { label: '待处理', color: '#f59e0b' },
  processed: { label: '已处理', color: '#3b82f6' },
  replied: { label: '已回复', color: '#22c55e' },
  closed: { label: '已关闭', color: '#6b7280' },
};

// 获取完整的文件URL（处理相对路径）
const getFullUrl = (url) => {
  if (!url) return '';
  // 如果已经是完整URL，直接返回
  if (url.startsWith('http://') || url.startsWith('https://')) {
    return url;
  }
  // 相对路径，使用当前域名
  return url;
};

const FeedbackManagement = () => {
  const [feedbacks, setFeedbacks] = useState([]);
  const [stats, setStats] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [pagination, setPagination] = useState({ page: 1, pageSize: 20, total: 0 });
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState({ status: '', keyword: '' });
  const [selectedFeedback, setSelectedFeedback] = useState(null);
  const [showDetailModal, setShowDetailModal] = useState(false);
  const [showReplyModal, setShowReplyModal] = useState(false);
  const [replyContent, setReplyContent] = useState('');
  const [replying, setReplying] = useState(false);
  const [previewImage, setPreviewImage] = useState(null); // 图片预览状态

  const fetchFeedbacks = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await adminAPI.getFeedbacks({
        page: pagination.page,
        pageSize: pagination.pageSize,
        ...filters,
      });
      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        setFeedbacks(response.data.data.list || []);
        setPagination(prev => ({ ...prev, total: response.data.data.total }));
      }
    } catch (error) {
      showToast('获取反馈列表失败', 'error');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [pagination.page, pagination.pageSize, filters]);

  const fetchStats = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await adminAPI.getFeedbackStats();
      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        setStats(response.data.data);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch stats:', error);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchFeedbacks();
  }, [fetchFeedbacks]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchStats();
  }, []);

  const handleStatusChange = async (id, newStatus) => {
    try {
      const response = await adminAPI.updateFeedbackStatus(id, newStatus);
      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        showToast('状态更新成功', 'success');
        fetchFeedbacks();
        fetchStats();
      } else {
        showToast(response.data.message || '更新失败', 'error');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      showToast('更新失败', 'error');
    }
  };

  const handleReply = async () => {
    if (!replyContent.trim()) {
      showToast('请输入回复内容', 'error');
      return;
    }
    setReplying(true);
    try {
      const response = await adminAPI.replyFeedback(selectedFeedback.id, replyContent);
      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        showToast('回复成功，邮件已发送', 'success');
        setShowReplyModal(false);
        setReplyContent('');
        setSelectedFeedback(null);
        fetchFeedbacks();
        fetchStats();
      } else {
        showToast(response.data.message || '回复失败', 'error');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      showToast('回复失败', 'error');
    } finally {
      setReplying(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm('确定要删除这条反馈吗？')) return;
    try {
      const response = await adminAPI.deleteFeedback(id);
      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        showToast('删除成功', 'success');
        fetchFeedbacks();
        fetchStats();
      } else {
        showToast(response.data.message || '删除失败', 'error');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      showToast('删除失败', 'error');
    }
  };

  const openDetailModal = (feedback) => {
    setSelectedFeedback(feedback);
    setShowDetailModal(true);
  };

  const openReplyModal = (feedback) => {
    setSelectedFeedback(feedback);
    setReplyContent('');
    setShowReplyModal(true);
  };

  const formatDate = (dateStr) => {
    if (!dateStr) return '-';
    return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleString('zh-CN');
  };

  const parseAttachments = (attachmentsStr) => {
    if (!attachmentsStr) return [];
    try {
      return JSON.parse(attachmentsStr);
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="feedback-management">
      <div className="page-header">
        <h1>反馈管理</h1>
        <p>管理用户提交的意见反馈</p>
      </div>

      {stats && (
        <div className="stats-cards">
          <div className="stat-card">
            <div className="stat-value">{stats.total}</div>
            <div className="stat-label">总反馈</div>
          </div>
          <div className="stat-card pending">
            <div className="stat-value">{stats.pending}</div>
            <div className="stat-label">待处理</div>
          </div>
          <div className="stat-card processed">
            <div className="stat-value">{stats.processed}</div>
            <div className="stat-label">已处理</div>
          </div>
          <div className="stat-card replied">
            <div className="stat-value">{stats.replied}</div>
            <div className="stat-label">已回复</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="filters-bar">
        <select
          value={filters.status}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setFilters(prev => ({ ...prev, status: e.target.value }));
            setPagination(prev => ({ ...prev, page: 1 }));
          }}
        >
          <option value="">全部状态</option>
          <option value="pending">待处理</option>
          <option value="processed">已处理</option>
          <option value="replied">已回复</option>
          <option value="closed">已关闭</option>
        </select>
        <input
          type="text"
          placeholder="搜索邮箱或内容..."
          value={filters.keyword}
          onChange={(e) => setFilters(prev => ({ ...prev, keyword: e.target.value }))}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') {
              setPagination(prev => ({ ...prev, page: 1 }));
              fetchFeedbacks();
            }
          }}
        />
        <button onClick={() => { setPagination(prev => ({ ...prev, page: 1 })); fetchFeedbacks(); }}>
          搜索
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="feedback-table-wrapper">
        <table className="feedback-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>ID</th>
              <th>邮箱</th>
              <th>内容摘要</th>
              <th>用户</th>
              <th>IP</th>
              <th>状态</th>
              <th>提交时间</th>
              <th>操作</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {loading ? (
              <tr><td colSpan="8" className="loading-cell">加载中...</td></tr>
            ) : feedbacks.length === 0 ? (
              <tr><td colSpan="8" className="empty-cell">暂无反馈</td></tr>
            ) : (
              feedbacks.map((feedback) => (
                <tr key={feedback.id}>
                  <td>{feedback.id}</td>
                  <td>{feedback.email}</td>
                  <td className="content-cell" title={feedback.content}>
                    {feedback.content?.substring(0, 50)}{feedback.content?.length > 50 ? '...' : ''}
                  </td>
                  <td>{feedback.username || '匿名'}</td>
                  <td>{feedback.ip || '-'}</td>
                  <td>
                    <span 
                      className="status-badge"
                      style={{ backgroundColor: STATUS_MAP[feedback.status]?.color }}
                    >
                      {STATUS_MAP[feedback.status]?.label}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td>{formatDate(feedback.createdAt)}</td>
                  <td className="actions-cell">
                    <button className="btn-action view" onClick={() => openDetailModal(feedback)}>
                      查看
                    </button>
                    {feedback.status !== 'replied' && feedback.status !== 'closed' && (
                      <button className="btn-action reply" onClick={() => openReplyModal(feedback)}>
                        回复
                      </button>
                    )}
                    <button className="btn-action delete" onClick={() => handleDelete(feedback.id)}>
                      删除
                    </button>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      <div className="pagination">
        <button
          disabled={pagination.page <= 1}
          onClick={() => setPagination(prev => ({ ...prev, page: prev.page - 1 }))}
        >
          上一页
        </button>
        <span>第 {pagination.page} 页 / 共 {Math.ceil(pagination.total / pagination.pageSize)} 页</span>
        <button
          disabled={pagination.page >= Math.ceil(pagination.total / pagination.pageSize)}
          onClick={() => setPagination(prev => ({ ...prev, page: prev.page + 1 }))}
        >
          下一页
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* 侧边抽屉 - 反馈详情 */}
      <div className={`drawer-overlay ${showDetailModal ? 'visible' : ''}`} onClick={() => setShowDetailModal(false)} />
      <div className={`drawer detail-drawer ${showDetailModal ? 'open' : ''}`}>
        <div className="drawer-header">
          <h3>反馈详情</h3>
          <button className="close-btn" onClick={() => setShowDetailModal(false)}>×</button>
        </div>
        {selectedFeedback && (
          <div className="drawer-body">
            <div className="detail-section">
              <h4>基本信息</h4>
              <div className="detail-grid">
                <div className="detail-item">
                  <label>反馈ID</label>
                  <span>#{selectedFeedback.id}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="detail-item">
                  <label>邮箱</label>
                  <span>{selectedFeedback.email}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="detail-item">
                  <label>用户</label>
                  <span>{selectedFeedback.username || '匿名用户'}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="detail-item">
                  <label>IP地址</label>
                  <span>{selectedFeedback.ip || '-'} {selectedFeedback.ipLocation && <span className="ip-location">({selectedFeedback.ipLocation})</span>}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="detail-item">
                  <label>提交时间</label>
                  <span>{formatDate(selectedFeedback.createdAt)}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="detail-item">
                  <label>状态</label>
                  <select
                    value={selectedFeedback.status}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      handleStatusChange(selectedFeedback.id, e.target.value);
                      setSelectedFeedback(prev => ({ ...prev, status: e.target.value }));
                    }}
                    className="status-select"
                  >
                    <option value="pending">待处理</option>
                    <option value="processed">已处理</option>
                    <option value="replied">已回复</option>
                    <option value="closed">已关闭</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="detail-section">
              <h4>反馈内容</h4>
              <div className="content-box large">{selectedFeedback.content}</div>
            </div>

            {parseAttachments(selectedFeedback.attachments).length > 0 && (
              <div className="detail-section">
                <h4>附件 ({parseAttachments(selectedFeedback.attachments).length})</h4>
                {/* 图片预览区域 */}
                {parseAttachments(selectedFeedback.attachments).filter(att => att.type === 'image').length > 0 && (
                  <div className="attachment-images-preview">
                    {parseAttachments(selectedFeedback.attachments)
                      .filter(att => att.type === 'image')
                      .map((att, idx) => (
                        <div 
                          key={idx} 
                          className="preview-image-item"
                          onClick={() => setPreviewImage(getFullUrl(att.url))}
                        >
                          <img src={getFullUrl(att.url)} alt={att.name} />
                          <div className="preview-image-overlay">
                            <span>点击预览</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                  </div>
                )}
                {/* 文件下载区域 */}
                {parseAttachments(selectedFeedback.attachments).filter(att => att.type === 'file').length > 0 && (
                  <div className="attachment-files-list">
                    {parseAttachments(selectedFeedback.attachments)
                      .filter(att => att.type === 'file')
                      .map((att, idx) => (
                        <a 
                          key={idx} 
                          href={getFullUrl(att.url)} 
                          download={att.name}
                          className="file-download-item"
                        >
                          <span className="file-icon">📄</span>
                          <span className="file-info">
                            <span className="file-name">{att.name}</span>
                            {att.size && <span className="file-size">{(att.size / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB</span>}
                          </span>
                          <span className="download-icon">⬇️</span>
                        </a>
                      ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            {selectedFeedback.replyContent && (
              <div className="detail-section">
                <h4>回复记录</h4>
                <div className="content-box reply-box large">{selectedFeedback.replyContent}</div>
                <div className="reply-meta">
                  <span>回复人: {selectedFeedback.repliedBy}</span>
                  <span>回复时间: {formatDate(selectedFeedback.repliedAt)}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="drawer-actions">
              {selectedFeedback.status !== 'replied' && selectedFeedback.status !== 'closed' && (
                <button className="btn-primary" onClick={() => { setShowDetailModal(false); openReplyModal(selectedFeedback); }}>
                  回复此反馈
                </button>
              )}
              <button className="btn-danger" onClick={() => { handleDelete(selectedFeedback.id); setShowDetailModal(false); }}>
                删除反馈
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {showReplyModal && selectedFeedback && (
        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => setShowReplyModal(false)}>
          <div className="modal reply-modal" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div className="modal-header">
              <h3>回复反馈</h3>
              <button className="close-btn" onClick={() => setShowReplyModal(false)}>×</button>
            </div>
            <div className="modal-body">
              <div className="reply-info">
                <p><strong>发送至:</strong> {selectedFeedback.email}</p>
                <p><strong>原反馈:</strong> {selectedFeedback.content?.substring(0, 100)}...</p>
              </div>
              <textarea
                placeholder="请输入回复内容..."
                value={replyContent}
                onChange={(e) => setReplyContent(e.target.value)}
                rows={6}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="modal-footer">
              <button className="btn-cancel" onClick={() => setShowReplyModal(false)}>取消</button>
              <button className="btn-submit" onClick={handleReply} disabled={replying}>
                {replying ? '发送中...' : '发送回复'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 图片预览弹窗 */}
      {previewImage && (
        <div className="image-preview-overlay" onClick={() => setPreviewImage(null)}>
          <div className="image-preview-container">
            <button className="preview-close-btn" onClick={() => setPreviewImage(null)}>×</button>
            <img src={previewImage} alt="预览" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} />
            <div className="preview-actions">
              <a href={previewImage} download className="preview-download-btn" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                下载图片
              </a>
              <a href={previewImage} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="preview-open-btn" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                新窗口打开
              </a>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default FeedbackManagement;

// ========== 文件: frontend-admin/src/pages/Login.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../utils/AuthContext';
import { adminAPI } from '../services/api';
import SliderCaptcha from '../components/SliderCaptcha';
import './Login.css';

const Login = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { login } = useAuth();
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    username: '',
    password: '',
  });
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [captchaVerified, setCaptchaVerified] = useState(false);
  const captchaRef = useRef(null);

  const handleChange = (e) => {
    setFormData({
      ...formData,
      [e.target.name]: e.target.value,
    });
    setError('');
  };

  const handleCaptchaSuccess = () => {
    setCaptchaVerified(true);
  };

  const handleCaptchaFail = () => {
    setCaptchaVerified(false);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');

    if (!captchaVerified) {
      setError('Please complete the captcha verification');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await adminAPI.login(formData.username, formData.password);

      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        const { token, admin } = response.data.data;
        login(token, admin);
        navigate('/dashboard');
      } else {
        setError(response.data.message || 'Login failed');
        // Reset captcha on login failure
        setCaptchaVerified(false);
        if (captchaRef.current && captchaRef.current.reset) {
          captchaRef.current.reset();
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.response?.data?.message || 'An error occurred during login');
      // Reset captcha on error
      setCaptchaVerified(false);
      if (captchaRef.current && captchaRef.current.reset) {
        captchaRef.current.reset();
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="login-container">
      <div className="login-card fade-in">
        <div className="login-header">
          <div className="logo">
            <svg width="48" height="48" viewBox="0 0 48 48" fill="none">
              <rect width="48" height="48" rx="12" fill="#2563eb"/>
              <path d="M24 12L32 20H28V32H20V20H16L24 12Z" fill="white"/>
              <rect x="16" y="34" width="16" height="2" fill="white"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <h1>Scholar Admin</h1>
          <p>Sign in to your account</p>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="login-form">
          <div className="form-group">
            <label htmlFor="username">Username</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              id="username"
              name="username"
              className="input"
              placeholder="Enter your username"
              value={formData.username}
              onChange={handleChange}
              required
              autoFocus
            />
          </div>

          <div className="form-group">
            <label htmlFor="password">Password</label>
            <input
              type="password"
              id="password"
              name="password"
              className="input"
              placeholder="Enter your password"
              value={formData.password}
              onChange={handleChange}
              required
            />
          </div>

          <SliderCaptcha
            ref={captchaRef}
            onSuccess={handleCaptchaSuccess}
            onFail={handleCaptchaFail}
          />

          {error && (
            <div className="error-message fade-in">
              <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor">
                <path d="M8 0C3.6 0 0 3.6 0 8s3.6 8 8 8 8-3.6 8-8-3.6-8-8-8zm1 13H7v-2h2v2zm0-3H7V4h2v6z"/>
              </svg>
              {error}
            </div>
          )}

          <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary btn-full" disabled={loading || !captchaVerified}>
            {loading ? (
              <>
                <span className="spinner"></span>
                <span style={{ marginLeft: '0.5rem' }}>Signing in...</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              'Sign In'
            )}
          </button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Login;

// ========== 文件: frontend-admin/src/pages/OrderManagement.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { adminAPI } from '../services/api';
import { showToast } from '../components/Toast';
import './OrderManagement.css';

const OrderManagement = () => {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [statistics, setStatistics] = useState({
    today_amount: 0,
    today_count: 0,
    today_users: 0,
    week_amount: 0,
    week_count: 0,
    week_users: 0,
    month_amount: 0,
    month_count: 0,
    month_users: 0,
    total_amount: 0,
    total_count: 0,
    total_users: 0,
  });
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState([]);
  const [pagination, setPagination] = useState({
    page: 1,
    pageSize: 20,
    total: 0,
  });
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState({
    planCode: '',
    userEmail: '',
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    loadStatistics();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadOrders();
  }, [pagination.page, filters]);

  const loadStatistics = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await adminAPI.getOrderStatistics();
      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
        setStatistics(response.data.data);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load order statistics:', err);
      showToast('加载订单统计失败', 'error');
    }
  };

  const loadOrders = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await adminAPI.getOrders(
        pagination.page,
        pagination.pageSize,
        filters.planCode,
        filters.userEmail
      );
      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
        setOrders(response.data.data.orders || []);
        setPagination(prev => ({
          ...prev,
          total: response.data.data.total || 0,
        }));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showToast('加载订单列表失败', 'error');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleFilterChange = (key, value) => {
    setFilters(prev => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }));
    setPagination(prev => ({ ...prev, page: 1 })); // Reset to first page
  };

  const handlePageChange = (newPage) => {
    setPagination(prev => ({ ...prev, page: newPage }));
  };

  const formatCurrency = (amount) => {
    return `¥${amount.toFixed(2)}`;
  };

  const formatDateTime = (dateStr) => {
    return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleString('zh-CN');
  };

  // 渲染用户信息
  const renderUserInfo = (order) => {
    const userInfo = [];
    
    // 用户名（主要显示）
    if (order.username) {
      userInfo.push(<div key="username" className="user-info-username">{order.username}</div>);
    } else {
      userInfo.push(<div key="userid" className="user-info-username">用户 {order.user_id}</div>);
    }

    const details = [];
    if (order.phone) {
      details.push(
        <div key="phone" className="user-info-detail">
          <span className="info-label">手机:</span> {order.phone}
        </div>
      );
    }
    if (order.email) {
      details.push(
        <div key="email" className="user-info-detail">
          <span className="info-label">邮箱:</span> {order.email}
        </div>
      );
    }
    if (order.wechat_name) {
      details.push(
        <div key="wechat_name" className="user-info-detail">
          <span className="info-label">微信:</span> {order.wechat_name}
        </div>
      );
    }
    if (order.wechat_union_id) {
      details.push(
        <div key="wechat_union_id" className="user-info-detail">
          <span className="info-label">UnionID:</span> {order.wechat_union_id}
        </div>
      );
    }
    if (order.github_name) {
      details.push(
        <div key="github_name" className="user-info-detail">
          <span className="info-label">GitHub:</span> {order.github_name}
        </div>
      );
    }

    return (
      <div className="user-info-cell">
        {userInfo}
        {details.length > 0 && (
          <div className="user-info-details-wrapper">
            {details.map((detail, index) => (
              <React.Fragment key={index}>
                {index > 0 && <div className="user-info-divider"></div>}
                {detail}
              </React.Fragment>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="order-management">
      <h1 className="page-title">订单管理</h1>

      {/* Statistics Cards */}
      <div className="stats-grid">
        <div className="stat-card stat-card-today">
          <h3>今日</h3>
          <div className="stat-value">{formatCurrency(statistics.today_amount)}</div>
          <div className="stat-details">
            <span>{statistics.today_count} 笔订单</span>
            <span>{statistics.today_users} 位用户</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="stat-card stat-card-week">
          <h3>本周</h3>
          <div className="stat-value">{formatCurrency(statistics.week_amount)}</div>
          <div className="stat-details">
            <span>{statistics.week_count} 笔订单</span>
            <span>{statistics.week_users} 位用户</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="stat-card stat-card-month">
          <h3>本月</h3>
          <div className="stat-value">{formatCurrency(statistics.month_amount)}</div>
          <div className="stat-details">
            <span>{statistics.month_count} 笔订单</span>
            <span>{statistics.month_users} 位用户</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="stat-card stat-card-total">
          <h3>总计</h3>
          <div className="stat-value">{formatCurrency(statistics.total_amount)}</div>
          <div className="stat-details">
            <span>{statistics.total_count} 笔订单</span>
            <span>{statistics.total_users} 位用户</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Filters */}
      <div className="filters">
        <div className="filter-group">
          <label>套餐筛选</label>
          <select
            value={filters.planCode}
            onChange={(e) => handleFilterChange('planCode', e.target.value)}
          >
            <option value="">全部套餐</option>
            <option value="pro">Pro</option>
            <option value="max">Max</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <div className="filter-group">
          <label>用户邮箱</label>
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="搜索用户邮箱"
            value={filters.userEmail}
            onChange={(e) => handleFilterChange('userEmail', e.target.value)}
          />
        </div>

        <button className="btn-reset" onClick={() => {
          setFilters({ planCode: '', userEmail: '' });
          setPagination(prev => ({ ...prev, page: 1 }));
        }}>
          重置筛选
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Orders Table */}
      <div className="orders-section">
        <h2>订单列表</h2>

        {loading ? (
          <div className="loading">
            <div className="spinner"></div>
            <p>加载中...</p>
          </div>
        ) : orders.length > 0 ? (
          <>
            <div className="table-container">
              <table className="orders-table">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th>订单号</th>
                    <th>用户信息</th>
                    <th>套餐</th>
                    <th>金额</th>
                    <th>支付方式</th>
                    <th>支付时间</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {orders.map((order) => (
                    <tr key={order.id}>
                      <td className="order-no">{order.order_no}</td>
                      <td className="user-info">{renderUserInfo(order)}</td>
                      <td>
                        <div className="plan-info">
                          <span className={`plan-badge plan-badge-${order.plan_code}`}>
                            {order.plan_name}
                          </span>
                          <span className="billing-cycle">
                            {order.billing_cycle === 'monthly' ? '月付' : '年付'}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="amount">
                        <div className="amount-details">
                          {order.discount_amount > 0 ? (
                            <>
                              <span className="final-amount">{formatCurrency(order.final_amount)}</span>
                              <span className="original-amount">{formatCurrency(order.amount)}</span>
                              <span className="discount-badge">已优惠{formatCurrency(order.discount_amount)}</span>
                            </>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="final-amount">{formatCurrency(order.final_amount)}</span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="payment-method">{order.payment_method || '-'}</td>
                      <td className="payment-time">
                        {order.payment_time ? formatDateTime(order.payment_time) : '-'}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>

            {/* Pagination */}
            <div className="pagination">
              <button
                className="pagination-btn"
                disabled={pagination.page === 1}
                onClick={() => handlePageChange(pagination.page - 1)}
              >
                上一页
              </button>
              <span className="pagination-info">
                第 {pagination.page} 页，共 {Math.ceil(pagination.total / pagination.pageSize)} 页
              </span>
              <button
                className="pagination-btn"
                disabled={pagination.page >= Math.ceil(pagination.total / pagination.pageSize)}
                onClick={() => handlePageChange(pagination.page + 1)}
              >
                下一页
              </button>
            </div>
          </>
        ) : (
          <div className="empty-state">
            <p>暂无订单记录</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default OrderManagement;

// ========== 文件: frontend-admin/src/pages/PromptTemplates.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { adminAPI } from '../services/api';
import './PromptTemplates.css';

const PromptTemplates = () => {
  const [templates, setTemplates] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [showModal, setShowModal] = useState(false);
  const [editingTemplate, setEditingTemplate] = useState(null);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: '',
    key: '',
    template: '',
    description: '',
    is_active: true
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    loadTemplates();
  }, []);

  const loadTemplates = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await adminAPI.getPromptTemplates();
      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
        setTemplates(response.data.data.templates || []);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to load prompt templates:', error);
      alert('加载提示词模板失败');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreate = () => {
    setEditingTemplate(null);
    setFormData({
      name: '',
      key: '',
      template: '',
      description: '',
      is_active: true
    });
    setShowModal(true);
  };

  const handleEdit = (template) => {
    setEditingTemplate(template);
    setFormData({
      name: template.name,
      key: template.key,
      template: template.template,
      description: template.description || '',
      is_active: Boolean(template.is_active) // Convert 0/1 to false/true
    });
    setShowModal(true);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    try {
      if (editingTemplate) {
        // Update existing template
        const response = await adminAPI.updatePromptTemplate(editingTemplate.id, formData);
        if (response.data.code === 0) {
          alert('提示词模板更新成功');
          setShowModal(false);
          loadTemplates();
        } else {
          alert('更新失败: ' + response.data.message);
        }
      } else {
        // Create new template
        const response = await adminAPI.createPromptTemplate(formData);
        if (response.data.code === 0) {
          alert('提示词模板创建成功');
          setShowModal(false);
          loadTemplates();
        } else {
          alert('创建失败: ' + response.data.message);
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to save template:', error);
      alert('保存失败: ' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm('确定要删除这个提示词模板吗？')) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      const response = await adminAPI.deletePromptTemplate(id);
      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        alert('删除成功');
        loadTemplates();
      } else {
        alert('删除失败: ' + response.data.message);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to delete template:', error);
      alert('删除失败: ' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
    }
  };

  const handleToggleActive = async (template) => {
    try {
      const response = await adminAPI.updatePromptTemplate(template.id, {
        name: template.name,
        template: template.template,
        description: template.description,
        is_active: !template.is_active
      });
      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        loadTemplates();
      } else {
        alert('更新失败: ' + response.data.message);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to toggle active:', error);
      alert('更新失败: ' + (error.response?.data?.message || error.message));
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="prompt-templates-page">
      <div className="page-header">
        <h1>提示词模板管理</h1>
        <button className="btn-primary" onClick={handleCreate}>
          <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor">
            <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M8 2a.5.5 0 01.5.5v5h5a.5.5 0 010 1h-5v5a.5.5 0 01-1 0v-5h-5a.5.5 0 010-1h5v-5A.5.5 0 018 2z"/>
          </svg>
          新建模板
        </button>
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <div className="loading-container">
          <div className="spinner"></div>
          <p>加载中...</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="templates-grid">
          {templates.map((template) => (
            <div key={template.id} className={`template-card ${!template.is_active ? 'inactive' : ''}`}>
              <div className="template-header">
                <div className="template-title">
                  <h3>{template.name}</h3>
                  <span className={`badge ${template.is_active ? 'badge-success' : 'badge-secondary'}`}>
                    {template.is_active ? '启用' : '停用'}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="template-actions">
                  <button
                    className="btn-icon"
                    onClick={() => handleToggleActive(template)}
                    title={template.is_active ? '停用' : '启用'}
                  >
                    <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor">
                      <path d="M8 15A7 7 0 1 1 8 1a7 7 0 0 1 0 14zm0 1A8 8 0 1 0 8 0a8 8 0 0 0 0 16z"/>
                      <path d="M10.97 4.97a.235.235 0 0 0-.02.022L7.477 9.417 5.384 7.323a.75.75 0 0 0-1.06 1.06L6.97 11.03a.75.75 0 0 0 1.079-.02l3.992-4.99a.75.75 0 0 0-1.071-1.05z"/>
                    </svg>
                  </button>
                  <button className="btn-icon" onClick={() => handleEdit(template)}>
                    <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor">
                      <path d="M12.146.146a.5.5 0 0 1 .708 0l3 3a.5.5 0 0 1 0 .708l-10 10a.5.5 0 0 1-.168.11l-5 2a.5.5 0 0 1-.65-.65l2-5a.5.5 0 0 1 .11-.168l10-10zM11.207 2.5 13.5 4.793 14.793 3.5 12.5 1.207 11.207 2.5zm1.586 3L10.5 3.207 4 9.707V10h.5a.5.5 0 0 1 .5.5v.5h.5a.5.5 0 0 1 .5.5v.5h.293l6.5-6.5zm-9.761 5.175-.106.106-1.528 3.821 3.821-1.528.106-.106A.5.5 0 0 1 5 12.5V12h-.5a.5.5 0 0 1-.5-.5V11h-.5a.5.5 0 0 1-.468-.325z"/>
                    </svg>
                  </button>
                  <button className="btn-icon btn-danger" onClick={() => handleDelete(template.id)}>
                    <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor">
                      <path d="M5.5 5.5A.5.5 0 0 1 6 6v6a.5.5 0 0 1-1 0V6a.5.5 0 0 1 .5-.5zm2.5 0a.5.5 0 0 1 .5.5v6a.5.5 0 0 1-1 0V6a.5.5 0 0 1 .5-.5zm3 .5a.5.5 0 0 0-1 0v6a.5.5 0 0 0 1 0V6z"/>
                      <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M14.5 3a1 1 0 0 1-1 1H13v9a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V4h-.5a1 1 0 0 1-1-1V2a1 1 0 0 1 1-1H6a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h2a1 1 0 0 1 1 1h3.5a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v1zM4.118 4 4 4.059V13a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h6a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V4.059L11.882 4H4.118zM2.5 3V2h11v1h-11z"/>
                    </svg>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="template-meta">
                <span className="meta-item">
                  <strong>Key:</strong> {template.key}
                </span>
              </div>

              {template.description && (
                <p className="template-description">{template.description}</p>
              )}

              <div className="template-preview">
                <strong>模板内容预览：</strong>
                <pre>{template.template.substring(0, 200)}...</pre>
              </div>

              <div className="template-footer">
                <small>创建时间: {new Date(template.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-CN')}</small>
                <small>更新时间: {new Date(template.updated_at).toLocaleString('zh-CN')}</small>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

{showModal && (
        <div className="modal-overlay">
          <div className="modal-content modal-xlarge">
            <div className="modal-header">
              <h2>{editingTemplate ? '编辑提示词模板' : '新建提示词模板'}</h2>
              <button className="btn-close" onClick={() => setShowModal(false)}>
                <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                  <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M4.293 4.293a1 1 0 011.414 0L10 8.586l4.293-4.293a1 1 0 111.414 1.414L11.414 10l4.293 4.293a1 1 0 01-1.414 1.414L10 11.414l-4.293 4.293a1 1 0 01-1.414-1.414L8.586 10 4.293 5.707a1 1 0 010-1.414z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="modal-body">
              {/* 基本信息区域 */}
              <div className="form-section">
                <div className="section-header">
                  <h3>基本信息</h3>
                  <p>设置模板的基本属性和标识</p>
                </div>

                <div className="form-row">
                  <div className="form-group form-group-flex">
                    <label>模板名称 <span className="required">*</span></label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      className="form-control"
                      value={formData.name}
                      onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
                      required
                      placeholder="例如：论文分析总结提示词"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="form-group form-group-flex">
                    <label>模板Key <span className="required">*</span></label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      className="form-control"
                      value={formData.key}
                      onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, key: e.target.value })}
                      required
                      disabled={!!editingTemplate}
                      placeholder="例如：paper_analysis"
                    />
                    {editingTemplate && (
                      <small className="form-help">创建后不可修改</small>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="form-group">
                  <label>模板描述</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    className="form-control"
                    value={formData.description}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="简短描述这个模板的用途，例如：用于分析搜索到的学术论文并生成结构化综述"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="form-group">
                  <label className="checkbox-label">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={formData.is_active}
                      onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, is_active: e.target.checked })}
                    />
                    <span>启用此模板</span>
                  </label>
                  <small className="form-help">停用的模板不会在系统中生效</small>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* 模板内容区域 */}
              <div className="form-section">
                <div className="section-header">
                  <h3>模板内容 <span className="required">*</span></h3>
                  <p>编写提示词模板，使用变量占位符实现动态内容</p>
                </div>

                {/* 变量快速插入工具 */}
                <div className="variable-toolbar">
                  <span className="toolbar-label">常用变量：</span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="btn-variable"
                    onClick={() => {
                      const textarea = document.querySelector('.template-textarea');
                      const cursorPos = textarea.selectionStart;
                      const textBefore = formData.template.substring(0, cursorPos);
                      const textAfter = formData.template.substring(cursorPos);
                      setFormData({ ...formData, template: textBefore + '{{query}}' + textAfter });
                    }}
                  >
                    <code>{'{{query}}'}</code>
                    <span>搜索关键词</span>
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="btn-variable"
                    onClick={() => {
                      const textarea = document.querySelector('.template-textarea');
                      const cursorPos = textarea.selectionStart;
                      const textBefore = formData.template.substring(0, cursorPos);
                      const textAfter = formData.template.substring(cursorPos);
                      setFormData({ ...formData, template: textBefore + '{{papers}}' + textAfter });
                    }}
                  >
                    <code>{'{{papers}}'}</code>
                    <span>论文列表</span>
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="form-group">
                  <textarea
                    className="form-control template-textarea"
                    value={formData.template}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, template: e.target.value })}
                    required
                    rows="18"
                    placeholder="输入提示词模板内容...&#10;&#10;例如：&#10;你是一位专业的学术研究助手。用户搜索了关键词：「{{query}}」&#10;&#10;## 论文列表&#10;{{papers}}&#10;&#10;请对这些论文进行深入分析..."
                  />
                  <div className="template-stats">
                    <span>字符数: {formData.template.length}</span>
                    <span>行数: {formData.template.split('\n').length}</span>
                    <span>变量: {(formData.template.match(/\{\{.*?\}\}/g) || []).length}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* 预览区域 */}
                {formData.template && (
                  <div className="template-preview-box">
                    <div className="preview-header">
                      <strong>模板预览</strong>
                      <span className="preview-hint">变量会以高亮显示</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="preview-content">
                      {formData.template.split(/(\{\{.*?\}\})/).map((part, index) => {
                        if (part.match(/\{\{.*?\}\}/)) {
                          return <span key={index} className="variable-highlight">{part}</span>;
                        }
                        return part;
                      })}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="modal-footer">
                <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={() => setShowModal(false)}>
                  取消
                </button>
                <button type="submit" className="btn-primary">
                  <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" style={{marginRight: '6px'}}>
                    <path d="M12.736 3.97a.733.733 0 0 1 1.047 0c.286.289.29.756.01 1.05L7.88 12.01a.733.733 0 0 1-1.065.02L3.217 8.384a.757.757 0 0 1 0-1.06.733.733 0 0 1 1.047 0l3.052 3.093 5.4-6.425a.247.247 0 0 1 .02-.022Z"/>
                  </svg>
                  {editingTemplate ? '保存修改' : '创建模板'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default PromptTemplates;

// ========== 文件: frontend-admin/src/pages/SubscriptionPlans.js ==========
/**
