              </button>
            </div>

            {/* WeChat Pay Configuration */}
            {wechatSubTab === 'pay' && (
              <>
                <div className="section-header">
                  <h2>微信支付配置</h2>
                  <p>管理微信支付配置</p>
              <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={handleCreateWechatPay}>
                <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" className="icon-inline">
                  <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M10 3a1 1 0 011 1v5h5a1 1 0 110 2h-5v5a1 1 0 11-2 0v-5H4a1 1 0 110-2h5V4a1 1 0 011-1z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
                </svg>
                添加配置
              </button>
            </div>

            {loading ? (
              <div className="loading-state">
                <span className="spinner"></span>
                <span>加载中...</span>
              </div>
            ) : wechatPayConfigs.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="no-config-state">
                <svg width="64" height="64" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" className="empty-icon">
                  <path d="M4 4a2 2 0 00-2 2v1h16V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H4z"/>
                  <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M18 9H2v5a2 2 0 002 2h12a2 2 0 002-2V9zM4 13a1 1 0 011-1h1a1 1 0 110 2H5a1 1 0 01-1-1zm5-1a1 1 0 100 2h1a1 1 0 100-2H9z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
                </svg>
                <p>暂无微信支付配置</p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="config-cards">
                {wechatPayConfigs.map((config) => (
                  <div key={config.id} className={`config-card ${config.is_active ? 'active' : ''}`}>
                    <div className="card-header">
                      <h3>微信支付配置 #{config.id}</h3>
                      {config.is_active && <span className="badge badge-success">已激活</span>}
                      {config.is_sandbox && <span className="badge badge-warning">沙箱环境</span>}
                    </div>
                    <div className="card-body">
                      <div className="config-row">
                        <label>商户号:</label>
                        <span>{config.mch_id}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="config-row">
                        <label>应用 ID:</label>
                        <span>{config.app_id}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="config-row">
                        <label>证书序列号:</label>
                        <span>{config.serial_no}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="config-row">
                        <label>APIv3密钥:</label>
                        <SensitiveField
                          value={config.api_v3_key}
                          isVerified={isVerified}
                          onRequestVerify={handleRequestVerify}
                        />
                      </div>
                      <div className="config-row">
                        <label>商户私钥:</label>
                        <SensitiveField
                          value={config.private_key}
                          isVerified={isVerified}
                          onRequestVerify={handleRequestVerify}
                        />
                      </div>
                      <div className="config-row">
                        <label>回调地址:</label>
                        <span>{config.notify_url}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="card-actions">
                      {!config.is_active && (
                        <button className="btn btn-success btn-sm" onClick={() => handleActivateWechatPay(config.id)}>
                          激活
                        </button>
                      )}
                      <button className="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onClick={() => handleEditWechatPay(config)}>
                        编辑
                      </button>
                      <button className="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onClick={() => handleDeleteWechatPay(config.id)}>
                        删除
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* WeChat Pay Modal */}
            {showWechatPayModal && (
              <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => setShowWechatPayModal(false)}>
                <div className="modal-content" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                  <div className="modal-header">
                    <h3>{editingWechatPay ? '编辑微信支付配置' : '添加微信支付配置'}</h3>
                    <button className="modal-close" onClick={() => setShowWechatPayModal(false)}>×</button>
                  </div>
                  <form onSubmit={handleSubmitWechatPay}>
                    <div className="form-group">
                      <label htmlFor="mch_id">商户号 *</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        id="mch_id"
                        className="input"
                        value={wechatPayForm.mch_id}
                        onChange={(e) => setWechatPayForm({ ...wechatPayForm, mch_id: e.target.value })}
                        placeholder="输入微信支付商户号"
                        required
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div className="form-group">
                      <label htmlFor="wechat_app_id">应用 ID *</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        id="wechat_app_id"
                        className="input"
                        value={wechatPayForm.app_id}
                        onChange={(e) => setWechatPayForm({ ...wechatPayForm, app_id: e.target.value })}
                        placeholder="输入微信 App ID"
                        required
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div className="form-group">
                      <label htmlFor="serial_no">证书序列号 *</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        id="serial_no"
                        className="input"
                        value={wechatPayForm.serial_no}
                        onChange={(e) => setWechatPayForm({ ...wechatPayForm, serial_no: e.target.value })}
                        placeholder="输入商户API证书序列号"
                        required
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div className="form-group">
                      <label htmlFor="api_v3_key">APIv3密钥 {editingWechatPay && '(留空不修改)'}</label>
                      <input
                        type="password"
                        id="api_v3_key"
                        className="input"
                        value={wechatPayForm.api_v3_key}
                        onChange={(e) => setWechatPayForm({ ...wechatPayForm, api_v3_key: e.target.value })}
                        placeholder="输入APIv3密钥(32位)"
                        required={!editingWechatPay}
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div className="form-group">
                      <label htmlFor="wechat_private_key">商户私钥 {editingWechatPay && '(留空不修改)'}</label>
                      <textarea
                        id="wechat_private_key"
                        className="input"
                        rows="6"
                        value={wechatPayForm.private_key}
                        onChange={(e) => setWechatPayForm({ ...wechatPayForm, private_key: e.target.value })}
                        placeholder="输入商户私钥(PEM格式)"
                        required={!editingWechatPay}
                      />
                      <small className="form-hint">请粘贴完整的PEM格式私钥，包括 BEGIN/END 标记</small>
                    </div>
                    <div className="form-group">
                      <label htmlFor="wechat_notify_url">回调地址 *</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        id="wechat_notify_url"
                        className="input"
                        value={wechatPayForm.notify_url}
                        onChange={(e) => setWechatPayForm({ ...wechatPayForm, notify_url: e.target.value })}
                        placeholder="支付回调地址"
                        required
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div className="form-group">
                      <label className="checkbox-label">
                        <input
                          type="checkbox"
                          checked={wechatPayForm.is_sandbox}
                          onChange={(e) => setWechatPayForm({ ...wechatPayForm, is_sandbox: e.target.checked })}
                        />
                        <span>沙箱环境</span>
                      </label>
                    </div>
                    <div className="modal-actions">
                      <button type="button" className="btn btn-outline" onClick={() => setShowWechatPayModal(false)}>
                        取消
                      </button>
                      <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary" disabled={loading}>
                        {loading ? '保存中...' : editingWechatPay ? '更新' : '创建'}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </form>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
              </>
            )}

            {/* WeChat OAuth Login Configuration */}
            {wechatSubTab === 'oauth' && (
              <>
                <div className="section-header">
                  <h2>微信扫码登录配置</h2>
                  <p>管理微信扫码登录配置</p>
                  <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={handleCreateWechat}>
                    <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" className="icon-inline">
                      <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M10 3a1 1 0 011 1v5h5a1 1 0 110 2h-5v5a1 1 0 11-2 0v-5H4a1 1 0 110-2h5V4a1 1 0 011-1z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
                    </svg>
                    添加配置
                  </button>
                </div>

                {loading ? (
                  <div className="loading-state">
                    <span className="spinner"></span>
                    <span>加载中...</span>
                  </div>
                ) : wechatConfigs.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="no-config-state">
                    <svg width="64" height="64" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" className="empty-icon">
                      <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M18 10c0 3.866-3.582 7-8 7a8.841 8.841 0 01-4.083-.98L2 17l1.338-3.123C2.493 12.767 2 11.434 2 10c0-3.866 3.582-7 8-7s8 3.134 8 7zM7 9H5v2h2V9zm8 0h-2v2h2V9zM9 9h2v2H9V9z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
                    </svg>
                    <p>暂无微信扫码登录配置</p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="config-cards">
                    {wechatConfigs.map((config) => (
                      <div key={config.id} className={`config-card ${config.is_active ? 'active' : ''}`}>
                        <div className="card-header">
                          <h3>微信配置 #{config.id}</h3>
                          {config.is_active && <span className="badge badge-success">已激活</span>}
                        </div>
                        <div className="card-body">
                          <div className="config-row">
                            <label>应用 ID:</label>
                            <span>{config.app_id}</span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="config-row">
                            <label>应用密钥:</label>
                            <SensitiveField
                              value={config.app_secret}
                              isVerified={isVerified}
                              onRequestVerify={handleRequestVerify}
                            />
                          </div>
                          <div className="config-row">
                            <label>回调地址:</label>
                            <span>{config.redirect_uri}</span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="config-row">
                            <label>授权范围:</label>
                            <span>{config.scope}</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="card-actions">
                          {!config.is_active && (
                            <button className="btn btn-success btn-sm" onClick={() => handleActivateWechat(config.id)}>
                              激活
                            </button>
                          )}
                          <button className="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onClick={() => handleEditWechat(config)}>
                            编辑
                          </button>
                          <button className="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onClick={() => handleDeleteWechat(config.id)}>
                            删除
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* WeChat OAuth Modal */}
                {showWechatModal && (
                  <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => setShowWechatModal(false)}>
                    <div className="modal-content" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                      <div className="modal-header">
                        <h3>{editingWechat ? '编辑微信配置' : '添加微信配置'}</h3>
                        <button className="modal-close" onClick={() => setShowWechatModal(false)}>×</button>
                      </div>
                      <form onSubmit={handleSubmitWechat}>
                        <div className="form-group">
                          <label htmlFor="wechat_app_id">应用 ID *</label>
                          <input
                            type="text"
                            id="wechat_app_id"
                            className="input"
                            value={wechatForm.app_id}
                            onChange={(e) => setWechatForm({ ...wechatForm, app_id: e.target.value })}
                            placeholder="输入微信应用 ID"
                            required
                          />
                        </div>
                        <div className="form-group">
                          <label htmlFor="app_secret">应用密钥 {editingWechat && '(留空不修改)'}</label>
                          <input
                            type="password"
                            id="app_secret"
                            className="input"
                            value={wechatForm.app_secret}
                            onChange={(e) => setWechatForm({ ...wechatForm, app_secret: e.target.value })}
                            placeholder="输入应用密钥"
                            required={!editingWechat}
                          />
                        </div>
                        <div className="form-group">
                          <label htmlFor="redirect_uri">回调地址 *</label>
                          <input
                            type="text"
                            id="redirect_uri"
                            className="input"
                            value={wechatForm.redirect_uri}
                            onChange={(e) => setWechatForm({ ...wechatForm, redirect_uri: e.target.value })}
                            placeholder="授权回调地址"
                            required
                          />
                        </div>
                        <div className="form-group">
                          <label htmlFor="scope">授权范围</label>
                          <select
                            id="scope"
                            className="input"
                            value={wechatForm.scope}
                            onChange={(e) => setWechatForm({ ...wechatForm, scope: e.target.value })}
                          >
                            <option value="snsapi_login">网页授权(snsapi_login)</option>
                            <option value="snsapi_base">静默授权(snsapi_base)</option>
                            <option value="snsapi_userinfo">用户信息(snsapi_userinfo)</option>
                          </select>
                        </div>
                        <div className="modal-actions">
                          <button type="button" className="btn btn-outline" onClick={() => setShowWechatModal(false)}>
                            取消
                          </button>
                          <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary" disabled={loading}>
                            {loading ? '保存中...' : '保存'}
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </form>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </>
            )}

            {/* WeChat Official Account Configuration */}
            {wechatSubTab === 'official' && (
              <>
                <div className="section-header">
                  <h2>微信公众号自动回复配置</h2>
                  <p>配置微信公众号服务器信息和AI自动回复功能</p>
                </div>

                {loadingConfig ? (
                  <div className="loading-container">
                    <div className="spinner"></div>
                    <p>加载中...</p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    {/* Webhook URL 展示 */}
                    <div className="info-box mb-4">
                      <h3>服务器地址(URL)</h3>
                      <div className="flex-row-gap mt-sm">
                        <code className="inline-code-block flex-1">
                          {getWebhookUrl()}
                        </code>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          className="btn btn-secondary"
                          onClick={() => {
                            navigator.clipboard.writeText(getWebhookUrl());
                            showToast('已复制到剪贴板', 'success');
                          }}
                        >
                          复制
                        </button>
                      </div>
                      <small>此URL需要配置在微信公众号后台</small>
                    </div>

                    {!savedWechatOfficialConfig && !isEditingWechatOfficial ? (
                      // 无配置且未编辑状态 - 显示创建提示
                      <div className="empty-state">
                        <svg width="64" height="64" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" className="empty-icon subtle-icon">
                          <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M8 10h.01M12 10h.01M16 10h.01M9 16H5a2 2 0 01-2-2V6a2 2 0 012-2h14a2 2 0 012 2v8a2 2 0 01-2 2h-5l-5 5v-5z" />
                        </svg>
                        <p className="text-secondary-sm mb-3">尚未配置微信公众号</p>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          className="btn btn-primary"
                          onClick={handleStartEditingWechatOfficial}
                        >
                          开始配置
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    ) : !isEditingWechatOfficial ? (
                      // 已有配置且未编辑状态 - 显示当前配置
                      <div className="config-display">
                        <div className="config-item">
                          <label>AppID</label>
                          <div className="config-value">{savedWechatOfficialConfig.app_id || '-'}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="config-item">
                          <SensitiveField
                            label="AppSecret"
                            value={realWechatOfficialConfig?.app_secret || savedWechatOfficialConfig.app_secret}
                            isVerified={isVerified}
                            onRequestVerify={() => setShowVerifyModal(true)}
                          />
                        </div>
                        <div className="config-item">
                          <SensitiveField
                            label="Token"
                            value={realWechatOfficialConfig?.token || savedWechatOfficialConfig.token}
                            isVerified={isVerified}
                            onRequestVerify={() => setShowVerifyModal(true)}
                          />
                        </div>
                        <div className="config-item">
                          <SensitiveField
                            label="EncodingAESKey"
                            value={realWechatOfficialConfig?.encoding_aes_key || savedWechatOfficialConfig.encoding_aes_key}
                            isVerified={isVerified}
                            onRequestVerify={() => setShowVerifyModal(true)}
                          />
                        </div>
                        <div className="config-item">
                          <label>消息加密方式</label>
                          <div className="config-value">
                            {savedWechatOfficialConfig.encryption_mode === 'plaintext' && '明文模式'}
                            {savedWechatOfficialConfig.encryption_mode === 'compatible' && '兼容模式'}
                            {savedWechatOfficialConfig.encryption_mode === 'secure' && '安全模式（加密）'}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="config-item">
                          <label>AI自动回复</label>
                          <div className="config-value">
                            {savedWechatOfficialConfig.auto_reply_enabled ? (
                              <span className="text-success">✓ 已启用</span>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-muted">未启用</span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        {savedWechatOfficialConfig.auto_reply_enabled && (
                          <>
                            <div className="config-item">
                              <label>AI模型等级</label>
                              <div className="config-value">
                                {savedWechatOfficialConfig.ai_model_level === 'low' && 'Low - 低成本模型'}
                                {savedWechatOfficialConfig.ai_model_level === 'medium' && 'Medium - 中等模型'}
                                {savedWechatOfficialConfig.ai_model_level === 'high' && 'High - 高级模型'}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                            <div className="config-item">
                              <label>系统提示词</label>
                              <div className="config-value text-pre-wrap">
                                {savedWechatOfficialConfig.system_prompt || '使用默认提示词'}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </>
                        )}
                        <div className="form-actions mt-4">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            className="btn btn-primary"
                            onClick={handleStartEditingWechatOfficial}
                          >
                            修改配置
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      // 编辑状态 - 显示表单
                      <form onSubmit={handleWechatOfficialConfigSubmit} className="settings-form">
                        <div className="form-group">
                          <label htmlFor="app_id">AppID</label>
                          <input
                            type="text"
                            id="app_id"
                            name="app_id"
                            className="input"
                            value={wechatOfficialConfig.app_id}
                            onChange={handleWechatOfficialConfigChange}
                            placeholder="wx1234567890abcdef"
                          />
                          <small className="form-hint">从微信公众号后台获取</small>
                        </div>

                        <div className="form-group">
                          <label htmlFor="app_secret">AppSecret</label>
                          <input
                            type="password"
                            id="app_secret"
                            name="app_secret"
                            className="input"
                            value={wechatOfficialConfig.app_secret}
                            onChange={handleWechatOfficialConfigChange}
                            placeholder={savedWechatOfficialConfig ? "留空表示不修改" : "请输入AppSecret"}
                          />
                          <small className="form-hint">
                            {savedWechatOfficialConfig ? "留空表示不修改当前配置" : "从微信公众号后台获取，请妥善保管"}
                          </small>
                        </div>

                        <div className="form-group">
                          <label htmlFor="token">Token</label>
                          <div className="flex-gap-sm">
                            <input
                              type="text"
                              id="token"
                              name="token"
                              className="input flex-1"
                              value={wechatOfficialConfig.token}
                              onChange={handleWechatOfficialConfigChange}
                              placeholder={savedWechatOfficialConfig ? "留空表示不修改" : "必须为英文或数字，长度为3-32字符"}
                            />
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              className="btn btn-secondary"
                              onClick={handleGenerateToken}
                            >
                              随机生成
                            </button>
                          </div>
                          <small className="form-hint">
                            {savedWechatOfficialConfig ? "留空表示不修改当前配置" : "消息加密密钥，由开发者任意填写"}
                          </small>
                        </div>

                        <div className="form-group">
                          <label htmlFor="encoding_aes_key">EncodingAESKey</label>
                          <div className="flex-gap-sm">
                            <input
                              type="text"
                              id="encoding_aes_key"
                              name="encoding_aes_key"
                              className="input flex-1"
                              value={wechatOfficialConfig.encoding_aes_key}
                              onChange={handleWechatOfficialConfigChange}
                              placeholder={savedWechatOfficialConfig ? "留空表示不修改" : "消息加密密钥由43位字符组成"}
                            />
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              className="btn btn-secondary"
                              onClick={handleGenerateEncodingAESKey}
                            >
                              随机生成
                            </button>
                          </div>
                          <small className="form-hint">
                            {savedWechatOfficialConfig ? "留空表示不修改当前配置" : "消息体加解密密钥，由43位字符组成"}
                          </small>
                        </div>

                        <div className="form-group">
                          <label htmlFor="encryption_mode">消息加密方式</label>
                          <select
                            id="encryption_mode"
                            name="encryption_mode"
                            className="input"
                            value={wechatOfficialConfig.encryption_mode}
                            onChange={handleWechatOfficialConfigChange}
                          >
                            <option value="plaintext">明文模式</option>
                            <option value="compatible">兼容模式</option>
                            <option value="secure">安全模式（加密）</option>
                          </select>
                          <small className="form-hint">
                            {wechatOfficialConfig.encryption_mode === 'plaintext' && '明文模式下，不使用消息体加解密功能，安全系数较低'}
                            {wechatOfficialConfig.encryption_mode === 'compatible' && '兼容模式下，明文、密文将共存，方便开发者调试和维护'}
                            {wechatOfficialConfig.encryption_mode === 'secure' && '安全模式下，消息包为纯密文，需要开发者加密和解密，安全系数高'}
                          </small>
                        </div>

                        <div className="section-divider"></div>

                        <div className="section-header">
                          <h3>AI自动回复配置</h3>
                          <p className="text-secondary-sm">配置AI模型自动回复用户消息</p>
                        </div>

                        <div className="form-group">
                          <label className="checkbox-label">
                            <input
                              type="checkbox"
                              name="auto_reply_enabled"
                              checked={wechatOfficialConfig.auto_reply_enabled}
                              onChange={handleWechatOfficialConfigChange}
                            />
                            <span>启用AI自动回复</span>
                          </label>
                          <small className="form-hint">开启后，用户发送文本消息时将自动调用AI生成回复</small>
                        </div>

                        {wechatOfficialConfig.auto_reply_enabled && (
                          <>
                            <div className="form-group">
                              <label htmlFor="ai_model_level">AI模型等级</label>
                              <select
                                id="ai_model_level"
                                name="ai_model_level"
                                className="input"
                                value={wechatOfficialConfig.ai_model_level}
                                onChange={handleWechatOfficialConfigChange}
                              >
                                <option value="low">Low - 低成本模型（适合简单对话）</option>
                                <option value="medium">Medium - 中等模型（平衡性能和成本）</option>
                                <option value="high">High - 高级模型（最佳回复质量）</option>
                              </select>
                              <small className="form-hint">选择用于自动回复的AI模型等级，需要在"第三方账号管理"中配置对应的AI模型</small>
                            </div>

                            <div className="form-group">
                              <label htmlFor="system_prompt">系统提示词</label>
                              <textarea
                                id="system_prompt"
                                name="system_prompt"
                                className="input resize-vertical min-h-100"
                                value={wechatOfficialConfig.system_prompt}
                                onChange={handleWechatOfficialConfigChange}
                                placeholder="你是一个友好的助手，请简洁准确地回答用户的问题。回复不要超过200字。"
                                rows="4"
                              />
                              <small className="form-hint">配置AI回复用户消息时使用的系统提示词，留空将使用默认提示词</small>
                            </div>
                          </>
                        )}

                        <div className="form-actions">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            className="btn btn-outline"
                            onClick={handleCancelEditingWechatOfficial}
                          >
                            取消
                          </button>
                          <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary" disabled={loading}>
                            {loading ? (
                              <>
                                <span className="spinner"></span>
                                <span className="text-gap-left">保存中...</span>
                              </>
                            ) : (
                              '保存配置'
                            )}
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </form>
                    )}

                    {/* 配置步骤说明 */}
                    <div className="info-box warning mt-4">
                      <h3>配置步骤</h3>
                      <ol className="tip-list">
                        <li>登录微信公众平台，进入"开发" - "基本配置"</li>
                        <li>填写上方的"服务器地址(URL)"</li>
                        <li>填写Token和EncodingAESKey（可使用"随机生成"按钮）</li>
                        <li>选择消息加密方式</li>
                        <li>点击"保存配置"按钮保存设置</li>
                        <li>在微信公众平台点击"提交"进行服务器验证</li>
                        <li>启用"AI自动回复"功能，选择合适的AI模型等级</li>
                      </ol>
                    </div>
                  </>
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Privacy Policy Tab */}
        {activeTab === 'privacy' && (
          <div className="settings-section fade-in">
            <div className="section-header">
              <h2>隐私协议配置</h2>
              <p>编辑用户注册和登录时显示的隐私协议内容,支持Markdown格式</p>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handlePrivacyPolicySubmit} className="settings-form">
              <div className="form-group">
                <label htmlFor="version">版本号</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  id="version"
                  name="version"
                  className="input"
                  value={privacyPolicy.version}
                  onChange={handlePrivacyPolicyChange}
                  placeholder="1.0"
                  required
                />
                <small className="form-hint">更新版本号以标识新版本的隐私协议</small>
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label htmlFor="content">隐私协议内容</label>
                <textarea
                  id="content"
                  name="content"
                  className="textarea"
                  value={privacyPolicy.content}
                  onChange={handlePrivacyPolicyChange}
                  rows={15}
                  placeholder="请输入隐私协议的详细内容...支持Markdown格式"
                  required
                />
                <small className="form-hint">支持Markdown格式,用户端会以美化的格式展示</small>
              </div>

              <div className="form-actions">
                <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary" disabled={loading}>
                  {loading ? (
                    <>
                      <span className="spinner"></span>
                      <span className="text-gap-left">更新中...</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    '更新隐私协议'
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Terms of Service Tab */}
        {activeTab === 'terms' && (
          <div className="settings-section fade-in">
            <div className="section-header">
              <h2>用户协议配置</h2>
              <p>编辑用户注册和登录时显示的用户协议内容,支持Markdown格式</p>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleTermsOfServiceSubmit} className="settings-form">
              <div className="form-group">
                <label htmlFor="terms-version">版本号</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  id="terms-version"
                  name="version"
                  className="input"
                  value={termsOfService.version}
                  onChange={handleTermsOfServiceChange}
                  placeholder="1.0"
                  required
                />
                <small className="form-hint">更新版本号以标识新版本的用户协议</small>
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label htmlFor="terms-content">用户协议内容</label>
                <textarea
                  id="terms-content"
                  name="content"
                  className="textarea"
                  value={termsOfService.content}
                  onChange={handleTermsOfServiceChange}
                  rows={15}
                  placeholder="请输入用户协议的详细内容...支持Markdown格式"
                  required
                />
                <small className="form-hint">支持Markdown格式,用户端会以美化的格式展示</small>
              </div>

              <div className="form-actions">
                <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary" disabled={loading}>
                  {loading ? (
                    <>
                      <span className="spinner"></span>
                      <span className="text-gap-left">更新中...</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    '更新用户协议'
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* GitHub OAuth Configuration Tab */}
        {activeTab === 'github' && (
          <div className="settings-section fade-in">
            <div className="section-header">
              <h2>GitHub 登录配置</h2>
              <p>配置 GitHub App 或 OAuth App 以支持用户通过 GitHub 账号登录</p>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleGithubConfigSubmit} className="settings-form">
              <div className="form-group">
                <label htmlFor="githubClientId">Client ID</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  id="githubClientId"
                  className="input"
                  value={githubConfig.githubClientId}
                  onChange={(e) => setGithubConfig({
                    ...githubConfig,
                    githubClientId: e.target.value
                  })}
                  placeholder="Iv1.1234567890abcdef"
                  required
                />
                <small className="form-hint">从 GitHub App 或 OAuth App 设置中获取</small>
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label htmlFor="githubClientSecret">Client Secret</label>
                <input
                  type="password"
                  id="githubClientSecret"
                  className="input"
                  value={githubConfig.githubClientSecret}
                  onChange={(e) => setGithubConfig({
                    ...githubConfig,
                    githubClientSecret: e.target.value
                  })}
                  placeholder="输入 Client Secret"
                  required
                />
                <small className="form-hint">从 GitHub App 或 OAuth App 设置中获取（请妥善保管，不要泄露）</small>
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label htmlFor="githubDomain">网站域名</label>
                <input
                  type="url"
                  id="githubDomain"
                  className="input"
                  value={githubConfig.githubRedirectUri}
                  onChange={(e) => setGithubConfig({
                    ...githubConfig,
                    githubRedirectUri: e.target.value
                  })}
                  placeholder="https://scholar.example.com"
                  required
                />
                <small className="form-hint">填写您的网站域名（包含 http:// 或 https://，不要以 / 结尾）</small>
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label htmlFor="githubCallbackUrl">完整回调地址（自动生成）</label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    id="githubCallbackUrl"
                    className="input readonly-input"
                    value={githubConfig.githubRedirectUri ? `${githubConfig.githubRedirectUri.replace(/\/$/, '')}/github/callback` : '请先填写网站域名'}
                    readOnly
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="copy-button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (githubConfig.githubRedirectUri) {
                        const url = `${githubConfig.githubRedirectUri.replace(/\/$/, '')}/github/callback`;
                        navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
                        showToast('回调地址已复制到剪贴板', 'success');
                      }
                    }}
                    disabled={!githubConfig.githubRedirectUri}
                  >
                    复制
                  </button>
                </div>
                <small className="form-hint">
                  根据您的域名自动生成，复制此地址到 GitHub App 或 OAuth App 的 Callback URL 配置中
                </small>
              </div>

              <div className="divider"></div>

              <div className="info-box">
                <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" className="icon-inline-lg">
                  <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M18 10a8 8 0 11-16 0 8 8 0 0116 0zm-7-4a1 1 0 11-2 0 1 1 0 012 0zM9 9a1 1 0 000 2v3a1 1 0 001 1h1a1 1 0 100-2v-3a1 1 0 00-1-1H9z" clipRule="evenodd"/>
                </svg>
                <div>
                  <strong>如何创建 GitHub App（推荐方式）：</strong>
                  <ol className="tip-list">
                    <li>访问 GitHub Settings → Developer settings → GitHub Apps</li>
                    <li>点击 "New GitHub App" 创建新应用</li>
                    <li>填写基本信息（App name, Homepage URL, Description）</li>
                    <li><strong>Callback URL</strong>：填写上面配置的回调地址</li>
                    <li><strong>权限设置</strong>：在 "Account permissions" 中选择：
                      <ul className="tip-list">
                        <li>Email addresses: Read-only（必需，用于获取用户邮箱）</li>
                      </ul>
                    </li>
                    <li>取消勾选 "Webhook" 相关选项（不需要接收 webhook）</li>
                    <li><strong>Where can this GitHub App be installed?</strong> 选择 "Any account"</li>
                    <li>创建后，进入 App 设置页面：
                      <ul className="tip-list">
                        <li>复制 <strong>Client ID</strong></li>
                        <li>点击 "Generate a new client secret" 生成并复制 <strong>Client Secret</strong></li>
                      </ul>
                    </li>
                    <li>将获取的信息填入上方表单并保存</li>
                  </ol>
                  <div className="hint-box">
                    <strong className="text-brand">💡 提示：</strong>
                    <ul className="tip-list">
                      <li>GitHub App 是 GitHub 官方推荐的方式，比传统 OAuth App 更安全、权限控制更细</li>
                      <li>如果已有 OAuth App，也可以继续使用（向下兼容）</li>
                      <li>Client Secret 只显示一次，请妥善保存</li>
                    </ul>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="form-actions">
                <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary" disabled={loading}>
                  {loading ? (
                    <>
                      <span className="spinner"></span>
                      <span className="text-gap-left">保存中...</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    '保存配置'
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* System Configuration Tab */}
        {activeTab === 'system' && (
          <div className="settings-section fade-in">
            <div className="section-header">
              <h2>系统配置</h2>
              <p>配置系统级别的功能设置</p>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleSystemConfigSubmit} className="settings-form">
              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="toggle-label">
                  <span className="toggle-label-text">
                    <span className="toggle-title">邮箱验证码验证</span>
                    <small className="form-hint">启用后，用户登录和注册时需要输入邮箱验证码</small>
                  </span>
                  <label className="switch">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={systemConfig.requireEmailVerification}
                      onChange={(e) => setSystemConfig({
                        ...systemConfig,
                        requireEmailVerification: e.target.checked
                      })}
                    />
                    <span className="slider"></span>
                  </label>
                </label>
              </div>

              <div className="divider"></div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label className="toggle-label">
                  <span className="toggle-label-text">
                    <span className="toggle-title">Cloudflare Turnstile 人机验证</span>
                    <small className="form-hint">启用后，用户登录和注册时需要通过 Turnstile 人机验证</small>
                  </span>
                  <label className="switch">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={systemConfig.enableTurnstile}
                      onChange={(e) => setSystemConfig({
                        ...systemConfig,
                        enableTurnstile: e.target.checked
                      })}
                    />
                    <span className="slider"></span>
                  </label>
                </label>
              </div>

              {systemConfig.enableTurnstile && (
                <>
                  <div className="form-row">
                    <div className="form-group">
                      <label htmlFor="turnstileSiteKey">Turnstile Site Key (公钥)</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        id="turnstileSiteKey"
                        className="input"
                        value={systemConfig.turnstileSiteKey}
                        onChange={(e) => setSystemConfig({
                          ...systemConfig,
                          turnstileSiteKey: e.target.value
                        })}
                        placeholder="1x00000000000000000000AA (测试密钥)"
                      />
                      <small className="form-hint">从 Cloudflare Turnstile 控制台获取</small>
                    </div>
                    <div className="form-group">
                      <label htmlFor="turnstileSecretKey">Turnstile Secret Key (私钥)</label>
                      <input
                        type="password"
                        id="turnstileSecretKey"
                        className="input"
                        value={systemConfig.turnstileSecretKey}
                        onChange={(e) => setSystemConfig({
                          ...systemConfig,
                          turnstileSecretKey: e.target.value
                        })}
                        placeholder="1x0000000000000000000000000000000AA (测试密钥)"
                      />
                      <small className="form-hint">从 Cloudflare Turnstile 控制台获取</small>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </>
              )}

              <div className="form-actions">
                <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary" disabled={loading}>
                  {loading ? (
                    <>
                      <span className="spinner"></span>
                      <span className="text-gap-left">保存中...</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    '保存配置'
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Verify Password Modal */}
      <VerifyPasswordModal
        isOpen={showVerifyModal}
        onClose={() => setShowVerifyModal(false)}
        onVerified={handleVerified}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default SystemSettings;

// ========== 文件: frontend-admin/src/pages/ThirdPartyAccounts.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { adminAPI } from '../services/api';
import { showToast } from '../components/Toast';
import './ThirdPartyAccounts.css';

const ThirdPartyAccounts = () => {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [accounts, setAccounts] = useState([]);
  const [stats, setStats] = useState(null);
  const [showModal, setShowModal] = useState(false);
  const [editingAccount, setEditingAccount] = useState(null);
  const [filterType, setFilterType] = useState('');
  const [filterActive, setFilterActive] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: '',
    type: 'semantic_scholar',
    config: {
      api_key: '',
      base_url: '',
      model_low: '',
      model_mid: '',
      model_high: '',
    },
    status: 1,
    priority: 0,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    loadAccounts();
    loadStats();
  }, [filterType, filterActive]);

  const loadAccounts = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await adminAPI.getThirdPartyAccounts(filterType, filterActive);
      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
        setAccounts(response.data.data.accounts || []);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showToast('加载账号列表失败', 'error');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const loadStats = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await adminAPI.getThirdPartyAccountStats();
      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
        setStats(response.data.data);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load stats:', err);
    }
  };

  const handleCreate = () => {
    setEditingAccount(null);
    setFormData({
      name: '',
      type: 'semantic_scholar',
      config: {
        api_key: '',
        base_url: '',
        model_low: '',
        model_mid: '',
        model_high: '',
      },
      status: 1,
      priority: 0,
    });
    setShowModal(true);
  };

  const handleEdit = (account) => {
    setEditingAccount(account);
    setFormData({
      name: account.name,
      type: account.type,
      config: account.config || {},
      status: account.status,
      priority: account.priority || 0,
    });
    setShowModal(true);
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm('确认删除此账号？')) return;

    try {
      const response = await adminAPI.deleteThirdPartyAccount(id);
      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        showToast('删除成功', 'success');
        loadAccounts();
        loadStats();
      } else {
        showToast(response.data.message || '删除失败', 'error');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showToast('删除失败', 'error');
    }
  };

  const handleTest = async (id) => {
    try {
      const response = await adminAPI.testThirdPartyAccount(id);
      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        showToast('测试成功: ' + response.data.data.message, 'success');
      } else {
        showToast('测试失败: ' + response.data.message, 'error');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showToast('测试失败', 'error');
    }
  };

  const handleRefreshCache = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await adminAPI.refreshThirdPartyAccountCache();
      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        showToast('缓存刷新成功', 'success');
      } else {
        showToast('刷新失败: ' + response.data.message, 'error');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showToast('刷新失败', 'error');
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    // Prepare config based on account type
    let config = {};
    if (formData.type === 'semantic_scholar') {
      if (!formData.config.api_key) {
        showToast('请输入API Key', 'error');
        return;
      }
      config = { api_key: formData.config.api_key };
    } else if (formData.type === 'ai_model') {
      if (!formData.config.base_url || !formData.config.api_key) {
        showToast('请输入Base URL和API Key', 'error');
        return;
      }
      config = {
        base_url: formData.config.base_url,
        api_key: formData.config.api_key,
      };
      // Add model codes if provided
      if (formData.config.model_low) {
        config.model_low = formData.config.model_low;
      }
      if (formData.config.model_mid) {
        config.model_mid = formData.config.model_mid;
      }
      if (formData.config.model_high) {
        config.model_high = formData.config.model_high;
      }
    }

    const data = {
      name: formData.name,
      type: formData.type,
      config,
      status: formData.status,
      priority: formData.priority,
    };

    try {
      let response;
      if (editingAccount) {
        response = await adminAPI.updateThirdPartyAccount(editingAccount.id, data);
      } else {
        response = await adminAPI.createThirdPartyAccount(data);
      }

      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        showToast(editingAccount ? '更新成功' : '创建成功', 'success');
        setShowModal(false);
        loadAccounts();
        loadStats();
      } else {
        showToast(response.data.message || '操作失败', 'error');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showToast('操作失败', 'error');
    }
  };

  const formatDate = (dateString) => {
    if (!dateString) return '从未使用';
    const date = new Date(dateString);
    return date.toLocaleString('zh-CN');
  };

  // 格式化为相对时间（更友好的显示）
  const formatRelativeTime = (dateString) => {
    if (!dateString) return '从未使用';
    
    const date = new Date(dateString);
    const now = new Date();
    const diffMs = now - date;
    const diffSeconds = Math.floor(diffMs / 1000);
    const diffMinutes = Math.floor(diffSeconds / 60);
    const diffHours = Math.floor(diffMinutes / 60);
    const diffDays = Math.floor(diffHours / 24);
    const diffWeeks = Math.floor(diffDays / 7);
    const diffMonths = Math.floor(diffDays / 30);

    if (diffSeconds < 30) {
      return '刚刚';
    } else if (diffSeconds < 60) {
      return `${diffSeconds}秒前`;
    } else if (diffMinutes < 60) {
      return `${diffMinutes}分钟前`;
    } else if (diffHours < 24) {
      return `${diffHours}小时前`;
    } else if (diffDays < 7) {
      return `${diffDays}天前`;
    } else if (diffWeeks < 4) {
      return `${diffWeeks}周前`;
    } else if (diffMonths < 12) {
      return `${diffMonths}个月前`;
    } else {
      return date.toLocaleDateString('zh-CN');
    }
  };

  // 格式化数字（添加千分位）
  const formatNumber = (num) => {
    if (num === undefined || num === null) return '0';
    return num.toLocaleString('zh-CN');
  };

  const getAccountTypeLabel = (type) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'semantic_scholar':
        return <span className="type-badge type-scholar">Semantic Scholar</span>;
      case 'ai_model':
        return <span className="type-badge type-ai">AI模型</span>;
      default:
        return <span className="type-badge">{type}</span>;
    }
  };

  const getStatusLabel = (status) => {
    return status === 1 ? (
      <span className="status-badge status-active">启用</span>
    ) : (
      <span className="status-badge status-inactive">停用</span>
    );
  };

  const getModelCodesLabel = (config) => {
    if (!config) return '-';
    const models = [];
    if (config.model_low) models.push(`Low: ${config.model_low}`);
    if (config.model_mid) models.push(`Mid: ${config.model_mid}`);
    if (config.model_high) models.push(`High: ${config.model_high}`);
    return models.length > 0 ? models.join(' / ') : '-';
  };

  return (
    <div className="third-party-accounts">
      <div className="page-header">
        <h2>第三方账号配置</h2>
        <div className="header-actions">
          <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={handleRefreshCache}>
            刷新缓存
          </button>
          <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={handleCreate}>
            添加账号
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {stats && (
        <>
          {/* 总览统计 */}
          <div className="stats-cards">
            <div className="stat-card">
              <div className="stat-label">总账号数</div>
              <div className="stat-value">{stats.total || 0}</div>
            </div>
            <div className="stat-card">
              <div className="stat-label">启用账号</div>
              <div className="stat-value">{stats.active_count || 0}</div>
            </div>
            <div className="stat-card">
              <div className="stat-label">总请求次数</div>
              <div className="stat-value">{formatNumber(stats.total_usage || 0)}</div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 按类型统计 */}
          {stats.type_stats && stats.type_stats.length > 0 && (
            <div className="type-stats-section">
              <h3 className="section-title">按类型统计</h3>
              <div className="type-stats-cards">
                {stats.type_stats.map((typeStat) => (
                  <div key={typeStat.type} className={`type-stat-card type-stat-${typeStat.type}`}>
                    <div className="type-stat-header">
                      <span className="type-stat-name">{typeStat.type_name}</span>
                      <span className="type-stat-badge">{typeStat.type}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="type-stat-body">
                      <div className="type-stat-item">
                        <span className="type-stat-label">账号数</span>
                        <span className="type-stat-value">
                          {typeStat.active_count} / {typeStat.total_count}
                          <span className="type-stat-unit">启用/总数</span>
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="type-stat-item">
                        <span className="type-stat-label">总请求次数</span>
                        <span className="type-stat-value">{formatNumber(typeStat.total_usage)}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="type-stat-item">
                        <span className="type-stat-label">最后使用</span>
                        <span className="type-stat-value type-stat-time" title={formatDate(typeStat.last_used_at)}>
                          {formatRelativeTime(typeStat.last_used_at)}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}

      <div className="filters">
        <select
          value={filterType}
          onChange={(e) => setFilterType(e.target.value)}
          className="filter-select"
        >
          <option value="">全部类型</option>
          <option value="semantic_scholar">Semantic Scholar</option>
          <option value="ai_model">AI模型</option>
        </select>
        <label className="filter-checkbox">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={filterActive}
            onChange={(e) => setFilterActive(e.target.checked)}
          />
          <span>仅显示启用账号</span>
        </label>
      </div>

      <div className="accounts-table-container">
        {loading ? (
          <div className="loading">加载中...</div>
        ) : accounts.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="empty-state">暂无账号</div>
        ) : (
          <table className="accounts-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>ID</th>
                <th>名称</th>
                <th>类型</th>
                <th>优先级</th>
                <th>模型编码</th>
                <th>状态</th>
                <th>使用次数</th>
                <th>最后使用时间</th>
                <th>创建时间</th>
                <th>操作</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {accounts.map((account) => (
                <tr key={account.id}>
                  <td>{account.id}</td>
                  <td>{account.name}</td>
                  <td>{getAccountTypeLabel(account.type)}</td>
                  <td>
                    <span className={`priority-badge priority-${account.priority || 0}`}>
                      {account.priority || 0}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="model-codes-cell">{account.type === 'ai_model' ? getModelCodesLabel(account.config) : '-'}</td>
                  <td>{getStatusLabel(account.status)}</td>
                  <td>{account.usage_count || 0}</td>
                  <td>{formatDate(account.last_used_at)}</td>
                  <td>{formatDate(account.created_at)}</td>
                  <td>
                    <div className="action-buttons">
                      <button
                        className="btn-action btn-test"
                        onClick={() => handleTest(account.id)}
                        title="测试"
                      >
                        测试
                      </button>
                      <button
                        className="btn-action btn-edit"
                        onClick={() => handleEdit(account)}
                        title="编辑"
                      >
                        编辑
                      </button>
                      <button
                        className="btn-action btn-delete"
                        onClick={() => handleDelete(account.id)}
                        title="删除"
                      >
                        删除
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        )}
      </div>

      {showModal && (
        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={() => setShowModal(false)}>
          <div className="modal-content" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div className="modal-header">
              <h3>{editingAccount ? '编辑账号' : '添加账号'}</h3>
              <button className="modal-close" onClick={() => setShowModal(false)}>
                ×
              </button>
            </div>
            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', flex: 1, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
              <div className="modal-body" style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto' }}>
              <div className="form-group">
                <label>账号名称</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.name}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="请输入账号名称"
                  required
                />
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label>账号类型</label>
                <select
                  value={formData.type}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, type: e.target.value })}
                  disabled={!!editingAccount}
                  required
                >
                  <option value="semantic_scholar">Semantic Scholar</option>
                  <option value="ai_model">AI模型</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              {formData.type === 'semantic_scholar' && (
                <div className="form-group">
                  <label>API Key</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={formData.config.api_key || ''}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setFormData({
                        ...formData,
                        config: { ...formData.config, api_key: e.target.value },
                      })
                    }
                    placeholder="请输入Semantic Scholar API Key"
                    required
                  />
                </div>
              )}

              {formData.type === 'ai_model' && (
                <>
                  <div className="form-group">
                    <label>Base URL</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={formData.config.base_url || ''}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setFormData({
                          ...formData,
                          config: { ...formData.config, base_url: e.target.value },
                        })
                      }
                      placeholder="https://api.example.com"
                      required
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div className="form-group">
                    <label>API Key</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={formData.config.api_key || ''}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setFormData({
                          ...formData,
                          config: { ...formData.config, api_key: e.target.value },
                        })
                      }
                      placeholder="请输入API Key"
                      required
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="model-codes-section">
                    <h4>模型编码配置</h4>
                    <small style={{ color: '#9ca3af', fontSize: '12px', marginBottom: '1rem', display: 'block' }}>
                      为不同级别的任务配置对应的模型编码。至少配置一个模型编码。
                    </small>

                    <div className="form-group">
                      <label>低级模型编码（Low）</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={formData.config.model_low || ''}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          setFormData({
                            ...formData,
                            config: { ...formData.config, model_low: e.target.value },
                          })
                        }
                        placeholder="例如: gpt-3.5-turbo, claude-3-haiku"
                      />
                      <small style={{ color: '#9ca3af', fontSize: '11px', marginTop: '4px', display: 'block' }}>
                        用于普通任务和基础对话
                      </small>
                    </div>

                    <div className="form-group">
                      <label>中级模型编码（Mid）</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={formData.config.model_mid || ''}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          setFormData({
                            ...formData,
                            config: { ...formData.config, model_mid: e.target.value },
                          })
                        }
                        placeholder="例如: gpt-4, claude-3-sonnet"
                      />
                      <small style={{ color: '#9ca3af', fontSize: '11px', marginTop: '4px', display: 'block' }}>
                        用于复杂分析和深度对话
                      </small>
                    </div>

                    <div className="form-group">
                      <label>高级模型编码（High）</label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={formData.config.model_high || ''}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          setFormData({
                            ...formData,
                            config: { ...formData.config, model_high: e.target.value },
                          })
                        }
                        placeholder="例如: gpt-4-turbo, claude-3-opus"
                      />
                      <small style={{ color: '#9ca3af', fontSize: '11px', marginTop: '4px', display: 'block' }}>
                        用于最高质量的任务和专业分析
                      </small>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </>
              )}

              <div className="form-group">
                <label>优先级</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  value={formData.priority}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, priority: parseInt(e.target.value) || 0 })}
                  min="0"
                  placeholder="0"
                />
                <small style={{ color: '#9ca3af', fontSize: '11px', marginTop: '4px', display: 'block' }}>
                  数字越小优先级越高，相同优先级的账号会随机选择
                </small>
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label>状态</label>
                <select
                  value={formData.status}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, status: parseInt(e.target.value) })}
                  required
                >
                  <option value="1">启用</option>
                  <option value="0">停用</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              </div>

              <div className="modal-actions">
                <button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={() => setShowModal(false)}>
                  取消
                </button>
                <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary">
                  {editingAccount ? '保存' : '创建'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default ThirdPartyAccounts;

// ========== 文件: frontend-admin/src/pages/UserManagement.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { adminAPI } from '../services/api';
import { showToast } from '../components/Toast';
import UserStatisticsChart from '../components/UserStatisticsChart';
import OnlineUserChart from '../components/OnlineUserChart';
import UserDetailDrawer from '../components/UserDetailDrawer';
import './UserManagement.css';

const UserManagement = () => {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [stats, setStats] = useState({
    onlineUsers: 0,
    todayRegistrations: 0,
    weekRegistrations: 0,
    monthRegistrations: 0,
    yearRegistrations: 0,
  });
  const [users, setUsers] = useState([]);
  const [onlineUsersList, setOnlineUsersList] = useState([]);
  const [pagination, setPagination] = useState({
    page: 1,
    pageSize: 20,
    total: 0,
  });
  const [sortConfig, setSortConfig] = useState({
    sortBy: 'last_login_at',
    sortOrder: 'desc',
  });
  const [activeView, setActiveView] = useState('list'); // 'list' or 'online'
  const [deleteConfirm, setDeleteConfirm] = useState({ show: false, userId: null, userEmail: '' });
  const [selectedUserId, setSelectedUserId] = useState(null);
  const [grantModal, setGrantModal] = useState({ show: false, user: null });
  const [grantForm, setGrantForm] = useState({ planCode: '', billingCycle: 'monthly', reason: '' });
  const [subscriptionPlans, setSubscriptionPlans] = useState([]);
  const [grantLoading, setGrantLoading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadUserStatistics();
    loadUserList();
    loadSubscriptionPlans();
  }, [pagination.page, sortConfig]);

  const loadSubscriptionPlans = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await adminAPI.getSubscriptionPlans();
      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
        // Filter out free plan
        const paidPlans = response.data.data.filter(plan => plan.plan_code !== 'FREE');
        setSubscriptionPlans(paidPlans);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load subscription plans:', err);
    }
  };

  const loadUserStatistics = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await adminAPI.getUserStatistics();
      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
        setStats({
          onlineUsers: response.data.data.online_users || 0,
          todayRegistrations: response.data.data.today_registrations || 0,
          weekRegistrations: response.data.data.week_registrations || 0,
          monthRegistrations: response.data.data.month_registrations || 0,
          yearRegistrations: response.data.data.year_registrations || 0,
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load user statistics:', err);
    }
  };

  const loadUserList = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await adminAPI.getUserList(
        pagination.page, 
        pagination.pageSize,
        sortConfig.sortBy,
        sortConfig.sortOrder
      );
      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
        setUsers(response.data.data.users || []);
        setPagination(prev => ({
          ...prev,
          total: response.data.data.total || 0,
        }));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showToast('加载用户列表失败', 'error');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const loadOnlineUsers = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await adminAPI.getOnlineUsers();
      if (response.data.code === 0 && response.data.data) {
        setOnlineUsersList(response.data.data.online_users || []);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showToast('加载在线用户失败', 'error');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleViewChange = (view) => {
    setActiveView(view);
    if (view === 'online') {
      loadOnlineUsers();
    }
  };

  const handlePageChange = (newPage) => {
    setPagination(prev => ({ ...prev, page: newPage }));
  };

  const handleDeleteClick = (user) => {
    setDeleteConfirm({
      show: true,
      userId: user.id,
      userEmail: user.email || user.username || `用户ID: ${user.id}`,
    });
  };

  const handleDeleteConfirm = async () => {
    if (!deleteConfirm.userId) return;

    try {
      const response = await adminAPI.deleteUser(deleteConfirm.userId);
      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        showToast('用户删除成功', 'success');
        setDeleteConfirm({ show: false, userId: null, userEmail: '' });
        // Refresh the user list and statistics
        loadUserList();
        loadUserStatistics();
      } else {
        showToast(response.data.message || '删除失败', 'error');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(err.response?.data?.message || '删除用户失败', 'error');
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteCancel = () => {
    setDeleteConfirm({ show: false, userId: null, userEmail: '' });
  };

  // Grant subscription handlers
  const handleGrantClick = (user) => {
    setGrantModal({ show: true, user });
    setGrantForm({ planCode: subscriptionPlans[0]?.plan_code || '', billingCycle: 'monthly', reason: '' });
  };

  const handleGrantCancel = () => {
    setGrantModal({ show: false, user: null });
    setGrantForm({ planCode: '', billingCycle: 'monthly', reason: '' });
  };

  const handleGrantConfirm = async () => {
    if (!grantModal.user || !grantForm.planCode) {
      showToast('请选择会员套餐', 'error');
      return;
    }

    setGrantLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await adminAPI.grantSubscription(
        grantModal.user.id,
        grantForm.planCode,
        grantForm.billingCycle,
        grantForm.reason
      );
      if (response.data.code === 0) {
        showToast('会员套餐发放成功', 'success');
        handleGrantCancel();
        // Refresh the user list
        loadUserList();
      } else {
        showToast(response.data.message || '发放失败', 'error');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(err.response?.data?.message || '发放会员套餐失败', 'error');
    } finally {
      setGrantLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // 格式化为相对时间
  const formatRelativeTime = (dateString) => {
    if (!dateString) return '从未登录';
    const date = new Date(dateString);
    const now = new Date();
    const diffMs = now - date;
    const diffSeconds = Math.floor(diffMs / 1000);
    const diffMinutes = Math.floor(diffSeconds / 60);
    const diffHours = Math.floor(diffMinutes / 60);
    const diffDays = Math.floor(diffHours / 24);
    const diffMonths = Math.floor(diffDays / 30);
    const diffYears = Math.floor(diffDays / 365);

    if (diffSeconds < 60) return '刚刚';
    if (diffMinutes < 60) return `${diffMinutes}分钟前`;
    if (diffHours < 24) {
      if (diffMinutes >= 30 && diffHours < 1) return '半小时前';
      return `${diffHours}小时前`;
    }
    if (diffDays < 30) return `${diffDays}天前`;
    if (diffMonths < 12) return `${diffMonths}个月前`;
    return `${diffYears}年前`;
  };

  // 格式化为精确时间
  const formatDate = (dateString) => {
    if (!dateString) return '从未登录';
    const date = new Date(dateString);
    return date.toLocaleString('zh-CN');
  };

  // 处理排序点击
  const handleSort = (field) => {
    setSortConfig(prev => ({
      sortBy: field,
      sortOrder: prev.sortBy === field && prev.sortOrder === 'desc' ? 'asc' : 'desc',
    }));
    // 重置到第一页
    setPagination(prev => ({ ...prev, page: 1 }));
  };

  // 获取排序图标
  const getSortIcon = (field) => {
    if (sortConfig.sortBy !== field) {
      return <span className="sort-icon">↕</span>;
    }
    return sortConfig.sortOrder === 'desc' 
      ? <span className="sort-icon active">↓</span> 
      : <span className="sort-icon active">↑</span>;
  };

  const getUserStatusLabel = (status) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 1:
        return <span className="status-badge status-active">正常</span>;
      case 0:
        return <span className="status-badge status-inactive">未激活</span>;
      case 2:
        return <span className="status-badge status-suspended">已封禁</span>;
      default:
        return <span className="status-badge">未知</span>;
    }
  };

  // 渲染联系方式列（包含邮箱、手机号、微信、GitHub）
  const renderSubscriptionPlan = (subscription) => {
    if (!subscription) {
      return <span className="plan-badge plan-free">免费</span>;
    }

    const planClass = `plan-badge plan-${subscription.plan_code}`;
    return (
      <span className={planClass}>
        {subscription.plan_name || subscription.plan_code}
      </span>
    );
  };

  const renderSubscriptionExpiry = (subscription) => {
    if (!subscription || !subscription.end_date) {
      return <span className="expiry-none">-</span>;
    }

    const endDate = new Date(subscription.end_date);
    const remainingDays = subscription.remaining_days;

    let expiryClass = 'expiry-normal';
    let warningIcon = null;

    if (remainingDays <= 0) {
      expiryClass = 'expiry-expired';
      warningIcon = '❌';
    } else if (remainingDays <= 3) {
      expiryClass = 'expiry-critical';
      warningIcon = '🔴';
    } else if (remainingDays <= 7) {
      expiryClass = 'expiry-warning';
      warningIcon = '⚠️';
    } else if (remainingDays <= 30) {
      expiryClass = 'expiry-soon';
    }

    return (
      <div className={`subscription-expiry ${expiryClass}`}>
        <div className="expiry-date">
          {warningIcon && <span className="expiry-icon">{warningIcon}</span>}
          {endDate.toLocaleDateString('zh-CN')}
        </div>
        <div className="expiry-days">
          剩余 {remainingDays} 天
        </div>
        {subscription.auto_renew && (
          <div className="expiry-auto-renew">自动续费</div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  };

  const renderContactInfo = (user) => {
    const contactInfo = [];

    if (user.email) {
      contactInfo.push(
        <div key="email" className="contact-info-detail">
          <span className="info-label">邮箱:</span> {user.email}
        </div>
      );
    }
    if (user.phone) {
      contactInfo.push(
        <div key="phone" className="contact-info-detail">
          <span className="info-label">手机:</span> {user.phone}
        </div>
      );
    }
    if (user.wechat_name) {
      contactInfo.push(
        <div key="wechat_name" className="contact-info-detail">
          <span className="info-label">微信:</span> {user.wechat_name}
