        </div>
      );
    } else if (user.wechat_openid) {
      contactInfo.push(
        <div key="wechat_openid" className="contact-info-detail">
          <span className="info-label">微信:</span> 微信用户
        </div>
      );
    }
    if (user.wechat_union_id) {
      contactInfo.push(
        <div key="wechat_union_id" className="contact-info-detail">
          <span className="info-label">UnionID:</span> {user.wechat_union_id}
        </div>
      );
    }
    if (user.github_login) {
      contactInfo.push(
        <div key="github_login" className="contact-info-detail">
          <span className="info-label">GitHub:</span> {user.github_login}
        </div>
      );
    }

    if (contactInfo.length === 0) {
      return <span className="empty-contact">-</span>;
    }

    return (
      <div className="contact-info-cell">
        {contactInfo.map((info, index) => (
          <React.Fragment key={index}>
            {index > 0 && <div className="contact-info-divider"></div>}
            {info}
          </React.Fragment>
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  };

  const totalPages = Math.ceil(pagination.total / pagination.pageSize);

  return (
    <div className="user-management-container">
      <div className="page-header">
        <h1>用户管理</h1>
        <p>查看和管理注册用户</p>
      </div>

      {/* Statistics Cards */}
      <div className="stats-grid">
        <div className="stat-card">
          <div className="stat-icon stat-icon-success">
            <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle>
              <path d="M12 6v6l4 2"></path>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div className="stat-content">
            <div className="stat-label">在线用户</div>
            <div className="stat-value">{stats.onlineUsers}</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="stat-card">
          <div className="stat-icon stat-icon-primary">
            <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <path d="M12 2v20M17 5H9.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 0 0 7h5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0 7H6"></path>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div className="stat-content">
            <div className="stat-label">今日注册</div>
            <div className="stat-value">{stats.todayRegistrations}</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="stat-card">
          <div className="stat-icon stat-icon-info">
            <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="18" rx="2" ry="2"></rect>
              <line x1="16" y1="2" x2="16" y2="6"></line>
              <line x1="8" y1="2" x2="8" y2="6"></line>
              <line x1="3" y1="10" x2="21" y2="10"></line>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div className="stat-content">
            <div className="stat-label">本周注册</div>
            <div className="stat-value">{stats.weekRegistrations}</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="stat-card">
          <div className="stat-icon stat-icon-warning">
            <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="18" rx="2" ry="2"></rect>
              <line x1="16" y1="2" x2="16" y2="6"></line>
              <line x1="8" y1="2" x2="8" y2="6"></line>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div className="stat-content">
            <div className="stat-label">本月注册</div>
            <div className="stat-value">{stats.monthRegistrations}</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="stat-card">
          <div className="stat-icon stat-icon-danger">
            <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
              <rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="18" rx="2" ry="2"></rect>
              <line x1="16" y1="2" x2="16" y2="6"></line>
              <line x1="8" y1="2" x2="8" y2="6"></line>
              <path d="M8 14h.01M12 14h.01M16 14h.01"></path>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div className="stat-content">
            <div className="stat-label">今年注册</div>
            <div className="stat-value">{stats.yearRegistrations}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Charts Section */}
      <div className="charts-section">
        <div className="chart-card">
          <div className="chart-header">
            <h3>用户注册趋势</h3>
          </div>
          <UserStatisticsChart />
        </div>

        <div className="chart-card">
          <div className="chart-header">
            <h3>在线用户趋势</h3>
          </div>
          <OnlineUserChart />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* View Toggle */}
      <div className="view-toggle">
        <button
          className={`toggle-btn ${activeView === 'list' ? 'active' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => handleViewChange('list')}
        >
          全部用户
        </button>
        <button
          className={`toggle-btn ${activeView === 'online' ? 'active' : ''}`}
          onClick={() => handleViewChange('online')}
        >
          在线用户
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* User List */}
      <div className="user-table-container">
        {loading ? (
          <div className="loading-container">
            <span className="spinner"></span>
            <p>加载中...</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            {activeView === 'list' && (
              <>
                <table className="user-table">
                  <thead>
                    <tr>
                      <th>用户</th>
                      <th>联系方式</th>
                      <th>会员信息</th>
                      <th>邀请者</th>
                      <th>状态</th>
                      <th 
                        className="sortable-header"
                        onClick={() => handleSort('last_login_at')}
                      >
                        最后登录 {getSortIcon('last_login_at')}
                      </th>
                      <th 
                        className="sortable-header"
                        onClick={() => handleSort('created_at')}
                      >
                        注册时间 {getSortIcon('created_at')}
                      </th>
                      <th>操作</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {users.length > 0 ? (
                      users.map(user => (
                        <tr key={user.id}>
                          <td>
                            <div className="user-info-cell">
                              <span className="user-id">#{user.id}</span>
                              <span className="user-name">{user.username || '-'}</span>
                            </div>
                          </td>
                          <td className="contact-info-td">{renderContactInfo(user)}</td>
                          <td>
                            <div className="subscription-info-cell">
                              {renderSubscriptionPlan(user.subscription)}
                              {renderSubscriptionExpiry(user.subscription)}
                            </div>
                          </td>
                          <td>
                            {user.invited_by ? (
                              <div className="inviter-info-cell">
                                <span className="inviter-id">#{user.invited_by.user_id}</span>
                                <span className="inviter-name">{user.invited_by.username || '-'}</span>
                              </div>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="no-inviter">-</span>
                            )}
                          </td>
                          <td>{getUserStatusLabel(user.status)}</td>
                          <td>
                            <div className="login-info-cell">
                              <div 
                                className="relative-time" 
                                title={formatDate(user.last_login_at)}
                              >
                                {formatRelativeTime(user.last_login_at)}
                              </div>
                              {user.last_login_ip && (
                                <div className="ip-location-cell">
                                  <div className="ip-address">{user.last_login_ip}</div>
                                  {user.last_login_ip_info && (
                                    <div className="location-info">{user.last_login_ip_info}</div>
                                  )}
                                </div>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </td>
                          <td>
                            <div 
                              className="relative-time" 
                              title={formatDate(user.created_at)}
                            >
                              {formatRelativeTime(user.created_at)}
                            </div>
                          </td>
                          <td>
                            <div className="action-buttons">
                              <button
                                className="action-btn view-btn"
                                onClick={(e) => {
                                  e.stopPropagation();
                                  e.preventDefault();
                                  setSelectedUserId(user.id);
                                }}
                                title="查看详情"
                              >
                                详情
                              </button>
                              <button
                                className="action-btn grant-btn"
                                onClick={(e) => {
                                  e.stopPropagation();
                                  e.preventDefault();
                                  handleGrantClick(user);
                                }}
                                title="发放会员"
                              >
                                发放
                              </button>
                              <button
                                className="action-btn delete-btn"
                                onClick={(e) => {
                                  e.stopPropagation();
                                  e.preventDefault();
                                  handleDeleteClick(user);
                                }}
                                title="删除用户"
                              >
                                删除
                              </button>
                            </div>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ))
                    ) : (
                      <tr>
                        <td colSpan="8" className="no-data">暂无用户数据</td>
                      </tr>
                    )}
                  </tbody>
                </table>

                {/* Pagination */}
                {totalPages > 1 && (
                  <div className="pagination">
                    <button
                      className="pagination-btn"
                      onClick={() => handlePageChange(pagination.page - 1)}
                      disabled={pagination.page === 1}
                    >
                      上一页
                    </button>
                    <span className="pagination-info">
                      第 {pagination.page} / {totalPages} 页 (共 {pagination.total} 条)
                    </span>
                    <button
                      className="pagination-btn"
                      onClick={() => handlePageChange(pagination.page + 1)}
                      disabled={pagination.page === totalPages}
                    >
                      下一页
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}
              </>
            )}

            {activeView === 'online' && (
              <table className="user-table">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th>ID</th>
                    <th>邮箱</th>
                    <th>用户名</th>
                    <th>最后活跃时间</th>
                    <th>IP地址/地区</th>
                    <th>设备信息</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {onlineUsersList.length > 0 ? (
                    onlineUsersList.map((user, index) => (
                      <tr key={user.id || index}>
                        <td>{user.id}</td>
                        <td>{user.email || '-'}</td>
                        <td>{user.username || '-'}</td>
                        <td>{formatDate(user.last_activity)}</td>
                        <td>
                          <div className="ip-location-cell">
                            <div className="ip-address">{user.ip || '-'}</div>
                            {user.location && (
                              <div className="location-info">{user.location}</div>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td>
                          <div className="device-info-cell">
                            {user.device || '-'}
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))
                  ) : (
                    <tr>
                      <td colSpan="6" className="no-data">暂无在线用户</td>
                    </tr>
                  )}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Delete Confirmation Modal */}
      {deleteConfirm.show && (
        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={handleDeleteCancel}>
          <div className="modal-content" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div className="modal-header">
              <h3>确认删除用户</h3>
            </div>
            <div className="modal-body">
              <p>您确定要删除用户 <strong>{deleteConfirm.userEmail}</strong> 吗？</p>
              <p className="warning-text">
                ⚠️ 此操作将删除该用户的所有数据（除统计数据外），包括：
              </p>
              <ul className="delete-list">
                <li>用户账号信息</li>
                <li>登录认证信息</li>
                <li>会话记录</li>
                <li>对话历史和消息</li>
                <li>订阅记录</li>
                <li>订单和支付记录</li>
                <li>使用配额记录</li>
              </ul>
              <p className="warning-text">此操作<strong>不可撤销</strong>！</p>
            </div>
            <div className="modal-footer">
              <button className="modal-btn cancel-btn" onClick={handleDeleteCancel}>
                取消
              </button>
              <button className="modal-btn confirm-btn danger-btn" onClick={handleDeleteConfirm}>
                确认删除
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* User Detail Drawer */}
      {selectedUserId && (
        <UserDetailDrawer
          userId={selectedUserId}
          onClose={() => setSelectedUserId(null)}
        />
      )}

      {/* Grant Subscription Modal */}
      {grantModal.show && (
        <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={handleGrantCancel}>
          <div className="modal-content grant-modal" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div className="modal-header">
              <h3>发放会员套餐</h3>
            </div>
            <div className="modal-body">
              <p>为用户 <strong>{grantModal.user?.email || grantModal.user?.username || `ID: ${grantModal.user?.id}`}</strong> 发放会员套餐</p>
              
              <div className="form-group">
                <label>选择套餐</label>
                <select
                  value={grantForm.planCode}
                  onChange={(e) => setGrantForm({ ...grantForm, planCode: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-select"
                >
                  <option value="">请选择套餐</option>
                  {subscriptionPlans.map(plan => (
                    <option key={plan.plan_code} value={plan.plan_code}>
                      {plan.plan_name} - 月付 ¥{plan.current_price_monthly} / 年付 ¥{plan.current_price_yearly}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label>计费周期</label>
                <div className="radio-group">
                  <label className="radio-label">
                    <input
                      type="radio"
                      name="billingCycle"
                      value="monthly"
                      checked={grantForm.billingCycle === 'monthly'}
                      onChange={(e) => setGrantForm({ ...grantForm, billingCycle: e.target.value })}
                    />
                    <span>月付（1个月）</span>
                  </label>
                  <label className="radio-label">
                    <input
                      type="radio"
                      name="billingCycle"
                      value="yearly"
                      checked={grantForm.billingCycle === 'yearly'}
                      onChange={(e) => setGrantForm({ ...grantForm, billingCycle: e.target.value })}
                    />
                    <span>年付（12个月）</span>
                  </label>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="form-group">
                <label>发放原因（选填）</label>
                <textarea
                  value={grantForm.reason}
                  onChange={(e) => setGrantForm({ ...grantForm, reason: e.target.value })}
                  className="form-textarea"
                  placeholder="例如：活动赠送、客服补偿、测试账号等"
                  rows={3}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="grant-info-box">
                <p className="info-title">📋 发放说明</p>
                <ul>
                  <li>系统将创建一笔订单记录，支付方式为"系统发放"</li>
                  <li>订单金额显示为套餐原价，折扣为100%，实付金额为0</li>
                  <li>用户会员状态将立即生效</li>
                  <li>此操作会记录管理员ID和发放原因</li>
                </ul>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="modal-footer">
              <button className="modal-btn cancel-btn" onClick={handleGrantCancel} disabled={grantLoading}>
                取消
              </button>
              <button 
                className="modal-btn confirm-btn primary-btn" 
                onClick={handleGrantConfirm}
                disabled={grantLoading || !grantForm.planCode}
              >
                {grantLoading ? '发放中...' : '确认发放'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default UserManagement;

import axios from 'axios';

// Use relative path so requests go through Nginx reverse proxy
// In production, this will be '' (empty), making requests to /api/v1/*
// In development, you can set REACT_APP_API_URL=http://localhost:8080 for direct backend access
const API_URL = process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL || '';

const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: `${API_URL}/api/v1`,
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  },
});

// Request interceptor to add auth token
api.interceptors.request.use(
  (config) => {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('admin_token');
    if (token) {
      config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
    }
    return config;
  },
  (error) => {
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
);

// Response interceptor to handle errors
api.interceptors.response.use(
  (response) => response,
  (error) => {
    if (error.response?.status === 401) {
      // Unauthorized - clear token and redirect to login
      localStorage.removeItem('admin_token');
      localStorage.removeItem('admin_user');
      window.location.href = '/login';
    }
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
);

export const adminAPI = {
  login: (username, password) =>
    api.post('/admin/login', { username, password }),

  getProfile: () =>
    api.get('/admin/profile'),

  getDashboardStatistics: () =>
    api.get('/admin/dashboard/statistics'),

    api.put('/admin/password', { old_password: oldPassword, new_password: newPassword }),

  createWeChatConfig: (data) =>
    api.post('/admin/wechat/config', data),

  updateWeChatConfig: (id, data) =>
    api.put(`/admin/wechat/config/${id}`, data),

  deleteWeChatConfig: (id) =>
    api.delete(`/admin/wechat/config/${id}`),

  activateWeChatConfig: (id) =>
    api.post(`/admin/wechat/config/${id}/activate`),

  // WeChat Official Account configuration management
  getWeChatOfficialConfig: (showSensitive = false) =>
    api.get('/admin/wechat-official/config', {
      params: showSensitive ? { show_sensitive: 'true' } : {}
    }),

  updateWeChatOfficialConfig: (data) =>
    api.put('/admin/wechat-official/config', data),

  // Order management
  getOrderStatistics: () =>
    api.get('/admin/orders/statistics'),

  getOrders: (page = 1, pageSize = 20, planCode = '', userEmail = '') => {
    const params = { page, page_size: pageSize };
    if (planCode) params.plan_code = planCode;
    if (userEmail) params.user_email = userEmail;
    return api.get('/admin/orders', { params });
  },

  // Coupon management
  getCouponTemplates: (page = 1, pageSize = 20, status = '', distributionType = '') => {
    const params = { page, page_size: pageSize };
    if (status) params.status = status;
    if (distributionType) params.distribution_type = distributionType;
    return api.get('/admin/coupon-templates', { params });
  },

  getCouponTemplate: (id) =>
    api.get(`/admin/coupon-templates/${id}`),

  createCouponTemplate: (data) =>
    api.post('/admin/coupon-templates', data),

  updateCouponTemplate: (id, data) =>
    api.put(`/admin/coupon-templates/${id}`, data),

  deleteCouponTemplate: (id) =>
    api.delete(`/admin/coupon-templates/${id}`),

  activateCouponTemplate: (id) =>
    api.post(`/admin/coupon-templates/${id}/activate`),

  pauseCouponTemplate: (id) =>
    api.post(`/admin/coupon-templates/${id}/pause`),

  distributeCoupons: (data) =>
    api.post('/admin/coupons/distribute', data),

  getDistributedCoupons: (page = 1, pageSize = 20, templateId = '', status = '', userEmail = '') => {
    const params = { page, page_size: pageSize };
    if (templateId) params.template_id = templateId;
    if (status) params.status = status;
    if (userEmail) params.user_email = userEmail;
    return api.get('/admin/coupons/distributed', { params });
  },

  getCouponStatistics: () =>
    api.get('/admin/coupons/statistics'),

  getCouponBatches: (page = 1, pageSize = 20, status = '') => {
    const params = { page, page_size: pageSize };
    if (status) params.status = status;
    return api.get('/admin/coupon-batches', { params });
  },

  getCouponBatch: (id) =>
    api.get(`/admin/coupon-batches/${id}`),

  createCouponBatch: (data) =>
    api.post('/admin/coupon-batches', data),

  executeCouponBatch: (id) =>
    api.post(`/admin/coupon-batches/${id}/execute`),

  cancelCouponBatch: (id) =>
    api.post(`/admin/coupon-batches/${id}/cancel`),

  // Analysis dimensions management (默认业务数据)
  getAnalysisDimensions: () =>
    api.get('/admin/analysis/dimensions'),

  updateAnalysisDimension: (id, data) =>
    api.put(`/admin/analysis/dimensions/${id}`, data),

  // Feedback management
  getFeedbacks: (params = {}) => {
    const queryParams = {
      page: params.page || 1,
      pageSize: params.pageSize || 20,
    };
    if (params.status) queryParams.status = params.status;
    if (params.email) queryParams.email = params.email;
    if (params.keyword) queryParams.keyword = params.keyword;
    if (params.startDate) queryParams.startDate = params.startDate;
    if (params.endDate) queryParams.endDate = params.endDate;
    return api.get('/admin/feedbacks', { params: queryParams });
  },

  getFeedback: (id) =>
    api.get(`/admin/feedbacks/${id}`),

  getFeedbackStats: () =>
    api.get('/admin/feedbacks/stats'),

  updateFeedbackStatus: (id, status) =>
    api.put(`/admin/feedbacks/${id}/status`, { status }),

  replyFeedback: (id, replyContent) =>
    api.post(`/admin/feedbacks/${id}/reply`, { replyContent }),

  deleteFeedback: (id) =>
    api.delete(`/admin/feedbacks/${id}`),
};

export default api;

// ========== 文件: frontend-admin/src/utils/AuthContext.js ==========
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * Scholay学术 V1.0
 * Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
 * 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
 * All Rights Reserved.
 * ============================================================================
 */

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from 'react';

const AuthContext = createContext(null);

export const AuthProvider = ({ children }) => {
  const [isAuthenticated, setIsAuthenticated] = useState(false);
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Check for existing token on mount
    const token = localStorage.getItem('admin_token');
    const userData = localStorage.getItem('admin_user');

    if (token && userData) {
      setIsAuthenticated(true);
      setUser(JSON.parse(userData));
    }
    setLoading(false);
  }, []);

  const login = (token, userData) => {
    localStorage.setItem('admin_token', token);
    localStorage.setItem('admin_user', JSON.stringify(userData));
    setIsAuthenticated(true);
    setUser(userData);
  };

  const logout = () => {
    localStorage.removeItem('admin_token');
    localStorage.removeItem('admin_user');
    setIsAuthenticated(false);
    setUser(null);
  };

  const value = {
    isAuthenticated,
    user,
    login,
    logout,
    loading,
  };

  return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>;
};

export const useAuth = () => {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

// Production-safe logging utility
// This utility will only log in development mode

const isDevelopment = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' || process.env.REACT_APP_ENABLE_LOGS === 'true';

export const logger = {
  log: (...args) => {
    if (isDevelopment) {
      console.log(...args);
    }
  },
  error: (...args) => {
    // Always log errors, even in production
    console.error(...args);
  },
  warn: (...args) => {
    if (isDevelopment) {
      console.warn(...args);
    }
  },
  info: (...args) => {
    if (isDevelopment) {
      console.info(...args);
    }
  }
};

export default logger;

/* View Transitions API - 页面切换动画 */
@supports (view-transition-name: search-composer) {
  /* 搜索框的过渡动画 - 交叉淡化效果 */
  ::view-transition-old(search-composer),
  ::view-transition-new(search-composer) {
    animation-duration: 0.4s;
    animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    /* 混合模式让新旧元素同时显示 */
    mix-blend-mode: normal;
  }

  /* 旧元素淡出 */
  ::view-transition-old(search-composer) {
    animation-name: composer-fade-out;
  }

  /* 新元素淡入 */
  ::view-transition-new(search-composer) {
    animation-name: composer-fade-in;
  }

  @keyframes composer-fade-out {
    from {
      opacity: 1;
    }
    to {
      opacity: 0;
    }
  }

  @keyframes composer-fade-in {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
    }
    to {
      opacity: 1;
    }
  }

  /* 页面根元素的过渡动画 - 更快速 */
  ::view-transition-old(root),
  ::view-transition-new(root) {
    animation-duration: 0.25s;
    animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  }

  /* 让根元素的过渡更加平滑 */
  ::view-transition-old(root) {
    animation-name: root-fade-out;
  }

  ::view-transition-new(root) {
    animation-name: root-fade-in;
  }

  @keyframes root-fade-out {
    from {
      opacity: 1;
    }
    to {
      opacity: 0;
    }
  }

  @keyframes root-fade-in {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
    }
    to {
      opacity: 1;
    }
  }
}

-- ========== 文件: docker/mysql/init/01_schema.sql ==========
-- ============================================================================
-- Scholay学术 V1.0
-- Copyright (c) 2025 成都恩特罐罐文化科技有限公司
-- 统一社会信用代码: 91510100MAEEHRNE26
-- All Rights Reserved.
-- ============================================================================

-- ============================================
-- Scholar Database Schema
-- 此文件包含所有表结构、索引定义
-- 注意: 仅包含DDL语句，不包含数据
-- ============================================

SET NAMES utf8mb4;
SET CHARACTER SET utf8mb4;
SET foreign_key_checks = 0;

-- ============================================
-- 核心用户和认证表
-- ============================================

-- 管理员用户表
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `admin_users` (
  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `username` VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  `password_hash` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  `email` VARCHAR(100),
  `status` TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '1=active, 0=inactive',
  `last_login_at` DATETIME,
  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE INDEX `uk_username` (`username`),
  INDEX `idx_status` (`status`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='管理员用户表';

-- 用户表（支持多种认证方式）
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `users` (
  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `username` VARCHAR(50),
  `email` VARCHAR(100),
  `phone` VARCHAR(20),
  `password_hash` VARCHAR(255),
  `avatar_url` VARCHAR(255),
  `bio` TEXT COMMENT '用户简介',
  `location` VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '用户位置',
  `website` VARCHAR(255) COMMENT '个人网站',
  `status` TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '1=active, 0=inactive, 2=suspended',
  `email_verified` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  `phone_verified` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  `subscription_plan` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'free' COMMENT 'free, pro, max',
  `subscription_expires_at` DATETIME COMMENT '订阅过期时间（免费用户为NULL）',
  `last_login_at` DATETIME,
  `last_login_ip` VARCHAR(45) COMMENT '最后登录IP',
  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE INDEX `uk_username` (`username`),
  UNIQUE INDEX `uk_email` (`email`),
  UNIQUE INDEX `uk_phone` (`phone`),
  INDEX `idx_status` (`status`),
  INDEX `idx_subscription_plan` (`subscription_plan`),
  INDEX `idx_location` (`location`),
  INDEX `idx_last_login_at` (`last_login_at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='用户表';

-- 用户认证提供者（OAuth、微信等）
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `user_auth_providers` (
  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `provider` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT 'email, phone, wechat, google等',
  `provider_user_id` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL COMMENT '第三方平台用户ID（微信为openID）',
  `provider_union_id` VARCHAR(255) COMMENT '第三方平台联合ID（微信UnionID，用于跨应用识别同一用户）',
  `provider_data` JSON COMMENT '第三方平台额外数据',
  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_provider_user` (`provider`, `provider_user_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_provider_union` (`provider`, `provider_union_id`),
  INDEX `idx_user_id` (`user_id`),
  INDEX `idx_union_id` (`provider_union_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_user_auth_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='用户认证提供者';

-- ============================================
-- 会话和统计表
-- ============================================

-- 用户会话（在线状态跟踪）
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `user_sessions` (
  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `token` VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
  `ip` VARCHAR(45),
  `user_agent` VARCHAR(500),
  `last_activity` DATETIME NOT NULL,
  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `expires_at` DATETIME NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  INDEX `idx_user_id` (`user_id`),
  INDEX `idx_token` (`token`(64)),  -- Optimized: index only first 64 chars to reduce storage overhead
  -- Removed redundant single-column indexes that are covered by composite indexes
  INDEX `idx_active_sessions` (`last_activity`, `expires_at`),
  INDEX `idx_user_activity` (`user_id`, `last_activity` DESC),
  FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='用户会话';

-- 用户统计（每日汇总数据）
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `user_statistics` (
  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `date` DATE NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '统计日期',
  `new_users` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '当日新增用户',
  `total_users` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '累计用户总数',
  `peak_online_users` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '当日最高在线用户数',
  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE INDEX `uk_date` (`date`),
  INDEX `idx_date` (`date`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='每日用户统计';

-- 在线用户快照（实时图表数据）
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `online_user_snapshots` (
  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `timestamp` DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT '快照时间',
  `online_count` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '在线用户数',
  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  INDEX `idx_timestamp` (`timestamp`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='在线用户快照';

-- ============================================
-- 对话和消息表
-- ============================================

-- 对话表
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `conversations` (
  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `title` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL COMMENT '对话标题（从首条消息生成）',
  `conversation_type` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'search' COMMENT 'chat或search',
  `model_level` VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'low' COMMENT '模型级别: low, mid, high',
  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  INDEX `idx_user_id` (`user_id`),
  INDEX `idx_updated_at` (`updated_at`),
  INDEX `idx_conversation_type` (`conversation_type`),
  INDEX `idx_user_type` (`user_id`, `conversation_type`),
  INDEX `idx_user_updated` (`user_id`, `updated_at` DESC),
  INDEX `idx_user_type_updated` (`user_id`, `conversation_type`, `updated_at` DESC),
  FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='用户对话历史';

-- 对话消息表（支持消息链）
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `conversation_messages` (
  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `message_id` VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL COMMENT '消息UUID',
  `conversation_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `parent_message_id` VARCHAR(36) COMMENT '父消息ID（支持分支）',
  `role` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT 'user, assistant, system',
  `content` TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '消息内容',
  `search_query` VARCHAR(500) COMMENT '搜索查询（如果是搜索消息）',
  `search_results` JSON COMMENT 'Semantic Scholar搜索结果',
  `search_results_total` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '搜索结果总数',
  `follow_up_questions` TEXT COMMENT '延伸思考问题（仅最新一轮assistant消息保存）',
  `token_count` INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT 'Token计数',
  `model` VARCHAR(50) COMMENT 'AI模型',
  `finish_reason` VARCHAR(20) COMMENT '完成原因',
  `error` BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE COMMENT '是否出错',
  `unfinished` BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE COMMENT '是否未完成',
  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE INDEX `uk_message_id` (`message_id`),
  INDEX `idx_conversation_id` (`conversation_id`),
  INDEX `idx_parent_message_id` (`parent_message_id`),
  INDEX `idx_created_at` (`created_at`),
  INDEX `idx_conversation_created` (`conversation_id`, `created_at`),
  INDEX `idx_message_chain` (`conversation_id`, `parent_message_id`, `created_at`),
  INDEX `idx_parent` (`parent_message_id`, `conversation_id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`conversation_id`) REFERENCES `conversations`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='对话消息';

-- ============================================

-- 订阅计划表
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `subscription_plans` (
  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `plan_code` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT '计划代码: free, pro, max',
  `plan_name` VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '计划名称',
  `price_monthly` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00 COMMENT '月费原价',
  `current_price_monthly` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00 COMMENT '月费实时价格',
  `price_yearly` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00 COMMENT '年费原价',
  `current_price_yearly` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00 COMMENT '年费实时价格',
  `yearly_discount_enabled` TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '年费是否使用折扣计算: 1=使用折扣, 0=直接定价',
  `yearly_discount_percent` DECIMAL(5,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00 COMMENT '年费折扣百分比(0-100)',
  `features` JSON NOT NULL COMMENT '计划功能和配额',
  `is_active` TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '1=启用, 0=停用',
  `sort_order` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '显示顺序',
  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE INDEX `uk_plan_code` (`plan_code`),
  INDEX `idx_is_active` (`is_active`),
  INDEX `idx_sort_order` (`sort_order`),
  INDEX `idx_active_type` (`is_active`, `plan_code`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='订阅计划';

-- ============================================
-- 订单和支付表
-- ============================================

-- 订单表
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `orders` (
  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `order_no` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '订单号',
  `plan_code` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT '订阅计划代码',
  `plan_name` VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '下单时的计划名称',
  `billing_cycle` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT 'monthly或yearly',
  `amount` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL COMMENT '订单原价（折扣前）',
  `coupon_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED COMMENT '使用的折扣券ID',
  `discount_amount` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00 COMMENT '折扣金额',
  `final_amount` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL COMMENT '最终支付金额（折扣后）',
  `status` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' COMMENT 'pending, paid, cancelled, refunded',
  `payment_method` VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '支付方式',
  `payment_time` DATETIME COMMENT '支付完成时间',
  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE INDEX `uk_order_no` (`order_no`),
  INDEX `idx_user_id` (`user_id`),
  INDEX `idx_coupon_id` (`coupon_id`),
  INDEX `idx_status` (`status`),
  INDEX `idx_created_at` (`created_at`),
  INDEX `idx_user_created` (`user_id`, `created_at` DESC),
  INDEX `idx_status_created` (`status`, `created_at` DESC),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_orders_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='订阅订单';

-- 支付交易表
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `payment_transactions` (
  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `order_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `transaction_no` VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '外部交易号',
  `payment_method` VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '支付方式',
  `amount` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
  `status` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' COMMENT 'pending, success, failed',
  `payment_data` JSON COMMENT '支付额外数据',
  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  INDEX `idx_order_id` (`order_id`),
  INDEX `idx_transaction_no` (`transaction_no`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_payment_order` FOREIGN KEY (`order_id`) REFERENCES `orders` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='支付交易记录';

-- ============================================
-- 折扣券系统表
-- ============================================

-- 折扣券模板表
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `coupon_templates` (
  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `code` VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '折扣券代码',
  `name` VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '折扣券名称',
  `description` TEXT COMMENT '折扣券描述',
  `type` ENUM('percentage', 'fixed', 'price_off') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'percentage' COMMENT '折扣类型',
  `discount_value` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL COMMENT '折扣值',

  -- 使用条件
  `min_purchase_amount` DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '最低消费金额',
  `applicable_plans` JSON COMMENT '适用的订阅计划ID列表',
  `applicable_products` JSON COMMENT '适用的产品类型列表',

  -- 发放规则
  `distribution_type` ENUM('manual', 'auto_invite', 'auto_register', 'batch', 'targeted') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual' COMMENT '发放类型',

  -- 时间限制
  `valid_days` INT DEFAULT 30 COMMENT '有效天数（从领取时开始计算）',
  `fixed_valid_start` DATETIME COMMENT '固定有效开始时间',
  `fixed_valid_end` DATETIME COMMENT '固定有效结束时间',

  -- 使用限制
  `max_usage_total` INT DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '总使用次数限制',
  `max_usage_per_user` INT DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '每用户使用次数限制',
  `first_purchase_only` BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE COMMENT '仅限首次购买',
  `new_user_only` BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE COMMENT '仅限新用户',

  -- 状态管理
  `status` ENUM('draft', 'active', 'paused', 'expired') DEFAULT 'draft' COMMENT '状态',
  `priority` INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '优先级',

  -- 邀请相关
  `is_invite_coupon` BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE COMMENT '是否为邀请折扣券',
  `inviter_benefit` JSON COMMENT '邀请人奖励配置',

  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `created_by` BIGINT UNSIGNED COMMENT '创建人ID',

  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_code` (`code`),
  INDEX `idx_status_type` (`status`, `distribution_type`),
  INDEX `idx_valid_time` (`fixed_valid_start`, `fixed_valid_end`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='折扣券模板表';

-- 用户折扣券表
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `user_coupons` (
  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '用户ID',
  `template_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '折扣券模板ID',
  `coupon_code` VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '折扣券唯一码',

  -- 来源追踪
  `source_type` ENUM('manual', 'invite', 'register', 'batch', 'targeted', 'activity') NOT NULL COMMENT '获取方式',
  `source_id` VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '来源ID',
  `source_detail` JSON COMMENT '来源详情',

  -- 有效期
  `valid_from` DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT '生效时间',
  `valid_until` DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT '失效时间',

  -- 使用状态
  `status` ENUM('unused', 'reserved', 'used', 'expired', 'cancelled') DEFAULT 'unused' COMMENT '状态: unused=未使用, reserved=已预留, used=已使用, expired=已过期, cancelled=已取消',
  `used_at` DATETIME COMMENT '使用时间',
  `used_order_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED COMMENT '使用订单ID',

  -- 折扣信息（冗余存储）
  `discount_type` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT '折扣类型',
  `discount_value` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL COMMENT '折扣值',
  `min_purchase_amount` DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '最低消费金额',

  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_coupon_code` (`coupon_code`),
  INDEX `idx_user_status` (`user_id`, `status`),
  INDEX `idx_template` (`template_id`),
  INDEX `idx_valid_time` (`valid_from`, `valid_until`),
  INDEX `idx_source` (`source_type`, `source_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_user_coupon_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_user_coupon_template` FOREIGN KEY (`template_id`) REFERENCES `coupon_templates` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='用户折扣券表';

-- 折扣券使用记录表
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `coupon_usage_logs` (
  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_coupon_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '用户折扣券ID',
  `user_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '用户ID',
  `order_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '订单ID',

  `original_amount` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL COMMENT '原始金额',
  `discount_amount` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL COMMENT '折扣金额',
  `final_amount` DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL COMMENT '最终金额',

  `status` ENUM('applied', 'confirmed', 'refunded') DEFAULT 'applied' COMMENT '状态',

  `applied_at` DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '应用时间',
  `confirmed_at` DATETIME COMMENT '确认时间',
  `refunded_at` DATETIME COMMENT '退款时间',

  `metadata` JSON COMMENT '额外信息',

  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  INDEX `idx_user_coupon` (`user_coupon_id`),
  INDEX `idx_user` (`user_id`),
  INDEX `idx_order` (`order_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_usage_log_user_coupon` FOREIGN KEY (`user_coupon_id`) REFERENCES `user_coupons` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_usage_log_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_usage_log_order` FOREIGN KEY (`order_id`) REFERENCES `orders` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='折扣券使用记录表';

-- 折扣券批次表
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `coupon_batches` (
  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `batch_code` VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '批次号',
  `template_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '折扣券模板ID',
  `name` VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '批次名称',
  `description` TEXT COMMENT '批次描述',

  -- 发放规则
  `target_type` ENUM('all', 'new_users', 'paid_users', 'specific_users', 'user_group') NOT NULL COMMENT '目标用户类型',
  `target_users` JSON COMMENT '特定用户ID列表',
  `target_conditions` JSON COMMENT '用户筛选条件',

  `total_quantity` INT NOT NULL COMMENT '发放总量',
  `distributed_quantity` INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '已发放数量',
  `used_quantity` INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '已使用数量',

  `status` ENUM('draft', 'processing', 'completed', 'cancelled') DEFAULT 'draft',

  `scheduled_at` DATETIME COMMENT '计划发放时间',
  `started_at` DATETIME COMMENT '开始发放时间',
  `completed_at` DATETIME COMMENT '完成时间',

  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `created_by` BIGINT UNSIGNED COMMENT '创建人ID',

  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_batch_code` (`batch_code`),
  INDEX `idx_template` (`template_id`),
  INDEX `idx_status` (`status`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_batch_template` FOREIGN KEY (`template_id`) REFERENCES `coupon_templates` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='折扣券批次表';

-- 论文AI分析结果缓存表（动态维度设计）
-- 同一篇论文可以有多条记录，对应不同的维度配置（dimension_hash）
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `paper_analysis` (
  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `paper_id` VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '论文ID（来自Semantic Scholar）',
  `paper_title` VARCHAR(500) COMMENT '论文标题',
  `dimension_hash` VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT '维度配置哈希，用于判断缓存是否匹配当前维度配置',
  `analysis_data` TEXT COMMENT 'JSON格式的分析结果 {"dimensionKey": "分析内容", ...}',
  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE INDEX `uk_paper_dimension` (`paper_id`, `dimension_hash`),
  INDEX `idx_dimension_hash` (`dimension_hash`),
  INDEX `idx_created_at` (`created_at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='论文AI分析结果缓存（动态维度）';

- 具有一定的探索性和前瞻性
- 涵盖不同角度（技术深化、应用拓展、跨领域融合、伦理思考等）
- 能够引发深入讨论
- 每个问题都应该简洁明了，一句话即可

请直接输出问题列表，不要有其他内容。',
'用于基于分析内容生成延伸思考问题，使用low模型独立调用',
'{"query": {"type": "string", "description": "User query", "example": "Transformer架构"}, "analysis": {"type": "string", "description": "Completed analysis content", "example": "## 研究领域概览\\n..."}}',

-- ============================================
-- 论文分析维度表
-- ============================================

-- 分析维度定义表（支持系统默认和用户自定义）
-- user_id = -1 表示系统默认维度，user_id > 0 表示用户自定义维度
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `analysis_dimensions` (
  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT -1 COMMENT '用户ID，-1表示系统默认维度，>0表示用户自定义',
  `dimension_key` VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '维度标识符（如 studyType, bigDataFocus）',
  `name` VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '维度名称（显示用）',
  `description` TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '维度解释/分析指示',
  `sort_order` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '排序顺序',
  `is_active` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',
  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE INDEX `uk_user_dimension` (`user_id`, `dimension_key`),
  INDEX `idx_user_id` (`user_id`),
  INDEX `idx_dimension_key` (`dimension_key`),
  INDEX `idx_sort_order` (`sort_order`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='论文分析维度定义表';

-- ============================================
-- AI审稿人系统表
-- ============================================

-- 审稿任务表（主表）
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `peer_review_tasks` (
  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '用户ID',
  `input_type` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'text' COMMENT '输入类型: text=文本, file=文件',
  `manuscript_text` LONGTEXT COMMENT '稿件文本内容',
  `file_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED COMMENT '关联的文件ID',
  `file_name` VARCHAR(500) COMMENT '上传的文件名',
  `manuscript_hash` VARCHAR(64) COMMENT '内容哈希，用于缓存',
  `title` VARCHAR(500) COMMENT '稿件标题（从内容中提取）',
  `target_venue` VARCHAR(255) COMMENT '目标期刊/会议',
  `model_level` VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'mid' COMMENT '模型级别: low, mid, high',
  
  -- 任务状态
  `status` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' COMMENT '状态: pending=等待处理, processing=处理中, completed=已完成, failed=失败',
  `progress` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '进度百分比 0-100',
  `progress_stage` VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '当前阶段描述',
  `error_message` TEXT COMMENT '错误信息',
  
  -- 处理结果（JSON存储）
  `manuscript_meta` TEXT COMMENT '稿件元信息 JSON',
  `literature_context` TEXT COMMENT '文献上下文 JSON',
  `literature_summary` TEXT COMMENT '文献总结 JSON',
  `gap_literature` TEXT COMMENT '研究空白相关文献 JSON',
  `review_content` LONGTEXT COMMENT 'Markdown格式的审稿报告',
  `recommendation` VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '最终推荐: Accept, Minor Revision, Major Revision, Reject',
  
  -- 时间戳
  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `started_at` DATETIME COMMENT '开始处理时间',
  `completed_at` DATETIME COMMENT '完成时间',
  
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  INDEX `idx_user_id` (`user_id`),
  INDEX `idx_status` (`status`),
  INDEX `idx_user_status` (`user_id`, `status`),
  INDEX `idx_user_created` (`user_id`, `created_at` DESC),
  INDEX `idx_manuscript_hash` (`manuscript_hash`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_peer_review_task_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='AI审稿任务表';

-- 审稿文件表（存储上传的文件）
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `peer_review_files` (
  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '用户ID',
  `file_name` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL COMMENT '原始文件名',
  `file_type` VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '文件类型: docx, doc, txt, pdf',
  `file_size` BIGINT COMMENT '文件大小（字节）',
  `file_path` VARCHAR(500) COMMENT '存储路径（可选）',
  `extracted_text` LONGTEXT COMMENT '提取的文本内容',
  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  INDEX `idx_user_id` (`user_id`),
  INDEX `idx_created_at` (`created_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_peer_review_file_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='AI审稿文件表';

-- 为审稿任务表添加文件外键
ALTER TABLE `peer_review_tasks` 
ADD CONSTRAINT `fk_peer_review_task_file` FOREIGN KEY (`file_id`) REFERENCES `peer_review_files` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL;

-- ============================================
-- 反馈系统表
-- ============================================

-- 用户反馈表
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `feedbacks` (
  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `email` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL COMMENT '反馈者邮箱',
  `content` TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '反馈内容',
  `attachments` TEXT COMMENT '附件列表（JSON格式，已废弃，改用feedback_attachments表）',
  `user_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED COMMENT '用户ID（登录用户，匿名为NULL）',
  `username` VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '用户名（登录用户）',
  `ip` VARCHAR(45) COMMENT '反馈者IP',
  `ip_location` VARCHAR(255) COMMENT 'IP归属地',
  `status` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' COMMENT '状态: pending=待处理, processed=已处理, replied=已回复, closed=已关闭',
  `reply_content` TEXT COMMENT '回复内容',
  `replied_at` DATETIME COMMENT '回复时间',
  `replied_by` VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '回复人',
  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  INDEX `idx_email` (`email`),
  INDEX `idx_user_id` (`user_id`),
  INDEX `idx_status` (`status`),
  INDEX `idx_created_at` (`created_at`),
  INDEX `idx_status_created` (`status`, `created_at` DESC),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_feedback_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='用户反馈表';

-- 反馈附件表
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `feedback_attachments` (
  `id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `upload_key` VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL COMMENT '上传批次key（UUID），用于关联未提交的附件',
  `feedback_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED COMMENT '关联的反馈ID（提交后填充）',
  `original_name` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL COMMENT '原始文件名',
  `file_data` LONGBLOB NOT NULL COMMENT '文件二进制数据',
  `file_size` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '文件大小（字节）',
  `file_type` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT '文件类型: image=图片, file=文件',
  `mime_type` VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT 'MIME类型',
  `is_used` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE COMMENT '是否已被使用（关联到反馈）',
  `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  INDEX `idx_upload_key` (`upload_key`),
  INDEX `idx_feedback_id` (`feedback_id`),
  INDEX `idx_is_used` (`is_used`),
  INDEX `idx_created_at` (`created_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_attachment_feedback` FOREIGN KEY (`feedback_id`) REFERENCES `feedbacks` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='反馈附件表';

-- ============================================
-- 数据库迁移：为 peer_review_tasks 添加 file_name 字段
-- ============================================
SET @exist := (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS 
               WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() 
               AND TABLE_NAME = 'peer_review_tasks' 
               AND COLUMN_NAME = 'file_name');
SET @sql := IF(@exist = 0, 
    'ALTER TABLE `peer_review_tasks` ADD COLUMN `file_name` VARCHAR(500) COMMENT ''上传的文件名'' AFTER `file_id`', 
    'SELECT 1');
PREPARE stmt FROM @sql;
EXECUTE stmt;
DEALLOCATE PREPARE stmt;
